An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the safety of a family recently deported from the Netherlands to Burundi, and whether other deportations had occurred. The State Secretary said the embassy checked on the family and found their safety was not at stake, that the family was the only one deported to Burundi this year, and that a six-month deportation and return moratorium was imposed with a general country report requested.
The family is the only one deported to Burundi this year.
Het gezin is het enige dat dit jaar is uitgezet naar Burundi.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen, Kuiken, Voortman en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat opvang wordt geweigerd aan (zieke) vreemdelingen die bereid zijn om het land te verlaten

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary whether asylum seekers willing to leave the Netherlands are being refused shelter at Ter Apel, including sick ones, and why the buitenschuld regime and the motions on voluntary return and bed-bad-brood arrangements are not reflected. The state secretary denied the premise, explained that shelter is conditional on demonstrated active cooperation with return, and stated that medically necessary care is available with a possible deferral of departure under article 64 Vw.
It is generally correct that not all foreigners who request shelter at the VBL are actually admitted to the VBL.
Het is in algemene zin juist dat niet alle vreemdelingen die verzoeken om onderdak in de VBL daadwerkelijk tot de VBL worden toegelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de voortgang van het openbaren van nieuwe categorieën overheidsinformatie

MP Voortman asks the Minister of Interior when the AEF study and cabinet appraisal on publishing new categories of government information will reach parliament, and what 'scaling up' of the pilots means. The minister replies the report and cabinet response will be sent before the summer recess, and describes ministry pilots on publishing research reports and open spending data at local level.
The report 'Steen voor steen de rivier over' by Andersson Elffers Felix and the cabinet response to that report will be sent to the House of Representatives before the summer recess.
Het rapport «Steen voor steen de rivier over» van Andersson Elffers Felix (AEF) en de kabinetsreactie op dat rapport, verzend ik voor het zomerreces aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de bezuinigingen op projectgezinnen

An MP asks the state secretary whether cuts to project families in youth care conflict with the Youth Act and what happens to children placed there, and whether pleegouders deserve support. The secretary answers that suitable care stays central, that project families are professional care rather than foster parents, and that the provider Horizon is seeking alternatives and possibly continuity, with TAJ available for mediation.
Horizon indicated in its intended decision to the project parents that it will look for suitable help for the children together with them.
Horizon heeft in haar voorgenomen besluit aan de projectouders aangegeven dat er met hen wordt gezocht naar passende hulp voor de kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de World Health Assembly

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the Dutch role at the 2016 World Health Assembly and pressed for a stronger international framework on R&D financing and affordable medicines, such as a convention or a second Open-Ended Meeting. The Minister described the Dutch delegation and EU presidency role, said the adopted resolution goes beyond an observatory, and stated that a binding convention is not currently feasible while a second Open-Ended Meeting is for the 70th Assembly to consider.
An international agreement or Convention is currently not a feasible option.
Een internationale overeenkomst of Conventie is momenteel geen haalbare kaart.
Antwoord op het vragen van lid Voortman over het bericht dat EU-diplomaten onderhandelen over een vluchtelingendeal met een van de Libische regeringen

An MP asked the government about reports that EU diplomats were negotiating a migration deal with a Libyan government, and about the Dutch role, the prospects of such a deal given Libya's instability, and rescue capacity on the Italy route. The minister replied that no broad migration agreement is under negotiation, that Libya cannot yet be a safe third country, that Dutch support is limited to coast guard and migration projects, and that EU operations already contribute to rescues.
There is, however, no question of negotiations on a broad migration agreement between the EU and Libya.
Er is echter geen sprake van onderhandelingen over een breed migratie-akkoord tussen de EU en Libië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Voortman en Karabulut over de arbeidsomstandigheden van de beveiliging op Schiphol

Three MPs asked whether working conditions for airport security staff at Schiphol had improved despite earlier promises, whether TNO's dwell-time recommendations were implemented, and whether Schiphol as client should be held to account, including whether security should return to a public body. Minister Asscher answered that employers and CAO parties are responsible, that the Inspectorate has received no complaints, that a new TNO report recommends a 120-minute dwell limit under review by June, and that no public body is needed.

Schiphol and the security companies have indicated that, until the new TNO report's recommendations are translated into practical and feasible dwell-time agreements, the current CAO norm of a maximum dwell time of 150 minutes is strictly observed.

Schiphol en de beveiligingsbedrijven hebben aangegeven dat, totdat de aanbevelingen uit het nieuwe TNO-rapport zijn vertaald in praktische en haalbare afspraken over statijden, de norm die in de huidige CAO staat – een maximale statijd van 150 minuten – strikt wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Ulenbelt en Van Raak over riante beloning van de top van UWV

MPs Voortman, Ulenbelt and Van Raak asked why UWV top officials earn above the WNT pay cap, whether transitional rules and side jobs can be stopped, and whether the transitional arrangement should end. Minister Asscher answered that UWV complies with the WNT, that remaining above-cap pay is protected by transitional law and European property rights, and that side functions are permitted if done in own time.
UWV has informed me that it will enter into discussion with the non-top officials concerned about their remuneration relative to the WNT maximum.
UWV heeft mij laten weten met betrokken niet-topfunctionarissen het gesprek aan te gaan over hun bezoldiging in verhouding tot het vastgestelde bezoldigingsmaximum van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over privacy in de zorg

An MP asked the health minister about patient data privacy in care, including the Dutch data protection authority's open letter, its finding that WhatsApp does not meet the standard for sharing sensitive data, and a privacy-friendly pilot. The minister answered that an independent study of how hospitals and mental health institutions protect patient data will be commissioned with results expected end 2016, that safer alternatives to WhatsApp should be developed, and that existing initiatives will be supported through the Informatieberaad programme and the pending data exchange law.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Bruins Slot, Bergkamp, Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over een verzekeraar die wijkverpleegkundigen passeert met nieuw pgb-beleid

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about insurer CZ's new policy limiting which home-care nurses may assess persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) eligibility, designating preferred organisations per region, and whether this restricts budget-holders' choice. The State Secretary answered that CZ's approach is within the agreed rules, budget-holders remain free to choose other providers with reduced reimbursement, the insurer has at least two providers per region, and an AMvB will be sent to parliament with a letter on the motion.
Control lies in all cases with the PGB holder.
De regie ligt in alle gevallen bij de pgb-houder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Grashoff over het oplossen van de problematiek rondom het zogenaamde ‘papieren inkomen’

MPs Voortman and Grashoff asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs about the unresolved problem of 'papieren inkomen' arising from debt-forgiveness of Bbz start-up loans, which raises tax-credit (toeslag) income tests. The government confirms the problem persists, says a structural fix via taxation is under study with municipalities and other departments, promises to inform the Ombudsman and the House by year-end, and defers any retroactive arrangement.
Once a solution is in view, we will inform the Ombudsman and the House of Representatives.
Als een oplossing in beeld is, zullen wij de Ombudsman en de Tweede Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat er meer aanwijzingen zijn voor asieltolken met banden met het dictatoriale regime in Eritrea

MPs Voortman and Sjoerdsma asked about reports that IND interpreters for asylum procedures may have ties to the Eritrean regime, and about the BV&I report, prior IND investigations, AIVD involvement, handling of other interpreters, notification of other employers, and the adequacy of IND selection and controls. The State Secretary declined to share individual dossiers, said the IND followed the code of conduct in 2014, reported that other Eritrean interpreters were invited for interviews with further investigation ongoing, and announced an external review of the integrity process.

As I already explained during the committee meeting of 12 November, I do not consider it correct to share dossiers on individual persons with whom a working relationship exists or has existed with the House.

Zoals ik tijdens het AO van 12 november jl. reeds heb toegelicht, acht ik het niet correct om dossiers over individuele personen met wie een werkrelatie bestaat, of heeft bestaan, met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat COA-personeel een asielzoeker heeft ontmoedigd om aangifte te doen van discriminatie en bedreiging

MP Voortman asked the State Secretary about reports that COA staff discouraged an asylum seeker from reporting discrimination and threats, and about oversight of COA staff conduct, complaint procedures, and sanctions against troublesome residents. The State Secretary denied that staff discouraged reporting, described COA codes of conduct, complaint rules and inspection oversight, rejected a separate confidant for vulnerable groups, and reported 7,470 sanctions imposed in 2015 with a stricter sanctions approach promised for March.
Enquiries with the COA have shown me that there was no question of discouraging the filing of a report.
Uit navraag bij het COA is mij gebleken dat hier geen sprake is geweest van het ontmoedigen van het doen van aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de schending van privacy door gemeenten in de jeugdzorg

An MP asked the state secretary why he has not answered earlier questions on how many municipalities have unlawfully requested personal data or breached confidentiality in youth care since 2015, and whether he tracks this and trusts councils to supervise privacy. The state secretary said he does not track these numbers, that supervision is local and by the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and that he sees no need for extra measures beyond existing programmes.
I do not keep data on that.
Ik houd daar geen gegevens van bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman en Van der Staaij over voorlichting aan asielzoekers in Nederland

MPs Voordewind, Voortman and Van der Staaij asked whether information for asylum seekers in reception centres is limited to LHBT groups, whether incidents involving asylum seekers are registered, whether incidents are more frequent in emergency reception locations, and whether an independent confidential person should be appointed. The minister answered that COA is consulting on broader information covering Christians, atheists and other minorities, that incidents are not registered by asylum status or sexual orientation, that the data do not show more incidents in larger locations, and that the government sees no added value in a separate confidential person.
The sexual orientation of a resident is not registered in COA's systems.
De seksuele gerichtheid van een bewoner wordt in de systemen van het COA niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat door redders wordt toegekeken bij het verdrinken van vluchtelingen uit angst voor vervolging

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether prosecution of volunteers rescuing refugees in Turkish waters off Greece is EU policy, and whether the government will press for it to stop and use its Council presidency to remove legal obstacles to rescues. The Secretary of State replied that no such EU or Turkey agreements exist, that Greece has prosecuted volunteers for people smuggling, that existing EU law has a humanitarian exemption, and that rescues can proceed under the current framework.
No agreements have been made within the EU or with Turkey on prosecuting persons who voluntarily rescue refugees in distress in Turkish waters.
Er zijn geen afspraken gemaakt binnen de EU of met Turkije over het vervolgen van personen die op vrijwillige basis vluchtelingen in nood redden in Turkse wateren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat welke bestuurders omwonend zijn wordt meegewogen bij plannen voor asielzoekerscentra

An MP asked the minister whether the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf mapped which local administrators live near the Julianakazerne before COA decided not to request it for asylum reception, whether such stakeholder mapping is standard, and whether COA would now request the site. The minister says the stakeholder analysis covered all parties affected by a zoning change without differentiating by role, that the wording suggesting administrators matter is unacceptable and not reflected in actual conduct, and that the site was ultimately offered to COA and then to the municipality, while COA chose another site after consultation with The Hague.
The wording in the email, as reported in the Algemeen Dagblad, creates the impression that the presence of administrators could make a difference. That cannot and may not be the case.
Het taalgebruik uit de e-mail, zoals gemeld in het Algemeen Dagblad, wekt de suggestie dat de aanwezigheid van bestuurders verschil kan maken. Dat kan en mag niet het geval zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het geweld, intimidatie en pestgedrag tegen homoseksuele asielzoekers in asielzoekerscentra

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about harassment, bullying and violence against gay asylum seekers in reception centres, and whether victims' reluctance to file complaints and the lack of separate safehouses were addressed. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said COA sanctions and criminal prosecution will be set out in a letter by March, and maintained that separate reception for vulnerable groups is not the answer, offering instead relocation of perpetrators and a safe place within the centre for victims.
In case of incidents, the COA takes (punitive) measures and encourages residents, in case of possible criminal offences, to file a complaint.
Het COA neemt in geval van incidenten (straf)maatregelen en stimuleert bewoners, in geval van mogelijk strafbare feiten, tot het doen van aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de vergoeding van het exoskelet

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether a paraplegic patient should keep a robotic exoskeleton funded after a trial, whether such innovations should be reimbursed, and what financing options exist. The minister said the device is CE-marked and eligible for reimbursement case by case under either the Wmo (municipalities) or the Zvw (health insurers), and that the Zorginstituut is asked to clarify which regime applies, with a promise to inform parliament later.
Because this is a demarcation issue between the Zvw and the Wmo, I have asked the Zorginstituut to clarify under which scheme this type of aid can fall.
Omdat hier sprake is van een afbakeningsvraagstuk tussen Zvw en Wmo, heb ik het Zorginstituut gevraagd om een verduidelijking binnen welke regeling dit soort hulpmiddelen kunnen vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de ingebruikname van de Julianakazerne voor de opvang van asielzoekers

An MP asked why the Julianakazerne in The Hague was not requested by the COA for asylum reception, despite a minister's earlier statement that the COA was still considering it, and whether the COA would now request it. The government answered that the COA requests a location only after prior consultation with the municipality, that a formal request was made for the former Ministry of Social Affairs building because The Hague agreed, and that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf was asked to offer suitable state-owned sites.
The COA only makes a formal request to a municipality for the use of a particular location once consultation has taken place.
Het COA doet pas een formeel verzoek aan een gemeente voor de ingebruikname van een bepaalde locatie als er overleg is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht van het SCP “Een op de drie Nederlanders geeft informele hulp”

MP Voortman asked whether the government will have the SCP repeat its 2014 informal care study for 2015 to assess the effects of the Wmo 2015 and Youth Act on carers, and about gender differences in paid work among carers. The state secretary answered that key parts will be repeated in 2016 within the long-term care reform evaluation, and described existing policy measures and studies on combining work and care, with a promised letter to parliament after a 2016 meeting.
Important parts of the study will be repeated by the SCP in 2016 as part of the evaluation of the long-term care reform.
Belangrijke onderdelen van het onderzoek zullen door het SCP in 2016 herhaald worden als onderdeel van de evaluatie van de hervorming langdurige zorg.
Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Voortman over het overtreden van regels van de farmaceutische industrie

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about record fines imposed on pharmaceutical firms for prohibited advertising, why the figures only became public through a FOIA request, and whether the inspectorate has enough capacity and whether companies should be forced to disclose more. The minister confirmed the fines, explained the timing and capacity of the inspectorate, pointed to a pending amendment to the Health Act on publishing enforcement data, and saw no need for further measures.
Measures of the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) are not actively made public because there is no legal basis for doing so.
Maatregelen van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) worden niet actief openbaar gemaakt omdat daar geen wettelijke basis voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grashoff en Voortman inzake bedrijven die streefcijfers voor topvrouwen niet halen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister why companies are missing the gender targets for women in boards and why there are no sanctions for failing to explain shortfalls in annual reports. The minister acknowledged slow progress, promised to intensify voluntary self-regulation with business and monitor closely, and said sanctions could be considered at the Wbt evaluation if compliance does not improve.
If this does not lead to results, the evaluation of the Wbt will consider whether sanctions on this point can be included in the Wbt.
Indien dit niet tot resultaat leidt, zal bij de evaluatie van de Wbt worden bezien of op dit punt sancties in de Wbt kunnen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de schending van privacy door gemeenten in de jeugdzorg

Voortman (GreenLeft) asked the State Secretaries whether municipalities breach privacy in youth care by sharing medical files via post or unsecured email and letting non-medical officials view children's medical records. The government answered that municipalities are primarily responsible for compliance, that the Cbp supervises, and that only necessary data may be shared, but it gave no concrete sanctions and largely pointed to existing guidance and responsibilities of councils and the Cbp.
The municipal executive is primarily responsible for ensuring the municipality complies with the legal and agreed requirements on information security and privacy protection.

Het college van B&W is primair verantwoordelijk om er voor te zorgen dat de gemeente voldoet aan de (wettelijke en in de gemeente afgesproken) vereisten ten aanzien van informatiebeveiliging en privacybescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) de Roemernorm omzeilt door uitzendkrachten twee weken naar huis te sturen

Green Left MP Voortman asked whether the Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) is evading the Roemer norm (a cap on temporary agency workers) by sending agency staff home for two weeks, and whether other ministries and bodies do the same and whether DUO will be addressed. The government answered that it sees no reason to conclude DUO is concealing a breach, no reason to investigate other bodies, and no reason to address DUO, referring to earlier answers to Van Raak.
Do you share the view that DUO is trying to conceal by this means that it is breaching the agreed percentage of flexible workers?
Vraag 1 Deelt u de mening dat DUO hiermee probeert te verhullen dat het de gemaakte afspraken over het percentage flexwerkers schendt?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Voortman over de uitzending van Radar ‘Kinderopvangtoeslag’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Voortman asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is fair that families with a fully disabled parent receive no childcare allowance when the other parent works, and whether a hardship clause or other flexibility should be introduced. The minister answered that the Sociaal Medische Indicatie (SMI) lets municipalities compensate such families, that municipalities are best placed to judge individual cases, that no new statutory route for the Belastingdienst is foreseen, and that the matter is for municipalities under their duty of care.
It is up to the municipal council to monitor the mayor and aldermen on the implementation of SMI.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om het college van burgemeester en wethouders te controleren inzake de uitvoering van SMI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voortman over de gesloten gezinsvoorziening in Kamp Zeist

MPs Gesthuizen and Voortman asked the State Secretary why the temporary closed family facility at Kamp Zeist is becoming permanent, how it differs and is child-friendly, how it fits 2013 rules on families, and how many children were detained and deported. The State Secretary answered that the facility becomes structural, with child-friendly design, and gave detention and removal figures for 2013-2015, while referring some points to earlier letters and not fully answering whether families can await removal at their previous location.

As indicated in the letter of 13 September 2013 you cite, asylum applications from families with minor children arriving at the external border are not processed in the closed extended asylum procedure.

Zoals in de door u aangehaalde brief van 13 september 2013 is aangegeven worden asielaanvragen van gezinnen met minderjarige kinderen, die aankomen aan de buitengrens, niet in de gesloten verlengde asielprocedure behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Klein en Sjoerdsma over het EU-Turkije actieplan migratie

MPs Voortman, Klein and Sjoerdsma asked about the sequencing, financing, Turkish commitments, Frontex data exchange, accession talks and migration law reform under the EU-Turkey migration action plan. The minister answered that the plan sets no sequence or fixed amounts, that Dutch funding awaits further talks, and that details will be worked out later with Turkey.
Neither the action plan nor the European Council conclusions contain target amounts or worked-out agreements on financing and spending.
Het actieplan noch de ER-conclusies bevatten streefbedragen of uitgewerkte afspraken over financiering en besteding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grashoff en Voortman inzake het bieden van premiekorting in ruil voor privédata door verzekeraar Achmea

MPs Grashoff and Voortman asked ministers whether insurer Achmea may offer premium discounts in exchange for personal behavioural data, and how data use, consent, sanctions and societal effects would be policed. The government answered that such data use is permitted only within the Wbp framework and purpose limitation, that the Cbp supervises compliance, and that insurers must inform customers of privacy risks, while acknowledging possible societal effects.
It is up to the Cbp to assess whether the Wbp is being complied with.
Het is aan het Cbp om te beoordelen of de Wbp wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur over Inburgering en de zijn brief over diverse onderwerpen betreffende inburgering

An MP asked the minister about a Nieuwsuur report on integration-exam barriers, the language accessibility of information for newcomers, and the fairness and pass rates of the reading-comprehension exam. The minister denied that newcomers struggle to find information, pointed to existing support and brochures in 15 languages, reported pass rates, said exam content was checked against level A2, and promised to report on exam changes after summer 2016, withholding the full research report as confidential.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de onduidelijkheid over privacygevoeligheid van zorgdeclaraties

An MP asked the Health Minister about the NZa's refusal to release care declaration data, citing privacy risks, and whether the data can be traced to individuals, contrary to earlier ministerial statements. The minister said two court cases are pending, that the risk of linking data to individuals is managed through technical and organisational measures, and that a legal basis for data sharing is being examined with the NZa.
In the following answer I will not go into the court cases in substance.
In de navolgende beantwoording ga ik inhoudelijk niet nader in op de rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Koser-Kaya, Karabulut en Schouten over de brief ‘Eerste tussenmeting banenafspraak’

MPs asked about Wsw sheltered-employment placements, waiting-list trends, hours worked and job counts under the banenafspraak (jobs agreement) for disabled workers in 2013-2014. The state secretary answered with Panteia and UWV figures, showing a shift from sheltered workshops to external placements and an increase of 7,304 unique extra jobs, and said the 2015 results would follow around summer 2016.
You will receive the answers in advance of the General Consultation on the Participation Act of 29 October.
U ontvangt de antwoorden voorafgaand aan het Algemeen overleg Participatiewet van 29 oktober.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over gezinshereniging

Ms Voortman (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about long waiting times for family reunification, whether the IND is understaffed, and whether more budget will be made available. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, said the average processing time is 134 days, that the IND will increasingly be unable to decide within the statutory term, and that the IND has hired additional capacity, without committing to extra budget.
Given the current circumstances with the unprecedentedly high inflow, the IND will increasingly be unable to decide within the statutory term.
Gezien de huidige omstandigheden met de ongekend hoge instroom, zal de IND in toenemende mate niet kunnen beslissen binnen de wettelijke termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de voortgang van de actieve openbaarmaking van onderzoeksrapporten

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the progress of proactive publication of research reports and where published reports can be found, plus 2014 pilot figures for BZK and OCW, reasons for delays, and disclosure of contractors and costs. The minister answered that reports are findable on rijksoverheid.nl, gave pilot counts (most published within 28 days, a few delayed or unpublished, with reasons such as interdepartmental coordination), said contractor names are usually disclosed and cost data will be published as open data, and noted the general meeting was postponed.
The costs of research fall under procurement information. This information will be published as open data in November.
De kosten voor onderzoeken vallen onder inkoopinformatie. Deze informatie zal november aanstaande gepubliceerd worden als open data.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het asielbeleid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary whether the Netherlands is returning asylum seekers to Hungary under Dublin, whether it considers Hungarian reception conditions inhumane, and how this fits with non-refoulement, Dublin reform and a durable solution. The state secretary confirmed Dublin transfers, said responsibility lies first with the European Commission and Hungarian courts, maintained the mutual trust principle, and declined to change the Dublin regulation, while noting that a Council of State appeal on Hungary was pending.
On 23 September the Division, in two cases, indicated that the person concerned may not be transferred to Hungary until the appeal they lodged has been decided.
Op 23 september jl. heeft de Afdeling, in twee zaken, aangegeven dat de betrokkene niet overgedragen mag worden naar Hongarije, totdat op het door hen ingestelde hoger beroep is beslist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind en Voortman over scheiding van gezinnen vanwege tegenwerping 1F

MPs Gesthuizen, Voordewind and Voortman asked whether families separated by an Article 1F exclusion would have the exclusion re-examined, whether the government could guarantee the utmost care, and which countries still prosecute alleged war crimes. The State Secretary replied that Article 1F is assessed in the asylum procedure separately from family life under Article 8 ECHR, that the exclusion is examined with all safeguards, that the choice to leave lies with family members, and that prosecution abroad is a separate matter that the Public Prosecution Service monitors.
Can you guarantee the Chamber that, where a family's situation is so serious, the Article 1F exclusion will be examined with the utmost care to determine whether it can stand?

Vraag 2 Kunt u de Kamer garanderen dat, indien sprake is van een voor een gezin dusdanig ernstige situatie, met de groots mogelijke zorgvuldigheid wordt onderzocht of de 1F-tegenwerping stand moet houden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen over het bericht van de uitzetting van twee kinderen

MPs Voortman, Sjoerdsma and Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary why a family including two children was detained in a closed family facility, whether the children should await appeal in the Netherlands, and whether the 10-year policy for relatives of 1F persons applies to the Children's Pardon. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, noted the family has been released, said the children's pardon scheme excludes relatives of 1F persons, and said the appeal rule applies only when the claim is upheld.
Beyond that, I will not go into the considerations in individual cases.
Voor het overige ga ik niet in op (de afwegingen in) individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme en Voortman over de Europese migratieproblematiek.

MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme and Voortman asked the government about the European migration crisis, including limits of reception capacity, funding for regional refugee aid, safe third country returns, relocation quotas and Dublin rules. The state secretary answered largely on substance, describing the planned approach and noting that many details remain to be negotiated with the EU and third countries.
Once the ideas take more concrete shape at European level, we can further develop the plans together with relevant reception countries, such as Syria's neighbours.
Zodra in Europees verband de ideeën concreter vorm krijgen, kunnen we de plannen verder uitwerken samen met relevante opvanglanden, zoals de buurlanden van Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Kerstens en Voortman over de risico’s voor het personeel als gevolg van de nieuwe beveiliging op Schiphol

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of dangerous situations, overtime breaches, and poor working conditions for security staff at Schiphol after a new central security concept, and whether the tender cut hours despite rising workload. The minister said working conditions are the employer's responsibility, the Inspectorate SZW saw no reason for project research, and that Schiphol decides on tendering and contractors while the private Code Verantwoordelijk Marktgedrag and CAO partners handle enforcement.
The Inspectorate SZW has recently not conducted any investigation into security companies at Schiphol or elsewhere in the country.
Er heeft recentelijk geen onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW plaatsgevonden naar beveiligingsbedrijven op Schiphol of elders in het land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind en Voortman over de scheiding van een gezin vanwege tegenwerping 1F

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the 1F exclusion (Refugee Convention) against a father, which has split his family, could be re-examined, and why the Public Prosecution Service did not prosecute. The State Secretary confidentially provided the court and Council of State rulings, declined to comment on prosecution, and refused to reopen the 1F assessment because the Council of State had already confirmed it.
I cannot inform your House. The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements about this individual case.
Ik kan uw kamer niet informeren. Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen mededelingen over dit individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de mogelijke inperking van de vrije artsenkeuze door het macrobeheersinstrument

An MP asked the health minister whether changes to the macro-budget instrument (mbi) shift cost burdens onto non-contracted providers, pressure providers into contracts, and undermine patient free choice of provider. The minister declined to answer substantively, saying the concerns are known and will be addressed in a forthcoming bill's explanatory memorandum, and rejected the claim that patient choice is affected.
The explanatory memorandum accompanying the bill will set out the reasoning regarding the LVVP's response.
In de memorie van toelichting bij het wetsvoorstel zal gemotiveerd worden ingegaan op de reactie van de LVVP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over toenemende agressie ten aanzien van apothekersassistenten

MPs Voortman and Dik-Faber asked the minister about rising aggression toward pharmacy assistants, linked to the 2014 split of the first dispensing conversation from the standard dispensing fee, and about falling job satisfaction, the trust relationship with patients, and whether the financing should be reversed. The minister acknowledged the preliminary survey results, said the NZa is negotiating with sector parties on a solution, and promised further talks with Optima Farma while defending the new payment as necessary for care content.
I hope that any solution will quickly bring clarity to all those involved and contribute to reducing aggression at the counter.
Ik hoop dat een eventuele oplossing snel tot duidelijkheid leidt voor alle betrokkenen en zal bijdragen aan de vermindering van agressie aan de balie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat de helft van de ziekenhuizen Ivf-behandelingen aan alleenstaande vrouwen weigert

MP Voortman asked the health minister whether it is acceptable that half of hospitals refuse IVF to single women, whether screening of single women but not couples is justified, and whether she will engage hospitals on this. The minister answered that single women are protected by equal-treatment law, that the NVOG protocol allows only case-specific assessment, and that she will talk to the NVOG but not to individual hospitals.
I will discuss this matter with the NVOG, but I see it as the task of the professional association to bring its own protocol back to the attention of practitioners and hospitals
Ik zal in gesprek gaan met de NVOG over deze kwestie, maar zie het als taak van de beroepsvereniging om het eigen protocol opnieuw onder de aandacht te brengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over onnodige verhuizingen van asielkinderen

MPs Voordewind, Schouw and Voortman asked whether the planned conversion of the Almelo family location into an asylum centre, forcing about 120 residents including children to move, could be postponed, and how the government weighs the harm of repeated relocations to children. The State Secretary confirmed the conversion, said COA is consulting the municipality and residents and tries to limit the impact, but that high intake makes avoiding moves impossible.
COA is in discussion with both the municipality and the residents.
Het COA is in gesprek met zowel de gemeente als de bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de uitvoering van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (WMO) door gemeenten

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about municipalities cutting domestic care under the Wmo 2015, including a case where a council ignored its objections committee, and about whether residents get personal plans and fixed-hours or fixed-rate care. The State Secretary replies that the law is clear, that municipalities are responsible for implementation and councils must supervise them, that no national overview exists, and that he sees no need for further measures.

The municipal executive is responsible for proper implementation of the law and the frameworks set by the municipal council; the council is primarily responsible for assessing that implementation and correcting it where needed.

Het gemeentebestuur heeft de verantwoordelijkheid voor een goede uitvoering van de wet en de door de gemeenteraad vastgestelde kaders, het is primair aan de gemeenteraad om het bestuur op die uitvoering te beoordelen en waar nodig bij te sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de beslissing van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) om een uitkeringsgerechtigde vrijwilligerswerk als chauffeur op de buurtbus te verbieden, terwijl een

Our MP Voortman asked follow-up questions about a UWV ban on a jobseeker volunteering as a bus driver while bijstand recipients may do so, and whether the 2015 WW volunteering rules change will be evaluated. The minister answers that the rules aim to give WW recipients more room for volunteering while preventing displacement of paid work, and commits to an evaluation with results to parliament by early 2016.
I am willing to evaluate whether the said regulation indeed does what is intended.
Ik ben bereid om te evalueren of genoemde regeling inderdaad doet wat is beoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Meenen over het bericht UvA probeert CAO te omzeilen

MPs Voortman and Van Meenen asked whether the University of Amsterdam planned to circumvent the new collective labour agreement by avoiding conversion of temporary contracts into permanent ones, as suggested in a leaked email. The minister answered that the executive board rejects such circumvention, will comply with the CAO and Wwz in letter and spirit, and has created an individual-rights ombudsperson whose opinions are binding, while noting the email was one employee's idea rather than university policy.
The Executive Board of the UvA has explicitly distanced itself from the idea that it plans to circumvent the new CAO Universiteiten.
Het College van Bestuur van de UvA (CvB) heeft laten weten nadrukkelijk afstand te nemen van het idee dat het van plan is de nieuwe CAO Universiteiten te omzeilen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over werken als zelfstandige in relatie tot een WW-uitkering (artikel 8 WW)

An MP asks whether WW unemployment benefit should be permanently reduced when benefit recipients work as self-employed, leaving them without full benefit even after reducing self-employed hours, and whether the law should change. The minister defends the current hours-offset system as a worker insurance rule, points to the starter scheme, and refuses to change the law.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de betalingsproblemen in de jeugdzorg

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Health about payment problems in youth care caused by mismatched software between municipalities and providers, longer waiting times, and providers leaving youth mental health care. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to a joint work agenda by VNG and provider organisations, stated that municipalities remain responsible for ensuring care and for payments, and referred struggling providers to the Transitieautoriteit Jeugd.

The primary responsibility for a proper setup of administrations at municipalities and care providers, and for making the right process agreements, lies with individual municipalities and individual care providers.

De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor een goede inrichting van de administraties bij gemeen ten en zorgaanbieders en het maken van de goede procesafspraken daarover ligt uiteraard bij individuele gemeenten en individuele zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat de Immigratie en Naturalisatie Dienst (IND) tolken inzet die banden hebben met het dictatoriale regime in Eritrea

An MP asks whether IND interpreters with ties to the Eritrean regime are acceptable, why the integrity investigation outcomes were not published, and what the consequences would be for asylum procedures. The State Secretary answers that the investigated interpreters could not be linked to the regime, that the outcomes were published after a WOB request with personal data redacted, and that the research method cannot be disclosed.
I am aware of the report.
Ik ben bekend met het bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Voortman en Voordewind over een verwachte uitspraak van de Raad van State

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary why he is awaiting a ruling on vrijheidsbeperkende locaties (VBL) rather than the pending cases on municipal bed-bad-brood shelters, and whether the expected Council of State ruling was about VBL adequacy. The State Secretary answered that he is not waiting for a ruling, that the existing system complies with treaty obligations, that the Council of State cases were withdrawn on 11 May 2015 so no ruling will follow in them, and that other related cases are pending.
First of all, I consider it important to note that I am not waiting for a court ruling.
Allereerst acht ik van belang op te merken dat ik niet wacht op een rechterlijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het verzamelen van persoonsgegevens in het kader van operatie Amberlight 2015

MP Voortman asked the State Secretary about Dutch participation in EU operation Amberlight 2015 at Schiphol, including whether personal data were collected and whether rights and data protection were guaranteed, and about next steps. The State Secretary answered that only non-traceable statistical data were collected, that this complies with the Dutch data protection law, and that the Latvian presidency will publish a final report.
In this operation only statistical data were collected.
In deze operatie zijn alleen statistische data verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het onderzoek “Zorg over de grenzen” van de Nationale ombudsman

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the National Ombudsman's report on medical advice in asylum procedures, including whether a complaint on carelessness was upheld and whether each recommendation will be adopted. The State Secretary says he will study the report and send a written reaction before summer, agrees to a meeting with the Ombudsman, and rejects the idea that medical treatment should be presumed less available in countries of return.
Before the summer recess I will send my written response to the report and its recommendations to your House.
Voor het zomerreces zal ik mijn schriftelijke reactie op het rapport en de aanbevelingen daarin aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat een jonge asielzoekster wordt uitgezet ondanks depressiviteit en suïcidaliteit

An MP asked why a young Guinean asylum seeker with depression, PTSD and suicidality was to be deported, and what criteria apply under Vw 2000 art. 17(1)(c) and art. 64. The State Secretary explained that these conditions do not automatically lead to a residence permit or postponement of departure, that medical advice from the BMA decides, and that travel conditions and minor trafficking victim rules exist.
PTSD, depression and suicidality do not automatically lead to the granting of a residence permit or to postponement of departure under article 64 of the Aliens Act 2000.
PTSS, depressiviteit en suïcidaliteit leiden niet zonder meer tot het verlenen van een verblijfsvergunning of tot uitstel van vertrek op grond van artikel 64 Vw 2000.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat mensen te maken krijgen met stijgende zorgkosten door de bezuinigingen op de langdurige zorg

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary about reports that care costs for people receiving long-term care rose sharply after cuts, including a 630 euro monthly co-payment and survey findings of large increases. The secretary disputes the survey interpretation, says the income figures do not match the claimed increases, and points to municipalities' responsibility for financial case-by-case support, while committing to information and no new compensation.
On the basis of the information available to me, it is not possible to give the requested explanation.
Op grond van de mij ter beschikking staande informatie is het niet goed mogelijk om de gevraagde verklaring te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het off-label voorschrijven van medicijnen

Green Left MP Voortman asked the health minister about off-label prescribing, noting that eleven of twenty medical professions have no guideline to fall back on despite legal requirements, and that RIVM and the CBG see risks. Minister Schippers answered that off-label use is permitted under the Medicines Act when guidelines are followed or the best treatment is chosen with the pharmacist, that the IGZ supervises prescribing, and that guideline development and drug rediscovery will be pursued, without committing to a new legal change.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) supervises the prescribing behaviour of doctors.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidzorg (IGZ) houdt toezicht op het voorschrijfgedrag van artsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over uitzettingen naar landen waar ebola heerst

Three MPs asked the State Secretary whether Belgium's suspension of forced returns to Ebola-affected countries (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) was justified given the travel advice, and whether returns endanger migrants' health care access. The State Secretary answered that forced returns are temporarily suspended for staff safety, that individual risk assessments under Article 3 ECHR continue, and that returns of migrants needing medical care will be handled cautiously and case by case.

However worrying the situation in the affected countries is, I am of the view that at this moment not all foreigners who must return to the affected countries are automatically at risk of violating Article 3 ECHR.

Hoe zorgwekkend de situatie in de getroffen landen ook is, ben ik van oordeel dat op dit moment niet bij voorbaat alle vreemdelingen die naar de getroffen landen moeten terugkeren, risico op schending van artikel 3 EVRM lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat de zorgpremie een stuk lager kan

MP Voortman asks whether health insurers hold excess reserves and profits that could lower the health premium, and whether the minister will urge them to return them. Minister Schippers acknowledges higher-than-required reserves but argues double gearing inflates the figures, says reserves will be needed for Solvency II and the AWBZ transfer, and says she has asked insurers for better, uniform transparency on premium setting.
I believe health insurers have a social duty to properly inform their insured about the level of the premium and the results achieved.
Ik vind dat zorgverzekeraars de maatschappelijke plicht hebben om hun verzekerden goed over de hoogte van de premie en de behaalde resultaten te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de situatie in de IJsselhallen in Zwolle

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary about conditions for asylum seekers housed in the IJsselhallen in Zwolle, including length of stay, health care, privacy, and plans for structural reception capacity. The State Secretary answered that the IJsselhallen are a temporary emergency measure, that health care access is adequate, and that new locations are being sought, while acknowledging privacy shortcomings and that emergency-type reception may be needed again.
The reception provided in the IJsselhallen is a temporary emergency measure and therefore deviates from the reception normally provided.
De opvang die geboden wordt in de IJsselhallen is een tijdelijke noodmaatregel en wijkt daarmee af van de opvang die normaal gesproken geboden wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) over het bericht «Tekorten ziekenhuizen verdoezeld»

MP Voortman (GroenLinks) asked the minister whether the NZa misinformed Parliament and the ministry about hospitals' financial position, and about the timing of the Borstlap inquiry and possible disciplinary action. The minister referred to a previous letter on a written consultation about the NZa's functioning rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Voortman (GroenLinks), question number 2014Z07269, have been answered by means of the letter 'Report of a written consultation on the functioning of the NZa 2012'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks), vraagnummer 2014Z07269 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Verslag van een schriftelijk overleg over het functioneren van de NZa 2012»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Voordewind over het bericht “Grensdetentie is niet langer houdbaar”

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a report calling border detention of asylum seekers, including children, incompatible with human rights norms and EU law. The State Secretary answered that detention and refusal of entry are applied under EU and national rules with individual assessment, that about 77% of asylum seekers detained at the border in 2013 eventually gained access, and that new policy for families with minor children and an IND work instruction would be introduced.
Furthermore, refusing entry and imposing border detention must take place with care.
Voorts geldt dat het weigeren van toegang en het opleggen van grensdetentie zorgvuldig moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht ‘Aandeelhouders farma belangrijker dan patiënten’

An MP asked whether pharmaceutical R&D serves health needs rather than best-selling drugs, whether financial incentives are right, whether public-funded business models should be studied, and whether industry invests enough in research relative to profits. The minister answered that drug development is primarily the industry's responsibility, that regulation also matters, that she will not commission a broad study of public-funded business models but will pursue targeted measures such as antibiotics and EU initiatives, and that she cannot judge the investment-to-profit ratio.
I am not a proponent of a broad and unqualified study into possibly more effective business models based on public financing for the entire pharmaceutical sector.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een breed en ongeclausuleerd onderzoek naar mogelijk effectievere businessmodellen op basis van publieke financiering voor de hele farmaceutische sector.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Voortman over het bericht dat overheden ervoor zorgen dat langdurige werklozen en arbeidsgehandicapten een hevige concurrentiestrijd leveren aan de onderkant van de arbeidsmark

MPs Schouten and Voortman asked whether social return in public tenders disadvantages social enterprises employing people far from the labour market, and whether government will support social entrepreneurship. The government answered that social return targets only extra placements, that social and regular firms face similar obstacles, that municipalities are responsible for their own tenders, and that it has asked the SER for advice due in early 2015.
Regarding the case in the article, the municipality concerned is responsible for the tenders it issues and the social conditions it sets. I have no insight into that.

Ten aanzien van de casus in het artikel geldt dat de betreffende gemeente verantwoordelijk is voor de aanbestedingen die zij doet en de sociale voorwaarden die zij daarbij stelt. Ik heb daar geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Maij, Schouw, Voordewind en Voortman over het bericht dat scholen niet in staat zijn kinderen uit Somalië en Eritrea te onderwijzen

MPs asked whether Dutch schools can adequately teach asylum-seeker children from Somalia and Eritrea, many of whom have had no schooling, and what additional measures will prevent them falling behind. The State Secretary disagreed that schools are inadequate, pointed to extra funding and an inspection report showing improved quality, and said he would discuss with Lowan and the VNG and PO-Raad the municipalities and schools that fail to take their responsibility, with no detailed further measures given.
I will therefore enter into discussion with Lowan, the VNG and the PO-Raad on this matter.
Ik zal daarom samen met Lowan het gesprek met de VNG en de PO-Raad hierover aangaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de sluiting van Synergon Metaal te Winschoten

An MP asked the state secretary about the closure of the Synergon Metaal sheltered-work metalworking unit in Winschoten, including whether workers keep their jobs and what options exist for regional employment in East Groningen. The state secretary said municipalities are responsible for sheltered employment and transfers are possible, and listed existing regional employment measures without committing to new ones.
The municipalities are responsible for the efficient implementation of the Wsw and can determine how sheltered-work employees are deployed.
De gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de efficiënte uitvoering van de Wsw en kunnen bepalen hoe de sw-medewerkers worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Bruins Slot en Voortman over het gesloten zorgakkoord met de vijf-partijencoalitie

MPs Leijten, Bruins Slot and Voortman asked the health minister for the text and financial basis of the June 2014 care agreement with the five-party coalition, whether the Finance Ministry and CPB were involved, which care organisations took part, and her view on amendments to the Health Insurance Act. The minister answered that no written agreement exists beyond the amendments, that Finance and CPB were involved in the costing, that the sector bodies signed the sector-level agreements, and that she supports most amendments while opposing those that would reverse the change to article 13.
Apart from this, there is no agreement committed to writing.
Er is hiernaast geen sprake van een op schrift gesteld akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over "de medische bezwaren tegen de voorgenomen herkeuring van Wajong-ers"

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary whether the planned reassessment of Wajong beneficiaries should be abandoned given its costs, psychological burden and expected waste, and whether results will be reported to parliament. The State Secretary rejects the claim of waste, says the reassessment is needed to identify who can work, and promises to inform parliament of the results after the operation is completed.
I intend to inform your House of the results after the completion of the reassessment operation.
Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer na afronding van de herbeoordelingsoperatie te informeren over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voortman over nareis van meerderjarige ongehuwde kinderen

MPs Gesthuizen and Voortman asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the family reunification of adult unmarried children, citing a case of a Syrian refugee's daughter too old to join her parent, and about the European Commission's guidance on the Family Reunification Directive. The State Secretary said Dutch law deliberately allows adult unmarried children to join asylum-holding parents subject to an individual 'more than normal emotional dependency' test, promised a general reply on the guidance after an expert meeting, and stated that the directive applies to these cases.
How many cases have a situation comparable to the individual case in question, I do not have insight into.
In hoeveel zaken zich een vergelijkbare situatie voordoet als in de betreffende individuele zaak, heb ik niet inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het beleid van kinderdagverblijven t.a.v. inentingen van kinderen waar zij zorg voor dragen

An MP asked whether parents have a right to know how daycare centres handle unvaccinated children and whether GGD inspections should cover this, and whether daycares may refuse unvaccinated children. The minister answered that parents may be informed and daycares may voluntarily register vaccination status, that outright refusal lacks a legal basis and could breach anti-discrimination law absent a justification, and that the minister will consult the GGD about raising vaccination registration in inspections.
The Minister of SZW will consult with the GGD on whether, in line with the RIVM advice, attention can be given during GGD inspections to registering the vaccination status of children in care.

De Minister van SZW zal in overleg met de GGD bezien of bij de GGD-inspectie – conform het advies van het RIVM – aandacht kan worden gegeven aan het belang van een registratie van de vaccinatiestatus van de opgevangen kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw, Gesthuizen en Voortman over de betekenis van de uitspraak van het Europees Comité voor Sociale Rechten (ECSR)

MPs asked the State Secretary how his refusal to take immediate measures after a European Committee of Social Rights ruling squares with a Amsterdam court ruling recognising a right to a dignified existence, and whether he will provide bed, bath and bread to rejected asylum seekers living on the street. The State Secretary replied that the court case concerned municipal welfare obligations rather than the ECSR letter, that the individual still had ongoing procedures, and that he sees no reason to change his position, judging the Dutch system balanced.
The ruling of the Amsterdam court therefore gives me no reason to revisit my position following the ECSR letter.
De uitspraak van de rechtbank Amsterdam vormt voor mij dan ook geen aanleiding om terug te komen op mijn standpunt naar aanleiding van de brief van het ECSR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Van Hijum, Voordewind en Voortman over het onderzoeksrapport naar de medische behandeling van een uitgezette minderjarige asielzoekster

MPs asked whether the health and justice inspectorates were refusing to release an unredacted report on the medical care of a deported six-year-old asylum seeker, and whether the family's consent should change that. The government replied that the report was withheld to protect medical confidentiality, that the family had not consented to an unredacted version, and that a redacted version was sent to parliament on 27 May 2014.
It is undesirable for reports of an investigative committee to be made public if they contain privacy-sensitive and medical information traceable to a person.
Het is ongewenst dat verslagen van een onderzoekscommissie openbaar worden gemaakt indien daarin privacygevoelige en medische informatie die tot een persoon te herleiden is, is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over richtsnoeren voor de toepassing van de Richtlijn inzake het recht op gezinshereniging

An MP asks the State Secretary whether Dutch family reunification practice (age limit of 21, civic integration test abroad, income duration rules, and individual balancing) should be changed to match new European Commission guidelines on the Family Reunification Directive. The State Secretary largely rejects changes: he says the age limit is compliant, the integration test awaits a CJEU ruling, individual assessment is adequately secured, and the policy will not be adjusted immediately.
Until then, I see no reason to change the policy on this.
Tot die tijd zie ik geen aanleiding om het beleid hieromtrent te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat het declaratiesysteem voor de zorg foute declaraties uitlokt

Voortman (GroenLinks) asked the health minister about reports that the hospital declaration system (DOT) induces incorrect billing, and whether the NZa, which both sets and enforces the rules, is marking its own homework. Minister Schippers denied hospitals are forced into fraud, said the NZa's rule-making and enforcement powers are organisationally separated, admitted DOT will need simplification, and pointed to an ongoing cost-awareness process with a progress letter promised before summer.
These powers are organisationally separated within the NZa.
Deze bevoegdheden zijn binnen de NZa organisatorisch gescheiden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw, Voortman en Gesthuizen over de uitzending van Zembla van 30 april jl. en de schriftelijke verklaring van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie aangaande het uitzett

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a Zembla broadcast and ministry statement on deporting people to Guinea, including whether Dutch authorities are responsible for checking the validity of travel documents issued by Guinean officials and whether deportations should be halted. The State Secretary answered that Guinea is responsible for the validity of its documents, that no concerns have been raised by the Guinean government, that monitoring deportees is not appropriate, and that the Commission Integraal Toezicht Terugkeer is reviewing the matter.
It is not for the Dutch government to make statements on whether certain (replacement) travel documents for return are valid or not.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse overheid uitspraken te doen over of bepaalde (vervangende) reisdocumenten ten behoeve van terugkeer al dan niet rechtsgeldig zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het Grondwetfestival en de openstelling van overheidsgebouwen

An MP asked whether the Grondwetfestival and opening of government buildings such as parliament, ministries and the Catshuis should be seen as a success, and whether such buildings should be open to the public at least annually, including Het Torentje. The minister agreed it was a success and said the ministry will take the initiative, with The Hague and partners, to explore a suitable follow-up to public openings of constitution-related buildings.

Following the findings of the National Committee 200 Years Kingdom on the Grondwet Festival, the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will take the initiative, in consultation with The Hague municipality and other partners, to examine how a suitable follow-up can be given to attention for the Constitution and the opening of related buildings.

Mede naar aanleiding van de bevindingen van het Nationaal Comité 200 jaar Koninkrijk over het Grondwet Festival zal het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties het initiatief nemen om in overleg met de gemeente Den Haag en andere partners te bezien op welke wijze een passend vervolg kan worden gegeven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Schouw en Voortman over schade die kinderen oplopen tijdens het verblijf in asielzoekerscentra

Four MPs asked the State Secretary whether children suffer developmental harm while living in asylum reception centres, citing a court ruling, and asked about oversight, relocation of children and the state's duty under the Convention on the Rights of the Child. The State Secretary rejected the claim that children face harm merely from reception centre stay, pointed to existing oversight by the COA Supervisory Board and inspectorates, and committed to no new independent oversight body or relocation study.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Voortman over het bericht dat er in de regio Hoogeveen onrust is ontstaan over het afschalen van de Intensive Care (IC) in het Bethesda Ziekenhuis

MPs Van Gerven and Voortman asked the minister about reported unrest in Hoogeveen over possible downscaling of the intensive care unit at Bethesda Hospital, including the status of a regional advisory report, planned concentrations, and insurer involvement. The minister said the plans are a draft under discussion with stakeholders, declined to publish the report as a regional plan under the responsibility of the parties involved, and said her statutory role applies only if 45-minute ambulance access or care safety is at risk.
Moreover, the regional plans are the responsibility of the parties involved, and it is not for me to send them to the House of Representatives.
Bovendien zijn de regioplannen de verantwoordelijkheid van partijen en is het niet aan mij deze aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de kwaliteitsnorm tolkgebruik bij keus voor professionele tolk

An MP asked the health minister about a new quality norm for interpreter use in care and whether it could ground insurer financing of professional interpreters. The minister said the norm is a useful tool, that patients are primarily responsible for Dutch language ability so interpreter costs are not covered by the Zorgverzekeringswet, though insurers may choose to pay, and that a KNMG-commissioned study proposal would be presented in April.

Because patients/clients (or their representatives) are themselves responsible for mastering the Dutch language, the costs of any interpreter deployment are not reimbursed under the Health Insurance Act.

Omdat de patiënten/cliënten (of hun vertegenwoordigers) zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het machtig zijn van de Nederlandse taal, worden de kosten voor de eventuele inzet van een tolk niet vergoed vanuit de Zorgverzekeringswet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over het bericht dat een ernstig zieke vader is uitgezet naar Guinee

Four MPs (SP, ChristenUnie, D66, GroenLinks) asked State Secretary Teeven why a seriously ill Guinean father was deported despite pending Article 8 ECHR proceedings, medical concerns, questions about travel documents, and Utrecht's offer of care. The State Secretary defended the deportation as the outcome of careful individual assessments, said medication was confirmed available in Guinea, and declined to discuss the individual case beyond what was necessary.
It is known to your House that I do not consider it desirable to enter into individual cases in public debate.
Het is uw Kamer bekend dat ik het niet wenselijk acht in het publieke debat in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat DBC Onderhoud de gemiddelde prijzen voor een beperkt aantal zorgproducten publiceert

An MP asked the minister about DBC Onderhoud publishing average prices for a limited set of hospital care products, the Ombudsman's view on patients' lack of insight into costs, the obligation to publish passantentarieven, and whether publishing volumes and prices per provider raises competition or confidentiality concerns. The minister acknowledged the limited scope, said hospitals must publish passantentarieven, and deferred the open-data decision to a forthcoming letter before summer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over uitstel van het rapport van de commissie Dienstverlening aan huis

An MP asked why the mandate of the Commission Dienstverlening aan huis was extended and when its final report would reach parliament, and whether the report should be awaited before the Wmo 2015 bill proceeds. The minister gave reasons for the delay, promised the report by 30 April, and rejected the view that the Wmo 2015 bill must wait for the report.
The establishing decree has been extended to 30 April. I expect to be able to share the final report with the House by that date.
Het Instellingsbesluit is verlengd tot 30 april. Ik verwacht voor die datum het eindverslag met de Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Voortman over het bericht dat er asielzoekerscentra (AZC's) worden geopend in voormalige gevangenissen en detentiecentra

MPs Voordewind and Voortman asked whether the COA is seeking to open asylum centres in former prisons and detention centres, how many asylum seekers lack regular reception places, and whether such unsuitable sites will be dropped in favour of alternatives. The State Secretary answered that COA searches broadly for reception sites (not only prisons), that about 1,700 places have been opened or reopened at former sites in Bellingwolde, Geeuwenbrug, Sweikhuizen, Uithuizen and Wassenaar, that every eligible asylum seeker currently has a place, and declined to discuss specific planned locations, citing municipal agreements.
Because of municipal and administrative agreements when acquiring locations, I do not consider it desirable to discuss locations intended for COA reception.
Vanwege gemeentelijke/bestuurlijke afspraken bij het verwerven van locaties vind ik het niet wenselijk om in te gaan op locaties die beoogd zijn voor de opvang door het COA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over een toename in de diefstal van Canta’s (voertuigen voor invaliden)

A GroenLinks MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising theft of Canta mobility vehicles, whether national figures exist, whether a licence plate requirement should be introduced, and what other measures are planned. The minister answered that police records misclassify Cantas, that an analysis shows about 74% of thefts occur in the Amsterdam region, that a plate requirement would not outweigh administrative costs for theft prevention alone, and that prevention is mainly the owner's responsibility, with tracking systems recommended.
The actual number of stolen Cantas therefore cannot be reliably traced from BVH.
Het werkelijke aantal gestolen Canta's is derhalve niet goed herleidbaar uit BVH.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat asielaanvragen van homoseksuele asielzoekers zorgvuldiger moeten worden beoordeeld

MP Voortman asked whether the government will act on the Raad van State ruling that gay asylum seekers should not be expected to behave discreetly on return, and whether the government will investigate criminalisation of homosexuality in countries with general country reports. Secretary Teeven answered that asylum policy on discretion will be adjusted and that terms of reference for country reports will be reviewed.
This means that from an asylum seeker whose LHBT status is considered credible, it will not be expected that they behave discreetly in the country of origin when expressing their sexual orientation.

Dit betekent dat van een asielzoeker waarvan geloofwaardig wordt geacht dat hij LHBT is, niet verwacht zal worden dat hij zich in het land van herkomst terughoudend opstelt bij het uiting geven aan zijn seksuele gerichtheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat stemgedrag van raadsleden praktisch niet te achterhalen is

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether council members' voting records and council minutes should be publicly accessible and whether a national model for publishing them should be created. The minister answered that municipalities are autonomous, the Gemeentewet does not regulate disclosure of individual voting behaviour, municipalities should improve transparency themselves, and no national model is planned for now.
The municipalities form an autonomous tier of government.
De gemeenten vormen een autonome bestuurslaag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat het VUmc geen geld heeft voor de behandeling van transgenders

An MP asked the health minister whether insurers have provided inadequate budget for gender dysphoria treatment at VUmc, and what the government will do about it. The minister said insurers have a duty of care, that existing treatments continue, that the NZa is investigating, and that responsibility for care chains lies with the sector, with the government facilitating.
The NZa has indicated it is already investigating this case, is alert to the issue and will keep me informed of developments.
De NZa heeft laten weten deze casus al te onderzoeken, alert op deze kwestie te zijn en mij geïnformeerd te houden over de ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat jonge medisch specialisten steeds vaker onbetaald werken in ziekenhuizen en maatschappen

An MP asks the health minister about reports that newly qualified medical specialists work unpaid in hospitals and practices, and whether this is acceptable given insurers pay for the procedures, and how it affects jobs and pay. The minister replies that there is no registration of unpaid work, that the number is unknown, that DBC pricing allows hospitals to account for actual costs, and that labour law and collective agreements give specialists sufficient means to protect their rights.
It is unknown how many medical specialists work unpaid. This is not registered.
Het is onbekend hoeveel medisch specialisten onbetaald werken. Dit wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over een voorstel voor cheques voor witte werksters

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Belgian-style service voucher scheme to move domestic cleaners out of undeclared work and about the timing of the Kalsbeek commission report. The minister answered that the commission report is nearly finished, the government reaction is expected this spring, and the Amsterdam alderman has been asked to wait for it.
As soon as possible after that, I will send you the cabinet's response.
Zo spoedig mogelijk daarna zal ik u de reactie van het kabinet doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over vertrouwelijke bijlages bij CTIVD-rapporten

An MP asked whether Snowden's revelations warrant publishing the secret annexes to several CTIVD oversight reports on the AIVD and MIVD, and why those annexes should stay secret. Minister Plasterk answered that the Wiv 2002 requires methods, sources and knowledge levels to be kept out of public reports, so the annexes cannot be published or shared beyond the CIVD, which already received them.
I therefore see no possibility to make the secret annexes public, nor to make them available for confidential inspection to any other part of your House than the CIVD
Ik zie dan ook geen mogelijkheden om geheime bijlagen openbaar te maken, noch om deze vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen aan enig ander onderdeel van uw Kamer dan de CIVD
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het onderzoek naar activiteiten van inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten tegen Roel van Duijn

MP Voortman asks about the status of the CTIVD investigation into intelligence services' intrusion into Roel van Duijn's private life, whether the minister agreed to widen it to other bodies such as the Amsterdam police Groep IJzerman, and whether he will ask the CTIVD to include them. Minister Plasterk answers that the CTIVD investigation is ongoing and independent, that he asked it to examine the BVD's conduct toward Van Duijn, and that the CTIVD's remit covers only the AIVD, so other police conduct falls outside it unless acting on BVD orders.
However, it is not the task of this committee to investigate the police other than where they fall under the responsibility of the AIVD or BVD.
Het is echter niet de taak van deze commissie om onderzoek te doen naar de politie anders dan vallend onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de AIVD of BVD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de toekenning van MAU- en IAU-uitkeringen

An MP asked the State Secretary about the handling of MAU and IAU supplementary welfare payments for municipalities, including the rejection of Enschede's application based on an exploratory econometric study and the number of applications and rejections. The State Secretary answered that 96 IAU and 45 MAU applications were filed, explained the Toetsingscommissie WWB assessment process, defended the Enschede review as careful and noted that objections and appeals remain available.
The Toetsingscommissie WWB has not yet been able to give me advice on Enschede's MAU application.
Over het MAU-verzoek van Enschede heeft de Toetsingscommissie WWB mij nog geen advies kunnen uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman en Schouw over het Nederlandse asielbeleid voor Russische LHBT-ers

MPs Gesthuizen, Voortman and Schouw asked whether Russia's anti-gay propaganda law endangers LGBT people, what the Netherlands is doing about it, whether visa liberalisation should be suspended, and whether Russian LGBT asylum claims will be processed faster. The minister replied that the Netherlands raises LGBT rights through dialogue with Russia, the EU and the Council of Europe, that visa liberalisation is only at an exploratory stage with human rights weighed in future steps, and that LGBT asylum claims are assessed case by case under existing criteria without priority processing.

The Netherlands continues to focus primarily, both bilaterally and multilaterally, on broad international attention and dialogue on the human rights situation and the position of the LGBT community in Russia, rather than hardening positions.

Nederland blijft zowel op het bilaterale als multilaterale spoor primair inzetten op brede internationale aandacht en dialoog over de mensenrechtensituatie en de positie van de LHBT-gemeenschap in Rusland, in plaats van het verharden van standpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Ojik over het weren van lesbiënnes, homo’s en bi’s in de Golfstaten
