Two Green Left MPs asked whether they condemn a reported Kuwaiti proposal for Gulf states to subject visa applicants to sex testing that would target transgender people, and whether they would raise it diplomatically. The minister said the proposal conflicts with equal treatment and the government's values, that the ministry is monitoring the situation and will act jointly with partners if appropriate.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is closely monitoring the situation, is in contact with EU partners, and will take appropriate action jointly with international partners if opportune.

Het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken volgt de situatie op de voet, staat in contact met EU-partners en zal indien het opportuun mocht zijn gepaste actie ondernemen gezamenlijk met internationale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Voortman over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars de Levenseindekliniek boycotten

MPs Arib and Voortman asked the health minister about reports that insurers are boycotting the Levenseindekliniek (end-of-life clinic) and whether patients are left dependent on donations. The minister answered that insurers have a duty of care but are free to choose contractors, that the CVZ has no specific opinion on the clinic, and that she will monitor developments without committing to new action.
It is up to the health insurer to decide with whom it wishes to contract for the provision of certain care.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraar om te bepalen met wie deze een contract wil sluiten voor het leveren van bepaalde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de lange wachtlijsten voor scolioseoperaties

GroenLinks MP Voortman asked the health minister about long waiting lists for scoliosis surgery, the failure to meet a three-month norm, and whether insurers capped surgeries per hospital. Minister Schippers said waiting times fell by a month since 2008, deferred urgency to specialists and the profession, deregulated prices in 2012, and promised talks with orthopaedic surgeons and monitoring by the NZa.
I have asked the NZa to monitor this and to ask the insurers concerned what they will do to reduce waiting times.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd om dit te monitoren en de betrokken zorgverzekeraars te vragen wat zij gaan doen om de wachttijden te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Klaver over seksuele vorming en de seksuele gezondheid van jongeren

MPs Voortman and Klaver asked the ministers about condom use, STI rates among young people, and whether schools and parents should do more sexual education. The government answered that schools' role is set by attainment targets and school-level choices, that GGDs run prevention campaigns, and that no new school-specific measures are planned.
However, schools themselves decide on which topics and in what way they involve parents in their children's education.
Scholen bepalen echter zelf bij welke onderwerpen en op welke manier zij ouders betrekken bij het onderwijs van hun kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Schouw, Gesthuizen, Ouwehand en Voordewind over de voorgenomen ontruiming van de vluchtflat

MPs asked the state secretary what happens to residents of the Amsterdam 'vluchtflat' without residence prospects after its planned eviction, whether immigration detention is appropriate for them, who bears responsibility for their welfare and medical care, and whether alternative shelter will be provided before eviction. The state secretary replied that residents may choose to work on return and then get shelter in a freedom-restricting location with DT&V facilitation, that detention is a last resort applied case by case, that residents remain responsible for their own choices while retaining right to necessary medical care, and that he shares the ambition to prevent residents ending up on the street.
Since the residents of the Vluchtflat show no willingness to return and hardly want to talk to the DT&V, I do not rule out that in individual cases immigration detention may be the last resort.

Nu de bewoners van de Vluchtflat niet getuigen van terugkeerbereidheid en nauwelijks willen praten met de DT&V, sluit ik niet uit dat in individuele gevallen vreemdelingenbewaring het uiterste middel kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Schouw over de voorgenomen uitzetting van een Angolese asielzoeker

MPs from ChristenUnie, SP, GroenLinks and D66 asked whether the government would reconsider the age cutoff of the Kinderpardon scheme, which excludes a 22-year-old Angolan asylum seeker who arrived at age ten, and whether he could await his objection procedure in the Netherlands and why he remains in detention. The State Secretary refused to revisit the upper age limit, allowed the man to await his objection procedure in the Netherlands, and defended detention given his earlier evasion of lighter measures.
I have now decided that the person concerned may await his objection procedure in the Netherlands.
Inmiddels heb ik besloten dat betrokkene zijn bezwaarprocedure in Nederland mag afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over verzekeraars die werkgevers chanteren om medische gegevens van werknemers door te spelen

An MP asked whether insurers pressuring employers to obtain employees' medical data violate privacy, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges that privacy rules are not always respected in sickness-absence management, calls the practice undesirable, and says the insurers' association will be asked to adjust practices and report on progress, while the CBP is responsible for supervision.
I will ask the VvV to keep me informed of the progress of this, so that such practices are prevented in the future.
Ik zal het VvV vragen mij op de hoogte te houden van de voortgang hiervan, zodat dergelijke uitvoeringspraktijken in de toekomst worden voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over de behandeling van asielzoekers op Schiphol

An MP asked the State Secretary about hunger-striking asylum seekers in border detention at Schiphol, the legal basis for detaining air arrivals but not land arrivals, duration of detention, and whether border detention should be abolished. The State Secretary replied that border detention is a necessary measure balancing legal protection against Schengen border obligations, that each case is assessed individually, and that alternatives are being explored, while referring the UNHCR/Vluchtelingenwerk critique to a separate letter.
That is also why it is assessed individually whether there is reason to lift the border detention.
Dat is ook de reden dat individueel wordt bekeken of er aanleiding is de grensdetentie op te heffen.

Vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie Nederland in gebre

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked the minister and state secretary about the European Commission's infringement notice against the Netherlands for not implementing the energy performance of buildings directive, and what the government would do to meet the obligations and reduce voluntary measures. The government answered that it takes the notice seriously, is in consultation with the Commission and simplifying the energy label, and expects the EU targets to be met with the chosen mix of measures, with an evaluation planned for 2016.
I of course take this notice seriously.
Ik neem dit bericht uiteraard serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over “een arbodienst die medische gegevens doorgegeven heeft aan werkgevers”

An MP asked the ministers whether they would act on a privacy regulator finding that an occupational health service and a sickness-absence firm passed unnecessary medical data to employers, and how doctor independence and worker privacy can be guaranteed. The minister says the company's breaches have ended, the regulator will check the occupational health service, and the government awaits SER advice on arbeidsgerelateerde zorg by March 2014 before considering further measures.
I therefore regret that these two companies acted carelessly.
Ik betreur het dan ook dat deze twee bedrijven onzorgvuldig hebben gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra en Voortman over autisme en rijbewijskeuringen

MPs asked why people with autism must be medically re-examined for a driving licence, whether a standard test and a public list of examining specialists should exist, why examination fees vary, and whether periodic re-examination can be dropped after the Health Council advice. The minister explains the Health Council basis and checklist, notes that the NZa sets maximum fees and plans tariff differentiation from 2014, declines free choice of doctor for now while promising to weigh a list with the CBR and specialists, and intends to adopt the advice dropping triennial re-examination by 1 October.
I intend to adopt this advice from the Health Council.
Ik ben voornemens dit advies van de Gezondheidsraad over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Voortman over onterecht betaalde belasting door zwangere zzp’ers

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether self-employed women (zzp'ers) who paid income tax on pregnancy benefits from their insurer can recover it, whether earlier years are covered, and what measures will prevent future over-taxation. The State Secretary answered that affected taxpayers can request ex officio reduction until five years after the tax year, that these benefits are not taxable, and that the Tax Administration will add a note on this to general information and the income tax return guidance.
The self-employed person can therefore still submit a request for ex officio reduction throughout 2013 for the years 2008 and onward.
De zzp’er kan gedurende het hele jaar 2013 dus nog een verzoek om ambtshalve vermindering indienen over de jaren 2008 en volgende.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over asielvergunningen aan alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers (ingezonden d.d. 1 juli 2013).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how many asylum permits were granted in 2012 and the first half of 2013 to unaccompanied minor asylum seekers across procedure types, and how the best interests of the child are taken into account in their procedures. The State Secretary said the figures cannot yet be provided because INDiGO management information is being restored in phases, expected from Q1 2014, and described existing child-specific safeguards such as specialised interviewers, a child-friendly interview room and tailored reception.
It is not yet possible to provide detailed information, which means the questions about unaccompanied minors cannot yet be answered.
Het is nog niet mogelijk om gedetailleerde informatie te leveren, wat betekent dat de gestelde vragen over amv’s nog niet kunnen worden beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Voortman over nieuwe fraudemogelijkheden met DigiD en gebrekkige dienstverlening van DigiD bij incidenten

MPs Verhoeven and Voortman asked the Interior Minister about DigiD fraud, where intercepted activation codes let perpetrators hijack accounts and obtain benefits, and about DigiD's handling of victims. The minister replied that misuse requires intercepting the postal code, that accounts are blocked on suspicion of fraud, that 118 fraudulent cases were found, and that a future eID issued in person is planned.
An investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into the use of the unlawfully obtained DigiDs is currently ongoing.
Op dit moment loopt een onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar het gebruik van de onrechtmatig verkregen DigiD's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de zwijgplicht over de huizenprijzen

An MP asked the housing minister whether he agreed with the big banks not to publish house price forecasts, and whether any such agreement excluded information from Parliament. The minister denied any such agreement, said he does not seek to influence bank research, and stressed the importance of reliable, independent housing market data.
No, this report is not correct. I also do not wish to exert influence over what banks research and publish.
Nee, dit bericht klopt niet. Ik wens ook geen invloed uit te oefenen op wat banken onderzoeken en publiceren.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over het bericht dat zorgorganisaties veel mensen die het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) verliezen geen zorg kunnen bieden

An MP asks whether care providers can serve people losing their personal budget (pgb) under the 10-hour rule and whether the government will change course. The Secretary of State says talks with Per Saldo, care offices and sector bodies are ongoing on how the rule can work, with an update expected in early July.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this in early July.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer hierover begin juli te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over het toepassen van het mvv-vereiste in gezinsmigratiezaken waar kinderen bij betrokken zijn

An MP asks whether the government will waive the mvv (provisional residence permit) requirement for a Dutch child's Nigerian mother in a family-migration case, citing ECHR and CRC principles. The state secretary declines to discuss the individual case, defends the mvv requirement as a pre-entry check, and says exemptions or the hardship clause may apply on the merits.
As is known, I cannot provide information about an individual case.
Zoals bekend kan ik geen informatie verstrekken over een individuele zaak.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over de aangenomen resolutie over sociale huisvesting in de Europese Unie

An MP asked the Minister for Housing whether the government shares concerns that the €34,229 income ceiling for social housing blocks middle-income households, whether Dutch discretion over the target group could be widened, and whether the government will renegotiate with the European Commission after a European Parliament resolution. The minister answered that the income limit is a member-state competence within EU competition rules, that waiting times for eligible households have fallen, and that renegotiation with the Commission is not considered necessary.
I do not consider it necessary to consult the European Commission on this again.
Ik acht het niet noodzakelijk daarover opnieuw met de EC te overleggen.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over het op straat zetten van voormalige tentenkampbewoners

An MP asked whether former tent-camp residents at Ter Apel were told they would be made homeless from 17 June, and why, and asked the government to await the advisory report on a broader buitenschuld (no-fault) criterion. The state secretary denied a fixed cut-off date, said continued shelter depends on effort toward return, and said he would not anticipate the forthcoming advice.
In the short term the Advisory Committee on Migration Affairs (ACVZ) will issue advice on the no-fault policy.
Op korte termijn komt de Adviescommissie voor Vreemdelingenzaken (ACVZ) met een advies over het buitenschuldbeleid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Schouw over uitzettingen van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, ChristenUnie and D66 asked the state secretary whether Guinean laissez-passers for deportations were issued despite the Guinean ambassador's claim that he signed none, and why Guinea did not take part in taskforces. The state secretary answered that about 20 laissez-passers were obtained in 2013 from the Brussels mission, signed by the consul, that two deportations have taken place, and that there is no reason to suspend deportations to Guinea.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman inzake risico's van de bezuinigingen voor de kwaliteit van de kinderopvang

An MP asked the minister about an Abvakabo survey showing quality pressures in childcare, staffing ratios not being met, growth in zero-hour contracts, and underspending on childcare allowance. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to GGD inspection and municipal enforcement, and declined to reinvest the underspent funds given the economic situation.
Locations where frequent and/or serious violations (such as on the staff-child ratio) are found are visited more often by the GGD.
Locaties waar veelvuldig en/of zware overtredingen (zoals op de beroepskracht-kindratio) worden geconstateerd, worden extra vaak bezocht door de GGD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de regeling aanwijzing groep chronisch zieken en gehandicapten

MP Voortman asked the government whether the narrow hardship clause for chronically ill and disabled tenants under the income-dependent rent increase should be widened, covering those who cannot reasonably move, including people with mantelzorg-reduced care indications and those who paid for adaptations. Minister Blok defended the existing criteria as needed for enforceability, offered only limited coulance for adapted dwellings and deferred on the mantelzorg compliment, promising to revisit that scheme.
No, I do not have this data available.
Nee, over deze gegevens beschik ik niet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Schouw en Voordewind over uitzettingen van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, D66 and ChristenUnie asked about cooperation between the Guinean embassy in Brussels and the Guinean taskforce in the Netherlands on deportations, why a May 2013 taskforce was postponed, and whether there is a dispute between them. The state secretary answered that presentations are coordinated with both channels, that the postponement was due to unspecified Guinean reasons, that he knows of no dispute, and that about 100 travel documents were issued in 2012 with roughly a third of those returned, with no reason to suspend deportations.
I am not aware of any disagreement between the Guinean taskforce and the Guinean government.
Van onenigheid tussen de Guineese taskforce en de Guineese overheid is mij niets bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over “de onkostenvergoeding voor gemeenteraadsleden en de gevolgen hiervan voor mensen met een wajong-uitkering "

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether council members' expense allowances count as taxable income, which can reduce income-linked benefits such as Wajong-related supplements, making council membership difficult for people with disabilities. The State Secretary answered that under the work-cost scheme (werkkostenregeling) the allowance can be kept outside taxable income, removing the financial obstacle, while noting the transition is not yet complete in all municipalities.
With the introduction of the work-cost scheme, the expense allowance of council members classed as fictitious employees can be kept outside the individual taxable wage of a council member.

Met de invoering van de werkkostenregeling kan de onkostenvergoeding van raadsleden die als fictief werknemer worden aangemerkt buiten het individuele belastbaar loon van een raadslid worden gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman en Schouw van Uw Kamer over de medische behandeling van vreemdelingen

MPs Voordewind, Voortman and Schouw asked the state secretary about the medical treatment of a hunger-striking asylum seeker at a Rotterdam detention centre, including allegations of mistreatment by a physician and restricted access for the trusted doctor. The state secretary defended the use of force by an internal assistance team, said the detainee refused a medical examination, referred the assault complaint to a police investigation, and stated that access and care procedures were followed.
If the outcomes give reason to do so, I will inform your House confidentially about this individual case.
Indien de uitkomsten daartoe aanleiding geven, zal ik uw Kamer vertrouwelijk over deze individuele casus informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat 220 duizend Nederlanders zich zwaar belast voelen door mantelzorg

MP Voortman asked the state secretary about a report that 220,000 Dutch people feel heavily burdened by informal care, and about the causes, support rights, and effects of AWBZ/PGB cuts on carers' respite and the mantelzorgcompliment. The state secretary acknowledged the burden, said it stems mainly from many hours of care, and pointed to municipal responsibility and planned measures without committing to new concrete steps.
So I am proceeding from what people can informally organise.
Ik ga dus uit van wat mensen informeel kunnen organiseren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat patiënten vaker in nood zijn door verdwenen medicijnen

An MP asked the health minister about reports that patients increasingly face shortages of medicines withdrawn or unavailable, and about the causes, consequences, and remedies such as a notification duty for manufacturers. The minister acknowledged the concern, said most shortages have substitutes but about 1% have none, and promised a plan of action before the summer recess.
I will, as I previously promised you, send a plan of action to the House of Representatives before the summer recess
Ik zal, zoals ik u eerder reeds heb toegezegd, voor het zomerreces een plan van aanpak naar de Tweede Kamer sturen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over Nieuwe medicijnen die niet goed getest zijn

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about a study finding that 15 percent of new chronic-disease drugs approved 2000-2010 did not meet the recommended trial size, and what would be done about it. The minister replied that the recommendation is a guideline weighed case by case, that drugs admitted with fewer patients typically carry conditions for post-approval research, and that pharmacovigilance monitors side effects after market entry.
When a study includes fewer patients than the guideline recommends, the CBG weighs whether registration can proceed.
Wanneer een onderzoek minder patiënten omvat dan in de richtlijn wordt aanbevolen, maakt het CBG een afweging of tot registratie kan worden overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Voortman en Voordewind over de uitzetting van een ernstig zieke vreemdeling

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked why a seriously ill Togolese former unaccompanied minor, resident over eleven years, faces deportation, why the state appealed a court ruling in his favour, and whether the discretionary power should be used. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, restated the medical-stay procedure and the general policy framework, and said rootedness is not an objective criterion.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case in answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, vind ik het niet wenselijk om in de beantwoording van kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht “Verstandelijk beperkte jongen week vast in Amsterdamse cel

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a report that a young man with an intellectual disability was held in an Amsterdam cell for five days after a police stop, asking whether this was proper, whether he was denied family contact and food, and whether aftercare will be provided. The State Secretary answers that the stop and detention followed procedure, that the youth's disability was not reported and gave no reason for care, that no aftercare will be arranged, but that detention was not the most suitable measure, so a damages offer was made to the lawyer.
In view of the information about the person that became known afterwards, detention was not the most appropriate measure.
Gelet op de informatie over de persoon van betrokkene die achteraf bekend is geworden, was inbewaringstelling niet het meest geëigende middel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over veiligheidscontroles bij medische kinderdagverblijven

An MP asked whether safety and quality controls at medical day-care centres for young children are adequate and why stricter rules for regular childcare (staff screening, four-eyes principle) do not apply to them. The state secretary replied that medical day-care falls under youth care law and health inspectorate oversight, that the four-eyes principle is impractical in youth care, that screening is being studied, and that no new legislation extending the childcare act is planned.
For youth care, it is currently being examined whether permanent screening of staff is possible and advisable.
Voor de zorg voor jeugd wordt momenteel onderzocht of permanente screening van medewerkers mogelijk en opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat tienduizenden mensen hun zorg verliezen als gevolg van de 10-uursgrens voor het persoonsgebonden budget

MP Voortman asked the state secretary about reports that tens of thousands of people will lose care under the 10-hour limit on personal budgets (pgb) for care, and whether this is affordable and adequate. The state secretary said the Per Saldo survey is not a formal study, that the 10-hour limit's effects will be reported to parliament, that care offices are responsible for providing suitable care, and that he sees no reason yet to revise the policy.
I do not find it appropriate or effective to respond to an ongoing reporting campaign that is not representative and on which care offices have not been asked for their view.
Ik vind het niet passend en effectief te reageren op een nog lopende meldactie die niet representatief is en waar bovendien zorgkantoren niet naar hun oordeel is gevraagd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over "het bericht dat Nederland voor het Europees Hof wordt gedaagd wegens onvoldoende bescherming van zwangere vrouwen tegen discriminatie".

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the European Commission would take the Netherlands to the EU Court over inadequate protection of pregnant women against discrimination at work. The state secretary replied that existing law is sufficient, the problem being awareness rather than regulation, that the infringement procedure is not yet before the Court, and that the Netherlands opposes extending maternity leave to 18 weeks with full pay.
I am of the view that this is sufficiently regulated by law.
Ik ben van mening dat dit voldoende wettelijk is geregeld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman inzake taalproblemen in de zorg

An MP asked the health minister about language barriers in healthcare, including whether reduced publicly funded interpreter services lower care quality and raise costs. The minister replied that patients are primarily responsible for communicating in Dutch, pointed to family support, pictorial aids and the Kwaliteitsinstituut, found no proof of quality loss or extra costs, and promised to report on an investigation by May 2013.
I have no indication of extra care costs incurred because the patient does not command the Dutch language
Ik heb geen indicatie van extra zorgkosten die gemaakt worden omdat de patiënt de Nederlandse taal niet machtig is
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het middel Alemtuzumab

An MP asked the health minister whether manufacturer Genzyme withdrew access to alemtuzumab for aggressive multiple sclerosis and whether a future higher price for the MS indication is justified. The minister confirmed the drug is off the market for MS outside study settings, said she cannot rule out a higher price on reintroduction, and saw no reason to intervene since trial patients continue treatment.
I understand the manufacturer has submitted a marketing authorisation application to the EMA for the use of alemtuzumab in MS.
Ik heb begrepen dat de fabrikant een registratie-aanvraag bij EMA heeft ingediend voor het gebruik van alemtuzumab bij MS.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over hoogopgeleide arbeidsgehandicapten, die noodgedwongen in de Wajong terecht komen

An MP asked the state secretary about highly educated disabled people who end up on the Wajong benefit because employers do not hire them, including a blind lawyer's case, and asked about government targets, UWV re-integration practice and benefit levels. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to planned quota rules from 2015, ongoing government initiatives, individual tailoring by UWV, and rejected any cut to the Wajong benefit.
The policy aims to increase the labour market participation opportunities of people with a disability.
Het beleid is gericht op het vergroten van de mogelijkheden tot arbeidsdeelname van mensen met een handicap.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren over het weigeren van blindengeleidehonden door taxichauffeurs

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked whether taxi drivers refusing guide dogs, shown on PowNews, is acceptable and what measures exist to guarantee taxi accessibility. The state secretary condemned refusals, said municipalities can impose accessibility and carriage duties under the Taxiwet, promised to urge municipalities to act, and said national legislation is not needed.
I will urge the municipalities to include this point in their local taxi regulations.
Ik zal bij de gemeenten aandringen dit punt in hun locale taxiregelgeving op te nemen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht ‘Nederland zet weer Somalische asielzoekers uit'

Green Left MP Voortman asked the State Secretary about reports that the Netherlands was resuming forced returns of Somali asylum seekers to Mogadishu, and about safety, monitoring and the views of UNHCR, Amnesty and VluchtelingenWerk. Teeven answered that the February 2013 removal was halted by a court, that returns to all of Somalia are again possible, and that individual assessment and the CITT oversight provide adequate safeguards, while not sharing the safety concerns.
It is expected that this will not involve more than a few removals per month.
Naar verwachting zal het niet om meer dan enkele uitzettingen per maand gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het gebruik van persoonsgebonden budget in het buitenland

An MP from GroenLinks asked why PGB holders may purchase AWBZ care abroad, even within the EU, for only 13 calendar weeks per year, while care in kind has no such time limit. The state secretary answered that the 13-week limit aligns with restitution rules and that EU law requires no export of cash payments like the PGB, so the difference is justified, and he sees no reason to extend the period.
I see no reason to extend the 13-week period during which the granted PGB can be used abroad.
Ik zie geen reden om de periode van 13 weken waarin het toegekende pgb in het buitenland kan doorlopen te verruimen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over de sterke stijging van het aantal failliete kinderdagverblijven in 2012

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in childcare bankruptcies in 2012, whether budget cuts are to blame, and what the government will do about employment and parents' ability to keep working. The minister attributes the bankruptcies to several causes including the economic crisis, higher parental fees and more competition, sees no need for further research, promises an analysis on usage of childcare in Q2 2013, and is willing to discuss childcare with the social partners if they wish.
Further research I do not consider necessary.
Een verder onderzoek acht ik niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Voortman over de verwevenheid van Nictiz en de Vereniging van Zorgaanbieders voor Zorgcommunicatie (VZVZ)

MPs Van Gerven and Voortman asked the minister about the ties between Nictiz and VZVZ, including whether Mr Velzel negotiated a company car with chauffeur as a secondary employment condition. The minister replied that the work is done under a consultancy contract and that she has no insight into that contract, so she cannot provide the information requested.
I have no insight into this contract and therefore do not have the information you requested.
Ik heb geen inzicht in dit contract en beschik dan ook niet over de door u gevraagde informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Voortman over de verwevenheid van Nictiz en VZVZ

Two MPs asked the health minister about the relationship between VZVZ and Nictiz, their funding, and whether VZVZ is a front for the ministry pushing the EPD/LSP. The minister answered that both are legally independent private organisations, that VZVZ is a self-run initiative of care providers funded partly by insurers, and that the government has no knowledge of a consultant contract's terms.
I have no insight into this contract and therefore do not have the information you requested.
Ik heb geen inzicht in dit contract en beschik dan ook niet over de door u gevraagde informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht ‘Steeds minder bedrijfsartsen’

MP Voortman asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about a report on the declining number of occupational physicians, including why intake is low, whether the specialty should be publicly funded, and whether statutory access to occupational physicians should be restored. Minister Asscher answered that responsibility for worker health lies first with workers and employers, that the cause of low intake is not yet explained, that the Arbowet deregulation keeps access to occupational physicians a matter for social partners, and that the government will consider the points in its response to the SER advice.
The Minister of SZW will further take your question into account in preparing the cabinet position on the cited SER advice and on the question of occupational health services in the longer term.

De Minister van SZW zal uw vraag voorts betrekken bij de voorbereiding van het kabinetsstandpunt naar aanleiding van genoemd SER-advies en bij het vraagstuk van de bedrijfsgezondheidszorg op de langere termijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het stopzetten van de vervoersregeling voor gehandicapte teamsporters

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister whether she is aware that the Fonds Gehandicaptensport has ended its transport scheme for disabled team athletes due to insufficient funds, and whether she will seek a structural solution. The minister confirmed the facts and stated that she is consulting with stakeholders on options for a structural solution, promising to inform parliament by 15 March 2013.
Together with the parties involved, I am in consultation to explore the possibilities of reaching a structural solution for the transport scheme.
Samen met betrokken partijen ben ik in overleg om de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om tot een structurele oplossing te komen voor de vervoersregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht 'Inzet wijkverpleegkundigen op de tocht'

An MP asked the health minister whether roughly half of the 'zichtbare schakel' budget for extra district nurses would no longer be used for that purpose by municipalities, and whether the funding would remain. The minister denied that the budget is being diverted, explaining the uneven yearly amounts as a result of late project starts, and said the funding was made structural for at least two years while the future financing model and the 2015 intensification are still being worked out.
The success of the visible link must be continued.
Het succes van de zichtbare schakel moet worden voortgezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht ‘pensioengeld belegd in kernwapens’

The MP asked whether the government will act on Dutch pension funds investing about 830 million euro in nuclear weapons makers, including the ABP's 50 percent increase, and whether it will require funds to disclose abandoned exclusion policies. The state secretary replied that funds are primarily responsible for their own investment policy, declined to motivate exclusion, and pointed to a pending bill requiring funds to disclose how they account for ESG factors.
Pension funds are primarily themselves responsible for the investment policy.
Pensioenfondsen zijn primair zelf verantwoordelijk voor het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voorman over het bericht “Verhuurders van kamers studenten zwaar getroffen”

An MP asked the minister for Housing whether the government's rental rules (rent at 4.5% of WOZ value) threaten student room rentals and the 30,000-room shortage, citing cancelled projects in Delft and Leiden, and whether student housing could be exempted. The minister said he is consulting parties and will inform parliament in spring after analyses, deferring decisions on individual projects to the clients.
I have already indicated to the House that, alongside talks with stakeholders, I want analyses of these measures on the (rental) housing market to be carried out first.
Aan de Kamer heb ik reeds aangegeven naast de gesprekken met betrokkenen ook eerst analyses over deze maatregelen op de (ver)huurmarkt te willen laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Voortman over de acties in de verpleeghuiszorg van 3 november jl

MPs Kuzu, Leijten and Voortman asked whether care provider Amsta received intensification funds for extra staff yet did not hire them, and questioned executive pay and strike-related measures. The state secretary answered that Amsta received about 4.1 million euros, reported on its use via a progress report, and that the government does not intend to request an overview from each institution; he also stated the right to strike is not in question.
Beyond the oversight of the care office, I monitor the progress of the realisation of the extra funds at macro level.
Naast het toezicht van het zorgkantoor monitor ik op macroniveau de voortgang van de realisatie van de extra middelen.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over de berichtgeving dat Nederland haar eigen inkomensbeleid mag voeren als het gaat om sociale verhuur

Voortman (GroenLinks) asks the minister of Housing about reports that the Netherlands may set its own income policy for social rental housing, citing PBL findings that waiting times rose for middle-income groups after the 34,085 euro income limit and asking why the limit was kept rather than raised. Minister Blok replies that member states set their own boundaries within EU competition rules, that waiting times fell for households below 34,000 euro but rose for higher incomes, and that the 10% allocation room for incomes up to 38,000 euro was chosen as a targeted measure with no final decision yet on a wider exception.
Member states are free to set their own limits within the European competition rules.
Het staat de lidstaten vrij om binnen de Europese mededingingsregels de eigen grenzen te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over inzake omkoping van ziekenhuizen door thuiszorginstellingen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister whether she knew that at least four hospitals had been paid by home-care providers for referring patients, and what sanctions, recovery of gains and measures would follow. The minister confirmed the reports, said the NZa had ordered the four hospitals to stop charging referral fees and published their names, and said the recovery question is subject to ongoing legal proceedings while the NZa still investigates the AWBZ institutions' role.
The NZa is currently still investigating the role of the AWBZ institutions in this matter.
De NZa onderzoekt op dit moment nog de rol van de AWBZ-instellingen in deze kwestie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaver en Voortman over het bericht “doof meisje kan geen journaliste worden”.

MPs Klaver and Voortman asked whether a deaf applicant was wrongly denied a place in journalism studies at Hogeschool Utrecht and whether the government would act, including on ratifying the UN disability convention. The state secretary replied that the student was selected, not refused, that the Equal Treatment Act requires reasonable adjustments, that the Commission for Equal Treatment can be called in, and that ratification work and a cost-benefit study are ongoing.
The Equal Treatment Act on grounds of disability or chronic illness prohibits making a distinction on grounds of disability or chronic illness.
De Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van handicap of chronische ziekte verbiedt onderscheid te maken op grond van handicap of chronische ziekte.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het vervallen van het pgb bij specialistische verpleging boven de 18 jaar

Voortman (GroenLinks) asked whether young people lose their personal budget (pgb) for specialist nursing when they turn 18, and whether personal control over this care can be preserved. The state secretary confirmed that adult care falls under the Zvw, that insurers decide whether to allow non-contracted care and restitution, and that the new cabinet will decide on organising and funding child hospital-based care.
It is up to the health insurer to offer that possibility, and the conditions under which, or not.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraar om die mogelijkheid, en de voorwaarden waaronder, wel of niet te bieden.
Antwoord vragen Voortman en Van Gent over het ontslag van klokkenluider bij VU Medisch Centrum

MPs Voortman and Van Gent asked whether the VU Medical Centre dismissed pulmonologist Postmus for raising patient safety concerns, and how whistleblowers in healthcare are protected. The minister says Postmus was placed on non-active status for an employment matter, not dismissed, promises intensified inspection and points to reporting channels and the new Adviespunt Klokkenluiders, but declines a separate inquiry into the case.
This concerns an employment-law matter whose content is not known to me.
Het gaat hier om een arbeidsrechtelijke zaak waarvan de inhoud mij niet bekend is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over de gezondheidszorg in penitentiaire inrichting Nieuwegein

An MP asked the state secretary and health minister about alleged inadequate medical care at PI Nieuwegein, including a former detainee's case and calls for IGZ, Ombudsman and inspection investigations. The government replied that care was adequate, cited an IGZ 2011 follow-up finding that care met standards, noted the RSJ rejected the complaint, and declined further investigation or emergency measures.
In view of the above, and my answer to question 2, I do not consider further investigation or emergency measures necessary.
Gelet op het voorgaande, en mijn antwoord op vraag 2, acht ik nader onderzoek en het treffen van noodvoorzieningen niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het artikel “Tena beoordeelt incontinente patient”

An MP asked the health minister about a report that Tena, a manufacturer, assesses which incontinence products patients need, raising concerns about cost, independence, privacy and marketing use of patient data. The minister replied that insurers and pharmacies set the arrangements, that the pharmacist remains responsible for the choice, that privacy rules apply and that she has no insight into the insurer-pharmacy contracts.
I do not have insight into the contracts concluded between the insurer and the pharmacist.
Ik heb geen inzage in de contracten die zijn afgesloten tussen verzekeraar en apotheker.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht “Niet alleen Tena belt incontinente patiënten”

MP Voortman asked whether the minister would widen an investigation into Tena's calls to incontinent patients to other manufacturers, halt such calls pending results, and involve the privacy regulator. The minister said no separate investigation is needed since the CBP is already questioning Tena, and that Tena has stopped calling patients for now.
The CBP is an independent administrative body and, as indicated, the CBP has asked Tena questions about the matter.
Het CBP is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan en zoals aangeven, heeft het CBP Tena vragen gesteld over het onderwerp.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over zorginstellingen die ouderen 44 uur in bed laten liggen

An MP asked the state secretary whether nursing homes keep elderly residents in bed for 44 hours due to staff shortages and why extra funding has not yet produced more nursing staff. The secretary said the bed-rest case was a specific care decision agreed with the legal representative, that staffing plans funded by the extra money are being implemented, and that no direct effects can be judged yet.
Care institutions cannot simply keep elderly people in bed without a clear agreement on this being included in the treatment plan.
Zorginstellingen kunnen niet zomaar ouderen in bed laten liggen, zonder dat hierover een duidelijke afspraak in het behandelplan opgenomen is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over problemen met stemmen voor blinden en slechtzienden

An MP asked why the 2010 tactile voting template for blind and partially sighted voters was not continued, and whether every polling station will have such an aid and whether voters can vote secretly and unassisted. The minister said the template was too large and complex and that work continues on a simpler ballot model, while assisted voting and proxy voting must remain available.
Therefore the cabinet is working on developing a new model ballot with which blind and partially sighted people can cast their vote independently, using a template.
Daarom werkt het kabinet aan de ontwikkeling van een nieuw model stembiljet waarmee blinden en slechtzienden zelfstandig, met behulp van een mal, hun stem kunnen uitbrengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over acute verloskunde in Meppel

An MP asked the health minister about the future of acute midwifery care and paediatrics in Meppel, including a hospital board member's statements, the state of consultations, and whether ambulance response times were at risk. The minister said the parties are being brought back to the table under a facilitated review, that a decision-shaping framework is expected by 1 November 2012, and that independent RIVM research on ambulance travel times will inform local decisions.

I expect that, as agreed in these consultations between all parties, the outlines of the care landscape and the organisation of the maternity care chain in the Meppel region will be known by 1 November 2012.

Ik verwacht dat, zoals afgesproken in deze overleggen tussen alle partijen, op 1 november 2012 de contouren van het zorglandschap en de inrichting van de keten van geboortezorg in de regio Meppel bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Voortman over de uitslag van het referendum over de cao VVT (Verpleeg- en Verzorgingshuizen en Thuiszorgorganisaties)

MPs Leijten and Voortman asked why 96 percent of over 20,000 participants rejected the cao VVT in a referendum, how legitimacy could be restored and how the motion they filed would be handled. The state secretary said he had no explanation, stated that his personal view on the cao was not relevant as he is not a party to it, and passed the motion to the responsible minister at SZW.
I have no explanation for that.
Daar heb ik geen verklaring voor.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi en Voortman over de overwegingen van de GGD bij het keuren van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers

MPs Voortman and Dibi asked whether GGD doctors assessing rejected asylum seekers are influenced by non-medical considerations, whether untreated dental cases reflect this, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. Minister Schippers said doctors must judge objectively, defended excluding specialist dental care from the care fund as parallel to insured patients, and said the Inspectorate will address vulnerable groups broadly rather than a separate inquiry.
I prefer such a broad approach over an approach that only looks at the role of one target group and/or actor.
Ik geef de voorkeur aan een dergelijke brede insteek boven een insteek die slechts toeziet op de rol van één doelgroep en/of actor.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Voortman over algemeen verbindendverklaring van de cao voor de verpleeg- en verzorgingshuizen en thuiszorgsector (VVT)

MPs Leijten and Voortman asked why the minister rejected a motion against declaring the VVT care sector collective agreement generally binding, and whether low sector-wide support and workload concerns are in the public interest. The state secretary answered that procedural and policy rules do not allow the government to weigh in, that representativeness will be assessed by the Minister of SZW, and that top-salary issues are addressed through the WNT bill.
I justified advising against the motion on the ground that the procedural and policy rules on declaring agreements generally binding do not allow me to play a role in it.
Ik heb het ontraden van de motie gemotiveerd met het argument dat de procedure- en beleidsregels rond het algemeen verbindend verklaren het niet toelaten dat ik daar een rol in speel.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over de Europese richtlijn omtrent de rechten van patiënten bij grensoverschrijdende zorg

An MP asked the health minister about the EU patients' rights directive on cross-border care, including implementation plans, barriers, a border-region test, a national contact point, and a pilot with border hospitals. The minister answered that Dutch law already largely meets the directive, that only a national contact point and recognition of prescriptions need to be added, and that implementation is due by October 2013.
The Netherlands therefore does not need to develop additional legislation in that area.
Nederland hoeft daarom op dat terrein geen aanvullende wetgeving te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord vragen Voortman en El Fassed over het bericht dat het UMC St. Radboud patiënten door middel van DigiD toegang geeft tot het patiëntendossier

MPs Voortman and El Fassed asked whether the Radboud UMC may give patients access to their medical records via DigiD, and what oversight prevents misuse and privacy breaches. The minister replied that DigiD level Midden plus a face-to-face identification at the hospital is used, that the hospital is bound by the Wbp under CBP oversight, and that DigiD only authenticates users and does not govern what data they may see.
The UMC St. Radboud is bound by the Personal Data Protection Act (WBP). The College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) supervises this.
Het UMC St. Radboud is gehouden aan de Wet Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (WBP). Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) houdt hier toezicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over ziekenhuisverplaatste zorg voor kinderen

MP Voortman asks whether hospital-based care for children is being moved from the AWBZ to health insurers, what this means for children's control over their care and their persoonsgebonden budget, and whether monitoring is planned. The state secretary denies a final decision has been taken, says the move will not happen before 1 January 2014, promises a letter in autumn, keeps the budget guarantee in place, and commits to monitoring after the Zvw financing is set up.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over de indicatie van intramuraal wonende moeders met een verstandelijke beperking

An MP asked the state secretary about mothers with intellectual disabilities living in AWBZ institutions with their children, who often lack an institutional indication, and about extra costs and a proposal to raise their care level to ZZP 7. The secretary said the AWBZ is not meant to cover care for non-indicated children, that parents are primarily responsible with support from youth services, and that no raise to ZZP 7 is warranted.
Safety, health, welfare and developmental stimulation of a child without an AWBZ indication are primarily the responsibility of the parents.
Veiligheid, gezondheid, welzijn en ontwikkelingsstimulering van een niet AWBZ-geïndiceerd kind horen primair tot de verantwoordelijkheid van de ouders.

Antwoord vragen Voortman en El Fassed over een EU-pilot voor een Europees elektronisch patiëntendossier en de uitspraken van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland inzake het verplicht stellen van aansluiting bij het Landelijk Schak

MPs Voortman and El Fassed asked about privacy safeguards in the EU-pilot EPSOS for a European electronic patient record and about insurers' plans to make connection to the national switchpoint (LSP) a contracting requirement. The minister said EPSOS pilots run only between other countries, that data stays at source with explicit patient consent, and that connection requirements are for the care providers' profession to set, with insurers not yet imposing one.
At this moment there is not yet any requirement to connect to the LSP.
Op dit moment is er nog geen sprake van een eis tot aansluiting op het LSP.

MPs from six parties asked the health minister about breast implants (PIP), the ASIA syndrome, the AZM autoimmune centre closure, registration, quality standards and liability. The minister said evidence linking implants to autoimmune disease is limited, referred to the pending NIV/NVPC study, and said clinics and insurers will cover aftercare while IGZ monitors, with other matters deferred to a separate letter.
Aftercare is the responsibility of the clinics and hospitals where these prostheses were implanted.
De nazorg is de verantwoordelijkheid van de klinieken en ziekenhuizen, waar deze protheses zijn ingebracht.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over het bericht dat het VU medisch centrum (VUmc) het medisch beroepsgeheim heeft geschonden

An MP asked the health minister about reports that VUmc hospital allowed a TV company to film emergency-room patients without prior consent, possibly breaching medical confidentiality. The minister said the public prosecutor is investigating whether an offence occurred, the inspectorate awaits that outcome, and she will alert hospitals to the rules on requesting consent, while declining to comment on agreements between VUmc and the filming company.
The OM will not make any statements about the content of those arrangements during the ongoing investigation.
Het OM zal geen mededelingen doen over de inhoud daarvan gedurende het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Voortman en Van Gent over het bericht dat homotherapie vergoed wordt

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether health insurers must reimburse 'homotherapy' aimed at curing homosexuality, which medical bodies call unsound and dangerous. Minister Schippers answered that such therapy is not covered by the Zvw, that the IGZ inspection found Different offers no treatment aimed at curing homosexuality, and that the IGZ will act on any new complaints.
Following the newspaper report, the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) paid an inspection visit to care organisation Different in Amsterdam.
Naar aanleiding van bedoeld krantenbericht, heeft de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) een inspectiebezoek gebracht aan zorgorganisatie Different te Amsterdam.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de terugloop van het aantal bedrijfsartsen en de druk die hi

An MP asked the ministers whether the shrinking number of occupational physicians (bedrijfsartsen) and the ageing of the profession would strain curative care and leave insufficient specialists, and what measures would be taken. The government acknowledged the signal, said the short-term shortage concern is not shared given lower market demand, is consulting the sector and examining cooperation between occupational and curative care, but declined to answer the question about the committee meeting.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de fusie tussen twee GGZ-instellingen (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether the Inspectorate for Health Care had assessed the effect of a merger between two mental health providers on care quality, and if so, what its verdict was. The minister replied that the regulators lack approval powers over mergers until stricter rules are enacted, but the inspectorate will monitor the providers more closely and intervene if care quality is endangered.

As long as the planned care-specific tightening of merger review is not legally anchored, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) have no approval power over proposed mergers.

Zolang de voorgenomen zorgspecifieke aanscherping van de fusietoetsing niet wettelijk is verankerd, hebben de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) geen goedkeuringsbevoegdheid ten aanzien van voorgenomen fusies.

An MP asked the health minister whether hospitals using PIP breast implants should bear removal costs, whether the 2001 IGZ advice was ignored, and what measures will prevent unsafe implants. The minister said the 2001 negative advice concerned different hydrogel implants, that hospitals could rely on the CE mark, and that the PIP case is fraud which existing regimes cannot fully prevent, with lessons to be drawn at EU level.
Naturally, it is being examined (particularly by the EU committee) what lessons can be drawn from the course of events surrounding PIP.
Vanzelfsprekend wordt (met name door de EU-cie) gekeken welke lessen uit de gang van zaken rondom PIP kunnen worden getrokken.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Van der Veen (Pvda), Van Gerven (SP) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitblijven van een structurele financiering van de to

Four MPs asked the health minister why structural funding for an extra ambulance post on Walcheren remains unsecured despite earlier commitments and a parliamentary motion. The minister said she asked the NZa in spring 2011 to expand the regional ambulance budget retroactively, but the NZa still lacks correct data from the regional service and insurers, and promised a decision within weeks.
The assessment of this request is for the NZa.
De beoordeling van dit verzoek is aan de NZa.

Vragen van de leden Uitslag (CDA) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Fokuswonen en het scheiden van wonen en zorg (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

MPs Uitslag and Voortman asked the state secretary about the status of a motion on separating housing and care, the letters from Fokuswonen on ADL cluster housing, and whether corporations should account for separating housing and care. The state secretary said cooperation with civil society has run since 2004, that the coupling of housing and ADL assistance serves to reserve adapted homes and secure 24-hour care, and that corporations already consider separating housing and care.
The minister of BZK recently announced that the cabinet wants to continue the action plans in the coming years.
De minister van BZK heeft recentelijk aangekondigd dat het kabinet de komende jaren een vervolg wil geven aan de actieplannen.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «aftrek 7 uur gebruikelijke zorg in strijd met wet» (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Health how the government would react to a Leeuwarden court ruling that the AWBZ policy rule deducting 7 hours of usual care from persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) claims conflicts with law, and whether CIZ would appeal. The state secretary answered that the one-hour margin is a long-standing indication practice, that other courts accepted it, that CIZ has appealed to the Centrale Raad van Beroep, and that she will await that outcome without taking further action.
The Leeuwarden court states that the content of the AWBZ indication policy rules on this point is not compatible with statutory provisions.
De rechtbank te Leeuwarden geeft aan dat de inhoud van de beleidsregels indicatiestelling AWBZ zich op dit punt niet verdraagt met wettelijke bepalingen.

Vragen van de leden Voortman en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de opvang van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers in Katwijk (ingezonden 7 november 2011

Green Left MPs asked the ministers whether medical care for rejected asylum seekers in the Katwijk reception centre was guaranteed after GPs ended cooperation with the COA, and whether medical dossiers and transfers were handled properly. The minister answered that care is guaranteed, that agreements were made with GPs and the COA on transfers, and that the COA is responsible for implementing the family-location framework.
In addition, I have explicitly instructed that a transfer will only take place after continuation of medical treatment at the new location has been guaranteed.
Daarnaast heb ik expliciet de opdracht gegeven dat een overplaatsing pas zal plaatsvinden nadat het continueren van de medische behandeling op de nieuwe locatie is gewaarborgd.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de dreigende sluiting van de acute verloskunde in Meppel (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the threatened closure of acute obstetric care in Meppel, including whether the hospital was asked not to close, the lack of clarity, midwives' exclusion from regional planning, and the inspectorate's study. The minister answers that the hospital was asked not to close until regional quality and accessibility norms are secured, that she will ask parties to re-engage midwives, and that the inspectorate's findings will be sent in early 2012.
However, I attach great importance to seeking a chain-wide approach (also) regarding midwifery care.
Ik hecht er echter groot belang aan dat (ook) ten aanzien van verloskundige zorg wordt gezocht naar een ketenbrede aanpak.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert (PvdA) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het beëindigen van de zorginkoop bij een zorgaanbieder in Twente (ingezonden 17 oktober 2011)

Two MPs asked why health insurer Menzis stopped contracting care from Bureau SPV in Twente, whether the underlying research can be shared, who supervises insurers' decisions, and whether there is any non-judicial route to challenge them. The state secretary said the Dutch health care authority (NZa) supervises legality and efficiency, the insurer is responsible for contracting decisions and the research is not held by the ministry, and that the only formal remedy is a court appeal.
No, there are no other formal ways than challenging the decision in court.
Nee er zijn geen andere – formele – manieren dan het besluit aan te vechten bij de rechter.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de Regeling Deskundigheidsbevordering Vrijwilligers (in

MP Voortman asked whether the subsidy scheme for volunteer expertise development would end, why organisations learned of this informally, and what support would follow. The state secretary confirmed no new national subsidies would be granted from 2012, citing budget cuts, low effectiveness and municipal responsibility, and promised a letter on informal care later in the year.
That no new subsidies could be granted from 2012 for national expertise development of volunteers was formally announced already in 2010.
Dat er vanaf 2012 geen nieuwe subsidies meer zouden kunnen worden verstrekt voor landelijke deskundigheidsbevordering van vrijwilligers is formeel al in 2010 aangekondigd.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Dijsselbloem (PvdA), Kooiman (SP), Koşer Kaya (D66), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn e

Six MPs asked the state secretary of Health why the Stichting Adoptievoorzieningen faces an extra structural cut to its aftercare subsidy on top of an earlier 1.5% efficiency cut, and whether this is disproportionate given a further cut from Justice. The state secretary answered that the cuts are justified by falling adoption numbers, that adoption-specific aftercare will largely remain, and that alternatives exist, and left the decision on a pending SGP amendment to the Chamber.
The budget cut obligation has forced me to make choices.
De bezuinigingstaakstelling heeft mij genoodzaakt keuzes te maken.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitnodiging vanuit Europa om te komen praten over de inkomensgrens sociale verhuur (ingezonden 20 oktober 201

Voortman asked the minister whether he knew of an EU Commissioner Barnier invitation to discuss the income ceiling for social housing and whether he would raise the ceiling to prevent waiting lists. Minister Donner replied that he was unaware of any such invitation and did not share the view that the income ceiling should be raised, referring to an earlier committee debate.
I am not aware of any invitation from Europe.
Mij is geen uitnodiging vanuit Europa bekend.

Vragen van de leden Voortman en Klaver (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bereiken van het subsidieplafond van projectsubsidies uit hoofde van het «Beleidskader Sport en Be

Two Green Left MPs asked the health minister whether the subsidy ceiling for the 'private interventions' sport-in-neighbourhoods scheme had been reached in 2011 and why the website still referred to applications. The minister confirmed the ceiling was reached, said 117 applications were received with 12 granted and 105 rejected, and declined to raise the budget, pointing to a new programme for 2012-2016.
No, I do not intend to increase the budget.
Nee, ik ben niet van plan het budget te verhogen.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Zorgkantoren negeren ZZP-ers voor AWBZ-zorg» (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

An MP asked why care offices reject self-employed care providers (ZZP'ers) for AWBZ care, and whether the state will act given the partial abolition of the personal budget (pgb). The State Secretary replied that rejections reflect the care offices' own purchasing criteria, that the offices have no contracting obligation, and that a separate budget and criteria for self-employed providers will be introduced.
I am making a separate budget available so that care offices can contract more in 2012.
Ik stel een apart budget beschikbaar zodat zorgkantoren in 2012 extra kunnen contracteren

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Groot artsentekort in verpleeghuis» (ingezonden

The MP asks whether a shortage of 180 elderly-care specialists is lowering care quality, whether the specialty is unpopular with medical students and what the minister will do, and why specialists earn about half of GP pay. The minister acknowledges the shortage, cites funding, training-place and alternative-staffing measures and says salary comparisons with GPs are misleading because specialists are employed while GPs are self-employed.
I share the concern. Various parties have therefore taken and are taking various measures to reduce the shortages.
Ik deel de bezorgdheid. Er zijn en worden door diverse partijen daarom verschillende maatregelen genomen om de tekorten te verminderen.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Steeds meer weekendrijders zonder alcohol de weg op» (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether mass-media campaigns such as the drink-driving (BOB) campaign and anti-smoking efforts are effective, and why the cabinet is ending lifestyle campaigns while keeping them for road safety. The minister replies that road safety is primarily the transport minister's responsibility, that mass campaigns are poorly targeted and hard to evaluate, and that the government will shift to targeted information via schools, websites and health professionals.
Apart from the question of effectiveness, this cabinet does not consider mass media campaigns the right way to influence the personal lifestyle choices of adult people.
Los van het vraagstuk van de effectiviteit, acht dit kabinet massamediale campagnes niet de juiste manier om de persoonlijke leefstijlkeuzes van volwassen mensen te beïnvloeden.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het onderzoek van de Landelijke Studenten Vakbond (LSVB) waaruit blijkt dat er een tekort aan studentenkamers is

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Interior Affairs how he would respond to an LSVB survey showing a shortage of about 30,000 student rooms and whether he was aware of it. The Minister replied that demand for student housing persists, that local shortages differ, and pointed to a forthcoming housing monitor and action plan without committing to specific immediate measures.
Together with Kences (umbrella of student housing providers), a student housing monitor is being developed to better and continuously map demand for student housing at local level.

Samen met Kences (koepel van studentenhuisvesters) wordt er daarom gewerkt aan een monitor studentenhuisvesting om de vraag naar studentenhuisvesting op lokaal niveau beter en continue in kaart te krijgen.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Kabinetsplannen bemoeilijken ouderenzorg» (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

Voortman (GroenLinks) asked the state secretary for Health about Verenso's warning that cabinet plans complicate elderly care, including moving specialists in geriatric medicine into the Health Insurance Act and the effect of co-payments on dementia care. The state secretary broadly supports better positioning of these specialists and says the organisation of funding is still under consideration, and refers to earlier answers that say a co-payment for dementia was not ruled out and a monitor on care avoidance will be set up.
On the question of how this can best be organised and funded, I am still considering it.
Over de vraag hoe dit het beste georganiseerd en bekostigd kan worden bezin ik mij nog.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht over de brief van Verzekeringscommissies van de samenwerkende CAM-artsenverenigingen aan Zorgverzekeraars Ne

An MP asked the minister whether insurers wrongly exclude CAM doctors from first-line care and refuse to reimburse lab and X-ray tests they order, and whether this hinders patient choice and the KNMG conduct rule. The minister answered that CAM care is not covered by the Zvw because it lacks evidence of effectiveness, that patients remain free to choose their doctor, and that reimbursement refusal does not hinder doctors from practising under the KNMG rule.

Because CAM provided by a CAM doctor does not belong to the medical care that general practitioners ordinarily provide, CAM doctors' care does not fall under the insured benefits of the Zvw and cannot be reimbursed through the Zvw.

Omdat CAM verleend door een CAM-arts niet behoort tot de geneeskundige zorg zoals huisartsen die plegen te bieden, valt de zorg van CAM-artsen niet onder de verzekerde prestaties van de Zvw en kan deze zorg niet via de Zvw worden vergoed.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de woonlasten van kopers en huurders (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the minister to respond to a Vereniging Eigen Huis study on owner-occupier housing costs and to explain how the government accounts for high housing-cost burdens of low-income households. The minister defends the Woononderzoek method, says maintenance costs are partly double-counted by VEH, promises a supplementary survey in 2013, and states that rent allowance will continue to dampen burdens despite planned cuts.
The ministry will include questions on household maintenance and improvement expenditure in the 2012 Energy module of the WoON, with results available in Q2 2013.
Het ministerie zal – in het kader van de Energiemodule 2012 van het WoON – enkele vragen opnemen over de onderhoud- en verbeteruitgaven van huishoudens

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Erasmus Medisch Centrum (EMC) Rotterdam patiënten weigert onder narcose te brengen bij een endoscopi

An MP asked the health minister whether Erasmus MC Rotterdam refuses to put patients under general anaesthesia for endoscopy because of budget cuts, and what she would do about it. The minister said the ministry does not comment on individual cases, described that sedation is usually light, and said the hospital is selective with adult general anaesthesia but offers it when light sedation is insufficient.
The Ministry of VWS does not make statements about individual cases.
Het ministerie van VWS doet geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten (SP), Voortman (Groenlinks) en Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over arbeidsvoorwaarden in de gemeentelijke thuiszorg (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

MPs asked the state secretary about a quality covenant requiring signalling in home care, its use in tendering, and why signalling is graded lower in the care job classification, and about a salary cut at a care provider. The state secretary said the Healthcare Institutions Quality Act already binds providers to the quality norms, declined to rule on classification disputes that belong to collective agreement procedures, and said salary matters are for employers and employees to settle.
In those procedures it is not fitting for a minister to make statements about labour disputes concerning working conditions.
In die procedures past het niet dat een bewindspersoon uitspraken doet over arbeidsvoorwaardelijke geschillen.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitzending van Kassa over de schadelijke effecten van 3D (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

MP Voortman asked the health minister about health risks of watching 3D images after a Kassa broadcast, whether independent Dutch research is needed, whether Dutch experts should be tasked with it, and what role NICAM/Kijkwijzer could play in consumer information. The minister acknowledged the reported nausea and dizziness, opposed additional Dutch research, offered to raise the issue at EU level, and said producers and the self-regulating industry body bear primary responsibility for consumer information.
As indicated in the previous answer, I am not in favour of separate additional research in the Netherlands.
Ik ben, zoals in het vorige antwoord aangegeven, geen voorstander van eigenstandig aanvullend onderzoek in Nederland.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de berichten «Bedrijfsarts onder druk gezet door werkgever en arbodiensten», en

An MP asks ministers whether they will act on reports that about one in five company doctors cannot work independently due to pressure from employers and occupational health services, including breaches of medical confidentiality and possible effects on sickness and care costs. The government promises a policy response later, notes that doctors should work independently, says confidential medical data should not be shared, and points to sector-led initiatives on contracts and specialist recruitment.
I am of the view that every company doctor must be able to carry out their work independently, in accordance with the applicable professional or conduct codes.
Ik ben van mening dat elke bedrijfsarts zijn werkzaamheden onafhankelijk, conform de geldende beroeps- of gedragcodes dient te kunnen uitoefenen.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «De gouden handdruk regeert» (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

MP Voortman asked the health minister about reports that hospitals still pay large severance payments to departing executives despite cuts, including payments above the one-year salary norm of the 2009 code, and whether the Wet Normering Topinkomens could apply to existing contracts. The minister replied by referring to her answers to near-identical questions from MP Gerbrands, without restating substance here.
For convenience, I refer to my answers to that set of questions.
Eenvoudigheidshalve verwijs ik naar mijn antwoorden op die set vragen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten (SP) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de intimidatie van werkgever Viva! Zorggroe

MPs Leijten and Voortman asked whether UWV's role in the Viva! Zorggroep dismissal applications concerns terminating employment or working conditions, whether the employer may obstruct union activity, and how to view the intimidating letters and refusal to let a union representative attend talks during a strike. The state secretary replied that UWV assesses only the business-economic necessity of the dismissals under the Ontslagbesluit, that the works council has a limited advisory role, that there is no legal duty for employers to permit union activity though dismissal protection exists, and that the labour dispute is not for government to judge.
This concerns a labour dispute between ViVa! Zorggroep and its employees. It is not for us to pass judgment on it.
Het betreft hier een arbeidsconflict tussen ViVa! Zorggroep en haar werknemers. Het is niet aan ons om hier een oordeel over te vellen.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zorg voor kankerpatiënten (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether Dutch cancer patients are denied experimental treatments such as Nexavar for GIST that are available in the US, and whether patients are given up too early. The minister answered that the treatment is not yet proven, that research is the manufacturer's and doctors' task, that Dutch cancer care is of high quality, and that the Inspectorate could look into possible undertreatment.
It seems right to me that those involved consult with the Health Care Inspectorate, so that the IGZ can assess whether patients are actually undertreated.
Het lijkt mij goed dat betrokkenen met de Inspectie van de Gezondheidszorg in overleg gaan, zodat de IGZ kan beoordelen of er daadwerkelijk sprake is van onderbehandeling van patiënten.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over doorverwijzing bij darmkanker en darmkankerscreening (ingezonden 8 april 2011)

MP Voortman asks the health minister about the NFK report that patients with colorectal liver metastases are under-referred for surgery, the need for research and a bowel cancer screening programme, and a public toilet priority card for bowel patients.
