The minister says more research is needed, expects a screening programme to start in 2013 after a feasibility assessment, and leaves the toilet card initiative to patient organisations.
I share the view that bowel cancer screening can prevent a great deal of suffering.
Ik deel de mening dat screening op darmkanker veel leed kan voorkomen.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport inzake de brief van het kabinet over het Persoonsgebonden Budget van 21 juni 2011 (ingezonden 23 juni 2011).

Voortman (GroenLinks) asks the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport whether 35,000–39,000 people will lose care under the PGB reform, why the programme letter figures are missing, how the 30% cheaper in-kind care assumption holds, how Wmo support for 70,000 people is guaranteed, and for projected PGB numbers and average costs. The state secretary denies that anyone falls through the cracks, explains the expected behavioural shifts, defends the assumptions and funding arrangements, and gives the requested figures.
As I indicated in my letter of Tuesday 21 June, no one falls between two stools, because the entitlement remains in place for everyone.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van dinsdag 21 juni (DLZ-6070169) heb aangegeven, valt niemand tussen wal en schip, omdat het recht voor iedereen behouden blijft.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Maastrichtse woningcorporatie Servatius (ingezonden 28

Opposition and coalition MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the WSW guarantee fund could cover liquidity shortfalls at Maastricht housing corporation Servatius, including the Campus Calatrava losses, and why a sanitation route via CFV was not used. The minister answered that WSW guarantees under category 6 were permitted, that the financing plan was approved by the appointed supervisor and the CFV/WSW, and that the planned sale of 1,850 homes was acceptable and that no formal council decision was needed.
It has been agreed with the backstoppers (the State and municipalities) that in all cases where the WSW considers guarantees under category 6, consultation with the backstoppers takes place first.
Met de achtervangers (Rijk en gemeenten) is afgesproken dat in alle gevallen dat het WSW borging onder categorie 6 overweegt, eerst overleg plaatsvindt met de achtervangers.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Te lange wachtlijsten voor transgenderzorg» (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about long waiting lists for transgender care at VUmc and whether these cause serious harm, and asked what measures would be taken. The minister explained the causes given by VUmc (shortage of expertise, rising demand, complex multidisciplinary care), said she lacks enough information on the consequences, declined to make promises beyond her system responsibility, and committed to consult VUmc and Transvisie on a sustainable future model.
I will, from my system responsibility, cooperate on a sustainable future transgender care in the Netherlands
Ik zal vanuit mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid meewerken aan een toekomstbestendige transgenderzorg in Nederland

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Waarom kennen vrouwen een van hun grootste risicofactoren voor borstkanker niet?» (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

MP Voortman asks the minister why women are not told that dense breast tissue is a major breast cancer risk factor, whether about 800 cancers are missed yearly, and whether breast density measurement should be added to the national screening programme. The minister says the missed-cancer figure is based on mainly American data and needs further research, that no alternative test exists yet so women are not informed of the risk, and that density assessment in screening is being studied.
As long as there is no scientific evidence, we unfortunately cannot offer women another or additional test.
Zolang er geen wetenschappelijk bewijs is, kunnen we vrouwen helaas geen andere of aanvullende test bieden.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «ActiZ adviseert tegen inzet zzp’ers». (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about an industry body's advice to care providers not to use self-employed workers (zzp'ers), and whether recent AWBZ and Wcz changes make their use possible. The state secretary said tax risks of subcontracting exist, that direct contracting will be tested in experiments with a report expected in 2012, and that the Wcz is a matter for parliament.
I will only decide on adjustments to regulations after reporting on the experiments.
Een beslissing over aanpassingen van regelgeving zal ik pas nemen na rapportage over de experimenten.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Assenaar in actie voor hulphond» van RTV Drenthe. (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether the assistance dog would be dropped from the basic insurance package in 2012, whether insurers are unduly withholding payments to dog trainers, and whether assistance dogs belong in the package. The minister said there is no plan to drop them, pointed to a planned CVZ cost-effectiveness review, said insurers follow protocols and have a duty of care, and recognised the dogs' value under current eligibility criteria.
I currently see no reason to remove the assistance dog from the package.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de hulphond uit het pakket te schrappen.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Bochove (CDA), De Boer (VVD), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kwaliteitsborging van energielabels

MPs asked the minister of Interior about quality assurance of energy labels, including how many were deregistered in 2010, whether spot checks by certifying bodies are legally regulated, whether certifying bodies may check firms they certified, and how many labels failed checks. The minister answered that certifying bodies found 582 deviations among 4,365 checked labels, leading to suspensions or withdrawals, that the market-based system is adequately safeguarded, and that the VROM-Inspectie's findings are not directly comparable.
I will continue to closely monitor the work of the Certifying Institutions and have them report to me regularly on their findings.
Ik zal de werkzaamheden van de Certificerende Instellingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en mij regelmatig laten rapporteren over hun bevindingen.

Vragen van de leden Voortman en Klaver (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de legitimatieplicht bij de verkoop van alcoholische dranken (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health minister about a CNV survey on age-verification duties for alcohol sales, including reported aggression toward supermarket staff and whether mandatory safety training is being given. The minister answered that the survey does not address enforcement of age checks, that available data point to incidents rather than a structural problem, and that employers are responsible for staff protection under the Arbo law.
On the basis of the available data I can only conclude that there seems to be more a question of incidents than of a structural problem.
Op grond van de beschikbare gegevens kan ik niet anders dan concluderen dat er eerder sprake lijkt te zijn van incidenten dan van een structureel probleem.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma (PvdA), Leijten (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Wiegman-van Meppelen Schepping (ChristenUnie) en Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet vergoeden van

MPs from several parties asked the health minister why a second cochlear implant for young deaf children is not reimbursed, and whether the evidence supports it, including costs and the CVZ's pending reassessment. The minister said the CVZ must judge the added benefit, that the research in Nijmegen is uncertain, and that she is open to temporary admission or conditional financing to generate evidence, as the motion requested.
It is for the College voor zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) to answer that question within the context of its role as package manager.
Het is aan het College voor zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) om die vraag te beantwoorden binnen de context van zijn rol als pakketbeheerder.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert (PvdA), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Smilde (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het recht van grensarbeiders op een Persoons Gebonden Budget (PGB) in Duitsland (ingezo

MPs asked whether Dutch premium-paying workers living in Germany can obtain a PGB or German Pflegegeld, why the CVZ website suggests otherwise, and what steps the minister will take to change EU rules or allow PGB access. The state secretary answered that PGB is a subsidy not a legal right, EU case law (Molenaar) classes Pflegegeld as a benefit not a service, and the government will examine the issue when legislating the PGB.
Legislating the PGB was agreed in the Coalition and Toleration Agreement.
Het wettelijk regelen van het PGB is afgesproken in het Regeer- en Gedoogakkoord
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een ontruimverbod van een kraakpand in Utrecht (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether a Utrecht court ruling blocking the criminal eviction of a squat, allegedly for lack of proper balancing, creates case law undermining the squatting law. The minister replies that the court found insufficient evidence of a reasonable suspicion of squatting an occupied building, that the owner (the municipality) gave no consent, and that the state will not appeal but will re-announce the eviction.
The court ruled that the lawfulness of the planned eviction had not been established and therefore prohibited the criminal eviction.
De rechtbank heeft geoordeeld dat de rechtmatigheid van de voorgenomen ontruiming niet is komen vast te staan en heeft daarom de strafrechtelijke ontruiming verboden.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport inzake onterechte claim door fabrikanten van vitaminepillen dat vitamine C de weerstand verhoogt (ingezonden 28 februari 2011

Voortman (GreenLeft) asked the health minister whether vitamin C supplement makers' claims that the product boosts immunity, which the EFSA had not found scientifically proven, are misleading and contrary to the Commodities Act, and what the government will do about them. The minister answered that the EFSA's view supports the claim, that the claims are not currently unlawful pending EU decision-making expected end 2011, and that enforcement of generic health claims by the nVWA will follow once the EU regulation is adopted.
These health claims are currently not in conflict with the Commodities Act.
Deze gezondheidsclaims zijn op dit moment niet in strijd met de Warenwet.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport inzake het niet verschaffen van een extra tegemoetkoming van de TOG-regeling aan alleenstaanden (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP asks why single persons cannot claim the extra TOG allowance for caring for a disabled child at home, while fiscal partners can, and whether this should be changed. The minister confirms the distinction, explains it is based on the single-earner household being left behind in disposable income, denies it favours partners, and promises a letter on child schemes including the TOG this spring.
This spring I will send a letter addressing the coherence, transparency and effectiveness of the child schemes.
Dit voorjaar kom ik met een brief waarin aandacht wordt besteed aan de samenhang, transparantie en effectiviteit van de kindregelingen.

Vragen van de leden Dibi en Voortman (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een zieke zwangere vrouw die is overgebracht naar het vertrekcentrum in Ter

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether a pregnant asylum seeker with bleeding was moved from Leersum reception centre to the Ter Apel detention centre, and whether she could return for medical reasons. The minister denied the transfer was to Ter Apel, stating she was placed at the Vlagtwedde restricted-liberty location after a medical check, and that necessary care is available there, so no return is needed.
The DT&V imposed on her the restriction-of-liberty measure under article 56 Vw 2000 for this purpose.
Door de DT&V is haar daartoe de vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel ex artikel 56 Vw 2000 opgelegd.
Vragen van de leden Voortman en Dibi (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Vinex-wijk dreigt getto te worden» (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether neighbourhood design in Vinex districts ignored the link between housing, work and recreation, and whether municipalities should invest and whether wijkenbeleid budget cuts threaten these areas. The minister answered that neighbourhood quality is primarily a municipal responsibility, that research found good links between housing and amenities, and that he would discuss the wijkenaanpak with aldermen and inform parliament by July 2011.
On 27 April I am meeting the aldermen concerned, among other things about the progress of the neighbourhood approach and the role of central government in this new phase.
Ik spreek 27 april aanstaande met de betrokken wethouders onder andere over de voortgang van de wijkenaanpak en de rol van het Rijk in deze nieuwe fase.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over leegstaande kantoren (ingezonden 26 januari 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about vacant office buildings, including a proposal to let municipalities requisition long-vacant offices, whether 6.5 million m2 stands empty, and whether government should take the lead. The minister answered that the market is primarily responsible, that the government will examine regulatory changes in an Action Programme due to Parliament shortly, and that the government will facilitate regional matching of supply and demand.
This and other proposals for changing regulations will be examined within the framework of the Vacant Offices Action Programme.
Dit en andere voorstellen voor wijziging regelgeving zullen worden onderzocht in het kader van het Actieprogramma Leegstand Kantoren.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp’ers) in de zorg die niet aan de slag komen (ingezonden 3 decembe

An MP asks the health ministers about self-employed nurses and carers in care who are sidelined by financial and legal barriers, including the 2010 PGB stop, and what policy will be taken to improve their position. The state secretary acknowledges the issue, says the PGB stop affected only new applications, and states that changing the AWBZ decree to allow direct contracting of self-employed care workers is being prepared for 2012, with a possible experiment.
This latter point is the reason for amending the AWBZ care entitlements decree so that self-employed care providers can contract directly with the care office/concession holder implementing the AWBZ.
Dit laatste is aanleiding tot het wijzigen van het Besluit zorgaanspraken AWBZ zodat zelfstandig zorgverleners direct kunnen contracteren met het zorgkantoor/concessiehouder uitvoering AWBZ.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA), Van Bochove (CDA) en Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het rapport Steenrijk e

MPs asked the minister for Interior Affairs to respond to criticism in the Steenrijk en Straatarm report of Maastricht housing corporation Servatius's sales plan, and to explain when the central housing fund and ministry were informed of Servatius's financial problems and why a formal instruction took six months. The minister rejected the report's criticism as one-sided, said the fund raised concerns once in 2009, and explained the 2008 delay by noting the ministry was not formally notified and checked legal robustness before issuing a pre-announced instruction.
The former ministry of VROM received no signals in June 2008 about the financial problems surrounding Servatius's campus project.
Het toenmalige ministerie van VROM heeft in juni 2008 geen signalen ontvangen over de financiële problematiek rond het campusproject van woningcorporatie Servatius.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Van Bochove (CDA), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verliezen va

MPs asked the minister how negative results on subsidiaries (deelnemingen) of housing associations were reflected in the 2010 assessment letters, and how those results break down across core, social and commercial property activities. The minister answered that subsidiary results were not explicitly addressed in the letters, that the CFV will examine more associations in 2011, and that the data do not allow the requested breakdown, while noting that most subsidiary losses likely relate to commercial activities.
The CFV will in 2011 examine more associations where there is an increased risk of unnecessary erosion of the socially bound assets.
Het CFV zal in 2011 meer corporaties onderzoeken waar een verhoogd risico is op onnodige aantasting van het maatschappelijk gebonden vermogen.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut, Jansen (beiden SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de fusie van de woningcorporaties Com-wonen

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and CDA asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporations Com-wonen and PWS may take on obligations before a merger is approved, whether the recruitment of three directors for a not-yet-existing corporation fits overhead reduction goals, and how to avoid evasive answers on announced mergers. The Minister said pre-merger commitments are allowed but must not present the merger as a fait accompli, that he will address the corporations on their advertisements, that the merger test remains in force, and that overhead is assessed under the professionalism and efficiency criterion.
I will address Com-wonen and PWS on this.
Ik zal Com.wonen en PWS hier op aanspreken.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een onderzoeksjournalist die medische gegevens van een voetballer van AZ heeft verkregen (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

Voortman asked the minister about a journalist obtaining a footballer's medical data from a hospital employee, and what safeguards exist for EPD leaks, the human factor, hacker testing, patient access, objection numbers and access logs. Minister Schippers answered at length, describing sanctions, technical protections, pending access improvements and planned patient notifications, without addressing the specific leak beyond noting it was local hospital data.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over plannen van een zorgondernemer om obligaties uit te geven (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about a care entrepreneur issuing bonds to attract private capital, whether this anticipates unfinished cabinet plans on private capital and profit distribution in care, and how this fits the minister's statement that care is not a market. The minister replies that bonds carry interest and repayment rights but no profit distribution or control, so the plans do not anticipate cabinet policy, while signalling that profit distribution for medical specialist care will be allowed with conditions.
It is up to care providers themselves to make choices about how they want to finance investments.
Het is aan zorgaanbieders zelf om keuzes te maken in de wijze waarop zij investeringen willen financieren.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een undercoverreportage over ouderenzorg (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

An MP asks the health ministers about an undercover report on elderly care at Zorggroep Rijnmond, the 12,000 extra care workers target, and whether planned measures suffice. The state secretary says the organisation has taken initiative, the Inspectorate was informed, and extra investment in long-term care is planned.
The chair of the Executive Board has indicated that, following the two-part series, it will take improvement measures.
De voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur heeft aangegeven naar aanleiding van het tweeluik verbetermaatregelen te zullen treffen.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gang van zaken bij bezwaar tegen indicatie door het Centrum Indicatiestelling Zorg (CIZ) (ingezonden 2 decemb

An MP asks whether a CIZ case where a client objecting to an assessment was implicitly threatened with a lower indication is an acceptable practice, and how often such cases reached the CVZ. The state secretary acknowledges the handling was improper, says the file was reassigned, apologises, and states that a client may never be placed in a worse position by objecting.
The client experienced this as directive and threatening, and both I and the CIZ find that undesirable.
Cliënt heeft dat als sturend en bedreigend ervaren en dat vinden ik en het CIZ ongewenst.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat kamernood op een gezamenlijke manier wordt aangepakt door middel van een nationaal akkoord (inge

MP Voortman asked the minister whether student housing shortages would rise to 60,000 rooms by 2015, how the government would respond to a national accord, and whether it would meet stakeholders, and asked about housing-policy measures. The minister replied that demand will persist, that local authorities should be monitored and encouraged (especially Leiden, Delft, Amsterdam), that existing rules already allow office-to-housing conversion, and that reinstating rent allowance for non-independent student rooms is not planned.
I will continue to monitor this local effort in particular and encourage it where necessary.
Ik zal met name deze lokale inzet blijven volgen en waar nodig stimuleren.
Vragen van de leden Voortman en Dibi (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de reconstructie van de Schipholbrand (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether staff had warned management of the Schiphol cell complex about leadership gaps and inexperienced colleagues before the 2005 fire, and what became of the staff survey. The minister replied that the survey's action points were not followed up after the fire, that the Rijksrecherche and Onderzoeksraad received all relevant documents including the survey, and that DJI now uses a digital risk inventory and periodic staff satisfaction surveys.
The Rijksrecherche and the Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid have received all relevant documents relating to the Schiphol fire file, including the staff survey.
De Rijksrecherche en de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid hebben alle relevante stukken ontvangen die betrekking hebben op het dossier Schipholbrand, ook de personeelsenquête.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport inzake de intensive care zorg in Vlissingen (ingezonden 30 september 2010).

The minister answered that the OM and IGZ are investigating, that the researcher's remarks were personal, that a direct phone line exists, that IGZ has received few reports with no significant increase, and that IGZ's regular 2010 study covers asylum healthcare quality.

Deze foto is, zoals ik ook in het vragenuurtje van 24 november jl. aangaf, door mijzelf gemaakt, om 09:23 uur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Verhoeven over het gebruik van discriminerende algoritmes en massasurveillance door de politie

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about predictive policing, the Roermond Sensing trial against mobile banditry, privacy and discrimination safeguards, and Amnesty's criticism. The minister replied that the trial is not predictive policing, that profiles and human officer decisions limit discrimination risks, and rejected stopping the project while noting it is now largely inactive.
The Roermond Operational Testing Ground (OPTR) does not use predictive policing.
De Operationele Proeftuin Roermond (OPTR) maakt geen gebruik van «predictive policing».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse universiteiten werken samen met omstreden techgigant Huawei’.

MPs asked why Huawei is partly excluded from critical 5G infrastructure in the Netherlands but not from university research cooperation with UvA and VU, and what framework governs cooperation with foreign-state-influenced companies. The government replied that universities are autonomous under the WHW and that the cooperation falls outside vital infrastructure, that authorities advised universities on risks, and that an investment screening and export-control framework is being developed, without committing to new binding rules on university cooperation.

Under their autonomy pursuant to the WHW, the universities themselves are responsible for deciding whether or not to enter a particular (international) research cooperation, within the frameworks of existing laws and regulations.

De universiteiten zijn vanuit hun autonomie op grond van de WHW zelf verantwoordelijk voor het besluit om – binnen de kaders van bestaande wet- en regelgeving – al dan niet een bepaalde (internationale) onderzoekssamenwerking aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht 'U staat op een zwarte lijst'

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that credit bureaus (EDR, Lindorff, Focum) hold personal data and score people without their knowledge, and whether this breaches the GDPR, plus questions on deposits, bailiffs and collection agencies. The minister answers that the Data Protection Authority is investigating, explains GDPR rights and grounds, and says he will talk to bodies if the investigation finds the practices unlawful.
Since the investigation by the Data Protection Authority has not yet been concluded, it is not possible to go into the matters substantively.
Gelet op dat het onderzoek van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens nog niet is afgerond, is het niet mogelijk om inhoudelijk op zaken in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Politie en COA 'overtreden privacywet' met delen persoonlijke data asielzoekers'

MPs Verhoeven and Van Beukering-Huijbregts asked whether police use COA asylum-seeker data for proactive checks, predictive policing and incident enforcement, and about the legal basis and DPIA for the COA-police data sharing. The minister answered that the data are not used for proactive checks or CAS, that the sharing rests on article 107 Vreemdelingenwet, that COA suspended sharing pending an external review, and that the DPIA is being refreshed, while stating that DPIAs and AVG compliance by municipalities and agencies are primarily their own responsibility.
Pending the outcome of the external review, the COA board decided on 16 July to suspend immediately the sharing of personal data with the police.
In afwachting van de uitkomsten van de externe toetsing heeft het bestuur van het COA op 16 juli jl. besloten het delen van persoonsgegevens met de politie per direct op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake de onlinedienst Lusha

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the online service Lusha, which publishes phone numbers of people who may not consent, and whether this breaches the GDPR and whether Lusha has a legitimate interest. The minister answered that the assessment of individual cases and of GDPR compliance is for the independent Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and explained the legal framework for legitimate interest without applying it to Lusha.
Assessment of individual cases is for the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, as is the question of whether Lusha's practices breach the GDPR.
De beoordeling van individuele zaken is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, zo ook de vraag of de werkwijze van Lusha in strijd is met de AVG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, De Groot en Verhoeven over verlengen certificaten voor de bruine vloot

D66 MPs asked the ministers whether the brown fleet of historic sailing ships, facing low revenue and costs from extended safety certificates during COVID-19, deserves more help and further postponement of certificate inspections. The government answered that EUR 15 million has been made available to secure the fleet, that existing schemes also apply, and that inspections need not be postponed further, while leaving room to reconsider extensions case by case.
With the additional EUR 15 million now made available, it is moreover not expected that entrepreneurs will still choose to postpone inspections.
Met de aanvullende € 15 miljoen die nu beschikbaar is gesteld, is het bovendien niet te verwachten dat ondernemers er nog voor zullen kiezen om keuringen uit te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘paspoort blijft op zak Controle op Schiphol verdwijnt’

An MP asked the government about reports that Schiphol border checks would disappear in favour of technology such as facial recognition, and about data, privacy, and legal safeguards. The State Secretary said the pilots (Seamless Flow, KTDI) are at concept/pilot stage, no structural decision has been taken, the Chamber will be informed before any implementation decision, and privacy analyses are part of the projects, while declining to provide some surveillance-technology overviews and deferring others to later letters.
If the cabinet intends to implement one or both of these concepts in regular border control, the Chamber will be informed of the intended decision, including the safeguards regarding privacy.

Indien het kabinet het voornemen heeft één van deze of beide concepten in het reguliere grenstoezicht te implementeren, zal de Kamer over het voorgenomen besluit geïnformeerd worden, inclusief over de waarborgen met betrekking tot privacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘cyberbeveiliger Fox-IT schorst drie directieleden’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that Fox-IT suspended three board members and what this means for government cybersecurity services and encryption of state secrets. The minister answered that cooperation is unchanged, that special safeguards from the 2015 takeover by NCC Group keep crypto work in a separate Dutch-registered subsidiary, and that the national crypto strategy aims to reduce supply risk.
Cooperation between the government and Fox-IT is for now unchanged, but we are monitoring the situation closely.
De samenwerking tussen de overheid en Fox-IT is vooralsnog onveranderd, wel houden wij de situatie nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Te koop: openbare orde en veiligheid; Onderzoek Beveiligingsmultinational G4S en de VVD-lobby’

MPs Van Dam (CDA) and Verhoeven (D66) asked about a 2016 intention statement on sharing sensor data between G4S-type security firms, police and prosecutors, the legal basis for camera footage sharing, camera rules for municipalities, facial recognition, and the conduct of a former OVV chair holding a G4S advisory role. The minister answered that the document is a non-binding intention statement with no follow-up, that legal frameworks (Wpg, Wjsg, AVG) govern data sharing, and that the former chair complied with reporting rules as far as known.
There is no question of a covenant.
Er is geen sprake van een convenant.

Antwoord op van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Leijten, Verhoeven en Kuiken over het onderzoek naar de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen (RUG) en zijn rol in de promotie van de ver

MPs asked about the RUG-commissioned investigation into professor Kochenov's secondary activities and his role in promoting the sale of passports on Malta, and whether he continued such advisory work. The minister reported that the report was released, that no passport-related advisory activities were found after September 2019 apart from attending a Henley & Partners congress, and that she cannot guarantee such cases will not recur.
The research report has today been made public by the RUG, and as promised I have sent you a copy of this report.
Het onderzoeksrapport is heden openbaar gemaakt door de RUG, een afschrift van dit rapport heb ik u – conform mijn toezegging – doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Paternotte over het in gevaar brengen van Nederlanders door het in brand steken van zendmasten

MPs Verhoeven and Paternotte asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister of Justice and Security about arson attacks on mobile telecom masts linked to 5G conspiracy theories, including the number of incidents, impact on emergency services, protective measures and EU coordination. The government reported 29 registered arson incidents, no prior precedent in the Netherlands, that emergency number 1-1-2 was affected at least once, that the most critical C2000 masts will be secured within about three months, and that the matter was raised at an informal EU Telecom Council.
For security reasons I will not go into the specific protective measures.
Vanuit veiligheidsoogpunt ga ik niet in op de specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Verhoeven over mondkapjes en het Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH)

MPs Diertens and Verhoeven asked why the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH) scaled up existing suppliers rather than adding new ones, whether this disadvantages other suppliers, how rejected masks are handled, and how contact professionals and citizens are informed about face masks. The minister answered that the LCH uses both existing and new suppliers, applies quality criteria, provides test results on rejection, and that information on masks is available on rijksoverheid.nl, with the LCH having no logistics role for non-medical masks.
In the case of forged certificates, no details are released, so as not to facilitate future fraud.
In het geval dat sprake is van vervalsing van certificaten, worden geen details vrijgegeven, om toekomstige fraude niet in de hand te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over het bericht 'Studenten protesteren tegen tentamensoftware die beelden van hun huiskamer opslaat'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Education about student protests against online exam proctoring software that records images of students' homes, asking which institutions use it, whether providers comply with the GDPR, whether students can be excluded for refusing extra personal data, and whether alternatives can be offered. The minister answered that institutions are responsible for GDPR compliance and transparency, that refusing proctoring is allowed but alternatives are limited during the Covid crisis, and that the government is exploring easing measures so on-site examinations can resume.
It is up to the educational institutions to properly inform students about the use and functioning of the proctoring software, for example through a privacy statement.
Het is aan de onderwijsinstellingen om de studenten goed te informeren over het gebruik en de werking van de proctoring software, bijvoorbeeld middels een privacyverklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over luchtvaart tijdens de Coronacrisis

MPs Paternotte and Verhoeven asked the ministers about aviation crew and passenger safety during COVID-19, including RIVM distancing compliance, empty middle seats, service restrictions, crew hotel conditions, arrival advice, flight bans and Schiphol rent relief. The ministers largely answered by pointing to EASA guidance, airline responsibility and existing measures, committing only to monitoring the crew hotel situation.
Airlines are best placed themselves to organise maximum spacing in aircraft, and it does not seem wise for us to determine which specific seats may or may not be occupied.

Luchtvaartmaatschappijen zijn zelf het beste in staat om maximale spreiding in vliegtuigen te organiseren en het lijkt ons niet verstandig dat wij gaan bepalen welke specifieke stoelen wel of niet bezet kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Canada en Nederland testen trans-Atlantische vluchten zonder paspoort’

D66 MPs asked about a Canada-Netherlands pilot testing passport-free transatlantic travel via facial recognition and a digital traveller identity, including its origins, necessity, duration, privacy safeguards, data use and function creep. The Secretary of State answered that the pilot is voluntary, governed by a data protection impact assessment, will be evaluated and shared with parliament, but gave only general or deferred answers on several points and no firm plans for other countries.
The outcomes and evaluation of the test will be published and I will share them with your House.
De uitkomsten en evaluatie van de test worden gepubliceerd en deel ik met uw Kamer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht 'Corona-app dreigt te mislukken door enorme haast van kabinet'

An MP from D66 asked the health and justice ministers about the rushed timeline and tender for the Corona contact-tracing app, including deadlines, cybersecurity, open source, and expert concerns. The government answered by referring to its COVID-19 update letter to parliament rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Verhoeven (D66) to the ministers of Health, Welfare and Sport and for Legal Protection have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update status'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Rechtsbescherming zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palland, Amhaouch, Wiersma, Verhoeven, Bruins, Gijs van Dijk, Van Kent en Stoffer over het aangekondigde massaontslag bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs asked the government about the announced loss of 750 jobs at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, a new Hungarian plant that received subsidies, and whether EU state aid rules were breached, and whether the government would press the Commission or the company. The minister replied that the Commission judged the Hungarian aid compatible with the internal market, saw no reason to contact the Commission or Hungary, said there were no prior warnings of reorganisation in contacts with the owner and the Enschede management, and left the social plan to the company while pointing to a regional deal.
Should further study of the case give cause for it, I will bring this to the attention of the Commission and my colleagues involved.
Mocht er na verdere bestudering van de casus aanleiding toe zijn dan zal ik dat bij de Commissie en mijn collega's die hierbij zijn betrokken onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Slachtoffers misdrijven willen meer privacy, angst voor wraak daders’

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that crime victims lack privacy protection and fear reprisals, including why victims are not always told about postal-address or anonymous-filing options. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained the limits of anonymous filing, said a generic anonymisation measure and process fixes are under review, and promised a progress letter in spring 2020.
I committed in that letter to inform the House in spring 2020 about the state of affairs of these actions.
Ik heb in deze brief toegezegd uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2020 te informeren over de stand van zaken van deze acties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de berichten ‘Universiteit Maastricht betaalde hackers losgeld’ en ‘Verzekeraars zorgen voor toename van ransomware-aanvallen’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that Maastricht University paid ransomware hackers and that insurers covering ransom payments increase attacks. The minister confirmed awareness, gave 188 reported ransomware cases in 2019 without a breakdown by public institution, said no data exists on how often ransom is paid, and noted paying is expected to encourage attacks while insurers could reduce risk through security requirements.
I have no information on the number of cases in which it was chosen to pay ransomware, or on the various considerations involved in deciding to pay.
Ik heb geen informatie over het aantal gevallen waarin is gekozen ransomeware te betalen, danwel over de verschillende afwegingen die een rol spelen bij het overgaan tot betaling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens de drukte niet aan kan

MPs Van Nispen and Verhoeven asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) lacks the capacity to handle its workload, including waiting times of at least six months, and about whether it must drop complaints. The minister acknowledges the shortage, notes €3.4 million added structurally in the 2019 spring memorandum and an external budget study, but declines to commit to an immediate budget increase before the study's results.
The aim of the study is to reach a shared picture of a sound financial basis for the AP to carry out all of its statutory tasks, both in the short and long term.
Doel van het onderzoek is te komen tot een gedeeld beeld van een gezonde financiële basis voor de uitoefening door de AP van al haar wettelijke taken, zowel op korte als lange termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Verhoeven  over het artikel ‘Autosector voldoet niet aan strenge privacynorm’

MPs Schonis and Verhoeven asked the minister whether the car sector complies with the GDPR, including whether it processes special personal data, opt-out data sharing and dealer bonuses for data sharing. The minister answered that compliance varies by manufacturer, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is taking targeted steps and that most responsibility lies with manufacturers and dealers, while promising further consumer information work and an exploration with the sector.
Towards the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP), the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the sector, efforts are therefore being directed on this issue.
Richting de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP), Autoriteit Consument & Markt (ACM) en de sector wordt hier dan ook op ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Sorry, alle IP-adressen zijn al vergeven’

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the exhaustion of IPv4 addresses, short-term fixes, whether government-held unused IPv4 addresses could be released, and whether a deadline could be imposed for the IPv6 transition. The state secretary answered that no good short-term solution exists, that selling unused government addresses is undesirable, and that the government will rely on stimulation and a commitment to make government websites and email reachable via IPv6 by end 2021 rather than enforce a deadline.
The government therefore has a stimulating role here, not an enforcing one.
De overheid heeft hierin dus een stimulerende rol, geen afdwingende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Verhoeven over de privacyrisico’s van onveilige beveiligingscamera’s

MPs Buitenweg and Verhoeven asked the Minister for Legal Protection about privacy and security risks of insecure internet-connected security cameras, including minimum security standards, data on hacks, enforcement, and privacy by design. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to EU-level work on minimum security requirements for IoT devices, said no data on hacks is recorded, and declined to take on a coordinating role with producers, leaving that to the Dutch DPA and manufacturers.
The total number of cases per year involving hacked security cameras is not known to me.
Het totaal aantal gevallen per jaar waarbij sprake is van gehackte beveiligingscamera’s is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Tientallen camera’s houden klanten van filiaal Jumbo in de gaten: “Willen we dit”?’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why he would not provide information on legal frameworks for facial recognition, whether the AP is investigating Jumbo's cameras, what citizens can do, whether Dutch agencies work with Clearview, and related privacy questions. The minister replied that the AP has the advisory role, that the AP has contacted Jumbo which has switched off the cameras pending advice, that affected people can complain to the AP or claim damages in civil court, and that he will send a letter on the legal framework for facial recognition, including the directive covering investigative use.
As a follow-up to a motion by MPs Verhoeven and Van Dam, I am preparing a letter on the legal framework applicable to facial recognition.
Ik bereid, als uitvloeisel van een motie van de leden Verhoeven en Van Dam 4 , een brief voor over het juridisch kader dat van toepassing is op gezichtsherkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Omtzigt, Kuiken en Verhoeven over de paspoorthandel van Malta en de betrokkenheid van een professor van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs asked the government about Malta's citizenship-by-investment scheme, the listed buyers of Maltese passports, the AIVD warning, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and a Groningen professor's links to a passport firm. The minister answered that the Maltese list covers all naturalisations, that the Commission is monitoring such schemes and the government will seek dialogue, that the Prime Minister raised rule-of-law concerns with his Maltese counterpart, and that the university is examining the professor's activities.
The cabinet considers the sale of passports to non-EU citizens who are suspected of crimes to be undesirable.
Het kabinet acht de verkoop van paspoorten aan niet-EU burgers, die onder verdenking staan van misdrijven, ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Verhoeven over het bericht dat DPG Media uitgeverij Sanoma overneemt

MPs Sneller and Verhoeven asked about DPG Media's takeover of publisher Sanoma and its effects on media plurality and competition. The minister replied that media concentration is not automatically a loss of plurality, that the ACM will assess competition effects in its merger review, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media monitors plurality annually.
Concentration of ownership within the media sector cannot simply be equated with a restriction of plurality.
Concentratie van eigenaarschap binnen de mediasector kan niet zonder meer gelijk gesteld worden aan inperking van pluriformiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake het bericht ‘Tientallen camera's houden klanten van filiaal Jumbo in de gaten: 'Willen we dit?'’

An MP (Verhoeven, D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that a Jumbo store uses facial recognition cameras on customers, and about the legal framework under the GDPR, whether the practice is compliant, and whether businesses will be informed. The minister replied that GDPR supervision lies with the Dutch Data Protection Authority, outlined the biometric data rules (Art. 9 GDPR, Art. 29 UAVG) and a planned amendment, and promised a letter to parliament on facial recognition law and a notice to a national crime-prevention platform.
Supervision of compliance with the GDPR is assigned to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP).
Toezicht op de naleving van de AVG is belegd bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Dutch minister urges EU action to fight child pornography online’’

An MP asks the Justice Minister why he urged EU action against online child abuse material in a way that appears to weaken encryption, contrary to the 2016 cabinet position. The minister answers that he seeks solutions within the 2016 framework, acknowledges that encryption makes investigations harder, and denies advocating weakening encryption software.
I aim for solutions that, within the framework of the cabinet position, do justice to the interests of investigation and national security.
Ik streef naar oplossingen die binnen de kaders van het kabinetsstandpunt recht doen aan de belangen van de opsporing en de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Verhoeven over paspoorthandel op Malta

Three D66 MPs asked the government about passport sales in Malta, including whether they enable crime, the role of the Maltese state, AIVD warnings, and Dutch positions in the EU. The government answered that Malta conducts due diligence but this is no guarantee, that it sees such sales as undesirable but that citizenship remains national competence, that it will await an EU Commission process before dialogue, and that the Dutch investor residence scheme will be reviewed for added value.
As indicated in the answer to question 6, it is wise to await the outcome of these Commission initiatives and then engage in dialogue, preferably at EU level, on these schemes.

Zoals in de beantwoording van vraag 6 is aangegeven, is het verstandig om de uitkomst van deze initiatieven van de Commissie af te wachten en op basis daarvan de dialoog – bij voorkeur op EU-niveau – over genoemde regelingen aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Minister bezorgd om versleuteling Facebook’

MP Verhoeven asked the Minister of Justice about press reports that the minister was concerned about Facebook's encryption plans, whether the minister would raise cabinet's encryption position in Washington, and whether weakening encryption exposes private communication to foreign powers and criminals. The minister confirmed awareness, said his concerns do not conflict with the 2016 cabinet position, and stressed the value of strong encryption while seeking solutions balancing investigation and national security interests.

I will bring the various interests involved and the conclusion from the cabinet position that it is not desirable to take restrictive legal measures regarding the development, availability and use of encryption within the Netherlands to attention.

Ik zal de diverse betrokken belangen en de conclusie uit het kabinetsstandpunt dat het niet wenselijk is om beperkende wettelijke maatregelen te nemen ten aanzien van de ontwikkeling, de beschikbaarheid en het gebruik van encryptie binnen Nederland onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Volgens minister helpt privacy bedrijven om klanten binnen te houden’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how the ban on cookie walls will be brought to the attention of companies and whether privacy-by-design requires default settings that prevent tracking. The minister replied that the Dutch Data Protection Authority has issued guidance, is intensifying enforcement, and that consent for tracking cookies must be opt-in and cannot be pre-ticked.
The AP has further informed me that it sent a letter with the interpretation of the norm to the organisations about which it received the most complaints.
De AP heeft mij voorts laten weten de organisaties waar zij de meeste klachten over heeft ontvangen een brief te hebben gestuurd met de normuitleg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Paspoortscanner op mobieltje vormt risico voor identiteitsfraude’

MP Verhoeven asked whether phone apps that read passport chips, the BSN appearing on documents, and a planned QR-code on passports create identity-fraud risks, and whether certification of chip readers is needed. The minister answered that the apps add no new risk beyond showing a passport, that chips are protected by international standards, that the AVG applies to app makers, and that certification would add burdens disproportionate to the risk.
Naturally I will continue to monitor developments in identity fraud to determine whether measures are needed.
Vanzelfsprekend blijf ik ontwikkelingen op het gebied van identiteitsfraude volgen om te bepalen of er maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Gezichtendatabase van politie bevat foto’s van 1,3 miljoen mensen’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police facial recognition: other systems in use, use in public space, scraping, why privacy audits do not examine specific systems, and whether exceeding legal retention periods is a breach reportable to the DPA. The minister said the Catch system is also used for immigration tasks, that camera stills are being examined for facial matching, that audits focus on the data protection framework rather than specific systems, and that exceeding retention periods is not a legal data breach but is a risk he is addressing through a Wpg/Wjsg revision and interim measures.
During this audit, specific working methods or systems are not examined.
Tijdens deze audit wordt niet gekeken naar specifieke werkwijzen of systemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over de moord op de Maltese journaliste Daphne Caruana Galizia

MPs Verhoeven and Groothuizen asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about the independence of the Maltese public inquiry into journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia's murder, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and pending libel suits against her. Minister Blok answered that the inquiry is for Malta to organise independently, the Netherlands raises concerns bilaterally, Malta is following the Venice Commission recommendations, and the libel cases are for the Maltese courts to decide.
It is for the inquiry commission to shape the investigation in an independent manner.
Het is aan de onderzoekscommissie om het onderzoek op onafhankelijke wijze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Brussel trekt 900 miljoen uit voor gevolgen harde Brexit’

An MP asked the government about reports that the European Commission would use the Solidarity Fund and Globalisation Fund to cushion a no-deal Brexit, and whether the Netherlands could claim these funds. The minister supports the Commission proposals, describes eligibility criteria for both funds, and says it is not yet possible to assess whether a Dutch claim will be made.

Nevertheless, I cannot yet estimate whether the Dutch government can submit an application, because it is not yet possible to estimate the scale of the financial and economic damage from a no-deal Brexit.

Desondanks kan ik nu nog niet inschatten of de Nederlandse overheid een aanvraag kan indienen omdat het nu nog niet mogelijk is om in te schatten wat de omvang van de financiële en economische schade ten gevolge van een no deal Brexit is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Polen sleept kritische juristen voor de rechter’

MPs Groothuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the government recognises that Polish prosecutions of critical academics, including professor Wojciech Sadurski, continue despite an earlier answer that a prosecution was withdrawn. The government replied that the earlier answer concerned threatened prosecutions against jurists, that the Sadurski case concerns private and party complaints over a tweet and remains with the Polish courts, and that it will monitor the case and raise rule-of-law concerns in EU and bilateral channels.
It does not befit the Netherlands to actively interfere in cases that are still before the courts and/or to make statements about them.
Het past Nederland niet om zich actief te mengen in zaken die nog onder de rechter zijn en/of daarover uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Ministerie onduidelijk over omstreden software’

MP Verhoeven asked whether Kaspersky antivirus software is still used in central government IT systems and critical infrastructure after a news report about unclear ministry positions. The minister could not confirm full phase-out in central government, pointing to an ongoing inventory due end 2019, and said that for critical infrastructure the decision to phase out rests with the organisations themselves.
Currently the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations has an inventory underway across central government to obtain a full picture, with results expected at the end of 2019.
Momenteel heeft het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties voor een volledig beeld hiervan een uitvraag lopen voor de rijksoverheid waarvan de resultaten eind 2019 verwacht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schonis over het bericht ‘Anonieme OV-chipkaart is niet anoniem, betoogt Michiel Jonker’

MPs Verhoeven and Schonis asked the State Secretary about claims that the anonymous OV-chipkaart is not really anonymous, and about what data NS and Translink store and share. The State Secretary answered that the data processing is lawful under the AVG, that anonymous card data is limited, that travellers are informed via privacy statements, and that a voordeeluren subscription is personal and cannot be placed on an anonymous card.
Translink has informed me that it cannot in any way trace the traveller's personal details, even when paying by card to top up the balance on the anonymous OV-chipkaart.
Translink heeft mij laten weten op geen enkele manier achter de NAW-gegevens van de reiziger te kunnen komen, ook niet als er gepind wordt om het saldo op de anonieme OV-chipkaart aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Nederlander in buitenland moet op pad voor extra check DigiD’

MPs Verhoeven and Sjoerdsma asked whether DigiD two-step verification is safe and why Dutch citizens abroad must collect an activation code at a counter in person, often far away, and whether this is acceptable. The State Secretary defends two-step verification as safer, explains the face-to-face requirement as necessary for reliable identity checks, and promises to explore improvements such as more counters and NFC-based activation from the second half of 2020.
I recognise and regret that for some Dutch citizens living abroad who want or need a DigiD this causes inconvenience and that they experience it as a problem.
Ik realiseer mij en betreur dat dit voor een deel van de Nederlanders die in het buitenland wonen en een DigiD willen of moeten hebben tot ongemak leidt en dat zij dit als een probleem ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Gezichtendatabase van politie bevat foto’s van 1,3 miljoen mensen’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that a police facial-image database holds photos of 1.3 million people, including questions on legal basis, scraping, retention periods, proportionality and security. The minister answered that the photos come from suspects under Article 55c Sv (or earlier Article 61a), that scraping is not used, that retention rules overlap and are unclear with a modernisation of the law planned, and that a privacy audit results are expected this autumn.
Complying with the letter of the law would only be possible through a crude selection method that would also destroy data that could contribute to investigating cold cases.
Het alsnog voldoen aan de letter van de wet zou alleen kunnen via een grove selectiemethode waardoor ook gegevens worden vernietigd die kunnen bijdragen aan de opsporing in cold case zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Alziend oog voor politie’

MPs Den Boer and Verhoeven asked the Justice Minister about reports that police use a private foundation, RTR-NL, to watch and link camera footage in a regional surveillance room, raising privacy, discrimination and GDPR concerns. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the police keep operational control, the foundation acts as processor under the Police Data Act, staff are vetted and trained, footage is retained for 7 or 28 days, and no new ICT system or tender was involved.
The police have operational control over the viewing of the footage.
De politie heeft de operationele regie op het uitkijken van de beelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Verhoeven over hoge marktconcentratie onder dagbladuitgeverijen

MPs Sneller and Verhoeven asked about high market concentration among Dutch newspaper publishers, including De Persgroep's expansion, falling freelance rates, and whether the market remains competitive. The minister answered that concentration is high but the market is hybrid and digitalising, that the ACM reviewed and approved the Independer takeover on competition grounds, and that the government is pursuing collective bargaining options for freelancers while having no comparative EU data.
The takeover of Independer by De Persgroep was notified to the ACM at the end of October 2018.
De overname van Independer door De Persgroep is eind oktober 2018 bij de ACM gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Den Boer over berichten op Twitter dat mensen een sms kregen van Forum voor Democratie zonder dat zij zich hebben ingeschreven bij de partij

MPs Verhoeven and Den Boer asked how Forum voor Democratie could text people who had not joined the party, whether the Data Protection Authority would investigate, how people can check and delete their data, what sanctions apply, and whether party membership is verified for state funding. The ministers answered that the phone numbers may have been obtained lawfully with consent or were a processing error, that complaints were already with the AP and ACM, that data access and erasure requests are available, and that membership is checked through a declaration of intent and audit.
Inquiries with the AP show that complaints about this situation have indeed been filed.
Navraag bij de AP leert dat er inderdaad klachten over deze situatie zijn ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Polen sleept kritische juristen voor de rechter’

MPs Verhoeven and Groothuizen asked the ministers about reports that Poland was prosecuting critical academics, the rule-of-law procedure against Poland, and the Commission's rule-of-law communication. The government answered that the threatened prosecution was dropped, that it will voice concern about Poland's rule of law at EU level, and that it will study the Commission's proposals before reporting further.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘WhatsApp Rushes to Fix Security Flaw Exposed in Hacking of Lawyer’s Phone’

An MP asked ministers about a report that WhatsApp rushed to fix a security flaw exposed in the hacking of a lawyer's phone, and about NSO Group's hacking software being used against dissidents and journalists. The minister said vulnerabilities should be reported to vendors, that export controls and screening of suppliers apply, but declined to say which regimes bought NSO software.
I have no insight into the customer base of NSO Group and therefore cannot make statements about NSO Group's sales policy.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het klantenbestand van de NSO Group en kan dus geen uitspraken doen over het verkoopbeleid van de NSO Group.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over Europese dreiging van de Eternal Blue exploit

A D66 MP asked the Interior Minister about the Eternal Blue exploit, the Baltimore ransomware attack, Dutch exposure to SMBv1 vulnerabilities and whether patch policy for government should change. The State Secretary answered that the NCSC advisory remains in force, the BIO patch rules are considered sufficient, and that existing cooperation structures are being strengthened.
For this one specific vulnerability I see no reason to change the government-wide patch policy as set out in the Baseline Information Security Government.
Ik zie vanwege deze ene specifieke kwetsbaarheid geen reden het overheidsbrede patchbeleid aan te passen, zoals dat is opgesteld in de Baseline Informatiebeveiliging Overheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Verhoeven over het artikel ‘Wie temt het datamonster in de auto-industrie?’

MPs Schonis and Verhoeven asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about in-car data collection, privacy, independent oversight and consumer choice over shared data. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports EU data-driven road safety, pointed to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and RDW as oversight bodies, said privacy is protected under the GDPR, and promised further study and a response to a related motion, while declining to give a full overview of all vehicle data.
A complete overview of all data that all types of cars generate and store I cannot give.
Een volledig overzicht van alle gegevens die alle typen auto’s genereren en opslaan kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Medische gegevens duizenden Nederlanders verplaatst naar Google: 'Riskant'’

MPs Verhoeven and Raemakers asked whether patient medical data moved to Google Cloud by Medical Research Data Management was safe, whether patients and the Dutch Data Protection Authority were informed, and whether privacy-friendlier alternatives exist. The minister said hospitals bear responsibility for informing patients, that data stays in Dutch datacentres under double encryption with Google barred from access, and that he will commission independent research on non-European cloud platforms.
I will have independent research carried out into the desirability of using non-European cloud platforms to store healthcare data.
Ik zal onafhankelijk onderzoek laten doen naar de wenselijkheid van het gebruik van niet-Europese Cloud platforms voor het opslaan van zorgdata.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Eijs over het bericht dat bedrijven websites als MijnBelastingdienst hebben ontdekt als jachtgrond voor persoonlijke gegevens

MPs Verhoeven and Van Eijs asked about reports that companies harvest personal data from government portals such as MijnBelastingdienst, and about data requirements for rental applicants. The State Secretary answered that the GDPR applies and that he is concerned about tenants' dependence on landlords, is exploring further legal frameworks for citizen control over personal data, and sees a government portal as not necessarily required.
I am currently examining whether further (legal) frameworks are needed for this.
Ik onderzoek momenteel of hiervoor nadere (juridische) kaders nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het loskoppelen van het burgerrechtengedeelte in het Brexit-uittredingsverdrag

Verhoeven (D66) asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister whether the government supports decoupling the Brexit citizens' rights chapter so it applies in all cases, including no deal, and whether dual nationality should be allowed for affected Dutch citizens in the UK. Minister Blok replied that the UK is responsible for protecting citizens' rights in a no-deal scenario, that the government will keep pressing the UK, and that it will not pursue a 'mini-deal' or broader dual nationality, preferring ratification of the withdrawal agreement.
The cabinet maintains that the EU and the European Council on its behalf must keep fully committed to ratification of the withdrawal agreement.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de EU en de Europese Raad namens haar zich vol moeten blijven inzetten voor ratificatie van het terugtrekkingsakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over het bericht 'EU waarschuwt luchtvaart voor verlies vliegrechten bij Brexit zonder deal'

MPs Paternotte and Verhoeven asked whether Online Travel Agencies should warn consumers about no-deal Brexit effects on flights to and via the UK, and what the government would do about passenger rights and air connectivity. The minister said the EU proposal for contingency measures on basic air connectivity is supported, a provisional agreement was reached, a bilateral fallback is possible, EU passenger rights regulation 261/2004 still applies, and that OTAs' communication is not something the government can assess.
How communication between Online Travel Agencies and their customers proceeds, I cannot assess.
Hoe de communicatie tussen Online Travel Agencies en hun klanten verloopt, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het artikel ‘A less political European Commission is needed’

An MP asks the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister how a less political European Commission can have more real authority, why the Spitzenkandidaten process is compared to a coup, whether the European Council bypassing the election outcome violates Article 17(7) TEU, and how the government will act on the views in the minister's Financial Times op-ed. The minister answers that a stronger but objective Commission is needed to enforce agreed rules, that the Spitzenkandidaten procedure is not in the treaty while Article 17(7) requires taking account of the election results, and that the government will set out its position in the State of the Union debate.
Article 17(7) of the EU treaty is clear about the procedure to follow in electing the President of the European Commission.
Artikel 17 (7) van het EU-verdrag is helder over de te volgen procedure bij de verkiezing van de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Verhoeven over de artikel 7-procedure

Two MPs (Van Ojik and Verhoeven) asked the Foreign Minister whether member states are stalling the Article 7 procedure against Hungary, whether a Council hearing with Hungary should be held, which states block it, and what deadlines and consequences apply. The minister answered that the Council must follow up the EP resolution with hearings, that no fixed deadline exists, that the Netherlands is pushing with like-minded states for an early hearing, and that the Council's deliberations are confidential.
Because the Council's deliberations are confidential, the cabinet cannot publicly provide further explanation of the positions of other member states on the Article 7 procedure against Hungary.

Het kabinet kan vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de beraadslagingen in de Raad publiekelijk geen verdere toelichting verschaffen over de positionering van de overige lidstaten ten aanzien van de artikel 7-procedure jegens Hongarije.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘EU zet bij grenscontrole dubieuze leugendetectie in’

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about an EU pilot (IBORDER CTRL) using a lie-detection system at external borders, questioning its scientific basis, ethical review, and whether the Netherlands would take part. The Minister answered that the pilot runs until August 2019 so effects cannot yet be judged, that the Netherlands does not participate, and that deployment must respect Schengen Borders Code and GDPR rules, while detailed conditions are unknown to him.
The concrete arrangements and conditions for implementing this pilot are not known to me.
De concrete invulling en voorwaarden voor de implementatie van deze pilot zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Australische overheid verbiedt Huawei en ZTE apparatuur te leveren voor 5g’

MP Verhoeven asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers whether they know of Australia's ban on Huawei and ZTE 5G equipment, whether the Netherlands will follow, and how such national-security decisions are made, including at EU level. The government answered that it assesses risks case by case on the basis of state-actor threats and legal duties to cooperate, declined to speculate on future measures, and said the existing framework is flexible enough and that national security remains a member-state responsibility.

Given the national security interests and the interests of business, there is no anticipating or speculating on which products, services or companies may or may not pose a risk to national security, or on possible future measures.

Gezien de nationale veiligheidsbelangen en de belangen van het bedrijfsleven wordt niet vooruitgelopen op of gespeculeerd over welke producten, diensten of bedrijven al dan niet een risico zouden kunnen vormen voor de nationale veiligheid en over al dan niet mogelijke toekomstige maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “Capgemini schikt ict-fiasco SVB voor 20,2 miljoen”

An MP asked whether settlements between ministries and ICT suppliers after failed ICT projects should be disclosed to Parliament, how many such settlements occurred in five years, and whether ministries must report them to the CIO Rijk. The minister agreed transparency is desirable, said no government-wide rules on disclosing settlements exist, and committed to ask the CIO Rijk to agree rules with departments and to include an annual overview of reported settlements in the annual Rijk operations report.
Specifically regarding the sharing of such settlement information with your House, no government-wide agreements have been made.
Specifiek over het delen van dergelijke schikkingsinformatie met uw Kamer zijn geen rijksbrede afspraken gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over Opinie 7/2018 van de Europese databeschermingsautoriteit (EDPS) over het voorstel om vingerafdrukken op ID-kaarten op te nemen

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary about the EDPS opinion 7/2018 criticising the proposed mandatory fingerprint storage on EU identity cards and its proportionality. The State Secretary agreed fingerprints are sensitive data, said Netherlands will keep questioning proportionality in negotiations, and promised to raise the issue again at the 14 September working group, while deferring to existing purpose-limitation rules.
In response to this and to the opinion of the European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS), I will continue to raise the proportionality of mandatory fingerprint collection.

Naar aanleiding hiervan en naar aanleiding van de opinie van de European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS) 1 blijf ik de proportionaliteit van de verplichte afname van vingerafdrukken aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘EU’s top watchdog slams Council secrecy’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the European Ombudsman's critical report on the Council's lack of transparency and whether the Council would respond. The minister answers that the Treaties impose no deadline on the Council, that the Council will respond substantively at a hearing, and that Netherlands will push for a broader transparency discussion in the autumn.
Formally, no obligation arises for the Council under the Treaties to respond within a set period to a report of the European Ombudsman.
Formeel vloeit er voor de Raad geen verplichting voort uit de Verdragen om binnen een bepaalde termijn te reageren op een rapport van de Europese Ombudman.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Privacywet of niet, Kadaster deelt privégegevens’

The MP asks about reports that the Kadaster discloses private personal data, whether this risks identity fraud, and how privacy can be better protected. The minister says the risk of identity fraud from Kadaster data is very limited and defers the substantive questions on balancing legal certainty and privacy, access restrictions and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens advice to a cabinet response promised before the summer recess.
I expect to be able to send the cabinet response on this to the House of Representatives before the summer recess.
Ik verwacht voor het zomerreces de kabinetsreactie hierop toe te kunnen zenden aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Algoritme voorspelt wie fraude pleegt bij bijstandsuitkering’

MPs Raemakers and Verhoeven asked whether municipalities use algorithms to detect welfare benefit fraud, which firms supply them, what data is used, and how discrimination and transparency are controlled. The state secretary answered that data-driven enforcement is supported within legal limits, that the algorithm may be withheld to protect detection methods, that data comes from municipal benefit records, and that a BZK study on government algorithms is expected in the second half of 2018.
