In the interest of protecting the modus operandi for detecting fraud, the municipal executive may decide not to release the algorithm.
In het belang van het beschermen van de modus operandi om fraude op te sporen, kan door het college worden besloten het algoritme niet vrij te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over Cambridge Analytica

An MP (Verhoeven, D66) asked ministers about Cambridge Analytica's methods, the number of Dutch Facebook users affected (up to 90,000), and whether Dutch parties use similar microtargeting. The minister answered that up to 89,373 Dutch people may have been affected, that no Dutch cases of Cambridge Analytica-style influence are known, that Dutch party microtargeting is not comparable and is subject to stricter privacy rules, and that the Raad voor het Openbaar Bestuur was asked to advise on digitalisation and democracy.
I am not aware of the exact methods of these companies, which data they had access to, or which social media platforms that personal data came from.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de exacte methodes van deze bedrijven, over welke gegevens zij de beschikking hadden, dan wel van welke sociale media platforms die persoonsgegevens afkomstig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het sociale mediagebruik van de politie

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about police social media posts that exposed personal data such as plates, faces and addresses, and about the rules, training and complaint procedures. The minister said the police are drafting new instructions, that 13 removal requests were received with eight still under review, and that talks on privacy in police videos are ongoing.
It is important that it does not make an unlawful intrusion on citizens' privacy, both for citizens and for the legitimacy of police conduct.
Het is van belang dat zij geen onrechtmatige inbreuk maakt op de privacy van burgers, zowel voor de burgers als voor de legitimiteit van het optreden van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht 'De staatsgreep van een briljant ambtenaar'

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether the appointment of Martin Selmayr as Secretary-General of the European Commission followed the rules and whether Dutch government would raise concerns about its transparency. The minister answered that the Commission says it followed all rules, that the European Parliament is examining the procedure, and that the Dutch government will not take over Parliament's role of scrutinising the Commission.
The cabinet notes that the European Parliament is currently exercising its treaty-based oversight task.
Het kabinet constateert dat het Europees parlement zijn verdragsrechtelijke controlerende taak op dit moment uitoefent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Flixbus wil met camera’s drugssmokkel bestrijden’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that Flixbus is installing cameras to fight drug smuggling and about police checks on international bus passengers, questioning their legal basis, effectiveness, and compatibility with EU free movement and Schengen. The Minister answered that the reported delays concern Germany, that checks are targeted at passengers showing suspicious behaviour, that no border controls are carried out, and that camera surveillance is Flixbus's private matter under data protection law with no government role.
I do not have data on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Experts: overheid moet ingrijpen bij internetapparaten’

Two MPs asked the ministers whether insecure internet-connected devices should be regulated, including a ban on proven insecure devices and a European certification mark, and what awareness campaigns and producer liability rules exist. The government acknowledged the threat, said a roadmap on secure hardware and software is being prepared with certification, awareness and liability as instruments, pointed to existing campaigns and to an EU review of product liability, and made no firm commitment to bans or a specific certification scheme.

To promote better security for IoT devices, the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, in consultation with the Ministry of Justice and Security, other departments and private parties, is currently drawing up a roadmap for secure hardware and software.

Om te bevorderen dat IoT-apparaten beter worden beveiligd, stelt het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat in samenspraak met het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, andere departementen en private partijen thans een roadmap veilige hard- en software op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht 'Kijk die Zweden nu eens!’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Sweden's 'EU Handshake' campaign to raise public engagement with the EU and whether the Netherlands should adopt similar measures. The minister answered that the government supports engagement, lists various steps, stresses that responsibility is shared with civil society, parties and media, and says it will examine how to give shape to closer involvement while respecting national context.
The cabinet is willing to further examine how closer involvement of people, civil society organisations and businesses in the EU can be given shape.
Het kabinet is bereid om nader te bezien op welke wijze vorm kan worden gegeven aan de nadere betrokkenheid van mensen, maatschappelijke organisaties en bedrijven bij de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Verhoeven en Den Boer over het bericht 'Burger ingezet bij opsporing'

MPs Groothuizen, Verhoeven and Den Boer (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a new OM directive allowing police publicity of suspects' identities to prevent serious crimes, including identifiable victims and witnesses, and about safeguards, subsidiarity, oversight and ECHR compliance. Minister Grapperhaus answered largely in substance, explaining the criteria and safeguards but declining to commit to annual reporting and saying no specific oversight was planned.
I see no reason to specifically exercise oversight over this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding daarop specifiek toezicht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Den Boer en Sneller over de beïnvloeding door buitenlandse entiteiten van democratische verkiezingen

Three D66 MPs asked the Interior Minister about foreign influence on elections via social media, including Russian political ads on Facebook, data protection against microtargeting, and advertiser transparency. The government replied by referring to a separate letter on covert influence of public opinion by state actors, without answering the questions on substance.
The written questions from MPs Verhoeven, Den Boer and Sneller (all D66), question number 2017Z15194, have been answered by means of the letter 'Covert influence on public opinion by state actors'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de van de leden Verhoeven, Den Boer en Sneller (allen D66), vraagnummer 2017Z15194 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «Heimelijke beïnvloeding van de publieke opinie door statelijke actoren»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de terugkeer van Nederlanders uit IS-gebied

MP Verhoeven (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether Dutch authorities help Dutch nationals returning from IS-held territory, how this squares with earlier NCTV statements, and whether such people should be prosecuted in the Netherlands. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government provides no active extraction, that consular help is available at Dutch missions, that each case is handled individually through criminal, intelligence or administrative routes, and that he agrees returnees should face Dutch justice, though nationality revocation may be used where national security requires it.
Yes, I share the view that travellers to conflict areas who may have committed terrorist acts there must come before a Dutch court and be prosecuted for the possible crimes they have committed.

Ja, ik deel de mening dat uitreizigers naar strijdgebied die mogelijk terroristische daden aldaar hebben gepleegd, in Nederland voor de rechter moeten komen en berecht moeten worden voor de mogelijke misdaden die zij hebben begaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Jetten over het bericht ‘Reclameborden op A'dam CS weten wanneer en hoelang jij kijkt’

MPs Verhoeven and Jetten asked the government about reports that cameras in advertising billboards at Dutch railway stations, including Amsterdam Centraal, collect viewer data. The government answered that NS and operator Exterion Media turned off the cameras and software after the publicity, claimed only anonymous statistical counts were generated, and noted the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is asking questions.

Following the conversation, it was decided to switch off the cameras and underlying software on the billboards, even though according to Exterion Media it falls within all applicable laws and regulations.

Naar aanleiding van het gesprek is besloten om de camera’s en achterliggende software op de borden uit te zetten, ondanks het feit dat het volgens Exterion Media binnen alle geldende wet- en regelgeving valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Verhoeven over het verstrekken van Europese paspoorten na een investering in de Cypriotische economie

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Cyprus granting EU passports to wealthy investors, whether the Commission is investigating, and whether the Netherlands engages in similar practices. The minister said no Commission investigation exists, that EU states decide their own nationality rules, that Dutch investor residence permits require a five-year legal stay before naturalisation, and that no conflict with international law has been established so no further action is planned.
It is up to the country to establish whether the national (legal) conditions for issuing a passport have been met and to prevent criminals possibly being facilitated thereby.

Het is aan het land om vast te stellen of aan de nationale (wettelijke) voorwaarden voor verstrekking van een paspoort is voldaan en om te voorkomen dat daardoor mogelijkerwijs criminelen worden gefaciliteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Niet meer geklopt op snelheid!’

An MP asked whether police may stop a car remotely by breaking into its software, given that the Computercriminaliteit III bill does not list stopping a car as an investigative power. The minister confirmed that stopping a car is not a permitted investigative act under the bill, said he would alert the police, and denied that the police have prepared for such intrusions.
Under the bill, it is therefore not permitted to break into a car's computer system in order to stop it.
Volgens het wetsvoorstel is het dus niet toegestaan binnen te dringen in het computersysteem van een auto om deze te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake ‘Russische whizzkid wordt rijk door jouw documentjes’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a website publishing leaked official documents with personal data was obtained illegally, what action would be taken against it, whether Google would be pressed to act, and whether government publications should stop linking to it. The minister answered that legality cannot be assumed, that the data protection authority is the competent supervisor and the Wbp may not apply to a foreign-based site, that delisting via individual requests is the available route, and that the government will raise the linking issue in appropriate channels.

Where there are violations of the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp), the Dutch Data Protection Authority is the independent supervisor, which has the power to act against violations of the Wbp and itself decides when to do so.

Daar waar sprake is van schendingen van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) is de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens de onafhankelijke toezichthouder, die de bevoegdheid heeft om op te treden bij schendingen van de Wbp en zelf bepaalt wanneer zij dat doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat in Nederland dagelijks 30 terreurexperts uit Europa bijeenkomen

The MP asks whether the AIVD head's claim that 30 European terrorism experts meet daily in the Netherlands is accurate, and about the group's composition, legal basis, information shared and oversight. The minister confirms the statement, explains it refers to a physical platform set up under Dutch chairmanship of the Counter Terrorism Group, describes its operational intelligence sharing, and says oversight is multilateral with national supervisors such as the CTIVD able to review AIVD conduct.
Multilateral oversight by national supervisors of the Platform members applies to the multilateral cooperation.
Bij de multilaterale samenwerking is multilateraal toezicht door nationale toezichthouders van de Platform-leden van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over massasurveillance door de Oezbeekse overheid

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked the government about mass surveillance in Uzbekistan, its human rights implications, the role of a Dutch-headquartered telecom firm's Uzbek subsidiary, and surveillance technology exports. The ministers condemned the human rights situation, said talks at senior official level were held with Veon, and stated that no export licences for surveillance technology to Uzbekistan had been granted.
The Netherlands has not granted any licences for the export of surveillance technology to Uzbekistan.
Nederland heeft geen vergunningen verleend voor de uitvoer van surveillancetechnologie naar Oezbekistan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Fox IT houdt zeggenschap staat af’

MPs Paternotte and Verhoeven asked whether the government secured co-control over Fox Crypto after NCC Group's takeover, dropped its first right of purchase, and what safeguards protect state secrets. The minister confirms ICT separation and contract transfers are done, says co-control and ownership terms are still under discussion, and gives only partial, procedural answers on secrecy safeguards, declining operational details for security reasons.
For security reasons I will not go into specific questions about the protection of state secrets.
Om veiligheidsredenen ga ik niet in op specifieke vragen over de beveiliging van staatsgeheimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Verhoeven over OV-chipkaartbedrijf Translink dat de reisgegevens van honderden studenten heeft doorgegeven aan de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs

MPs Jetten and Verhoeven asked how Translink could hand travel data of hundreds of students to DUO, on what legal basis, and whether travellers are notified. The government answered that DUO relied on general supervisory powers and data protection provisions, that the Hague court has since ruled these insufficient and transfers stopped, and it declined to address pending appeal questions while promising limited follow-up on privacy and information sharing.

The Hague District Court ruled in its judgment of 8 May that Articles 5:16 and 5:17 of the General Administrative Law Act do not in themselves provide a sufficiently specific legal basis for the data processing.

De rechtbank Den Haag heeft echter in haar uitspraak van 8 mei jl. geoordeeld dat de artikelen 5:16 en 5:17 van de Awb als zodanig geen voldoende specifieke wettelijke grondslag bieden voor de gegevensverwerking
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Verhoeven over het bericht dat meerderheid van de zorgsites onbeveiligd is

MPs Dijkstra and Verhoeven asked whether the Minister would act after a report that most healthcare provider websites lack secure connections, and why some sectors perform worse. The Minister replied that information security is primarily the providers' own responsibility, enforced by the Data Protection Authority and IGZ, and pointed to an action plan and awareness efforts without new binding measures.
I do not have a specific explanation for why one healthcare sector has a higher percentage of secure connections than another.
Ik heb niet een specifieke verklaring waarom de ene zorgsector een hoger percentage beveiligde verbindingen heeft dan de andere zorgsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Verhoeven over patiënten die onder druk gezet worden om bijzondere persoonsgegevens af te staan in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg

MPs Diertens and Verhoeven asked the Minister of Health about a clinic fining patients who did not complete ROM questionnaires, whether ROM data use for benchmarking is appropriate, and whether patients are pressured into sharing sensitive data. The Minister said patients must be able to refuse, financial pressure is unacceptable, the practice has stopped, and no further signals of pressure are known so no further inquiry is planned.
In doing so, a patient must always have the option to refuse to participate in ROM or to withhold consent for passing personal data on to Stichting Benchmark GGZ (SBG).
Daarbij moet een patiënt wel altijd de mogelijkheid hebben te weigeren om mee te werken aan ROM of geen toestemming te geven voor doorlevering van persoonsgegevens aan Stichting Benchmark GGZ (SBG).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Verhoeven over anti-corruptie rechtbanken in Oekraïne

Dutch MPs Groothuizen and Verhoeven asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed with the European Commission president that a dedicated anti-corruption court in Ukraine was unnecessary and whether the Netherlands would press for one. The minister replied that the EU and IMF demand independent anti-corruption institutions, that the Netherlands supports an independent anti-corruption court and will keep advocating it, while stressing that the independence and transparency of the judicial structure must be guaranteed.
The Netherlands has also actively lobbied the Ukrainian authorities for this.
Nederland heeft hier ook actief bij de Oekraïense autoriteiten voor gepleit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad dat vergaand onderzoek in smartphones privacy rechten schendt

MPs Groothuizen and Verhoeven asked how the Supreme Court's 4 April 2017 ruling on smartphone searches affects criminal investigations, whether it differs from the Computer Crime III bill, and whether a prompt statutory regime is needed. The minister answered that prosecutor authorisation is now generally required for searching seized phones, that the bill covers remote access rather than seizure, and that existing provisions suffice in most cases while new Code of Criminal Procedure rules are under consultation.

Following the Supreme Court ruling, from 4 April 2017 the main rule in criminal investigations is that, where the police seize independently, examining a seized smartphone or other electronic data carrier requires the prosecutor's authorisation.

Naar aanleiding van het arrest van de Hoge Raad geldt in strafrechtelijke onderzoeken vanaf 4 april 2017 als hoofdregel dat, indien sprake is van zelfstandig beslag door de opsporingsambtenaar, er voor het doen van onderzoek aan een inbeslaggenomen smartphone of andere elektronische gegevensdrager of geautomatiseerd werk, de toestemming van de officier van justitie voor dat onderzoek vereist is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Nispen over de aanstaande voorkeurspeiling onder gedetineerden voor de vaststelling van het aanbod van geestelijke verzorging binnen justitiële inrichtingen

MPs Verhoeven and Van Nispen asked whether the new preference survey among detainees on prison chaplaincy would reflect their real needs, including non-religious care, and whether the humanist option should be labelled non-religious. The Secretary of State answered that all detainees receive the survey in 14 languages with an information leaflet explaining the options, that humanist care is described as non-religious there, and that results will be discussed with DJI and reported to the House.
Yes, I will discuss the results of the preference survey with DJI and then inform the House.
Ja, ik zal de resultaten van de voorkeurspeiling met DJI bespreken en daarna de Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het onderzoek van de Consumentenbond over het Bel-me-niet Register

An MP asked the minister about a Consumentenbond survey finding that 89% of respondents received unsolicited sales calls, whether the bond's proposal to extend Bel-me-niet protection to former customers should be adopted, and whether the Telecommunicatiewet should be improved. The minister said the current right-of-objection system is balanced, rejected the proposal, but will consider amending the rules during the ePrivacy review.
I therefore see no reason to adopt the Consumentenbond's proposal.
Ik zie daarom ook geen reden om het voorstel van de Consumentenbond over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Overheid eist invloed bij cyberbeveiliger FOXIT’

An MP asked ministers whether the takeover of Fox-IT by NCC Group risks state secrets reaching foreign intelligence, why the government was informed only after the sale, and how dependent it is on private encryption firms. The government answered that existing secrecy law and contractual security requirements, with state supervision, cover the risk, that ministries were informed beforehand, and that alternative Dutch suppliers exist only in limited form.
Before the takeover, the ministries of the Interior and Defence were informed about it.
Voorafgaand aan de overname zijn de ministeries van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Defensie ter zake ingelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat een Nederlandse vrouw na 24 jaar het Verenigd Koninkrijk moet verlaten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Dutch woman living in the UK for 24 years must leave after Brexit, and whether Dutch citizens in the UK would be supported and the UK government contacted. The minister could not confirm the case, said it was not generalisable, noted the embassy provides information, and said rights of EU citizens will be negotiated after the UK formally triggers Article 50.
No, I cannot confirm the content of the newspaper article.
Nee, ik kan de inhoud van het krantenartikel niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het akkoord over verplichte paspoortcontrole voor reizigers van internationale hogesnelheidstreinen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported agreement among the Netherlands, Belgium, the UK and France to mandatory passport checks on international high-speed trains, and why parliament was not informed beforehand. The minister denied any binding agreement, said only a joint impact analysis on passenger data from Thalys and Eurostar will be carried out, and deferred most operational questions to that analysis, promising to inform parliament of its outcome.
Your House will be informed of the outcomes of the impact analysis.
Uw Kamer zal geïnformeerd worden over de uitkomsten van de impactanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Segers en Verhoeven over het bericht dat drugs met medeweten van de politie Nederland in is gesmokkeld

MPs Van Nispen, Segers and Verhoeven asked whether police officers knowingly let cocaine shipments into the Netherlands, whether a tipster was paid, and whether the no-let-pass rule (doorlaatverbod) was breached. Minister Blok declined to address the specific questions because the criminal case is before the court, restated the legal framework for seizure and controlled delivery, and saw no reason for a further investigation.
Given that the criminal case is currently before the court, it is not appropriate for me to address these questions in substance.
Gelet op het feit dat de strafzaak momenteel onder de rechter is, past het mij niet om inhoudelijk in te gaan op deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Nederland verspeelt kansen in veelbelovende ruimtevaartmarkt’

MPs Verhoeven and Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an article saying the Netherlands is losing opportunities in the space market, including its low ranking in ESA programme investment and risks to ESTEC. The minister agreed space technology is important, explained Dutch ESA contributions and the geo-return principle, and said the government is looking at further support for ESTEC.
Currently it is being considered what more the Netherlands can do for ESTEC to further secure its presence in Noordwijk.
Momenteel wordt bezien wat Nederland extra kan doen voor ESTEC om haar aanwezigheid in Noordwijk verder te bestendigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Sjoerdsma over de blokkade van NOS in Turkije

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the blocking of NOS's website and app in Turkey, why it occurred, whether he had protested, and whether he would act and raise it in the EU. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands objected and requested clarification, and noted that press and internet freedom are EU values raised regularly with Turkey, without announcing a specific new step.
In response to the blocking, the Netherlands lodged an objection with the Turkish authorities and requested clarification.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van de blokkade bezwaar aangetekend bij de Turkse autoriteiten en om opheldering gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Verhoeven over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Verhoeven asked the ministers about the documentary 'Grenzeloos misbruikt' on online child sexual abuse, covering police undercover and honeypot powers, use of decoy personas, Philippine cooperation, detection technology like PhotoDNA, and education. The government answered that current law limits deanonymising darknet users, that pending bill Computercriminaliteit III would add powers, that decoy personas are permitted under the Tallon criterion, and described ongoing cooperation and education efforts.
Current legislation offers little to no possibility to de-anonymise users in the relevant environments on the TOR network.
De huidige wetgeving biedt weinig tot geen mogelijkheden om de gebruikers op de bedoelde omgevingen op het TOR-netwerk te de-anonimiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de topsalarissen bij de publieke omroep

An MP asked the government about reported high salaries at public broadcasters, including a radio DJ allegedly earning about three times the WNT norm, and asked for greater transparency. The state secretary said such pay above the WNT norm is undesirable, that the NPO was ordered to announce concrete steps on hiring and pay policy, that the WNT is being extended to non-top officials via a draft bill, and that the broadcasters must provide information to the minister on request.
I have ordered the public broadcaster to inform me in the short term of the concrete follow-up steps it intends to take regarding more responsible hiring and remuneration policy.
Ik heb de publieke omroep gesommeerd mij op korte termijn te laten weten welke concrete vervolgstappen zij voornemens is te zetten op het terrein van een meer verantwoord inhuur- en beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis, Jasper van Dijk en Verhoeven over geheime contracten en onzorgvuldige begeleiding van deelnemers bij RTL-programma's rond hulp-tv

MPs asked the state secretary about RTL reality-help programmes allegedly misleading vulnerable participants, binding them to secret contracts, and filming therapy under pressure, and whether the state has adequate legal tools and oversight. The state secretary said producers and broadcasters bear primary responsibility, the Mediawet 2008 contains no such rules and no new legislation is planned, RTL (under Luxembourg supervision) has promised to review its practices and media code, and medical questions were referred to the health minister.
I also see no reason to propose statutory rules for this.
Ik zie ook geen aanleiding om daar wettelijke regels voor te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Verhoeven, Grashoff, Voordewind en Thieme over het bericht dat EU-Turkijerapporteur Kati Piri wordt geweerd uit Turkije

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey had barred EP Turkey rapporteur Kati Piri from entering the country, what reasons were given, and what the government was doing to secure her access and support her criticism of arrests of HDP parliamentarians. The minister confirmed the report, referred to an earlier letter, said Turkey had cancelled her scheduled meetings rather than denying entry, and stated the Turkish reasons were unknown while promising to keep raising the issue with Turkey.

The matter is primarily a matter between the European Parliament and Turkey, but the Netherlands will continue to bring to the attention of the Turkish authorities the importance of dialogue with the EP and access for its rapporteurs.

De kwestie is primair een zaak tussen het Europees parlement en Turkije, maar Nederland zal het belang van een dialoog met het EP en de toegang van haar Rapporteurs bij de Turkse autoriteiten onder de aandacht blijven brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Verhoeven over de zeer hoge uitkering aan de topman van NXP bij de verkoop van het bedrijf

MPs Gesthuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the reported USD 428 million payout to NXP's chief executive from the company's sale, and the risks of such exorbitant pay, were acceptable, and whether the clawback rules and NXP subsidies would be reviewed. The minister, on behalf of the economic affairs minister, declined to judge the amount, said pay assessment is for shareholders and the company, referred to earlier answers on clawback and subsidies, and gave no new commitments.
I have no opinion on the amount reported in the media that the NXP chief executive would keep from the takeover if he exercised his options and sold his shares.
Ik heb geen oordeel over de in de media genoemde hoogte van het bedrag dat de uitvoerend bestuurder van NXP zou overhouden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Verhoeven over het bericht “Renovatie Binnenhof officieel geheim”

MPs Koolmees and Verhoeven asked why the Binnenhof renovation was declared secret, bypassing open tender, and how contractors are selected and costs checked. Minister Blok answered that security risks justified secrecy, pointed to precedents, and said selection criteria and price checks apply despite limited competition.
I decided to deviate from the usual procedures in order to limit risks to the security situation of the Binnenhof complex and its users.
Ik heb besloten af te wijken van de gebruikelijke procedures om risico’s voor de veiligheidssituatie van het Binnenhofcomplex en zijn gebruikers te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de minister van Economische Zaken doorgaat met het gebruik van Gmail voor communicatie met ambtenaren

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether ministers' private email accounts used for work should be investigated, which officials used such accounts, and why the Rijksbeveiligingsambtenaar and the national security advice were not acted on earlier. The minister answered that the government sees no need to extend the Auditdienst Rijk investigation to all ministers, that a concrete reason exists for his own account, that the security officer was informed in 2014 and 2016, and that the advisory report cannot be shared with parliament.
The cabinet is of the view that an investigation of a private email account is an infringement of personal privacy.
Het kabinet is van mening dat een onderzoek van een privé e-mailaccount een inbreuk op de persoonlijke levenssfeer is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Swinkels over het bericht dat de politie foto’s neemt van personen en hun identiteitsbewijzen in Apeldoorn

MPs Verhoeven and Swinkels (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police photographing people and their identity documents in Apeldoorn, and whether this is lawful under the Wet politiegegevens and consistent with the National Ombudsman's findings. The Minister answered that such photography is permitted when necessary for police tasks, that storage is kept brief and deleted at end of shift, that the practice is being replaced by the MEoS scanning app, and that he accepts the Ombudsman's view that automatic deletion should be the aim, while answering late.
The making of photos of identity documents becomes unnecessary with the introduction of MEoS.
Het maken van foto’s van identiteitsbewijzen wordt door de invoering van MEoS overbodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de plannen om burgers met satellieten vanuit de ruimte te gaan bespieden

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a market consultation on using satellites for investigation and other purposes, including scope, legal basis, data sharing with the FIOD, costs, and foreign precedents. The minister answered that the consultation is exploratory within an innovation programme, no tender is planned, satellite use is limited to incidental, technically feasible tasks under existing rules, and no costs or specific applications are yet known.
There is currently no intention to place our own satellites in orbit around the earth.
Er is op dit moment geen voornemen om eigen satellieten in een baan om de aarde te brengen.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat het ministerie van VWS zorgverleners aanraadt om browsers niet te updaten

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked why the Ministry of Health advised healthcare providers not to update browsers over Java plugin support ending, and whether this exposed patient data to cyberattacks. The minister explained the advice was to avoid uncontrolled updates that could break software, that responsibility lies with providers, that NCSC was not initially involved but now is, and that a solution is expected by year-end.
It is important that healthcare providers themselves weigh security against possible limits on functionality.
Het is belangrijk dat zorgverleners zelf de afweging maken tussen beveiliging en mogelijke beperking in functionaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de zedenpolitie van AVROTROS

An MP asked the state secretary whether it was absurd that AVROTROS removed a homosexual sex scene from the series La Famiglia and asked for a talk with the broadcaster about this 'moral policing'. The government answered that the scene was dropped only for narrative placement reasons, that AVROTROS has no problem with gay sex scenes, that no Mediawet rule is breached, and that broadcasters are programmatically autonomous so no talk is needed.
From my answer to questions 1–3 it appears that there is no question of 'moral policing' by AVROTROS.
Uit mijn antwoord op de vragen 1–3 blijkt dat geen sprake is van «zedenpolitie» door AVROTROS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat Frankrijk een internationale aanpak wil op het gebied van encryptie

An MP from D66 asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Economic Affairs about France's proposal for an international approach to encryption, including whether the Netherlands received the proposals and whether weakening encryption would harm security and trust. The government confirmed it was informed of the Franco-German initiative, reaffirmed its unchanged position supporting strong encryption, and said it sees no current way to weaken encryption without compromising digital security.
The Dutch position and the considerations underlying it have been translated into English and are actively promoted internationally.
Het Nederlandse standpunt en de afwegingen die daaraan ten grondslag liggen zijn vertaald naar het Engels en worden internationaal actief uitgedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het gebruik van prepaidkaarten door de Minister van Defensie

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Defence Minister's use of prepaid phones for security reasons is consistent with the planned ban on anonymous prepaid SIM cards, and whether the ban would affect ministers' security protocols. The minister answered that no general ban is planned, only an investigation into mandatory registration of prepaid SIM holders, and declined to detail security protocols for security reasons.
For security reasons I will not go into the content of security protocols or rules.
Om veiligheidsredenen ga ik niet nader in op de inhoud van beveiligingsprotocollen of – regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de gevolgen van een Brexit voor de City of London, Nederlandse bedrijven, en de Amsterdamse Zuidas

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about the effects of a Brexit on the City of London, Dutch firms and the Amsterdam Zuidas, covering timing, sector impacts, financial passporting and talent. The government answered that the UK remains an EU member until withdrawal, that Dutch sectors such as food processing and chemicals face the largest risks under WTO rules, and that the effects on the City and the Zuidas remain uncertain.
The cabinet will attend such meetings more often in the coming weeks and months, including at sector level, such as with the Dutch manufacturing industry.
Het kabinet zal de komende weken en maanden vaker dergelijke bijeenkomsten bijwonen, onder meer op sectorniveau, zoals met de Nederlandse maakindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het Verhoeven over het bericht dat gemeenten en winkels zich niet houden aan de regels voor wifi-tracking

An MP asked whether municipalities and shops are complying with privacy rules on wifi-tracking of phones in public spaces, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the Data Protection Authority did not investigate concrete cases in 2016, gave guidance letters instead, considers its enforcement powers sufficient, and pointed to awareness campaigns, while stating that the AP found no non-compliance by municipalities.
It is therefore not known whether municipalities and shops comply with the rules.
Het is dus niet bekend of gemeenten en winkels zich aan de regels houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de eenheid van regeringsbeleid ten aanzien van het raadgevend referendum

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether she agreed with Prime Minister Rutte's remarks calling the Ukraine referendum disastrous and opposing referenda on multilateral agreements, and how this fits the government's neutral advice on the advisory referendum law. The minister answered that the PM's remarks were a personal view, that the cabinet gave neutral advice and later signed the law, and that individual ministers may comment on long-term general matters without threatening policy unity.
He also noted that his remark about referenda (in general terms) is a personal opinion.
Daarnaast heeft hij opgemerkt dat zijn uitlating over referenda (in algemene zin) een persoonlijke opvatting is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Minister van Economische Zaken doorgaat met het gebruik van Gmail voor communicatie met ambtenaren

An MP (Verhoeven, D66) asked whether Minister Kamp's use of a private Gmail account for work email exposed state secrets, whether he was phished, and whether ministers receive cybersecurity training. The minister answered that he has ended the private-account use, that an Auditdienst Rijk investigation into classified material is underway with results expected after the summer recess, and that he sees no grounds to assume classified information reached third parties.

I have therefore instructed the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) to investigate whether documents bearing the classifications Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, Staatsgeheim Confidentieel, Staatsgeheim Geheim or Staatsgeheim Zeer Geheim were present on my private email account.

Ik heb daarom de Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) opdracht gegeven onderzoek te doen naar de vraag of documenten met de rubriceringen Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, Staatsgeheim Confidentieel, Staatsgeheim Geheim of Staatsgeheim Zeer Geheim
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Cyber security van apparatuur in ziekenhuizen kwetsbaar’

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked about reports that medical equipment in hospitals is vulnerable to cyber attacks, including malware infections and whether ministers would investigate device security and push for a national approach. The minister replied that hospitals are responsible for their own information security, pointed to existing NCSC initiatives (ISAC, Z-CERT) and a forthcoming quickscan, and committed to further study and discussion with stakeholders.
Information security is an own responsibility of a healthcare institution.
Informatiebeveiliging is een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een zorginstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over audiodescriptie bij film en televisie voor blinden, slechtzienden en meervoudig gehandicapten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about audio description for blind, visually impaired and multiply disabled viewers on public broadcasting and film, and why subtitles are mandatory but audio description is not. The State Secretary answered that the NPO runs a pilot and evaluation, Telefilms and Filmfonds-funded films will get audio description, a decision on further steps awaits the evaluation, and the EU merely encourages such accessibility.
I first want to investigate how this technology is experienced and used and also await the outcome of the NPO evaluation before taking further steps.
Ik wil eerst onderzoeken hoe die techniek ervaren en gebruikt wordt en ook de uitkomsten van de evaluatie van de NPO afwachten alvorens verdere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de consequenties van een Brexit voor verblijfsrechten van Nederlanders en Britten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Brexit's effects on residence rights of Dutch and British citizens, British voting eligibility in the referendum, naturalisation and integration requirements, and the UK's possible single-market access terms. The minister answered that the government cannot yet say what Brexit would mean for residence status, depends on negotiations, and declined to take positions on scenarios, while committing only to the standard Article 50 process.

The cabinet cannot currently state what the impact of a possible UK withdrawal from the European Union would be on the residence status of Dutch nationals in the UK and of British nationals in the Netherlands.

Het kabinet kan op dit moment niet aangeven wat de invloed is van eventuele terugtrekking van het Verenigd Koninkrijk uit de Europese Unie op de verblijfsstatus van Nederlanders in het Verenigd Koninkrijk en van Britten in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Noodtoestand in Amerikaans ziekenhuis wegens ransomware’ (een chantagemethode op internet)

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether a ransomware-driven emergency like the US hospital case could happen in the Netherlands and what safeguards exist for hospital IT. The minister answers that no such emergency is known, that information security is the hospitals' own responsibility under existing NEN norms, and points to breach notification duties, IGZ outreach, and planned NIS directive and Z-CERT measures, but declines to commit to mandatory IT testing.
Information security is the hospital's own responsibility.
Informatiebeveiliging is een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Verhoeven over minimumtarieven voor zelfstandigen zonder personeel in collectieve arbeidsovereenkomsten

MPs Van Weyenberg and Verhoeven asked whether cao rate agreements for self-employed workers without staff (zzp'ers) in the architects' cao breach the Dutch cartel prohibition, and whether such rules should be declared generally binding. The minister answered that competition enforcement belongs to the ACM, that the avv-procedure is still ongoing, that the cao rules are not generally binding for now due to competition risk, and that no further guidelines on bogus self-employment are needed.
It is therefore only up to the ACM to make statements in individual cases.
Het is dan ook slechts aan de ACM om uitspraken te doen in individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake uitgaven door de KRO

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about KRO broadcaster spending of association funds on year-end projects, chocolates, cars, a project manager and a website. The State Secretary answered that the spending concerns association money rather than public media funds, that the Commissariaat voor de Media finds no reason to act, and that no further tightening of supervision is needed.
The Commissariaat judges that this has been the case here.
Het Commissariaat oordeelt dat zulks hier het geval is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Maij en Segers over het gebruik door GeenPeil van de subsidieregeling referendum

MPs Verhoeven, Maij and Segers asked the Minister of the Interior whether the referendum subsidy scheme was being misused by GeenPeil, where natural persons applied for subsidies while a legal entity stood behind them and purchased services from it. The Minister replied that the independent Referendum Commission assesses applications only against the scheme's criteria, that over 40 applicants bought services from GeenPeil and disclosed this, and that he cannot judge the application himself.
It is not for me to comment on the extent to which subsidy applications and related circumstances are acceptable and permissible.
Het is niet aan mij om mij uit te laten over de mate waarin subsidieaanvragen en/of met die aanvragen samenhangende omstandigheden acceptabel en geoorloofd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over het vermeende Oekraïense filmpje dat op internet is geplaatst

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked whether the government is aware of reports that a threatening Ukrainian video against the Netherlands was a forgery, and whether it would promptly investigate the video's origin and share the results with parliament. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that the Ukrainian government and the Azov battalion disavow the threats, and said the videos are known to Dutch investigative authorities, without committing to an investigation or disclosure.
The videos are known to the Dutch investigative authorities.
De filmpjes zijn bekend bij de Nederlandse opsporingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Rusland de Nederlandse politiek financieel beïnvloedt

MPs Verhoeven and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russia has tried to influence Dutch politics, financially or otherwise, including the upcoming referendum on the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, and whether the Netherlands would follow up on a reported US investigation. Minister Koenders answered that the AIVD reports Russian influence efforts in general but the government has no indications of improper Russian influence on the referendum or of clandestine funding of Dutch parties, declined to comment on possible intelligence investigations, and saw no reason to ask US authorities.
No public statements can be made about any possible investigations by the Dutch intelligence services.
In het openbaar kunnen geen mededelingen gedaan worden over eventuele onderzoeken van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya, Verhoeven, Van Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Bontkragen van kinderjassen vol schadelijk gif’

D66 MPs asked whether mislabelling of fur-trimmed children's jackets and possible toxic substances warranted action, and whether the NVWA should have flagged the issue proactively. The minister said labelling rules are already set at EU level, toxic levels were below legal norms per NVWA and RIVM, and a formal NVWA risk assessment is pending with advice expected end of March.
I have asked the NVWA to have its risk assessment of the Kassa research reviewed by the RIVM.
Ik heb de NVWA verzocht haar risico-inschatting van het onderzoek van Kassa te laten toetsen door het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol, Pieter Heerma, Verhoeven, Jasper van Dijk, Thieme en Kuzu over de behandeling van de Mediawet in de Eerste Kamer

MPs asked the State Secretary about appointments to the supervisory boards of the NOS and NTR and the NPO, including alleged political favouritism and whether a board chair's position at UWV made the appointment incompatible with the Mediawet. The State Secretary denied any legal incompatibility, said the NPO appointment followed an independent advisory committee, and refused to reverse it.
I regret the impression that has arisen and do not consider it consistent with the actual course of events.
Ik betreur het beeld dat is ontstaan en vind dat ook niet in overeenstemming met de feitelijke gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de United Nations Convention on Transparency in Treaty-based Investor-State Arbitration

An MP asked the minister why the Netherlands has not signed the UN Convention on Transparency in Treaty-based Investor-State Arbitration while the US, Canada and some EU states have, and whether it will sign quickly. The minister explains that the EU failed to reach consensus on signing, so the Netherlands has waited for an EU position, and says a Dutch decision on signing will be taken very shortly.
In parallel, the cabinet will take a decision on signing the convention in the very short term, and the approval documents are also in the final stage of preparation.
Parallel daaraan zal het kabinet op zeer korte termijn een besluit nemen over de ondertekening van het verdrag en ook de goedkeuringsstukken zijn in de laatste fase van voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut versleutelde berichten op telefoons kan kraken

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Forensic Institute uses software to crack encrypted phone messages, what technique it uses, and whether it exploits unknown vulnerabilities. The government declined to name the software or techniques for operational reasons, and said it would address the handling of zero-day vulnerabilities in a separate letter.
providing information on which specific software the investigative services use carries major risks for the usability of those means
brengt het verstrekken van informatie over welke specifieke software de opsporingsdiensten gebruiken grote risico’s met zich mee voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over het bericht 'Regering negeert referendumstem vanuit het buitenland'

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked the Interior Minister how the government mobilises Dutch citizens abroad to vote, including in the Ukraine association referendum, and why postal voting and repeated registration are used. The minister answered that information was provided via websites, banners, social media, embassies and municipal registers, that internet voting was shelved for security and cost reasons, and that a bill for permanent registration is pending.
I am of the view that everything necessary is being done to enable Dutch voters abroad to vote.
Ik ben van oordeel dat al het nodige wordt gedaan om stemgerechtigde Nederlanders in het buitenland in de gelegenheid te stellen om te gaan stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over kentekenregistratie (in Kampen en Zwolle) om fietsgebruik te bevorderen

An MP asked the minister about licence-plate registration used in Kampen and Zwolle to encourage cycling, including whether a privacy impact assessment was done and whether motorists could opt out. The minister said no PIA was required or carried out by the regional government, motorists cannot opt out of the registration beyond blocking postal advertising, and similar cycling projects, such as in Breda, are expected.
A PIA was not carried out by the Province of Overijssel and therefore cannot be shared.
Een PIA is niet door de Provincie Overijssel doorlopen en kan derhalve ook niet gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht van de ANWB dat autofabrikanten ongezien data van automobilisten verzamelen

An MP asked ministers about reports that car manufacturers collect driver data without drivers' knowledge, including which privacy law applies, whether consumers are informed and must consent, and whether data can be sold to third parties. The government answered that manufacturers are responsible for complying with privacy law under the European directive and Dutch Wbp, that information duties and consent via purchase contracts apply, and that transfer or sale of personal data is only allowed within legal limits.
A complete overview of all data that all types of cars generate and store cannot be provided.
Een volledig overzicht van alle gegevens die alle typen auto’s genereren en opslaan kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Veldhoven over het budget voor energie-innovatie in 2016

MPs Verhoeven and Van Veldhoven asked why the Topsector Energie was prioritised over the DEI demonstration scheme in reallocating 2016 energy-innovation budget, which projects receive additional funds, and which DEI projects might fall through. The minister replied that the Topsector Energie budget stays roughly flat, the DEI budget rises slightly, no additional funds go to the Topsector, and DEI tender outcomes will only be known after the tranches close.
There is no question of additional budget for the Topsector Energie.
Er is geen sprake van additioneel budget voor de Topsector Energie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven en Voordewind over de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van het associatieverdrag tussen de EU en Oekraïne

MPs Omtzigt, Verhoeven and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the provisional application of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, including which articles apply, whether unanimity and parliamentary consent were needed, and what happens if the Netherlands rejects it in the referendum. The minister answered that about 355 articles (roughly 70%) are provisionally applied under EU competence, that the Council decisions were adopted by unanimity with Dutch consent, and that the Netherlands will follow the referendum law without prejudging the outcome.
The cabinet does not have continuous insight into the timing and manner in which the national parliaments of the 27 member states are informed of the decision on provisional application.
Het kabinet heeft niet voortdurend zicht op het tijdstip en wijze van informeren van de nationale parlementen in 27 lidstaten over het besluit tot voorlopige toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Slowaakse overheid geen Nationaal Actieplan LHBTI gelijkheid aanneemt

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Slovak government dropping its national LGBTI equality action plan, and whether this conflicts with the Dutch-Maltese-Slovak EU presidency trio. The minister confirmed awareness, said the trio statement on gender equality remains intact and that the Netherlands will seek Council conclusions backing the Commission's LGBTI action plan, without new concrete steps.
I will continue to work for improving the position of LGBTI people in Europe.
Ik blijf mij inspannen voor de verbetering van de positie van LHBTI in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de vermeende beïnvloeding van de NOS door het Koninklijk Huis

MP Verhoeven asked whether a phone call expressing displeasure from the Royal House over an NOS satirical clip during a sports gala occurred, and whether there was pressure on media. The Prime Minister answered that no call was made on behalf of the Royal House during the broadcast, only a brief personal SMS from a Royal House staff member, with no intent to influence content, and declined further investigation.
During the broadcast in question, no one on behalf of or from the Royal House telephoned to express displeasure about the broadcast.
Er is gedurende de bewuste uitzending niet door of namens leden van het KH getelefoneerd om ongenoegen over de uitzending uit te drukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Swinkels over de indiening van het wetsvoorstel computercriminaliteit III bij de Tweede Kamer

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a press release announced the computer crime III bill after a two-year consultation, before it was submitted to parliament, and when it would be submitted. The minister defended active government communication about legislative steps, said the release marked a ministerial council decision on the anti-jihadism action programme, and noted that all four bills have since been submitted.
I consider open and transparent communication about legislative processes an important part of government information.
Ik acht het open en transparant communiceren over wetgevingsprocessen een belangrijk onderdeel van overheidsvoorlichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Nederland gooit deur dicht voor Amerikaanse delegatie’

MPs Knops and Verhoeven asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands would not host a US Congress–European Parliament Transatlantic Legislators' Dialogue meeting during its EU presidency, and whether this was due to cost or hassle. The minister replied that no formal request had been received, that he welcomes such contacts, that Brussels is the preferred venue for third-country meetings for cost and coherence reasons, and that relations with the US are good.
If the cabinet receives a formal request to host this meeting – which has not been the case so far – I will of course look at it seriously, in close consultation with your parliament.

Als het kabinet een formeel verzoek ontvangt om gastheer te zijn van deze ontmoeting – wat tot op heden niet het geval is – dan zal ik daar uiteraard serieus naar kijken, in nauw overleg met uw parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “Taxfree shoppen bestaat niet op Schiphol”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether businesses and Schiphol may advertise 'taxfree prices' when consumers still pay VAT and are not cheaper than regular prices, and whether the Reclame Code Commissie should investigate. The minister answered that the ACM and RCC are responsible, that neither received complaints, and that the SRC will hold an exploratory talk about a monitoring project.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) supervises compliance with these rules.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) houdt toezicht op de naleving van deze regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het beboeten van illegale downloads en de vrijheid van het internet

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether filmdistributors and Stichting BREIN may monitor and pursue individual downloaders and uploaders, and whether such databases of IP addresses are lawful and privacy-compatible. The Minister answered that enforcement is civil, IP data may be obtained from providers only under court-supervised balancing, the CBP must review BREIN's sensitive-data processing, and no specific filmdistributor application had yet been received.
If the internet service providers do not wish to provide this data, copyright holders can ask the court to rule on it.
Wanneer de internet service providers deze gegevens niet willen verschaffen, dan kunnen auteursrechthebbenden de rechter vragen hierover een uitspraak te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Restaurantje spelen in eigen huis’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the platform Airdnd, which lets people run home restaurants, and whether such hobby cooks should follow the same hygiene, fire safety and tax rules as professional restaurateurs, and whether new regulation is needed as Hotrec proposes. The minister answered that home restaurants are already covered by food safety, alcohol licensing and tax rules enforced by the NVWA and municipalities, that he prefers a case-by-case approach over new general regulation, and promised further information before year end.
I am therefore more in favour of a case-by-case approach.
Ik ben dan ook meer voorstander van een case-by-case aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Verhoeven over minimumtarieven voor zzp'ers in cao’s

MPs Van Weyenberg and Verhoeven asked whether collective agreements may set minimum fee rates for self-employed workers without staff, and how this relates to bogus self-employment, competition law and tax treatment. Minister Asscher answered that such clauses likely fall under the cartel prohibition unless the workers are bogus self-employed, that the ACM decides on bogus self-employment, and that the agreement has no effect on tax deductions or the Belastingdienst's assessment.
Whether or not there are bogus self-employed workers does not appear from this collective agreement provision.
Of al dan niet sprake is van schijnzelfstandigen blijkt niet uit deze cao-afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Verhoeven en Keijzer over kosten van RADAR

MPs from SP, D66 and CDA asked about the cost of the RADAR ICT system, including the value of the Capgemini delivery contract, extra work paid after termination, and external staffing costs. The State Secretary corrected earlier figures, estimated about 350,000 euro extra for Capgemini's support on the KvK interface, declined a detailed breakdown of staffing costs as too burdensome, and promised a planning for that answer.
I therefore suggest, given the administrative burden, that you refrain from this effort.
Ik geef u daarom in overweging mee, met het oog op administratieve lastendruk, af te zien van deze inspanning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “Geen kabinetscampagne Oekraïne-referendum”

An MP asked whether the cabinet would run a campaign supporting the EU-Ukraine association agreement ahead of the advisory referendum, and whether the referendum commission's role includes campaigning. The minister answered that the commission only informs voters, and that the cabinet supports the agreement and will take part in the public debate without a separate campaign timetable.
As the advisory referendum act provides, it is the task of the referendum commission to provide voters with information about a law subject to a referendum.
Zoals de wet raadgevend referendum bepaalt, is het de taak van de referendumcommissie om informatie aan de kiezer te verstrekken over een aan een referendum onderworpen wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Verhoeven inzake het bericht dat Sesamstraat verdwijnt van NPO1.

MPs Van Dijk and Verhoeven asked whether the removal of Sesamstraat from NPO1 to a themed channel is acceptable, given its educational role and the audience reach lost. The Secretary of State answered that the decision lies with the NPO under programmatic and editorial autonomy, that the morning broadcast remains on NPO 3, and that declined to discuss the decision with the NPO.
That editorial autonomy is explicitly guaranteed in the Mediawet (Media Act).
Die redactionele autonomie staat nadrukkelijk gegarandeerd in de Mediawet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat Achmea premiekorting biedt in ruil voor privédata

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether Achmea's offer of premium discounts in exchange for private driving and health-related data is acceptable, and how it complies with privacy law. The minister answered that insurers may use behavioural data within the Wbp framework, that the DPA is responsible for enforcement, that Achmea has not yet submitted the plan to the DPA, and that sharing with third parties is not Achmea's intent, while declining to judge the desirability of such practices.
It is not my place to pass judgment on the way insurers treat their customers.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg om een oordeel te geven over de manier waarop verzekeraars hun klanten tegemoet treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Omtzigt over het bericht van de Kiesraad “Groen licht voor referendum over Associatieovereenkomst Oekraïne”

MPs Verhoeven and Omtzigt asked about the Kiesraad's approval of a referendum on the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, whether partners were informed, how the public will be informed, and the agreement's provisional application and ratification status. The government answered that the referendum does not affect provisional application, that the ratification law's entry-into-force provision lapsed, and that it will follow the Advisory Referendum Act, with a further decision on any rejection to be made later.
The cabinet will follow the Advisory Referendum Act.
Het kabinet zal de Wet raadgevend referendum volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over promotie van het Koningslied

An MP asked whether the NPO and DWDD were paid to promote the Koningslied, how much the Nationaal Comité Inhuldiging paid the NPO, and whether this amounted to covert advertising in breach of media rules. The Staatssecretaris answered that no programme costs were paid to Radio 2 or DWDD, that the NPO received 1.8 million euro for media coverage of inauguration events under a contract safeguarding editorial independence, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media found no violation and no grounds for further investigation.
I asked the Commissariaat to assess the mediation agreement between the NPO and the Nationaal Comité Inhuldiging in relation to the Koningslied.
Ik heb het Commissariaat gevraagd de bemiddelingsovereenkomst tussen de NPO en het Nationaal Comité Inhuldiging in relatie tot het Koningslied te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder en Verhoeven over de aanbesteding van boekscanners en de digitalisering van rijksarchieven door het Nationaal Archief

MPs from VVD, SP, CDA and D66 asked the minister why the Nationaal Archief's digitisation of national archives is being in-sourced to the Belastingdienst rather than tendered, despite a parliamentary motion and the Commission of Procurement Experts' advice against it. The minister defends in-sourcing as lawful internal shared services, citing cost, logistics and business-case reasons, while acknowledging the earlier letter wording on loan of scanners was unfortunate and deferring answers pending a research report.
Reversing the in-sourcing of the work, as the motion requests, would lead to a further delay of, expected, at least one year.
Terugdraaien van de inbesteding van de werkzaamheden, zoals de motie vraagt, leidt tot een verdere vertraging van, naar verwachting, minimaal een jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Verhoeven over het gebruik van software van het Hacking Team door de Nationale Politie (NP)

MPs Oosenbrug and Verhoeven asked whether the National Police had considered or used Hacking Team spyware, whether its hacking tools exceed what Dutch law allows, whether it has source-code access, and whether the government will reconsider such tools after the Hacking Team breach. The Secretary of State declined to give details on specific software, citing risks to investigative capability, stated that use is limited to lawful powers under the Code of Criminal Procedure with judicial authorisation, and said he sees no reason to change policy.
I therefore cannot provide information on this.
Ik kan hier derhalve geen informatie over verstrekken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Bergkamp en Verhoeven over de gevolgen van de onlangs ingevoerde aanpassing van de Opiumwet (nieuw art. 11a) voor Nederlandse ondernemers in de hennepzaadindustrie en in d

MPs from D66 asked whether the new article 11a of the Opiumwet could criminalise sales of hemp seed, whether that conflicts with legality, the economic size of the hemp seed industry, and whether seized seeds would be grown by police. The minister answered that hemp seed is excluded from the Opiumwet prohibitions but that sales can fall under article 11a when intended for illegal cultivation, that legal fibre hemp cultivation remains permitted under Green Deals, and that the claim of police growing cannabis is untrue, with seeds only undergoing DNA testing.
Yes, I know this report, but it does not match the facts.
Ja, ik ken dit bericht, maar het stemt niet overeen met de feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het verslag van de Raad Buitenlandse Handel van 7 mei 2015

MP Verhoeven asked the trade minister about the list of green goods in the EU-WTO environmental goods negotiations, the Dutch economic stakes, environmental and climate effects, and the EU decision-making process. The minister answered that the list is not yet fixed, gave EU export figures from Commission studies, said impact assessments are ongoing, and committed to keeping Parliament informed.
There is currently no fixed list of green goods.
Er is op dit moment nog geen vastgestelde lijst met «groene goederen».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Hachchi over het bericht dat kwetsbaarheden in encryptiesoftware door Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten zijn gebruikt

Two D66 MPs asked whether a research article on Diffie-Hellman weaknesses, which suggests the NSA may have used them to read VPN, SSH and TLS traffic, is credible, whether other states or non-state actors have used such weaknesses, and whether the government wants access to encrypted data or a uniform policy on zero-day vulnerabilities. The government declined to say whether the researchers' hypothesis is correct because intelligence services do not disclose their collection methods, advised longer key lengths and stronger configuration, and said it supports encryption and responsible disclosure, referring to a forthcoming letter on encryption.
Intelligence and security services do not give insight into how they collect their intelligence, in connection with protecting sources, modus operandi and current knowledge level.
Inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten geven geen inzicht in de wijze waarop zij hun inlichtingen verzamelen in verband met de bescherming van bronnen, modus operandi en actueel kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de algemene voorwaarden van De Persgroep voor freelance journalisten

An MP asked ministers about De Persgroep's new terms for freelance journalists, including unilateral change with eight days' notice, competition clauses, broad exploitation rights and licence fees. The government answered that these are private civil-law contracts, that disputes are for the courts or the ACM, and that the new copyright contract law sets a 'fair remuneration' standard it cannot judge itself.
However, this concerns a civil-law contract between private parties to which the government is not a party.
Het betreft hier echter een civielrechtelijke overeenkomst tussen private partijen waarbij de overheid geen partij is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Berndsen-Jansen en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de nationale politie proeven houdt met privacy schendende chips in kentekenplaten

D66 MPs asked whether the national police is testing privacy-invasive RFID chips in number plates that could track all drivers' movements, and how this relates to the pending ANPR bill. The minister denied police involvement, said a private developers' field test at a defence training centre is underway, and said a privacy assessment and CBP advice would follow only if the government later decides to introduce the chip.
Once the results of the test are known, the cabinet will consider whether it is desirable to introduce the RFID chip.
Op het moment dat de resultaten van de proef bekend zijn, zal het kabinet bezien of het wenselijk is om de RFID-chip in te voeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Verhoeven over het clusteren van werkzaamheden bij een aanbesteding door Rijkswaterstaat

MPs Schouten and Verhoeven asked whether Rijkswaterstaat's combined multi-year maintenance tender for the West-Nederland-Zuid area breached the Aanbestedingswet's ban on unnecessary clustering and disadvantaged SMEs. The government answered that a complaint was upheld, the tender was withdrawn and split into three smaller lots, and it will evaluate the law's clustering rules in the summer.
Rijkswaterstaat found the complaint well-founded and withdrew the tender.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft de klacht gegrond bevonden en heeft de aanbesteding ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het aanspreken van hostingproviders door de politie op cybercrime

An MP asked about police plans to approach hosting providers about cybercrime under the 'Nederland Schoon' project, including whether content could be taken offline without a judge. The State Secretary explained the project targets cybercrime facilitated by Dutch hosting providers, that no specific content removal will be requested within the project, and that formal removal orders still require prosecutor action with investigating judge authorisation.
In the discussions within the Nederland Schoon project, hosting companies will be neither requested nor required to remove specific content from their network.
In de gesprekken binnen het project Nederland Schoon zal aan de hostingbedrijven verzocht noch gevorderd worden om specifieke content van hun netwerk te verwijderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake de plannen van de NPO

Dutch MP Verhoeven (D66) asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether the NPO's plans to remove underperforming programmes and favour popular ones, cut debate programmes and emphasise ratings conflict with the government's aim of a more distinctive public broadcaster, and whether the NPO's commercial aims are subordinating content. The State Secretary answered that public value must come first, that programmes should be judged on more than ratings, that the NPO is editorially independent but must make sharp choices, and that the NPO has been asked to include a quality assessment framework in its concession plan.
The NPO has an important role in realising this.
De NPO heeft een belangrijke rol in de realisatie hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Brussel ligt dwars bij nieuw instituut voor hypotheken’

MPs Verhoeven and Koolmees asked the Ministers of Housing and of Finance about reports that Brussels opposes the planned Dutch mortgage institute (NHI), including the state-aid and debt-classification issues, the difference from the existing NHG guarantee, and the added value of the NHI in current market conditions. The minister answered that talks with the European Commission and Eurostat are not concluded, that state-aid and classification outcomes are still open, that the NHI's added value lies mainly in stress periods and transparency, and that no signals of waning investor interest were received.

Naturally, I aim to have sufficient clarity and assurance as soon as possible on whether the preconditions can be met so that the NHI does not lead to state aid and is not classified in the government sector.
Vanzelfsprekend streef ik ernaar zo spoedig mogelijk voldoende duidelijkheid en comfort te hebben of aan de randvoorwaarden kan worden voldaan dat de NHI niet leidt tot staatssteun
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake het niet beschikbaar zijn van de website van de NOS tijdens de stroomstoring op 27 maart 2015

An MP asked whether the NOS website was offline for an hour during a 27 March 2015 power outage and how the public broadcaster's emergency back-up and role as disaster broadcaster are arranged. The government replied the outage lasted about 20 minutes, that crisis.nl serves as the online equivalent, and that the back-up is partly realised with the cause of the failed generator at the data centre under investigation.
Yes, I have asked the NPO about this.
Ja, ik heb dit bij de NPO nagevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over afspraken tussen FOX en NOS

MP Verhoeven asks the state secretary about the NOS-EMM deal giving Fox free spots, possible Mediawet violations, NPO knowledge of the deal, responsibility, and Ster revenue impact. The secretary answers that the Commissariaat voor de Media is investigating and extending its inquiry, that the NPO was informed at mandate level, that the NOS is responsible for its contracts, and that confidentiality limits disclosure of figures and contract terms.

On 19 January 2015 the Commissariaat voor de Media announced that it is continuing and widening its investigation into the purchase of the Eredivisie summary rights to other parties, including the Ster.

Het Commissariaat heeft op 19 januari 2015 aangekondigd dat het zijn onderzoek naar de aankoop van de rechten op de Eredivisiesamenvattingen vervolgt en verbreedt naar andere partijen, waaronder de Ster.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de website van de Rijksoverheid plat lag door een DDoS-aanval

An MP from D66 asked about a DDoS attack that took the central government website offline, the status of 2013 counter-measures, attacker identity, a cybersecurity conference agenda and the lack of an emergency website. The minister confirmed awareness, reported progress on the 2013 measures, said attackers are unknown, a criminal complaint was filed, and promised a supplier improvement plan and a further legislative proposal in 2015.
The Ministry of General Affairs has filed a criminal complaint.
Het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken heeft aangifte gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Verhoeven over het bericht dat Valkenburg de ideale plek is voor een ‘Unmanned Valley’

MPs Van Veldhoven and Verhoeven asked the government about a report proposing Valkenburg airfield as a testing site for unmanned vehicles, and whether the land-use plan for housing, work and recreation is consistent with the government's innovation ambitions. The minister answered that the masterplan allows room for smaller drone testing but not larger drones, that a self-driving car test regulation has been sent to parliament, that the central government re-offered an alternative solution to local parties in January 2015, and declined the request for a one-week answer deadline.
In July 2014 the central government offered the solution direction mentioned in the answer to question 4 to the parties involved.
Het Rijk heeft in juli 2014 de oplossingsrichting, zoals genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 4, aangeboden aan de betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat Facebook korte metten maakt met beschermde foto's

MP Verhoeven asked the State Secretary about reports that Facebook blocked the Reclaim app and imposed new terms on photos and personal data, including whether Dutch users can give informed consent.
