The State Secretary said the app works again, that the CBP's investigation must be awaited before judging Dutch consent and possible measures, and that he will not contact Facebook to interfere with the CBP's approach.
As I already indicated in the answers to earlier parliamentary questions, I will await this investigation.
Zoals ik in de beantwoording op eerdere Kamervragen 2 reeds heb aangegeven, zal ik dit onderzoek afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Schouw, Van Tongeren en Gesthuizen over de onwettigheid van de bewaarplicht van telecomgegevens van burgers

Four MPs asked whether the Dutch data retention law, which the Court of Justice had found incompatible with EU rights, should be suspended, and whether providers could claim damages or be shielded from client claims. The minister replied that the Dutch regime is more detailed than the annulled directive and is compliant, that there is no reason to suspend it, that providers may face damages claims left to the courts, and that no reliable investment estimate exists.
I see no reason to freeze the implementation of the current law until parliament has dealt with the proposed amendment.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de uitvoering van de huidige wet te bevriezen totdat het parlement de voorgestelde wetswijziging heeft behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de G20 landen dicht bij een deal zijn om de ‘Patent Box’ af te schaffen

An MP asked whether G20 countries were close to a deal to abolish patent boxes and whether the Netherlands would replace the Innovatiebox with an investment incentive for startups. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands is involved in OECD talks on a substance criterion but that abolition is not on the table, and the Innovatiebox will be kept.
The Innovatiebox is not being abolished.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de geheime malware die aangetroffen is binnen de systemen van de Europese Unie en bedrijven in Europese lidstaten

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the ministers whether the government knew of the Regin malware reportedly found in EU and Belgian systems, whether Dutch systems are safe and whether the US or UK were involved. Minister Plasterk said the AIVD found no direct Dutch targeting in 2013, gave no guarantees against foreign malware, declined to confirm details publicly, and pointed to general cyber security initiatives and EU cooperation.
No public statements can be made about that.
Daarover kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over problemen met ontvangst van Omroep Zeeland via Digitenne

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about poor reception of regional broadcaster Omroep Zeeland via Digitenne and what the government would do about it. The state secretary answered that the public broadcaster meets its licence conditions of at least rooftop reception, that improvement is for Digitenne and NPO to pursue, and that alternatives such as cable, DSL, fibre and streaming exist, leaving the assessment of their adequacy to Omroep Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat NPO televisietoestellen gaat afluisteren

An MP asked whether the NPO app's new feature, which recognises audio watermarks to synchronise second-screen content and enrich commercials, breaches privacy and fits the public broadcaster's remit. The State Secretary answered that the feature is consent-based, user-switchable, does not store viewing data, fits the NPO's innovation mandate, and cost EUR 20,000 in development plus EUR 110,000 in annual licence fees.
I do not share the view that this feature infringes people's privacy at the NPO.
Ik deel de mening niet dat er met deze functie door de NPO inbreuk gemaakt wordt op de privacy van mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de controle op Europese subsidies

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Interior about the burden of controls on EU subsidies, the risk of double enforcement, reclaiming of EU funds, and the trust principle. Minister Kamp answered that the Commission's rules differ from Dutch principles, that the government is working to balance controls and promote risk-based audits, and that it will prepare a new bill replacing the state-aid recovery bill.
To safeguard the lawfulness of expenditure, I am of the view that there must be a good balance between the control efforts of national and European control bodies and their efficiency.

Om de rechtmatigheid van de uitgaven te borgen ben ik van mening dat er sprake moet zijn van een goede balans tussen de controle-inspanningen door de nationale en Europese controle-instanties en de doelmatigheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat het CBP pleit voor het inhoudelijk analyseren van dataverkeer

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the data protection authority (CBP) advocated content analysis of traffic such as Deep Packet Inspection, and whether this fits privacy protection. The minister answered that the CBP only stated legal limits on retention, that analysis without prior consent may breach privacy, that subscribers may consent to analysis, and that existing apps offer alternatives, so no research into alternatives is needed.
Yes, analysing traffic data (for example via DPI) can lead to a breach of privacy, namely where no prior consent has been obtained for the analysis.
Ja, het analyseren van verkeersgegevens (bijvoorbeeld via DPI) kan leiden tot schending van privacy, namelijk in het geval er geen voorafgaande toestemming is verkregen voor het analyseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Verhoeven over het hacken van servers door de politie terwijl de zogenaamde ‘hackwet’ nog niet door de Kamer is behandeld

Members Berndsen-Jansen and Verhoeven asked whether police hacking of servers in the Blackshades investigation has a legal basis while the 'hackwet' bill is pending. The Minister answered that the police acted under article 125i of the Criminal Procedure Code with prior authorisation from an examining judge, in only two exceptional cases, and that the Computercriminaliteit III bill will be submitted early next year.
Under certain circumstances it is possible, on the basis of article 125i of the Code of Criminal Procedure with authorisation from the examining judge, to enter a computer system remotely.
Het is onder bepaalde omstandigheden op basis van artikel 125i van het Wetboek van Strafvordering met een machtiging van de rechter-commissaris mogelijk om op afstand een computersysteem te betreden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de voorgenomen fusie van ANP en Novum

MP Verhoeven asked whether the planned takeover of news agency Novum by ANP risks a monopoly, how the minister views it given earlier competition-authority precedent, and whether the ACM will be asked to investigate. The minister declined to judge individual cases, said the deal falls below the merger notification thresholds so no ACM merger review is expected, but noted the ACM could still act against cartels or abuse of dominance.
That ruling is known to me.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het gebruik van cookies op de websites van de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep (NPO)

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether public broadcaster NPO violates privacy law by placing tracking cookies without prior consent, as the Dutch data protection authority CBP found, and how this relates to a bill amending the Telecommunications Act. The minister said supervision of the Data Protection Act is for the independent CBP, and explained that the cookie presumption in the bill is sharpened so that cookies used only for analytics or without profiling are excluded.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether, in a specific case, personal data is processed in breach of the Data Protection Act.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of in een concreet geval sprake is van een verwerking van persoonsgegevens in strijd met de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de veranderde taakopvatting van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Statistics Netherlands (CBS) director-general's stated shift toward providing more contextual information and preventing misuse of data, and whether this is politically neutral and was agreed with the minister. The minister answered that the approach aims to reduce misinterpretation, that the choice of publication method lies with the director-general under the CBS Act, and defended the neutrality of a rent-increase press headline.
No, the manner of publishing statistics, as well as the choice of methodology, is reserved for the director-general of statistics.
Nee, de wijze van het openbaar maken van statistieken is, evenals de keuze van de gebruikte methodologie, voorbehouden aan de directeur-generaal van de statistiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat hackers 1,2 miljard inloggegevens en 500 miljoen e-mailadressen hebben gestolen

MPs Verhoeven and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that hackers stole 1.2 billion login credentials and 500 million email addresses, and whether Dutch organisations were affected and how this relates to the data breach notification bill. The minister could neither confirm nor deny the claim, said the NCSC had alerted its government and critical-sector audience and is seeking information from Hold Security, and explained that breaches like this would generally need to be reported under the proposed duty.
This claim I can neither confirm nor deny.
Deze claim kan ik bevestigen noch ontkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van der Linde, Verhoeven, De Rouwe en Baay-Timmerman over gouden handdrukken bij woningcorporatie Rochdale

MPs asked the Minister for Housing about severance payments of about 4.5 million euros at housing corporation Rochdale, including whether tenants were effectively paying for them and whether the sums could be reclaimed. The Minister answered that the payments were made under a social plan to five non-top employees, that no legal framework was breached, that no recovery is possible, and promised to look into comparable rules in Germany and Denmark later.
That possibility does not exist, because there is no question of excessive severance payments in relation to the Normalisation of Top Incomes Act or the Housing Act.
Die mogelijkheid is er niet, omdat er geen sprake is van te hoge ontslagvergoedingen in relatie tot de Wet Normering Topinkomens of de Woningwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de trage beantwoording van digitaal verstuurde vragen en klachten door gemeenten

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the Minister of Interior about slow responses by municipalities to emails and contact-form questions, as reported by the Consumentenbond. The Minister says he relies on ombudsman signals, points to service standards and the VNG quality charter, and states that digital-only service is a goal under the Digitaal 2017 programme, while the National Commissioner for Digital Government will not cover email responses.
I interpret the signals as an incentive to further develop and fill in the Digitaal 2017 programme with extra energy and attention to quality.
Ik vat de signalen op als een aansporing om met extra energie en aandacht voor kwaliteit het programma Digitaal 2017 verder uit te werken en in te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “Rammelend systeem huurcommissie leidt tot onzekerheid over huurprijs”

An MP asks the minister why the Huurcommissie's online rent-check tool produced errors, since when the minister knew, and what harm was done to tenants and foreign investors. The minister replies that the tool is only an informational aid, that errors are acknowledged as inherent to simplification, that the tool is being rebuilt with tenant and landlord representatives, and that the old tool has been removed.
I had myself informed and then learned that the Huurcommissie had already started renewing the rent-check tools.
Ik heb mij daarop laten informeren en vernam toen dat de huurcommissie reeds was gestart met het vernieuwen van de huurprijschecks.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Veldhoven naar aanleiding van het bericht van 28 april 2014 dat de alternatieve taxidienst Uber wordt verboden in Brussel en Berlijn

MPs Verhoeven and Van Veldhoven asked whether Dutch law accommodates innovative platforms such as Uber and Airbnb, after bans in Brussels and Berlin. The minister answered that existing taxi rules pose no obstacles to intermediaries like Uber, that the taxi part of the Passenger Transport Act will be evaluated in autumn 2014, and that the German and Belgian rulings do not affect EU internal market policy.
In autumn 2014 the taxi part of the Passenger Transport Act 2000 will be evaluated.
In het najaar van 2014 wordt het taxideel van de Wet personenvervoer 2000 geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over het bericht ‘Google gaat gebruikers volgen naar de echte winkel’

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the ministers about reports that Google would link online browsing to offline store purchases, including whether it happens in the Netherlands, how it fits Dutch cookie and data protection law, and whether extra safeguards are needed. The minister answered that the test is only in the United States, that cookies require informed consent under the Telecommunications Act and the Data Protection Act, and that a broader big-data letter and the forthcoming EU regulation will address the issue.
The cabinet does not have sufficient information to assess whether this representation of events is correct.
Het kabinet beschikt over onvoldoende informatie om te beoordelen of deze voorstelling van zaken correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het bericht “ING geeft adverteerder inzicht in klantgedrag”

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven (D66) asked the government about reports that ING wanted to commercialise customers' payment data, and whether this is lawful under the Dutch data protection act and the sector code. The State Secretary answered that such use for third-party marketing is not explicitly covered by the code, that consent must be free, specific and informed, and that the Cbp and supervisors are critical, while leaving the question of ING's plans to ING and the supervisors.
A careless approach and poor communication could damage consumer trust in the banking sector.
Een onzorgvuldige aanpak en slechte communicatie kan het vertrouwen van de consument in de bancaire sector schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Verhoeven en Hachchi over drones die huizen fotograferen

MPs from D66 asked whether the commercial drone firm Billionhomes may photograph homes from the air and publish them without owners' consent, and how privacy is protected under the Wbp and drone permit rules. The Minister answered that the Wbp applies only where data are traceable to persons, that the ILT has received no permit application from Billionhomes, that privacy is not part of the aviation-safety permit assessment, and that a WODC study on privacy and drones is under way.

I have recently informed your House about a study that the WODC is carrying out at the cabinet's request into various questions surrounding unmanned aircraft (UAS), with particular attention to the possible negative effects of their use on privacy and how that privacy can be safeguarded most effectively.

Ik heb uw Kamer recent geïnformeerd over een onderzoek dat het WODC op verzoek van het kabinet uitvoert naar diverse vragen rondom onbemande luchtvaartuigen (UAS), met daarbij bijzondere aandacht voor de mogelijk negatieve effecten van het gebruik van onbemande luchtvaartuigen op de privacy
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “NPO vanaf dinsdag ‘uitgekleed’ in Belgische tijdschriften”

An MP asked the State Secretaries about a reported sharp rise in the fees Belgian magazines must pay the NPO for Dutch broadcast programme data, and whether this matches the intent of the Mediawet. The government answered that the statutory tariffs were never meant to apply to foreign users, that this will be clarified in the next amendment to the Mediawet, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media will report before the summer recess.
Because this currently does not sufficiently appear from the Mediawet 2008, this will be corrected in the next bill amending the Mediawet 2008.
Omdat dit momenteel onvoldoende uit de Mediawet 2008 blijkt, zal dit worden hersteld in het eerstvolgende wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Mediawet 2008.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de Minister-President en de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanbesteding Fotografie Beeldcentrum Overheid (ingezonden 7 februari 2014).

An MP asks the Prime Minister about the EU tender for government photography (Fotografie Beeldcentrum Rijksoverheid), including criticism from the sector, the transfer of copyright, pay levels, quality, and photographers' liability for portrait rights. The government answers that the tender followed the rules and the standard government terms (ARVODI), that pay was set by market research, that copyright transfer is intended for government communication, and that portrait consent forms are required.
In preparing the tender, use was made of the knowledge and experience of all the departments involved.
Bij de voorbereiding van de aanbesteding is gebruik gemaakt van de kennis en ervaring van alle betrokken departementen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over het bericht dat onder dreiging van een rechtszaak de minister en Coolcat een gezamenlijke verklaring hebben opgesteld over de inspanningen van Coolcat in textie

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked whether the minister knew of CoolCat's threatened lawsuit over her remarks on Bangladesh textile factories, whether the joint press release was a settlement, and why she named CoolCat in an interview. The minister confirmed the lawsuit was withdrawn after a joint statement, denied speaking of a blacklist or linking CoolCat to child labour, and said her remarks concerned signing the safety accord.
In the future too I will continue this dialogue, about the need to improve working conditions in the textile sector.
Ook in de toekomst zal ik deze dialoog, over de noodzaak om arbeidsomstandigheden in de textielsector te verbeteren, blijven voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat NPO met een eigen betaaldienst komt

MP Verhoeven (D66) asked the state secretary about the NPO's plan for a paid on-demand service (NPO Plus) that would place publicly funded productions behind a paywall, and whether it distorts the market and what conditions apply. The secretary answered that the service is a financing and rights matter, that free Uitzending Gemist will remain, that the service is part of a joint platform with commercial broadcasters, and that a pilot with a formal approval procedure with public consultation and appeal rights will precede any permanent approval.
I believe the public broadcaster can and should move into the digital domain precisely to bind the audience.
Ik vind dat de publieke omroep zich in het digitale domein kan en moet begeven, juist om het publiek te binden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de financiële problemen van lokale omroepen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about financial problems at local broadcasters, including municipal underfunding below the guideline amount, falling advertising revenue, and possible spillover into regional and national media. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for funding, that the national government sets only framework conditions, and that professionalisation and cooperation are being pursued through the OLON and an additional 287,000 euro grant, while declining to expand the future media review or revisit the regional broadcasting cut.
Responsibility for the funding lies with the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de financiering ligt bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de signalen dat de Amerikaanse NSA ook topmensen uit het bedrijfsleven afluistert

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether the US NSA also spies on Dutch business leaders and Dutch companies for economic purposes, and what the risks and government response would be. Minister Plasterk answered that intercepting metadata for counterterrorism is acceptable within legal limits, that the AIVD cannot publicly discuss its methods or examples of corporate espionage, and that the government will send a signal to the US, referring to a letter of 28 October 2013.
No public statements can be made about the working methods and knowledge level of the AIVD, including examples of corporate espionage.
In het openbaar kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de werkwijze en het kennisniveau van AIVD, inclusief voorbeelden van bedrijfsspionage.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het kopiëren van identiteitsbewijzen door telecombedrijven

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister whether telecom companies copy customers' identity documents when signing up, whether this breaches the CBP privacy guidelines, and whether the government will act. The minister answered that partly masked scans are standard practice to prevent fraud, that enforcement is for the independent privacy regulator CBP, and that the government will not itself pressure telecom providers.
It is not for me to call telecom providers to account for the way they implement privacy legislation.
Het is niet aan mij om de telecomaanbieders aan te spreken op de manier waarop uitvoering wordt gegeven aan de privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse National Security Agency (NSA) via telecomaanbieders het internationaal telefoonverkeer afluistert

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the government about reports that the US NSA was intercepting international telephone traffic via Belgian provider Belgacom, and whether Dutch telecom providers had been similarly breached or approached. The minister said there is no indication of a comparable breach in the Netherlands, that providers are responsible for their own security under the Telecommunicatiewet, that the government does not know whether foreign services approached Dutch providers, and that EU-US expert group work and the JBZ-Raad addressed the issue.
No public statements are made about contacts between the Dutch intelligence and security services and foreign services.
Over contacten tussen de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten en buitenlandse diensten worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de brandweer zorgen heeft over de borging van brandveiligheid in het omgevingsrecht

An MP asks the government whether fire-safety responsibilities of municipalities and safety regions will be safeguarded under the planned Omgevingswet and private quality assurance in construction, given fire service concerns. The minister replies that municipal fire-service responsibility is unchanged, private quality assurance will keep the Bouwbesluit 2012 as the test framework, and further details will follow in a letter this autumn.

The Omgevingswet proposal, however, contains no such changes and does not alter the principle that the tasks and powers for the physical living environment that government must address lie primarily with the municipalities.

Het voorstel Omgevingswet bevat dergelijke wijzigingen echter niet en brengt geen wijzigingen aan in het beginsel dat de taken en bevoegdheden voor de fysieke leefomgeving die de overheid moet behartigen in de eerste plaats bij de gemeenten liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de Big Brother Awards

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the Big Brother Awards, including the Tax Authority's expert prize and the Justice Minister's public prize for privacy-infringing policy. The minister answered that no jury report exists, defended the Tax Authority's use of police camera data and bulk requests to parking authorities as proportionate, rejected the suggestion that he ignores privacy, and promised a general letter on privacy and security later that autumn.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice and I will send your House a more general letter on the balance between privacy and security later this autumn.
De staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en ik zullen uw Kamer nog dit najaar een meer algemene brief sturen over de balans tussen privacy en veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over persoonsgegevens bij digitale televisie en Netflix

An MP asked the state secretaries about personal data handling by Netflix and digital TV providers, including whether Dutch privacy law applies to Netflix operating from Luxembourg and whether viewing data can reveal sensitive information. The government answered that the Dutch Wbp does not apply to Netflix, which falls under Luxembourg law implementing the same EU directive, and described Ziggo's opt-in rules for sharing viewing data.
The Wbp does not apply because Netflix has no establishment in the Netherlands.
De Wbp is niet van toepassing aangezien Netflix geen vestiging in Nederland heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Veldhoven over de uitvoering van de subsidieregeling voor zonnepanelen

MPs Verhoeven and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the solar panel subsidy scheme: whether subsidies can be obtained without proof of payment, whether checks are only sampled under the high-trust approach, how many applicants were checked, whether other schemes are run the same way, how the money will be evaluated, and what the scheme means for employment after the China import dispute. The minister replied that a signed purchase agreement is required, that 224 sampled applications were checked with no undue payments found, that the scheme will not be evaluated, and that the employment outlook is uncertain.
That is why it was decided not to request proof of payment at the time of the subsidy application.
Daarom is er voor gekozen om op het moment van de subsidieaanvraag geen betalingsbewijs te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat ondernemers in de problemen komen door rentederivaten

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that SMEs face problems from interest rate derivatives, including the scale of the problem, litigation, the AFM investigation, comparison with housing corporations, mis-selling and the duty of care. The minister answered that no data on numbers or amounts is available yet, that the AFM investigation results come in September, and that further steps will wait for those results.
At this moment I have no additional information on how many entrepreneurs are struggling with problematic (interest rate) derivatives or what total amount is involved.
Op dit moment heb ik geen aanvullende informatie over hoeveel ondernemers kampen met problematische (rente)derivaten of om welk totaalbedrag het zou gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Voortman over nieuwe fraudemogelijkheden met DigiD en gebrekkige dienstverlening van DigiD bij incidenten

MPs Verhoeven and Voortman asked the Interior Minister about DigiD fraud, where intercepted activation codes let perpetrators hijack accounts and obtain benefits, and about DigiD's handling of victims. The minister replied that misuse requires intercepting the postal code, that accounts are blocked on suspicion of fraud, that 118 fraudulent cases were found, and that a future eID issued in person is planned.
An investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into the use of the unlawfully obtained DigiDs is currently ongoing.
Op dit moment loopt een onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar het gebruik van de onrechtmatig verkregen DigiD's.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de DigiNotar-affaire op basis van WOB-stukken

An MP asked the government twelve questions about how operational management of DigiNotar was taken over after its 2011 certificate breach, including the legal basis, the scope of the power of attorney and the user lists. The minister answered that only operational management was taken over under a power of attorney from VASCO, with no specific statutory basis, and pointed to the Wob decisions for the detailed description.
DigiNotar was not taken over de facto. Only operational management was taken over after good consultation with VASCO.
DigiNotar is niet de facto overgenomen. Alleen het operationeel management is overgenomen na goed overleg met VASCO.
Antwoord op vragen van de Verhoeven over het uitvallen van DigiD vanwege DDoS-aanvallen

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the DDoS attacks that made DigiD hard to reach, including the attack's modest scale, the comparison with the DigiNotar incident, and single points of failure. The minister answered that DigiD was never fully offline, that no hacks occurred, that the eID design will avoid single points of failure, and that Logius strengthened measures with NCSC support.
Given the economic and social importance of DigiD, Logius has taken additional and tightened measures following the attacks to continue monitoring and securing DigiD's continuity and availability.

Gelet op het economisch en maatschappelijk belang van DigiD heeft Logius naar aanleiding van de aanvallen additionele en verscherpte maatregelen getroffen om de continuïteit en beschikbaarheid van DigiD, te kunnen blijven bewaken en te borgen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de privacyvoorwaarden bij apps en ander mobiel telefoongebruik

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the ministers about app privacy terms, Apple's user terms, and whether mobile location data can be traced to individuals. Minister Kamp answered that privacy law requires clear, readable terms and informed consent, that the matter of specific producer-consumer relations is not for him to judge, and that consumers can complain to the Autoriteit Consument & Markt and the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens.
It is not for me to pass judgment on how that relationship is shaped.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel uit te spreken over de invulling van die relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de marktverstorende overheid en herintredende overheidsdiensten

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked why the government takes back in-house activities it had outsourced, whether this distorts markets under the Wet markt en overheid, and how it squares with the compact civil service goal. The minister answered that the state may freely choose between outsourcing and in-house work, that in-house activities fall outside the market-conduct law, and that employment considerations will be presented in May.
I consider it desirable that government service providers assess per activity whether it is sensible to put an assignment on the market or to carry out the activity themselves.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat overheidsdiensten per activiteit beoordelen of het verstandig is om een opdracht in de markt te zetten of om de betreffende activiteit zelf uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Ulenbelt over de verhoogde verplichte heffing van het af te schaffen van het Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel (HBD)

MPs Verhoeven and Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he knows the Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel raised its compulsory levy from €79 to €110, whether this rise is unwelcome, and whether a levy could still be imposed in 2014. The minister confirmed the increase, explained it as covering the wind-down costs and higher purchasing costs, and said levies may still be imposed until the bodies are formally abolished, while promising to inform parliament this spring.
I will, as promised during the budget debate of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, inform your House this spring about the process to abolish the product and industry boards.

Ik zal uw Kamer, zoals toegezegd tijdens de behandeling van de begroting van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, dit voorjaar informeren over het traject tot opheffing van de product- en bedrijfschappen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten nog meer mogelijkheden heeft om in clouddata graaien

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw (D66) asked whether US law (the FISAA, extended on 30 December 2012) lets US authorities access personal data stored in the EU by US-based cloud providers, and what the consequences and remedies are. The state secretary answered that the Act grants no new powers, that no concrete cases of such demands for EU-stored data are known (US authorities say requests go via mutual legal assistance), and that the government will raise the issue in the EU data protection regulation negotiations.
Negotiations are under way in Brussels on a General Data Protection Regulation.
Er wordt in Brussel onderhandeld over een Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Ulenbelt over aanstaande facturen van de product- en bedrijfschappen

MPs Verhoeven and Ulenbelt asked whether the government knows that product and trade boards are already sending invoices for 2013, when the abolition of the boards will take effect, whether boards should waive levies if they hold reserves, and when the last invoices will be sent. The minister answers that the boards will be abolished as agreed in the coalition agreement, public tasks will move to the ministry from 2014, a legislative process will start, and levies may still be needed until abolition because reserves may not cover long-term obligations.
Until the moment of abolition, the boards constitute administrative bodies with their own board, responsibility and the power to impose levies.
Tot het moment van opheffing vormen de schappen bestuurslichamen met een eigen bestuur, verantwoordelijkheid en de bevoegdheid om heffingen op te leggen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de gegevens waarop de doorrekening van het CPB zijn gebaseerd

An MP asked whether the CPB's costing of the coalition agreement accounted for a 15% fall in house prices and falling WOZ values since 2008, and whether it used the baseline including mandatory annuity mortgage repayment and the phased cut in mortgage interest deduction. The minister answered that the CPB uses a stable growth path from 2005 that roughly matches the CBS house price index, and that the baseline and all housing measures were fully included.
Yes, in the costing of the housing market measures in the coalition agreement, all measures in the owner-occupied and rental markets were fully included.
Ja, in de doorrekening van de woningmarktmaatregelen in het Regeerakkoord zijn alle maatregelen op de koop- en huurmarkt integraal doorgerekend.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven over het gebruik van cookies op de websites van de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep

An MP asked whether the public broadcaster NPO may block users who refuse tracking cookies and whether it should offer an analytics-only cookie option. The state secretary answered that NPO uses only analytics cookies itself, that the Ster's advertising and social media cookies are placed by third parties, that the NPO must comply with the Telecommunications Act, and declined to require an analytics-only option or talks with NPO.
No, I believe the NPO must comply with the law and properly inform users about the use of cookies.
Nee, ik vind dat de NPO zich aan de wet moet houden en de gebruikers goed moet informeren over het gebruik van cookies.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven en Schouw over de privacy van internetters

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether personal data of a 16-year-old was handed to the state by Skype without a valid request, and how many such cases occur per year. The minister explains that police may not request voluntary data disclosure, that spontaneous third-party disclosures are permitted with a proces-verbaal, and that no statistics on such cases are kept.
The Public Prosecution Service does not keep statistics on the number of cases in which personal data was spontaneously provided to investigators.
Het Openbaar Ministerie houdt geen statistieken bij over het aantal gevallen waarin spontaan persoonsgegevens aan de opsporing zijn verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Filmlaboratorium Cineco failliet’

MPs Bergkamp and Verhoeven asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Finance about the bankruptcy of film laboratory Cineco, including its causes, consequences for the Dutch film industry, and whether a tax shelter is needed for a level playing field in Europe. The minister answered that the consequences are hard to judge yet, that the industry itself must look at preserving Cineco's expertise, and that it cannot yet be determined whether the lack of a tax shelter was decisive, while creating new fiscal facilities for specific sectors conflicts with simplifying the tax system.
It is up to the industry itself to examine whether there are possibilities to preserve Cineco's knowledge and expertise in the Netherlands.
Het is aan de bedrijfstak zelf om te bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om de kennis en kunde van Cineco in Nederland te behouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “Oprichting sloopfonds kantoren loopt spaak” en “Huurder kantoor is lachende derde”

An MP asks the minister about reports that municipalities oppose a demolition fund for vacant offices and fear subsidies keep office prices high, and asks how the convenant on vacant offices survives without municipal approval. The minister says the fund is optional, will not talk with municipalities that have already refused, keeps talks open with others, and says all parties must take responsibility, with progress reviewed in early 2013.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven over de groeiende verschillen in de kredietverlening tussen grootbedrijf en midden- en kleinbedrijf (MKB)

An MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs about the growing interest-rate gap between large firms and SMEs and what the government will do to support SME credit and innovation financing. The minister replies that credit has broadly held up, attributes the gap to market risk factors and supervisory rules, and points to existing schemes such as the BMKB and the Innovatiefonds MKB+ while promising a new financing monitor.
At the end of this year I will send you a new financing monitor, which will further shed light on developments in credit provision to businesses.
Eind van dit jaar zal ik u een nieuwe financieringsmonitor aanbieden, welke verder licht zal werpen op de ontwikkelingen omtrent kredietverlening aan het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de NS die in een brief aan haar leveranciers te kennen heeft gegeven dat ze 3 maanden moeten gaan wachten op hun geld

An MP asks the ministers whether NS, the state-owned railway company, may impose 90-day payment terms with a 4% discount on its suppliers, and how SMEs can resist and what the government will do. The ministers reply that NS withdrew the letter and keeps the 30-day norm, that the state as shareholder will not intervene, and that the late-payment directive does not apply to NS but 30 days remains the norm.
NS has now withdrawn this letter.
NS heeft deze brief inmiddels ingetrokken
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven over de vertraging ten aanzien van de start Fyra-verbinding Antwerpen – Breda

An MP from D66 asks the Minister why the Fyra high-speed service between Breda and Antwerp is delayed again, why contact with Belgian minister Magnette has been slow, and what the consequences are for the Beneluxtrein and finances. The Minister answers that the start depends on a financing agreement on the Belgian side, that talks with Magnette were only recently scheduled, that the Beneluxtrein will be replaced, and gives no expected start date.
This consultation has now been scheduled.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen en Verhoeven over de onveilige wegen op Goeree-Overflakkee

D66 MPs Berndsen and Verhoeven asked the minister about road safety on Goeree-Overflakkee, including the absence of lighting and crash barriers, fragmented responsibility among several authorities, and the quality of accident data. The minister replied that the Rijk roads follow the Handboek Wegontwerp, that the province is coordinating road safety, that accident risk there is average, and that planned upgrades on the N57 will finish by end 2013.
I do not recognise the picture that on Goeree-Overflakkee there is slow implementation of consistent and safe infrastructure as a result of divided responsibilities.
Ik herken het beeld dan ook niet dat er op Goeree-Overflakkee sprake is van een trage implementatie van een consistente en veilige infrastructuur als gevolg van verdeelde verantwoordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de OPTA-kritiek op netneutraliteit in Nederland

An MP asked the minister whether he had seen OPTA's criticism of Dutch net neutrality law and whether his views had changed. The minister said his view is unchanged, defended the statutory net neutrality rule as a safeguard against market incentives, and said OPTA will enforce it.
My view has not changed. I continue to stand behind the Dutch regulation on net neutrality.
Mijn mening is niet gewijzigd. Ik blijf achter de Nederlandse regelgeving over netneutraliteit staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de plannen van Europese telco’s om de netneutraliteit te schaden

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch government would oppose an ETNO proposal to introduce sending-party-pays interconnection charges for internet data, which would threaten net neutrality. The minister said the proposal is preliminary and raises concerns about barriers to services and monopoly-like bottleneck pricing, will discuss it within the EU, and firmly distances the government from it.
Based on my current understanding of what the ETNO proposal entails, I firmly distance myself from it.
Op basis van mijn huidig beeld wat het voorstel van ETNO inhoudt, neem ik daar krachtig afstand van.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over verkoop van goederen via een webwinkel op een perceel met bestemming "bedrijfslocatie"

An MP asks ministers whether municipal zoning rules that treat webshops like physical retail, and a court ruling allowing municipalities to exclude webshops from certain zones, create uncertainty and economic harm, and whether national rules should be updated. The state secretary answers that there is no national rule on webshop locations, that zoning is a municipal and provincial matter, and that no national steps are planned.
I therefore see no reason to take further steps at national level here.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om van rijkswege hier nadere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het onvoldoende versleuteld opslaan van wachtwoorden

An MP asked the minister for Economic Affairs about the LinkedIn password breach, its responsibility, whether specific rules for password storage exist, and whether talks with large companies are possible. The minister said LinkedIn bears primary responsibility, that the government will not take over that responsibility, that no specific password storage rules exist under the data protection law, and that the issue will be revisited under a parliamentary motion and awareness campaigns will be updated.
Given the question about the responsibility of business, I expect my successor in the next cabinet to address this issue further as part of implementing the Gesthuizen/Verhoeven motion.

Mede gezien de vraagstelling over de verantwoordelijkheid van het bedrijfsleven, verwacht ik dat mijn opvolger in het volgende kabinet nader op deze problematiek zal ingaan als onderdeel van de uitvoering van de motie Gesthuizen/Verhoeven.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Verhoeven over de oproep van de NMa aan ziekenhuizen om grote inkoopcombinaties te vormen

MPs Gesthuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the NMa's call on hospitals to form large purchasing alliances conflicts with their amendment against unnecessary clustering of public tenders, and whether the advice is one-sided. The minister replied that the NMa's recommendation does not require merging tenders, is not in conflict with the amendment or current procurement rules for academic hospitals, and has not created confusion, so no action against the NMA is planned.

I am of the view that the NMa's call for more purchasing alliances does not conflict with the amendment Verhoeven/Gesthuizen, adopted by the House of Representatives, on unnecessary clustering of public contracts.

Ik ben van mening dat de oproep van de NMa om meer inkoopcombinaties te vormen niet haaks staat op het onlangs door de Tweede Kamer aangenomen amendement Verhoeven/Gesthuizen over het onnodig clusteren van overheidsopdrachten.

An MP asked the minister whether Chamber of Commerce (KvK) sales of business address data exposing self-employed people's home addresses are lawful, and whether an opt-in should be introduced. The minister answered that home addresses are not sold as such, that business addresses are public for legal certainty, that the Non Mailing Indicator is being expanded, and that the new Ondernemerspleinen will not displace private activity.
It may however be that the business address of the company coincides with the home address of the entrepreneur.
Wel kan het zijn dat het zakelijk adres van de onderneming samenvalt met het woonadres van de ondernemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake de ondernemer Roel Bakker

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he failed to answer calls from entrepreneur Roel Bakker after promising to be reachable, and whether his ministry is unreachable for entrepreneurs. The Prime Minister confirmed giving his number, denied missing calls, said the issue was resolved and a follow-up call was missed, and denied the ministry is unreachable.
No. I have learned from Mr Bakker that he did make a call attempt, but when he got no voicemail he subsequently discarded the number.
Nee. Ik heb van dhr. Bakker vernomen dat hij wel een belpoging heeft gedaan, maar toen hij geen voicemail kreeg het nummer vervolgens heeft weggegooid.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven en Schouw over het opslaan van adresbestanden door Twitter

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether Twitter's storage of users' full address books breaches privacy and the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary said the assessment and any enforcement belong to the independent CBP and OPTA, which do not comment on ongoing investigations, and the government itself takes no action.
The judgement on whether there is a breach of the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens in this case, and any enforcement measures, is not for me but for the College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).

Het oordeel of er in casu sprake is van een schending van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, en het eventueel inzetten van handhavende maatregelen, is niet aan mij, maar aan het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven over de niet nagekomen belofte over lokale lastenverzwaring

Verhoeven (D66) asks Prime Minister Rutte why local tax burdens for businesses are rising despite the cabinet's earlier promise to prevent disproportionate local levies, and what action the cabinet will take. The government answers that it will send a letter in May after consulting local government bodies, and rejects the claim that the cabinet broke its promise.
As the state secretary of EL&I already committed to your House on 17 January, the cabinet will come with a letter in May addressing the development of local levies.
Zoals de staatssecretaris van EL&I uw Kamer reeds op 17 januari heeft toegezegd, zal het kabinet in mei met een brief komen waarin wordt ingegaan op de ontwikkeling van de lokale lasten.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen bittorrent-verkeer blokkeert

MP Verhoeven (D66) asked whether the University of Groningen's computing centre, by blocking BitTorrent traffic for students without a court order, acts as an internet access provider bound by the proposed Telecommunications Act article 7.4a and whether such blocking and disconnection of students at rightsholders' request is acceptable. The minister answered that the RUG appears to be an internet access provider under the proposed article 7.4a, that blocking is only allowed in limited exceptions such as a court order, that he knows of no concrete cases of students being disconnected at rightsholders' request, and that the proposed article 7.6a limits disconnection to non-payment, bankruptcy and fraud.
This means that if the new article 7.4a takes effect, the RUG may not hinder or block services or applications when providing internet access to its students.
Dit betekent dat als het nieuwe artikel 7.4a van kracht wordt, de RUG bij het bieden van internettoegang aan haar studenten geen diensten of toepassingen mag belemmeren of blokkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de privacyvoorwaarden van Google

An MP asked the government about Google's revised privacy terms, including whether combining user data across products requires opt-in consent and whether Google's market power leaves users without alternatives. The minister deferred conclusions to the European data protection authorities, explained the legal framework under the Wbp, and said alternatives exist and competition law applies.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the steps taken by the European supervisory authorities before I can inform you about the consequences of Google's new privacy terms.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van de stappen van de Europese toezichthouders af alvorens ik u kan informeren over de gevolgen van de nieuwe privacyvoorwaarden van Google.
Antwoord vragen Koolmees en Verhoeven over het voorstel tot een ‘Slim Reisbudget’ vanuit 50 grote werkgevers

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the B50 proposals for a 'Smart Travel Budget' (Persoonlijk Mobiliteitsbudget and Bonus Malus Leasebudget), including whether the government would assess them, how they relate to the Autobrief tax study, and the expected effects on traffic and emissions. The State Secretary responded positively in principle, promised to test budget neutrality and administrative costs and to report on the proposals before the summer recess, while stating that effects depend on how employers and employees implement them.
I previously committed to sending the results of that study to your House before the summer recess.
Ik heb eerder toegezegd de resultaten van dat onderzoek voor het zomerreces aan uw Kamer te zullen toezenden.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed, Verhoeven, Voordewind, Eijsink, Jasper van Dijk en Koppejan over het schip de Chariot dat naar verluidt munitie vervoerde met bestemming Syrië

MPs from six parties asked the foreign minister whether Cyprus, Russia and EU partners would be pressed over the ship Chariot, reportedly carrying munitions to Syria in breach of the EU arms embargo, and whether prosecution or Europol/Interpol involvement was possible. The minister confirmed the transit violates the embargo, said Nederland raised it with Cyprus in the EU, would press Russia through the EU, and said primary responsibility for action lies with the flag state and Cyprus.
Primarily it is up to the flag state (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) or the port state (Cyprus) to take action where possible.
Het is primair aan de vlaggenstaat (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) of de havenstaat (Cyprus) om waar mogelijk actie te ondernemen.

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een vermeend programma geïnstalleerd op smartphones dat de gebruiksgegevens van telefoongebruiker (ingezonden 7 decembe

MP Verhoeven asked the minister whether the Carrier IQ software reported on smartphones violates Dutch privacy law, whether its presence on any phone in the Netherlands can be excluded, and whether an investigation will follow. The minister answered by referring to earlier answers given to MP Gesthuizen without addressing the questions on substance.
To answer your questions 2 and 3, I refer to my answers to the parliamentary questions from MP Gesthuizen.
Voor de beantwoording van uw vragen 2 en 3 verwijs ik naar mijn antwoorden op de kamervragen van het lid Gesthuizen
Vragen van de leden Monasch (PvdA) en Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over constructiefouten in de bouw (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

MPs Monasch and Verhoeven asked the Minister of Interior about reports of thousands of construction defects, the safety risks, the estimated 20,000 yearly defects, and their causes and costs. The minister answered that most reported defects cause only economic damage, that the estimate was a rough illustration without verified basis, and that monitoring is primarily the sector's responsibility, with no separate study of costs planned.
I currently see no need to conduct additional research into the causes, consequences and societal costs of structural defects.
Ik zie op dit moment geen noodzaak om in aanvulling hierop onderzoek te doen naar de oorzaken, gevolgen en maatschappelijke kosten van constructieve fouten.

Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het ontbieden van de nuntius van de Heilige Stoel om een reactie te verkrijgen op het rapport-Deetman (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the nuncio of the Holy See should be summoned to react to the Deetman report on sexual abuse, and whether the Pope's reaction should inform policy. The government answered on dual-use export controls, internet freedom and corporate human rights responsibility, without addressing the nuncio request.
Furthermore, the Netherlands also works through forums to encourage companies to take responsibility for respecting human rights online.
Daarnaast zet Nederland zich er ook via fora voor in om bedrijven te stimuleren hun verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor respect voor mensenrechten online.

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat Innovatie van oude instituties moet komen en wat dit voor ondernemers betekent (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether the proposal to give more room to the bedrijfschappen (industry boards) fits the cabinet's plan to slim them down, and what this means for entrepreneurs' levies and innovation tasks. The minister answered that such tasks are only allowed as exceptional additional tasks under strict conditions, that the levies will fall substantially, and that the revised law is planned for 2013.
It cannot be foreseen which tasks would still be carried out if the levies were made voluntary.
Het is niet te voorzien welke taken nog zouden worden uitgevoerd als de heffingen vrijwillig worden gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over vermeende privacy-schendingen met cookies door Facebook (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

Deputy Verhoeven asked the minister whether Facebook's irremovable cookies collecting privacy-sensitive data breach the Dutch Personal Data Protection Act, and how this relates to the cookie amendment to the Telecommunications Act and the minister's earlier stance favouring self-regulation. The minister answered that the Wbp requires unambiguous consent that can be withdrawn, that assessing compliance is for the Cbp, that OPTA will supervise article 11.7a Tw once in force, and that he opposed the original amendment's stricter wording but never argued for self-regulation replacing legislation.
Whether in the situation described personal data was processed, and whether the Wbp was then complied with, is not for me to assess.
Of in de beschreven situatie sprake was van verwerking van persoonsgegevens, en of in dat geval voldaan is aan de Wbp, is niet aan mij om te beoordelen.
Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw (beiden D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over bedrijven die de privacy schenden (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the state secretary about reports that companies ignore data access (inzage) requests under privacy law, and what the government and the CBP will do about it, including fines and mediation powers. The state secretary said he could not confirm widespread non-compliance, that the CBP chooses its enforcement priorities independently, and that the cabinet intends to give the CBP administrative fining powers.

Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Berndsen (beiden D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar de brand bij de radiotoren bij IJsselstein (ingezonden 26 augu

Two D66 MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs why the findings of investigations into the fire at the IJsselstein radio mast remain undisclosed and whether they should be made public immediately. The minister replied that the cause is not yet definitively established, that the investigations are commissioned by the parties and insurers and are still ongoing, and that he will announce findings publicly once available and will address responsibilities for mast safety in a forthcoming review.
I am of the view that once this is the case, the cause of the fire must also be communicated publicly.
Ik ben van mening dat zodra dit wel het geval is, over de oorzaak van de brand ook in de openbaarheid moet worden gecommuniceerd.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya, Schouw en Verhoeven (allen D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Immigratie en Asiel over barrières bij het inhuren van kennismigranten (ingezonden 1 september

Three D66 MPs asked why employer groups complain that importing skilled workers is too hard, and about the market-rate salary test for the highly skilled migrant scheme introduced in June 2011, its basis, past abuse, refusals, and the income thresholds. The minister defended the test as a safety valve used only on suspicion of misuse, said no refusals had yet occurred, explained the income criteria, and agreed to talk with the employer organisations.
This measure was partly introduced because your House, including through a motion by MP Ulenbelt et al., expressed concern about possible misuse of the highly skilled migrant scheme.
Deze maatregel is onder meer tot stand gekomen omdat uw Kamer, onder andere bij motie van het lid Ulenbelt c.s. zijn zorgen heeft geuit over mogelijk misbruik van de kennismigrantenregeling
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de beveiliging van Digi-D en overheidswebsites (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the security of DigiD and government websites after DigiNotar certificates were distrusted by browsers following a hack. The minister confirmed that government sites used DigiNotar certificates, that these are being replaced in a controlled phased migration, that browser warnings and rogue copies are possible during the transition, and that a separate letter will describe events.
The CIOs of central government and decentralised governments have been designated to direct the conversion of the DigiNotar certificates.
De CIO’s (Chief Information Officers) van Rijk en decentrale overheden zijn aangewezen om de omzetting van de certificaten van DigiNotar aan te sturen.

Vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over verschillende stekkers en betaalpasjes voor het laden van elektrische voertuigen (ingezonden 1

Two D66 MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the number of charging plugs, charging systems and payment cards for electric vehicles, and whether these would be standardised. The minister said three plug types currently suffice, that type 2 is the intended standard for public charging, and that EU-level standardisation is targeted for end 2011 via CEN-CENELEC.
At public charging points the electricity is currently still free.
Op publieke laadpunten is de stroom momenteel nog gratis.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent (GroenLinks), Haverkamp (CDA), Bashir (SP) en Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de bediening van NS station Hoogeveen door intercitytreinen (ingezonden 22 juli

MPs from GroenLinks, CDA, SP and D66 asked the minister whether NS plans to drop intercity stops at Hoogeveen from 2013, whether Zwolle-Assen would then be the longest stretch without an IC station, whether the concession should require IC stops there, and whether through-running stoptrains from Groningen as intercitys was studied. The minister replied that the timetable is NS's responsibility, the concession sets only minimum service levels (not train type or stops), she will not add IC-stop requirements, and through-running is possible but has disadvantages that NS judged unattractive, while noting ProRail's Zwolle station works.
I will therefore not interfere in NS's choice regarding Hoogeveen station or any other station.
Ik zal mij dus niet mengen in de keuze van NS ten aanzien van station Hoogeveen of welk ander station dan ook.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat een Brits advertentiebedrijf een da

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven (D66) asked about reports that a British advertising firm holds profiles of nearly all Dutch internet users, including risks of concentrating such data, compliance with Dutch data protection law, retention periods, and the effect of the cookie law. The minister replied that supervision of these companies lies with competent supervisory authorities abroad or in the Netherlands, that no statutory retention limits exist, and that the cookie provision will require consent for storing or reading data on users' devices.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het functioneren van Buma/Stemra (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether Buma/Stemra, which holds a de facto monopoly on music copyright licensing, is governed properly, and whether it should be placed under temporary administration or audited. The minister answers that Buma is a private association accountable to its members, that a governance review is underway, and that the College van Toezicht Auteursrechten and a certification body will monitor it, without ordering an audit or administration.
It is up to the members of the association – and not primarily up to the State Secretary of Security and Justice – to form a judgement on how the association's board functions.

Het is aan de leden van de vereniging – en niet in de eerste plaats aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie – om zich een oordeel te vormen over het functioneren van het bestuur van de vereniging.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de ministers van Financiën en Binnenlandse Zaken over het afschaffen van de overdrachtsbelasting (ingezonden 23 juni 2011).

The MP asks the ministers of Finance and Interior about abolishing or lowering the transfer tax, including for first-time buyers, its budgetary cost, required tax increases to cover it, and effects on the housing market. The government replies that it has temporarily lowered the rate on homes from 6% to 2%, gives cost estimates and covering options, and says research shows lower transaction costs increase mobility.
The cabinet has meanwhile decided to temporarily lower the transfer tax rate for homes from 6% to 2%.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om het tarief van de overdrachtsbelasting voor woningen tijdelijk te verlagen van 6 naar 2%.
De vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat 9292 OV-data tegen betaling vrijgeeft (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether 9292 charging for OV transport data, rather than releasing it free, conflicts with promises of open public transport data and the Digital Agenda. The minister replied that the data itself is free while requesters pay cost-based delivery fees under the WP2000 and BP2000 framework, and that the government would promote open access without committing to a specific change.
The data are therefore free; the 'collection costs' are for the account of the recipient.
De data zijn dus gratis, de «ophaalkosten» zijn voor rekening van de afnemer.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over omgang van de Kamer van Koophandel (KvK) met persoonsgegevens (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether it is acceptable that the Chamber of Commerce sells business contact data, which generates unsolicited mailings, and whether it should switch the Non Mailing Indicator from opt-out to opt-in and convert its mandatory levy to a voluntary one. The minister defends the revenue role of address sales, notes the NMI gives no absolute protection, promises a principled review of registry data use, and says the levy will be substantially reduced in a later letter.
I want to make a more principled assessment in the short term of the openness, availability and permitted use of the data in the commercial register.
Daarom wil ik op korte termijn een meer principiële afweging maken in de openbaarheid, beschikbaarheid en het mogen gebruiken van de gegevens in het handelsregister.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de ondernemingspeiling van het Productschap Tuinbouw (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asked the minister about an online business survey by the Productschap Tuinbouw, questioning its neutrality and whether PBO legitimacy could be measured better through voluntary contributions. The minister answered that such surveys are voluntary, self-directed bodies' communications, distinct from the legally mandated representative draagvlak survey, and deferred the broader PBO question to a forthcoming cabinet position.
The legally mandated draagvlak survey must be carried out using a representative sample.
Het wettelijk verplichte draagvlakonderzoek dient te worden uitgevoerd door middel van een representatieve steekproef.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over uitbreiding van de Ring Utrecht binnen de bestaande bak van Amelisweerd (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether widening the Ring Utrecht within the existing Amelisweerd bank could be reconsidered, and whether the Dutch and European requirements cited earlier are binding or can be departed from. The minister confirmed the requirements are EU TEN guidelines and national NOA guidelines that can be departed from with justification, but refused to reconsider the in-bank option, citing expert safety advice, prior agreements and a rejected parliamentary motion.
These concern European guidelines developed for the so-called Trans-European Networks (TENs).
Het gaat hierbij om Europese Richtlijnen die zijn ontwikkeld voor de zgn. Trans-Europese Netwerken (TEN’s).

Vragen van de leden Ferrier (CDA) en Verhoeven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Economische Zaken Landbouw en Innovatie over het ODA-budget (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

The MPs ask how the 300 million euro of ODA funds earmarked for the top sectors will be spent and how much remains uncommitted through 2015, and whether civil society organisations can use these funds. The minister answers that the top-team advice is still pending, that funds rise from 200 million in 2012 to about 300 million in 2015 with a large share already committed to business programmes, and that civil society can participate through programmes such as IDH and the PPP fund.
In the business letter the cabinet sends to the House before Prinsjesdag, the allocation of funds for the top sectors will be discussed in more detail.
In de bedrijfslevenbrief die het kabinet voor Prinsjesdag naar de Kamer stuurt zal nader worden ingegaan op de verdeling van de middelen ten behoeve van de topsectoren.

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de bezuinigingen op de rijksbijdrage aan het Nederlands Bureau voor Toerisme en Congressen (NBTC) (ingezonden 1

An MP asked the state secretary about cuts to the state contribution to NBTC, the tourism and congress promotion body, and about the sector's importance and the cut's rationale. The state secretary answered that the contribution falls 65% to 5.8 million euros from 2015 as part of general budget consolidation, not due to dissatisfaction with NBTC's performance.
The cabinet announced in the coalition agreement that it will cut 500 million euros in subsidies for business.
Het kabinet heeft in het Regeerakkoord aangekondigd 500 miljoen euro aan subsidies voor het bedrijfsleven te schrappen.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over buitenlandse beurzen (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MPs Van der Ham and Verhoeven asked why the government is ending the Huygens Scholarship Programme for Dutch students at top foreign universities, and what the effects and alternatives are. The state secretary defended the cut as affecting a small group relative to the wider internationalisation infrastructure, pointed to other scholarships, Erasmus and student finance, and said no quantitative target would be set.
In filling the subsidy cut target I gave priority to maintaining the infrastructure for internationalisation of higher education, which has a wider reach.
Ik heb bij het invullen van de subsidietaakstelling prioriteit gegeven aan het in stand houden van de infrastructuur voor de internationalisering van het hoger onderwijs, die een breder bereik heeft.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onterechte bijdragen aan het Hoofdbedrijfschap Ambachten (HBA) (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An MP asked whether levies imposed by the Hoofdbedrijfschap Ambachten on roofing firms and non-member installers, who did not request the services, are acceptable, and whether they should be made voluntary. The minister replied that compulsory levies are a feature of public-law trade bodies, that a pending court case means no comment on the matter, and that a cabinet position on product and trade boards would follow before 1 September 2011.
It is customary not to make statements about a case while it is before the court.
Het is goed gebruik dat er geen uitspraken over een zaak worden gedaan zolang deze onder de rechter is.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de gevolgen voor het uitgaansleven van gewijzigde BUMA regels (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

MPs Van der Ham and Verhoeven asked the state secretary about BUMA's lowered fee threshold for live performances, its effects on clubs and venues, the number of events affected, the VAT increase, and the expected revenue. The state secretary answered that the threshold change was agreed with Koninklijke Horeca Nederland, costs are hard to estimate, about 5000 events of roughly 100000 may be affected, the VAT increase played no role, and BUMA distributes collected amounts under its rules.
Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe flitspaal (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the EU-funded ASSET 3D speed camera, its legal basis, privacy implications and relation to ANPR. The minister answered that the project is research-stage, that any Dutch deployment would be notified to parliament, and that privacy would be safeguarded under data protection law, though many details were left open.
Should there in future be cause to deploy this or similar techniques on Dutch roads, it goes without saying that the House will be informed of this.
Mocht er in de toekomst aanleiding zijn om deze of soortgelijke technieken in te zetten op Nederlandse wegen, dan spreekt het voor zich dat de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd wordt.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de onduidelijkheid rondom de inning van provinciale opcenten (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked whether citizens can clearly tell which government layer receives motor vehicle tax and provincial opcenten, and how to make this more transparent. Minister Donner answered that the tax is sufficiently transparent because the assessment notice states that opcenten are levied for the province, and no changes are planned.
On the motor vehicle tax assessment it is clearly stated that besides motor vehicle tax, opcenten are also levied for the province where one lives.
Op de aanslag motorrijtuigenbelasting is duidelijk aangegeven dat er naast motorrijtuigenbelasting ook opcenten worden geheven ten behoeve van de provincie waar men woonachtig is
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de 30 projecten uit de Spoedaanpak (ingezonden 17 maart 2011).

An MP asks the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the Council of State's interim ruling on the A1 't Gooi road project, how it happened, the next steps, and the status of the 30 Spoedaanpak projects, including whether the groundbreaking target will be met. The minister explains the ruling found outdated traffic data in the noise study, gives the twelve-week administrative loop to fix it, and says the ten-opening target was met while the groundbreaking for the A1 project is delayed; the status of other projects will follow in a progress report.
Until there is a final ruling, the case therefore remains before the court.
Totdat er een einduitspraak is, ligt de zaak dus nog onder de rechter.

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de consequenties van de bezuinigingen op Ruimte om de Stad (RODS) (ingezonde

An MP asked the state secretaries how cuts to Ruimte om de Stad (RODS) recreation projects affect agreements with residents, which projects are halted, their spending and progress, the financial impact on local governments, and effects on recreation indicators. The government replied that Rijk no longer steers individual projects, referred questions to the provinces, confirmed a 40 million euro cut for 2011, and promised later reporting from the planning agency.
Since the introduction of the Investeringsbudget Landelijk Gebied (ILG) in 2007, the national government no longer steers individual projects.
Sinds de invoering van het Investeringsbudget Landelijk Gebied (ILG) in 2007 stuurt het Rijk niet meer op individuele projecten.

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over enorme kostenstijgingen voor woonboten (ingezonden 27 januari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretaries about sharp mooring-fee increases for houseboat residents, why these fees are being aligned with social rental housing, what tenancy protections houseboat residents have compared with tenants, and whether a three-year transition period should be introduced for objectors. The government answered by letter of 1 April 2011, without the answers being reproduced in the document.
These questions were answered by letter of 1 April 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 730, no. 1).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 1 april 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 730, nr. 1 ).

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het aanstaande bankroet van de Hoge Snelheidslijn (HSL) en de gevolgen hiervan voor de staatskas (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

An MP asked the minister about press reports that the HSL-Zuid is heading for bankruptcy, whether a carrier will ever again pay such a high usage fee, which budget lines hold the concession revenues, and which projects are at risk. The minister confirmed reading the article, said alternatives are still being examined so the fee question cannot yet be answered, and declined to name the budget lines or guarantee project funding because the concession revenues are not linked to specific projects.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gebrek aan talent, kennis en kunde als grootste act

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Education and Economic Affairs how they respond to business concerns that budget cuts to education threaten Dutch attractiveness for talent and growth, and how German business confidence relates to German knowledge investment. The minister answered that the cuts match intensifications, that Dutch attractiveness rests on multiple factors, that the top-sector policy will help, and that German confidence reflects export performance rather than knowledge investment.
The cabinet faces the task of restoring public finances to order.
Het kabinet staat voor de opgave om de overheidsfinanciën weer op orde te brengen.

Vragen van de leden Slob (ChristenUnie), Dijksma (PvdA), Bashir (SP), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Verhoeven (D66) en Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de voortgang van de werkzaamheden Landtu

Six MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the schedule, budget and legal challenges for the A2 Leidsche Rijn tunnel and the temporary bypass. The minister answered that the schedule and budget are unchanged, the court rejected residents' challenge on 11 February 2011, and the bypass will open by 1 April 2011.
On Friday 11 February 2011 the court ruled. The appeal was declared unfounded and the request for an interim injunction was also rejected.
Op vrijdag 11 februari 2011 heeft de Rechtbank uitspraak gedaan. Het beroep is ongegrond verklaard en ook het verzoek voor een voorlopige voorziening is afgewezen.

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Nederlandse bedrijfsleven raakt verder achterop met R&D» (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

MP Verhoeven (D66) asks the minister of Economic Affairs why Dutch private R&D investment ranks 16th in the OECD, whether Nederland belongs at that position, and what ambition and plans the government has to raise private knowledge investment.
