The minister acknowledges the ambition for a top-5 knowledge economy, attributes low private R&D to sector structure and weak attraction of foreign R&D, argues output indicators give no cause for pessimism, and refers to the new business policy letter and the National Reform Programme for targets.
For this I refer you to the main lines of the new business policy, described in the letter "Naar de top".
Hiervoor verwijs ik u naar de hoofdlijnen van het nieuwe bedrijfslevenbeleid, beschreven in de brief «Naar de top».
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Annual Growth Survey (ingezonden 18 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government would take the European Commission's criticism of the draft National Reform Programme into account and why the Commission omitted the Netherlands from its table of national Europe 2020 targets, and asked for those targets to be added. The minister replied that the criticism is addressed in a joint letter of 4 February 2011 and that national targets for CO2, renewables and early school leavers already exist, while the others are qualitative and will be elaborated in the April reform programme.
In the National Reform Programme of April, the cabinet's ambitions will be further elaborated in policy terms.
In het Nationaal Hervormingsprogramma van april zullen de ambities van het kabinet beleidsmatig nader worden uitgewerkt.

Vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een onderzoek naar de effecten van de verhoging van de maximumsnelheid op de CO2-uitstoot (ingezonden 21 december 201

D66 MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the CO2 and NOx effects of raising motorway speed limits to 130 km/h, citing an earlier letter to the informateur, and why the measure is in the coalition agreement despite those effects. The minister said the figures are indicative, further research is needed, and details on the approach and the questions will follow in spring.
For a more precise picture of the effects, further research is necessary.
Voor een nauwkeuriger beeld van de effecten is nader onderzoek noodzakelijk.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de toegenomen sociale ongelijkheid in de woonsituatie (ingezonden 10 december 2010).

MP Verhoeven asks the minister how he views the growing social inequality in housing, its causes, whether it is a concern, and what he will do about it. The minister says homeownership has grown, the gap between higher and lower educated groups rose from 7 to 19 percent mainly through higher-educated buyers, he does not see a concerning situation for lower educated, and the cabinet will make the move from renting to buying easier, for example through housing associations selling homes to sitting tenants.
I would find it a worrying development if lower educated people could not obtain a good quality home, but at present there is no such situation.
Ik zou het een zorgelijke ontwikkeling vinden als laagopgeleiden geen kwalitatief goede woning kunnen bemachtigen, maar hiervan is op dit moment geen sprake.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over rijtijden van buschauffeurs (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

An MP asks the minister why EU driving-time rules require a 45-minute break after 4.5 hours for freight and non-scheduled bus services, while city bus drivers fall under the Working Hours Act allowing 5.5 hours before a 30-minute break, and whether this distinction is desirable. The minister explains the EU regulation excludes scheduled urban and regional transport, which is governed by the Working Hours Act and a collective labour agreement, with the state responsible for framework legislation and social partners for rosters.
The European driving-time regulation does not apply to city bus drivers who drive according to a timetable.
De Europese rijtijdenverordening is niet van toepassing op buschauffeurs in steden die volgens een dienstregeling rijden.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het woningbeleid voor samenwoners (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the Interior Minister about Amsterdam housing rules that reportedly push cohabiting people out of social housing, and whether such rules spread to other cities and can be ended. The minister replies that allocation policy is a local matter for the municipal council, that no signals of similar rules elsewhere were received, and that the VROM Inspectorate could investigate only a possible breach of regulations, not a policy disagreement.
Policy choices weighing target groups (both students and low-income families) are in principle a local matter.
Beleidsmatige keuzes waarbij de afweging ten aanzien van doelgroepen (zowel studenten als gezinnen met een laaginkomen) gemaakt wordt zijn in beginsel een lokale aangelegenheid.

Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Financiën over de hoge hypotheekmarges in Nederland (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

Two MPs from D66 asked the economics and finance ministers about high mortgage margins in the Netherlands, prompted by an NMa quick scan, asking about the cause, the timing of the full study, possible price-fixing, transparency and fiscal treatment. The minister answered that margins are high historically and relative to other countries, that the NMa's second study will examine causes, that no suspicion of price agreements exists, and that the finance minister will consult market parties on transparency.
As I answered to your earlier questions, the NMa will in the second part of its study of the Dutch mortgage market examine in depth the competitive conditions and their developments.

Zoals ik op eerdere van uw vragen heb geantwoord, zal de NMa in het tweede deel van haar onderzoek naar de Nederlandse hypotheekmarkt diepgaand ingaan op de concurrentieomstandigheden en de ontwikkelingen daarvan.
Vragen lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over bezuinigingen in de farmasector (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

MP Verhoeven (D66) asks the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether the expected end of FES funding for the pharma Top Institute TI Pharma, and cuts to knowledge investment, are consistent with earlier commitments to strengthen innovation and the investment climate, and what concrete measures will keep the Netherlands competitive. The minister replies that FES was a one-off impulse, that existing projects continue with funds moved to departmental budgets, that TI Pharma has bridging finance to July 2012, and that a Bedrijfslevenbeleid note will follow in 2011.
The cabinet will commit across the full breadth to strengthening the knowledge economy.
Het kabinet zal zich over de volle breedte inzetten voor het versterken van de kenniseconomie.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over marktwerking in de kinderopvang (ingezonden 5 november 2

MPs Koşer Kaya and Verhoeven asked ministers whether market liberalisation in childcare since 2005 has raised prices, created waiting lists and lowered quality, and how competition, parent choice and oversight are assessed. The minister acknowledges the market does not yet function optimally, promises a letter next year and a CPB study, but largely defends the market model and says oversight changes will be considered in that letter.
I have asked the CPB whether it would be willing to conduct research into the childcare market.
Ik heb het CPB gevraagd of zij onderzoek willen doen naar de kinderopvangmarkt.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de toegenomen animo voor huurwoningen (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the housing minister how to respond to rising demand for rental homes, whether the market can absorb it, and whether a larger private rental segment for middle incomes is needed, given that tenants expect lower rents than the 4.5% return norm implies. The minister answered that the demand is largely cyclical, that the market will respond if structural demand emerges, and that caps on social housing allocation and rent rules will make private rental more attractive, while maintaining that the mortgage interest deduction supports homeownership.
If it were to turn out that there is a structural demand for more rental homes, one may expect market parties to respond to it.
Indien zou blijken dat sprake is van een structurele vraag naar meer huurwoningen, dan mag verwacht worden dat marktpartijen daarop zullen inspelen.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de ministers van Justitie en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de gevolgen van de uitvoering van de Wet kraken en leegstand (ingezonden 29 september 2010).

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Justice and Housing whether the Wet kraken en leegstand would make police eviction of squats far easier and faster, and what the consequences would be for vacancy, displaced residents, community uses and anti-squat housing. The government answered that the comparison is difficult, that it expects no negative consequences or need for shelter measures, points to existing municipal tools and a planned vacancy programme, and promises an evaluation within five years.
All aspects mentioned in the preceding questions will be included in this evaluation.
Hierbij zullen alle aspecten die in de voorgaande vragen zijn genoemd worden betrokken.
Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over asbestslopers (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

MPs Verhoeven and Koşer Kaya asked whether stricter asbestos-removal certification rules would bankrupt many small demolition firms, whether industry consent was required, and how small firms would be protected. The minister replied that the rules are drafted by a college including industry, that he sets them himself, that the health risks justify strict enforcement with a transition period, and that he is committed to keeping dialogue open.
Ultimately I myself establish the rules by ministerial regulation.
Uiteindelijk stel ik zelf de regels bij ministeriële regeling vast.

Vragen van de leden Koolmees en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de effectiviteit van besteding van belastinggeld door btw-verlaging in de bouw (ingezonden 10

D66 MPs asked whether the temporary VAT reduction on labour costs in construction (renovation and repair of homes) is an effective and efficient use of tax money, citing differing impact estimates from ABN AMRO and Bouwend Nederland, and asked when the evaluation of housing-market measures would be available. The minister acknowledged the estimates, argued the measure is a targeted temporary stimulus that the industry committed to pass on to consumers, said the effects can only be judged after the measure ends, and stated that the EIB evaluation will be sent to parliament in 2011.
In the course of 2011 the final report will be sent to the House of Representatives.
In de loop van 2011 zal de eindrapportage naar de Tweede Kamer worden gestuurd.

m: Amendement van het lid Van Beek over het samenvoegen van de gemeenten Bussum, Muiden en Naarden
Amends the municipal merger bill so Bussum, Muiden and Naarden merge into Naardermeer and adjusts the Weesp boundary.
municipalities Bussum, Naarden and Muiden are merged into the new municipality Naardermeer
gemeenten Bussum, Naarden en Muiden worden samengevoegd tot de nieuwe gemeente Naardermeer
Amendement van het lid Van Beek over het opnemen van een voorziening in het wetsvoorstel ter voorkoming van schade voor Naardermeer, voortkomende uit de juridische procedure tussen de gemeente Bussum
Provides the new municipality of Naardermeer a supplementary grant from the municipal fund capping its exposure to a damages claim against its predecessor.
the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, in agreement with the Minister of Finance, grants the municipality on its request a supplementary benefit
verleent Onze Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, in overeenstemming met Onze Minister van Financiën, de gemeente op haar verzoek een aanvullende uitkering
Motie Heijnen c.s. over een visie op de bestuurlijke inrichting van de provincie
Asks the government to ask the province and municipalities in Friesland to draft a shared vision on the province's administrative structure.
requests the government to ask the province, in consultation with the municipalities in Friesland, to draw up a possibly joint vision on the province's administrative structure
verzoekt de regering de provincie te vragen in overleg met de gemeenten in Friesland een, zo mogelijk gezamenlijke, visie op de bestuurlijke inrichting van de provincie op te stellen
Motie Heijnen c.s. over een evaluatie in 2013
Asks the government, with the new Zuidwest-Friesland municipality and the province, to evaluate that municipality's functioning in 2013 and report to the House.
requests the government to evaluate the functioning of this municipality in 2013 with the new municipality and the province and report to the House
verzoekt de regering om in 2013 in overleg met de nieuw te vormen gemeente en de provincie Friesland het functioneren van deze gemeente te evalueren en hierover aan de Kamer te rapporteren
Motie Van Beek over voorbereidingen voor definitieve besluitvorming over minder departementen
Asks the government to prepare for a final decision on reducing the number of ministries at the next cabinet formation.
requests the government to make preparations leading to definitive decision-making on fewer departments at the next cabinet formation
verzoekt de regering voorbereidingen te treffen die ertoe leiden dat bij de komende kabinetsformatie definitieve besluitvorming over minder departementen kan plaatsvinden
Motie Van Beek over afspraken met het IPO over het takenpakket van provincies volgens de lijnen van het rapport van de commissie-Lodders
Motion asks the government to agree with the IPO that provinces focus on supra-municipal and regional tasks as set out in the Lodders commission report.
requests the government to make agreements with the Interprovincial Consultation (IPO) on this
verzoekt de regering daar met het Interprovinciaal Overleg (IPO) afspraken over te maken
Amendement van het lid Bilder c.s. over het aanbrengen van een grenscorrectie tussen de gemeente Bergen en de nieuwe gemeente Venlo
Amendment adding a municipal boundary correction between Bergen and the new municipality of Venlo, departing from the usual Arhi procedure.
This amendment aims to make a boundary correction between the municipality of Bergen and the new municipality of Venlo.
Dit amendement beoogt een grenscorrectie aan te brengen tussen de gemeente Bergen en de nieuwe gemeente Venlo.
Motie Van Beek c.s. over het terugstorten van de onrechtmatig uit de gemeentekas onttrokken gelden
Asks the cabinet to ensure unlawfully withdrawn municipal funds are repaid and to prevent council decisions retroactively legitimising them.
requests the cabinet to take measures so that the funds are repaid by those responsible
verzoekt het kabinet het daartoe te leiden dat maatregelen worden genomen opdat de gelden door de daarvoor verantwoordelijken worden teruggestort
Motie van het lid Schinkelshoek c.s. over experimenteerregio's in en om Limburg
Asks the government to work with German and Belgian authorities toward experimental cross-border regions in Limburg and to report progress to the Chamber.
requests the government: 1. in consultation with German and Belgian authorities, step by step working toward experimental regions in and around Limburg
verzoekt de regering: 1. in overleg met Duitse en Belgische overheden stap voor stap op weg naar het drielandenoverleg toe werken naar experimenteerregio’s in en om Limburg
Motie van de leden Kathmann en White over gelijke privacybescherming in het hele Koninkrijk
Asks the government to draw up a plan with autonomous countries and islands to equalise privacy protection across the Kingdom, including enforcement and supervision resources.
to develop a broadly supported plan to bring privacy protection across the Kingdom to an equivalent level within a few years
te komen tot een gedragen plan om binnen enkele jaren de privacybescherming in het hele Koninkrijk op een gelijkwaardig niveau te brengen
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over opdracht geven tot het opstellen van een gedragscode
Asks the presidium to commission a conduct code for MPs on respectful behaviour towards colleagues and staff, based on the Senate's recent code.
requests the presidium to commission the drafting of a conduct code
verzoekt het presidium om opdracht te geven tot het opstellen van een gedragscode
Motie van het lid Kathmann c.s. over voortzetting van de activiteiten van ProDemos
Asks the presidium to consult ProDemos and the ministries of BZK and JenV to continue its activities and inform the House of the outcome.
requests the presidium to consult with ProDemos and the ministries of BZK and JenV

An MP asked the government about the American takeover of Dutch cloud company Solvinity, including exposure of government data to US surveillance laws and contract options. The state secretary answered that the risk of US data access already existed, that an inventory of critical dependencies is underway, that the Landsadvocaat is reviewing whether a change-of-control clause allows termination, and that further measures will be decided case by case.
An inventory is currently being carried out to determine whether critical processes depend on the services provided by Solvinity.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de overname van Zivver door een Amerikaans bedrijf

An MP asks the government about the acquisition of Dutch encrypted email provider Zivver by a US company, raising concerns about US surveillance law, data sovereignty and whether overheid use should continue. The government answers that US law could apply and risks must be reassessed under DPIA procedures, but it cannot fully exclude data reaching US or Israeli hands, leaves the decision on continued use to individual departments, and says existing investment screening laws do not cover Zivver, while promising no specific new oversight measure beyond reviewing risk analyses and exploring a sovereign cloud.
The cabinet currently has no indications that data held by the government ends up in the US or Israel in breach of data protection law, but it cannot fully rule this out with complete certainty.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over TikTok- algoritmes en extremisme

An MP asked the government about TikTok recommendation algorithms favouring far-right content, their role in radicalisation and extremism, election interference via donations to online creators, and possible national regulation. The government answered that platforms are responsible under the DSA, that the Commission supervises VLOPs, that national regulation is not currently needed beyond the DSA and TOI regulation, and that it will pursue dialogue, a pilot with Meta, and evaluation in 2027.
The cabinet therefore believes the priority should lie with effective and uniform application and enforcement of the DSA.
Het kabinet is daarom van mening dat de prioriteit moet liggen bij de effectieve en uniforme toepassing en handhaving van de DSA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de afhankelijkheid van de financiële sector van Amerikaanse techgiganten

An MP asked the government about the financial sector's dependence on American tech giants, including DNB and AFM warnings, scenario analysis, European coordination, and procurement exclusion. The minister acknowledged the risks, pointed to DORA, the vifo screening law, EU-level digital autonomy efforts and cloud policy, but said procurement exclusion of non-European firms is constrained by non-discrimination rules and the cloud policy review is delayed.
I will discuss with the supervisors how we can follow up on the recommendations.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over een op te richten Europese 'intelligence unit'

The MP asked whether the government is involved in a planned EU intelligence unit, whether AIVD/MIVD data would be shared, seconded staff, and legal basis. The minister replied that no Commission proposal has yet been shared, that the government supports SIAC-based strengthening but opposes parallel structures, and that details on multilateral cooperation are state secret and will be reported when a proposal is published.
The details of multilateral and international cooperation arrangements are state secret; I cannot comment on them in public.
De details omtrent multilaterale en internationale samenwerkingsverbanden zijn staatsgeheim, ik kan daar in het openbaar geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over de overstap van de Belastingdienst naar Microsoft

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked why the Tax Administration is moving its office IT and email to Microsoft 365, given dependence on the US, the motion requiring an independent justification and in-house email, and the exit strategy. Minister Heinen answers that dependence on the US increases but is comparable to alternatives, that the risk analysis and exit strategy are confidential, and that the primary tax processes stay in Dutch data centres while office automation moves to Microsoft.
The risk analysis will be made available to your House on a confidential basis.
De risico-analyse wordt vertrouwelijk ter inzage aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over Europese ontwikkelingen rondom chatcontrole

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the EU CSAM regulation (chat control) discussed in the Law Enforcement Working Party, whether it excludes mandatory detection, what the Netherlands' position is, and whether AIVD advice was sought. The minister answered that mandatory detection is removed and an explicit recital added, that voluntary detection would be made permanent, that the Netherlands will abstain, and that AIVD assessed the digital-resilience risks as very high.
To protect the Dutch negotiating position and diplomatic relations, I cannot share these with the House.

An MP asked whether the government would push for the stricter Dutch court-ordered timeline choice on Meta's recommender algorithms as a European standard, whether supervisors rather than courts should enforce the DSA, and how government will support supervisors and civil society organisations like Bits of Freedom. The government replied that the court only interprets existing DSA norms, that it sees no need for a European push, that civil enforcement alongside public supervision is legitimate, that supervisors are adequately funded, and that it will not provide financial aid to civil lawsuits.

Het Ministerie van Defensie is daarin buiten beschouwing gelaten omdat zij buiten de scope van het Rijksbreed cloudbeleid vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the government about dependence on US tech giants for public cloud services, including whether ministries, DJI, IND and CJIB will reconsider migrations and whether data could be exposed under US law. The state secretary answers that existing cloud policy requires weighing risks, that migrations are being reconsidered under a temporary cloud policy line, and that dependence on US providers will largely persist for now while the cloud policy is revised.
The cabinet agrees with the submitters that careful considerations regarding cloud migrations are of great importance.
Het kabinet is het met de indieners eens dat zorgvuldige afwegingen bij cloudmigraties van groot belang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

Two MPs asked the government about growing dependence on US tech giants for cloud services, including whether DNB and other agencies will reconsider migrations, which data and processes are already in US clouds, and the risks from US laws such as the CLOUD Act. The government answered that existing cloud policy already weighs market concentration and continuity risks, that some migrations were reconsidered, that a sovereign government cloud is being explored, and that it cannot give a blanket commitment to halt dependence.
The cabinet agrees with the submitters that careful deliberation on cloud migrations is of great importance.
Het kabinet is het met de indieners eens dat zorgvuldige afwegingen bij cloudmigraties van groot belang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked whether government organisations, including Logius, would reconsider moving data and services to US cloud providers, and what the risks would be if US access were cut off. The State Secretary answered that Logius does not use US cloud services, that the government is reviewing its cloud policy and exploring a sovereign government cloud, and that several planned migrations were reconsidered or halted.
The revision of the government-wide cloud policy also addresses further reducing dependence on a few suppliers, the so-called market concentration and continuity risks.

4 In de herziening van het rijksbreed cloudbeleid wordt tevens aandacht besteed aan het verder beperken van afhankelijkheid van enkele leveranciers, de zogeheten marktconcentratie- en conti nuïteitsrisico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the government whether public bodies such as the KvK, CBS and RVO will reconsider moving services to US cloud providers, and how exposed data and continuity are to US law and sanctions. The government answered that the Rijksbreed cloud policy already requires weighing market concentration and continuity risks, that some migrations (e.g. Oracle ERP) are being reconsidered and kept within the EEA, and that it is exploring a sovereign government cloud and an ACM review.
For the Parliamentary letter of 22 November 2024, a survey was held among all ministries to obtain an overview of all planned and proposed cloud migrations of government ICT abroad.

Antwoord 4 Rijksbreed Ten behoeve van de Kamerbrief van 22 november 2024 2 is een uitvraag gedaan bij alle departementen ten behoeve van een overzicht van alle geplande en voorgenomen cloudmigraties van overheids-ICT naar het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de hack op een lab van Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health about the hack of a laboratory used by Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland, covering notification of affected people, data use, protection measures, oversight and future safeguards. The government answered that about 941,000 participants will be informed, that oversight by the IGJ and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is ongoing, and that the Cyberbeveiligingswet will impose security duties and incident reporting on care providers, but gave no firm dates for the investigations.
As soon as relevant outcomes of the investigations are known, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Zodra relevante uitkomsten van de onderzoeken bekend zijn, zal ik uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de nieuwe voorwaarden van WeTransfer om data van gebruikers te gebruiken voor verkoop en het trainen van AI

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and the State Secretary of the Interior whether WeTransfer's new terms allowing use of user data for sale and AI training are lawful, and whether users should be able to opt in. The government answered that data protection and consumer complaints lie with the independent regulators (AP and ACM), that AI training on personal data can rest on legitimate interest under the GDPR, that EU copyright law uses an opt-out rather than opt-in regime, and that it will not interfere with the regulators' independence.
That would be a task for the independent regulator, if it considers this opportune.
Dat zou een taak van de onafhankelijke toezichthouder zijn, indien deze dat opportuun vindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de hackaanval op het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Mutluer and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister about the hack of the Public Prosecution Service (OM) digital environment, including data stolen, staff and witness safety, Citrix vulnerability, and restoration timing. The minister answered that no evidence yet shows data was manipulated or taken, that the OM is returning online in phases with enhanced monitoring, and that the NCSC has urged all Citrix users to investigate, while withholding details of the ongoing criminal investigation.
I cannot provide you with any information about the ongoing criminal investigation while that investigation continues.
Over het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik u gedurende dat onderzoek geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de schijnveiligheid van jongeren op sociale media

An MP asks the government about the 'false security' of teen accounts on Instagram and related issues: addictive design, Meta's responsibility, EU regulation, age limits and parental guidance. The government answers that the DSA and European Commission investigation are the main tools, that enforcement rests with independent regulators, and that it will pursue a public campaign, a parenting guideline and further study of addictive design.
Ultimately it is up to the regulators to determine whether there is a breach of legal obligations.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de toezichthouders om vast te stellen of er sprake is van schending van wettelijke verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Kathmann over het emancipatiebeleid van Nederland en de rol van digitalisering

Two MPs (Westerveld and Kathmann, GroenLinks-PvdA) asked about emancipation policy and digitalisation, covering AI bias and discrimination, gender equality and LHBTIQ+ rights in the EU, Roma and Sinti inclusion, and online radicalisation of young men. The government answered each of the 23 questions in substance, pointing to existing tools, EU regulation and ongoing programmes, without addressing parliamentary oversight of the executive directly.
The cabinet rejects all forms of discrimination.
Het kabinet keurt iedere vorm van discriminatie af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de rol van Microsoft bij Amerikaanse sancties richting het Internationaal Strafhof

Kathmann asked the government whether it accepts US tech firms like Microsoft being used to pressure the International Criminal Court, whether Microsoft will resist Trump-era demands, and whether Dutch citizens and infrastructure could lose access to US digital services. The government rejects the US sanctions on ICC officials, says it is pressing the US to limit their effects, and says that Microsoft's compliance is a matter for US companies, while outlining its digital sovereignty policy.
The cabinet is in contact with Dutch business about the US sanctions against the ICC, among other things to prevent so-called overcompliance.
Het kabinet staat in contact met het (Nederlandse) bedrijfsleven over de kwestie van Amerikaanse sancties tegen het ISH, onder meer om zogenaamde overcompliance te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Kathmann over huisbezoeken aan demonstranten en de gegevensverwerking van demonstranten

MPs Lahlah and Kathmann asked the Justice and Security minister about police home visits to demonstrators, the legal basis and limits for police data collection and retention on protesters, complaint outcomes, and remedies, including Amnesty's call for stronger oversight. The minister answered that police contact with citizens is standard practice and that the Ombudsman study and WODC research will be followed by policy responses, while data oversight rests with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and the police chief, and that the answers were late.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to comment on the recommendations made to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, because the exercise of supervision is independent.

Het is daarbij niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om mij uit te laten over de aanbevelingen die zijn gedaan richting de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, omdat de uitoefening van het toezicht onafhankelijk geschiedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Lahlah en Kröger over “het sluiten van het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie”

Three GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about the closure of the Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie after a rush of applications, technical problems, and the mandatory DigiD requirement. The State Secretary acknowledged the frustration and access problems, but said no additional public or third-party funds were available, the fund had to close, and a DigiD was required to verify income.
To prevent administrative risks, the central government can only contribute funds when third parties also contribute more than one third of the total sum.
Het Rijk kan om bestuurlijke risico's te voorkomen enkel middelen inleggen wanneer derde partijen ook meer dan één derde van de totale som financieel bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nordkamp en Kathmann over de bescherming van persoonsgegevens van militairen op apps

MPs Nordkamp and Kathmann asked the Defence ministry how it protects soldiers' personal and location data from fitness and dating apps such as Strava, and what it has done about the risk. The state secretary answered that Defence bans certain apps on its own devices, trains personnel, and has no power over private phones, while acknowledging the risk and saying effectiveness is hard to measure.
Defence, however, has no control over private equipment and private use of the internet.
Defensie heeft echter geen zeggenschap over privéapparatuur en het privégebruik van het Internet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over bescherming tegen digitale aanvallen op internationale instellingen in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about Dutch and EU protection of international organisations in the Netherlands against state-linked cyberattacks, following a press report on the hack of the EMA in Amsterdam. The minister answered that primary responsibility lies with the organisations, that the host state has an effort obligation, that the AIVD and NCSC can assist only on a voluntary basis, and that EU cooperation is being strengthened through NIS2 and Regulation 2023/2841.
I do not make statements about specific AIVD cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over specifieke casussen van de AIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Nordkamp over het werkbezoek van de staatssecretaris van Defensie aan Microsoft en Amazo

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence about his March 2025 working visit to Microsoft and Amazon in Seattle, its purpose and programme, and Defence's dependence on non-European cloud providers. The government answered that the visit aimed at understanding tech developments and sovereignty, that no commitments were made, that Defence uses a risk-spread multicloud approach and is exploring European alternatives, and that only unclassified or lightly classified data is stored with US providers.
For privacy reasons we cannot give names or functions, but talks were held with both companies at director and corporate vice president level.
Vanwege privacy kunnen wij geen namen of functies geven, maar er is gesproken met beide bedrijven op het niveau van director & corporate vice president.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over de nieuwe werkplek van SSC-ICT

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked whether migrating 58,000 government digital workplaces to the public cloud is necessary, what it costs, whether US cloud laws and dependencies pose risks, and how data and metadata are handled. The State Secretary answered that migration is needed because Windows 10 and Ivanti components reach end of support, that most data stays in government data centres with only metadata held by US providers, and that risks are being managed and a revised cloud policy is coming in mid-2025.
I am still consulting on how we can share the advice of the intelligence and security services in outline, whether or not confidentially.
Ik ben nog in overleg hoe we op hoofdlijnen, al dan niet vertrouwelijk, de adviezen van de inlichtingen-en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over het onbetrouwbare algoritme dat jongeren als crimineel bestempelt

MPs Kathmann and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about the Preselect Recidive algorithm that flags young suspects as future criminals, including its purpose, validation, transparency, privacy assessment, error rates and whether affected youths can object. The State Secretary answered that the tool only informs a human decision at the ZSM consultation, promised to register it in the Algorithm Register in 2025, to inform youths and parents, and to redevelop the tool with a new report in the second half of 2025.
When the Preselect Recidive is applied there is therefore always a decision by people, not by an algorithm, which also uses other information about the young person.
Er is bij de toepassing van de Preselect Recidive dus altijd sprake van een besluit door mensen, niet door een algoritme, waarbij ook andere informatie over de jongere wordt gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van der Lee over “de online surveillance van Bunq”, naar aanleiding van een artikel in het Financieele Dagblad van 19 december 2024

MPs Kathmann and Van der Lee asked whether bank Bunq pressured customers via its app to stop online criticism, whether it may link user data to such posts, and whether supervisors should investigate. The minister replied that Bunq denies threatening or terminating customers, that banks cannot use online criticism as a legal basis to process customer data, and that the independent supervisors AFM and DNB cannot be instructed to investigate a specific case.
The AFM and DNB are independent administrative bodies and function as independent supervisors. I therefore cannot ask the supervisors to investigate a specific situation.
De AFM en DNB zijn zelfstandige bestuursorganen en functioneren als onafhankelijke toezichthouders. Ik kan de toezichthouders daarom niet vragen om een specifieke situatie te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kathmann over de toegankelijkheid van overheidsdiensten

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked about the digital accessibility of government services, citing a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report and raising issues such as the non-compliance of many public websites, IDO funding, accessibility in healthcare and education, and emergency services. The State Secretary responded that the government is working on a work agenda, accessibility standards, a planned 2028 deadline, and reform of IDO financing, while acknowledging compliance is too low but declining to commit to sanctions for now.
The Ministry of BZK considers the number of government websites and apps that meet the legal requirement to be too low.
Het Ministerie van BZK vindt het aantal overheidswebsites en -apps die aan de wettelijke verplichting voldoen te laag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en El Abassi over het niet naleven van de Wet politiegegevens

MPs Kathmann and El Abassi ask why the police have not complied with the Wet politiegegevens' deletion deadline for removed data, which the korpschef deliberately did not destroy from 2019 pending legal reform, and who oversees this. Minister Van Weel answers that the non-compliance is a deliberate, politically backed choice limited to article 14 data usable in cold cases, that the Raad van State has been asked for advice, and that a bill is planned for consultation in 2025.
There is no question of a tolerance decision. The korpschef decided, pending an amendment of the retention periods in the Wpg, not to proceed with destroying the relevant data.
Er is geen sprake van een gedoogbesluit. De korpschef heeft besloten in afwachting van een wijziging van de bewaartermijnen in de Wpg niet over te gaan tot vernietiging van de betreffende gegevens.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Six-Dijkstra en Kathmann over de rechterlijke toegang tot burgerinformatie van de politie

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police refuse a court order to give a court-appointed forensic expert access to police data systems, and how citizens can access their police data. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, stated that court rulings should be followed and that police are in talks with the expert, and cited the Wpg access rules and existing audit findings.
In principle, court rulings must be followed.
Aan rechterlijke uitspraken dient in beginsel gevolg te worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Lahlah en Mutluer over gezichtsherkenning bij de politie

MPs Kathmann, Lahlah and Mutluer asked about police use of facial recognition and camera surveillance at peaceful demonstrations, citing an Amnesty report, and asked about oversight, data sources, retention and procurement. The Minister replied that police do not use real-time facial recognition at demonstrations, only retrospectively against suspects of crimes, that the Dutch DPA has adequate expertise to supervise, and that a national legal framework and an AI-regulation-based transparency register are being explored and will follow.
Only when criminal offences have been committed can the police subsequently use facial recognition technology to identify suspects.
Enkel wanneer sprake is van strafbare feiten kan door de politie achteraf gezichtsherkenningstechnologie worden ingezet om verdachten te identificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Kathmann over het bericht ‘Controversial ‘chat control’ back on EU agenda this week’

MPs Six Dijkstra and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister about the EU 'chat control' proposal on scanning private messages, its timing in the Council, and its compatibility with Dutch constitutional privacy and telecommunications rights and EU/ECtHR case law. The Minister answered that the Netherlands will not support mandatory detection measures practically implementable only via client-side scanning, that the proposal is not yet ready, and that the answers to the questions were delayed beyond the deadline.

With the information now available, the cabinet will not support proposals on mandatory detection that in practice can only be carried out through client-side scanning, because of the consequences for digital resilience.

Met de informatie die nu voorhanden is, zal het kabinet geen voorstellen over verplichte detectie ondersteunen die in de praktijk uitsluitend kunnen worden uitgevoerd door middel van client-side scanning, vanwege de gevolgen voor de digitale weerbaarheid.
Antwoord op de vragen van leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie over het uitlezen van mobiele telefoons

MPs Kathmann and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister how the CJEU ruling allowing phone searches for minor offences would affect Dutch practice, and what protocols, consent rules and data retention apply. The minister replied that the ruling's impact is still uncertain, that a codifying bill will be consulted on once clearer, and described current Dutch rules, biometric unlocking and data storage periods.
Before the end of the year, your House will receive the policy response to the evaluation reports.
Voor het einde van het jaar ontvangt uw Kamer de beleidsreactie op de evaluatierapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Stultiens over het bericht 'Paniek over veiligheid pensioenen APG: kritisch rapport legt problemen bloot'

MPs Kathmann and Stultiens asked the ministers about reported IT vulnerabilities at pension administrator APG and how critical institutions and supervisors such as DNB handle cybersecurity. The government answered that APG has taken mitigating measures under supervision of DNB and AFM, that the minister is not directly involved, and that the forthcoming Cyberbeveiligingswet will impose a risk-management duty on organisations, while declining to disclose supervisory details.
Due to supervisory confidential information, DNB cannot make statements about what share of supervision is devoted to cybersecurity of pension funds.
Vanwege toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie kan DNB geen uitlatingen doen welk aandeel van het toezicht besteed wordt aan cyberveiligheid van pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op  vragen van het lid Kathmann over het ontslag van het gehele TikTok moderatieteam in Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior about TikTok's dismissal of its Dutch content moderation team and whether this conflicts with DSA obligations on human oversight and local expertise. The State Secretary answered that TikTok says the Dutch dismissals do not significantly reduce Dutch-language moderators, that the Commission is the primary DSA supervisor, that a government study on moderation practices is underway, and that a complaints body is being explored.
The assessment of whether TikTok complies sufficiently with the DSA is for the European Commission.
Het oordeel of TikTok de DSA correct genoeg naleeft is aan de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van der Werf over de aanval op Nederlandse apparaten door Chinese staatshackers

MPs Kathmann and Van der Werf asked the government about a Chinese state-linked hacking botnet that infected Dutch consumer devices, including its motives, consequences, affected parties and EU legislative remedies. The government answered that the botnet was untargeted, that no critical infrastructure or state secrets are known to have been affected, that NCSC and DTC issued general advice, and that the Cyber Resilience Act would strengthen device security.
As far as is known, the infected systems in the Netherlands were not part of the central government or vital infrastructure.
Voor zover bekend waren de in Nederland besmette systemen geen onderdeel van de Rijksoverheid of vitale infrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over een verklaring van nationale politiehoofden die betrekking heeft op end-to-end- encryptie

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the Justice Minister about a European police chiefs' call to weaken end-to-end encryption and how it relates to rulings by the ECtHR, CJEU and EDPB. The minister answered that the government keeps its existing position supporting end-to-end encryption, that lawful access should be sought through European cooperation, and that the rulings are not inconsistent with that position.
That position is not up for discussion here.
3 Dit standpunt staat hier niet ter discussie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Kathmann en Inge van Dijk over de opkomst van niet-Europese online marktplaatsen en de impact hiervan op concurrentievermogen, consumentenbescherming en productveiligheid

MPs Thijssen, Kathmann and Inge van Dijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the flood of parcels from Chinese online marketplaces, unequal competition, consumer protection and product safety, and asked what the government itself can do. The Minister acknowledges the concerns, points to EU instruments (DSA, DMA, customs reform, Digital Product Passport) and to supervisors' responsibility, and commits to talks with the Consumentenbond and retail associations and to coordination with Germany and at EU level.
I am willing to enter into discussion with the Consumentenbond and the retail industry associations and to inform the House about relevant outcomes.
Ik ben bereid om in gesprek te gaan met de Consumentenbond en de retailbrancheverenigingen en de Kamer te informeren over relevante uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Kathmann over het archiveren van zakelijke appjes

MPs Chakor and Kathmann asked how ministries ensure that business WhatsApp messages are properly archived, why compliance with the 2023 guidelines is inconsistent, and how oversight and responsibility are organised. The state secretary answers that compliance has improved, that oversight rests with the Inspectie OE and CIO Rijk monitoring, that a Rijksbrede chat-archiving facility is being built, and that the government will respond to the ADR audit report with the Algemene Zaken budget.
The aim is to provide the response to the ADR audit report before the Algemene Zaken budget debate.
Gestreefd wordt om de reactie op het ADR-onderzoeksrapport voor de behandeling van de begroting van Algemene Zaken te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kathmann over het onderzoek van Trollrensics over desinformatienetwerken tijdens de EU verkiezingen

MPs Piri and Kathmann asked the government about a Trollrensics report on disinformation networks targeting the 2024 European elections, including whether AIVD, MIVD and NCTV confirm it, whether similar campaigns occurred in the Netherlands, the role of Dutch hosting infrastructure, and whether the DSA suffices against platforms like X. The minister answered that the network was not observed in the Netherlands, that the services cannot publicly confirm investigations, that DSA enforcement by the European Commission is ongoing, and that a broader Dutch disinformation strategy is underway.
The cabinet cannot publicly disclose where the intelligence and security services are or are not conducting investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen naar waar de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten al dan niet onderzoek naar doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het opschorten van de AI-plannen van Meta na druk toezichthouders

An MP asks the government whether Meta may use users' photos and posts to train AI models under GDPR, DMA and the AI Act, whether its legitimate-interest claim holds, and whether opt-in, collective objection and EU coordination are possible. The minister answers that the assessment of lawfulness lies with the data protection authorities (AP and the Irish DPC), that the DMA may apply, that the government will not intervene in individual cases, and that no joint EU position is being prepared.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether Meta's plans are acceptable, but primarily for the supervisory authority.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of de plannen van Meta acceptabel zijn, maar in de eerste plaats aan de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Koekkoek over het niet op orde hebben van het toezicht op de geheime diensten

MPs Kathmann and Koekkoek asked why the CTIVD, which oversees the intelligence services, still lacks workspace and 10 additional staff, and whether the new Temporary Act can responsibly take effect without a fully equipped overseer. The government answers that housing is being sought with strict security requirements, a temporary solution is available from January 2025 and permanent housing by mid-2026, and that the Act's powers will be phased in as oversight capacity grows.

As stated in the letter of 26 June 2024 on the entry into force of the Temporary Act, the Act contains provisions that must become available as soon as possible but that create no additional work for the CTIVD.

Zoals in de brief van 26 juni 2024 over de inwerkingtreding van de Tijdelijke wet is aangegeven, bevat de Tijdelijke wet voorzieningen waarvan het van groot belang is dat deze zo spoedig mogelijk beschikbaar komen, maar waar geen extra werkzaamheden voor de CTIVD uit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mohandis over het bericht 'Incassobedrijf gebruikt AI om kwetsbare schuldenaar te spotten: 'Kan bizarre situaties opleveren''

MPs Kathmann and Mohandis asked about reports that debt collector Intrum uses AI to scan correspondence of vulnerable debtors, raising risks of discrimination, privacy breaches and lack of transparency. The minister acknowledged the risks, said the government cannot guarantee AI use is optional for consumers, and pointed to existing GDPR and WKI rules and the forthcoming EU AI Act, while stating the details of Intrum's practices are not yet known and a meeting with Intrum is planned.
From the article, the precise methods or working practices of Intrum are not clear to me.
Uit het artikel worden de precieze methoden of werkwijzen van Intrum mij niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Tseggai en Kathmann  over opleidingsniveau als risico-indicator voor fraude

MPs asked whether education level (mbo, hbo, wo) was used as a fraud risk indicator, including by DUO, and whether it is ethically justified given government goals to value all forms of education equally. The government acknowledged the former DUO risk profile, said no fraud-related algorithm in the register uses education type, stated that education type is generally an unjustified criterion and that DUO has stopped using it, and referred the broader question to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Westerveld over het onterecht verwijderen van foto’s en video’s van mensen met een zichtbare beperking

MPs Kathmann and Westerveld asked whether large platforms like Facebook may remove photos and videos of people with visible disabilities and whether this breaches Dutch and EU rules, and what remedies exist. The government answered that DSA transparency and appeal duties and the Dutch equal-treatment law (Wgbh/cz) prohibit disability discrimination by platforms, pointed to complaint routes via platforms, the ACM and the College voor de rechten van de mens, and said it is exploring a dispute-settlement body and a knowledge centre.
On the case you mention I have not received any signals.
Over het door u genoemde geval heb ik geen signalen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathman over het bericht ‘Geheime afmeldcodes van duizenden alarmsystemen opvraagbaar door softwarefout’

MP Kathmann asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a software flaw that exposed secret deactivation codes of thousands of alarm systems run by SMC and Securitas, including which government and vital organisations were affected and what steps were taken. The minister answered that the NCSC judged the impact limited, that the companies had taken remedial measures and found no evidence of misuse, and that the NCSC issued no general advisory.
SMC and Securitas are themselves responsible for informing their customers about the leak.
SMC en Securitas zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het informeren van hun klanten over het lek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over Fiches over digitalisering in de door de informateurs aangeboden formatiestukken

An MP asked whether the 27 underlying fiches referenced in the formation document on digitalisation exist and whether they can be published now. The state secretary confirmed the 27 fiches, said other departments may have produced related fiches but she is not aware of any, and said publication is excluded under the Wet open overheid until formation concludes, with later publication left to the responsible ministers.
Under article 5.4 of the Open Government Act, documents prepared for the formation are in principle excluded from disclosure until the formation is concluded.

Antwoord 3 Uit artikel 5.4 van de Wet open overheid (Woo) volgt dat in beginsel geldt dat documenten die ten behoeve van de formatie zijn opgesteld – zoals de onderhavige fiches – uitgezonderd zijn van openbaarheid totdat de formatie is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de slechte beveiliging van gemeentelijke websites

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior about poorly secured municipal websites, including forgotten sites, and the lack of enforcement of security standards. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, cited a 54% compliance rate, pointed to existing coordination, monitoring and planned supervision of security standards, and committed to further steps and reporting before the summer recess.
Under the Digital Government Act (Wdo), I am exploring how supervision of the legally mandatory standards can be strengthened.
In het kader van de Wet digitale overheid (Wdo) ben ik aan het verkennen hoe het toezicht op de wettelijke verplichte standaarden steviger kan worden ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de onbereikbaarheid van provinciewebsites als gevolg van DDoS-aanvallen

An MP asked the State Secretary about provincial websites going offline due to DDoS attacks, including causes, impact, guidelines, and coordination with the Anti-DDoS coalition. The government answered that the outages were DDoS attacks likely linked to pro-Russian hacktivists, that impact was probably limited, that a baseline guideline exists with responsibility resting on provinces, and that provinces are being connected to the NCSC and a DDoS scrubbing service.
Furthermore, the affected provinces have now connected to a so-called DDoS scrubbing service.
Verder zijn de getroffen provincies inmiddels aangesloten op een zogenaamde DDoS-wasstraat.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Piri en Kathmann over nieuwssites die al jaren pro-Chinese desinformatie verspreiden

MPs Piri and Kathmann asked the government about a network of news sites spreading pro-Chinese disinformation, including reach, platform promotion, and whether EU rules (DSA, disinformation code) can address it. The government answered that the sites have negligible reach, fall largely outside DSA scope, that it will report on its disinformation strategy in spring, and that further EU regulation is not yet needed.
The cabinet is in close contact, both bilaterally and multilaterally, with friendly countries on foreign interference and Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI).

Het kabinet staat zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband in nauw contact met bevriende landen over de problematiek van buitenlandse inmenging en Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Kathman over de recente faillissementen in de winkelstraat

MPs Van Kent and Kathmann asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about bankruptcies in shopping streets, workers' position in insolvency, the pending Wovof bill, director liability, and union access to company information. The answers were given orally on 12 March 2024, and this written reply refers to those oral answers.
The written questions from MPs Van Kent and Kathmann about the recent bankruptcies in the shopping street were answered through oral questions (2024Z03962) on 12 March 2024.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Kent en Kathman over de recente faillissementen in de winkelstraat zijn beantwoord middels mondelinge vragen ( 2024Z03962 ) op 12 maart 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Klaver, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over Russische desinformatiecampagnes

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about Russian disinformation campaigns, including Czech intelligence reports that Voice of Europe served as a conduit for Russian payments to Dutch politicians, and whether the Czech government was asked to share that information and whether further investigation and capacity investment are planned. The answer declines to answer in writing and asks that the questions be put orally in the plenary debate instead.
I request that you put the questions orally during the debate on the report that, according to the Czech secret service, Russia paid cash to Dutch and European politicians
Ik verzoek u de vragen mondeling te stellen tijdens het debat over het bericht dat volgens de Tsjechische geheime dienst Rusland cash betaalde aan Nederlandse en Europese politici
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Six Dijkstra en Sneller over de verhuizing van het.nl domein

MPs Kathmann, Six Dijkstra and Sneller asked about SIDN's plan to move the .nl domain registration system to Amazon Web Services, raising sovereignty, US access, oversight and security concerns. The minister answers that no move has yet occurred, that SIDN has committed to no irreversible steps, that the RDI and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens will review risks via a DPIA/DTIA, and that a quickscan of Dutch and EU alternatives will be carried out with a further letter expected in Q2.
It has been agreed that SIDN will not take any irreversible steps at this time.
Afgesproken is dat SIDN op dit moment geen onomkeerbare stappen zal zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann inzake exposegroepen en doxing op Telegram

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about exposure and doxing groups on Telegram, including whether such groups should be removed, how the Digital Services Act applies to Telegram and what enforcement tools exist. The Minister answered that platforms bear primary responsibility, that Telegram has no Dutch representative so Dutch enforcement is limited, that the DSA enforcement belongs to Belgian and EU regulators, and that police and prosecutors have tools such as orders to make data inaccessible, but made no commitment to contact Telegram's representative or to ban the app.
I cannot make further statements about ongoing cases.
Over lopende zaken kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over de Russische desinformatiecampagne via sociale media in Duitsland

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about a reported Russian disinformation campaign on X in Germany and whether similar campaigns target the Netherlands, including the adequacy of Dutch law, the EU Digital Services Act and platform responsibility. The minister acknowledged foreign interference risks, said no concrete Dutch cases were identified in the election, pointed to EU and NATO information sharing, announced a review of whole-of-government disinformation policy, and noted the European Commission opened a formal DSA procedure against X.

In its letter of 9 November 2023 the cabinet already announced it would examine whether, and if so how, the whole-of-government approach to disinformation about the core democratic processes should be strengthened.

In de brief 9 november 2023 heeft het kabinet daarom al aangekondigd te onderzoeken of, en zo ja hoe, de Rijksbrede aanpak van desinformatie over de kernprocessen van de democratie versterkt moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Koekoek over het niet op tijd invoeren van de Uitvoeringswet digitaledienstenverordening (DSA)

MPs Kathmann and Koekkoek asked why the Dutch Digital Services Act implementation law (Uitvoeringswet DSA) was not in force by the EU deadline, what legal powers the ACM has meanwhile, and how to avoid future delays. The minister answered that the 15-month deadline was too short for a formal law, that the ACM was provisionally designated by ministerial order, that the bill would be submitted around March 2024, and that the Commission alone supervises very large platforms.
The bill itself contains no further rules that intermediary service providers must comply with.
Het wetsvoorstel zelf bevat geen nadere regels waar aanbieders van tussenhandeldiensten zich aan moeten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over vermogensgrenzen voor kwijtschelding van lokale belastingen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a Utrecht council motion to align wealth limits for local tax waivers with the Participatiewet bijstand limits, and about raising the thresholds generally. The minister declined substantive comment, pointed to the controversial declaration of earlier Chamber correspondence, noted the 2022 regulation allowing municipalities to raise the limit by up to 2,000 euro, and confirmed the Kroon annulled the Utrecht decision for conflict with law and the public interest.

Given the controversial declaration by your Chamber and the many policy effects linked to a possible increase in the wealth norm for waivers, the cabinet does not consider it opportune to respond substantively to this now.

Gezien de controversieelverklaring door uw Kamer en gelet op de vele beleidsmatige effecten die samenhangen met een eventuele verhoging van de vermogensnorm voor kwijtschelding vindt het kabinet het niet opportuun hier nu inhoudelijk op te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over kinderopvanglocaties die trucs inzetten om meer omzet te draaien

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether childcare centres use accounting tricks to inflate billed hours and how the government will prevent misuse when setting price rules. The minister says the sector was urged to improve transparency, a sample of opening hours will be taken, parents have complaint routes, and tariff regulation is being studied with results expected in early 2025.
There is no overview of the scale on which the practices discussed in the article are applied, or of their financial consequences for parents.
Er is geen overzicht op welke schaal de praktijken die besproken worden in het artikel, worden toegepast en wat de financiële gevolgen voor ouders zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kathmann over het bericht dat twee op de drie werkende Nederlanders zich niet door zijn werkgever gestimuleerd voelen om zichzelf te blijven ontwikkelen door het volgen van e

MPs Westerveld and Kathmann asked whether workers should receive a lifelong personal learning budget, how government can encourage employers to stimulate training, and how to reduce learning reluctance among practically educated workers, citing STAP-budget lessons. The ministers answer that lifelong learning is important, that employers bear primary responsibility, point to existing schemes (SLIM, leercultuur, LLO collectief, levenlanglerenkrediet) and say a personal learning budget is a decision for the next cabinet, referring to a November 2023 exploration.
Weighing the various pros and cons of introducing a development budget and the further decision-making on it is up to a next cabinet.
Het afwegen van de diverse voor- en nadelen van invoering van een ontwikkelbudget en de verdere besluitvorming daarover is aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over digiC

MP Kathmann asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the digiC consultation model for collective bargaining undermines trade union independence, whether cao's signed by De Unie alone or using digiC should be withdrawn or refused registration, and how independence is enforced. The minister says unions must be independent, online consultation of workers does not in itself breach independence, the ministry does not record digiC use, and it will discuss union independence with the social partners and leaves it to courts to judge.
The use of online means to consult employees in collective bargaining does not, in general terms, constitute an infringement of trade union independence.
Het gebruik van online middelen voor raadpleging van werknemers bij cao-onderhandelingen maakt in algemene zin geen inbreuk op de onafhankelijkheid van vakbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kathmann over het bericht ‘Bagagemedewerkers mogen maximaal 216 koffers per dag tillen op Schiphol, maar zitten vaak aan de 200 per uur’

MPs De Hoop and Kathmann asked the government about a report finding that baggage handlers at Schiphol are exposed to excessive physical strain, and about employer responsibility, liability, enforcement and timelines. The minister answered that employers are primarily responsible under the Working Conditions Act, that the Labour Inspectorate has imposed penalty payments and conducts inspections, and that mechanisation will take 8-10 years while interim measures are required now.

With the penalty payments imposed on the baggage handling companies, the Labour Inspectorate is forcing employers to take technical and organisational measures to limit physical strain as much as possible.

Met de lasten onder dwangsom die zijn opgelegd aan de bagageafhandelaren dwingt de Arbeidsinspectie de werkgevers technische en organisatorische maatregelen te nemen om de fysieke belasting zoveel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Thijssen over kwijtschelding van de waterschapsbelasting

MPs Kathmann and Thijssen asked whether water boards can grant remission of the water board levy to people earning above the welfare norm, whether a progressive levy should be studied, and about social collection practices. The minister answered that boards already may extend remission (cost-of-living norm up to 100% of the welfare norm, higher asset threshold) and that a progressive levy will not be studied because the levy principles of the water system must be preserved.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over recherchebureaus die zonder vergunning onderzoek doen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why private investigation agencies were allowed to keep working without a valid licence after their renewals were delayed by Justis backlogs, and whether this was lawful and what happens to information gathered. The Minister answered that Justis issued a tolerance declaration for around 20 agencies, that it was justified by Justis's own delays, that the agencies could rely on it, and that the gap was later covered by an explicit licence.
The arrangement put in place was considered justified under the circumstances.
De getroffen voorziening is onder de gegeven omstandigheden verantwoord geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het rekenen van extra kosten door zorgverzekeraars voor het ontvangen van post

MP Kathmann asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about health insurer IZA charging €1.25 per month for paper post and how this fits with the Leijten motion on non-digital alternatives. The State Secretary answered that the cooperative VGZ will keep informing vulnerable groups on paper free of charge, that she is talking with private institutions about keeping offline access open, and that the Kamer will receive the outcome in October.
As promised to your House, I am however in discussion with these institutions about how they ensure everyone can continue to participate.
Als toegezegd aan uw Kamer ben ik echter met deze instellingen in gesprek over hoe zij ervoor zorgen dat iedereen mee kan blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over een AOW-gat voor AOW-gerechtigden die enkele jaren in voormalig Nederlands Nieuw-Guinea hebben gewoond

An MP asked the minister why former Dutch New Guinea residents (about 740 AOW recipients, a 11 million euro missed-contribution gap) should not receive a one-off compensation like the Surinamese group, given no transfer agreement existed. The minister replied that the Surinamese recognition gesture reflects a unique combination of circumstances and that extending compensation to other groups would have far-reaching consequences for the AOW system, so no compensation is planned.
Compensation for incomplete AOW accrual for people who were then residents of the Kingdom of the Netherlands would have far-reaching consequences for the AOW system.
Compensatie voor een onvolledige AOW-opbouw voor mensen die destijds ingezetenen van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden waren zou vergaande gevolgen hebben voor het stelsel van de AOW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het artikel ‘Miljoenen snappen digitale overheid onvoldoende, meeste hoofdpijn over DigiD’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a report that millions of Dutch people struggle with digital government services, the difficulties with DigiD, and the effects on benefit take-up. The State Secretary answered that a broader literacy program, alternative non-digital access and the Informatiepunten Digitale Overheid are in place, that research into non-take-up will follow, and that DigiD app updates will improve accessibility.
For people who find it difficult to communicate digitally with the government there must always be an alternative way to contact public service providers.
Voor mensen die het lastig vinden om digitaal te communiceren met de overheid moet er altijd een alternatief zijn om op een andere manier in contact te treden met publieke dienstverleners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kathmann over een uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over het uitzendbeding

MPs Van der Lee and Kathmann asked the minister about the Supreme Court ruling on the temp-agency termination clause and its consequences, including repeated four-week contracts, misuse against holiday pay and pregnancy, and whether the ketenbepaling should apply to phase A. The minister explained the new cao rules, acknowledged some reports of misuse, but declined to extend the chain rule to phase A or change the four-week minimum, promising only an exploratory review of sick-leave termination.
Under the law there is no obligation whatsoever regarding the duration of such an agreement.
Op basis van de wet geldt geen enkele verplichting voor de duur van een dergelijke afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Kathmann over online identiteitsfraude

MPs Mutluer and Kathmann asked about online identity fraude, including its prevalence, links to data hacks, who bears the burden of proof for disputed contracts, and whether businesses should verify customer identities. The minister answered that no central figures exist, pointed to CMI and Fraudemonitor data, stated the trader bears the burden of proof, and said verification is a business responsibility while promising a letter on the Energy Act.
Article 150 of the Code of Civil Procedure provides that the party relying on legal consequences of facts or rights it asserts bears the burden of proving them.
Artikel 150 van de Wet van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering stelt dat de partij die zich beroept op rechtsgevolgen van door haar gestelde feiten of rechten, de bewijslast daarvan draagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de chatbot van Snapchat

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a Snapchat chatbot that presented itself as a real person and proposed meeting children, raising risks of deception, harmful advice and data profiling. The government answered that Snap has changed the feature to disclose it is a chatbot, pointed to upcoming DSA and AI Act obligations, and promised a public awareness campaign and a broader policy letter on children's digital protection.
Before the summer I will send Parliament a broad policy letter on the protection of children in the digital world.
Voor de zomer zal ik een brede beleidsbrief over de bescherming van kinderen in de digitale wereld aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over sociale verzekeringspremies in de binnenvaart

An MP asked how the SVB and Tax Authority decide whether Dutch social insurance premiums apply to inland shipping crew, and whether premiums paid elsewhere matter, plus questions on appeal rights and the 25% working-time test. The government explained the Rhine boatmen agreement and EU coordination rules, said appeals are possible against these decisions, and noted that a relief scheme and collection pause exist for affected crew.
Against both types of determinations, the possibility of objection and appeal is open.
Tegen beide soorten vaststellingen staat de mogelijkheid van bezwaar en beroep open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over loondemping bij toename van het aantal vrouwen in beroepsgroepen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about wage depression in female-dominated occupations, including the Sullerot effect and a reported 7.7% starting-pay gap for female judges and prosecutors. The minister acknowledged the gap, pointed to the EU pay transparency directive and an upcoming report on labour-market discrimination, and said further research on wage depression is being explored without committing to specific new measures.
I am working on a swift implementation of this into Dutch laws and regulations.
Ik werk aan een spoedige implementatie hiervan in de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over problemen met de uitkering van de energietoeslag 2023 vanwege voorschotten op de energietoeslag 2022

MP Kathmann asked whether municipalities that paid €500 of the 2023 energy allowance early as 2022 payments can still pay that amount, and how new 2023 recipients who received nothing earlier would be treated. The minister answered that the €500 is a shift of 2023 funds into 2022, not an advance, that municipalities have policy discretion and must decide whether to top up from their own funds, and that no compensation from the national government will be provided.
Deze toezegging kan ik niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over een fatsoenlijk loon voor werknemers van sociale werkbedrijven

An MP asked the minister whether sheltered-workshop (SW) employees should be compensated for rising prices and why their pay lags behind other civil servants under the new municipal collective agreement. The minister answered that wage matters are primarily for municipalities, social workshops and unions, pointed to general cost-of-living measures, said the state is not party to the cao, and promised further talks with VNG and Cedris before informing the House.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about the Temporary Energy Emergency Fund: application numbers and budget spent, whether the application window stays open, whether households with block heating can get support, and how application problems are being fixed. The minister reported about 70,000 applications, €42 million reserved, a planned scheme for block-heating households opening 25 April, and a computer version of the application that reduced complaints.
The cabinet wants people with a block connection to also benefit from support, in the form of an appropriate compensation.
