Het kabinet wil dat ook mensen met een blokafsluiting kunnen profiteren van steun, in de vorm van een passende tegemoetkoming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Kathmann over de brief van artsenfederatie KNMG over het effect van armoede op ziekte

MPs Bushoff and Kathmann asked the government how it will respond to the KNMG's warning that poverty drives illness, including whether it will reduce health inequalities, target prevention where needed, and act on the KNMG's four recommendations. The state secretaries answered that health gaps are being addressed through existing agreements and programmes, that the KNMG recommendations are under discussion, and that legally anchoring health targets was rejected in a vote, leaving the response largely to policy programmes.
The cabinet is currently holding talks with the KNMG about these recommendations.
Het kabinet voert op dit moment gesprekken met de KNMG over deze aanbevelingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de arbeidsomstandigheden van flitsbezorging

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions of quick-delivery couriers: sick-pay pressure, workload, low pay and demands from a petition. The minister says employers must keep work safe and fair, the Labour Inspectorate has acted on violations, and talks between unions and companies are ongoing, while no new minimum-wage increase is planned.
If quick-delivery workers have to keep working under unfair, unhealthy and/or unsafe conditions despite the talks, I call on them to report this to the Labour Inspectorate.
Indien flitsbezorgers ondanks de gesprekken onder oneerlijke, ongezonde en/of onveilige omstandigheden moeten blijven werken, roep ik hen op dit te melden bij de Arbeidsinspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht “Vrijwilligers in de knel door regels fiscus voor vergoeding: ‘Gedwongen om te stoppen’”

An MP asks the ministers about volunteers on benefits or allowances who must repay volunteer reimbursements above the tax-free threshold, calling the rules unclear and unfair and asking for clearer rules and support. The ministers acknowledge the communication problems, promise to work with the LCR and other ministries on clearer information, and explain the rules as an administrative-burden measure, but offer no change to the rules themselves.
The cabinet would like to work with the LCR to look at options to clarify, in particular, the communication about the rules.
Het kabinet wil graag samen met de LCR kijken naar mogelijkheden om met name de communicatie rond de regels te verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Kathmann over de inkomenseffecten van het afschaffen van de IACK

MPs Maatoug and Kathmann asked what income effects abolishing the IACK has for parents, including new cohorts born from 2025 who lose the credit, and whether the government will compensate those with lower incomes. The minister answers that new cohorts face a negative effect (median about EUR 2,500 per year for single parents and EUR 2,400 for dual-earner couples in a simulation for 2023), that combined with minimum wage and childcare increases a net negative remains, and that there are no concrete plans to compensate, though income policy is reviewed annually.
At present there are no concrete plans to compensate this effect.
Op dit moment zijn er geen concrete plannen om dit effect te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug  over het spoedig uitkeren van de energietoeslag 2023

MPs Kathmann and Maatoug asked the minister why municipalities were told they must wait until about June 2023 to pay the 2023 energy allowance, despite earlier urging to pay early, and about funding shortfalls and continuity of local processes. The minister replied that anticipating the not-yet-enacted law is not justified this year given other income measures, that the 2022 budget via the municipal fund has no evidence of insufficiency, and promised to pursue a faster legislative process.
In my view, there are currently insufficient reasons to justify anticipating the new law.
In mijn ogen zijn er nu onvoldoende redenen die het anticiperen op de nieuwe wet rechtvaardigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over Buy Now, Pay Later betaaldiensten

MP Kathmann asks the Minister about Buy Now, Pay Later services such as Klarna, which may draw young people into debt through high reminder fees and handovers to debt collectors. The Minister acknowledges the risks, says providers must check age and that BNPL will be brought under EU consumer credit rules, and promises talks with providers and a regulatory response.
The cabinet wants to sit down with BNPL providers in the short term to reinforce this call.
Het kabinet wil op korte termijn met de aanbieders van BNPL-betaaldiensten om tafel om deze oproep kracht bij te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug over het bericht dat er een burn-outgolf dreigt als gevolg van de arbeidsmarktkrapte

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of a looming burn-out wave caused by tight labour markets, including prevention, employer risk assessments, after-hours reachability and inspection enforcement. The Minister answered that burn-out rates rose from 12% to 17% and pointed to existing programmes (BMS, RI&E programme, subsidy scheme), inspection figures showing enforcement at 22% and 16% of first inspections, and agreed to answer before the plenary debate on the reachability bill.
I will inform the House shortly about the progress of the BMS.
Ik informeer uw Kamer binnenkort over de voortgang van de BMS.

Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Nijboer over schuldhulpverlening en het krijgen van een baan

MPs Kathmann and Nijboer asked whether people in debt assistance must have their wages paid to a trustee, whether this deters employers, and how to remove that barrier to work. The minister explained that wages go to a account in the debtor's own name managed by a trustee, that this need not stigmatise, and that the government promotes employer support for debt-stressed employees.
As explained, debt assistance and/or the payment of wages into a management account need not be an obstacle to finding work.
Zoals uitgelegd hoeft schuldhulpverlening en/of de uitbetaling van het loon op een beheerrekening geen drempel te zijn bij het vinden van werk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kathmann over het bericht dat er steeds meer tijdelijke contracten worden gegeven in het onderwijs

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that temporary contracts in education are increasing and whether this undermines retention amid teacher shortages. The ministers answered that permanent work should be the norm, outlined measures such as tightening rules on temporary contracts and strategic HRM legislation, and provided university and hogeschool contract ratios for 2015-2021.
The cabinet's starting point is that structural work is in principle organised on the basis of permanent employment contracts.
Het uitgangspunt van het kabinet is dat structureel werk in principe wordt georganiseerd op basis van arbeidsovereenkomsten voor onbepaalde tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het rapport ‘Van schuld naar schone lei’

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about the RVS report 'From debt to clean slate', covering government language on debt, minimum wage timing, debt relief schemes, creditor practices and prevention. The minister answered broadly, committing to pilots, a collective debt arrangement approach, new studies and further talks, without addressing several specific demands directly.

I will discuss with municipalities how we can offer standard guidance to clients of municipal debt assistance before and during a wsnp procedure in all municipalities, and inform the House about this this autumn.

Ik zal met gemeenten bespreken hoe we de begeleiding van cliënten door de gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening naar en tijdens een wsnp-traject in alle gemeenten standaard kunnen aanbieden en uw Kamer daar dit najaar over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over uitsluiting studenten energietoeslag is onrechtmatig

An MP asks the Minister for Poverty Policy whether excluding students from the one-off energy allowance is unlawful and why students are referred to individual special assistance instead. The minister defends the exclusion as justified given the diversity of student housing, notes limited municipal funds (EUR 35 million extra), and rejects changing the law or using DUO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over Rechter: studenten mogen niet als hele groep worden uitgesloten van eenmalige energietoeslag

MP Kathmann asked why the minister has not extended the one-off energy allowance to students following a court ruling that students cannot be excluded as a group, and whether a class action is needed. The minister maintains that excluding students as a group is justified because housing situations vary, points students to individual special assistance, says DUO cannot implement the allowance quickly, and offers extra municipal funds.
I maintain my advice not to give students group access to the one-off energy allowance.
Ik blijf bij mijn advies om studenten niet als groep toegang te geven tot de eenmalige energietoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de indexatie van verkeersboetes

MPs Mutluer and Kathmann asked whether the government will index traffic fines to inflation during a cost-of-living crisis and whether it will exempt them, and how many fines were imposed, unpaid, or led to debt. The Minister of Justice and Security replied that fines are indexed annually to correct for price erosion, that the government will address inflation impacts through other means, and that a review of the indexation method is planned.
I have instructed my department to review the long-standing system for indexing Wahv fines based on inflation.
Wel heb ik mijn departement opdracht gegeven om de reeds lang bestaande systematiek voor de indexering van Wahv-boetes gebaseerd op de inflatie tegen het licht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht dat PostNL een nieuwe digitale kloof creëert door afschaffing van papieren 'niet-thuisberichtjes'

MP Kathmann asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether replacing paper 'not at home' notices with digital ones by PostNL creates a digital divide and whether the government will act on it, including a motion on offline options. The minister answered that paper notices remain for universal postal service parcels and registered or medical post, that PostNL accepts responsibility to support non-digital users, and that the government sees no need to talk to PostNL itself.
I therefore see no need to hold a conversation with PostNL myself on this subject.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak om nu zelf een gesprek met PostNL te voeren over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en de Hoop over het bericht 'stagiair wordt ingezet als goedkope arbeidskracht'

PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether unpaid internships, which are widespread and may amount to cheap labour, are acceptable, and whether a fixed internship allowance or a reporting point for abuse should be introduced. The minister replied that internships are for learning, that employers are not legally obliged to pay, that he will discuss voluntary agreements with the education and labour sectors, and that the Labour Inspectorate handles complaints about unpaid work under the minimum wage act.
I will therefore enter into discussions with the education and labour sectors to make agreements on how more employers can be ensured to offer an appropriate internship allowance.
Ik zal daarom met het onderwijs- en werkveld in gesprek gaan om afspraken te maken hoe er gezorgd kan worden dat meer werkgevers een passende stagevergoeding bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over aandelenovername kinderopvangketen Partou

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the sale of childcare chain Partou from private equity firm Onex to Waterland, including subsidy flows, worker and parent influence, and regulatory oversight. The minister answered that the deal's amount is undisclosed, that the effects are not yet known, and that a study on financing forms in childcare will be sent to parliament in Q1 2023, while explaining the roles of the ACM and AFM.
The amount involved in the takeover has not been disclosed.
Het bedrag dat met de overname is gemoeid, is niet bekend gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over long-Covid bij leraren en onderwijsondersteunend personeel

An MP asked the ministers about long covid among teachers and support staff, including WIA disability benefits, loss of wage continuation, medical costs, a possible third sick year, and a compensation fund like the one for care workers. The government answered that it does not register the reason for sick leave, provides no sector-specific data, applies the general sickness and disability rules, and that the care-sector subsidy is not planned for education.
During the period of sickness before a WIA application is made, the reason for sick leave is not registered.
Tijdens de periode van ziekte voordat er een WIA-aanvraag wordt gedaan, wordt de reden van ziekmelding niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over verkoop van levensgevaarlijk speelgoed op Bol.com

An MP asked the minister whether Bol.com bears moral and legal responsibility for dangerous toys sold by third-party sellers on its platform, and whether stricter notice-and-takedown or liability rules and tougher NVWA enforcement are warranted. The minister answered that marketplaces must take responsibility, pointed to the Product Safety Pledge, the 2019 NVWA-Bol.com protocol, the DSA, and pending EU product safety and market surveillance regulations, and saw no reason for additional legislation or stronger enforcement now.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het verbieden van mobiele telefoons door GXO

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether GXO's ban on workers bringing mobile phones into the warehouse, and reports of unsafe conditions and 'slave-like' treatment, were justified and whether the Labour Inspectorate would be asked to inspect. The minister replied that the employer may issue such a safety-based instruction, that phone use was later allowed when not used during work, that late cancellation of on-call shifts without pay is illegal, and that the Labour Inspectorate sets its own risk-based priorities, with the warehouse sector already in its focus.
The Netherlands Labour Authority works programmatically and on a risk basis, and is an independent supervisory body.
De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie werkt programmatisch en risicogericht, en is onafhankelijk toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Nijboer over "achterblijvende reiskostenvergoeding voor werknemers"

MPs Kathmann and Nijboer asked the government about rising commuting costs, the non-indexed tax-free travel allowance, and low employer reimbursement in low-wage sectors. The minister answered that the cost effects vary by worker, data on employer practices is incomplete, a study on modernising the allowance is due in 2022, and temporary fuel excise cuts and a planned future increase of the allowance are pointed to.
The Ministry of Finance is conducting research into modernising the travel allowance, and this research will be delivered in 2022.
Het Ministerie van Financiën doet onderzoek naar een modernisering van de reiskostenvergoeding, dat onderzoek zal in 2022 worden opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug over private equity Bencis koopt in stilte weer kinderopvangverblijven op

MPs Kathmann and Maatoug asked the Minister of Social Affairs about private equity firm Bencis buying back childcare centres, the Estro/Smallsteps history, lack of parent information on ownership, rising tariffs, interest payments and profit levels in childcare. The minister answered that ownership is public but parents should be proactively informed, that a study of financing forms (including possible profit or tariff limits) will be launched, and that tariff caps are not currently under consideration.
That is why I want to investigate the role of the different financing forms in childcare.
Daarom wil ik de rol van de verschillende financieringsvormen in de kinderopvang gaan onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het tegengaan criminele activiteiten via de verzending van postpakketten

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about rising drug trafficking through parcel post, the Customs and police interception results, the Sensing project, screening rates, and whether senders should be required to identify themselves. The minister reported intensified Customs controls and seizures, planned a Multidisciplinary Post Team, and rejected a sender identification requirement as ineffective and disproportionate, while committing to examine ways to lift sender anonymity.
It is not possible to state how many parcels or postal items are checked in this way, as this is not recorded.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel pakketten of poststukken op deze wijzen gecontroleerd worden, dit wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over gokken door minderjarigen

An MP asked whether minors could deposit money into online gambling accounts via third-party bank accounts and what enforcement was planned. The minister said the Kansspelautoriteit has acted against one operator, that third-party deposits are already prohibited, and that no further signals are known, while noting that Holland Casino fixed a related issue.
Should an operator violate the law, the Kansspelautoriteit will take action against it.
Mocht een aanbieder de wet overtreden zal de Kansspelautoriteit daartegen actie ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en van Nispen over de “te slappe” aanpak van geweld tegen hulpverleners

MPs Kathmann and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether the prosecution service's handling of violence against care workers, including out-of-court OM penalty orders, undermines victims' sense of being taken seriously and their right to be heard. The Minister answered that OM penalty orders are a full legal equivalent of a court judgment, that the OM considers victims' interests and their right to be heard, and that victims can challenge a penalty order via a complaint to the appeals court under article 12 Sv.
The OM supports the victim as well as possible in obtaining compensation for their material and immaterial damage.
Het OM ondersteunt het slachtoffer zo goed als mogelijk bij het verkrijgen van een vergoeding van zijn materiële en immateriële schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de strafbaarstelling van femicide

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether femicide with a sexist motive should get its own offence with a higher maximum sentence than ordinary manslaughter, and whether the current definition of premeditation is too hard to prove in cases after stalking or abuse. The minister answered that the existing offences suffice, pointed to a bill raising the manslaughter maximum from 15 to 25 years, and said prevention efforts with police and Veilig Thuis are the focus.
For additional legislative measures in the form of a specific offence of manslaughter with a sexist motive carrying a higher maximum penalty, I see no need.
Voor aanvullende wetgevende maatregelen in de vorm van een specifieke strafbaarstelling van doodslag met een seksistisch oogmerk met een hoger strafmaximum zie ik geen noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de digitale kwetsbaarheid van gemeenten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about municipalities struggling with ICT quality, security and privacy, and about sharing best practices. The State Secretary said the government has no overview of municipal ICT quality, that municipalities are responsible themselves within the BIO framework, and listed knowledge-sharing initiatives and a commitment to work with the VNG on strengthening digital resilience.
No, I do not have an overview of the quality of municipal ICT systems.
Nee, ik beschik niet over een overzicht van de kwaliteit van ICT-systemen van gemeenten.

Antwoord op vragen van leden Kuiken en Kathmann over het veilige verloop van de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen en de gevolgen van de snelle toename van het aantal besmettingen voor de organisatie van de gemeenteraadsverkiezin

Two PvdA MPs asked how rising COVID-19 infections affect the safe organisation of the municipal elections, including adequacy of measures, mobile polling stations, polling staff and contacts with municipalities. The minister answers that the Temporary COVID-19 Elections Act provides sufficient powers, that voter turnout is not expected to fall, that municipalities decide on mobile polling stations, and that a national recruitment campaign is not needed but support materials are provided.
The Temporary COVID-19 Elections Act (Twv) provides the legal basis for taking the measures needed to keep elections safe during the coronavirus pandemic.
De Tijdelijke wet verkiezingen covid-19 (Twv) biedt de grondslag voor het nemen van maatregelen die nodig zijn om verkiezingen veilig te houden tijdens de coronapandemie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het rapport Kwetsbaar door software – Lessen naar aanleiding van beveiligingslekken door software van Citrix

MP Kathmann asked the ministers about the Safety Board's report on software vulnerabilities (Citrix) and whether software makers should bear responsibility, invest more, and face liability. The government says it is studying the report, points to existing measures such as the Roadmap for Digitally Secure Hardware and Software and EU certification efforts, and defers liability and quality-requirement questions to the European level, promising a full response before summer.
As stated in the letter to parliament of 16 December 2021, the cabinet will study the report carefully and respond in writing to the OVV within the statutory six-month period.
Zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 16 december 2021 zal het kabinet het rapport zorgvuldig bestuderen en binnen de wettelijke reactietermijn van zes maanden schriftelijk richting de OVV reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over vergoeding van schade naar aanleiding van een uitspraak van de civiele rechter

An MP asked whether private parties holding civil-court damages claims against childcare benefit victims should receive government advances during the moratorium, as crime victims with criminal damages awards do. The minister confirmed awareness, explained that advances apply only to criminal-court damages awards, and said civil claimants must enforce judgments themselves.
A citizen can claim damages in civil proceedings on the basis of tort.
Een burger kan in civiele procedures schadevergoeding eisen op grond van onrechtmatige daad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht dat meer dan de helft van de Amsterdamse taxichauffeurs betrokken was bij strafzaken in de afgelopen drie jaar

MPs Kathmann asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government responds to a report that over half of Amsterdam taxi drivers were involved in criminal cases in three years, including whether this occurs elsewhere, how drivers are made resilient, how supervision works, and whether large taxi platforms should be restricted. The minister answered that the report is noted, that a joint integral approach with multiple agencies is being explored, that licensing and VOG screening are in place, and that platform rules will be reviewed in the periodic taxi law evaluation due in 2023.

Together with the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, the municipality of Amsterdam, the Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport, the Public Prosecution Service, the police, the Regional Information and Expertise Centres and the Tax Authority, measures that could be taken in response to the Bureau Beke study are being explored.

Met het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, de gemeente Amsterdam, de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport, het Openbaar Ministerie, de politie, de Regionale Informatie en Expertise Centra en de Belastingdienst wordt naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van Bureau Beke verkend welke maatregelen er kunnen worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kathmann over het bericht dat 5G zorgt voor een toename in het energieverbruik van telecommunicatie

MPs Thijssen and Kathmann asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the energy use of 5G networks was studied beforehand, why 5G masts are not yet used efficiently, and whether the government should accelerate greening of the telecom sector. The minister answered that energy efficiency has been an ongoing concern, that industry has strong incentives to reduce consumption, and that the government sees no need for a specific state role, pointing to EU-level cooperation instead.
I am of the view that the telecommunications sector is making considerable efforts to deliver its services as energy-consciously as possible.
Ik ben van mening dat de telecommunicatiesector zich aanzienlijk inspant om zijn diensten zo energiebewust als mogelijk te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over incidenten in het Justitieel Complex Zaanstad

MP Kathmann asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether recent incidents at the Zaanstad prison complex are exceptional, whether the situation is worrying and safe, and whether scale matters. The minister answered that incidents are inherent to prisons, that Zaanstad has a relatively high number of misconduct reports largely due to its special regimes, that the situation is comparable to other institutions, and that additional safety measures were announced.
I see no link between incidents and the size of the penal institution.
Ik constateer geen verband tussen voorvallen en de grootte van de penitentiaire inrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het vervolgen van een verdachte van moord die in India verblijft

An MP asked the Justice Minister why India refuses to extradite a murder suspect in the 'Haagse ijskastmoord' case, what steps have been taken, and whether India would prosecute domestically. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stressed the need to prevent impunity, and said Dutch authorities are seeking alternative ways to ensure prosecution.
On individual criminal cases, contact about them with a foreign authority, and the way a foreign authority acts, I do not make statements.
Over individuele strafzaken, het contact daarover met een buitenlandse autoriteit en de wijze waarop door een buitenlandse autoriteit wordt gehandeld, doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de verwarring die ontstaan is over welke dienst er bij de politie verantwoordelijk is voor de aanpak van ondermijning

An MP asked the Justice Minister to clarify the responsibilities of the MIT, the Taskforce Aanpak Criminele Machtsstructuren and the new strategic knowledge centre against organised crime, and about inter-service rivalry, data sharing of encrypted chat data and statements by police leaders. The minister answered that the bodies are still being set up, outlined their roles, rejected turf competition, said the police leadership culture is being addressed and that the legal use of Encrochat/Sky data is under review.

It is currently being legally examined whether the data obtained from these criminal investigations can be used by the participating organisations in the MIT for joint analysis purposes, and under what conditions and safeguards within the existing frameworks.

Momenteel wordt juridisch onderzocht of de data verkregen uit de genoemde opsporingsonderzoeken door de deelnemende organisaties in het MIT kan worden gebruikt voor gezamenlijke analysedoeleinden, en onder welke voorwaarden en waarborgen binnen de bestaande kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht ‘Chef undercover unit moet het veld ruimen’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reported distrust, high workload and leadership turnover at the police Dienst Speciale Operaties (DSO) undercover unit, and whether the head's departure endangers field safety. The minister said an Inspectorate investigation is ongoing with results expected early 2022, a leadership improvement programme is underway, the unit head is stepping down to hand over leadership, and he will not comment on individual officers' functioning.

The investigation is still ongoing. The Inspectorate has informed me that the investigation at the AO department is expected to be completed by the end of the year and can be presented to your House in early 2022.

Het onderzoek loopt op dit moment nog. De Inspectie heeft mij laten weten dat het onderzoek bij de afdeling AO naar verwachting voor het einde van het jaar zal worden voltooid en begin 2022 aan uw Kamer kan worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Kuiken over de aanpak van drugscriminaliteit in Utrecht

MPs Kathmann and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about drug crime in Utrecht, including whether police capacity is sufficient and whether the government will act on the mayor's concerns. The minister said crime has fallen overall but shifted in nature, that police staffing will recover around 2024-2025, and that he will ask the Strategic Council on Undermining for advice on funding allocation and will meet the mayor.
I speak with the mayor of Utrecht regularly.
Ik spreek de burgemeester van Utrecht regelmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kathmann over mogelijke dataverzameling van Chinese drones

Written questions from MP Kathmann asked whether data from Chinese DJI drones used by the police and Rijkswaterstaat could flow to Chinese servers, and why Defence avoids them. The government answered that risks are assessed per case, that data safeguards were applied, that police and Rijkswaterstaat will keep using the drones for non-confidential tasks, and that it sees no reason to change course.
Should we nonetheless see cause to discuss this with the police and/or Rijkswaterstaat, we will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Mochten wij alsnog aanleiding zien om hierover in gesprek te gaan met de politie en/of Rijkswaterstaat, dan zullen wij uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Kuiken en De Hoop over de samenwerking tussen Nederland en China bij onderzoek naar DNA

MPs Kathmann, Kuiken and De Hoop asked whether Dutch scientists collaborated with Chinese researchers on DNA techniques that could predict appearance and whether results could be misused against Uyghurs and Tibetans, and asked about ethics review and risk screening. The minister said Erasmus MC and LUMC denied involvement in the specific China-linked studies, promised a meeting with institutions and an update in early 2022, and pointed to ongoing knowledge-security measures.
I will inform you in early 2022 about the outcomes of that.
Ik zal u begin 2022 informeren over de uitkomsten daarvan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Ellian en Kathmann over internationale kinderontvoeringen

MPs Van Nispen, Ellian and Kathmann asked how countries that are party to the Hague Child Abduction Convention but fail to comply can be held to account, whether the agreements are adequately enforced, and whether the Dutch Central Authority has sufficient capacity. The Minister answered that return is the starting point but courts decide, that cooperation and the revised Brussels II-bis regulation from August 2022 aim to improve enforcement, and that the Central Authority responds on average within five working days.
It is not for me to pass judgment on the ruling of an independent judicial body (in another country).
Het is niet aan mij een oordeel te vellen over de uitspraak van een onafhankelijke gerechtelijke instantie (in een ander land).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de voorschotregeling voor slachtoffers van misdrijven

An MP asked whether victims of violent and other crimes can receive an advance from the state when a perpetrator's payment of compensation is suspended under a moratorium, and whether the 5,000 euro cap applies. The minister answered that the state will pay victims an advance equal to the amount normally collected from the offender during the moratorium, without the 5,000 euro cap, and that the advance rule protects victims from a perpetrator's temporary inability to pay.

Since I consider this an undesirable situation, on 14 June I decided to pay victims of violent and other crimes an advance during the moratorium so that they are not disadvantaged by the temporary suspension.

Aangezien ik dit een ongewenste situatie vind, heb ik op 14 juni jl. besloten om gedurende het moratorium een voorschot aan de slachtoffers van gewelds- en andere misdrijven uit te keren zodat zij niet worden benadeeld door de tijdelijke opschorting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Kuiken over het manifest van Brabantse burgemeesters tegen ondermijnende criminaliteit

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about a manifesto by Brabant mayors calling for a tougher approach to undermining crime, including softdrug legalisation and prevention of youth recruitment into crime. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government shares the urgency, cites new funding and a coffeeshop-chain experiment, and disagrees with legalising softdrugs before the experiment's results are known.
I am convinced that with these we contribute to strengthening our rule of law and making the Netherlands less attractive for organised drug crime.
Ik ben ervan overtuigd dat we hiermee bijdragen aan de versteviging van onze rechtsstaat en Nederland minder aantrekkelijk maken voor georganiseerde drugscriminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kathmann over het bericht dat de digitale veiligheid onvoldoende is

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers whether they accepted findings that cybersecurity at hazardous-substance companies (Brzo) in Zuid-Holland is inadequate and what they would do. The ministers accepted that more attention to cybersecurity is needed, described shared responsibilities of companies, provinces and national departments, and listed existing measures such as NCSC support, Wbni designation and Digital Trust Center tools.
That is why it is important that companies get to work on this.
Daarom is het van belang dat bedrijven hier mee aan de slag gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de interpretatie van het begrip “wettige nakomelingen” in artikel 25 en artikel 31 van de Grondwet

An MP asked the Prime Minister how the constitutional term 'wettige nakomelingen' (lawful descendants) in articles 25 and 31 should be read, including whether children from same-sex marriages, adoption, or donor/surrogacy should qualify for succession. The government answered that a successor may marry a same-sex partner without losing the throne, but declined to settle the succession status of such children now, deferring it to a future consent law and case-specific weighing.
It is not useful to anticipate such a weighing regarding succession now, in the context of a consent law.
Het is niet dienstig om nu vooruit te lopen op een dergelijke weging omtrent de erfopvolging in het kader van een toestemmingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de mogelijkheid van vervolging van klanten van minderjarige cocaïnedealers

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Justice whether prosecution of buyers of cocaine from minors should be prioritised, whether legislation should raise penalties for such buyers, and what practical or legal obstacles exist. The Minister answered that buyers and sellers are already liable to prosecution, that local police set priorities, that capacity is the main constraint and is being addressed, and that existing law already allows heavier sentences for minor sellers so no legal change is needed.
I do not consider amending the law necessary for that reason.
Aanpassing van de wet acht ik om die reden niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kathmann over het bericht dat verdachtenverhoor bij de politie tekortschiet

MP Kathmann asked the Justice Minister about a report that police interrogations of suspects fall short, and why the OM replaced its recording directive with a non-public instruction. Minister Grapperhaus rejected the claim of insufficient interrogator skill, explained that the directive was converted into an instruction under a broader OM policy cleanup, and defended not publishing instructions since they have no external effect.
Instructions as such have no external effect; third parties cannot derive rights from them.
Instructies hebben als zodanig geen externe werking; derden kunnen er geen rechten aan ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Kathmann over de hulp van ambtenaren bij een privékwestie van de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

MPs Arib and Kathmann asked whether ministry officials helped State Secretary Knops with a private land purchase matter, and whether that is appropriate. The minister answers that the ministry checked the facts because integrity was at issue, found no improper conduct, and declines to publish the landsadvocaat's advice while stating the ministry bore no responsibility for the private lawsuit.
To be as transparent as possible, I have attached the email with which the landsadvocaat was asked for advice.
Om zoveel mogelijk transparant te zijn, heb ik de e-mail bijgevoegd waarmee de landsadvocaat om advies is gevraagd.
Antwoord van de leden Kathmann, Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over kleinschalige evenementen die niet door kunnen gaan wegens corona

MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why restaurants with a terrace permit may not organise small events under the COVID-19 rules, and about the economic harm and possible support. The Minister confirmed the rule (article 4.4 of the Trm) is tied to the epidemiological situation, acknowledged the business impact, said the loss of revenue from events is unclear, and pointed to the TVL support scheme and a planned supplementary scheme for night-time hospitality.
For entrepreneurs in sectors including hospitality who lose more than 30% of their income due to the corona measures, the TVL scheme is open among others.
Voor ondernemers uit onder andere de horeca die meer dan 30% van hun inkomsten missen door de coronamaatregelen staat onder meer de TVL regeling open.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gündoğan, Simons en Kathmann over het bericht “Kabinet wil ‘homogenezing’ ‘krachtig tegengaan’ maar komt niet met een verbod”

MPs Gündoğan, Simons and Kathmann asked the Health Minister whether conversion therapy should be banned, given that it harms minors and that a legal ban was part of the COC Rainbow Accord. The minister agreed that conversion therapy is unacceptable and noted it can already be prosecuted under existing criminal and civil law, but declined to commit to a specific ban, promising a broader exploration of further measures first.
For this reason the cabinet will carry out a broad exploration of possible effective additional measures, including legislation and regulation, including the option of some form of a legal ban.

Om die reden zal het kabinet een brede verkenning uitvoeren naar mogelijke, effectieve nadere maatregelen, waaronder wet- en regelgeving, inclusief de optie van mogelijkheden voor enige vorm van een wettelijk verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kathmann en Kuiken over het schietincident bij de ggz-locatie Parnassia

Two MPs asked the Justice and Security and Health ministers about a shooting at a mental health facility, whether the perpetrator's firearm permit had been revoked, whether such persons should be monitored, and how to protect mental health staff from violence. The government answered that the permit was withdrawn and weapons seized, that revoked-permit holders are not specifically monitored under the Firearms Act though past compulsory-care records are weighed in new applications, that no reliable violence statistics exist, and that it will work with sector partners on reporting and a police-mental health cooperation protocol.
Violence against care workers is not subject to a reporting obligation and is not recorded in a uniform way in police systems.
Geweld tegen hulpverleners is niet meldingsplichtig en wordt niet op een eenduidige manier vastgelegd in de politiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Van der Laan, Ellemeet, Kathmann en Simons over het bericht 'Kabinet biedt excuses aan voor oude transgenderwet'

MPs asked why the compensation scheme for the former transgender sterilisation requirement was not published by 1 July, how the Transgender and Intersex Collective was involved, and why the amount is EUR 5,000. The minister said publication was delayed, the Collective was consulted and its input shaped the scheme, the amount follows an earlier scheme for youth care abuse victims, and the scheme will be published in the Staatscourant with applications from 18 October 2021.
It has become apparent that drafting the scheme and preparing its implementation required more time than originally estimated.
Het is gebleken dat de totstandkoming van de regeling en het voorbereiden van de uitvoering meer tijd vereisten dan op voorhand was ingeschat.
Antwoord op van de leden Kuiken en Kathmann inzake de mishandeling van een veertienjarig meisje

MPs Kuiken and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister how he views the assault on a 14-year-old girl, whether he will publicly condemn it and reach out to the victim, and whether a higher maximum sentence for discriminatory motive should be introduced. The minister condemns discrimination in general, declines to comment on the criminal case under investigation, and states that a statutory discriminatory-motive aggravating factor would bring clear benefits, pointing to a pending member's bill.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation in this case, I cannot make further statements about it.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek in deze casus kan ik daar verder geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht dat de politie zich zorgen maakt over de toename van zelfgemaakte bommen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police concern over a rise in homemade bombs, whether further measures are planned, whether explosive precursors can be banned like drug precursors, whether police have enough capacity, and whether enough is done against illegal fireworks. The minister answered that the tightened EU precursor regulation took effect in February 2021, that enforcement is shared with the ILT, that police capacity is limited but priorities are set, and that illegal fireworks enforcement is being intensified with more seizures in 2020.
Activities involving serious danger, such as the possible production of explosives, are given priority.
Activiteiten met een ernstige gevaarzetting zoals het mogelijk produceren van explosieven krijgen prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van Ginneken over het bericht dat Russen ten tijde van het MH17-onderzoek door een hack diep in de systemen van de politie zaten

MPs Kathmann and Van Ginneken asked whether Russian hackers accessed police systems during the MH17 investigation, how well police systems were secured, and about friction with the AIVD and the police's cybersecurity measures. Minister Grapperhaus answered that for state-security reasons he cannot comment on specific measures or incidents, said there is no friction with the AIVD, referred to general measures such as the BIO baseline and red teaming, and declined to answer questions on uncorrected security recommendations.
For reasons of state security, I cannot make statements about the specific measures taken by the services under my responsibility.
Vanwege staatsveiligheid kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de specifieke maatregelen die de onder mij ressorterende diensten treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Laan, Bromet en Kathmann over het bericht ‘raadsleden pleiten voor modernisering verlofregeling’

Four MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether leave arrangements for councillors should be modernised, following a letter from three municipal councils. The Minister said the current leave rules for elected representatives were a deliberate choice, that broader leave is not warranted, and that she will consult professional associations and administrative bodies on possible flexibilisation, leaving any legislative change to her successor.

I want to see whether the Dutch Association of Councillors, the Dutch Association of Provincial Members and the Association of Water Board Members support the call for a more flexible arrangement set out in the letter.

Ik wil bezien of de Nederlandse Vereniging van Raadsleden, de Nederlandse Vereniging van Statenleden en de Vereniging van algemeen bestuursleden van de Waterschappen het pleidooi voor een flexibeler regeling uit de brief ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Van Nispen en Kathmann over het terughalen van ontvoerde kinderen

MPs Ellian, Van Nispen and Kathmann asked the Minister for Legal Protection about slow cooperation between central authorities in international child abduction cases, including a case of a child taken to Thailand, and what could be done to speed up return. The minister said cooperation is generally adequate, that deadlines vary by country, that the Hague Convention sets a six-week guideline, and that the Thailand case has full attention without discussing the individual case.
Without going into the individual case, I can assure you that the matter of Mr De K. has the full attention of the Central Authority.
Zonder in te gaan op de individuele casus kan ik u verzekeren dat de zaak van de heer De K. de volle aandacht van de Centrale autoriteit heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de inwerkingtreding van de Wet straffen en beschermen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how the entry into force of the Wet straffen en beschermen affects leave eligibility for prisoners already detained, and whether transitional rules should protect those whose detention was postponed due to COVID. The minister confirmed the new leave rules apply immediately from 1 July 2021, with applications assessed under the regime in force at filing, and declined a transitional arrangement, citing the immediate-effect principle and administrative complexity.
Within the execution of sentences, immediate effect is the starting point, which I consider permissible for (among other things) the new re-integration leave.
Binnen de tenuitvoerlegging geldt onmiddellijke werking als uitgangspunt, hetgeen ik geoorloofd acht voor (onder meer) het nieuwe re-integratieverlof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de oproep van agenten om het dreigend vragen naar privégegevens strafbaar te stellen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police calls to criminalise threatening requests for officers' private data (doxing), and the effect on police work and recruitment. The minister condemns intimidation of police, encourages officers to file complaints, and announces a consultation on a new criminal offence for doxing before the summer recess.
This is a societal problem that I am looking into with urgency.
Dit is een maatschappelijk probleem waarnaar ik met urgentie naar ga kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht dat de meeste Nederlandse bedrijven niet voldoen aan privacywetgeving

MP Kathmann asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that most Dutch companies do not comply with GDPR/AVG privacy rules, and whether the burden unfairly falls on European firms dependent on non-European tech giants. The minister answered that the AVG divides responsibilities between controllers and processors, acknowledged that smaller firms struggle to negotiate compliant cloud contracts, and pointed to government DPIAs, supervisory-authority involvement, and European cloud initiatives such as GAIA-X as remedies.
Currently, the possibilities are being explored to broaden this approach to the other strategic suppliers of the central government.
Momenteel worden de mogelijkheden verkend om deze aanpak te verbreden tot de andere strategische leveranciers van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de Belgische overheid die (gedeeltelijk) plat lag door een DDoS-aanval

An MP asked the government about a reported DDoS attack that disrupted parts of the Belgian government, including how often the Dutch government is targeted, whether it is resilient, whether it proactively scans for vulnerabilities, whether an emergency protocol exists, whether contact was made with Belgium, and lessons learned. The State Secretary answered that no complete picture of attacks exists, points to existing frameworks (NCSA, BIO, NCP-Digitaal, proactive vulnerability scanning), and reports contacts with CERT-BE and the Belgian federal government.
There is no complete picture of the number of attacks on which the Dutch government has been a target.
Er is geen volledig beeld van het aantal aanvallen waarvan de Nederlandse overheid doelwit is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen en Kathmann over overleveringen aan Polen

MPs Van Nispen and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister why the Netherlands still extradites suspects to Poland despite rule-of-law concerns, whether judges can suspend extraditions, and what safeguards and alternatives exist. The minister answered that each extradition request is individually tested by the Amsterdam court under CJEU case law, that suspension requires a systemic breach finding, and that guarantees and return arrangements are possible but limited.
Surrender can only be refused if there are grounds for it in the individual case.
Overlevering kan alleen worden geweigerd als daar in het individuele geval gronden voor bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over voedselvoorziening als vitale infrastructuur

MP Kathmann asked the Justice and Security Minister whether food supply should be designated critical infrastructure, its criteria, NCSC support, and cyberattack risks and detection rates. The government explained that designation follows objective impact criteria reviewed every four years, that a food-sector assessment is planned later this year, and that cybercrime detection is complex and being addressed through broader measures.
Such a vitality assessment of food supply will take place later this year within this framework by the responsible ministry (Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality).
Een dergelijke vitaliteitsbeoordeling van de voedselvoorziening vindt in het kader hiervan later dit jaar plaats door het verantwoordelijke Ministerie (Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit).
Antwoord op vragen van Kathmann over de aanpak van matchfixing

Kathmann (PvdA) asks the Minister for Legal Protection whether sports federations are right that the government lacks urgency on matchfixing, and whether a Sports Betting Intelligence Unit and better handling of Wwft reports are needed. The minister rejects the urgency criticism, points to an information coordinator pilot evaluated this summer, says the Kansspelautoriteit's role is limited to supervising licensees' detection duties, and agrees that suspicious Wwft reports must be recognisable as matchfixing signals, citing FIU powers and a planned fast lane to sports bodies.
The results of the evaluation will be shared with your House.
De resultaten van de evaluatie zullen met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over sancties voor racisme en discriminatie binnen de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the mild disciplinary sanctions for racism and discrimination within the police and whether the sanctioning model should be tightened. The Minister answered that the police leadership will review the sanctioning system, hold dialogue with the police and stakeholders, but rejected an external disciplinary tribunal for the police, citing the existing internal system and the AGFA advisory commission.
Partially removing the responsibility to determine disciplinary measures for improper conduct and placing it externally does not, in the police's view, contribute to an open, transparent climate.

Het – gedeeltelijk – weghalen van de verantwoordelijkheid om disciplinaire maatregelen te bepalen bij ongeoorloofd gedrag en deze extern neerleggen, draagt naar het oordeel van de politie niet bij aan een open, transparant klimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van Nispen over het stopzetten van AMBER Alert

MPs Kathmann and Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the police are ending the AMBER Alert contract for missing-child alerts and moving them into Burgernet, questioning its effectiveness, cost, consultation and the minister's earlier praise. Minister Grapperhaus answered all eleven questions, defending the move as lawful and cost-efficient while stating that missing-child alerts continue and the minister remains convinced of their value.
The police decided not to extend the commercial contract with Netpresenter B.V. for the service for this functionality, currently branded AMBER Alert.
De politie heeft besloten het commerciële contract met het bedrijf Netpresenter B.V. voor de dienstverlening voor deze functionaliteit, die momenteel de merknaam AMBER Alert draagt, niet te verlengen

m: Amendement van het lid Stultiens c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over middelen voor het terugdraaien van bezuinigingen
Amends the education budget to reverse planned cuts of about €1.6 billion per year, funded by offsetting measures.
This amendment therefore completely reverses these cuts.
Dit amendement maakt deze bezuinigingen daarom volledig ongedaan.
Amendement van het lid Stultiens c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 6 over middelen voor het terugdraaien van bezuinigingen
Reverses planned education, culture and science budget cuts of about 1.6 billion euros per year by increasing spending across many articles of the education budget.
This amendment therefore fully reverses these cuts.
Dit amendement maakt deze bezuinigingen daarom volledig ongedaan.
Amendement van het lid Stultiens c.s. over middelen voor het terugdraaien van bezuinigingen
Amendment restoring about 1.6 billion euro per year in education, culture, science and related budget lines by reversing planned cuts.
This amendment therefore fully reverses these cuts.
Dit amendement maakt deze bezuinigingen daarom volledig ongedaan.
Motie van de leden Westerveld en Pijpelink over de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage afschaffen
Asks the government to abolish the voluntary parental contribution to schools to reduce educational inequality.
Requests the government to abolish the voluntary parental contribution.
verzoekt de regering om de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage af te schaffen
Motie van de leden Westerveld en Pijpelink over erkennen dat kansengelijkheid breder is dan het bevorderen van basisvaardigheden en het beleid richten op de brede definitie
Asks the government to recognise that equal opportunity in education is broader than mastering basic skills and to target policy accordingly.
requests the government to recognise that equal opportunity is broader than promoting basic skills and to focus policy on the broad definition
verzoekt de regering om te erkennen dat kansengelijkheid breder is dan het bevorderen van basisvaardigheden en het beleid te richten op de brede definitie
Motie van het lid Pijpelink over bijlessen en examentrainingen niet langer vrijstellen van btw en deze gelden herinvesteren in bijlessen op school
Asks the government to end the VAT exemption for private tutoring and exam training and reinvest the revenue in school tutoring.
requests the government to no longer exempt private tutoring and exam training from VAT
verzoekt de regering om bijlessen en examentrainingen niet langer vrij te stellen van btw
Motie van het lid Dassen c.s. over het creëren van bewustwording bij scholen omtrent het inzetten van private onderwijsondersteuning
Asks the government to raise schools' awareness, via education councils, about private education support providers until a regulatory structure exists.
requests the government to create awareness via the education councils
verzoekt de regering om via de onderwijsraden bewustwording te creëren
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Stultiens c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 4 over middelen voor het terugdraaien van voorgenomen bezuinigingen
Amendment reversing the proposed cuts of about 2 billion euro a year to the education, research and culture budget by reallocating funds across OCW budget articles.
This amendment therefore fully reverses these cuts.
Dit amendement maakt deze bezuinigingen daarom volledig ongedaan.
Motie van de leden Pijpelink en Rooderkerk over de hoogste prioriteit geven aan de aanpak van het lerarentekort en de achteruitgang van de beheersing van de basisvaardigheden
Asks the government to give the highest priority to tackling the teacher shortage and declining basic skills in primary and secondary education policy.
requests the government to give highest priority to tackling these problems in the coming period
verzoekt de regering om de aanpak van deze problemen de komende tijd de hoogste prioriteit te geven

Motie van het lid Pijpelink over het uitgangspunt hanteren dat de overheid de kerndoelen en eindtermen vaststelt en scholen hun eigen keuzes maken uit het aanbod van methodes van educatieve uitgeverij
Asks the government to adopt as a principle that it sets core goals and attainment targets while schools freely choose methods from publishers, citing constitutional education freedom.
the government sets core goals and attainment targets for primary and secondary education, publishers write methods, and schools have freedom to choose from the offer

de overheid voor het funderend onderwijs de kerndoelen en eindtermen vaststelt, de educatieve uitgeverijen daarvoor methodes schrijven en de scholen de vrijheid hebben uit het aanbod hun keuzes te maken
Motie van de leden Beckerman en Pijpelink over onderzoek doen naar het aanpakken van marktwerking in schoolboeken
Asks the government to research tackling market forces in school textbook pricing and supply.
requests the government to conduct research into tackling market forces in school textbooks
verzoekt de regering onderzoek te doen naar het aanpakken van marktwerking in schoolboeken
Motie van het lid Rooderkerk c.s. over uitspreken dat de btw op school- en studieboeken niet verhoogd moet worden
Asks the House to state that VAT on school and study books should not be raised, as planned in the coalition agreement.
expresses that VAT on school and study books should not be raised
spreekt uit dat de btw op school- en studieboeken niet verhoogd moet worden
Motie van het lid Pijpelink over opties uitwerken voor voldoende financiële middelen voor onderwijshuisvesting tot 2050
Asks the Minister to set out options in the next progress letter for securing sufficient funding for school buildings up to 2050.
requests the Minister, in her next progress letter on school housing, to develop options for ensuring sufficient financial resources up to 2050
verzoekt de Minister in haar volgende voortgangsbrief over onderwijshuisvesting opties uit te werken voor hoe er tot 2050 wordt gezorgd voor voldoende financiële middelen
Motie van het lid Pijpelink over een brede verkenning van monitoringsmogelijkheden binnen het stelsel ten behoeve onderwijshuisvesting
Asks the government to explore by summer 2025 monitoring options for school housing policy, including costs and administrative burden.
requests the government to carry out a broad exploration by summer 2025 of monitoring possibilities within the system
verzoekt de regering om voor de zomer van 2025 een brede verkenning uit te voeren van monitoringsmogelijkheden binnen het stelsel
Amendement van de leden Stoffer en Pijpelink ter vervanging van nr. 9 over een uniforme formulering van de bepaling over het informatierecht van de medezeggenschapsraad
Replaces the wording of the school works council information right, making the council's right to information reasonable and fair and requiring timely information on request.
and, when asked, timely provide all information that the council deems necessary for its task reasonably and fairly
en, gevraagd, tijdig alle inlichtingen die deze voor de vervulling van zijn taak naar redelijkheid en billijkheid nodig acht
Motie van het lid Pijpelink over een minstens vijftien jaar durend noodplan tegen het lerarentekort
Asks the government for a plan of at least fifteen years to tackle the quantitative and qualitative teacher shortage.
requests the government to tackle this problem with a plan against the teacher shortage, qualitative and quantitative, for a period of at least fifteen years
verzoekt de regering om deze problematiek het hoofd te bieden met een plan tegen het lerarentekort, kwalitatief en kwantitatief, voor de duur van minstens vijftien jaren
Motie van de leden Pijpelink en Paternotte over bij de Voorjaarsnota bezien of er alternatieve structurele bekostiging mogelijk is van schoolmaaltijden
Asks the government to examine in the spring budget memorandum whether school meals can be funded structurally rather than via the broad bridge-class subsidy.
requests the government to examine in the Spring Memorandum whether alternative structural funding is possible
verzoekt de regering om bij de Voorjaarsnota te bezien of er alternatieve structurele bekostiging mogelijk is
Motie van het lid Teunissen c.s. over gezonde en groene schoolpleinen
Asks the government to consult schools, municipalities and IVN and propose how national government can help realise greener school playgrounds, starting with the most vulnerable schools.
requests the government to consult with schools, municipalities and IVN
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met scholen, gemeenten en IVN
Motie van het lid Pijpelink c.s. over het onderzoek naar de juridische haalbaarheid van het afschaffen dan wel limiteren van de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage in het p.o. en vo snel uitvoeren
Asks the government to speedily carry out research into the legal feasibility of abolishing or limiting voluntary parental contributions in primary and secondary education.
requests the government to speedily carry out this research into the legal feasibility of abolishing or limiting the voluntary parental contribution
verzoekt de regering dit onderzoek naar de juridische haalbaarheid van het afschaffen dan wel limiteren van de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage in het p.o. en vo snel uit te voeren
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Pijpelink over de onderwijstaal op Caribisch Nederland

MPs White and Pijpelink asked the State Secretary of Education about aligning education law for Caribbean Netherlands, school quality on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and the CAS islands, and the role of Dutch versus Papiamentu in schooling. The State Secretary answered that Caribbean Netherlands education is subject to comply-or-explain and separate laws, that quality concerns are being addressed through island education agendas and support, and that Dutch-language and multilingual policy is pursued through ministerial cooperation.
It is worrying that the inspectorate again assesses the education quality of one of the schools as insufficient.
Het is zorgelijk dat de inspectie de onderwijskwaliteit van een van de scholen wederom als onvoldoende beoordeelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Westerveld over het bericht 'Ouders die kind van school houden vanwege geloofsovertuiging worden niet meer vervolgd'

Two MPs (Pijpelink and Westerveld) asked the State Secretary of Education about the Public Prosecution Service's decision to stop prosecuting parents who keep children home on grounds of religious or life-conviction objections to schooling, and the risks this poses for children's right to education. The State Secretary answered that the OM made the decision because the legal provisions are interpreted inconsistently, regretted not being informed beforehand, is examining other enforcement options and a possible removal of the exemption, and provided case figures.
I regret that the OM feels compelled to take this decision and that the Ministry of OCW was not informed in advance.
Ik betreur dat het OM zich genoodzaakt ziet om dit besluit te nemen en dat het Ministerie van OCW hier niet van te voren op de hoogte is gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Pijpelink en Beckerman over het bericht 'Nationaal Onderwijsmuseum in Dordrecht dreigt te verdwijnen vanwege geldgebrek'

MPs asked why the Minister is ending funding for the National Education Museum in Dordrecht, whether alternatives were explored, and whether the decision will be reconsidered. The Staatssecretaris replied that budget cuts forced choices favouring core education tasks, that alternatives would require a substantial subsidy increase deemed unavailable, that the collection belongs to the museum foundation, and that no reconsideration is planned.
I informed the Education Museum as early as possible to give it the chance to seek alternative funding or, if it sees no options, to achieve a careful wind-down.

Ik heb het Onderwijsmuseum zo vroeg mogelijk geïnformeerd om de kans te bieden op zoek te gaan naar alternatieve financiering of, als zij hier geen mogelijkheden voor zien, een zorgvuldige afbouw te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Pijpelink over de Week van de Lentekriebels

MPs Westerveld and Pijpelink asked the state secretaries of Education and Health about misinformation campaigns against the Week van de Lentekriebels and its effect on school participation. The government acknowledged the misinformation as harmful, noted participation fell from 43.2% to 35%, and promised continued support, information efforts and curriculum safeguards while stressing school autonomy.
Spreading incorrect and incomplete information is harmful.
Het verspreiden van onjuiste en onvolledige informatie is schadelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over één- of tweevakkigheid van de tweedegraads lerarenopleidingen

An MP asked the minister about the history of two-subject teacher training in the Netherlands, comparison with other European countries, and whether dual qualifications for shortage subjects like German should be supported, including in a plan to address teacher shortages. The minister explained that two-subject training was abolished in 1989 for quality reasons, that dual qualifications remain possible at institutions' discretion, and that a Herstelplan Kwaliteit Onderwijs focuses on staffing quality.
The current two-qualification system offers possibilities for training towards a dual qualification.
Het huidige tweebevoegdhedenstelsel biedt mogelijkheden voor het opleiden tot een dubbele bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Pijpelink over het bericht dat criminele ronselaars hun slag slaan op scholen

MPs Mutluer and Pijpelink asked the ministers of Justice and Education about reports that criminal recruiters increasingly target pupils at schools, and what the government knows, trains, and does about it. The minister answers that no figures on school recruitment are recorded, points to a study requested from the Centre for Child and Human Trafficking, existing school safety duties, a planned notification duty for serious incidents, and the Preventie met Gezag programme, and says he will consult the VNG on youth workers at schools.
There are no figures available on the number of young people approached by criminals.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal jongeren dat wordt benaderd door criminelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Pijpelink over dreigende ontslagen bij University College Roosevelt in Middelburg

MPs Stultiens and Pijpelink asked the Minister of Education about job cuts at University College Roosevelt in Middelburg caused by budget reductions, and whether the government would reconsider its cuts and grant Zeeland an exemption from the Wet internationalisering in balans. The minister acknowledged the cuts and personnel effects, stated the institution has spending freedom and is accountable to its works council and supervisory board, declined a general exemption for regions while offering a regional criterion in the law.
Institutions have spending freedom over the funds they receive through funding and are responsible for implementing the cuts carefully.
Instellingen hebben bestedingsvrijheid over de middelen die zij via de bekostiging ontvangen en zijn verantwoordelijk om de bezuinigingen op zorgvuldige wijze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over het bericht ‘Dilemma’s door de doorstroomtoets: scholen doen met tegenzin mee of haken af omdat ze de toets niet meer vertrouwen’

An MP asked whether primary schools refusing the doorstroomtoets (transition test) would leave pupils without a definitive school advice and how to handle this. The State Secretary answered that the four schools involved now plan to administer the test during the catch-up period, that the test is legally required for a definitive advice except for statutory exemptions, and that the government will intervene if schools refuse.
For all these reasons I see myself obliged to intervene when a school refuses to administer the transition test.
Om al deze redenen zie ik mij genoodzaakt in te grijpen wanneer een school weigert de doorstroomtoets af te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Stultiens over de gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel Wet Internationalisering in Balans op de regio Zeeland

MPs Pijpelink and Stultiens asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the Internationalisation in Balance Act will affect University College Roosevelt and HZ in Zeeland, and how the government will prevent loss of programmes and international students. The Minister says the answers depend on an amendment-Bontenbal that requires a nota van wijziging and a letter to parliament in January, promises regional tailoring via the regional-circumstances criterion, and defends the Act as steering rather than restricting international student flows.

I am currently considering whether and how this criterion should be adjusted, in line with the Bontenbal et al. amendment, to give sufficient room for English-language teaching in regions with specific circumstances such as Zeeland.

Ik bezie op dit moment of en hoe dit criterium moet worden aangepast om – conform het amendement Bontenbal c.s. – voldoende ruimte te geven voor anderstalig onderwijs aan regio's met specifieke omstandigheden, zoals Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Westerveld over reclame voor en samenwerking met extern aanvullend onderwijs

MPs Pijpelink and Westerveld asked the State Secretary of Education about schools advertising or cooperating with commercial supplementary tutoring providers despite government guidelines, and about inequality, municipal funding and a possible legal ban. The State Secretary answered that the 2025 Monitor will assess the effect of the guidelines, that further measures will be considered if they prove ineffective, and that no statutory ban or municipal agreements are planned for now.
If it turns out that the guidelines are not sufficiently effective, I will consider possible follow-up measures.
Indien blijkt dat de richtlijnen niet afdoende effectief zijn, zal ik mij beraden op eventuele vervolgmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Tseggai over ‘Opnieuw meer jongeren van middelbare school of mbo af zonder diploma’

MPs Pijpelink and Tseggai asked the Minister of Education about a report that early school leaving without diploma rose again, including causes such as mental health and the need for income, and what the government will do to reduce it. The Minister acknowledges the rise, states the government keeps the action plan and 18,000 target for 2026 (calling it ambitious), points to planned legislation on support toward sustainable work, mental health measures, and an ongoing study into a statutory minimum internship allowance.
The cabinet adheres to the early school leaving action plan and the target agreed in the Werkagenda mbo of 18,000 new early school leavers in 2026.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan het actieplan vsv en de in de Werkagenda mbo afgesproken doelstelling van 18.000 nieuwe voortijdig schoolverlaters in 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Beckerman, Pijpelink en Ergin over het delen van alternatieve opties voor het uitstellen van de curriculumherziening

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Education to share a scenario exploration document on revising the core objectives (kerndoelen) before a committee debate on the curriculum reform. The State Secretary refused, citing the convention that documents prepared for cabinet and sub-committee deliberations are not made public to protect cabinet unity.
In line with cabinet-wide disclosure policy, documents prepared for the Council of Ministers and its sub-committees are in principle not made public in order to safeguard the unity of cabinet policy.

In lijn met het kabinetsbrede beleid rondom openbaarmaking worden stukken ter voorbereiding van de ministerraad en onderraden in principe niet openbaar gemaakt om de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Pijpelink over het bericht 'Gebruik laptop op veel scholen verplicht, lang niet elke ouder kan dat betalen'

An MP asked the state secretary for education about reports that laptops are mandatory at many schools while not all parents can afford them, and about the growing number of requests to charities like Stichting Leergeld. The state secretary said schools must provide a full alternative if parents cannot pay, that devices are not covered by the Free Schoolbooks Act, and that an inquiry into device access will report this autumn.
If parents cannot or will not pay for a laptop, the school must ensure a full alternative.
Als ouders een laptop niet kunnen of willen betalen moet de school zorgen voor een volwaardig alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over de doorstroomtoets

An MP asked the State Secretary about the 2024 doorstroomtoets: the fall in vwo advice, the higher upward adjustment of advice for pupils from low-SES families, differences between test providers and regions, and whether action is needed. The State Secretary answered that the vwo share fell about 4 percentage points on definitive figures, that the new upward-adjustment rule is working with about three-quarters of eligible pupils adjusted, that differences between test providers are under study, and that further monitoring and action are planned.

I am pleased that the final DUO data show that schools in 2024 responded well to the new measure: three quarters of pupils with a higher test result than the provisional school advice received an adjusted advice.

Ik ben blij dat uit de definitieve data van DUO blijkt dat scholen in 2024 goed gehoor hebben gegeven aan de nieuwe maatregel: driekwart van de leerlingen met een hoger toetsresultaat dan het voorlopig schooladvies kreeg een bijgesteld advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over de sluiting van de Van Brienenoordschool in Rotterdam

An MP asked the minister why the Van Brienenoordschool's education quality was not acted on earlier, how former pupils (spread over about 25 schools) are monitored and funded for catching up, and how a repeat can be prevented.
