The minister answered that the inspectorate found the school adequate in 2020, intervened in 2022 after risk signals, that the board closed the school, that inspection does not monitor individual pupils' results, that receiving schools must catch up largely on their own with limited coordinated funding, and that boards bear primary responsibility.
Inspection supervision takes place at the level of schools and boards, including the schools and boards concerned here.
Het toezicht van de inspectie vindt plaats op het niveau van scholen en besturen, ook de scholen en besturen waar het hier om gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over te lage schooladviezen voor bijna de helft van de Drentse basisschoolleerlingen

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about under-advising of Drenthe primary pupils (schooladviezen lower than end-test results) and whether final advice should be postponed until after the third year of secondary school. The minister answered that a new measure requiring schools to adjust advice upward, and ongoing research and monitoring, are in place, and that regional differences will be tracked, with further policy to follow.
Through the annual DUO Monitor on school advice and transfer test we closely monitor how this new measure affects the transfer and opportunities of pupils.
Via de jaarlijkse DUO Monitor schooladvies en doorstroomtoets houden we scherp in de gaten hoe deze nieuwe maatregel uitwerkt op de doorstroom en kansen van leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over de groeiende bijlesindustrie die de kloof tussen rijke en arme kinderen vergroot

The MP asks the minister about the growing private tutoring industry and its effect on inequality, including whether schools should stop cooperating with commercial tutoring firms. The minister says schools should provide extra help on-site, prefers non-profit partners, reports positive early signals from its appeal to schools, and promises a repeat monitor in 2025.
With the periodic Monitor Aanvullend Onderwijs, which will be carried out again in 2025, I will among other things track the effect of the appeal more structurally.
Met de periodieke Monitor Aanvullend Onderwijs, die in 2025 opnieuw wordt uitgevoerd, zal ik onder andere het effect van de oproep structureler in beeld brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Pijpelink over wachtrijen voor netaansluitingen

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about grid connection queues in Zeeland and other provinces, including effects on jobs, firms affected, and investment in renewables. The minister answered that company-level queue data is confidential, the province warned only in general terms, and congestion research and flexible grid solutions are ongoing, without committing to a new concrete step.
Applications for a grid connection by individual companies with the grid operator are commercially confidential information.
Aanvragen voor een netaansluiting door individuele bedrijven bij de netbeheerder zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over het lerarentekort in Zeeland

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about the growing teacher shortage in Zeeland, its similarity to urban shortages, and whether the national teacher strategy needs adjusting for cross-border regions. The Minister acknowledged concern, cited Centerdata figures showing falling primary shortages and a rising secondary outlook, and said the existing regional approach through education regions already suits cross-border contexts.
I share the concerns about the teacher shortage in Zeeland.
Ik deel de zorgen over het lerarentekort in Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Pijpelink over de scheur in de Westerscheldetunnel

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the crack in the Westerscheldetunnel, the timing of repairs, and safeguarding access for Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. The minister replied that the tunnel is safe, that repair planning is the responsibility of the NV Westerscheldetunnel (owned by the province of Zeeland), that the ministry is a stakeholder, and that temporary measures may follow if monitoring warrants it.
The repair is a responsibility of the NV WST, of which the province of Zeeland is the sole shareholder.
De reparatie is een verantwoordelijkheid van de NV WST, waarvan de provincie Zeeland enig aandeelhouder is.

Dit amendement regelt dat de S&O-afdrachtvermindering feitelijk wordt afgeschaft door alle percentages op nul te stellen.
Amendement van het lid Van Aalst over een structurele impuls geven aan het hoofdwegennet
Increases the national road network budget by 1 billion euro, funded through a shift from the WBSO tax relief.
With this amendment the aim is to give a structural boost to the main road network.
Met dit amendement wordt beoogd een structurele impuls te geven aan het hoofdwegennet.
Amendement van het lid van Aalst over een structurele impuls geven aan het hoofdwegennet
Amendment raising the budget for the main road network investment fund by one billion euro, funded by abolishing the WBSO wage tax reduction.
Funding is found in an amendment to the Tax Package 2019 that regulates the abolition of the WBSO wage tax reduction.
Dekking wordt gevonden in een amendement op het Pakket Belastingplan 2019, dat de afschaffing van de afdrachtvermindering speur- en ontwikkelingswerk (WBSO) regelt.
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over stationeren van de politie op de grotere treinstations
Asks the government to station the railway infrastructure police unit at larger train stations to make the rail police visible.
requests the government to station the rail unit of the Infrastructure Service at the larger train stations from now on
verzoekt de regering, om de afdeling Spoor van de Dienst Infrastructuur voortaan op de grotere treinstations te stationeren
Amendement van het lid Van Aalst over het feitelijk afschaffen van de Wbso
Amendment effectively abolishes the WBSO R&D tax credit by setting all percentages to zero and renaming the ministry.
regulates that the WBSO is effectively abolished by setting all percentages to zero
regelt dat de WBSO feitelijk wordt afgeschaft door alle percentages op nul te stellen
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over saneren van asbestdaken kleiner dan 35m2
Motion asks that all asbestos roofs under 35 m2 be removed only by certified removal companies.
also have asbestos roofs equal to and smaller than 35 m2 removed only by certified removers
ook de asbestdaken gelijk aan en kleiner dan 35 m 2 alleen door gecertificeerde saneerders te laten saneren
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over risicogestuurd invullen van de saneringsopgave
Asks the government to fill in the asbestos roof removal programme on a risk-based basis.
requests the government to fill in the asbestos roof removal task on a risk-based basis
verzoekt de regering om, de saneringsopgave voor asbestdaken risico gestuurd in te vullen
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over doortrekken van de A4 aan de kant van Rotterdam
Asks the government to include an exploration of extending the A4 on the Rotterdam side in the next MIRT, creating an extra exit road for Voorne-Putten and Spijkenisse.
requests the government to include an exploration in the next MIRT to extend the A4 on the Rotterdam side
verzoekt de regering om, een verkenning op te nemen in het volgende MIRT om de A4 aan de kant van Rotterdam door te trekken
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over de A1-A35 tussen de knooppunten Azelo en Buren
Asks the government to talk with the region about an approach to the A1-A35 stretch between Azelo and Buren and inform the House before the autumn 2018 MIRT.
requests the government to enter into talks with the region on an approach to the A1-A35 stretch between Azelo and Buren
verzoekt de regering om, in gesprek te gaan met de regio over een aanpak van het stuk A1-A35 tussen de knooppunten Azelo en Buren
Motie van het lid Remco Dijkstra c.s. over prioritering in de aanpak van N-wegen
Asks the government to set priorities for tackling N-roads in the Meer Veilig programme based on accidents and cofinancing.
requests the government, within the Meer Veilig programme, to set a priority for tackling N-roads
verzoekt de regering, in het kader van het programma Meer Veilig een prioritering aan te brengen van aanpak van N-wegen
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over een verkeerslichtenvrij knooppunt A27 Hooipolder
Asks the government, in consultation with the province, to make the A27 Hooipolder junction free of traffic lights as soon as possible.
requests the government, in consultation with the province, to make the A27 Hooipolder junction traffic-light free as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering om, in overleg met de provincie het knooppunt A27 Hooipolder zo spoedig mogelijk verkeerslichtvrij te maken
Motie van de leden Van Aalst en Remco Dijkstra over opwaardering van de spitsstroken tussen Zaandam en Purmerend
Asks the government to consider upgrading the peak-hour lanes between Zaandam and Purmerend to full traffic lanes in its preferred-route decision.
requests the government to consider, in the preferred-route decision, whether the peak lanes between Zaandam and Purmerend can be upgraded to full lanes
verzoekt de regering om, in de afweging voor het voorkeursbesluit mee te nemen of de spitsstroken tussen Zaandam en Purmerend op de A8 en A7 opgewaardeerd kunnen worden tot volwaardige rijstroken
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over de N35 bij Mariënheem
Asks the government, with provincial co-financing, to complete the last section of the N35 at Mariënheem as a 2x2 100 km road.
requests the government, with co-financing from the province, to complete the last piece of the N35 at Mariënheem as a 2x2 100 km road
verzoekt de regering om, met cofinanciering van de provincie het laatste stukje van de N35 bij Mariënheem te voltooien tot een 2x2 100 km-weg
Motie van de leden Van Aalst en Remco Dijkstra over sneller realiseren van project A20 Nieuwerkerk-Gouda
Asks the government to build the A20 Nieuwerkerk–Gouda project faster with provincial co-financing.
requests the government to realise the A20 Nieuwerkerk a/d IJssel–Gouda faster with co-financing from the province
verzoekt de regering om, met cofinanciering vanuit de provincie de A20 Nieuwerkerk a/d IJssel–Gouda sneller te realiseren
Motie van de leden Van Aalst en Wilders over de verbreding van de A67 Eindhoven-Venlo
Asks the government to widen the A67 between Eindhoven and Venlo to 2x3 lanes as soon as possible without first examining alternatives.
to realise as soon as possible the necessary widening of the A67 to 2x3 lanes between Eindhoven and Venlo
de benodigde verbreding van de A67 naar 2x3 rijstroken tussen Eindhoven en Venlo zo spoedig mogelijk te realiseren
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over verbreding van de A2 Eindhoven-Weert
Asks the government to widen the A2 Eindhoven–Weert to at least 2x3 lanes as soon as possible, in consultation with Platform A2.
requests the government, in consultation with Platform A2, to widen the A2 Eindhoven–Weert as soon as possible to at least 2x3 lanes
verzoekt de regering om, in samenspraak met Platform A2 de A2 Eindhoven–Weert zo spoedig mogelijk te verbreden naar ten minste 2x3 rijstroken
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over de A4-Zuid als verkenning opnemen
Asks the government to include the A4-Zuid road as an exploration project in the next MIRT planning round.
requests the government to include the missing link of the A4, the A4-Zuid, as an exploration in the next MIRT
verzoekt de regering om, de ontbrekende schakel van de A4, de A4-Zuid, als verkenning in het volgende MIRT op te nemen
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over het schrappen van de bijmengverplichting voor alle biobrandstoffen
Asks the government to scrap the blending obligation for all biofuels.
requests the government to scrap the blending obligation for all biofuels
verzoekt de regering om, de bijmengverplichting voor alle biobrandstoffen te schrappen
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over omzetten van spitsstroken in volwaardige rijstroken
Asks the government to convert as many peak-hour and plus lanes as possible into full traffic lanes.
to convert as many peak and plus lanes as possible, at least on the left lane, into full traffic lanes
om zo veel mogelijk spits- en plusstroken van in ieder geval de linkerrijbaan om te zetten naar volwaardige rijstroken
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over twee snelheidsregimes
Asks the government to reduce highway speed regimes from six to two: 130 km/h standard and 100 km/h where needed for safety.
by reducing them from six to two regimes
door deze terug te brengen van zes naar twee regimes
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over de verdeelsleutel voor infrastructuur
Asks the government to adjust the allocation key for infrastructure funding to match the total mobility needs of the population.
requests the government to adjust the allocation key of financial resources for infrastructure to the total mobility needs of the Dutch population
verzoekt de regering om, de verdeelsleutel van financiële middelen voor infrastructuur aan te passen aan de totale mobiliteitsbehoefte van de Nederlandse bevolking
Amendement van het lid Van Aalst over het toevoegen van 100 FTE aan de ILT
Moves 8.12 million euro from various I&M budget items to the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport to hire 100 extra FTE for road freight enforcement.
This allows 100 extra FTE to be appointed for road freight transport
Hiermee kan 100 extra FTE worden aangesteld voor het goederenvervoer over de weg
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over het schrappen van aan klimaatscenario's gerelateerde elementen uit het Deltaprogramma en Deltafonds
Asks the government to remove all climate-scenario elements from the Delta Programme and Delta Fund and redirect the freed funds to strengthening dikes.
requests the government to remove all climate-scenario-related elements from the Delta Programme and Delta Fund
verzoekt de regering om, alle aan klimaatscenario's gerelateerde elementen uit het Deltaprogramma en Deltafonds te schrappen
Amendement van het lid Van Aalst over een standaard beginnerstermijn van 5 jaar
Proposes a uniform five-year probationary period for all driving licence types and ages, replacing the varied probationary terms in the bill.
by applying a standard probationary period of 5 years for every licence type and every age
door voor iedere type rijbewijs en iedere leeftijd een standaard beginnerstermijn van 5 jaar te hanteren
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over het uitschakelen van alle 80 km-zones rondom de grote steden
Asks the government to switch off all 80 km/h zones around big cities as soon as possible because they increase congestion and emissions.
requests the government to switch off all 80 km zones around the big cities as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering om alle 80 km-zones rondom de grote steden zo snel mogelijk uit te schakelen
Motie van het lid Van Aalst over de totale kosten van het klimaatbeleid inzichtelijk maken op de begroting van I&M
Asks the government to show the total costs of climate policy transparently in the I&M budget from the 2018 budget onward.
requests the government to make the total costs of climate policy transparent in the I&M budget for the 2018 budget
verzoekt de regering om bij de begroting 2018 de totale kosten van het klimaatbeleid inzichtelijk te maken op de begroting van I en M
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het nieuws dat goederentreinen vanwege het winterweer stiltaan in de Rotterdamse haven

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why freight trains stalled in the Rotterdam port during winter weather, why heating on switches was defective, why the WIRAS switch was not adopted, what compensation freight operators would receive, and why Parliament was not informed earlier. The State Secretary answered that ProRail is working on maintenance and an evaluation, that the WIRAS switch was judged unsuitable in 2014 and will be re-examined, that damage details are confidential business information, and that a compensation scheme will be shared in spring.
I have no information on the extent of any financial damage suffered by rail freight operators as a result of the restrictions concerned. This concerns commercially sensitive information.
Over de omvang van eventuele vermogensschade die spoorgoederenvervoerders hebben geleden als gevolg van de bedoelde beperkingen heb ik geen informatie. Het betreft hier bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het nieuws dat de kosten van het havengeld voor sommige binnenvaartschippers meer dan verdubbeld zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that new port dues in Twente more than doubled costs for some inland shippers, including some serving medical logistics, and asked whether the government would intervene or investigate other municipalities. The minister acknowledged the reports, said costs vary by operator and that the change is favourable for some, declined to judge the cost increase generally, and said municipalities are responsible for their own port policy and will evaluate the scheme in Q2 2021 without the minister taking further action.
No, the municipalities are after all competent to conduct independent policy.
Nee, de gemeenten zijn immers bevoegd om zelfstandig beleid te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het fatale ongeluk bij een niet actief beveiligde overgang in Drenthe

An MP asked the state secretary about a fatal accident at an unsecured rail crossing in Wijster and why unsecured crossings were not being closed faster, including whether ProRail had said blocking them with concrete blocks was legally impossible. The state secretary said the crossing is private, ProRail is negotiating closure, blocking is legally problematic, and an enforcement power (aanwijzingsbevoegdheid) is being prepared.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de BSO-bus

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat about a BSO bus that caught fire near a childcare centre, whether the RDW tested fire safety, whether the test documents will be shared, and whether the type approval will be reconsidered and the investigation made independent. The minister said the RDW type approval does not cover fire safety, that investigations by insurers, the manufacturer and inspectorates are ongoing, and that no immediate intervention is currently deemed necessary.
A fire safety test is not part of this.
Een toetsing op brandveiligheid maakt hier geen deel van uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Van Aalst en Wilders over nieuwe rekenregels voor geluid die de woningbouw lam dreigen te leggen

PVV MPs asked whether new noise calculation rules for cumulative noise would stall housing construction, and whether windmill noise would be counted less strictly. The government answered that it is aware of the housing shortage, that the updated aviation noise rule is still under joint impact analysis with local partners and an interim transitional provision keeps the current formula, and that separate noise norms for windmills remain and their noise is included in cumulative assessment without being weakened.
Together with the administrative partners it has been agreed to jointly carry out a further impact analysis of the possible consequences of updating the aviation noise calculation rule.
Met de bestuurlijke partners is afgesproken gezamenlijk een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren naar de mogelijke consequenties van de actualisering van de rekenregel voor luchtvaartgeluid

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over de berichten ‘Nederlands vaardocument gebruikt bij grootschalige drugssmokkel’ en ‘Nederlandse schepen aan ketting in Italië door omstreden bootpaspoort’

MPs Van Aalst and Helder asked the ministers whether the Dutch ICP pleasure-craft certificate is facilitating international drug smuggling and what registration reforms are planned. The minister acknowledged misuse of the ICP, said procedures will be tightened via a new convenant from 1 January 2021, and said a broader boat-ownership registration needs further study with the Justice ministry.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over “het bericht dat er zeven gewonden zijn gevallen bij een ernstig ongeluk met een camper en drie auto’s op de N50 bij Kampen”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the N50 Kampen–Kampen Zuid widening is delayed, citing a serious crash and accusing the government of slow road safety action due to nitrogen concerns. The minister confirmed the widening's planned 2023 opening, said nitrogen study may only cause limited delay, pointed to road safety programmes, but declined to accelerate the project.
In the first quarter of 2021 I intend to adopt a draft route decision to widen the N50 Kampen-Kampen Zuid to 2x2 lanes as well.
In het eerste kwartaal van 2021 wil ik een ontwerpTracébesluit nemen om de N50 Kampen-Kampen Zuid eveneens te verbreden naar 2x2 rijstroken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Van Aalst en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat asielzoekers buschauffeurs intimideren en reizigers bestelen

PVV MPs asked why asylum seekers who intimidate bus drivers and rob passengers are allowed to continue, and whether they should be expelled or jailed. The state secretary answered that overlast by asylum seekers is a serious but relatively small group problem, cited cooperation with transport partners, a landelijk convenant and Top-X lists, and said such behaviour leads to lik-op-stuk measures.
For nuisance behaviour the starting point is that, regardless of the person, this is not tolerated and leads to firm enforcement measures.
Bij overlastgevend gedrag is het vertrekpunt dat, ongeacht de persoon, dit niet wordt getolereerd en dit leidt tot lik-op-stuk maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het nieuws dat de politie extra auto’s aanschaft om de pakkans op snelheidsovertredingen te vergroten

Two PVV MPs asked whether police buying extra unmarked cars to catch speeders after the speed limit change is a waste of taxpayer money, and what it costs. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the cars replace existing radar vehicles already in the police budget, involve no extra investment, and need no extra capacity, and that enforcement continues as before.
This replacement was already provided for in the police budgets. It is therefore not an extra investment.
Deze vervanging was reeds voorzien in de budgetten van de politie. Het gaat dus niet om een extra investering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Van Aalst over het bericht dat hulpdiensten in de knel komen door de verlaging van de maximumsnelheid

Two MPs from the PVV asked the minister whether lowering the daytime speed limit to 100 km/h would lengthen emergency response times and endanger people in need, and whether the government would protect emergency services. The minister answered that the effects are expected to be small to negligible, that emergency services may still exceed the limit by up to 40 km/h, and that the effects will be monitored with the Kenniscentrum Voorrangsvoertuigen and adjusted if bottlenecks emerge.
The exact effects of the speed reduction between 06:00 and 19:00 on emergency service response times are currently not known.
De exacte effecten van de snelheidsverlaging tussen 06.00 en 19.00 uur op de aanrijtijden van de hulpdiensten zijn op dit moment niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Aalst over de berichten ‘Helmplicht voor snorfietser wordt geleidelijk ingevoerd’ en ‘Ook de snorfietser moet eraan geloven: een niet-coole helm op’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports on a gradual helmet obligation for moped (snorfiets) riders, asking about safer alternatives, comparative risks, economic effects, relocation to the road, and how owners will be informed and can object. The Minister answered all ten questions on substance, explaining the planned helmet rule, the Arcadis study, the ongoing internet consultation, and that a communication campaign will follow if the rule is adopted.
The aim of this measure is to reduce the number of road deaths and injuries among moped riders, not to push the snorfiets off the streets.
Het doel van deze maatregel is om het aantal verkeersdoden en -gewonden onder snorfietsers te verminderen, niet om de snorfiets uit het straatbeeld te verdringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het nieuws dat het hervatten van het rangeren met gevaarlijke stoffen op Waalhaven Zuid opnieuw is uitgesteld

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the repeated postponement of shunting dangerous goods at Waalhaven Zuid, and about the economic damage and why the fire-suppression system does not cover the whole yard. The minister confirmed the delay, said the authorities allowed resumption only under conditions, and promised to inform parliament once the timeline and measures for extending fire protection are clear.
Once there is clarity about the necessary measures and the timeline, I will inform your House about this.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over de benodigde maatregelen en het tijdpad, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Van Aalst over 700 miljoen euro voor schaamteloze EU-propaganda

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares the Commission's view on the DiscoverEU free-travel pilot and the reported 700 million euro EU promotion budget, and whether he will demand that Dutch taxpayer money not be spent on it. The minister said the Netherlands is critical of DiscoverEU in its current form, wants clarity on learning effects, selection and impact before judging, and will press for a financially sustainable MFK with cuts to existing policy.
The cabinet is critical of DiscoverEU in its current form as a pilot programme.
Het kabinet is kritisch over DiscoverEU in de huidige vorm van het pilotprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen door de leden Van Aalst, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht dat Arriva haar personeel afvalt als zij het boerkaverbod in de bus handhaven

PVV MPs asked whether the government would condemn Arriva for dismissing a bus driver who enforced the face-covering ban, and whether they would act against transport operators refusing to enforce it. The minister answered that both driver and police acted lawfully, that enforcement is a police and prosecutor task, that operators must only ask riders to remove face coverings, and that no operator currently refuses to comply, so no action is planned yet.
Contacts with public transport companies currently do not show that they refuse to comply with the law.
Uit de contacten met de openbaar vervoer bedrijven blijkt op dit moment niet dat zij de wet weigeren na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht dat er weer een frontale botsing op de N36 heeft plaatsgevonden

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether she shares the view that measures taken on the N36 are inadequate after another head-on collision, and whether she will act quickly and ask the province of Overijssel to contribute. The minister answers that one year is too short to judge the effect of the road-layout measures, that Rijkswaterstaat will review accident data over three years, and that a behavioural campaign is being developed with the regional road safety body.
A period of one year is therefore too short for me to make well-founded statements at this time about the effect of the measures taken on the road layout.
De periode van een jaar vind ik daarom te kort om op dit moment gefundeerde uitspraken te doen over het effect van de genomen maatregelen voor de weginrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de actieve handel in privégegevens uit het kentekenregister

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that private data from the vehicle registration register was being traded actively, and whether a large-scale investigation into alleged corruption at the RDW would be held by an independent party. The minister answered that a police investigation with the RDW and LIV is underway after an RDW criminal complaint, that the RDW has commissioned an external review of structural safeguards, and that measures will be decided once findings are available.
The RDW filed a criminal complaint with the police, who then started an investigation in cooperation with the RDW (and the LIV).
De RDW heeft aangifte gedaan bij de politie die daarop in samenwerking met de RDW (en het LIV) een onderzoek is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Van Aalst over het mensonterende voorval in Zeist

PVV MPs asked ministers about a degrading incident involving a regional taxi driver filmed on Facebook, and whether low tariffs in insurer tenders cause work pressure. The minister denied a link to tariffs, said the contract with the province of Utrecht sets realistic rates and quality requirements, and will ask the NZa to explore the issue with stakeholders.
For that reason he will ask the NZa to carry out an exploration by talking with all parties (insurers, taxi unions and patient associations) about the possible problems.
Om die reden zal hij aan de NZa vragen om een verkenning uit te voeren door met alle partijen (verzekeraars, taxibonden en patiëntenverenigingen) in gesprek te gaan over de mogelijke problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de noodzaak van de oeververbinding voor de Krimpenerwaard

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Krimpenerwaard bridge link is needed to relieve the Van Brienenoord bridge, and what steps and funding are planned. The minister answered that a new eastern river crossing is needed to relieve the A16 corridor, that the choice of location is for the regional authorities, and that the funding will be decided after the MIRT study, with EUR 200 million reserved for the A16 bottleneck.
It was agreed to start the MIRT exploration and to take the start decision in mid-2019.
Er is afgesproken om de MIRT-Verkenning te starten en medio 2019 de Startbeslissing te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst en Fritsma over de speciale asielbus in Ter Apel

PVV MPs asked why a special asylum shuttle bus from Ter Apel to Emmen is priced cheaper than regular public transport, who pays for tickets, who protects drivers and whether the government will remove disruptive asylum seekers. The State Secretary answered that the three-month pilot is priced close to regular line 73, that tickets are paid from the statutory leefgeld, that the operator handles security and no incidents were reported in the first five weeks, and that no total asylum stop is planned.
On the deployment of the various measures and the implementation of adopted motions in this regard, you will be informed in the separate letter on disruptive asylum seekers.
Over de inzet van de verschillende maatregelen en de uitvoering van aangenomen moties daaromtrent wordt u geïnformeerd in de separate brief over overlastgevende asielzoekers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema, Van Aalst en Madlener over de acute zorg op Voorne-Putten met het oog op aankomende wegwerkzaamheden (en afsluitingen) en de wens in de regio om het Spijkenisse Medisch Centrum op t

PVV MPs asked the ministers about acute hospital care on Voorne-Putten, given road works and bridge closures, and about reopening the Spijkenisse Medisch Centrum as a full hospital with an emergency department, acute obstetrics and weekend stay. The minister replied that care should be provided in the right place, that the 45-minute norm is the relevant standard and is under study, that bridge disruptions are managed with contingency plans, and that the hospital is not a sensitive hospital and cannot be designated as a system hospital.
Before the summer I will inform you further about my vision on developments in the hospital landscape and my role in it.
Voor de zomer zal ik u nader informeren over mijn visie op de ontwikkelingen in het ziekenhuislandschap en mijn rol hierin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Van Aalst over het bericht dat Sea-Watch weer uit mag varen

Three PVV MPs asked why the government cannot keep NGO rescue ships like Sea-Watch in port, as Italy and Panama do, and called for a halt to asylum and the detention of the ship. The minister answered that Dutch flag and safety rules govern the ship, that the government supports rescue at sea but not operations that aid smugglers, and that it cannot impose an asylum stop because that would breach international obligations.
Regarding the asylum stop you propose, I refer you to the earlier answer from the State Secretary for Justice and Security.
Ten aanzien van de door u voorgestelde asielstop, verwijs ik u naar de eerdere beantwoording van de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Aalst over het weer aanzetten van de verlichting langs de snelweg

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why motorway lighting switched off for night hours has not been restored despite the coalition agreement, and whether the lights can go back on. The minister replied that restoration is being pursued where it improves traffic safety, that she ordered a halt to further switching-off, and that Rijkswaterstaat is studying effects on protected species, with results expected by summer 2019 and no final decision yet.
I have immediately instructed that the switching off of additional lighting between 11pm and 5am be stopped
Ik heb direct opdracht gegeven te stoppen met het uitzetten van extra verlichting tussen 23h en 5h
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Aalst over de asielbus tussen Ter Apel en Emmen

Two MPs from the PVV asked whether a pilot shuttle bus between Ter Apel and Emmen rewards asylum seekers who intimidate bus staff, and whether a shuttle to Marrakech should replace it. The State Secretary answered that nuisance is unacceptable and the bus is a temporary pilot within a broader Top-X approach to the most serious nuisance offenders, and refused the Marrakech proposal.
Regarding the arrangement of the transport, further agreements will be made in the short term with carriers and other stakeholders.
Over de invulling van het vervoer worden op korte termijn nadere afspraken gemaakt met vervoerders en andere betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de manier waarop het KNMI in 2016 de temperatuurmetingen van voor september 1951 corrigeerde

An MP asked the State Secretary whether KNMI's 2016 homogenisation of pre-1951 temperature records, which lowered some warm-day temperatures and reduced recorded heatwaves, was an incorrect representation and whether it was done deliberately to support climate policy, and demanded dismissals and reversal of the correction. The State Secretary answered that homogenisation is standard, methodologically sound, transparent and peer-reviewed, that the trend findings are consistent across five stations, that no dismissals or data corrections are warranted, and that both original and adjusted series are published.
There is no reason for dismissals or for correcting the research data.
Er is geen aanleiding tot ontslagen of tot het corrigeren van de onderzoeksdata.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het in het gevaar komen van de verkeersveiligheid nu een goede handhaving van de rij- en rusttijden niet meer kan worden gegarandeerd

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, following reports that the Inspectorate for Transport (ILT) cannot guarantee enforcement of driving and rest times due to sophisticated tachograph fraud and capacity limits, why capacity was not addressed instead of imposing levies on transport firms, and what concrete measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged the fraud, denied new budget cuts, said the ILT prioritises via a risk analysis, and committed to tightening sanctions, including possible withdrawal of fitters' competence, with a further letter to parliament before summer.
I will inform your House further about the measures to be taken before the summer.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer verder informeren over de te treffen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de wens van het bedrijfsleven om vrachtvluchten op Twente Airport te laten vliegen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether she knows of business demand for cargo flights at Twente Airport, whether this would help the Schiphol cargo slot shortage, and whether she will fund a quickscan. The minister replied that she knows of no concrete initiatives, that the province of Overijssel is responsible for Twente Airport, that regional airports will be considered in the upcoming Aviation Policy Note, and declined to commission a quickscan because the lead lies with the province.
Twente Airport is an airport of regional significance, for which the province of Overijssel holds competence.
Luchthaven Twente is een luchthaven van regionale betekenis, waarvoor de provincie Overijssel bevoegd gezag is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de aankoop van grond langs het spoor door ProRail

MP Van Aalst asks why the ministry advised negatively on ProRail's purchase of rail-side land later sold to RailSide, whether this was a miscalculation, whether an investigation will be held, and whether remaining land is inventoried. The State Secretary replies that the 2011 refusal was based on rijksvastgoedbeleid, that the later-sold land was reserved by NS rather than bought, that the relevant information was provided to the House, and that a full inventory is not practical, but ProRail and NS will agree to share land-sale lists.
On behalf of the Minister of Finance as well, I have asked NS and ProRail to provide me with all relevant information, which I have sent you as an annex to my letter.
Ik heb mede namens de Minister van Financiën NS en ProRail gevraagd mij alle relevante informatie te verstrekken die ik u heb doen toekomen als bijlage bij mijn brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Remco Dijkstra, Van der Graaf, Von Martels, Gijs van Dijk, Van Aalst, Schonis en Laçin over de nieuwe prijsverhoging voor tachograafkaarten

MPs asked whether the government would accept a proposed 5% price rise for tachograph cards by Kiwa, how the Dutch price compares with neighbouring countries, and why the new fee system has not yet taken effect. The minister said the current card price stays at 95 euro while a new generation card is priced at 100 euro due to new EU requirements, promised a benchmark study and a letter later in the year, and refused to suspend the price increase despite a motion.
No, the tariffs for tachograph cards remain at the established price.
Nee, de tarieven voor de tachograafkaarten blijven op de vastgestelde prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de chaos bij het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An MP from the PVV asks the minister about delays at the CBR (driving licence authority) that leave professional drivers out of work, and whether these will be resolved and who will compensate them. The minister acknowledges the delays, describes measures such as priority handling and a fast-track procedure, expects normal timelines by autumn 2019, and points to the CBR complaints procedure, the National Ombudsman and civil courts for compensation.
The CBR expects the processing times to be back in order by autumn 2019 at the latest.
Het CBR verwacht dat de doorlooptijden uiterlijk in het najaar van 2019 weer op orde zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht ‘Miljoenen nodig om tunnels brandbestendig te maken’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, following a press report, about the cost of making four recently completed tunnels and one under construction fire-resistant, whether the Rijkswaterstaat guidelines complied with fire-resistance rules, and whether pre-2008 tunnels are safe. The minister answered that repair costs are estimated at 105 to 135 million euros plus up to 100 million for the Gaasperdam contract, that contract requirements have been tightened, and that there is currently no reason to think older tunnels are insufficiently fire-resistant, with further research due in 2019.
I expect to be able to inform the House further about the results in 2019.
Over de resultaten zal ik de Kamer naar verwachting in 2019 nader kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het bericht ‘Moerdijk vraagt hulp bij problemen met Albanese inklimmers’

MPs Van Aalst and Helder asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that Moerdijk needs help with Albanian stowaways climbing into lorries and ships, and whether the ministry would take a national lead, talk with the port authorities and promote awareness campaigns. The minister says controls at maritime border posts have been intensified, that several bodies are working on the problem, that outreach to drivers is underway, and that tailored solutions per location and secure truck parking are being pursued, without committing to new specific steps.
Various bodies are working on measures for the stowaway issue.
In diverse gremia wordt er gewerkt aan maatregelen voor het «inklimmersvraagstuk».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht ‘Geen landelijk systeem voor aanpak agressie in het openbaar vervoer (OV)’

An MP asks whether a national incident-data system linking public transport operators and police is needed to tackle aggression on public transport, and whether NS data should be shared with regional operators. The State Secretary says the research supports one system but operators lack commitment, so information sharing will be explored through standard reports and structured consultation instead.
As an alternative, the research bureau proposes exchanging incident data and figures through national and regional standard reports and structural consultations.
Alternatief geeft het onderzoeksbureau het uitwisselen van gegevens over incidenten en cijfers in de vorm van landelijke en regionale standaard rapportages en structurele gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht “Spoorwegdoden door schuld laks ministerie”.

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a report on railway crossing deaths, including the OVV's findings on recklessness, whether the ministry is responsible and should steer ProRail, whether cost should matter for safety, and when unguarded crossings will be secured or closed. The State Secretary said she will study the OVV report before drawing conclusions and respond in a policy reaction, called crossing safety a shared responsibility of rail and road managers, stated that cost is weighed against safety benefits, and committed to closing or securing all open unguarded crossings and private connections as quickly as possible with ProRail.
It is good that the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) thoroughly investigated the safety situation at level crossings and also looked at the underlying causes of accidents.
Het is goed dat de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) de veiligheidssituatie rond overwegen grondig heeft onderzocht en daarbij ook heeft gekeken naar de achterliggende oorzaken van ongevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Van Aalst over het bericht dat de EU 15.000 Interrailpassen weggeeft

MPs Maeijer and Van Aalst asked whether the Netherlands supported the EU DiscoverEU free Interrail pass pilot and whether its expansion for 2021-2027 is EU propaganda paid by Dutch taxpayers. Minister Blok answered that DiscoverEU is a European Parliament pilot included in the 2018 EU budget and referred to the BNC-fiche on the proposed Erasmus+ programme for the expansion questions, without giving a cost figure or a position on the propaganda charge.
For the cabinet's appraisal of this proposal, I refer you to the BNC-fiche on Erasmus sent to your House on 10 July.
Voor de kabinetsappreciatie van dit voorstel verwijs ik u graag naar het op 10 juli jl. aan uw Kamer verzonden BNC-fiche over Erasmus
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Bruins, Ziengs, Van Aalst, Baudet en Von Martels over het gebruik van werkbakken aan hijskranen bij asbestsanering

MPs asked whether the government will allow cranes with work baskets for asbestos roof removal in exceptional cases, given a sector decision system and an Aboma report criticising stricter Dutch rules. The State Secretary said a независимый study will report before summer 2018 and that a decision on any regulatory change will follow, without committing to temporary relief now.
As promised to the House, I will commission an independent study into the problems the asbestos removal contractors describe.
Ik laat, zoals aan uw Kamer is toegezegd, een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitvoeren naar de problematiek die de asbestsaneerders aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht ‘Ook NS stopt nu met ‘dames en heren’’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about NS replacing 'dames en heren' with 'beste reizigers' in announcements, asking for FTE and cost figures, sanctions on staff, and whether the government would push NS to dismiss those responsible. The state secretary said it is NS's own matter, did not have the FTE and cost data, said staff may still use 'dames en heren' and that it is up to the conductor, and refused to press for dismissals.
I consider it a matter for the company itself.
Ik vind het een zaak van het bedrijf zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het bericht “Twee conducteurs mishandeld door treinreizigers”

PVV MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports of conductors and police being assaulted on trains, asking why measures have not stopped it, whether travel bans and harsher penalties will be imposed, whether NS security staff will get batons and pepper spray, whether a perpetrator profile and a real-time database of travel bans will be created. The government answered that eight and 23 measures are being implemented or evaluated, that travel-ban evaluation will be shared in autumn, that NS security staff have no need for pepper spray, that a perpetrator profile report was already delivered, and that a database will be considered in the travel-ban evaluation.
These measures are currently being evaluated. You will be informed about this in the autumn.
Deze maatregelen worden momenteel geëvalueerd. Hierover zult u in het najaar worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het bericht ‘Milieuactivisten maken voor tienduizenden euro’s schade’

MPs Van Aalst and Helder asked whether police knew in advance of a Code Rood activist break-in at an Amsterdam port business park, why police did not intervene sooner, how few arrests were made, and whether damages can be recovered. Minister Blok answered that the mayor is responsible for police operations, referred specific questions to the local authority, reported 13 arrests, and noted victims can claim damages through criminal or civil routes.
The mayor is responsible for directing the police with regard to public order in his or her municipality.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor de aansturing van de politie ten aanzien van de openbare orde in zijn of haar gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht 'Mariënheem timmert stevig aan de weg in N35-actie'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the N35 at Mariënheem should be upgraded to a full motorway with 2x2 lanes after residents' 'Traverse-plus' plan was rejected as too expensive, and why the project has taken 27 years. The minister answered that the plan was judged too costly, that about 600 million euro has been invested in the N35, and that a staged package of safety measures through 2020 is being pursued within existing budgets, with no further upgrade planned.
However, this plan was dropped because it is too expensive.
Dit plan is echter afgevallen omdat het te duur is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht op Telegraaf.nl “Schipholtunnel toch niet open voor avondspits”

An MP asked the minister why the damaged Schiphol tunnel was reopened later than announced, whether repairs could be done outside rush hour, whether tunnel law hinders faster reopening, and whether an investigation is warranted. The minister explained that safety systems had to be fully restored and tested before reopening, denied tunnel law caused delay, rejected the call for an inquiry given the incidental nature, and regretted the inconvenience.
Given the incidental nature, I currently see no need to launch an investigation.
Ik zie op dit moment, gelet het incidentele karakter, geen noodzaak om een onderzoek in te stellen.

Motie van het lid Palland over het in beeld brengen van de maatschappelijke kosten en baten van het afschaffen van de kostendelersnorm voor familieleden

requests the cabinet to map the social costs and benefits of abolishing the lodger norm for family members

requests the cabinet, with the SVB, UWV, tax and benefits service and possibly VNG, to explore and possibly pilot on a small scale whether data linkage
verzoekt het kabinet in samenspraak met de SVB, het UWV, belastingen/dienst toeslagen en eventueel de VNG te verkennen en eventueel op kleine schaal te testen of via gegevenskoppeling
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid De Kort c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 24 over middelen voor een subsidie voor inclusiviteitstechnologie

Daarom voorziet dit amendement in geld voor mkb-ondernemers die deze investering willen doen.

requests the cabinet to ask the SER for an exploration of (new) options for personal external leave saving

funds are freed up from the approach to money worries, poverty and debt under article 2 Social assistance, Participation Act and Allowances Act.
worden middelen vrij gemaakt uit de aanpak geldzorgen armoede en schulden op artikel 2 Bijstand, Participatiewet en Toeslagenwet.

Motie van het lid De Kort c.s. over het delen van de resultaten van de invoeringstoets met de Kamer één jaar na de invoering van de wetswijziging

requests the government to share the results of the implementation test with the House one year after introduction of the legislative amendment
verzoekt de regering de resultaten van de invoeringstoets één jaar na invoering van de wetswijziging met de Kamer te delen

to limit the scope of the initiative proposal, for now, to organisations with at least 10 employees
de reikwijdte van het initiatiefvoorstel, vooralsnog, te beperken tot organisaties met ten minste 10 werknemers

Een (externe) vertrouwenspersoon hoeft niet, indien er geen sprake is van meldingen, uit zichzelf organisaties te benaderen

Dit artikel is van toepassing op arbeidssituaties in ondernemingen waar in de regel ten minste tien personen werkzaam zijn.

Artikel 45a vervalt twee jaar na inwerkingtreding van die bepaling.

report the lessons learned from the voluntary pilot group back to the House before implementing the written work method obligation
de lessons learned vanuit de vrijwillige kopgroep terug te koppelen aan de Tweede Kamer alvorens de schriftelijkewerkwijzeverplichting

requests the government to grant pension funds that must use this scheme, after consultation with DNB, conditional exemption from the ten-year recovery period
verzoekt de regering om pensioenfondsen die genoodzaakt zijn om van deze regeling gebruik te maken, na overleg met DNB, onder voorwaarden vrijstelling te verlenen

requests the government to enable data exchange between the UWV and pension providers

Dit amendement verruimt de regels voor gebruik van de standaardmethode bij het invaren, waardoor deze methode ook geschikt wordt voor fondsen met hoge dekkingsgraden.
Motie van de leden Palland en Ceder over bij de monitoring de randvoorwaarden meenemen die zijn opgenomen in het pensioenakkoord

requests the government to observe the preconditions included in the pension agreement when monitoring
verzoekt de regering daarbij de in het pensioenakkoord opgenomen randvoorwaarden in acht te nemen
Motie van het lid Palland c.s. over onderzoeken of na invoering van de Wtp de vertegenwoordiging door de belanghebbenden in het pensioenfonds afdoende is voor evenwichtige besluitvorming
Asks the government to examine whether stakeholder representation in pension funds remains adequate for balanced decision-making under the new pension act and to inform the House before summer 2023.
requests the government to examine whether after the introduction of the Future Pensions Act the representation by stakeholders in the pension fund is still adequate
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of na de invoering van de Wet toekomst pensioenen de vertegenwoordiging door de belanghebbenden in het pensioenfonds nog steeds afdoende is

requests the government to advocate in the EU for bilateral talks on EU labour migration.

requests the government to further develop the STAP scheme and possibly involve

Motion asks the government to start a broad, integral study of the situation of families in the Netherlands as a basis for a new family policy note.

qa: Antwoord op van het lid Palland over doorwerken na AOW-leeftijd naaraanleiding van het commissiedebat Pensioenonderwerpen d.d. 21 juni 2023

An MP from the CDA asked how employment law and collective agreement pay scales apply when employees keep working for the same employer after reaching the AOW pension age, including whether prior service counts. The minister answers that these terms are for employer and employee to agree within collective agreements, that the government offers public information campaigns, and that it sees no role in discussing the matter with social partners.
It is important that employer and employee discuss the options for working after the AOW age in good time, if this is the wish of one or both.
Het is belangrijk dat werkgever en werknemer tijdig het gesprek aangaan over de mogelijkheden om na de AOW-leeftijd door te werken, als dit de wens van (één van) beide is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht ''Arnhemse Werkbrigade' slaat aan: begeleid werk via Scalabor leidt tot vaste baan'

An MP asked the minister about the Arnhem Werkbrigade pilot run by Scalabor that places long-term unemployed people in paid part-time jobs, and how the Palland/Kathmann motion on base jobs with regular employers will be implemented. The minister described the pilot's pay and results, said a follow-up on the motion will come in Q2 2024, and pointed to a broader infrastructure package for social development companies.
In the second quarter of 2024 I will inform your House further.
In het tweede kwartaal van 2024 zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘UWV vordert tienduizenden euro’s aan toeslagen terug vannietsvermoedende arbeidsongeschikten’

MPs Palland and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that UWV reclaimed tens of thousands of euros in supplementary benefits from disability recipients who received back-payments of disability pensions, and whether UWV followed its own rules. The minister acknowledged two confirmed cases, said UWV regrets the contact failures, outlined ongoing efforts on gross reclaiming, pension cooperation, and a review of recovery policy, but did not provide aggregate figures.
Pension funds and UWV unfortunately have no insight into the number of disabled Dutch citizens who received a back-payment in the past five years.
Pensioenfondsen en UWV hebben helaas geen inzicht in het aantal arbeidsongeschikte Nederlanders dat in de afgelopen vijf jaar een nabetaling heeft ontvangen
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag inzake het onterecht intrekken van de ANBI-status van de As-Soennah-moskee

MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Hague district court ruling that the tax authority wrongly revoked the ANBI status of the As-Soennah mosque, and whether selection of ANBI institutions was based on nationality or religion. The State Secretary declined to address individual taxpayers citing fiscal secrecy, noted pro forma appeal, explained the selection practice in general terms and said the mosque-related CAF investigation continues.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation, I cannot address an individual taxpayer.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik niet ingaan op een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op ragen van Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht Koester familiebedrijven, ze dragen de economie

MPs Inge van Dijk, Palland and Amhaouch asked whether family businesses deserve protection and whether the planned tightening of the business succession exemption (BOR) risks harming them, citing commentary by Maarten de Groot. The State Secretary agreed family firms add substantial economic value and should be supported, but rejected claims that the BOR changes would threaten them, citing a CPB evaluation, and promised to report after a pending study requested by a motion.
The cabinet does not expect that the announced adjustments to the BOR will lead to this.
Het kabinet verwacht niet dat de aangekondigde aanpassingen in de BOR hier toe zullen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over "de werkerscoöperatie in aanvulling op de beraadslagingen tijdens het commissiedebat ZZP van woensdag 7 juni 2023"

Palland (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether platform workers forming a worker cooperative escape the cartel prohibition, whether they may agree collective terms with clients, how independence from the platform is guaranteed, and whether the 149-member limit under financial supervision rules applies. The Minister answered yes, subject to conditions: the cooperative must be an economic unit with no internal competition and decisive influence over members' market conduct, collective agreements with platforms are outside the cartel ban, independence rests on ILO convention 98 and voluntary cooperation, and the 149-person threshold relates to the Prospectus Regulation exemption.
Yes, provided certain conditions are met.
Ja, mits aan bepaalde voorwaarden is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Palland en Maatoug over de onderwijsroute naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan het Da Vinci College te Dordrecht over de onderwijsroute Wet inburgering 2021

Three MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Wi2021 education route after a visit to Da Vinci College in Dordrecht, covering extra assessments, the share routed to the education track, national coverage, and waiting youths. The minister answered that most municipalities now offer the route, that the maximum inburgering term is three years, and that outcome data on quality and progression will only be available in 2024.
Regarding the quality and progression from the education route to regular education, there is still insufficient knowledge due to the short duration of the Wi2021.
Over de kwaliteit en doorstroom vanuit de onderwijsroute naar regulier onderwijs is nog onvoldoende bekend vanwege de korte looptijd van de Wi2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Slootweg 'kabinetsbrief van 14 juni 2023, inzake kinderbijslag per 1 juli 2023'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs why child benefit (kinderbijslag) was negatively indexed from 1 July 2023 and whether the government would compensate families, including past negative indexations, budget effects, other benefits at risk, why the WML freeze mechanism was not used for child benefit, and whether family impacts will be shown in purchasing-power figures. The minister answered that a generic compensation is not suitable and will be considered in the August decisions, that the indexation was a shortfall versus the budget assumption, that the mechanism will be reviewed and reported in December, and that the government will implement the Palland/Stoffer motion on showing child impacts.
As promised during the Social Security Implementation committee debate on 29 June, I will examine whether adjusting the indexation method is possible and desirable.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het Commissiedebat Uitvoering Sociale Zekerheid op datum 29 juni jl. zal ik kijken of aanpassing van de wijze van indexeren mogelijk en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘UWV en ministerie van Sociale Zaken kwakzalven door met STAP-regeling’

MPs Palland and Van den Berg asked whether the government and UWV had filtered pseudoscientific courses out of the STAP training subsidy scheme and whether the scheme should be refocused on shortage sectors. The ministers answered that filtering measures have been tightened and thousands of courses removed, that STAP funding is being ended from 2024, and that lessons will inform a future lifelong-learning approach to be reported around summer.
The cabinet will inform the House around the summer about the LLO future exploration, involving the Ministries of SZW, OCW and EZK.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer rond de zomer informeren over de toekomstverkenning LLO, waar de Ministeries van SZW, OCW en EZK bij betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht "Bedrijf komt vaker uit bij zzp’er; In twee jaar tijd kwamen er in ons land bijna een miljoen nieuwe banen bij”

MP Palland (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the rise of freelancers (zzp'ers) as employers hire them amid a tight labour market, including effects on temporary workers, young people and the balance with employees. The minister answered that the tight market drives hiring of freelancers, that some may be disguised self-employed, and that the government is working on a labour market package and measures to balance employee and self-employed contracts.
An important aim of the package of measures to reform the labour market is therefore to create a more level playing field between freelancers and employees.
Een belangrijke inzet van het pakket maatregelen om de arbeidsmarkt te hervormen is daarom het zorgen voor een gelijker speelveld tussen zzp'ers en werkenden in loondienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Palland over het bericht ‘Subsidie op je rieten dak, maar alleen als het riet uit China komt’

CDA MPs asked why Chinese reed qualifies for ISDE insulation subsidy while Dutch reed does not, and whether Dutch reed's lower environmental impact was ignored. The minister said Chinese reed was listed because it met the minimum insulation value, Dutch reed is awaiting a performance declaration due in May, and the subsidy does not discriminate by country of origin.
Currently it is being examined how a good environmental performance of insulation material, for example biobased insulation materials, can be valued in the insulation subsidy schemes.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht hoe een goede milieuprestatie van isolatiemateriaal – bijvoorbeeld bij biobased isolatiematerialen – kan worden gewaardeerd in de subsidieregelingen voor isolatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht 'Medewerkers op Schiphol krijgen deze zomer 840 euro per maand extra'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland (CDA) asked about reports that Schiphol staff would receive extra pay via a summer bonus and an allowance rather than a raised collective wage, and about how these payments affect net income, benefit entitlements and repayment risk. The government gave a detailed answer with example calculations showing high marginal tax burdens for some groups, and said it was in contact with Schiphol and the unions, with no new binding commitment beyond existing ones.
I have asked Schiphol whether it is aware of this.
Ik heb Schiphol gevraagd of hier oog voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over achterblijvende lonen en lage reiskostenvergoeding van werknemers van sociaal ontwikkelbedrijven

An MP asked the minister about low wages and a 10-cent-per-km travel allowance for sheltered-employment workers under the SW and Aan de Slag collective agreements, and whether government funding or action could improve them. The minister answered that the central government is not a party to these agreements, that municipalities receive funding they can use, that the cao parties must decide on changes, and that talks with VNG and Cedris are ongoing with a letter to the House after the summer recess.
The cao parties themselves are primarily responsible for complying with the agreements in the collective agreements.
Het is primair aan de cao-partijen zelf om afspraken uit de cao's na te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Drost, Stoffer, Pouw-Verweij en Palland over de beeldvorming van leven met downsyndroom

MPs from five parties asked the government about a biology textbook passage on Down syndrome, its implications for inclusion, prenatal counselling and support for people with disabilities. The minister said the publisher withdrew the passage, that schools must promote democratic basic values, and described existing policy on inclusion, counselling and support, but declined to evaluate the effects of the prenatal screening funding change.
I am always open to societal signals following funding changes, but an investigation is not appropriate.
Ik sta altijd open voor maatschappelijke signalen naar aanleiding van bekostigingswijzigingen, maar een onderzoek ligt niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Palland over het bericht 'Wie redt de grootste kerk van de vier noordelijke provincies? Zelfs de klokken mogen nu niet luiden'

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the structural decay of the Bovenkerk in Kampen and whether the Rijk should fund a restoration including re-foundation. The secretary acknowledged the problems, said the RCE is involved, and said funding depends on pending structural research; she committed to a broader policy review letter in June.
I expect to send the cabinet's response to the heritage policy review to the House in June.
Ik verwacht de kabinetsreactie op de beleidsdoorlichting erfgoed in juni naar de Kamer te sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.
Antwoord op van het lid Palland over de berichten ‘Maak regels arbeidsmigratie snel strenger’ en ‘Duitse burgemeesters niet blij met arbeidsmigranten’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about reports that staffing agencies house Dutch-employed migrant workers across the German border and about German mayors' complaints, with eleven questions on scale, cooperation, housing rules and tighter policy. The minister answered that no precise data exist, pointed to ongoing Dutch-German cooperation and joint inspections, described progress on housing measures, and said a business impact assessment and a demographic commission are in preparation.
Precise figures on the number of migrant workers and which staffing agencies operate across the border do not exist.
Precieze cijfers over het aantal arbeidsmigranten en welke uitzendbureaus grensoverschrijdend werken zijn er niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van den Berg en Kuik over de berichten ‘Groen licht voor euthanasie, maar Nathalie wil verkrachter eerst nog een keer in de ogen kijken’ en ‘Na loodzwaar traject kreeg ik ‘groen l

Three CDA MPs asked the health minister about press reports of euthanasia requests linked to sexual trauma, asking for data, whether society is failing victims, waiting times and treatment availability for trauma care. The minister answered that no national data on trauma-linked euthanasia requests exists, acknowledged the tragedy, pointed to the national action programme and the Integral Care Agreement, and gave waiting-time and PTSS treatment figures.
No, no data on this is collected at the national level.
Nee, hierover worden op landelijk niveau geen gegevens verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Boswijk over wachtlijsten bij agrarische kinderopvang vanwege starre regelgeving

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether rigid rules cause long waiting lists for farm-based childcare and whether those rules block growth of this multifunctional farming activity. The government agreed that farm childcare has benefits, said it is working with LTO and VNG on municipal permit barriers and an updated handreiking, and committed to further talks and checking whether linking permits to farm turnover is a problem, without conceding that rules currently make growth impossible.
At present, LNV, together with VNG and LTO, is working on a proposal to update the 2011 'Handreiking Multifunctionele Landbouw en Ruimtelijke Ordening'.
Op dit moment wordt vanuit LNV samen met VNG en LTO aan een voorstel gewerkt om de «Handreiking Multifunctionele Landbouw en Ruimtelijke Ordening» uit 2011 te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Palland over het aanblijvende gebrek aan voortgang bij de unaniem aangenomen motie aanpak AOW-hiaat

MPs Van Kent and Palland asked why the unanimously adopted motion on the AOW-gap for self-employed people who were already ill before the AOW age rise has seen no progress, and when the initiators would be involved. The minister acknowledges the delay, states that a two-year extension of the Overbruggingsuitkering is proposed as the solution, and promises a technical briefing and letters to affected people.
I regret the delay that has arisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Arbonormen bagagepersoneel Schiphol jarenlang overschreden, deel heeft gezondheidsklachten'

MPs Palland and Van der Molen (CDA) asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Infrastructure and Finance about reports that baggage handling staff at Schiphol worked beyond Arbo limits for years and that the Labour Inspectorate had not inspected these firms for twelve years. The government replied that employers bear primary responsibility, that the Inspectorate has started investigations and will report further, and that sector CAO, access restrictions on handlers and talks with Schiphol and KLM are underway.
I have asked the Labour Inspectorate to examine whether improvements are possible. Parliament will be informed further on this.
Ik heb de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Hierover wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over de bijdrage van de stichting Femmes for Freedom aan  emancipatie van meisjes en vrouwen met een biculturele achtergrond

MP Palland asked the ministers whether the 2020 Peters motion on a lasting role for Femmes for Freedom in the theme of self-determination had been carried out, and what concrete arrangements had been made. The minister answers that the foundation is a durable partner for the government on inclusion and emancipation, lists its involvement in consultations, awareness material, a bill on marital captivity and a funded alliance, while noting other parties may also apply for subsidies.
The Foundation Femmes for Freedom is a durable discussion partner of the national government on issues of inclusion and emancipation of girls and women with a bicultural background.

De Stichting Femmes for Freedom is een duurzame gesprekspartner van de rijksoverheid waar het gaat om vraagstukken op het gebied van inclusie en emancipatie van meisjes en vrouwen met een biculturele achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Werner over kwetsbare ouderen die vaak geen gebruik maken van inkomensvoorzieningen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Ministers for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions and for Long-term Care and Sport about vulnerable older people who often do not claim income support, citing a National Ombudsman report on complexity, distance from government and low trust. Minister Schouten largely agreed with the analysis, estimated roughly 30% potential non-take-up of the AIO (about 20,000 households), announced a data-exchange pilot between SVB and UWV/Tax Authority, and defended current application procedures while saying automatic allocation is complex and only sometimes feasible.
I broadly share the analysis of the National Ombudsman.
Ik deel de analyse van de Nationale ombudsman in grote lijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner, Inge van Dijk en Palland over het beschermen en behouden van maritiem erfgoed.

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about protecting maritime and sailing heritage, including historic houseboats, and about registration, legal anchoring and a plan of action. The State Secretary answered that the national government's role is mainly support and facilitation, that existing registers and designation tools are in place, and that the Erfgoedwet evaluation and a follow-up meeting with the sector will come later.
For the national government, that role lies mainly in support and facilitation in the field of knowledge and expertise.
Voor het Rijk ligt die vooral in ondersteuning en facilitering op het vlak van kennis en kunde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van den Berg over de STAP-subsidie in relatie tot kwakzalverij en dropshopping

MPs Palland and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether STAP training subsidies can fund therapeutic and dropshipping courses, and how the government verifies their labour-market relevance. The minister answered that such courses are not excluded if the provider is accredited and the training is legal, that the Toetsingskamer STAP monitors providers and has ordered the removal of over 2,000 courses, and that an evaluation will follow in early 2023.
The STAP budget is a learning scheme that is continually adjusted and further targeted.
Het STAP-budget is een lerende regeling, die gaande weg wordt aangepast en verder wordt gericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over de Circulaire Samenloop vergoedingen raadsleden met een uitkering en het borgen van inclusiviteit in de lokale democratie

Two CDA MPs asked whether municipal councillors receiving WIA disability benefits must surrender 75% of their council allowance, how this compares with Participatiewet rules, and whether the 2015 circular should be updated to promote inclusiveness in local democracy. The ministers answered that the WIA offset rules apply to council allowances, outline the rules by benefit phase, confirm the circular is substantively correct but needs updating, and point to an action plan and a planned website expansion.

However, it indeed needs to be updated because, for example, the decision on the legal position of council and committee members was replaced by the Decision on the Legal Position of Decentralised Political Office Holders as of 2019.

Zij moet echter inderdaad geactualiseerd worden omdat bijvoorbeeld het rechtspositiebesluit raads- en commissieleden per 2019 is vervangen door het Rechtspositiebesluit decentrale politieke ambtsdragers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Den Haan over het nader verslag inzake wijziging van de Pensioenwet, de Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001 en enige andere wetten in verband met herziening va

MPs Palland, Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Den Haan asked whether the government's pension projection table ignores the 1.5% projection return, whether pensions can keep pace with 2%, 4% or 6% inflation, and whether more detailed scenario tables are possible. The minister admitted the table was a simplified example with an implicit zero nominal projection return and that the assumptions should have been stated more clearly, argued the new contract offers earlier prospects of indexation than the current one, and promised supplementary DNB calculations before the 12 September hearing.
I acknowledge that the answer could have been clearer about the assumptions underlying the projection return used.
Ik erken dat in de beantwoording duidelijker had kunnen worden aangegeven van welke veronderstellingen bij het gehanteerde projectierendement is uitgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Palland, Peters en Bikker over het artikel 'Investeer in preventie en die begint al bij de kinderwens'

MPs from CDA and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about preconception care such as the Nu Niet Zwanger programme, its reach, and whether it should be part of the Kansrijke Start programme and municipal prenatal advice duties. The state secretary answered that Nu Niet Zwanger is already part of Kansrijke Start, available in 172 municipalities, that 272 municipalities have a local Kansrijke Start coalition, and that structural funding and possible anchoring will be explored.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Grote woorden winnen in politiek Maastricht van sympathie’

MPs Palland and Koekkoek asked about a Maastricht council debate on a court ruling concerning the Tozo scheme for cross-border entrepreneurs, appeals, EU free-movement concerns and cross-border policy testing. The minister said the matter is for the municipality, that appeals were lodged and the ministry joins them, that the CRvB will rule, and that the Tozo's non-export rule follows the territoriality principle.
That is why it is good that the higher administrative court now assesses this case in an independent and impartial manner.
Daarom is het goed dat nu de hogere (bestuurs)rechter deze zaak op een onafhankelijke en onpartijdige wijze gaat beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: zzp’ers en de fiscale oudedagsreserve’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report showing many self-employed workers claim the fiscal retirement reserve (FOR) without actually setting the money aside for retirement, and about the complexity, efficiency and consequences of the FOR. The State Secretary answered that the FOR is largely a tax deferral tool, that he finds this undesirable, and that the cabinet will propose abolishing the FOR from 1 January 2023 in the Belastingplan 2023.
As part of the Tax Plan 2023, it will be proposed to abolish the FOR.
Als onderdeel van het Belastingplan 2023 zal worden voorgesteld de FOR af te schaffen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht "Rechter steunt grensondernemers over Tozo"
