MPs Palland and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that cross-border entrepreneurs may be entitled to the Tozo support scheme, asking about the consequences, number of affected people, contact with neighbouring countries, and the status of earlier motions. The minister answered that officials are studying the ruling, the municipality of Maastricht intends to appeal, and no substantive answers on the scope, implications or motions can be given until legal proceedings are complete.
For this reason I cannot yet respond substantively to your questions concerning the municipality's operational framework.
Daarom kan ik op dit moment nog niet inhoudelijk ingaan op uw vragen met betrekking tot het handelingskader van de gemeente.
Àntwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over de toekomst van de zeilende beroepsvaart

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about a 2022 report on financing the future of the sailing commercial fleet (bruine vloot) as maritime heritage, and whether they would consult sector and government partners and answer before the tourism debate. The answer is only a referral: the questions were answered in a separate letter on tourism.
The written questions ... have been answered by letter 'Reaction to committee request on supplementary main lines on tourism' (Parliamentary paper 26 419, no. 96).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «Reactie op verzoek commissie over aanvullende hoofdlijnen inzake toerisme» (Kamerstuk 26 419, nr. 96 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Investeerders vergroten hun greep op de kinderopvang'

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about private equity investors buying childcare organisations for profit, the consequences for quality and access, parents' rights to be informed of takeovers, and how to prevent property investors from dominating childcare. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says quality is what matters regardless of ownership, notes parents have oudercommissie advisory rights and takeovers preserve existing agreements, and announces a study of financing forms including possible profit caps.
That is why I have announced that I will investigate the role of the different financing forms in childcare.
Daarom heb ik aangekondigd dat ik de rol van de verschillende financieringsvormen in de kinderopvang ga onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Palland over gebrek aan voortgang bij de unaniem aangenomen motie aanpak AOW-hiaat

MPs Van Kent (SP) and Palland (CDA) asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions why a unanimously adopted motion on compensating self-employed people affected by the AOW-gap has made no visible progress, and whether the initiators have been informed. The answer notes the questions were already answered during question hour on 19 April 2022, pointing to a separate reply rather than providing substance here.

The written questions from MP Van Kent (SP) to the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions on the lack of progress on the unanimously adopted motion on the AOW-gap were answered during question hour on 19 April 2022.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Kent (SP) aan de Minister voor Armoedebeleid, Participatie en Pensioenen over gebrek aan voortgang bij de unaniem aangenomen motie aanpak AOW-hiaat ( 2022Z03459 ) zijn beantwoord tijdens het vragenuur van 19 april 2022 ( 2022Z07752 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Chinese douanescanners Schiphol en Rotterdamse haven onder vuur: 'Dit is onbegrijpelijk''

CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that Chinese-owned Nuctech scanners are used by Dutch customs and whether Nuctech's ties to the Chinese state, low bids and security risks were properly assessed. The government answered that it weighs national security risks case by case, found no abnormally low bids, cannot guarantee that the Chinese state has no access to the scanners, and is conducting follow-up security research.
The cabinet cannot give any guarantees about this.
Het kabinet kan hier geen garanties over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht dat 'Vandalen coronarellen ontlopen betalen van aangerichte schade'

An MP asked the Justice Minister how the government responds to reports that rioters over COVID measures escape paying for damage, and why damages recovery from perpetrators has been limited. The minister answered that businesses were compensated via a scheme, that recovery from offenders is partly successful but not yet concluded, and that the government is working with the prosecution service on recovery options and awaits the advisory commission's proposals.
Figures on the criminal recovery of damage compensation measures are not registered.
Cijfers rondom het strafrechtelijk vorderen van de schademaatregelen worden niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht ‘Ondernemers: Stel UBO-register uit tot uitspraak Europese Hof’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland asked the Finance Minister whether the UBO register registration deadline should be postponed pending a CJEU ruling, and about privacy protection of beneficial owners. The minister answered that the Advocate-General's opinion is not binding, that Dutch practice already largely follows its points, that no grounds exist to postpone the deadline, and that the privacy impact will be evaluated after one and four years.
I therefore see no reason, or legal basis, to postpone the legally established registration deadline.
Daarmee zie ik dan ook geen reden, of grondslag, tot uitstellen van de wettelijk vastgelegde registratiedeadline.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Miljoenen voor omscholing komen nauwelijks in de sectoren terecht die het nodig hebben: 'Dit slaat de plank volledig mis''

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that only 30 percent of NL Leert Door subsidised training courses target jobs with good prospects, and whether the scheme reaches workers with low qualifications. The minister defended the broad crisis-era design, said UWV's list of promising occupations is the reference, noted that about 79 percent of completed short courses were at mbo-2 level, and promised an evaluation report around summer 2022 without changing the scheme.
The Overview of promising occupations dates from 20 December 2021.
Het Overzicht Kansrijke beroepen stamt van 20 december 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht ‘De digitale knokploeg van Forum voor Democratie’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that Forum voor Democratie supporters on Telegram threaten political opponents and share addresses, and what police and platforms can do. The minister declined to judge the specific case, outlined police observation powers and platform obligations, and noted pending doxing legislation.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to comment on this specific case.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om mij uit te spreken over dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht ‘verdrievoudiging van bedreigingen en geweld tegen gemeenteraadsleden

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland asked about a report that threats and violence against municipal councillors had tripled since 2015, and about support, aftercare and measures against intimidation. The minister responded that the government works with the Netwerk Weerbaar Bestuur on norms, prevention and aftercare, will report monitoring results before summer, and that the doxing bill will be sent to parliament after the Council of State advises.
I consider it important to periodically monitor how the number and form of intimidation and threats against councillors and other local political office holders develop.
Ik vind het belangrijk om periodiek te monitoren hoe het aantal gevallen en de vorm van intimidatie en bedreiging onder raadsleden en andere decentrale politieke ambtsdragers zich ontwikkelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Rutte gaat in gesprek met bedrijfsleven over toenemende 'ellende''

CDA MPs asked the government about reports that Prime Minister Rutte would talk with business about rising hardship, debt built up during COVID, the hardship-fund and TVL/NOW subsidy gaps, bank refinancing costs, retail support and Bbz/TONK uptake. The ministers answered that talks with business continue, that a broad set of debt-relief tools exists, that subsidy rules cannot easily cover edge cases without slowing payments, and that some follow-up letters and reviews will come.
The cabinet realises that the current support package does not fit every individual situation, and that feels uncomfortable.
Het kabinet beseft dat het huidige steunpakket niet op iedere individuele situatie aansluit, en dat voelt ongemakkelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Familiebedrijf Balk Shipyard in Chinese handen'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the reported takeover of family shipyard Balk Shipyard by a Chinese investment group, including fit with industrial policy, financing instruments, screening under the investment screening law, and whether the firm will stay on Urk. The minister answered that the takeover is welcomed for enabling growth, that no screening obligation appears to apply, and that no reason exists to expect the firm to leave, while giving only generic information about the investor and no commitments on local agreements.
The cabinet does not collect information on business locations, corporate or ownership structures of companies unless required by laws and regulations.
Het kabinet verzamelt geen informatie over vestigingslocaties, bedrijfs- en/of eigendomsstructuren van bedrijven zolang dit niet is vereist voor wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Kuik over het artikel 'In veel branches wordt werk geruild voor seks'

Two CDA MPs asked whether trading work for sex in various industries, reported by AD, falls under prostitution rules, whether it amounts to exploitation of vulnerable people, and what measures, reporting options and advertisement restrictions exist. The State Secretary answered that exchanging services for sex is not prostitution, is not prohibited but is condemned when it involves abuse, pointed to a pending bill on sexual offences, reporting options and branch self-regulation, and promised to draw branches' attention to the law.

The cabinet will ensure that the bill now with the Council of State, which makes it punishable to know or ought to know that the other person does not want sexual contact, is explicitly brought to the attention of the branches.

Het kabinet zal ervoor zorgen dat het wetsvoorstel dat bij de Raad van State ligt, waarmee geregeld wordt dat je strafbaar bent als je weet of had moeten weten dat de ander geen seksueel contact wil, uitdrukkelijk onder de aandacht wordt gebracht bij de branches.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Palland over het misbruik van militaire uniformen bij de coronademonstratie in Amsterdam van 2 januari jl.

CDA MPs asked whether soldiers and veterans in uniform at a 2 January 2022 Amsterdam COVID demonstration, including a violent attack on a police officer, breached rules, and asked for stronger enforcement of uniform misuse laws. The ministers said uniform rules apply, that Defence has instructed commanders that demonstrating in uniform is a disciplinary offence, and that existing criminal provisions are not shown to be causing enforcement problems, though enforcement is discussed with prosecutors and police.
The Commander of the Armed Forces instructed his subordinate commanders in writing in December 2021 on how to act when military personnel in uniform take part in protests or demonstrations.
De Commandant der Strijdkrachten heeft in december 2021 zijn ondercommandanten schriftelijk geïnstrueerd hoe zij kunnen handelen als militairen in uniform meedoen aan protesten/betogingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het artikel 'Juridische fuik overheid maakt burgers 'kansloos''

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland asked the government about press reports that strict Awb deadlines leave citizens powerless when they file late objections, and about the 'bestuurlijke lus' and the citizen's ability to navigate the law. The minister says the Awb will be revised, citing a 2021 change in case law softening late-objection rules, and promises to examine a 'burgerlijke lus' and to consider more lenient handling of deadlines in two-party disputes.
In this context it is being examined whether to give administrative bodies more room to substantively handle an objection that was not filed within six weeks.
Hierbij wordt gekeken naar de mogelijkheid om meer ruimte te bieden voor bestuursorganen om een niet binnen zes weken ingediend bezwaar alsnog inhoudelijk te kunnen behandelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht dat European Sleeper de dienstregeling van de nieuwe nachttrein tussen Brussel, Rotterdam, Amsterdam, Berlijn en Praag heeft bekendgemaakt

MPs Amhaouch and Palland (CDA) asked about the European Sleeper night train timetable, why it stops only in the Randstad and not in regional stations like Hengelo, the government's involvement or subsidies, and the role of regional stations and capacity. The Staatssecretaris answered that the operator decides its stops, no subsidy goes to European Sleeper, other international trains do stop in regional stations, and capacity has been allocated without major problems.
Developing the timetable is in principle the responsibility of the operator itself, including the choice of a particular stopping pattern.
Het ontwikkelen van de dienstregeling is in beginsel de verantwoordelijkheid van de vervoerder zelf, inclusief de keuze voor een bepaald stoppatroon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Palland over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zelfredzaamheid productie mondkapjes’

MPs Van den Berg and Palland asked the health minister how the government will keep domestic face-mask production viable, including whether a Sittard firm could be kept on standby and whether the LCH could keep buying masks. The minister said no subsidies were given, the state will not rescue firms at risk of bankruptcy, and a study and innovation competitions are underway, with a ready-stock plan to follow later this year.
It is not for the government to support these companies in case they threaten to go bankrupt.
Het is niet aan de overheid om deze bedrijven te ondersteunen in het geval ze failliet dreigen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht ‘‘Gratis geld, en nog laat KLM haar flexwerkers spartelen’’

MP Palland (CDA) asked the minister about reports that KLM dismissed flexible workers during COVID-19 without adequate severance or reemployment support, and about the EGF subsidy application that covered only permanent staff. The government answered that it lacks full data, provided the EGF application, explained the EGF eligibility rules and their change, and said the responsibility for school-to-work transitions lies with employer and employee.
It is not possible for me to provide all the requested information, because I do not have it.
Het is voor mij niet mogelijk om alle gevraagde informatie te verstrekken, omdat ik daarover niet beschik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van Nispen over de Kamerbrief 'Financiële compensatie voor het tekortschieten in de informatievoorziening bij wijziging van de SBF-regeling'

MPs Palland (CDA) and Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the SBF-scheme compensation, arguing that SBF-ers suffered pension damage from the 2010 and 2013 changes and that DJI's poor information provision was wrongful. The Minister answered that no pension damage has been established, accepted the Boot/Lubbers finding of inadequate information only for the 2013 change (compensated), and declined further talks with the affected group.
I have not planned any consultation or follow-up steps with the SBF employees who used the SBF leave scheme or with the interest group 'SBF moet eerlijk'.
Ik heb geen overleg of vervolgstappen gepland met de SBF-medewerkers die gebruik hebben gemaakt van de SBF-verlofregeling of van de belangengroep «SBF moet eerlijk» gepland staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en van Nispen over het RTL4 nieuwsitem inzake de intimidatie van de advocaten van de nabestaanden van de MH17-zaak

MPs Palland and Van Nispen asked whether lawyers for MH17 victims' relatives were intimidated, likely by Russia, and what the government would do about it. Minister Grapperhaus declined to confirm individual cases or attribution for security reasons, citing close cooperation with intelligence services and general awareness measures, and offered a confidential technical briefing to the House.
For security reasons, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik geen uitspraken doen over individuele casuïstiek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over de berichten ‘Bedrijfsleven start eigen alarmsysteem tegen hackers: ‘overheid te traag’ & ‘Informatie over op handen zijnde hacks wordt grotendeels weggegooid’

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked whether the government is aware of reports that business is setting up its own hack-alert system because government is too slow, and asked about the Digital Trust Center, the NCSC's legal limits, and evaluation of these bodies. The minister says the private initiative is positive, defends the DTC and NCSC, and points to a draft amendment to the Wbni and pilots while promising to report on DTC results in early 2022.
It is a positive development that private initiatives in the field of cybersecurity, such as the "alarm system", are emerging.
Het is een positieve ontwikkeling dat private initiatieven op het gebied van cybersecurity, zoals het «alarmsysteem», zich ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Problemen met kwetsbare 112-meldkamers na zes jaar nog niet opgelost’

MPs Palland and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers about reports that vulnerable 112 emergency control rooms remain unresolved after six years, including staffing, responsibility fragmentation, ICT investigation and implementation of inspection recommendations. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the concerns are shared and a multi-year transition is underway, but largely defended the existing governance split, promised a WODC evaluation in 2022, periodic updates and a mobile coverage map by spring 2022.
I therefore do not share the supervisors' view on this point.
Ik deel het standpunt van de toezichthouders op dit punt dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Peters over het bericht ‘Kloosters kijken nog steeds uit naar coronasteun’

MPs asked the government about religious institutions such as monasteries, churches and mosques that reportedly struggle with lost income and get little corona support. The government answered that religious organisations can use the TVL and NOW schemes on the same terms as others, reported 79 religious TVL applications (66 granted, EUR 1,001,482), and said it had held talks with religious umbrella bodies.
For the NOW, it was not separately registered whether religious institutions made use of the NOW.
Voor de NOW is niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd of religieuze instellingen gebruik hebben gemaakt van de NOW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Thijssen en Amhaouch over de maatregelen om de energietransitie bij de maakindustrie in het ‘zesde cluster’ te bevorderen

MPs Palland, Thijssen and Amhaouch asked how the government will promote energy transition, hydrogen infrastructure and financing for energy-intensive manufacturers in the 'sixth cluster' (ceramics, carpets) in eastern Netherlands, fearing they are overlooked. The minister and state secretary answer that the cluster has equal support via existing subsidies (VEKI, TSE, DEI+), a hydrogen transport network plan due spring 2022, regional energy strategies, and reject a dedicated transition fund for now.
The sixth cluster receives the same support as the rest of industry to achieve a reduction in energy consumption and CO2 emissions, including the switch to hydrogen.
Het zesde cluster krijgt dezelfde ondersteuning als de overige industrie om een vermindering van het energieverbruik en van CO 2 -emissies, waaronder de omschakeling naar waterstof, te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch , over het bericht ‘Opnieuw problemen met Keolis-bussen die plotseling uitvallen'

MPs from the CDA asked the government about recurring failures of BYD-built Keolis buses in the Overijssel emergency concession, including whether provinces can exclude foreign manufacturers and how the EU International Procurement Instrument would affect bus procurement. The minister replied that the faults were limited and did not endanger safety, that provinces have limited ability to set origin requirements for privately purchased buses, and that the IPI would apply to public tenders but not private purchases, with information to provinces to follow once it takes effect.
In theory the province could purchase the buses itself, but in practice this almost never happens.
In theorie zou de provincie de bussen zelf kunnen inkopen, maar in de praktijk gebeurt dit vrijwel nooit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over de berichten ‘Beruchte topgangster deelt lakens uit in bajes Zaanstad’: ‘De R. bepaalt wat er gebeurt’ en ‘Motorbendekopstuk Lysander de R. (39) in allerijl uit cel gehaald en

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports that a gang leader inside Zaanstad prison runs a rival motorclub, influences prison affairs, and was moved after media attention. The minister confirmed the reports in part, explained the rules for inmate committees and complaint procedures, declined to discuss the individual transfer or the keylogger case due to an ongoing police investigation, and listed measures against criminal activity from detention.
In the interest of this investigation, I am not making any further statements about the keylogger at this time.
In het belang van dit onderzoek doe ik op dit moment geen verdere mededelingen over de key-logger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over herintroductie van de werktijdverkorting

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the minister about reintroducing short-time working (WTV), its eligibility rules, sector support, and a part-time unemployment scheme. The minister answered that WTV reopens from 1 October 2021 with pre-corona conditions, that supply shortages are generally normal business risk, and that a structural alternative will be sent to parliament before the budget debate.
Before the SZW 2022 budget debate, the House will receive a letter setting out several variants for a structural calamity/crisis scheme.
Voor de begrotingsbehandeling van SZW 2022 zal de Kamer een brief ontvangen met daarin uitgewerkt een aantal varianten voor een structurele calamiteiten/crisisregeling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch, en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Coronacrisis kost overheid tot dusver al 76,2 miljard euro' en het bericht 'Een vijfde van de coronasteun ging naar bedrijven met omze

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Finance, Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about reports that a fifth of corona support went to firms with year-on-year revenue growth, asking how much support was paid, how much was repaid, and whether firms would be asked to voluntarily repay. The government answered that support was not conditioned on annual revenue loss, estimated the share going to growing firms from partial data (TVL about 9%, NOW about 16% per ESB researchers), reported repayment figures, and committed to informing parliament and to a moral appeal to firms to repay.
Having an annual revenue decline was not a condition for using the generic support measures such as the TVL and NOW schemes.
Het hebben van een omzetdaling op jaarbasis is geen voorwaarde geweest om gebruik te maken van de generieke steunmaatregelen zoals de TVL en de NOW-regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bikker en Palland over de kleinschalige detentievoorziening De Compagnie in Krimpen a/d IJssel

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the small-scale detention unit De Compagnie in Krimpen a/d IJssel, including its outcomes, funding, possible nationwide rollout and reported closure. The minister answered that it is a pilot with promising recidivism and financial indications but no full cost-benefit analysis, that its elements will be built into the BBA concept, and that no irreversible steps will be taken before informing the House after the summer recess.
I will inform your House about this after the summer recess.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover na het zomerreces informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Werner over dynamische evenementenvergunningen

MPs from the CDA asked about the status of more flexible, phased event permit procedures (dynamic permits), why fairgrounds are classed as events rather than throughflow locations, differentiation by event category, municipal hesitancy, timelines, and a handreiking for municipalities. The Minister answered that permitting is primarily a municipal responsibility, that talks with the VNG are ongoing, that the government has communicated conditions for events to ease planning, and that answers were timed with the 11 June communication.
Issuing permits is primarily a local responsibility of the municipality, which is advised by the safety region, emergency services and other parties.
Het verstrekken van vergunningen is primair een lokale verantwoordelijkheid van gemeente, zij worden hierbij geadviseerd door de veiligheidsregio, hulpdiensten en andere partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Palland over het bericht ’Wijs bruine vloot aan als werelderfgoed’

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Palland asked the government whether the Dutch 'bruine vloot' (heritage sailing vessels) could be designated UNESCO World Heritage, whether Dutch vessels receive less subsidy than abroad, and whether the government would engage with provinces and the sector. The minister replied that movable objects like ships cannot be listed under the World Heritage Convention, pointed to intangible heritage routes and existing COVID support schemes, and offered to talk with the sector while info on foreign subsidies was still being gathered.
I asked the RCE to gather information through its international network, but this will take some time.
Ik heb de RCE gevraagd via zijn internationale netwerk informatie te verzamelen, maar dit zal enige tijd in beslag nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over de berichten ‘Dreigbrief bezorgd bij meerdere moskeeën in Nederland’ en ‘Brandstichting bij moskee in aanbouw in Gouda’

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the Minister of Justice about reports of threatening letters and parcels sent to multiple mosques and an arson attack on a mosque under construction in Gouda. The minister condemned the actions, said at least 24 mosques received parcels, one suspect was arrested for the Gouda fire, and that the incidents are under investigation, while referring the national discrimination coordinator and mosque security guidance to other bodies.
Because this concerns an ongoing investigation, I cannot go into further details of the threats.
Omdat het hier een lopend onderzoek betreft, kan ik niet ingaan op de verdere details van de bedreigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Peters over het bericht ‘Kloosters vragen om compensatie, want ook broeders bijten in coronatijd op houtje'

MPs asked whether monasteries whose income from abbey shops and guesthouses fell due to COVID-19 can access compensation, and whether they should be treated like shops and hospitality businesses. The government answered that these organisations can use the generic COVID schemes (NOW, Tozo, TVL) if they meet the conditions, and it does not plan additional measures specifically for them.
The cabinet is not currently planning to introduce additional support measures specifically for this group, beyond the existing generic support measures.
Het kabinet is vooralsnog niet voornemens om, naast de bestaande diverse generieke steunmaatregelen, aanvullende ondersteuningsmaatregelen te treffen specifiek voor deze groep.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Boswijk en Palland over Nederlandse (midden en klein-)bedrijven meer laten profiteren van grote overheidsaanbestedingen zoals de renovatie van de Afsluitdijk

CDA MPs asked whether Rijkswaterstaat ensured that the Afsluitdijk renovation contract, awarded to Levvel, would use innovative Dutch small and medium enterprises and avoid leakage of money abroad (e.g. Chinese valve products). The minister answered that the contract was tendered as a whole for integrality, that EU procurement law prevents mandating product origin, and that a large share of investment benefits the Dutch economy, though exact figures are withheld for competition reasons.
I cannot make precise figures public for reasons of competition.
Precieze cijfers kan ik uit concurrentieoverwegingen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het uitblijven van branchespecifieke coronasteun voor de bruine vloot

An MP asked the government about the lack of sector-specific corona support for the traditional sailing ship (bruine vloot) sector, including delays in a promised 15 million euro scheme and wrongly assigned SBI codes forcing repeated objections. The state secretary answered that existing TVL/TOGS support fits these businesses, that the new scheme aims to open in June, and that RVO.nl is speeding up objection handling.
By May at the latest, the Ministers of Finance, Economic Affairs and Climate, and Social Affairs and Employment will come with a proposal on what the support will look like in the third quarter.
Uiterlijk in mei komen de Ministers van Financiën, Economische Zaken en Klimaat en Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid met een voorstel hoe de steun eruit zal zien in het derde kwartaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Palland over het bericht ‘Werkgevers: creatieve oplossing nodig voor meer stageplekken mbo’ers’

Two CDA MPs asked ministers whether creative solutions such as more trainees per company, variable internship length and retired supervisors could ease the shortage of MBO internship places, and what the SBB action plan has achieved. The minister answers that these options are already possible under the service document, cites about 20,000 students still seeking placements, and promises continued pressure on schools and employers and further action if needed.
If I find that this is not yet sufficient, I will work with SBB and other partners to ensure that the additional room from the service document is used as much as possible.
Als ik merk dat dit nog niet volstaat, zal ik mij samen met SBB en andere partners inspannen om te zorgen dat de extra ruimte uit het servicedocument zoveel mogelijk wordt benut.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over hoe baggeraars zich verweren tegen Chinese concurrentie

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked the Ministers of Foreign Trade and Economic Affairs about unequal competition from Chinese dredging firms in EU tenders and the lack of reciprocal market access. The government acknowledged the problem and pointed to existing tools and EU instruments under development (IPI, foreign subsidies white paper) without committing to new sector-specific measures.
The cabinet is increasingly concerned about an unequal playing field between European and Chinese companies.
Het kabinet maakt zich in toenemende mate zorgen over een ongelijk speelveld tussen Europese en Chinese bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Zorgmedewerkers ervaren vaccinatiedruk'

MPs Palland and Van den Berg asked whether healthcare workers experience pressure to be vaccinated against COVID-19 from employers or colleagues, and what the government is doing about it. The ministers answered that vaccination must remain voluntary, that about 20 reports of perceived pressure reached unions while the inspectorates received almost none, and that the government relies on persuasion and advice rather than coercion.
Due to the confidentiality of the reports, they cannot provide further information about these reports.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de meldingen kunnen zij geen nadere info verschaffen over deze meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Von Martels over "amateurvoetbalverenigingen die in financiële problemen komen vanwege een bureaucratische regel van de overheid"

Two CDA MPs asked why amateur football clubs miss NOW 3.0 wage compensation because June 2020 was chosen as the reference month, when many clubs have no trainers on payroll during the summer break. The minister acknowledges the problem but says no fix is possible without undue risk, points clubs to the TASO scheme, and says the government is looking at extending TASO for the first and second quarters.
The cabinet hopes in this way to meet the amateur clubs.
Het kabinet hoopt hiermee de amateurclubs tegemoet te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over deeltijd-WW

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about implementing the adopted motion on a deeltijd-WW (partial unemployment benefit) scheme, UWV capacity, timelines and stakeholder involvement. The minister answered that a structural scheme is being explored with UWV, that the 2008-09 model cannot simply be reinstated due to 2015 WWZ changes, that UWV capacity is limited until around 2022, that the scheme will take several years and be left to the next cabinet, and that social partners will be consulted.
However, I leave the elaboration of, and decision-making on, such a scheme to the next cabinet.
De uitwerking van – en besluitvorming over – een dergelijke regeling laat ik echter over aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Palland over het bericht 'Gaat de Nederlandse industrie aan boord van Nederlandse onderzeeboten?'

MPs Van Helvert and Palland (CDA) asked about concerns that Dutch industry may not be included in the new submarines given the three-yard competition, the cost burden on SMEs, and knock-out criteria for industrial participation. The government replied that essential security interests and strategic autonomy will be secured through primary and secondary requirements in the procurement, that a parallel industrial cooperation agreement led by EZK will pursue broader Dutch involvement, and that no fixed participation percentage is imposed in advance.
Defence will, after testing in the dialogue, set requirements in the D-phase to safeguard essential national security interests and strategic autonomy.
Defensie zal daarbij, na toetsing in de dialoog, in de D-fase eisen stellen ter borging van het wezenlijk nationaal veiligheidsbelang en de strategische autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van Weyenberg over de onbelaste vaste reiskostenvergoeding

MPs Palland and Van Weyenberg asked whether the tax-free fixed travel allowance measure expires on 1 April 2021, what considerations underlie extending it, how employers view it, and when clarity will be given. The government answered that the measure is extended to 1 July 2021, explained the trade-offs, said it is studying a supplementary scheme for home-working costs, and said the Tax Administration cannot see how many employers kept unchanged allowances.
The Tax Administration therefore has no information on how many employers have not adjusted the travel allowance despite no actual travel costs being incurred.
De Belastingdienst beschikt daardoor niet over informatie hoeveel werkgevers de reiskostenvergoeding niet hebben aangepast ondanks dat er geen daadwerkelijk gemaakte reiskosten tegenover staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'West-Zeeuws-Vlaamse horeca moet voor Pasen open: 'Als dit nog maanden duurt, gaan bedrijven kapot''

Three CDA MPs asked the minister about the West Zeeland-Flemish hospitality sector's demand to reopen before Easter, the lack of economic perspective in the COVID-19 roadmap, and whether sectors such as hospitality and hairdressing were consulted. The State Secretary answered that the epidemiological situation allows only small steps, that sectors are consulted through regular talks and advisory bodies such as the SER and CPB, and that plans for a phased reopening will be integrated into a periodic revision of the roadmap.
That is why the cabinet has started working with VNO-NCW and MKB-Nederland to formulate plans for a smart reopening of sectors.
Daarom is het kabinet met VNO-NCW en MKB-Nederland aan de slag gegaan om plannen te formuleren voor een slimme heropening van sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Domper voor winkeliers: PostNL verlaagt vergoedingen'

CDA MPs asked the Minister whether PostNL may cut the compensated hours for shopkeepers hosting parcel service points from eight to six, given that the parcel boom boosts PostNL's turnover, and whether this was decided without consulting retailers. The Minister answered that the carriers voluntarily offered temporary extra compensation, that PostNL may freely end it, and that she sees no reason to intervene in company policy or the civil-law relationship with shopkeepers.
I do not consider it desirable to interfere in PostNL's business operations or in the civil-law relationship between the parcel carrier and the shopkeeper who manages a postal and parcel point.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk om mij te mengen in de bedrijfsvoering van PostNL of in de civielrechtelijke relatie tussen de pakketvervoerder en de winkelier die een post- en pakketpunt beheert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Palland over de telefonische bereikbaarheid in Overijssel

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile phone coverage in Overijssel, especially around Vilsteren and Hoge Hexel, and the status of a planned KPN mast. The State Secretary agreed coverage should be optimal everywhere, said KPN plans to realise the Hoge Hexel site by the end of the second quarter of 2021, and said coverage in Vilsteren is not optimal but plans there are less concrete, pointing the municipality of Ommen to existing guidance.
Improving coverage has the attention of mobile operators.
Het verbeteren van de dekking heeft de aandacht van mobiele operators.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Schuifdakenfabrikant Inalfa Venray zet zeker 190 mensen op straat'

MPs Amhaouch and Palland (CDA) asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Social Affairs about the planned loss of at least 190 jobs at Inalfa Venray, the regional impact, and industrial policy. The minister answered that no direct government contact with Inalfa occurred before the reorganisation, that the regional labour market can help affected workers, that the R&D subsidy scheme will open by 15 May 2021, and that a regional SWOT analysis is not considered necessary.
To date there has been no direct contact between the central government and Inalfa about the impending reorganisation at the company.
Er is tot op heden geen direct contact geweest tussen de rijksoverheid en Inalfa over de op handen zijnde reorganisatie bij het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het delen van een Europees advies over de Tozo

MP Palland asked whether the European Commission requested an advice on the Tozo from MoveS network experts, whether it would be shared with the Chamber, and when answers to earlier questions on the Tozo for cross-border entrepreneurs would be sent. The minister confirmed the Commission provided two opinions (June and July 2020) at SZW's request, released them anonymised and with consent, stated they are not the Commission's position, and gave the date the earlier answers were sent.
The European Commission made the advice available at the request of SZW and agreed to its publication.
De Europese Commissie heeft het advies op verzoek van SZW beschikbaar gesteld en heeft ingestemd met openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het rapport 'Houding en gebruik MKB-ontzorg-verzekering'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about low uptake of the MKB sick-pay insurance product, its higher premiums, the effect of shortening the sick-pay period, and whether support for small employers will work. The minister answered that the product is in a start-up phase, that uptake is expected to grow, and that the alternative package of measures is being implemented, while defending the product and noting the premium effect of shorter sick pay is an estimate from insurers.
There are no figures available that give insight into the use and awareness of the MKB sick-pay insurance across the different sectors.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend die inzicht geven in het gebruik en de bekendheid van de MKB verzuim-ontzorg-verzekering tussen de verschillende sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Postma over het bericht "Thuiswerken met peuter of baby? Dat is een illusie''

MPs Palland and Postma asked the minister about parents struggling to combine work, schooling and childcare during the lockdown, and about calls for a temporary corona leave scheme like those in Belgium, Germany, Austria and Norway. The minister says the situation has improved since reopening, relies on employer-employee agreements and collective labour agreements, and says no feasible extra corona leave scheme was found in talks with social partners, promising to inform the House further.
I will inform you further about this in response to the Smeulders/Van Weyenberg motion of 28 January 2021.
Ik zal u hierover nader informeren als reactie op de motie Smeulders / Van Weyenberg van 28 januari 2021

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het korten van de WIA-uitkering voor Nederlanders die in België werken en waarvan de werkgevers een beroep doet op het stelsel vantijdelijke werkloosheid wegens overmacht in Be

Palland (CDA) asked whether Dutch WIA recipients working in Belgium or Germany and receiving Belgian temporary unemployment-for-force-majeure benefits, or NOW-type wage support, are wrongly having their WIA benefit reduced, and whether that is acceptable. Minister Koolmees answered that these payments are treated as earnings from work offset against the WIA benefit, so recipients keep the same WIA amount as before the crisis, and he sees no reason to change this.
I therefore see no reason or need to do this differently.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden of noodzaak om dit anders te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Nauwelijks coronasteun voor startende ondernemers: 'Ik hou het nog drie maanden vol'’

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked why businesses founded in 2020 cannot access the NOW and TVL COVID support schemes, and what alternatives were considered. The State Secretary answered that a separate Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will use Q3 2020 as reference revenue, with about 180 million euro budgeted, after alternatives such as constructed reference revenue and flat payments were rejected for fairness and feasibility reasons.
To be able to support businesses that started in the period from 1 October 2019 through 30 June 2020, the cabinet will develop a separate scheme for starters.
Om ondernemingen die zijn gestart in de periode vanaf 1 oktober 2019 tot en met 30 juni 2020 te kunnen ondersteunen, zal het kabinet een separate regeling voor starters ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Palland en Bruins over signalen vanuit de Industriecoalitie m.b.t. de regelingen Leven Lang Ontwikkelen (LLO)

MPs Tielen, Palland and Bruins asked whether the government is aware of the Industriecoalitie's signals that LLO schemes are fragmented, favour surplus sectors over shortage sectors, and are hard to scale or combine with modular training. The minister acknowledged the consultations and defended the existing complementary schemes, promising evaluation and sector-led plans without committing to a structural redesign.
The starting point is that people can receive support depending on their position and needs.
Het uitgangspunt is dat mensen, afhankelijk van hun positie en behoefte, ondersteuning kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Palland over de Tozo voor grensondernemers

MPs Van Weyenberg and Palland asked about cross-border entrepreneurs living in Germany or Belgium who run businesses in the Netherlands and are excluded from the Tozo, and whether support could be extended. The minister answered that Tozo and TONK are social assistance not exportable abroad for equality and practical reasons, pointed to other Dutch support schemes, said EU talks are ongoing, and committed to a quarterly monitoring report.
The Tozo is social assistance provided only to persons residing in the Netherlands.
De Tozo betreft immers sociale bijstand die alleen wordt verstrekt aan personen die in Nederland woonachtig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Peters en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Arbeidsinspectie gaf werkgevers jarenlang onterechte en te hoge boetes'

Three CDA MPs asked the minister about press reports that the labour inspectorate imposed wrongful and excessive fines, and about its appeal practice, matching of fines, and remedies for affected employers. The minister denied systematic misinformation, said appeals are decided case by case, and committed to a review of the graduated approach to minor workplace accidents.
No, there is no automatic or maximal pursuit of appeals. It is always a case-by-case weighing.
Nee, er wordt niet automatisch of zoveel mogelijk doorgeprocedeerd. Het betreft steeds een weging per geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van den Berg, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over het bericht 'Misstanden bij koeriers zijn eerder regel dan uitzondering'

MPs asked the Social Affairs minister about reports of widespread abuses at parcel and courier firms, including WW recipients working as couriers, workers without valid residence papers and sham constructions, and how these can persist. The minister acknowledged the serious findings from Inspectie SZW, described its sector programme and enforcement, and said the Inspectorate will confront major clients and evaluate in 2022 whether further measures are needed.
I attach great importance to fair, healthy and safe work for all employees.
Ik hecht groot belang aan eerlijk, gezond en veilig werk voor alle werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van den Berg, Palland, Postma en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Keuringsinstantie DCI Joure (NKIP) in Chinese handen'

MPs from the CDA asked the Infrastructure and Environment and Economic Affairs ministers whether the Dutch yacht certification body DCI Joure, which became fully Chinese-owned in November 2019, poses risks, whether the takeover could have been screened, and what monitoring applies. The government answered that the takeover falls outside existing investment screening, that accreditation by the RvA and supervision by the ILT ensure quality and independence, and that it sees no national security risk.
The cabinet establishes that there are no risks to national security from the takeover of this body, which oversees the quality of pleasure craft.
Het kabinet stelt vast dat er voor de nationale veiligheid geen risico’s zijn bij de overname van deze instantie, die toeziet op de kwaliteit van plezierjachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Terpstra over het bericht 'Migranten in Westland wonen in tenten en hutjes door gebrek aan huisvesting'

MPs Palland and Terpstra (CDA) asked ministers about reports that migrant workers in Westland live in tents and shacks due to lack of housing, including agreed bed-space targets and national support instruments. Minister Koolmees answered that the municipality reports about 4,500 people housed rather than 'barely any', that Den Haag is responsible for the tent images, and that the government will act on the Aanjaagteam advice and inform parliament by 16 December.
The cabinet is working on this and hopes to inform the House of Representatives about it by 16 December.
Het kabinet is hiermee aan de slag en hoopt voor 16 december daarover de TK te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Slootweg over de berichten 'Mkb'ers maar matig op de hoogte van financieringsmogelijkheden' en 'Kredietverzekeraar: Nederland wacht volgend jaar grote faillissementsgo

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about SMEs' limited awareness of financing options and about a predicted bankruptcy wave, including whether insolvency law could intervene earlier and whether a temporary protection for healthy firms should be introduced. The state secretary answered that many support schemes exist, that bankruptcies remain low due to support packages and court delays, that the WHOA restructuring law is the chosen tool, and that a general protection measure is rejected as too broad, while committing to a Kamer report on the annual SME action plan and a bank-data analysis.

I have not made a commitment that, in addition to the existing CBS monitoring commissioned by EZK, periodic reporting will be provided on the use of the guarantee schemes in general and specifically on rejections.

Ik heb geen toezegging gedaan dat er aanvullend op de bestaande monitoring door het CBS in opdracht van EZK (periodiek) gerapporteerd wordt over het gebruik van de garantieregelingen in het algemeen en specifiek over afwijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Von Martels over (vakantie)verhuurplatforms en toeristenbelasting

MPs Palland and Von Martels asked how Dutch tourist tax collection through holiday rental platforms differs from other European countries, why France can have platforms collect it while the Netherlands does not, and whether an agreement with platforms is feasible. The minister answered that no comparative overview exists, that platform collection is not necessary in the Netherlands given the registration obligation in the new short-stay rental law, and that no signal shows parties now consider a platform agreement feasible.
An overview of the manner of any local tourist tax levy in other European countries is not available, so no comparison with the Netherlands can be made.
Een overzicht van de (wijze van de) eventuele heffing van (lokale) toeristenbelasting in andere Europese landen is niet beschikbaar, dus er kan geen vergelijking met Nederland worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Amhaouch en Palland over het met contant geld kunnen blijven betalen in winkels

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether shops are increasingly refusing cash, whether COVID plays a role, what is done for groups dependent on cash, and how costs for small businesses will develop. The minister answered that no current data exist, a DNB/Panteia study is pending, cash acceptance is a commitment under MOB agreements, and further research on cash infrastructure is planned.
There is currently no up-to-date data available on the number of retail outlets concerned and the extent to which corona plays a role.
Er zijn op dit moment geen actuele gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal toonbankinstellingen dat dit betreft en in hoeverre corona hierbij een rol speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht Camping kreeg duizenden UWV-brieven voor onbekende Polen. ‘Dit is gewoon uitkeringsfraude’ en ‘massale uitkeringsfraude op camping’

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that a holiday park received thousands of UWV letters addressed to unknown Polish residents, raising suspicion of benefit fraud. The minister replies that the letters largely reached the park through address and postal errors, that an ongoing criminal and administrative investigation prevents disclosing fraud findings, and that UWV will be asked to pay closer attention to returned post.
Regarding this ongoing investigation, I cannot make further statements in the interest of the investigation.
Over dit – lopende – onderzoek kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Accountants verwachten dat bedrijven een aanzienlijk deel noodsteun moeten terugbetalen'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that accountants expect firms to repay a large part of NOW wage-support subsidies after applying at group rather than subsidiary level. The minister acknowledged problems where subsidiaries applied at the wrong level, announced a planned amendment to NOW-1 and NOW-2 allowing a subsidiary-level settlement and deferring two conditions to the settlement stage, but could not say how many applications were affected.

Therefore I am preparing an amendment to NOW-1 and 2 that makes it possible for these firms, when applying for settlement, to still qualify for the subsidy being set at subsidiary rather than group level.

Daarom bereid ik een wijziging van de NOW-1 en 2 voor die het mogelijk maakt dat deze bedrijven bij de aanvraag van vaststelling alsnog ervoor in aanmerking komen dat de subsidie niet op het niveau van het concern maar op het niveau van de werkmaatschappij wordt vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Arbeidsmigrant reist steeds verder' en het bericht 'Goedkope arbeidsmigrant komt van steeds verder'

MP Palland (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that temporary labour migrants from outside the EEA are increasingly employed in the Netherlands via A1 posting arrangements, where contributions are paid abroad, and whether this creates unfair competition and fraud risks. The minister answered that the arrangements are lawful within EU rules but premium-shopping is unacceptable, that data on non-EEA workers under A1 are not recorded, and that enforcement is shared among several bodies with further measures pending.
From the data currently available to us, it cannot be deduced how many workers from outside the EEA have been employed in the Netherlands via A1 posting in recent years.
Uit de ons thans ter beschikking staande gegevens valt niet af te leiden hoeveel arbeiders van buiten de EER in de afgelopen jaren via een A1-verloning in Nederland te werk zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over 'De uitzending 'Vermalen door instanties' van het televisieprogramma Hollandse Zaken'

MP Palland (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Hollandse Zaken broadcast on UWV practices, including the opaque CBBS job-matching system, the 'kapdatum' cut-off date, incorrect dates in letters, advising claimants to switch from WW to ZW benefits, maatmanloon calculations, file reference numbers and signature requirements for medical assessments. The minister answered that claimants can verify CBBS matches with the case worker and request printouts, that the Stichting van de Arbeid advice on transparency will be discussed with social partners and UWV with a report before year-end, and that the other matters are explained as routine UWV procedure with recourse via objection and appeal.
I will discuss this with the social partners and UWV. I will inform you of the outcome of these discussions before the end of this year.
Ik zal hierover in gesprek gaan met de sociale partners en UWV. Over de uitkomst van deze gesprekken zal ik u voor het einde van dit jaar informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch, Van der Molen, Van Helvert en Van Weyenberg over het bericht "Nederland moet ondernemers in het buitenland mogelijk toch TOZO-uitkering geven"

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the State Secretary whether the European Commission's view that the Tozo is a special non-contributory benefit requires exporting it to cross-border entrepreneurs, and whether Tozo 2's partner test should be treated differently. The State Secretary answered that the Tozo is a social assistance benefit outside the scope of the coordination regulation, so it cannot be exported, and that cross-border entrepreneurs can use other support measures instead.
The Tozo is a social assistance benefit and cannot be regarded as a special non-contributory benefit.
De Tozo is een bijstandsuitkering en kan niet gezien worden als een bijzondere non-contributieve uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Gedeputeerde kaart oneerlijke concurrentie busaanbesteding aan in Brussel’

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a report that a Overijssel deputy wants to stop unfair competition from non-EU bus tenderers in regional procurement. The State Secretary answered that the government favours reciprocity and a level playing field via the International Procurement Instrument and a forthcoming EU white paper on foreign subsidies, but that national and regional procurement rules cannot discriminate on origin, so the room for steering toward local firms is limited.
I therefore see only limited possibilities to steer toward awarding contracts to local and regional companies.
Ik zie daarom slechts beperkte mogelijkheden om te sturen op het gunnen aan lokale en regionale bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Eaton in Hengelo schrapt 300 arbeidsplaatsen’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Eaton's plan to cut 300 jobs in Hengelo by moving production to lower-cost countries, and about the government's response, industrial strategy and contacts with the company and regional bodies. The minister answered that the ministry was only informed on 1 July, that it and local authorities were not consulted beforehand, that talks are ongoing via Oost NL, and that the industrial vision for the manufacturing sector will follow in autumn.

The ministry and the local authorities were not involved in the considerations behind the relocation of production and outsourcing of company units and therefore had no opportunity to take action beforehand to influence this plan.

Het ministerie en de lokale overheden zijn niet meegenomen in de overwegingen van de productieverplaatsing en outsourcing van bedrijfsonderdelen en hebben daarom geen mogelijkheden gehad om vooraf acties te ondernemen dit voornemen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet, Palland en Postma over het bericht 'Indrukwekkend corona-protest met tientallen historische schepen bij eiland Pampus: 'Net Sail Amsterdam’'

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a protest by historic sailing charter vessels near Pampus, the sector's loss of income under COVID measures, subsidies for historic vessels, and how to preserve the sector after the crisis. The government answered that Mondriaan Fund restoration schemes apply, sets out available COVID support measures for the sailing charter sector, and says it is willing to consult municipalities, provinces and the sector, but did not answer within the two-week deadline.
Of course I am willing to consult with the other relevant departments, the mentioned subnational governments and the sector.
Uiteraard ben ik bereid om samen met de andere betrokken departementen in overleg te treden met de genoemde medeoverheden en met de sector
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Vervoersbedrijf Keolis nam initiatief tot ‘frauduleuze’ side letters'

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that Keolis proposed side letters with Chinese bus suppliers BYD and Ginaf outside the official tender contracts, and whether the Keolis concession for the IJssel-Vecht region was fairly awarded. The State Secretary said the matter must first be investigated, that the ministry has no side letters, and that if reports prove true the provinces could revoke or retender the concession, while leaving further investigation to the provinces and the prosecution service and promising only to consider lessons learned after current investigations finish.
This matter must first be investigated.
Deze zaak moet nu eerst worden onderzocht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Ondernemingsraad in Enschede zegt vertrouwen op in Vredestein-directie’ en het bericht ‘Bedenkelijke praktijken rond Hongaarse subsidie aan eigenaar V

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Apollo Vredestein plant closure in Enschede, the works council's loss of confidence in management, and questions about Hungarian subsidy practices and EU notification. The minister answered that the matter is for the parties themselves, that the Hungarian government and the Commission must decide on further investigation, and that the government is working with the province and municipality to limit job losses.
It is for the Hungarian government to assess whether investigation is needed.
Het is aan de Hongaarse overheid om te beoordelen of onderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Ronnes en Palland over de website coronaverlies

MPs Van Dam, Ronnes and Palland (CDA) asked the government about the website coronaverlies.nl, which offered claim-recovery services to businesses hit by COVID-19, and whether it was a scam exploiting entrepreneurs. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the site is now offline, that it is not for the cabinet to judge whether such services are legitimate, and that victims can file a police report for the Public Prosecution Service to assess.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether services offered on websites such as coronaverlies.nl are legitimate.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of diensten die worden aangeboden op websites als coronaverlies.nl legitiem zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over de Kamerbrief ‘Uitbreiding doelgroep Tijdelijke overbruggingsregeling zelfstandig ondernemers’

Two CDA MPs asked why cross-border self-employed people (living in NL with a business abroad, or living abroad with a business in NL) are treated differently under the Tozo and foreign benefits, and asked about monitoring, communication and numbers. The Secretary of State explained the territoriality principle, stated the reasoning behind eligibility, said no monitoring is planned because refusals cannot show who falls between the schemes, and gave rough estimates of affected entrepreneurs.
The answer to the first question is yes, with a caveat.
Het antwoord op de eerste vraag luidt ja, met een kanttekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'VDL Groep verliest busorder aan Chinees bedrijf'

MPs Amhaouch and Palland (CDA) asked how VDL Groep lost a bus order to Chinese BYD Auto, whether the tender was fair, and what the government will do about foreign subsidies and reciprocity in procurement. The Secretary of State answered that the buses were a private purchase by concessionaire Keolis rather than a tender, found no evidence of unfair competition, acknowledged that current powers to investigate foreign subsidies are limited, and pointed to a proposed EU level playing field instrument and reciprocity measures.

At the same time, I must note that the current possibilities for investigating companies that may receive discriminatory financial support, and for taking action against them if this proves to be the case, are limited.

Tegelijkertijd moet ik constateren dat de mogelijkheden op dit moment beperkt zijn om onderzoek te doen naar bedrijven die mogelijk discriminatoire financiële steun ontvangen, en op te treden tegen bedrijven indien dat het geval blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Snellere betaling kan spanning bij infraprojecten nu al verminderen’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that invoice payment in construction takes an average of 62 days, and whether faster payment could ease liquidity problems and bankruptcies in the sector. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat pays 97% of invoices on time, that faster payment depends on the earlier invoicing stage, and that the government intends to cut the statutory payment term for large companies from 60 to 30 days.
With this I will carry out the Wörsdörfer/Amhaouch motion on a 30-day payment term as the statutory norm.
Hiermee zal ik de motie-Wörsdörfer/Amhaouch over een betaaltermijn van 30 dagen als wettelijke norm uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Slootweg over het bericht 'Consumentenbond: Producten van webwinkels buiten de EU vaak onveilig'

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a Consumentenbond report finding many products from non-EU webshops unsafe, and about level-playing-field concerns, platform liability, the Amhaouch motion on EU liability officers, import controls and consumer awareness. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to EU platform pledges, a planned SER advice on platform liability, the market surveillance regulation requiring EU contact points from July 2021, and an awareness campaign, but declined generic import blocks as contrary to WTO rules.
I will discuss the latest state of affairs regarding the Product Safety Pledge with the European Commission.
Ik ga met de Europese Commissie in gesprek over de laatste stand van zaken met betrekking tot de Product Safety Pledge.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palland, Amhaouch, Wiersma, Verhoeven, Bruins, Gijs van Dijk, Van Kent en Stoffer over het aangekondigde massaontslag bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs asked the government about the announced loss of 750 jobs at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, a new Hungarian plant that received subsidies, and whether EU state aid rules were breached, and whether the government would press the Commission or the company. The minister replied that the Commission judged the Hungarian aid compatible with the internal market, saw no reason to contact the Commission or Hungary, said there were no prior warnings of reorganisation in contacts with the owner and the Enschede management, and left the social plan to the company while pointing to a regional deal.
Should further study of the case give cause for it, I will bring this to the attention of the Commission and my colleagues involved.
Mocht er na verdere bestudering van de casus aanleiding toe zijn dan zal ik dat bij de Commissie en mijn collega's die hierbij zijn betrokken onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Franse treinfabrikant Alstom neemt treinentak Bombardier over'

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the planned takeover of Bombardier's rail unit by Alstom, its effect on European rail industry and competition, and European industrial and competition policy. The State Secretary answered that competition authorities must judge the merger case by case, that a strong independent competition regime is preferred over creating European champions, and that the government promotes a level playing field through trade instruments.
It is up to competition authorities to assess case by case whether a takeover leads to a significant restriction of competition.
Het is aan mededingingsautoriteiten om per casus te beoordelen of een overname leidt tot een significante beperking van de mededinging.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht dat banken het mkb leegmelken

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked whether banks may unilaterally raise interest margins on SME loans, including for sector-wide risk, and what has improved since the banking sector's self-regulation. The minister answered that such changes are allowed under contract terms and the 2018 Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering, that information duties are now set, that complaints to Kifid about such changes are absent, and that the code will be evaluated in 2021.
I have no figures on the extent to which banks do this.
Ik heb geen cijfers over in hoeverre banken dat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Peters over het bericht dat het extraatje i.v.m. een 12,5 jarig jubileum moet worden ingeleverd vanwege de Wajong-uitkering

MPs Palland and Peters (CDA) asked how Wajong recipients can keep extra payments above their monthly income, such as a 12.5-year service jubilee bonus, and why a manual reporting process or an exemption from the wage definition was not feasible. The State Secretary replied that Wajongers keep at least 30 percent of extras under the proposed harmonised rule and fully keep one-off payments under the guarantee scheme, but that UWV lacks reliable data on extras and a manual process carries fraud and enforcement risks.
To deviate for the Wajong by exempting extras above the monthly income, UWV must be able to rely on reliable data on the actual amount of these extras.
Om voor de Wajong af te wijken door extra's boven het maandinkomen vrij te stellen, moet UWV kunnen beschikken over betrouwbare gegevens over de feitelijke hoogte van deze extra's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Palland over het gelijk speelveld voor fruittelers

MPs Van den Berg and Palland asked whether fruit growers' sales cooperatives can counter buyers, whether market elements create an uneven playing field, whether the ACM has investigated market power in fruit, and when the amended Competition Act and unfair trading practices law take effect. The government answered that growers see themselves as weak, that the agro-nutrimonitor covers six chains but not fruit as a whole, and gave an entry-into-force date of 1 July 2021 for the Competition Act change.
The ACM has so far not conducted any research into the fruit sector as a whole.
De ACM heeft tot op heden geen onderzoek gedaan naar de fruitsector als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Palland over het bericht dat extraatje vanwege 12,5 jarig jubileum moet worden ingeleverd vanwege Wajonguitkering

MPs Peters and Palland (CDA) asked why a Wajong beneficiary's anniversary bonus of a 12.5-year service is deducted from his benefit and whether this can be changed. The State Secretary answered that such bonuses count as wage for tax purposes and UWV must offset them; exempting them would need a change to the wage tax act, which the cabinet considers disproportionate, and within current rules full exemption is not possible, though beneficiaries keep at least 30 percent and those on the guarantee benefit can keep one-off payments in full.
Within the current legal framework it is not possible to fully exempt extras above monthly income such as bonuses and gratuities.
Binnen het huidige wettelijke kader is het niet mogelijk om extra's boven het maandinkomen zoals bonussen en gratificaties volledig vrij te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Palland over het ontbreken van data van arbeidsbeperkte werkzoekenden in de kandidatenverkenner van het UWV

Two CDA MPs asked why the UWV candidate browser for people with work limitations is not working due to missing data, and why so few such people were helped into work despite IT investment. The minister and state secretary replied that complete profiles are a long-standing challenge, that about 8% of profiles are available for work, that many profiles are incomplete, and that additional measures such as Perspectief op Werk and regional agreements are being taken.

Question 4: Is it true that the makers of the candidate browser system already knew that many necessary data were missing and reported this to the UWV top in 2016, but that nothing was done with this notice?

Vraag 4 Is het juist dat bij de makers van het systeem van de kandidatenverkenner al bekend was dat veel noodzakelijke gegevens ontbreken en dat zij dit in 2016 ook hebben gemeld bij de UWV-top, maar dat met deze mededeling niets is gedaan?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Palland over de toename van bedrijfsongevallen door risicovol werk

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary about a reported rise in workplace accidents in risky jobs, including whether unreported accidents are common, enforcement and reporting efforts, and whether work pressure is a factor. The State Secretary acknowledged under-reporting by employers, announced an Inspectorate study and capacity expansion, listed fines for late reporting, and described ongoing programmes on safety culture and psychosocial workload.
It is known that there are employers who do not comply with the obligation to report work accidents immediately ("under-reporting").
Het is bekend dat er werkgevers zijn die zich niet houden aan de verplichting om arbeidsongevallen direct te melden («de ondermelding»).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Palland over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer 'Ouderdomsregelingen ontleed'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Court of Audit report on old-age schemes, which found 34,000 to 51,000 entitled households not claiming the AIO, and about the SVB's ability to address non-take-up using pension-register data and records of incomplete AOW accrual. The minister acknowledged the non-take-up as undesirable, accepted responsibility for the scheme's functioning, promised further research and a possible proportionate data-sharing proposal, and admitted an earlier commitment on self-employed disability insurance was not met.
I consider the scale of non-take-up reported by the Court of Audit significant and undesirable.
Ik vind de omvang van het door de Algemene Rekenkamer gerapporteerde niet-gebruik fors en onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Palland over de arbeidskrapte in de kinderopvang en het niet kunnen inzetten van gediplomeerde kraamverzorgenden

MPs De Pater-Postma and Palland asked the State Secretary about labour shortages in childcare and why qualified maternity nurses cannot be deployed in baby groups, including whether the sector-agreed list of qualifying diplomas should be revised. The State Secretary said a labour market plan will follow in the first half of next year, that the diploma list is a matter for the social partners in the collective agreement, and that a equivalence request procedure exists for candidates outside the list.
Addressing bottlenecks around the established list of training programmes is up to the social partners themselves and does not fit the role of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment.
Het oppakken van knelpunten rondom de vastgestelde lijst van opleidingen is aan de sociale partners zelf en past niet bij de rol van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Donatiewebsite plotseling offline: tienduizenden euro’s verdwenen'

An MP asked the government about a donation website that went offline with tens of thousands of euros missing, and whether crowdfunding donation platforms should face the same registration and AFM oversight as investment crowdfunding. The government answered that existing consumer protection applies, that donation crowdfunding differs from investment crowdfunding and needs no AFM supervision, and that the sector and CBF are exploring a code of conduct rather than new government measures.
Crowdfunding through donation is therefore comparable to donating to more traditional charitable institutions, for example via a collection box.
Crowdfunding door middel van donatie is daarom vergelijkbaar met doneren aan meer traditionele charitatieve instellingen, bijvoorbeeld via een collectebus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Von Martels en Palland over het bericht 'Brandweer dreigt alle vrijwilligers kwijt te raken'

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister about reports that the volunteer fire service risks losing its volunteers due to the Wnra civil service law, and about recruitment, diversity and the working group. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the Wnra does not itself threaten volunteerism, that a working group and recruitment programme are underway, and that the Wnra's entry into force for fire services is postponed pending clarity.
It is not correct that the Wnra civil service law causes the fire service to risk losing its volunteer character.
Het klopt niet dat de Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren (Wnra) ervoor zorgt dat de brandweer haar vrijwillige karakter dreigt te verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Bouwer staat 3:1 achter bij Tendergeschil: ‘Bizar dat politiek ingrijpen uit blijft''

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about industry complaints that the Commission of Procurement Experts' role is being weakened, the imbalance in court versus commission outcomes, and whether complaint handling and suspension rules should be strengthened. The State Secretary answered that the Commission will keep its complaint role for several years as a backstop, that a review of complaint handling and a possible mandatory suspension will be studied with a sounding-board group, and that the Commission's advisory role will be evaluated before any change.

As a first additional measure, I want to keep the current role of the CvAE in complaint handling for at least several more years and will examine how the CvAE can play a backstop role where complaint handling at contracting authorities is still insufficient.
Als eerste aanvullende maatregel wil ik de huidige rol van de CvAE in klachtafhandeling nog zeker enkele jaren behouden en zal ik bekijken hoe de CvAE een rol kan spelen als stok achter de deur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht ‘Wildgroei flexmakelaars vormt toenemend risico voor zzp’ers’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the rapid rise of intermediary brokers for freelancers and the risks this poses, including the ING/TCP non-payment case and BAM's freelancer constructions. The minister acknowledges abuses in triangular relationships, announces a study of agency work and triangular relations, and describes planned measures and the DBA-law replacement, while declining to assess the number of brokers or the adequacy of the Bovip quality mark.
As I previously committed to your House, I am exploring on several points which measures are needed to prevent abuse arising from labour intermediation.
Zoals ik eerder aan uw Kamer heb toegezegd ben ik op een aantal punten bezig te verkennen welke maatregelen nodig zijn om misbruik als gevolg van arbeidsbemiddeling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over "de onrust onder bezorgers van Deliveroo na een tariefwijziging"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about unrest among Deliveroo couriers after a tariff change and whether the government would act.
