The minister declined to comment on individual companies, stated that contractual freedom applies, and said the planned minimum tariff for self-employed workers is still being developed.
First, I would like to note that I do not make statements about individual companies.
Vooraf wil ik opmerken dat ik geen uitspraken doe over individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Nieuwe probleemgroep: meer jonge mannen kunnen of willen niet werken'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that the share of men aged 25-45 who cannot or will not work has nearly doubled over ten years, and about benefit receipt, sickness benefit growth, UWV reach, and measures. The minister acknowledges the rise (4.9% to 8.1% from 2009 to 2019), notes it is still relatively low compared with women and older men, attributes part of it to the crisis, says data on sickness benefit trends are incomplete, and promises to monitor the group and pursue labour-market measures.
We are therefore closely monitoring the labour participation of this group (as for other groups) to see whether extra action is needed.
We houden de arbeidsparticipatie van deze groep (net als voor andere groepen) dan ook nauwlettend in de gaten om te bezien of extra actie nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht dat bezorgers van online supermarkt Picnic de noodklok luiden over de arbeidsomstandigheden

An MP asked the government about reports that Picnic online supermarket couriers raised alarms over working conditions, including alleged dismissals for union contact, precarious temp workers, safety, and whether an e-commerce CBA is needed. The state secretary answered that employers must ensure safe work, complaints can go to the Inspectie SZW, dismissal for union contact is not a valid reason, and CBA interpretation is for the social partners.
I have no information on whether this occurs or how often.
Ik heb geen informatie of en zo ja, hoe vaak dit voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Palland over de berichten inzake de Ketelbrug

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about recurring malfunctions of the Ketelbrug bridge reported by De Stentor, including the cause, data transfer, communication with shipping, and prevention. The minister answered that the faulty frequency-regulator parts were replaced, the bridge was monitored for a week without new faults, communication ran through standard channels, and Rijkswaterstaat is open to talks with affected shipping groups but cannot guarantee no future faults.
Rijkswaterstaat is also open to a conversation to consider what can reasonably and within its tasks and responsibilities be additionally done to limit or prevent the inconvenience for shipping.

Rijkswaterstaat staat daarnaast open voor een gesprek om te bezien wat redelijkerwijs en binnen zijn taken en verantwoordelijkheden extra gedaan kan worden om de hinder voor de scheepvaart te beperken c.q. te voorkomen.

m: Motie Weekers en Aptroot over opheffen van de product- en bedrijfschappen
Asks the government to submit proposals by 15 October 2010 to abolish the product and industry boards and move their statutory tasks to bodies subject to democratic control.
states that the boards should be abolished and their statutory tasks moved so that democratic control is possible
spreekt als haar mening uit dat de schappen moeten worden opgeheven en de wettelijke taken zodanig moeten worden ondergebracht dat democratische controle mogelijk is
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Weekers ter vervanging van nr. 18 over het inperken van de verantwoordelijkheid en aansprakelijkheid van bestuurders ten opzichte van het wetsvoorstel
Limits directors' joint liability for improper management where tasks are divided by the articles, keeping liability only for matters within their own remit.
If a matter falls within the duties of two or more directors, each of them is liable for the whole
Behoort een aangelegenheid tot de taak van twee of meer bestuurders, dan is ieder van hen voor het geheel aansprakelijk
Amendement van het lid Kalma c.s. over de goedkeuring van bestuursbesluiten in de zin van artikel 2:164/274 BW door de meerderheid van de niet-uitvoerende bestuurders
Requires that board decisions under the company-law approval rules be approved by a majority of non-executive directors in one-tier companies.
This amendment therefore provides that board decisions under articles 2:164/274 of the Civil Code must be approved by a majority of the non-executive directors
Dit amendement regelt derhalve dat bestuursbesluiten in de zin van artikel 2:164/274 BW goedgekeurd moeten worden door de meerderheid van de niet-uitvoerende bestuurders
Amendement van het lid Weekers over het voorkomen van aansprakelijkheid voor taken waartoe een bestuurder niet bevoegd is

Amends the bill so that co-directors are liable for a shortcoming only if they are not seriously at fault and were not negligent in taking measures, and a statutory task division does not release a director from duty to mitigate consequences.
A statutory division of tasks does not release a director from the duty to take measures to avert the consequences of improper management.
Een statutaire taakverdeling ontslaat een bestuurder niet van de plicht tot het treffen van maatregelen om de gevolgen van onbehoorlijk bestuur af te wenden.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Weekers ter vervanging van nr. 13 waarin wordt geregeld dat, ook wanneer een vennootschap heeft gekozen voor een monistisch bestuursmodel, de benoeming van personen to
Requires that, even under a monist board model, the shareholders' meeting appoints executive and non-executive directors of a company.
Amendement van het lid Weekers dit amendement hangt samen met het amendement Weekers op wetsvoorstel 31058, nr. 17
Amends the Civil Code provision on board appointments in public limited companies by removing a phrase requiring decisions to be taken in line with appointment requirements.
in the proposed article 133, third paragraph, the phrase 'taken in accordance with the requirements for appointment' is deleted
vervalt in het voorgestelde artikel 133, derde lid, het zinsdeel ’dat is genomen in overeenstemming met de vereisten voor benoeming’
Amendement van het lid Weekers over het standpuntrecht van dochtermaatschappijen
Amendment exempting subsidiaries from works council standpoint rights where the parent already has them; concerns company law, not executive checks.
Paragraph 3 does not apply to a company that is a subsidiary
Lid 3 is niet van toepassing op een vennootschap die dochtermaatschappij is
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Weekers ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 10 over het standaard vaststellen van een aantal gegevens bij aandeelhoudersvergaderingen
Requires that vote counts and voting percentages be established at all listed company shareholder meetings, not only on shareholder request.
The number of valid votes, the percentage of capital represented and the number of votes for and against should therefore be established by default at all shareholder meetings of listed companies

Het aantal geldige stemmen, het percentage van het kapitaal dat daarmee vertegenwoordigd en het aantal voor- en tegenstemmen dient daarom bij alle aandeelhoudersvergaderingen van beursvennootschappen standaard te worden vastgesteld

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Kalma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8, over het opnemen van streefcijfers voor de participatie van vrouwen in raden van bestuur en raden van commissarissen in de code Ta
Amends the Civil Code so that companies must set gender balance targets (30% each sex) for management and supervisory boards, with reporting duties.
In a balanced distribution of seats on the management board and supervisory board, at least 30% of seats are held by women
Bij een evenwichtige verdeling van de zetels van het bestuur en de raad van commissarissen wordt ten minste 30% van de zetels bezet door vrouwen
Amendement van de leden Weekers en Van Vroonhoven-Kok waarin wordt geregeld dat de rechtsverhouding tussen een bestuurder en de vennootschap niet wordt aangemerkt als arbeidsovereenkomst
Declares that a board member's legal relationship with a listed company is not an employment contract, removing labour-law protection for existing-style arrangements going forward.
the legal relationship between a board member and the company is not classified as an employment contract
wordt de rechtsverhouding tussen een bestuurder en de vennootschap niet aangemerkt als arbeidsovereenkomst

Amendement van het lid Weekers waarin wordt geregeld dat, ook wanneer een vennootschap heeft gekozen voor een monistisch bestuursmodel, de benoeming van personen tot uitvoerend dan wel niet uitvoerend
Amends corporate law so that appointment of executive and non-executive directors in monistic boards must be made by the shareholders' meeting.

Amendement van het lid Weekers c.s. waarin wordt geregeld dat ook het doen van (bindende) voordrachten voor (her)benoeming van bestuurders tot de exclusieve taak van de niet-uitvoerende bestuurders za
Assigns to non-executive directors the exclusive task of making binding nominations for the appointment or reappointment of board members in one-tier company boards.
making nominations for the appointment of a director
het doen van voordrachten voor benoeming van een bestuurder

Amendement van het lid Weekers dat regelt dat ook ten aanzien van beursvennootschappen waarvan aandelen op multilaterale handelsfaciliteiten worden verhandeld de regels van de Richtlijn aandeelhouders
Extends the shareholder rights directive to listed companies with a balance sheet of at least €500 million whose shares trade on a multilateral trading facility rather than a regulated market.
The mere fact that shares of a Dutch listed company trade on another type of trading facility is no justification for making it harder for shareholders to exercise their rights.

De enkele omstandigheid dat de aandelen van een Nederlandse beursvennootschap op een ander type handelsfaciliteit worden verhandeld vormt immers geen rechtvaardiging om het aandeelhouders lastiger te maken hun rechten uit te oefenen.
Amendement van het lid Weekers over het standaard vaststellen van een aantal gegevens bij aandeelhoudersvergaderingen
Removes the condition that vote counts at shareholder meetings are established only on a shareholder's request, so they are always established.
the number of valid votes, the capital represented and the votes for and against should therefore be established by default at all shareholder meetings of listed companies

het aantal geldige stemmen, het percentage van het kapitaal dat daarmee vertegenwoordigd en het aantal voor- en tegenstemmen dient daarom bij alle aandeelhoudersvergaderingen van beursvennootschappen standaard te worden vastgesteld
Amendement van het lid Kalma c.s. over mannen en vrouwen in raden van bestuur en raden van commissarissen
Proposes that company boards and supervisory boards aim for at least 30% of each gender when appointing members, with exemptions for certain companies.
as far as possible account is taken of a balanced distribution of seats between men and women
zoveel mogelijk rekening gehouden met een evenwichtige verdeling van de zetels over mannen en vrouwen
Amendement van het lid Weekers betreffende het schrappen van spreekrecht van de ondernemingsraad over schorsing van bestuursleden en commissarissen
Removes the works council's right to state a position and speak on proposals to suspend board members or supervisory directors at the general meeting.
The works council should not state a position on, or have a right to speak on, suspension of a director or commissioner by the general meeting.
dient de ondernemingsraad bij schorsing van een bestuurder of commissaris door de algemene vergadering geen standpunt te geven en spreekrecht daarover te hebben
Amendement van het lid Weekers over de toepassing van de nieuwe rechten van de ondernemingsraad vanaf de 91e dag na inwerkingtreding van de wet
Delays application of new works council rights to general meetings held within 90 days after the law takes effect, to avoid retroactive effect.
provided that the rights granted to the works council by this law cannot be exercised for general meetings held within ninety days
met dien verstande dat de bij deze wet aan de ondernemingsraad toegekende rechten niet kunnen worden uitgeoefend met betrekking tot algemene vergaderingen die gehouden worden binnen negentig dagen
Amendement van het lid Weekers betreffende een voorbehoud bij het spreekrecht van de ondernemingsraad bij besluiten over belangrijke wijzigingen van karakter of identiteit van de vennootschap
Softens the requirement that a works council must state its view before a shareholder meeting on major changes to a company's identity, to protect speed for listed companies.
The amendment aims to safeguard the agility of Dutch listed public limited companies
Het amendement beoogt de slagvaardigheid van Nederlandse beurs-NV's te waarborgen
Amendement van het lid Weekers over het schrappen van het spreekrecht van de ondernemingsraad bij de benoeming van commissarissen
Proposes deleting the article giving the works council a right to state its view on appointing supervisory directors of a public limited company.
Article I, part E, is deleted.
Amendement van het lid Weekers over aanpassing van de reikwijdtecriteria
Amends the Civil Code so works council rights for Dutch NV subsidiaries apply independently of the employee-location criterion, with a foreign-majority exception.
The amendment aims to make the two scope criteria contained in the provisions, which are entirely separate, independent of each other.
Het amendement beoogt de twee in bovengenoemde bepalingen besloten liggende reikwijdtecriteria, die geheel los van elkaar staan, te verzelfstandigen.
Amendement van het lid Weekers over beperking van het spreekrecht van de ondernemingsraad tot beursgenoteerde NV's
Limits the works council's right to state a view on major board decisions to companies whose shares are listed on a regulated market.
The amendment aims to bring the bill into line with the SER advice on balanced corporate governance.
Het amendement strekt ertoe het wetsvoorstel in overeenstemming te brengen met het SER-advies Evenwichtig Ondernemingsbestuur.
Motie Omtzigt en Weekers over een tegemoetkoming in de sfeer van de accijns voor historische vliegtuigen
Asks the government to provide a excise relief for historic aircraft flying on light fuel so their tax burden matches kerosene, in the Miljoenennota 2010.
requests the government to come up before the Miljoenennota 2010 with a proposal for a relief scheme regarding excise duty for historic aircraft
verzoekt de regering voor de Miljoenennota 2010 met een voorstel voor een tegemoetkomende regeling in de sfeer van de accijns voor historische vliegtuigen te komen
Motie Omtzigt c.s. over onder bronstaatheffing brengen van de exitheffing voor pensioenen en lijfrentes
Asks the government to renegotiate tax treaties so the exit tax on pensions is subject to source-state taxation and to report to the House every six months on progress.
and to report to the House every six months on progress.
en de Kamer halfjaarlijks te rapporteren over de voortgang
Motie-Tang c.s. over niet opwerpen van belemmeringen voor gesprekken van de Tweede Kamer met de president van DNB
Asks the government not to raise unnecessary obstacles when the House of Representatives requests a conversation with the president of De Nederlandsche Bank.
requests the government not to raise unnecessary obstacles to conversations with the president of DNB when the House of Representatives asks for a conversation
verzoekt de regering geen onnodige belemmeringen op te werpen voor gesprekken met de president van DNB als de Tweede Kamer tot een gesprek verzoekt
Motie Weekers over implementatie van het Kader financieel beheer rijkssubsidies
Asks the government to implement the Framework for Financial Management of State Subsidies quickly and fully adopt the Audit Office's advice on small subsidy schemes.
requests the government to implement the Framework for Financial Management of State Subsidies as soon as possible and to adopt the Audit Office's advice in full
verzoekt de regering zo snel mogelijk het «Kader financieel beheer rijkssubsidies» te implementeren en daarbij het advies van de Algemene Rekenkamer onverminderd over te nemen
Amendement van de leden Weekers en Blanksma-van den Heuvel dat voorziet voor zwaardere straffen voor recidive
Amends the administrative fine rules in several financial supervision laws by capping fines at 2 million euro per offence and doubling the fine for repeat offences within five years.
the amount of the administrative fine referred to in the first sentence is doubled for a separate offence.
wordt het bedrag van de bestuurlijke boete, bedoeld in de eerste volzin, voor een afzonderlijke overtreding verdubbeld
Amendement van het lid Weekers dat het mogelijk maakt niet alleen de rechtpersoon, maar ook degenen die tot het feit opdracht hebben gegeven een boete op te leggen
Allows the financial supervisor to impose administrative fines directly on individuals who ordered or led a violation, not only on the legal entity.
This amendment provides that, besides the legal entity, a fine may also be imposed on those who ordered the act and those who actually led the prohibited conduct.

Dit amendement regelt dat naast de rechtspersoon ook tegen hen die tot het feit opdracht hebben gegeven, alsmede tegen hen die feitelijk leiding hebben gegeven aan de verboden gedraging een boete kan worden opgelegd.
Motie Weekers c.s. over de verantwoordelijkheid van de staatssecretaris voor een vlekkeloze uitvoering van de wet
States that the state secretary must take full political responsibility for a flawless implementation of the chronic illness allowance law.
the state secretary of VWS must take her full political responsibility for a flawless implementation of the law
de staatssecretaris van VWS haar volledige politieke verantwoordelijkheid moet nemen voor een vlekkeloze uitvoering van de wet
Motie Sap c.s. over uitstel van invoering van de Wtcg
Asks the government to postpone the introduction of the Wtcg by one year and reconsider whether the BU can achieve its goals more simply.
requests the government to postpone the introduction of the Wtcg by one year
verzoekt de regering om invoering van de Wtcg met een jaar uit te stellen
Motie Weekers over het weer opnemen van de huidige buitengewone uitgavenregeling in het belastingplan 2009
Asks the government to reinstate the existing extraordinary expenditure scheme in the 2009 tax plan instead of replacing it with the Wtcg.
requests the government to again include the current extraordinary expenditure scheme in the Tax Plan 2009
verzoekt de regering de huidige buitengewone uitgavenregeling weer op te nemen in het Belastingplan 2009
Motie Sap c.s. over duidelijkheid over het aantal langdurig uitkeringsgerechtigden en herintreedsters dat extra aan een baan geholpen wordt
Asks the government to inform the House before the budget debate on results and on its ambition for long-term unemployed and returners placed in jobs.
requests the government to inform the House before the budget debate about the results achieved
verzoekt de regering voor de behandeling van de begroting van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid de Kamer te informeren over de bereikte resultaten
Amendement van de leden Weekers en van Dijck over een drempelvrijstelling
Amendment adding a threshold exemption of 5,000 euro for small employee equity stakes under the excessive remuneration tax rules.
the employment-related lucrative interest whose benefits in total do not exceed 5,000 euro is excluded
wordt uitgesloten het met een werkzaamheid verband houdende lucratieve belang waarvan de voordelen in totaal niet meer bedragen dan € 5 000
Amendement van de leden Van Dijck en Weekers over carried interest-regelingen bij private equity organisaties
Removes the carried-interest tax provisions from this excessive-remuneration tax bill and asks for a separate law with a clearly defined group.
The proposed tax measure in this bill on carried interest is far too broadly worded
De voorgestelde fiscale maatregel in dit wetsvoorstel ten aanzien van carried interest is veel te ruim geformuleerd
Amendement van de leden Weekers en van Dijck over het nader invullen van de definitie 'lucratief belang'
Narrows the definition of 'lucratief belang' in the excessive remuneration tax rules by objectifying it and clarifying the catch-all provision, to increase legal certainty for taxpayers.
by further specifying the definition of 'lucratief belang', to increase legal certainty for taxpayers
door de definitie «lucratief belang» nader in te vullen. Dit om de rechtszekerheid voor belastingplichtigen te vergroten
Amendement van de leden Weekers en van Dijck dat bewerkstelligt dat de latente aanmerkelijk belang claim op een lucratief belang heffing niet ongedaan wordt gemaakt middels de step-up
Removes retroactive effect of the tax on latent substantial-interest claims by excluding it from the step-up rule, setting a 13 May 2008 reference date.
The addition to the fifth paragraph ensures that the latent substantial-interest claim on a lucrative interest levy is not undone through the step-up.
De toevoeging aan het vijfde lid bewerkstelligt dat de latente aanmerkelijk belang claim op een lucratief belang heffing niet ongedaan wordt gemaakt middels de step-up.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de zorgen die leven bij de Vereniging Natuurmonumenten over de beheersvergoedingen in het kader van het rietlandbeheer in Nationaal Park de Weerribben-Wie

CDA MPs asked whether the subsidy levels for reed-land management in the Weerribben-Wieden park are adequate, and whether the 2014 income-tax changes and 6% VAT rate undermine the SNL standard-cost system. The State Secretary says provinces set compensation at 75% of norm costs under the Natuurpact, that VAT is due on paid management outsourcing, that no relevant tax changes occurred, and that a reduced VAT rate is not possible under EU rules, while committing to no concrete action.

On the basis of the information known to me, I cannot assess whether and to what extent the management compensation provided to reed cutters is insufficient to achieve the desired nature quality through the summer mowing regime.

Op basis van de mij bekende gegevens kan ik niet beoordelen of en in hoeverre de verstrekte beheersvergoedingen die in het kader van het rietlandbeheer aan riettelers verstrekt worden ontoereikend zijn om de gewenste natuurkwaliteit via het regime van zomermaaibeheer te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Neppérus en Van der Linde over het bericht dat criminelen zich laten uitschrijven uit de GBA en daarmee belasting ontduiken

Two VVD MPs asked whether criminals deregister from the GBA population register to evade tax, what revenue is lost, whether the new BRP accounts for this, how data is exchanged with other countries, and how emigration of Dutch non-residents is tracked. The minister said losses cannot be quantified since criminal activity is hidden by definition (FIOD research ongoing), explained the BRP's new fines for false registration and non-resident registration, and described limited direct data exchange abroad and municipal verification and reporting mechanisms.
For that reason it is by definition not possible to give concrete figures on this.
Daarom is het per definitie niet mogelijk om hierover concrete cijfers te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over een gelijk Europees speelveld voor de Nederlandse havens

MPs De Vries and Groot asked whether the government would delay or drop corporate tax for Dutch port operators until an EU study on port competition is published and EU-level state aid rules are agreed. The minister answered that no general EU-wide tax comparison is possible, that talks with the Commission on modernising corporate tax liability for state enterprises are ongoing, and that a bill is aimed for Prinsjesdag 2014 with transitional arrangements considered.
We have no insight into the progress of processing the results and the analysis thereof.
Wij hebben geen inzicht in de voortgang van de verwerking van de resultaten en de analyse daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir over het bericht dat Stichting Dienstverlening Serviceflats (SDS) ouderen uit serviceflats jaagt

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked the government to respond to reports that Stichting Dienstverlening Serviceflats (SDS) pressures elderly residents of service flats, including through alleged financial exploitation, intimidation and forced sales, and asked whether an independent investigation would follow. Minister Blok replied that complaints about a service-flat management organisation are a matter for the courts, that private management contracts fall outside government supervision, and pointed to industry certification initiatives, without committing to an investigation.
Ultimately it is for the judiciary to pass judgment and not for me to go into the substance of this.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechterlijke macht om een oordeel te vellen en niet aan mij om hier inhoudelijk op in te gaan.

Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over verlies van inleg op obligaties als gevolg van afhandeling van faillissement van Lehman Brothers Treasury Co B.V. (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether a US Chapter 11 proposal to treat Lehman Treasury notes claims at 50% would harm Dutch noteholders and disadvantage non-American creditors, and what the government would do. The minister answered that he cannot interfere in individual cases or foreign court proceedings, that affected parties may take legal action themselves, and that he knows of no comparable cases.
It is not open to me to interfere in individual cases.
Het staat mij niet vrij mij in individuele zaken te mengen.
Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de berichten over fraude in de champignonteelt (ingezonden 22 juni 2010).

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs about reports of fraud in mushroom cultivation, including which agencies took part in the inspections, whether other growers are being checked, how illicit gains are recovered, and whether similar action is needed in other horticulture sectors. The minister answered that a multi-agency intervention team inspected firms in three regions, imposed about 1.5 million euro in fines and back-payments so far, is continuing its work, and is expanding risk analysis and cooperation with sector bodies.
The intervention team determines in advance, based on risk analyses and signals (including reports), whether and which companies are inspected and which instruments are deployed.
Het interventieteam bepaalt op basis van risicoanalyses en signalen (waaronder meldingen) vooraf of, en welke ondernemingen worden geïnspecteerd en welke instrumenten worden ingezet.
Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over het vrijgeven van het spaarloon (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether unblocking the savings-wage scheme (spaarloon) would boost household consumption and the economy, given weak spending and households using holiday pay to cover shortfalls. The minister answered that roughly 1 billion euro is releasable this year, that CPB estimates of the boost are modest (about 0.25% consumption, 0.1% growth in the base case), and that the cabinet does not plan to unblock now, deferring the decision to coalition talks.
The cabinet is currently not planning to unblock the savings-wage balances.
Het kabinet is op dit moment niet van plan om de spaarloontegoeden te deblokkeren.

Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over de werking van het verdrag ter voorkoming van dubbele belasting tussen Nederland en Duitsland voor Rijnvaartschippers (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the Dutch-German tax treaty and Dutch law give enough clarity on the 'home port' concept that determines where Rhine barge operators are taxable, and why the government did not start the treaty consultation procedure before assessments were final. The minister explains that home port is defined through case law and the OECD model, that Germany also regards these skippers as non-resident, and that he has discussed the problem informally with German authorities and will open a consultation procedure if needed.
However, I am of course willing to enter into mutual consultation with the German competent authorities, as soon as there is reason to do so, in order to eliminate double taxation where necessary.

Ik ben echter uiteraard bereid om – zodra daartoe aanleiding bestaat – met de Duitse bevoegde autoriteiten in onderling overleg te treden teneinde in voorkomend geval dubbele belastingheffing weg te nemen.
Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over de gevolgen van een negatieve BKR-registratie (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

MP Weekers asked the Finance Minister whether a BKR credit-registration of small arrears (e.g. a €90 phone bill) causing five years of exclusion from mortgages is proportionate, and whether a threshold, BSN use, and access/notification rights for registrants should be introduced. The minister defended the registration system as a tool against over-indebtedness, noted arrears must last 60 days and be pre-announced, opposed a €500 floor, and pointed to pending legislation giving notice of rejection and free access, with BSN use blocked by the privacy college.

In the bill pending before your House implementing the consumer credit directive, it is provided that when a credit application is rejected on the basis of a BKR registration, the person concerned is informed of this free of charge.

Antwoord 5 en 6 In het bij uw Kamer aanhangige wetsvoorstel ter implementatie van de richtlijn consumentenkrediet 3 wordt geregeld dat, wanneer een kredietaanvraag wordt afgewezen op grond van een BKR-registratie, de betrokkene daarover kosteloos wordt geïnformeerd.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het dichten van het btw-lek

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the VAT gap caused by refunds on unpaid invoices of failed customers could be closed by introducing a cash-based VAT scheme, and asked about its administrative and financial effects. The State Secretary answered that no reliable estimate of the gap exists, that a mandatory cash scheme would have mixed effects on businesses and a one-off negative cash effect for the Treasury, and that the Netherlands had not argued for it in the EU Green Paper response.
The Tax Authority has no specific information on the amount of VAT deducted by bankrupt businesses on unpaid invoices, so no statement can be made on the size of this VAT gap.

Bij de Belastingdienst is over de omvang van door failliete bedrijven in aftrek gebrachte btw waarbij de factuur niet is betaald geen specifieke informatie aanwezig, zodat geen uitspraak kan worden gedaan over de omvang van dit btw-lek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over fiscale tip- en toongelden, samenwerking door de fiscus met criminelen en het opvolgen van de aanbevelingen van de Commissie Van Traa

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the fiscal tip-money policy, cooperation between the tax authority and criminals, the 2010 policy framework and whether the Van Traa commission's recommendations were followed, including the 1994 internal memo, FIOD guidelines, a former FIOD official's later role, and how entrapment is prevented. Wiebes answered that the 2010 framework remains unchanged, the 1994 memo was internal and informative, the Van Traa recommendations concern criminal investigation and do not apply, no separate protocol exists, several documents could not be found, and details of payments are withheld.
It is not possible to state how many potential tipsters have reported since 2001, because this was not recorded.
Het is niet mogelijk aan te geven hoeveel potentiële tipgevers zich vanaf 2001 hebben gemeld, omdat dat niet is bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Neppérus en Aukje de Vries over de mogelijke dubbele bankenbelasting voor Nederlandse banken

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance what steps had been taken to prevent double bank taxation for Dutch banks, the progress of treaty talks with Germany, Belgium, Hungary, Slovakia and South Korea, and the practical results of the August 2012 amendment to the double taxation decree. The State Secretary answered that only the UK treaty had been concluded, that the other countries showed little or no interest in a bilateral arrangement, and that the unilateral relief in the decree had been used in practice only in relation to the UK.
Only in relation to the United Kingdom has the Decree been applied to avoid double bank taxation.
Alleen in relatie tot het Verenigd Koninkrijk is het Besluit toegepast om dubbele bankenbelasting te vermijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de fiscale vrijstelling voor (agrarisch) natuurbeheer

An MP asked whether subsidies under the SNL and SKNL nature schemes are exempt from income and corporation tax, whether agrarian nature management is covered, and whether farmers and reed cultivators face tax or VAT liabilities. The State Secretary confirmed a tax exemption limited to landscape management, said the government intends to continue it if the European Commission approves, refused a dedicated exemption for other agrarian nature management, and declined to confirm VAT exemption in all cases.
I cannot provide that at present. I undertake to inform your House further before the new agrarian nature management system is introduced.
Dat kan ik momenteel niet geven. Ik zeg toe dat ik uw Kamer voor het invoeren van het nieuwe stelsel van agrarisch natuurbeheer nader zal informeren.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Financiën over de bijstellingsregeling directe belastingen (ingezonden 6 januari 2014).

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance why the 2014 provisional tax assessments use incorrect rates, why two tax reductions were not applied, how the eigenwoningforfait and its indexation were calculated, and whether the Waarderingskamer's price data was known in time. The State Secretary acknowledges technical errors, explains that some measures will only be applied in final assessments, announces a correction for the eigenwoningforfait, and defends the indexation approach while not raising the disputed base amount.
I note that in answering the parliamentary questions of 2 January 2014 from members Knops, Omtzigt and Bashir an error crept in.
Hierbij merk ik op dat bij de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van 2 januari 2014 van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Bashir over de bijstellingsregeling directe belasting (nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de resultaten van de aanpak van fraude bij toeslagen (o.a. de `Bulgarenfraude`)

MP Omtzigt asked about the Bulgarian benefit-fraud case, collection of fines, the fraud coordinator's work, household registration and the Kavelaars criticism of unimplemented advice. The State Secretary answered most questions with figures and described measures taken, but withheld the dates of benefit payments citing the investigation and did not commit to new steps beyond existing measures.
Because of the investigation's interests, no statements can be made about this.
Vanwege het onderzoeksbelang kunnen hierover geen mededelingen gedaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Bashir over bijstellingsregeling directe belasting

MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Bashir asked when the Secretary of State learned of the 2014 indexation raising the eigenwoningforfait from 0.6% to 0.7%, why earlier calculations assumed 0.6%, and how the rise affects taxpayers, provisional assessments and cost estimates. The government answered that the indexation follows the statutory mechanism, was signed on 18 December 2013 and published without notifying parliament, and that provisional assessments used 0.65% with later requests recalculated at 0.7%, with a commitment to adjust the trial calculation.
It is not customary to share the outcomes of statutory indexation mechanisms with members of the cabinet.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om de uitkomsten van wettelijke indexeringsmechanismes aan leden van het kabinet mede te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Groot over de uitzending ‘Caribisch Nederland, Drie jaar later, Bonaire’

Two MPs asked the government about a broadcast on Bonaire's high prices, falling real incomes, electricity and produce costs, and competition, and whether the 2010 tax reform and the switch to the US dollar caused price rises. The minister answered at length, acknowledging strong price rises and partly attributing them to global factors and dollarisation, citing indexation, tax relief and planned electricity and price regulation, while admitting gaps in data.
The Statistics Netherlands has started a study into, among other things, income developments on the islands.
Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek is een onderzoek gestart naar, onder andere, (bewegingen in) de inkomenssfeer op de eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pieter Heerma over het gebruik van overheidsvorderingen

CDA MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority's use of government claims (overheidsvordering) to debit taxpayers' bank accounts, including the protection of the attachment-free minimum, usage and complaint figures, evaluations, and consultation with debt-relief and bailiff bodies. The government answered that the instrument is lawful and efficient, that a correction for the attachment-free minimum has been added since November 2013, that complaints have been rare, and that consultations and a bailiffs' register are underway.
As of 1 November 2013 the Collection Guidelines 2008 have been amended.
Met ingang van 1 november 2013 is de Leidraad Invordering 2008 gewijzigd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over belangenverstrengeling hoogleraren financiële sector

An MP asks the government about conflicts of interest arising from professors in the financial sector holding outside positions, including on the Commission Structuure Nederlandse Banken, and about transparency and funding of chairs. The minister says transparency agreements with universities are being upheld, that outside positions do not disqualify advisers, and that existing codes suffice, promising no new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de beperkte en onduidelijke uitleg van het Sportbesluit

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Belastingdienst's handling of VAT on sports facilities, including a court ruling on artificial turf, long waiting times for advice, the treatment of walking and cycling routes, and a call for clearer rules. The State Secretary answered that the tax office has appealed the district court ruling and continues to challenge artificial constructions, that advice can take weeks to over a year, that reserved routes qualify under the reduced rate, and that an updated policy decision is expected in early 2014 after consultation with sports bodies.
I intend to update the aforementioned policy decision of 27 October 2011.
Ik heb het voornemen om het hiervoor genoemde beleidsbesluit van 27 oktober 2011 te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer naar aanleiding van berichten in de media dat Oostenrijk en Luxemburg hun bankgeheim willen behouden

MP Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Austria and Luxembourg's wish to keep bank secrecy hampers the fight against tax evasion and money laundering, and what options exist to force them to lift it. The State Secretary answered that the question is no longer whether bank secrecy will be abolished but when, pointing to OECD, FATCA and EU initiatives on automatic information exchange and to Nederland's negotiating position at the December European Council.
The question is no longer whether bank secrecy will be abolished but when.
De vraag is niet meer of het bankgeheim zal worden afgeschaft maar wanneer.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de Staatssecretarissen van Financiën en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het validatiestelsel voor ANBI's en het aflopende convenant «ruimte voor geven» (inge

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance and of Security and Justice about the delayed validation system for charities (ANBI) and the expiring 'Ruimte voor geven' covenant, including who is responsible for the system, the evaluation of covenant commitments, the SBF's representativeness, and the status of the governance and pay code. The government answered that the SBF develops the validation system with the ministries jointly responsible, that the covenant was evaluated in September 2013 with mixed results, that a new covenant is under negotiation, and that it is awaiting the De Jong committee's advice before informing parliament further.
The validation system for philanthropy will be adopted jointly by the covenant parties.
Het validatiestelsel filantropie wordt gezamenlijk door de convenantspartijen vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over het Nederlands verzet tegen country-by-country reporting voor internationaal opererende ondernemingen

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the Dutch government is opposing an EU-wide country-by-country reporting obligation for multinationals and whether its position remains consistent with earlier commitments. The government answered that it supports transparency initiatives through tax reporting in general, while stressing possible negative economic effects of public disclosure, the need for coordination with existing rules, and clear, well-assessed EU proposals.
The Netherlands will also in future take a position along the lines outlined above.
Nederland zal ook in de toekomst een positie langs de hiervoor geschetste lijnen innemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over belastingheffing op de Amsterdamse beurs door Frankrijk en Italië

An SP MP asked the Finance Ministry whether French and Italian transaction taxes on shares listed in Amsterdam are legitimate, whether the revenue can flow to the Dutch treasury, and whether the tax can be credited against Dutch box 3 tax. The State Secretary confirmed the taxes apply, said they are legally permissible without a basis for sharing revenue, and said they cannot be credited against box 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en van Hijum over het bericht “Leugens en bedrog bij burgerzaken”

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked about a report on tax nomads who deregister from the municipal population register (GBA) to evade the state, including how many emigrants filed final tax returns, whether data is exchanged with foreign tax authorities, and whether passports are denied. The government answered that the report was shared confidentially, outlined the Taskforce VOW and an FIOD investigation, gave deregistration and filing figures, and said about 40 persons were flagged for passport refusal, with a broader anti-fraud approach promised for December 2013.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations sent you this report by letter for confidential handling.
De minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties heeft u dit rapport bij brief ter vertrouwelijke behandeling toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Recourt over belastingontduiking door misdaadondernemers

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether criminals can evade tax by deregistering from the municipal population register (GBA), why conservatory assessments on emigration are limited, whether immediate settlement on emigration could replace them, and why a RIEC study on this fraud has not yielded an effective approach. The State Secretary answered that residence for tax purposes is assessed on all circumstances, that GBA deregistration alone does not end tax liability, that EU law makes immediate collection on emigration doubtful, and that an FIOD investigation into the phenomenon is underway with measures to follow depending on its outcome.
To gain further insight into the possible scale of this specific phenomenon, the FIOD is currently conducting an investigation.
Om nadere duiding over de mogelijke omvang van dit specifieke fenomeen te krijgen, voert de FIOD momenteel onderzoek uit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Klaver over de uitwerking van het verlaagde energiebelastingtarief voor decentrale duurzame elektriciteitsopwekking door coöperaties en V.v.E.’s zoals overeengekomen in het

GreenLeft MPs asked how the reduced energy tax rate for cooperatives and homeowners' associations generating renewable electricity would work, including metering, self-consumption, and whether business members may participate. The State Secretary answered that metering and netting are allowed under conditions, that business members are excluded for policy and state-aid reasons, and that the scope for business small users will be studied by summer 2014.
Entrepreneurs may not be members of the cooperative, because the scheme is intended for local renewable energy generation by cooperatives of, and for, private small consumers.

Ondernemers mogen geen lid zijn van de coöperatie, omdat de regeling is bedoeld voor de lokale duurzame energie opwekking van energie door coöperaties van – en ten behoeve van – particuliere kleinverbruikers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver inzake het bericht Dubieuze stellingnames en rekenfout in SEO-rapport over belastingparadijs Nederland

MP Klaver asked the Finance and Justice ministers about a Quotenet report criticising a SEO study on the Netherlands as a tax haven, covering supervision costs, prosecution of letterbox companies, trust office reporting, and the SEO dividend tax estimate. Minister Opstelten answered that supervision claims are unclear, costs of extra enforcement and prosecution are uncertain, DNB supervises trust offices and has taken enforcement measures, and the SEO revenue figures will be addressed in a separate government response.
Tightening the control of trust offices, by contrast, is a constant concern.
Aanscherping van de controle op trustkantoren daarentegen is voortdurend aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over het bericht “Meer dan 3.500 postbusfirma's in Nederland overtreden de wet”

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked whether the government was aware that many postbox firms and foreign cooperatives fail to file annual accounts on time, and what sanctions and oversight are in place. The minister answers that enforcement is multilayered (Chamber of Commerce monitoring, creditor claims, criminal fines, Tax Authority investigation), that sanctions need no tightening, and that a central shareholder register is planned.
I therefore see no reason to tighten the sanctions.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding de sancties aan te scherpen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over het akkoord tussen de koepelorganisatie voor de woningcorporaties Aedes en het kabinet, waarin onder meer is afgesproken dat de integratieheffing komt te vervallen

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked about the August 2013 agreement with Aedes that abolishes the integration levy, whether this applies to all sectors, the budgetary effect, and timing. The minister confirmed the levy is abolished entirely via the Belastingplan 2014 from 1 January 2014, with a total revenue loss of 95 million euros per year, of which about 35 million is attributed to housing associations.
The proposal that forms part of the Belastingplan 2014 aims to abolish the integration levy entirely and not only for the housing association sector.
Het voorstel dat onderdeel uitmaakt van het Belastingplan 2014 beoogt de integratieheffing in het geheel te laten vervallen en niet alleen voor de corporatiesector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over pensioenen

An MP asked how many Dutch residents are entitled to and receive Greek state pensions, how many have sought SVB help, and whether the government has contacted other countries or Greece. The State Secretary answered that the government lacks data on entitlements and payments, has received only a few signals, and sees no need for further action, while noting that collecting the pension is the pensioner's own responsibility.
I do not know how many people residing in the Netherlands are entitled to a pension from the Greek state.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel personen die woonachtig zijn in Nederland recht hebben op een pensioen van de Griekse staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot, Monasch en Omtzigt over het mislukken van het overleg over directe huurtoeslagbetaling aan woningbouwcorporaties

MPs Groot, Monasch and Omtzigt asked why the motion-based arrangement for direct payment of rent allowance (huurtoeslag) to housing associations failed. The State Secretary answered that housing association umbrella body Aedes judged the partnership arrangement commercially unviable, and that no alternative route for direct payment is available within the legal framework.
I see no possibilities, within the statutory scheme and the conditions attached to it, to give direct payment of rent allowance to housing corporations an alternative form.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om binnen de wettelijke regeling en de daarbij geldende randvoorwaarden een directe betaling van huurtoeslag aan woningcorporaties op alternatieve wijze vorm te geven.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de inning van Europese douanerechten in Nederland en de boetes die Brussel heeft opgelegd aan Nederland voor het niet, incorrect of onvolledig innen van Europese douanerechten

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Netherlands' performance in collecting EU customs duties (traditional own resources) and about EU liability claims against the Netherlands for uncollected or misallocated duties. The government disputed the comparability of an EU Parliament report, explained collection rates and fraud trends, and listed liability amounts paid or contested since 2006.
The Netherlands informed the European Commission that it cannot be held liable for errors of the customs authorities in question.
Nederland heeft de Europese Commissie medegedeeld dat Nederland niet aansprakelijk kan worden gehouden voor fouten van de douaneautoriteiten in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de tabakslobby in Nederland

An SP MP asked three ministers about tobacco industry lobbying, the use of industry-funded research and Philip Morris-commissioned STAR reports, and conflicts of interest. The government answered that industry-commissioned studies are reviewed on usefulness, that the STAR reports were confidential but the latest was published, and that it does not track professors' tobacco-industry ties beyond disclosed side positions.
I am not free to provide these reports to the House without the consent of the commissioning party.
Het staat mij niet vrij deze rapporten zonder toestemming van de opdrachtgever aan de Kamer te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de Big Brother Awards

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the Big Brother Awards, including the Tax Authority's expert prize and the Justice Minister's public prize for privacy-infringing policy. The minister answered that no jury report exists, defended the Tax Authority's use of police camera data and bulk requests to parking authorities as proportionate, rejected the suggestion that he ignores privacy, and promised a general letter on privacy and security later that autumn.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice and I will send your House a more general letter on the balance between privacy and security later this autumn.
De staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en ik zullen uw Kamer nog dit najaar een meer algemene brief sturen over de balans tussen privacy en veiligheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Groot over tax rulings van de Nederlandse Belastingdienst

An MP asked whether a tax ruling let KPN deduct a €3.7bn book loss on selling E-Plus against future profits, costing the state about €900m, and whether this breaches the participation exemption. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual taxpayer under confidentiality rules, confirmed that losses on selling a participation fall under the exemption and cannot be deducted, and said the tax authority would not make such agreements.
Agreements on deducting losses from selling a participation conflict with the participation exemption. Therefore the tax authority will not make such agreements.

Afspraken over het aftrekken van verliezen geleden door verkoop van een deelneming staan op gespannen voet met de deelnemingsvrijstelling. Derhalve zal de Belastingdienst dergelijke afspraken niet maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de exclusieve afnameverplichtingen tussen brouwers en horecaondernemers op de biermarkt en het effect van aangekondigde maatregelen in de grensregio

Two MPs (Mulder and Omtzigt, CDA) asked about exclusive beer purchase obligations between brewers and hospitality businesses, expected beer excise revenue, cross-border beer consumption, and the financial effects of planned excise measures in border regions. The state secretary answered that the market must function effectively, gave the 2012 excise revenue figures, said data on cross-border consumers is not recorded, declined to give a calculation rule for the excise effect, and promised to inventory relevant memos and send any found separately by end of October.
This request cannot be met in the short term. This will first have to be inventoried.
Aan dit verzoek is niet op korte termijn te tegemoet te komen. Dit zal eerst moeten worden geïnventariseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Den Haag en tabak’

An SP MP asked the state secretaries of Health, Economic Affairs and Finance whether the government had consulted the tobacco industry before setting its position on the EU Tobacco Products Directive, and whether this conflicted with the FCTC treaty and earlier statements. The government replied that industry contact is limited to technical implementation matters, that the industry was only consulted on the directive after the BNC fiche was sent to parliament, and that no FCTC violation occurred.
VWS deliberately chose not to consult the tobacco industry and health organisations while the government position was being drafted.
VWS heeft er bewust voor gekozen om, ten tijde van het opstellen van het regeringsstandpunt, niet met de tabaksindustrie en de gezondheidsorganisaties in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Dik-Faber en Rebel over het hergebruik van datadragers van de overheid

MPs Dik-Faber and Rebel asked why government destroys reusable phones, tablets and computers instead of reusing them, and whether data safety can be guaranteed for reuse. The state secretary agreed reuse is preferable, cited AIVD security rules and a study due early 2014 into alternatives, and promised to consider them.
Since spring 2013 a study has been running that looks for alternatives.
Sedert het voorjaar 2013 loopt een onderzoek waarin er naar alternatieven wordt gezocht.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en AgnesMulder (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Economische Zaken over arrest van het hof in Luxemburg 219/12(Finanzamt Freistadt Rohrbach Urfahr tegen Una

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance about the CJEU ruling C-219/12 (Fuchs), which treats solar panel operation for feed-in as VAT-relevant economic activity, including why the Netherlands did not intervene, retroactive VAT recovery, administrative burden, and whether it would push for a directive change. The state secretary answered that there is no retroactive effect, that the small business exemption and annual form apply, that the revenue loss will be covered, and that the Netherlands has raised the matter with the Commission and will seek a directive amendment.
I consider the outcome of the ruling undesirable, but see no legal room in the ruling to deny entrepreneurship when the conditions are met.
Ik acht de uitkomst van het arrest ongewenst, maar zie in het arrest geen juridische ruimte om het ondernemerschap te ontkennen

Vragen van de leden Neppérus en De Liefde (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Economische Zaken over controle van poststukken door «postsnuffelaars» (ingezonden 30 juli 2013).

Two VVD MPs asked whether customs should let the anti-counterfeiting group SNB-React open suspect mail, as in the UK, and why the enforcement of counterfeit goods should involve business. The state secretary replied that the proposal would not bring efficiency gains in the Dutch system, that current practice is kept after consultation, and that options for improvement will be explored.
As a follow-up to the consultation with SNB-React, other possibilities for improving the process will be examined together with other trademark holders and their representatives.
Als vervolg op het overleg met SNB-React zal, ook met andere (vertegenwoordigers van) merkhouders, onderzocht worden of er andere mogelijkheden zijn voor verbeteringen in het proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt, Jasper van Dijk en Bashir over misbruik van de Wet vermindering afdracht loonbelasting en premie voor de volksverzekeringen (WVA)

SP MPs asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs and the state secretary of Finance about firms and training institutions abusing the wage-tax reduction for education (AV onderwijs), including whether unqualified teachers and sham courses were used and whether the responsible parties would be punished. The minister answered that the Inspectorate found shortcomings at several institutions, that investigations continue at two, that the AV onderwijs is being abolished in favour of a new subsidy scheme, and that the Tax Service and FIOD can act, while declining to name firms or give tax-recovery estimates for confidentiality reasons.
Under the duty of confidentiality, no statements are ever made about individual taxpayers in tax matters.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht worden wat betreft fiscale aangelegenheden nimmer uitspraken gedaan over individuele belastingplichtigen.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en De Rouwe (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «Rijk rekent zich rijk met brandstofaccijns» (ingezonden 13 augustus

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about an article claiming the government profits from fuel excise, asking for fuel sales forecasts, cross-border fuel purchase data, the effect of tax changes, and internal memos on border effects. The State Secretary answered that no sales forecasts are made, gave excise revenue figures and revised 2013 estimates, said cross-border data is not recorded, gave no formula for tax-change effects, and pointed to earlier documents as the only internal analyses.
No forecasts of expected sales of motor fuel are made for the purposes of the national budget.
Er worden geen ramingen gemaakt van de verwachte verkoop van autobrandstof ten behoeve van de rijksbegroting.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, De Rouwe en AgnesMulder (allen CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken over de BPM, de wegenbelasting, de KIA, de MIA

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance whether a Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV and a Tesla S Performance can be bought with near-zero tax burden via BPM exemption, KIA, MIA, Vamil, a 0% company-car addition and no road tax, and how this compares to conventional cars and CO2 emissions trading prices. The government confirmed the tax treatment, provided worked net-cost calculations, and said it would present measures on electric car incentives around Prinsjesdag.
In this context I inform you that around Prinsjesdag I will send your House a letter presenting a number of measures to arrive at a more balanced form of stimulating (semi-)electric cars.

In het kader van het bovenstaande deel ik u mede dat ik omstreeks Prinsjesdag een brief aan uw Kamer zal doen toekomen, waarin ik een aantal maatregelen aan u zal presenteren om te komen tot een meer evenwichtige vorm van stimulering van (semi) elektrische auto's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Neppérus over vertraging bij het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Neppérus (VVD) asked about delays at the UWV in providing employers with information needed to decide on becoming self-insured for sickness benefits in 2014, and about the tight Tax Administration deadline. The minister replied that higher-than-expected demand for benefit decision copies slowed processing, that the UWV has added capacity, and that the Tax Administration will allow case-by-case extensions to 1 December.
The UWV has deployed extra capacity to provide the copies to employers as quickly as possible.
Het UWV heeft extra capaciteit ingezet om de kopieën zo snel mogelijk aan werkgevers te verstrekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Zoveel banen, dat is echt stupide”

MP Klaver asked the state secretary of Finance about criticism by three professors that SEO's job estimates for letterbox companies rested on a calculation error, and whether the claimed job effects would survive without these firms. The state secretary answered only by referring to a joint government letter of 30 August with a cabinet response to the SEO report, without addressing the substance of the questions.
In a joint letter with the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation of 30 August, I sent the House, as previously promised, a cabinet response to, among other things, the SEO report.

In een gezamenlijke brief met de minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking van 30 augustus heb ik, zoals eerder toegezegd, een kabinetsreactie op, onder andere, het SEO rapport aan uw kamer gezonden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het aantal gereden kilometers met een oldtimer

MP Bashir (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about criticism from the FEHAC that the Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving overstated oldtimer mileage, whether the report should be improved, the reasons for abolishing the oldtimer motor vehicle tax exemption, and how revenue and motion implementation were calculated. The government answered that the PBL figures rest on CBS data, that the exemption removal serves environmental and budgetary aims, and that an agreed alternative with the trade sector will be included in the 2014 tax plan.
This alternative will be included in the Tax Plan 2014 and will be covered within the overall package of measures.
Dit alternatief zal worden meegenomen in het Belastingplan 2014 en zal binnen het totaalpakket aan maatregelen worden gedekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Groot over studiereizen met privékarakter op kosten van de belastingbetaler

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about tax deductions for training costs and study trips with a private character, including differences between income tax and corporate tax rules and whether abuse is controlled. The State Secretary explained the deduction rules, said the treatment of entrepreneurs and employees is sufficiently balanced, declined to give details of audit methods, and said improper use is undesirable without proposing new limits.
To prevent future abuse, no statements can be made about the audit method and audit coverage.
Om toekomstig misbruik te voorkomen kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de werkwijze bij controle en over de controledichtheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de heffing van vennootschapsbelasting bij waarborgfondsen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether corporate tax now applies to former tax-exempt guarantee funds, when it started, whether any minister was consulted, the state's backstop exposure, and the effects on housing corporations' investment and VAT. The State Secretary declined to give fund-specific tax positions citing article 67 AWR, stated no change in the tax authority's position occurred, and said the requested effect studies were not carried out and would add nothing.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) does not allow me to provide information on the tax positions of individual guarantee funds.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) staat mij niet toe informatie te verstrekken over de belastingposities van individuele waarborgfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Groot over de verkoop van vakantiedagen

MPs Hamer and Groot asked the ministers about a report that businesses hold about 16 billion euro in unused leave and whether a lower tax rate on buying out leave days would boost the economy. The government answered that the 16 billion figure rests on a small, uncertain survey, that only above-statutory leave can be bought out, and that a reduced tax rate is undesirable because of unequal treatment, revenue loss and tax arbitrage.
For tax purposes, the buyout of holiday days is treated as wages taxed at the rate applying to the employee who buys out.
Fiscaal wordt de afkoop van vakantiedagen beschouwd als loon dat belast wordt naar het tarief zoals dat geldt voor de werknemer die afkoopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over onduidelijke regels omtrent identificatieplicht voor zzp’ers

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether self-employed workers (zzp'ers) face unclear and contradictory identification rules when accepting assignments, and how their privacy is protected. Minister Kamp replied that identification is only required when a client demands a Verklaring Arbeidsrelatie, that the client must keep copies for seven years, and that the Chamber of Commerce only shares business addresses unless legal exceptions apply.
Self-employed workers are not obliged to identify themselves when accepting assignments.
Zzp'ers zijn niet verplicht zich te identificeren bij het aannemen van opdrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Mei Li Vos over de btw-vrijstelling die geldt voor PostNL

Two MPs asked the government about the VAT exemption for universal postal services that benefits PostNL, including its origins, its size and revenue cost, and whether the government would push for its abolition in Europe. The State Secretary confirmed the exemption covers only universal service parcels, explained its historical basis, declined to give volumes or revenue loss citing confidentiality, and said the Netherlands supports abolition, which the Commission withdrew, with a possible future proposal to be notified to parliament.
Due to the commercial confidentiality of the data, the exact size of the UPD share of the total market cannot be stated.
Door de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van de gegevens, kan de exacte grootte van het UPD-aandeel in de totale markt niet worden aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Berndsen-Jansen over de kosten van het softdrugsbeleid van de financiële effecten van het reguleren van softdrugs

MPs Koolmees and Berndsen-Jansen (D66) asked about enforcement costs of soft drug policy, the Taskforce B5 results and costs, coffeeshop turnover and tax revenue, and the financial effects of regulating soft drugs. The government answered that enforcement capacity is not earmarked, the Taskforce B5 cost about 1.99 million euro, and that tax data on coffeeshops are not available per branch, while stating that regulation would not reduce enforcement costs.
Whereas the current cabinet is doing everything it can to turn the tide and tackle crime, nuisance and drug tourism hard.
Dit terwijl het huidige kabinet er juist alles aan doet om het tij te keren en criminaliteit, overlast en drugstoerisme hard aan te pakken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat de regering, ondanks veel toezeggingen, nooit een plan gemaakt heeft om ingezetenen van Nederland met een buitenlands kenteken, belasting te laten betalen

Omtzigt (CDA) asks why the government, despite repeated promises, never produced a plan to make residents with foreign-registered cars pay Dutch motor vehicle tax, and when the promised letter and tax rules will arrive. State Secretary Weekers answers that residents must register cars in the Netherlands, that enforcement data is being collected, and that a letter with combined legislative and enforcement measures will follow, with legislation in the Belastingplan 2014.
The final touches are currently being put to it.
Daaraan wordt op dit moment de laatste hand gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het controleren van box 3-aangiften door de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how many box 3 tax returns were thoroughly checked by the Tax Authority, how many FTE are available, and about data sources and foreign property. The State Secretary declined to give totals or selection criteria, stating the Tax Authority does not have a consolidated overview, and described existing data sources and ongoing efforts on automatic information exchange.
Due to the multitude of forms, an overall picture of the number of box 3 checks and the associated capacity deployment is not available.
Door de veelheid aan verschijningsvormen is een totaalbeeld van het aantal box 3-controles en de daarmee gemoeide capaciteitsinzet niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Voortman over onterecht betaalde belasting door zwangere zzp’ers

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether self-employed women (zzp'ers) who paid income tax on pregnancy benefits from their insurer can recover it, whether earlier years are covered, and what measures will prevent future over-taxation. The State Secretary answered that affected taxpayers can request ex officio reduction until five years after the tax year, that these benefits are not taxable, and that the Tax Administration will add a note on this to general information and the income tax return guidance.
The self-employed person can therefore still submit a request for ex officio reduction throughout 2013 for the years 2008 and onward.
De zzp’er kan gedurende het hele jaar 2013 dus nog een verzoek om ambtshalve vermindering indienen over de jaren 2008 en volgende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ojik en Klaver over Investeringen vanuit Nederland in Afrika

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked why around 62 percent of Dutch-channelled investment in Africa comes from foreign multinationals using Dutch holdings, and whether treaty shopping under Dutch tax treaties with African countries costs developing countries revenue and will be curbed. The minister answers that Dutch treaties reduce withholding taxes, that the tax law does not distinguish 'real Dutch' companies from foreign multinationals, that revenue losses are hard to estimate, and that anti-abuse clauses and OECD BEPS work will be used.
Where desired, the Netherlands includes anti-abuse clauses in new treaties and is also willing to extend existing treaties with anti-abuse clauses where unintended use of the treaty is found.

Nederland neemt in nieuwe verdragen desgewenst anti-misbruik clausules op en is ook bereid bestaande verdragen bij gebleken onbedoeld gebruik van het verdrag uit te breiden met anti-misbruik clausules.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het onterecht krijgen van toeslagen door Oost Europeanen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why the tax authority does not check whether registered persons still live and work in the Netherlands, and how many benefit recipients live abroad and what is paid to them. The State Secretary explains that childcare, health and child benefit allowances are exportable under EU and international rules, reports about 45,000 non-resident recipients and several million euros paid, and describes risk-profile checks, stopping and recovering payments and address-based reviews.
With the help of risk profiles, about 1,200 childcare allowances and about 400 rent allowances have been stopped since 11 March 2013.
Met behulp van de risicoprofielen zijn vanaf 11 maart 2013 ongeveer 1.200 kinderopvangtoeslagen en ongeveer 400 huurtoeslagen gestopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “Terugvorderen opbrengst belastingfraude moeilijk”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance and other ministers about reports that recovering proceeds of tax and benefit fraud is difficult, including fraud amounts and fines in a Deventer case, foreign childcare allowances, unregistered persons receiving allowances, Polish recipients, and EU residence and coordination rules. The government answered in detail, providing figures, explaining controls, and acknowledging some untraceable recipients and data limitations, while promising maatregelen to improve pre-payment checks and a later overview.
The correct amount cannot be given.
Het juiste bedrag is niet te geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt betreffende de zorg aan militairen die niet onder de Zorgverzekeringswet valt

Two CDA MPs asked why active-duty soldiers, who are outside the Zorgverzekeringswet, end up with a higher taxable income and lower benefits than comparable employees, and whether this was deliberate. The State Secretary confirmed the difference, explained that soldiers' health costs run through the military insurer SZVK with a taxable employer share, called it a consequence of soldiers' special position and the Wet ULB, and described a one-off 2013 fix with a structural solution to follow for 2014.
For 2014 and onward, work is under way on a structural solution.
Voor 2014 en verder wordt gewerkt aan een structurele oplossing
Antwoord vragen van de leden Graus en Van Vliet over de gevolgen van de voorgenomen accijnsverhoging

Two MPs from the PVV asked the ministers whether the 2013 beer excise increase and the planned 2014 increase will actually raise revenue or merely fuel excise tourism, cross-border unfair competition and revenue losses. The state secretary of Finance answered that 2013 beer excise receipts are in line with expectations, that Dutch excise applies to foreign brewers selling here, that illegal commercial trade is being tackled with the Belastingdienst and brewers' association, and that a border-effects report will be sent after the summer recess before the government decides on the 2014 increases.
After the summer recess I will send the border-effects report I promised to the House of Representatives.
Na het zomerreces zal ik de door mij toegezegde grenseffectenrapportage aan de Tweede Kamer sturen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bashir en Paulus Jansen over het opschorten van toeslagen en hypotheekrenteaftrek

MPs Bashir and Paulus Jansen (SP) asked why childcare and other allowances were withheld without prior notice during an investigation of entitlement, how many people were affected, and how the burden of proof and reimbursement timing were handled. State Secretary Weekers answered that a processing error blocked payments to 1411 allowance recipients and 518 tax refunds, which were then paid late, with about 750 cases paid twice, and described the balie and letter procedure for verifying entitlement.
Immediately after the error was discovered, the allowances and income tax refunds were paid after all (by the first week of July at the latest).
Direct nadat de fout is ontdekt zijn de toeslagen en de terugbetalingen inkomstenbelasting alsnog uitbetaald (uiterlijk in de eerste week van juli).

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat het IMF de stekker uit het hulpprogramma voor Griekenland wil trekken als de leiders van de eurozone geen oplossing vinden voor een gat van 3 tot 4 milja

An MP asks whether the IMF's threat to withdraw from the Greek bailout over a 3-4 billion euro funding gap contradicts the Eurogroup chair's denial of any gap, and whether the Netherlands still treats IMF participation as a firm condition and regrets breaking its no-money-for-Greece pledge. The minister replies that the Troika's positive July assessment means no gap exists, that the government's position on IMF participation is unchanged, and that its view on the earlier motion is unchanged.
The IMF has indicated that there is no financing gap as long as the outcomes of the progress mission are positive.
Het IMF heeft aangegeven dat er geen sprake is van een financieringsgat zolang de uitkomsten van de voortgangsmissie positief zijn.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over "het huren van kantoren door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) van bedrijven die niet in Nederland gevestigd zijn"

MP Ulenbelt asked whether UWV should avoid renting offices from landlords that may avoid Dutch tax, and whether the government will investigate the ownership and tax residence of those landlords' groups. The minister answered that UWV's role is limited to concluding a lawful lease, that investigating the landlord's corporate structure is the landlord's responsibility, and that fraud falls to police, prosecutors and the FIOD, so no investigation is planned.
The design of the organisational and financing structure is the responsibility of the landlord.
De inrichting van de organisatie- en financieringsstructuur is de verantwoordelijkheid van de verhuurder.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Straus en Neppérus over het verschil in btw voor naschoolse programma’s in het primair onderwijs

MPs Straus and Neppérus asked why some after-school educational programmes in primary education are VAT-exempt and others are not, and whether technology programmes should be exempt too. The State Secretary explained that only programmes derived from the publicly funded regular curriculum or tied to primary education are exempt, that CRKBO registration does not apply to primary-school programmes, and that no separate technology exemption is planned.
No separate statutory VAT exemption is provided for teaching programmes focused on technology.
Er is niet voorzien in een aparte wettelijke vrijstelling van btw voor lesprogramma's die zijn gericht op techniek.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over witwaspraktijken op Cyprus

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether reports by Deloitte and Moneyval on money laundering in Cyprus were available, public, and linked to conditions for European aid tranches, and whether they gave a misleadingly incomplete picture. The minister answered that the reports were received and published on the Cypriot finance ministry website, that the problem lies in implementation rather than legislation, and that completing an action plan is a condition for the next aid tranche.

As also stated in the Eurogroup and Ecofin Council report of 13 and 14 May 2013, the research shows that the shortcomings lie not so much in the laws and regulations as in their implementation and compliance.
