Zoals ook vermeld in het verslag van de Eurogroep en Ecofin Raad van 13 en 14 mei 2013 (met kenmerk BFB 2013-5174M) blijkt uit het onderzoek dat niet zozeer in de wet- en regelgeving tekortkomingen zijn, maar in de implementatie en naleving hiervan.
Antwoord vragen Lucas, Neppérus en Ziengs over regeldruk door informatieuitvragen van de Centrale Dienst voor In- en Uitvoer van de Belastingdienst en van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek

MPs Lucas, Neppérus and Ziengs (VVD) asked whether the CDIU and CBS collect statistics from contracting authorities and businesses in burdensome ways, such as postal-only responses and malfunctioning CBS software. The minister replied that TED data is incomplete, so missing data is requested directly, that the new Aanbestedingswet moves notifications to TenderNed, and that about 98% of statistical burden on businesses stems from EU regulation, with CBS working to reduce it.
The intention is to have the collection of data related to the statistical obligation go electronically via TenderNed in the future.
Het is de bedoeling om in de toekomst de verzameling van gegevens in verband met de statistiekverplichting elektronisch via TenderNed te laten verlopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het belastingtarief voor alternatieve genezers

Van Gerven (SP) asks how alternative healers such as magnetisers can be VAT-exempt like psychologists under EU and Dutch law, given no equivalent training or effectiveness proof, and whether the law should be tightened. The state secretary answers that the exemption is limited to GZ-psychologists from 2013, that the court's reading is too broad so cassation was filed, and that EU case law requires equal treatment of competing services.
In my view this is too broad an interpretation of the term 'services of a psychologist' in the exemption provision. I have therefore lodged cassation against this ruling.
Dit is naar mijn oordeel een te ruime uitleg van het begrip «diensten van een psycholoog» als bedoeld in de vrijstellingsbepaling. Daarom heb ik dan ook cassatie ingesteld tegen deze uitspraak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over duidelijkheid omtrent de duur van de hypotheekrenteaftrek bij trouwen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about conflicting interpretations of how long mortgage interest deduction lasts when partners marry, and about the Tax Service's delayed answers and whether homeowners should receive annual overviews. The State Secretary confirmed the Tax Service applies the interpretation that a single loan cannot yield more than 30 years of deduction, admitted earlier 2010 answers differed, kept the old position for the old regime, and declined annual overviews for now, while committing to a policy decision clarifying the issue.
The explanatory memorandum to that bill also gave an example of the consequences of marriage under the owner-occupied home scheme in force until 1 January 2013.
In de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag bij dat wetsvoorstel is ook een voorbeeld gegeven van de gevolgen van een huwelijk onder de tot 1 januari 2013 geldende eigenwoningregeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het onlangs afgesloten belastingverdrag met China en over het belastingverdrag met Mongolië

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the newly signed China tax treaty and the Mongolia treaty enable profit shifting by multinationals, and whether the Mongolia losses of over 4 billion euros were accurate. The State Secretary defended the China treaty as anti-abuse safeguarded and said the Mongolia figure was unsubstantiated while committing to renegotiate with Mongolia under reformed policy principles.
I will not hesitate to act swiftly if a situation of tax border-probing with regard to this treaty were to arise.
Ik zal niet aarzelen voortvarend aan de slag te gaan als zich een situatie van fiscale grensverkenning met betrekking tot dit verdrag zou voordoen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht ‘Nederland laat fiscale kansen liggen om verder te vergroenen’

MP Klaver asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the Netherlands is missing fiscal opportunities to green its economy, including KPMG's ranking, recent green tax changes and removals, and the employment effects of green taxation. The government answered that the Netherlands is already a frontrunner in environmental taxes, listed the recent measures and their rationale, and said further green taxation is constrained by level-playing-field concerns and that new taxes work best at EU level.
I share the view that green fiscal policy can have positive effects on innovation, the environment and sustainability.
Ik deel de mening dat fiscale vergroening positieve effecten kan hebben op innovatie, milieu en duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over de ontwikkeling en de internationale concurrentiepositie van de Nederlandse havens

MPs De Vries and Groot asked the ministers about the OECD study on Rotterdam and Amsterdam port competitiveness, corporate tax exemption for state port companies, and EU support for smaller ports. The government said the OECD study draws no competitiveness conclusions, that the consequences of ending the tax exemption are not yet clear, and that a level playing field is important to the Netherlands.
However, it is not yet clear at this moment how the revision of the corporate tax liability for state-owned enterprises will be shaped.
Het is op dit moment echter nog niet duidelijk hoe de herziening van de vennootschapsbelastingplicht voor overheidsbedrijven wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bashir en Paulus Jansen over de gevolgen van de auto van de zaak voor het autogebruik

MPs Bashir and Jansen (SP) asked the ministers whether they endorse Van Ommeren's analysis that the company car tax regime causes large economic losses through extra car travel, parking and vehicle choice. State Secretary Weekers rejected the analysis and its conclusions, arguing the evidence for the claimed effects is weak and that existing tax burdens and employer incentives already address these issues.
No, I endorse neither the main lines of the analysis nor all of the conclusions.
Nee, ik onderschrijf noch de hoofdlijnen van de analyse noch alle conclusies.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Groot en Kerstens over zzp'ers die door de Bbz-regeling in de knel raken

MPs asked whether self-employed people on Bbz benefits are being pushed into financial trouble when a Bbz loan is converted into a non-repayable benefit, causing loss of allowances, and how the tax office and municipalities handle the annual statement and this conversion. The minister answered that the conversion is taxed in the year of definitive determination, that individual cases fall to municipalities and the tax secrecy duty, suggested adjusting income estimates for allowances, and said he will ask the state secretary to explore options and inform the House.
However, I have persuaded the state secretary of Finance to explore other options to mitigate or remove the described effects.
Wel heb ik de staatssecretaris van Financiën bereid gevonden andere mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om de geschetste effecten te matigen dan wel weg te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over verlenging van de VUT-uitkering

Two PvdA MPs asked whether extending VUT early-retirement benefits to bridge the rise in the AOW pension age would trigger immediate taxation, and whether the Tax Authority's pension knowledge group's view was government policy. The state secretary answered that extension past age 65 would lose the transitional regime and trigger the VUT levy, that the knowledge group's advice is not policy, and that spreading existing entitlements over a longer period will be tolerated under conditions via a policy decision.
Policy in the formal sense is determined exclusively by me.
Beleid in formele zin wordt uitsluitend door mij vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het forfaitair rendement in box 3 van de Wet IB 2001

MP Bashir asked the state secretary of Finance whether the 4% forfaitair return in box 3 is fair given low savings rates, and whether a capital gains tax should replace the wealth yield tax. The state secretary rejected the claim that savings rates only fell since 2008, defended the 4% long-term benchmark as stable revenue, declined to change it for budgetary reasons, and said a capital gains tax would raise administrative costs.
I therefore have no intention of proposing the introduction of a capital gains tax.
Ik heb dan ook geen voornemen om een voorstel te doen voor de invoering van een vermogenswinstbelasting.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "het huren van kantoren door UWV van bedrijven die niet in Nederland gevestigd zijn

Mr Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether UWV rents offices from landlords with foreign, possibly tax-avoiding structures and how much tax the state loses as a result. The minister replied that UWV does not investigate the ownership chains of landlords, that 132 buildings are rented from Dutch and five German owners at about 81 million euro a year, that rental income from Dutch property is taxed in the Netherlands, and that tax information on individuals cannot be disclosed.
UWV does not investigate the organisational and financing structure of the group to which a landlord may belong.
UWV voert geen onderzoek uit naar de organisatie- en financieringsstructuur van de groep waartoe een verhuurder eventueel behoort.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de btw-heffing bij zelfstandigen in de zorg

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked whether self-employed nurses in hospitals, who are exempt from VAT under the BIG-registration logic, should charge 21% VAT, and how this squares with Article 10 of the VAT Directive and a Breda court ruling. The state secretary answers that such nurses are treated like temporary-staffing agencies, that the work is taxable labour provision, that the Tax Authority has appealed the Breda ruling, and that payment arrangements exist for back-tax assessments.
The Tax Authority has therefore lodged an appeal against the Breda district court ruling.
De Belastingdienst heeft daarom hoger beroep ingesteld tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank Breda.
Antwoord vragen Oskam over de berichten ‘Gokbranche wil lagere belasting’ en ‘Het Nederlandse model voor gokken op internet komt eraan’

Oskam (CDA) asked whether the government should accept online gambling firms' demands for a much lower gambling tax rate, and how it would prevent evasion from tax havens like Malta. The government confirms it is considering a lower 20 percent rate for remote gambling, arguing a high rate drives players to illegal operators, and says a strong regulated regime and enforcement will address evasion.
A lower rate for legal remote gambling is indeed being considered.
Een lager tarief voor legale kansspelen op afstand wordt inderdaad overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de uitzending van Tegenlicht ‘De Tax Free Tour’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Tegenlicht documentary on offshore tax avoidance, including the size of the offshore industry, bronbelasting, tax rulings, economic zones and tax holidays. The State Secretary declined to confirm the offshore figures, rejected withholding tax on interest and royalties, acknowledged that corporate tax avoidance shifts burdens to others, and defended tax rulings as legitimate advance certainty.
I have said on several occasions that this is an international problem that must be tackled internationally and that I am committed to that international approach.
Ik heb bij verschillende gelegenheden gezegd dat dit een internationaal probleem is dat internationaal aangepakt moet worden en dat ik mij voor die internationale aanpak inzet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Wet uniformering loonbegrip

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Wet uniformering loonbegrip (article 11d Wet LB), which excludes the Zvw income-dependent contribution from taxable wages, unfairly disadvantages cross-border workers insured abroad, including Belgian and German employees working in the Netherlands and Dutch residents working in Belgium. The state secretary answered that the rule does not apply to workers insured under foreign schemes, so the Uitvoeringsregeling is not unlawful, but that a comparable provision will be added for foreign situations and the 2009 decree will be updated.

To remove the distinction between employees under the Dutch Zorgverzekeringswet and employees under a comparable foreign scheme, I will include in a bill for foreign situations a provision comparable to article 11d of the Wet op de loonbelasting 1964.

Om het onderscheid tussen werknemers die onder de Nederlandse Zorgverzekeringswet vallen en werknemers die onder een vergelijkbaar buitenlands stelsel vallen, weg te nemen, zal ik in een wetsvoorstel voor de buitenlandse situaties een aan artikel 11d van de Wet op de loonbelasting 1964 vergelijkbare bepaling opnemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over het bericht van de Franse regering om er binnen de EU voor te ijveren dat country-by-country reporting verplicht wordt gesteld voor alle bedrijven

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the government supports France's EU push for country-by-country tax reporting for all multinationals, and what it will do about it. The government supports international efforts against aggressive tax planning, would back France if it raises the proposal in the EU, but favours such reporting only if introduced at EU level.
The cabinet will therefore support the French government if it wishes to consult at EU level on an obligation for such reporting.
Het kabinet zal dan ook de Franse regering steunen als zij in EU-verband wenst te overleggen over een verplichting tot een dergelijke rapportage.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en Van Vliet over mogelijk misbruik van de kennismigrantenregeling

Two PVV MPs asked whether foreigners often switch an existing residence permit to 'knowledge migrant' status and whether the 30% tax ruling for expats should be denied to those already living in the Netherlands. The government answered that 1,130 (2010) and 1,260 (2011) such changes occurred, and that people already resident on another basis are excluded from the 30% ruling unless they are students, interns or PhD candidates.
Employees who already reside in the Netherlands on another residence basis are not eligible for the 30% ruling, unless they reside in the Netherlands as a student, intern or PhD candidate.

Werknemers die reeds op grond van een ander verblijfsdoel in Nederland verblijven, komen niet in aanmerking voor de 30%-regeling, tenzij zij in Nederland als student, stagiair of promovendus verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over mogelijke fouten in loonstrookjes als gevolg van de samenloop WUL en AOW leeftijdsverhoging

Two MPs asked whether the 2013 AOW age increase combined with the new wage definition (WUL) caused errors in pensioners' payslips, whether the SVB communicated adequately, and whether taxpayers need to file returns. The government denied a systematic error, explained how tax credits are split between AOW and pension income, pointed to Belastingdienst information, and declined to extend the early WUL evaluation to pension-fund and SVB implementation.
At present, given the answers above, I see no reason to also include the implementation and communication by pension funds and the SVB in that evaluation.
Ik zie op dit moment – gezien de hierboven gegeven antwoorden – geen reden ook de uitvoering en communicatie door pensioenfondsen en SVB in die evaluatie te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Paulus Jansen over een belastingaanslag over wateronttrekking ten behoeve van een installatie voor warmte-koudeopslag

MPs Van Tongeren and Paulus Jansen asked whether a heat-cold storage (WKO) installation that extracts and reinjects groundwater was liable for groundwater tax under the Wbm, and why nine-year-old residents in Etten-Leur received an assessment. The State Secretary answered that the exemption required a permit, closed-loop reinjection into the same aquifer, and compliance with permit conditions, that the tax was abolished from 1 January 2012, and that he had no indication the inspector misinterpreted the law, citing tax confidentiality for concrete cases.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation, I cannot provide information on concrete cases.
In verband met de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik over concrete gevallen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over gebreken bij het verstrekken van inkomensgegevens door de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asked the ministers about a glitch on 11 April 2013 in the Tax Authority system that gave landlords income data for income-dependent rent increases, plus remedies, error rates, damages claims and administrative burden. The minister answered that the glitch was fixed within a day, that landlords were advised to re-request data, that five landlords have made liability claims, and that some figures cannot be provided for privacy or data reasons while a fuller update will follow after the summer recess.
For reasons of privacy, only the information necessary for this purpose is generated.
Om redenen van privacy wordt alleen de hiervoor noodzakelijke informatie gegenereerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over mogelijke belastingontwijking door leden van het Koninklijk Huis

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked the Prime Minister and State Secretary of Finance about possible tax avoidance by members of the Royal House, including how their structure compares to Princess Christina's, and whether they should be taxed like ordinary citizens. The government answered that royals are subject to the same legal privacy protections in tax matters as other taxpayers, that no change is needed, and that press reports do not alter this.
With regard to the legal protection of personal privacy connected to taxation, members of the Royal House do not differ from other taxpayers.
Ten aanzien van de met belastingheffing verbonden wettelijke bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer verschillen leden van het koninklijk huis niet van andere belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Dik-Faber over het meetellen van het persoonsgebonden budget in box 3

MPs Schouten and Dik-Faber asked whether unspent personal budget (PGB) advances count as box 3 wealth, lowering the fairness of the AWBZ own-contribution rules, and whether the government will investigate alternatives. The government confirmed PGB advances count as liquid assets, noted that payment timing by two care offices can create a small effect, and promised a letter after the Spring Memorandum on possible remedies.

During the debate of 4 April 2013 on the unintended effects of the wealth income add-on, I committed to indicate in a letter following the Spring Memorandum whether there are options to remedy the identified effects of the PGB on the wealth income add-on for the AWBZ own contribution.

Tijdens het debat van 4 april 2013 over de ongewenste effecten van de vermogensinkomensbijtelling heb ik toegezegd dat ik in een brief naar aanleiding van de Voorjaarsnota zal aangeven of er mogelijkheden zijn om de geconstateerde gevolgen van het PGB voor de vermogensinkomensbijtelling voor de eigen bijdrage AWBZ te verhelpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Heerma over de kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked whether working lone parents living with a parent lost childcare allowance after the 2012 partner rules change, whether they were warned, whether allowance remains for shared households, and whether they will compensate affected parents. The minister confirmed the partner rule can strip allowance, that notification was given via general communication and personal letters, and that compensation is not proposed without a parliamentary decision because of budgetary consequences.
Het gaat dan om ca. 4,6 miljoen belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het aanvragen van de voorlopige aanslag

An MP asked why the tax authority no longer automatically imposes provisional income tax assessments for 2013 and whether taxpayers can be exposed to unexpected large bills. The state secretary answered that about 3.9 million provisional assessments were issued, roughly 0.1 million could not be issued due to the Wet uniformering loonbegrip, affected people were asked to reapply, and the government denied a structural increase in administrative burden.

Therefore it was decided not to impose a first provisional assessment in these cases, but to ask these citizens by letter – if they believe they are nevertheless entitled to a first provisional assessment – to submit a new application.

Daarom is besloten in deze gevallen geen eerste voorlopige aanslag op te leggen, maar deze burgers per brief te vragen – als zij menen toch recht te hebben op een eerste voorlopige aanslag – een nieuwe aanvraag in te dienen.
Antwoord vragen Bashir en Ulenbelt over gesjoemel met lonen in de bouw

MPs Bashir and Ulenbelt asked the ministers how foreign construction firms use constructions to underpay social premiums, which controls apply, whether the NMa, FIOD and Belastingdienst are involved, and what measures will follow. The minister answered that inspectorates are cooperating and have broad powers, pointed to an action plan on sham constructions with intensified supervision, and withheld Belastingdienst findings citing confidentiality.
As you have seen in the action plan, we will intensify this supervision.
Zoals u heeft gezien in het actieplan zullen we dit toezicht gaan intensiveren.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over Duitse pensioenen

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about German pensions paid to Dutch residents, including whether war-victims' and military pensions reach Dutch tax authorities, whether SS-related pensions are withdrawn, and whether AOW is stopped for prisoners. The State Secretary replies that the tax service now receives automatic data on German statutory pensions but not military pensions, that German pension matters are largely a German internal affair, and that the answers to several questions are not available in the Netherlands.
There is no data available in the Netherlands showing how many Dutch nationals were entitled to a German pension due to German military service.
Er zijn in Nederland geen gegevens beschikbaar waaruit blijkt hoeveel Nederlanders recht hadden op een pensioen uit Duitsland vanwege Duitse krijgsdienst.
Antwoord vragen Klaver over het bericht “Weekers lokt Japanse investeerders met belastingklimaat”

MP Klaver asked the State Secretary of Finance about reported statements promoting the Dutch tax climate to Japanese investors, and how fiscal certainty is given to foreign companies. Weekers answered that the Netherlands was promoted as an attractive investment location, that advance certainty is provided through the APBI contact point for investments of at least EUR 4.5 million, and that agreements remain within the legal framework.
The contact point provides advance certainty on planned investments of in principle at least EUR 4.5 million that lead to sustainable employment in the Netherlands.
Het aanspreekpunt geeft zekerheid vooraf op voorgenomen investeringen van in beginsel minimaal € 4,5 miljoen die leiden tot duurzame werkgelegenheid in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Groot en Wolbert over de btw-heffing bij zelfstandigen in de zorg

Three PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT treatment of self-employed nurses in healthcare, including whether unclear rules create unfair competition and why inspectors allegedly apply rules inconsistently. The State Secretary answered that self-employed nurses working under a hospital's supervision are VAT-liable, denied inconsistent enforcement, and said the Tax Administration has informed the sector and updated its public guidance.
I do not recognise the criticism that tax inspectors apply the rules inconsistently.
Ik herken de kritiek niet dat belastinginspecteurs de regels niet eenduidig zouden hanteren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over belastingontwijking in Zambia

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked the ministers whether a Dutch treaty with Zambia enables tax avoidance by a British sugar company, whether Zambia loses more to avoidance than it gains in aid, and whether the treaty should be renegotiated. The government said it lacks data on specific amounts, acknowledged the 5% dividend withholding rate under the 1977 treaty, and promised a review of treaties with developing countries with results expected in summer 2013.
We have no information on the amount of tax that may have been avoided in Zambia.
Over de omvang van de eventueel in Zambia ontweken belasting hebben wij geen informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de samenloop van de crisisheffing en de levensloopregeling

MP Dijkgraaf asked whether the extended crisis levy on high incomes clashes with the favourable 2013 life-course scheme, which raises employers' extra costs when employees withdraw their savings in one lump sum, and whether the one-off withdrawal could be exempted. Staatssecretaris Weekers answered that he shares the concern, will provide in the bill that wages from a full 2013 withdrawal under the 80% scheme do not count toward the crisis levy base.

When drafting the extension of the pseudo-final levy on high wages (the so-called crisis levy), I will therefore include in the bill that if an employee withdraws the full life-course balance in 2013 under the 80% scheme, the wages from that withdrawal will not count toward the base of the levy.

Bij de uitwerking van de verlenging van de pseudo-eindheffing voor hoog loon (ook wel de crisisheffing genoemd) zal ik daarom in het wetsvoorstel met betrekking tot deze verlenging opnemen dat indien een werknemer in het jaar 2013 met toepassing van die 80%-regeling het volledige tegoed van de levenslooprekening opneemt, het loon ter zake van die opname niet meetelt voor de grondslag van de pseudo-eindheffing voor hoog loon.

Antwoord vragen Knops en Omtzigt over de problemen als gevolg van de huidige regelgeving met betrekking tot  hypotheekrenteaftrek die kunnen optreden voor mensen met een eigen woning die in scheiding liggen

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the government about problems for divorcing homeowners with negative equity under current mortgage interest deduction rules, including sale times, tax treatment at divorce, and bank conditions. The minister replied that existing measures (restschuld financing, temporary tax deduction on residual debt, divorce exceptions, extended move-out periods) are sufficient within budget limits, declined to extend the divorce term or relax the amortisation requirement, and said banks reassess the finances of the remaining partner.

Within the tight budgetary margins caused by the current economic crisis, this is currently the maximum that can be done about the problem of homes being underwater and its consequences for taxpayers going through divorce.

Binnen de – door de huidige economische crisis – krappe budgettaire marges is dit op dit moment het maximale dat gedaan kan worden aan het probleem van het «onder water staan» van woningen en de gevolgen daarvan voor belastingplichtigen die aan het scheiden zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Merkies over “belastingparadijzerij”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the adopted Van Vliet motion rejecting the label 'tax haven' for the Netherlands would be implemented, and pressed on whether the Netherlands facilitates tax avoidance by multinationals, the OECD criteria for tax havens, preferential regimes, and the meaning of 'tax-haven practices'. The State Secretary answered that the motion means a parliamentary majority does not consider the Netherlands a tax haven, that only the OECD criteria are meaningful, that the Netherlands takes anti-avoidance measures and an enforcement intensification, and that the term was used loosely in debate without a defined meaning.
I do not agree, and as the adopted motion shows, a majority in the House of Representatives does not agree either.
Ik ben het er niet mee eens en, zo blijkt uit de aangenomen motie, een meerderheid in de Tweede Kamer ook niet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Zuid Europese bedrijven drukken belasting met Nederlandse postbusfirma’s”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Finance whether he knew that many southern European multinationals use Dutch letterbox companies, and how he viewed low effective tax rates and the fairness of the tax burden. The State Secretary said he holds no data on these holdings or tax paid by non-resident companies, rejected the claim that southern European governments lose revenue through Dutch routing, and pointed to EU and OECD initiatives on the matter.
I do not have data on the extent to which companies established in the said states hold shares in companies established in the Netherlands.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over de mate waarin vennootschappen gevestigd in de genoemde staten aandelen houden in vennootschappen die in Nederland zijn gevestigd.
Antwoord vragen Groot over het opzeggen door Mongolië van het belastingverdrag met Nederland

Labour MP Groot asked the State Secretary of Finance about Mongolia's termination of its tax treaty with the Netherlands, including whether an IMF report calls the treaty problematic and why Mongolia terminated it. The State Secretary answered that the IMF report only flags the 0% dividend rate as problematic, that Mongolia terminated the treaty over lost revenue, and declined to propose new substance requirements for Dutch-based companies.
The fact that Mongolia has terminated the Treaty is not, for me, a reason to make proposals to amend Dutch statutory or regulatory provisions.
Het feit dat Mongolië het Verdrag heeft opgezegd, is voor mij geen aanleiding voorstellen te doen om Nederlandse wet- of regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen Klaver over het bericht “Mongolië pikt het niet meer en zegt belastingverdrag met Nederland op”

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether Mongolia's termination of its tax treaty with the Netherlands, which it said let multinationals avoid Mongolian taxes, was justified and why the Netherlands had not renegotiated it, and asked about IMF criticism and a motion on reviewing treaties for developing-country effects. The state secretary rejected the premise that Mongolian taxes are generally avoided, argued Mongolia retains substantial mining revenue, explained the treaty was concluded in 2002 at Mongolia's request, denied refusing renegotiation terms outright, and said a review of treaties with developing countries is underway with results expected in summer.
Moreover, only dividends on shares not held by the Mongolian state will leave Mongolia.
Daar komt bij dat alleen de dividenden op aandelen die niet in handen zijn van de Mongoolse staat, Mongolië zullen verlaten
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Nijboer over het belastingvoordeel dat gepaard gaat met het aanbieden van hypotheken onder marktrentes

MPs Groot and Nijboer asked the state secretary of Finance whether employee mortgage discounts below market rate should be taxed at market value rather than the 3% norm rate, and about the revenue loss. The state secretary confirmed the tax treatment rules, said the norm rate is applied in practice, and stated there is no budgetary loss; the rule will be reviewed in light of planned mortgage interest deduction limits.
In light of the upcoming restrictions on mortgage interest deduction, as foreseen in the VVD/PvdA coalition agreement, this arrangement will still be reviewed.
In het licht van de aanstaande beperkingen van de hypotheekrenteaftrek, zoals voorzien in het Regeerakkoord VVD/PvdA, zal deze regeling nog worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het over de nieuwe financieringsconstructe voor koopwoningen uit het woonakkoord

An SP MP asked the minister about the new two-part mortgage (annuity loan plus a second loan financing part of the repayments) under the housing accord, covering notary costs, bank interest, tax treatment, risks on forced sale, cooperative ownership and rental alternatives. The minister answered that the government gives advance clarity on tax consequences but does not intervene in bank product design, that risk suitability is left to lenders and the AFM, and that the government sees no case for cooperative or rental-based reform.
In line with the answer to question 2, it is not appropriate to seek contact with banks or other financial institutions to establish whether there is interest in offering a second loan.
In lijn met het antwoord op vraag 2 ligt het niet in de rede contact te zoeken met banken of andere financiële instellingen om na te gaan in hoeverre er interesse bestaat.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over e-Health diensten en btw-heffing

An MP asked whether the tax authority's demand that care provider Ksyos pay VAT on eHealth services was justified, and whether VAT blocks other care projects. The government declined to discuss the individual case citing tax secrecy, explained that VAT exemptions apply to medical care by doctors but not to the ICT services supporting teledermatology, and said it could not identify other affected projects while the ministries investigate attribution questions.
The questions concern an individual matter. Due to the tax secrecy obligation, no statements can be made about it.
De vragen betreffen een individuele aangelegenheid. Daarover kunnen in verband met de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over horizontaal toezicht

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about horizontal supervision of the Tax Administration, including whether budget cuts and rising firm numbers undermine vertical enforcement. The State Secretary answered that the instruments complement each other, cuts do not affect supervision, extra staff and enforcement measures are underway, and that there is no real disagreement with the staff association.
The cuts do not come at the expense of supervision.
De bezuinigingen gaan niet ten koste van het toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Neppérus en Ziengs over lasten bij invoer van biologische wijnen

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why organic wines imported into the Netherlands must be re-certified as organic even though they already met EU rules in the country of origin, and whether similar rules apply to other organic products. The reply states that Customs has no role in checking organic status, that EU Regulation 834/2007 requires certification of traders selling organic products to business buyers, that Skal performs these checks as an EU obligation, and that Skal keeps the burden low through risk-based inspection.
These checks by the Skal foundation are a European obligation.
Deze controles door stichting Skal zijn een Europese verplichting.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over het onderzoek van de FIOD naar mogelijke belangenverstrengeling in de top van SNS Property Finance

PvdA MP Nijboer asked the ministers of Finance about a FIOD investigation into possible conflicts of interest at SNS Property Finance, including the basis for suspicion, links to its losses and nationalisation, contact with SNS Reaal's new board, and liability and bonus claw-back for staff. The minister declined to discuss the ongoing criminal investigation, said the board was monitoring integrity signals, and noted employers can hold staff financially liable for fraud.
I make no statements regarding ongoing criminal investigations.
Ik doe geen mededelingen met betrekking tot lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Merkies over het bericht dat Nederland laks is in de bestrijding van corruptie

Two SP MPs asked the government how it can tolerate that 14 of 22 signalled foreign bribery cases were never investigated and none led to conviction, and what it will do about it. The minister replied that the OECD evaluation is part of three pending reviews, that an integrated policy response is due in autumn 2013, that a new prosecution guideline was adopted, 150 extra FIOD investigators are being recruited, and several legislative and prosecution measures are underway, but gave no firm timetable for the OECD-recommended legislative changes.

The cabinet letter presenting the OECD report stated that the cabinet aims to present an integrated policy response on Dutch anti-corruption efforts to the House after the three evaluations are complete.

In de Kamerbrief ter aanbieding van het OESO-rapport 2 is aangegeven dat het kabinet ernaar streeft om na afloop van de drie evaluaties een integrale beleidsreactie over de Nederlandse corruptiebestrijding aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over oneigenlijk gebruik van de kinderopvangtoeslag

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about reported multi-million euro fraud with childcare allowances in 2009-2010 and why measures announced in 2011 did not prevent it. The minister answered that the measures took effect in 2012, that roughly 40 million euro of fraud had been established with a further 40 million under prosecution, that the effectiveness of the measures cannot be precisely demonstrated, and that no additional measures are planned for now.
I do not intend to take additional measures at this stage. When I see reason to do so, the House will be informed.
Ik ben niet voornemens om nu al aanvullende maatregelen te nemen. Wanneer ik daar aanleiding toe zie, zal de Kamer daar over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Bashir over het bericht dat Nederlandse banken tientallen vennootschappen hebben in belastingparadijzen

SP MPs Merkies and Bashir asked whether Dutch banks, especially state-supported ones, should avoid tax via tax-haven subsidiaries, whether such structures are tax avoidance, and whether banks should disclose and justify foreign subsidiaries, plus the status of a proposed reporting duty for tax advisers. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that he has no reason to doubt banks' stated reasons, that tax avoidance is legal but sometimes undesirable, that foreign subsidiaries are already partly disclosed and tax authorities have sufficient powers, and that a reporting point for tax advisers is unnecessary given existing covenants.
Moreover, Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act does not allow me to go into individual cases.
Overigens staat artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelasting mij niet toe in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vermeende aangifte wegens ambtelijke corruptie tegen dhr J. van Rey

The MP Omtzigt asked whether a Belastingdienst official filed a corruption complaint against sitting Senator J. van Rey, how suspects are notified, what rules apply to complaints against parliamentarians, and who in government was informed. Minister Opstelten answered that the procedure was followed without deviation, that no specific rules exist for complaints against MPs, and that a criminal investigation is ongoing so further details cannot be given.
Given the interests of this criminal investigation, which is still ongoing, I cannot go into further detail.
Gelet op de belangen van dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat nog gaande is, kan ik niet verder in detail treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Neppérus over het bericht dat ambtenaren van de Belastingdienst aanlopen tegen zaken, die zij willen doorgeven aan het Openbaar Ministerie

An MP asked how often Tax Authority officials report suspected non-fiscal crimes to the Public Prosecution Service, what the procedure is, and whether superiors are informed. The state secretary answered that several hundred such reports were made in 2009-2012, routed through a designated contact officer, with discretion left to local staff and no notification to management in the case reported in the press.
No report was made to the management about suspicions of official corruption against Mr Van Rey as mentioned in the ANP report of 3 January 2013.
Er is geen melding aan de dienstleiding gedaan van vermoedens van ambtelijke corruptie tegen de heer Van Rey als genoemd in het ANP-bericht van 3 januari 2013.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de multiplier in de Geefwet

Parliamentarian Omtzigt asked for an overview of all laws, schemes and projects for which the Dutch government sought European Commission approval but had not yet received an answer, with dates of formal requests. Minister Timmermans replied that EU law generally does not require prior Commission approval of national legislation, with exceptions such as state aid notifications, and that no central overview of Dutch state aid notifications is kept.
No central overview is kept of Dutch state aid notifications from the various ministries.
Voor wat betreft Nederlandse staatssteunmeldingen van de verschillende ministeries wordt geen centraal overzicht bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het artikel ‘Banken actief in belastingparadijzen’

MP Klaver asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Dutch banks, including state-aided ones, use shell companies in tax havens and what should be done, including on substance rules, transparency and public beneficial-ownership registers. The State Secretary declined to address individual cases, saw no reason to doubt banks' explanations, said existing reporting rules give sufficient transparency, and pointed to ongoing international work in the Global Forum.
Moreover, Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act does not allow me to comment on individual cases.
Overigens staat artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelasting mij niet toe in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de multiplier in de Geefwet

An MP asks whether the Commission's approval of the Geefwet multiplier for cultural institutions is still pending, and asks for correspondence and a list of pending state-aid approvals. The state secretary says approval is expected in early 2013 but refuses to release the correspondence while the procedure is open, and promises a separate reply from the foreign minister on the list.
As long as a state-aid approval procedure with the European Commission has not yet led to a decision, I cannot provide the information you requested to the House.
Zolang een procedure inzake goedkeuring van staatssteun bij de Europese Commissie nog niet heeft geleid tot een besluit, kan ik de door u gevraagde informatie niet aan de Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen Klaver over het bericht ‘Fiscale trucs onder vuur’

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance about Starbucks paying no UK corporation tax via Dutch structures, whether a Dutch tax arrangement with Starbucks would be published, and how the Netherlands avoids being seen as a tax haven. The government declined to comment on an individual company's tax position citing confidentiality under article 67 AWR, said it finds the Netherlands being labelled a tax haven very undesirable, and committed to supporting international anti-avoidance initiatives while protecting small open economies.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not allow me to give a judgment on the tax position of an individual company.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen staat mij niet toe een oordeel geven over de belastingpositie van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over fiscale vluchtroutes door Nederland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about multinationals such as Google, Starbucks and Amazon using Dutch structures for tax avoidance, including whether the Dutch government facilitates this and whether royalty tax rulings give discounts. The State Secretary declined to judge individual companies, rejected the claim that the Netherlands aims to facilitate avoidance, said no rates are reduced via rulings, and promised a technical briefing and further action through EU and OECD initiatives.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not allow me to give a judgment on the tax position of an individual company.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen staat mij niet toe een oordeel geven over de belastingpositie van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord vragen Klaver over het bericht "Google houdt 2 mrd weg bij de fiscus"

MP Klaver asked the State Secretary of Finance whether he condemns Google's tax avoidance through the Netherlands, whether tax treaties should be revised, and how the motion on closing avenues for tax avoidance will be implemented. The State Secretary declined to judge an individual company's tax position under the General Tax Act, saw no evidence of unlawful conduct, said treaties aim to avoid double taxation, and pointed to EU and OECD initiatives and a forthcoming letter on the issue.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not allow me to give a judgment on the tax position of an individual company.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen staat mij verder niet toe een oordeel geven over de belastingpositie van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Merkies over het ontwijken van belasting door Google

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about Google's tax avoidance through Dutch and Bermudan structures, the low effective tax rate, the 'substance' requirements for letterbox companies, the EU's push against aggressive tax planning and reform of the Code of Conduct group and anti-abuse rules. The State Secretary declined to judge the individual company's tax position (citing Article 67 AWR), said no law was broken, defended the status quo, and only supported international initiatives without committing to concrete national steps.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not allow me to give an opinion on the tax position of an individual company.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen staat mij niet toe een oordeel geven over de belastingpositie van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het artikel “Griechen und Spanier kaufen massenhaft deutsche Immobilien“

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether tax data on suspicious cash property purchases abroad are exchanged across the EU, and whether Greece and other states should ratify the mutual assistance protocol. The government answered that automatic exchange under Directive 2011/16/EU applies from tax year 2014, that it supports ratification, and that it will ask Greek authorities about follow-up on a list of Dutch yacht owners after a few months.
This does not seem necessary for now, because the aforementioned Directive 2011/16/EU
Dit lijkt mij vooralsnog niet nodig, omdat genoemde Richtlijn 2011/16/EU
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat door een computerfout duizenden burgers een foutieve brief van de Belastingdienst gekregen hebben

An MP asked whether thousands of citizens received an erroneous Belastingdienst letter due to a computer error, how many were affected, and whether recipients must re-submit data. The state secretary answered that 35,000 households were wrongly told of upcoming policy changes, about 16,000 were confirmed in error and will receive a correction letter, and 4,700 remain under investigation, with the cause traced to a legacy system and no effect on allowance amounts.
These 16,000 households will receive a letter in December stating that they wrongly received a letter and that Belastingdienst/Toeslagen will correct the error made.
Deze 16.000 huishouden krijgen in december een brief waarin staat dat ze ten onrechte een brief hebben gekregen en dat Belastingdienst/Toeslagen de gemaakte fout hersteld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over ‘de karige informatie op de voorschotbeschikkingen voor de zorg- en huurtoeslag 2013’

An SP MP asked why the 2013 childcare and rent allowance advance decisions omit the assessed income and rent data, and whether this information can be restored given that many people lack internet access. The state secretary defended the compact notice as more efficient, pointed to Mijn toeslagen, BelTel and service points as alternatives, and declined to restore the information on all decisions.
Compared with the decision sent last year, the compact notice saves 17 million A4 sheets.
Ten opzichte van de beschikking zoals die vorig jaar nog werd verzonden levert de compacte mededeling een besparing van 17 miljoen vellen A4 op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw c.s. over de zaak Van Rey - Weekers

Opposition and coalition MPs ask the State Secretary for Finance about the Van Rey–Weekers affair: a billboard donation, the sale of a tax office and a tax request involving real estate. They press on the nature and financing of the donation, contacts about closing tax offices, and handling of a personal tax request. The item is a bundle of written questions; the answers are not included in the text provided.
Have you verified that the donation was indeed made only by Mr Van Rey and, as agreed, processed via the regional campaign fund? Can you make the accounts public?

Heeft u zich ervan vergewist dat de donatie inderdaad alleen door de heer Van Rey is gedaan en, zoals afgesproken, via de regionale campagnekas is afgehandeld? Kunt u de rekeningen hiervan openbaar maken?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het verruimen van de overgangsperiode voor het omzetten van een bestaande aflossingsvrije hypotheek in een (bank)spaarhypotheek tot 1 april 2013

An SP MP asked how large the fiscal costs would be in 2013 and later if all homeowners with interest-only mortgages switched to savings mortgages before 1 April 2013, and what the basis and financing of the extended transition period was. The minister, on behalf of the state secretary of Finance, answered that the budgetary loss is expected to be nil in 2013 and in the long run, assuming owners who chose interest-only mortgages deliberately chose not to save and few would now switch.
The budgetary loss resulting from the introduction of this transitional arrangement is expected to be nil in 2013 and in the long term.
De budgettaire derving als gevolg van de introductie van deze overgangsregeling, zal in 2013 en op lange termijn naar verwachting nihil zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de oude economische eigendomsrechten

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Finance about problems with old economic property transfers (koop without levering), including revocable powers of attorney lapsing on bankruptcy, the cost of the art. 2:23c BW procedure, and possible remedies. The government answered that buyers bear the risks of this chosen form, that the procedure is a deliberate safeguard, and that it opposes an amnesty for these fiscal constructions.
I am therefore not in favour of an amnesty scheme, as advocated by the KNB.
Ik ben daarom ook geen voorstander van een amnestieregeling, zoals bepleit door de KNB.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Hijum en Knops over de hypotheekrenteaftrek

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance about the planned phased reduction of the mortgage interest deduction top rate (fourth bracket) from 52% to 38% and its effect on marginal tax rates. The government confirmed the plan, said details on the marginal tax effects and the mechanism (no tax credit route) would follow in a bill, and stated that the phasing-down timetable runs over 28 years to give housing market certainty.
It is premature to make statements now about the tax rate that will then apply in the third bracket or the combined tax and premium rate in the second bracket.
Het is voorbarig om nu uitspraken te doen over het dan geldende belastingpercentage in de derde schijf of het gecombineerde belasting- en premiepercentage in de tweede schijf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht in het Algemeen Dagblad ‘Een op de vijf rijscholen werkt zwart’

An MP asked the ministers whether driving schools that appear to under-report revenue, and whether cheap lessons and possible examination irregularities, warrant action, and asked about instructor entry requirements and entrepreneurship training. The government said the Tax Administration is targeting about 20% of driving schools with a themed approach, that discrepancies do not automatically imply fraud, and declined to judge the entry requirements while the WRM evaluation is ongoing.
The intention is to take firm action against driving school owners who deliberately commit fraud.
Daarbij is het de bedoeling dat bewust frauderende rijschoolhouders krachtig worden aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Filmlaboratorium Cineco failliet’

MPs Bergkamp and Verhoeven asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Finance about the bankruptcy of film laboratory Cineco, including its causes, consequences for the Dutch film industry, and whether a tax shelter is needed for a level playing field in Europe. The minister answered that the consequences are hard to judge yet, that the industry itself must look at preserving Cineco's expertise, and that it cannot yet be determined whether the lack of a tax shelter was decisive, while creating new fiscal facilities for specific sectors conflicts with simplifying the tax system.
It is up to the industry itself to examine whether there are possibilities to preserve Cineco's knowledge and expertise in the Netherlands.
Het is aan de bedrijfstak zelf om te bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om de kennis en kunde van Cineco in Nederland te behouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over namaak goede doelen in de zorg

An MP asked whether fake charities in healthcare should be stopped by stricter rules, such as extra demands on the 'Ruimte voor geven' covenant and limits on ANBI tax status. The government answered that it opposes misleading charities, points to the transparency and supervision vision already sent to parliament, and says adding new covenant demands now would be premature, while agreeing that only compliant charities should get ANBI status.
The cabinet finds it undesirable that people are misled and that incorrect medical information is provided, whether via sites of fake charities or otherwise.
Het kabinet vindt het ongewenst dat mensen worden misleid en dat foutieve medische informatie wordt verstrekt, of dit nu via sites van namaak goede doelen gebeurt of anderszins.
Antwoord vragen Mei Li Vos en Recourt over identiteitsfraude door slecht bewaarde paspoortkopieën

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked about identity fraud risks from copies of passports that self-employed contractors must give each client and clients must keep for seven years. The minister replied that the retention duty is legally required, that the government lacks data on fraud involving such copies, suggested contractors write purpose and date on copies, and said the VAR web module will not change the identification requirement.
The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will start a campaign at the end of this year to point people to this option.
Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties start eind dit jaar een campagne om mensen op deze mogelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het onderzoek ‘Erven zonder financiële zorgen’

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked the government about a study proposing three routes to protect heirs from unintended acceptance of an estate's debts, about the number of households with negative home equity, and about delays in CAK and Toeslagen decisions affecting inheritances. The government said it has no exact count of negative-equity households (estimated around 700,000), announced mortgage-debt measures and a temporary tax deduction for residual debt, and promised a reply on the study's preferred route by year-end.
The cabinet does not have information that gives insight into the exact number of households with negative home equity.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die inzicht geeft in het exacte aantal huishoudens met een negatieve overwaarde.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Groot en Wolbert over de verhoogde vrijstelling van de erfbelasting voor mantelzorgers

MPs Recourt, Groot and Wolbert asked whether the government would improve information to carers about the inheritance tax exemption linked to the mantelzorgcompliment, and whether the exemption should rest on receiving that compliment. The state secretary replied that information has already been improved, including SVB letters, and that the compliment is not meant for the exemption, so the statutory condition cannot be waived through the hardship clause.
Since this is an explicit choice by the legislature, I have no room to deviate from it by applying the hardship clause.
Nu sprake is van een uitdrukkelijke keuze van de wetgever, heb ik geen ruimte om daarvan met toepassing van hardheidsclausule af te wijken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over fiscale bevoordeling van overuren door buitenlandse seizoenwerkers

MP Ulenbelt asked whether the arrangement agreed between LTO Nederland and the Tax Authority, allowing overtime pay to be converted into tax-free housing and travel allowances for foreign seasonal workers, reduces tax and premium revenue, distorts competition, encourages overtime, and whether unions were consulted. The minister replied that the Tax Authority's explanation fits existing law, that no revenue is lost because an existing exemption is used, that competition and overtime incentives are not affected, and that consultation with unions was not needed.
This concerns an explanation that fits within the current legal framework and the Tax Authority's current policy.
Het gaat hier om een uitleg die past binnen de huidige wettelijke kaders en het huidige beleid van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over het bericht "kinderdagverblijven kampen met problemen door wanbetalende ouders"

An MP asked whether childcare centres face rising non-payment by parents, whether this is fraud, and what measures the government will take, including a blacklist and direct payment of childcare allowance to centres. The state secretary said non-payment is a matter between centres and parents, that no national figures on non-payers exist, that no government role is seen beyond possible direct payment arrangements being worked out with the sector.
Information on the development of the number of non-payers across all childcare institutions is not known.
Informatie over de ontwikkeling van het aantal wanbetalers voor het totale aantal kinderopvanginstellingen is niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over nieuwe berichten over «middeleeuwse belastingheffing»

MP Heijnen asked ministers about reports that municipalities such as Woerden may face the medieval 'dertiende penning' land levy, including whether it can be imposed at any time and on what legal basis. The government answered that Woerden had not yet received an assessment, that the right persists until 2015 under a 1984 law, that the state's own position is being examined with a commitment to inform parliament, and that the levy rests on a surviving medieval property right.
The position of the State is currently being mapped and it is being examined whether it is opportune for the State to exercise its rights, and if so how.
Momenteel wordt de positie van de Staat in kaart gebracht en wordt onderzocht of het opportuun is dat de Staat haar rechten zal effectueren
Antwoord vragen van het lid Braakhuis over de betrokkenheid van een Nederlands trustkantoor bij illegale houtkap

An MP asked the Finance ministry whether a Dutch trust office's involvement in illegal logging in Indonesia was adequately checked by DNB, including UBO transparency, consolidation duties, treaty misuse and substance requirements. The minister declined to discuss the individual case citing secrecy rules, explained DNB's supervisory scope and general legal framework, and said no change to the Civil Code was needed.
Due to statutory confidentiality obligations for the Tax Authority and De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB), I cannot simply go into the details of this individual case.
Door wettelijke geheimhoudingsverplichtingen voor de Belastingdienst en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) kan ik op de bijzonderheden van dit individuele geval niet zonder meer ingaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Monasch over het verschil in belastingdruk tussen bouwrijpe en braakliggende grond

MPs Groot and Monasch asked why selling a demolished building plot with foundations left attracts only 2% transfer tax while removing the foundations triggers 19% VAT, and whether this discourages greening vacant land and harms neighbourhood liveability. The State Secretary of Finance answered that VAT applies only to a building plot as defined under the VAT Act, that removing foundations does not create a building plot merely to make a garden or lawn, and that no liveability signals are known; he declined to change the law pending a Court of Justice ruling.
I do not intend to take legislative measures for the time being pending that ruling.
Ik ben niet voornemens om in afwachting daarvan thans wettelijke maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitgestelde visie over toezicht en verantwoording van goede doelen van SBF en regering

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the long-delayed vision on supervision and accountability of charities (goede doelen) had not appeared, how often consultations had taken place, when the mandatory publication bill for foundations and the ANBI disclosure motion would be implemented, and whether a bill had been scheduled for the Council of Ministers. The State Secretary answered that the vision was sent to parliament on 20 September 2012, the publication bill is nearing completion, ANBI data disclosure will be required from 2014 via a tax amendment, and declined to disclose Council of Ministers agenda matters while denying a leak.
Since the signing of the covenant 'Ruimte voor geven' on 21 June 2011, two regular administrative consultations have taken place in which the progress of the Vision was discussed among other things.
Sinds de ondertekening van het convenant «Ruimte voor geven» op 21 juni 2011 heeft tweemaal een regulier bestuurlijk overleg plaatsgevonden
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over problemen bij het zuiver aanvaarden van een nalatenschap

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked about heirs who unknowingly accepted an inheritance purely (zuiver) and so became liable for debts, including whether bank forms, emptying the estate and court fees trap heirs, and why minors are protected but not uninformed adults. The state secretary answered that heirs can get free public information and notary advice, that certain acts count as pure acceptance, that protecting minors reflects their inability to judge, and that beneficiary acceptance mostly causes unnecessary burdens, while promising only to consult the profession if a law change is considered.
I maintain my position that beneficiary acceptance will in most cases lead to unnecessary administrative burdens for citizens.
Ik blijf bij mijn standpunt dat beneficiaire aanvaarding in de meeste gevallen zal leiden tot onnodige administratieve lasten voor de burger.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over multidisciplinaire samenwerking in de zorg en btw-heffing

An SP MP asked whether VAT charged on support and coordination work by a multidisciplinary primary-care foundation is consistent with government goals of integrated care. The state secretary explained that such non-medical support and coordination services are not VAT-exempt, that the tax inspector decides case by case, and promised to examine with the health minister whether VAT rules for these services can be adjusted.

Given developments in cooperation in primary health care, I will, together with the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport and in consultation with the sector, examine whether there are possibilities to adjust the VAT levy on the services concerned.

Gelet op de ontwikkelingen op het terrein van samenwerking in de eerstelijnsgezondheidszorg zal ik, samen met de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en in overleg met de betrokken sector, bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn de btw-heffing ten aanzien van de in het geding zijnde diensten aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Braakhuis over belastingontduiking

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance about a report claiming superrich individuals hide large sums offshore, the role of Dutch private banks, country-by-country reporting, beneficial ownership registers, and substance rules for letterbox companies. The state secretary answered that the estimate is hard to verify, that Nederland fights tax fraud through information exchange and anti-avoidance rules, that no bank-specific conditions are planned, and that the substance concept has no separate legal meaning, while pointing to a forthcoming study.
As previously reported to the House of Representatives, this approach has so far yielded €430 million.
Zoals eerder aan de Tweede Kamer is gemeld, heeft deze aanpak tot dusver € 430 miljoen opgeleverd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de overeenstemming tussen de Verenigde Staten (VS) en de vijf grootste economieën van Europa om belastingontduiking tegen te gaan

An SP MP asked whether the US and five major European economies reached agreement against tax evasion and what Netherlands lost to evasion in 2011, and why the Netherlands has not signed. The state secretary explained the model FATCA-based bilateral agreement, said the revenue loss cannot be estimated, and said talks with the US will continue.
It is not possible to estimate the amount the Netherlands lost to tax evasion in 2011.
Het is niet mogelijk om een inschatting te geven van het bedrag dat Nederland in 2011 is misgelopen door belastingontduiking
Antwoord vragen van de leden Neppérus en Lodders over de vermindering van pensioenaanspraken van particuliere pensioen bv’s

MPs Neppérus and Lodders asked why directors-major shareholders of private pension BVs cannot reduce pension entitlements as pension funds can, and whether the Adviescommissie's advice to widen the tax rule was considered. The state secretary answered that the rules cannot be widened without disproportionate costs and that a limited one-off reduction at pension start will be proposed in the Belastingplan 2013.

I intend to include in the Belastingplan 2013 a proposal under which, in certain cases and under strict conditions, a one-off reduction of pension entitlements built up in own management can take place at the pension start date.

Ik ben voornemens in het Belastingplan 2013 een voorstel op te nemen op grond waarvan in bepaalde gevallen en onder strikte voorwaarden op pensioeningangsdatum (eenmalig) een vermindering van in eigen beheer opgebouwde pensioenaanspraken kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “Gebrekkige voorlichting strop voor mantelzorgers” en de uitzending over mantelzorgers en erfbelasting

MP Omtzigt asked whether the SVB and Tax Authority information on the higher inheritance tax exemption for informal carers (mantelzorgers) was adequate, why the carers' allowance is limited to extramural care, and whether those who cared intensively for parents with a nursing-home indication and applications without a form can be helped. The State Secretary said the SVB website was improved and a letter will mention the inheritance tax link, will look at clarifying Tax Authority wording, explained that the extramural-only criterion reflects budget and administrative limits, and said the SVB will be asked to add information on applications without a form.
I will ask the SVB to adapt the site on this point.
Ik zal de SVB verzoeken de site op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Groot en Wolbert over de verhoogde vrijstelling van de erfbelasting voor mantelzorgers

MPs Recourt, Groot and Wolbert asked whether carers can qualify for the raised inheritance tax exemption of 600,000 euro, what conditions apply, and whether citizens have been adequately informed. The state secretary confirmed the partner exemption conditions (including the carer allowance, cohabitation contract or five-year registration, and no other partner), said no specific agreements on information were made with parliament, and committed to working with Mezzo on improving information to carers.
The state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport will consult with Mezzo to examine whether information to carers on inheritance tax and the exemption could be further improved.
De staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zal in overleg met Mezzo bezien of zij de voorlichting aan mantelzorgers over erfbelasting en vrijstelling verder zouden kunnen verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over mogelijke belastingontwijking door NS

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether NS Financial Services Co, NS's financing subsidiary, is based in Dublin to avoid Dutch tax, and what the tax and dividend effects are. The government explains the Dublin location was chosen for lease-company investment conditions, declines to give individual tax figures citing secrecy rules, denies any effect on executive bonuses, and says Dutch tax is not earmarked for public transport.
The confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents disclosing information about individual taxpayers.
De geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen staat eraan in de weg informatie over individuele belastingplichtigen openbaar te maken.

Vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de gevolgen van nieuwe belastingregels op de economie van Saba

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about the effects of the new tax regime (ABB, flat tax, excise duties) on the economy of Saba and Sint Eustatius, including tax burden, prices, transport costs, Sint Maarten transit, and budget effects. The state secretary answered that the overall tax burden stayed roughly constant with a shift from direct to indirect taxes, that most households gained net income, and that no separate figures exist for several effects, while committing to talks with Sint Maarten on exemption of transit goods.
There are no figures known on the effect of the ABB on the government budget on Saba and Sint Eustatius.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het effect van de ABB op het overheidsbudget op Saba en Sint Eustatius.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over transparantie en publicatieplicht

MP Omtzigt asked whether a transparency bill for charities (ANBI register and publication duty) was pending before cabinet, whether consultation partners saw it, and when a joint transparency vision and bill would be ready. The state secretary refused to disclose cabinet deliberations, said consultation is standard and more time is needed for sector support, and confirmed the bill and full implementation of the motion will proceed.
Antwoord vragen Neppérus en Ten Broeke over belastingheffing bij Nederlanders door Duitsland over pensioenen

MPs Neppérus and Ten Broeke asked why Germany taxes Dutch pensions at what they reported as the top German rate, how many people are affected, and how to improve information and prevent such surprises. The State Secretary replied that the German tax follows a 2002 constitutional court ruling, that the applicable rate is often 14% rather than the top rate, that about 45,000 Dutch residents are affected, and that the Tax Administration will improve information and cooperate with Germany.
Yes, I believe there is room for improvement in the information provided to pensioners with a pension from abroad.
Ja, ik vind dat er verbetering te behalen is in de informatievoorziening aan gepensioneerden met een pensioen uit het buitenland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en van Bochove over het bericht dat het aantal mensen met een betalingsachterstand op de hypotheek de afgelopen vier jaar verdubbeld is

Two CDA MPs asked the government about the doubling of mortgage payment arrears, whether homeowners can rent out part of their home given bank consent and tenancy protection, whether students will face delays finding rooms, and whether a quick short-lease option could be introduced. The minister confirmed the arrears figure, explained that banks must be asked for consent and that the hospitality rule and the tax room-rental exemption already apply, and pointed to the national student housing action plan, without proposing new legislation.
In view of the above, I am of the opinion that measures are already in place, both on tenancy protection and tax legislation, that facilitate the renting of rooms.
Gezien het bovenstaande ben ik van mening dat al voorzien is in maatregelen zowel qua huurbescherming als qua belastingwetgeving die het verhuren van kamers faciliteren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling in de Successiewet 1956

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance about a Breda court ruling that the business-succession exemption in the Successiewet 1956 breaches the equality principle, its scope, its budget impact (around 1 billion euros), and whether the law will be amended. The secretary says the Tax Authority disagrees, will appeal, relies on a 2011 Supreme Court ruling, does not plan an amendment now, and expects the ruling not to stand.
In view of the Supreme Court ruling of 9 December 2011, I will not take the Breda District Court ruling as a guideline.
Gelet op het arrest van de Hoge Raad van 9 december 2011 zal ik de uitspraak van Rechtbank Breda niet als richtsnoer nemen.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het toegezegde maar nog steeds niet gerealiseerde ANBI-register

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance why the promised ANBI register, requested by a motion to publish organisation details, pay and accounts of charities, is still not realised, and why the SBF representativeness plan and joint oversight document have not been delivered. The state secretary answers that the SBF is responsible for its representativeness plan, that consultations with the Justice ministry on a joint vision on oversight and transparency are ongoing, and that the government does not intend to abandon openness, with results expected shortly after the summer.
Once the consultation is concluded, you will be informed further.
Zodra het overleg is afgerond, wordt u nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koser Kaya over de aanhoudende problemen met koopkracht en belastingdruk op de BES-eilanden

Two D66 MPs asked about the state of the interdepartmental studies on purchasing power, inflation, tax revenue and poverty in Caribbean Netherlands, and about a double-taxation problem with Sint Maarten. The government answered that the Ecorys purchasing-power study and the poverty exploration were completed and sent to parliament in June 2012, that a first revenue estimate was requested, and that talks with Sint Maarten on double indirect taxation were constructive.
Only in autumn 2012 will definitive clarity on the revenue of the new tax system be possible.
Pas in het najaar van 2012 zal definitieve duidelijkheid over de opbrengst van het nieuwe belastingstelsel kunnen worden gegeven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groot over de berichtgeving over een eventuele verhoging van de kilometervergoeding

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance whether he knew of reports on raising the mileage allowance from 19 to 24 cents per km, what the budget effect would be, and whether he would seriously consider the ANWB's smart travel budget alternative. The state secretary confirmed awareness, stated a 5-cent increase would cost about 500 million euro in forgone revenue, and said he was positive about B50 plans but that the budget agreement now puts the emphasis on fiscal consolidation.
A rise in the tax-free mileage allowance of 5 cents results in a budgetary loss of about 500 million.
Een stijging van de onbelaste kilometervergoeding met 5 cent heeft een budgettaire derving van circa 500 miljoen als gevolg.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Bochove over de erfbelasting over een niet verkochte woning

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about inheritance tax problems for heirs who cannot sell an inherited house and lack liquid funds to pay. The government answered that about 528 deferral requests were received in early 2012, that deferrals are granted case by case under existing policy, that no new rules are planned, and it referred heirs to notaries for advice on accepting an inheritance with benefit of inventory.
It is therefore not necessary to take further measures and make it possible, as the questioners propose, to grant up to two years of deferral (on top of the standard year).
Het is derhalve niet nodig om nadere maatregelen te treffen en het mogelijk te maken, zoals vraagstellers voorstellen, om maximaal twee jaar uitstel (bovenop het standaard jaar) voor te schrijven.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het bericht “Achterstand bij verwerking rekeningnummers”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a backlog in processing changed bank account numbers for allowances, affecting about 24,000 applicants, and about how affected people are informed, how to stop payments, liability for misdirected childcare allowance, and overdue objections. The State Secretary confirmed the notice was published with his approval, explained the backlog was a partly manual processing error, and said letters were sent and processing was underway, while giving figures on overdue objections but declining to inform the House fully within a week.
I would like to receive the case so that I can have it investigated.
Graag ontvang ik de casus zodat ik die kan laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over weekenduitgaven voor gehandicapten

MP Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Finance why the tax deduction for weekend care costs of disabled people is conditional on the disabled person's own income and assets, and what legal basis and thresholds apply. The state secretary cited the legal basis in the income tax act, explained the two requirements (costs borne by the taxpayer and a reasonable sense of obligation), said no fixed income or asset threshold applies, and promised to amend the Belastingdienst website text.
Antwoord vragen Braakhuis en El Fassed over het bericht dat Apple belasting ontwijkt via Nederland

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a New York Times report that Apple avoids taxes via the Netherlands, including whether the 'Double Irish with a Dutch sandwich' route is used by hundreds of firms and whether Dutch profits pass tax-free. The State Secretary answered that the term has no legal definition, that Dutch entities mainly earn and pay royalties subject to Dutch corporate tax, that the number of firms using such structures is not relevant, and that he sees no reason to change the Dutch reputation or substance research approach beyond the ongoing substance study.
