I note that the margin between royalties received and paid in the Netherlands is fully subject to corporate income tax, and that the size of that margin must be in line with the activities performed in the Netherlands.

Ik merk hierbij op dat de marge tussen in Nederland ontvangen en betaalde royalty gewoon met vennootschapsbelasting belast is en dat de hoogte van die marge in overeenstemming moet zijn met de in Nederland verrichte werkzaamheden.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen over belastingvrije donaties aan sekten.

Berndsen (D66) asked the State Secretaries of Finance and of Security and Justice whether sects can qualify as ANBI charities, whether Scientology is benefiting via a side route after a court ruling, and whether ANBI fraud or money laundering occurs. State Secretary Weekers answered that a sect has no clear legal meaning, that improper use of ANBI status is unacceptable and can lead to retroactive revocation after an Tax Authority investigation, and that no ANBI fraud cases are currently under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service.
The statutory duty of confidentiality does not allow me to address facts or assumptions concerning individual institutions.
De wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht staat mij niet toe in te gaan op feiten of veronderstellingen ten aanzien van individuele instellingen.
Antwoord vragen De Caluwé en Haverkamp over Vliegveld Valkenburg

MPs De Caluwé and Haverkamp asked about the redevelopment of former Valkenburg airfield, the early end of recreational flying there, and alternatives such as a glider airfield. The state secretary answered that accommodating general aviation is primarily a provincial and municipal responsibility, that the RVOB needs the site cleared for preparatory work in 2012, and that the province is still looking for an alternative location.
The accommodation of General Aviation (GA) is a shared responsibility of the national government and the province.
De accommodatie van General Aviation (GA) is een gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid van het Rijk en de Provincie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de gevolgen van het fiscaal partnerbegrip voor mantelzorgverleners

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether adult children who take a parent into the home for care are treated as fiscal partners inconsistently, and whether this penalises them. The State Secretary replied that partner criteria are objective, that the penalty framing is wrong since it reflects household capacity, and that reinstating an option for unmarried cohabitants is not planned.
I am not in favour of reintroducing this for a specific category, in which there are moreover no undesirable effects.
Ik voel er niet voor om deze te herintroduceren voor een specifieke categorie, waarin bovendien geen sprake is van ongewenste gevolgen.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over de vrijwilligersvergoeding

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether tax objections against volunteer-allowance deductions rejected for lack of liquidity should be granted ex officio after a court ruling favouring deductibility, and how affected taxpayers would be informed of further options. The State Secretary answered that he disagrees with the court ruling, will not grant the objections ex officio, and maintains that deductibility depends on the ANBI's ability to pay.
I expressly maintain my policy pursued until now.
Ik houd uitdrukkelijk vast aan mijn tot op heden gevoerde beleid.
Antwoord vragen Schouw en Koolmees over het doorgeven van van Europese data aan de Verenigde Staten

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked about the Netherlands joining a US-G5 government-to-government approach to FATCA, its data-protection implications for EU data sent to US authorities, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary answered that the joint statement is a non-binding intention, that the Commission is studying the data-protection issues, that no Dutch cases of forced US data disclosure are known, and that the matter is for the Commission and member states to resolve.
The Netherlands has declared its willingness to join the statement of intent for this government-to-government approach.
Nederland heeft zich bereid verklaard om aan te sluiten bij de intentieverklaring voor deze »government to government approach».
Antwoord vragen Neppérus over de artikelen 'VS jagen in Europa op zwart geld' en 'Kamer verrast over coöperatie met VS'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports on US pressure on European banks under FATCA and on Dutch cooperation with the US on tax information exchange, including privacy safeguards, bank obligations, and sanctions. The government answered that it is open to a G5-style intergovernmental agreement with automatic reciprocal exchange, that privacy safeguards are a starting point, and that the 'passthru payment' example in the press is not a valid illustration.

In the decision-making on the Dutch position on the joint statement, the starting point has always been that providing information to the US via the government must be in line with privacy protection safeguards.

In de besluitvorming rondom de Nederlandse positie over de «joint statement» is altijd het uitgangspunt geweest dat informatieverstrekking aan de VS via de overheid in lijn moet zijn met de waarborgen van bescherming van de privacy.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Groot over het bericht in de Volkskrant over de vrije val van de huizenverkoop

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of the Interior and the State Secretary for Finance about a newspaper report of a sharp fall in home sales in February 2012 and why the Dutch housing market is weaker than neighbouring countries. The minister answered that the drop is partly overstated when compared with recent months, attributed the decline to market dynamics and the economic situation, and listed measures the cabinet has already taken to support the housing market.
This cabinet has taken various measures to give a targeted boost to confidence in the housing market and to remove obstacles to transactions.
Er zijn door dit kabinet verschillende maatregelen genomen om het vertrouwen op de woningmarkt een gerichte impuls te geven en belemmeringen voor transacties weg te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over de verkoop van Holland Casino

An MP asked the state secretaries of Finance and Justice about the possible privatisation of Holland Casino, whether it could become an entertainment company, and reports of foreign interest. The government answered that no concrete privatisation proposal exists yet, that any sale will be considered within the broader reform of the gambling market, and that it cannot yet give meaningful answers on sale methods or buyers.
There is therefore currently no concrete proposal for privatisation.
Een concreet voorstel tot privatisering is er nu derhalve niet.
Antwoord vragen Groot over de belastingopbrengsten op de BES eilanden

MP Groot asks whether the Finance Ministry refused to give BES island representatives information on expected tax revenue and what revenues were in 2009-2011 and the target yield. The state secretary replies that 2011 figures are not yet available, estimates a 50-65 million USD range, and explains the tax differences between the islands.
The requested information on the 2011 yield of national taxes in the Caribbean Netherlands is not yet available.
De gevraagde informatie over de opbrengst over het jaar 2011 van de rijksbelastingen op Caribisch Nederland is nog niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen Van Vliet over het jaarlijks mislopen van 2 miljard aan belastinginkomsten

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about roughly 2 billion euro in tax revenue lost each year, citing a union report on the Tax Administration's collection and write-offs, and about overlapping collection agencies. The government answers that write-offs were about 1.8 billion in 2011 (mostly unrecoverable debts), that open debts of 4.4 billion are not all uncollectable, and that it is studying collection pilots and consolidation without committing to a specific structural change.
Nevertheless I consider this share too high and I have asked the Tax Administration to come up with plans to reduce it.
Toch vind ik dit deel te hoog en ik heb de Belastingdienst gevraagd met plannen te komen om dit omlaag te brengen.
Antwoord vragen Neppérus over het artikel “Leaserijder ontloopt hogere bijtelling”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a reported leasing scheme that lets drivers order new cars before the transitional deadline to keep the older, lower company-car tax rules for 60 months, and whether this causes lost tax revenue and what will be done. The State Secretary said the scheme goes beyond the intended transitional law, that the scale is unknown, and that additional legislation in the Belastingplan 2013 is planned if the scheme is widely used.
I have always assumed that this transitional law also fully matches the wishes of the car leasing industry.
Ik ben er altijd van uitgegaan dat dit overgangsrecht ook volledig aansluit bij de wensen van de autoleasebranche.
Antwoord vragen Groot over de alleenstaande ouderenkorting

An MP asked whether two fiscal partners living apart, both receiving the single-person AOW pension, are each entitled to the single elderly tax credit, including for part of the year and in the digital tax return. The state secretary confirmed entitlement in full, said the credit is granted automatically by the tax authority from SVB data, and that the 2012 return program will be adjusted.
They will automatically be granted the single elderly tax credit in their 2011 assessment.
Zij zullen de alleenstaande ouderenkorting in hun aanslag over 2011 automatisch toegekend krijgen.
Antwoord vragen Neppérus over “de problemen bij KPN bij ingebruikname van het BAPI-certificaat”.

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about problems at KPN with the rollout of the replacement BAPI certificate after the DigiNotar incident, including security, delays for businesses filing tax returns, the selection of KPN without tender, and whether other suppliers will be added. The State Secretary answers that security was never compromised, the migration deadline is 1 June 2012 (possibly extended), a coulance scheme is offered for late filers, KPN was chosen as the only ready party without a tender obligation, and two other suppliers are in talks but no alternatives are yet in place.
However, security has never been at stake.
De veiligheid is echter nimmer in het geding geweest.
Antwoord vragen Groot over de belastingheffing over de opbrengst van een appartementencomplex

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling that taxed rental income from an apartment complex in Box 3 rather than Box 1, and about its budgetary effects. The State Secretary replied that the ruling turned on its specific facts within existing Supreme Court criteria, is under appeal, has no budgetary consequences, and that no further measures are warranted.
Decisions like this one, which involve no changed assessment criteria and are strongly casuistic in nature, have no budgetary consequences.
Beslissingen als de onderhavige waarin geen veranderde beoordelingscriteria aan de orde zijn en die sterk casuïstisch getint zijn, hebben geen budgettaire gevolgen.
Antwoord vragen Bashir en Paulus Jansen over de fiscale behandeling van waterwoningen

MPs Bashir and Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance how the Supreme Court ruling on floating houses (waterwoningen) affects transfer tax, mortgage interest relief, the eigenwoningforfait, municipal property tax and box 3 wealth tax, with worked examples, numbers and a plan to remove the unequal treatment. The State Secretary answered that floating homes classed as movable goods fall outside transfer tax and box 3 while the ruling leaves the owner-occupier rules intact, that the number and revenue effect are highly uncertain (a few hundred homes, a few million euros a year), and that he will examine options to remove the difference, reporting by the Belastingplan 2013.
I am not prepared to accept this difference in advance.
Ik ben niet bereid dit verschil op voorhand te accepteren.

Antwoord vragen Arib en Groot over het bericht dat de fiscus belasting heft over smartengeld van slachtoffers uit de Tweede Wereldoorlog en mogelijk ook over vergoedingen voor slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik binnen de

MPs Arib and Groot asked whether tax is levied on compensation paid to Second World War victims and to victims of abuse in the Catholic Church, and how such payments affect benefit entitlements. The government answered that periodic Artikel 2 Fonds payments are taxable income, that lump-sum church compensation is not income for tax purposes but counts as assets, and that municipalities decide on benefit means-testing, with a planned exemption under review.
I have decided together with the relevant fellow ministers to take measures so that the one-off payments from the Roman Catholic Church at issue are included in this regulation.

Ik heb met de betrokken collega-bewindslieden besloten om maatregelen te treffen waardoor de hier aan de orde zijnde eenmalige uitkeringen van de Rooms-Katholieke Kerk in deze regeling worden opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Lodders over het bericht dat door de lage rente werknemers te maken kunnen krijgen met grote kortingen van hun pensioen

Lodders (VVD) asked the ministers whether low interest rates cause large pension cuts for workers with defined-contribution schemes, and whether the pension 'knip' or its extension could help. Minister Kamp answered that payouts depend on market rates at purchase, that about 626,000 participants hold such schemes with only tens of thousands likely affected per year, and that he sees no need to extend the temporary knip now but will review it in 2013.
I am willing to review in the course of 2013 whether the transitional period bridged by the temporary scheme requires extension
Ik ben bereid om in de loop van 2013 te bezien of de overgangsperiode die met de tijdelijke regeling wordt overbrugd, verlenging behoeft
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over het sluiten van diverse belastingkantoren

An MP asked why the Tax Administration offices in Emmen, Helmond and Heerenveen are being closed, why this was not discussed with parliament first, and what the job losses and dismissal risks are. The minister replied that no final decisions on Emmen have been taken, the Helmond and Heerenveen leases were terminated for efficiency reasons, and the office location policy is indicative and will be worked out in provincial masterplans, with no forced dismissals intended.
It is not customary to share housing changes with the House first.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om huisvestingsveranderingen eerst met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord vragen Groot inzake de sleuteltabel 2012

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance for the budgetary yields and costs of many tax changes and asked for the Sleuteltabel 2012 to be sent to parliament early. The government sent the key table of indicative budgetary effects and referred the detailed questions 2 to 75 to that table.
Answer 1 Yes, see below the SLEUTEL TABEL 2012 level 2011 as of 2012
Antwoord 1 Ja, zie onderstaand SLEUTEL TABEL 2012 niveau 2011 per 2012
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Braakhuis over het bericht: “Facebook geen vriend meer van de fiscus”

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that multinationals such as Facebook use aggressive tax structures (double Irish, Dutch sandwich) and virtual office rentals, and whether these are legal, whether Netherlands' role as conduit country is risky, what taxing interest and royalties would yield, and whether requiring employees for treaty benefits is required. The State Secretary answers that all structures are legal, declines to launch an investigation into their use, says the terms are undefined, says a substance inquiry will follow before summer, and notes that employee requirements are part of that pending substance study.
I have previously described the structures that are generally meant.
Ik heb al eerder 2 beschreven op welke structuren in het algemeen wordt gedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Smilde over het vertrek van de belastingdienst uit Emmen

MPs Wolbert and Smilde asked whether the Tax Authority's departure from Emmen, costing about 300 jobs, had been weighed against regional employment and service to citizens. The minister replied that no decisions on relocation have been taken, that the regional impact will be assessed in the Drenthe office masterplan with the province, and that savings phase in through 2020.
Antwoord vragen Braakhuis over het bericht dat grote bedrijven in Zuid Europa de fiscus ontwijken via Nederland

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether large companies in Portugal, Italy, Greece and Spain route over 60% of their internal money flows via the Netherlands, whether this lowers their tax burden, and whether the government will act. The State Secretary could not confirm the figures, said the Netherlands aims to keep an attractive investment climate with a reputation for tax integrity, and saw no clear link between Dutch tax policy and deficits in those countries.
I cannot confirm those figures. I have no insight into the total worldwide money flows of large companies, nor into the turnover of Greek and Portuguese companies.
Ik kan die cijfers niet bevestigen. Ik heb geen inzicht in de totale wereldwijde geldstromen van grote bedrijven, noch in de omzet van Griekse en Portugese bedrijven.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het betalen van toon- en tipgeld

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the policy on paying tip money (toon- en tipgeld), including a court ruling requiring disclosure of a tipster agreement, payments since 2010, and instructions to staff. The State Secretary answered that a court ruling allowed a summary instead of full disclosure, that no new tip payments have been made, that the Tax Administration takes a restrictive approach, and that the Justice ministry was willing to publish the Bijzondere Opsporingsgelden regulation.
The Tax Administration chose this option when executing the ruling.
De Belastingdienst heeft bij het uitvoeren van de uitspraak voor deze mogelijkheid gekozen.
Antwoord vragen Groot over de behandeling van bezwaarschriften door de Belastingdienst

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about an internal Tax Administration proposal to approve objections unseen, the backlog of 61,000 income-tax objections, handling capacity and timeliness. The State Secretary confirmed the proposal existed but was not adopted, attributed the backlog to the Tijdige Aangifte campaign, ex officio assessments and stricter penalties, and said the peak should be cleared by 1 September, while stating cuts will not compromise rights enforcement.
This proposal has not been adopted.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over de voortvarendheid waarmee de Belastingdienst huiseigenaren van dienst is bij het achterhalen van de hoogte van het inkomen van achteloze huurders

MPs Monasch and Groot asked whether the Tax Authority's web tool letting landlords check whether a household's income exceeds 43,000 euro is lawful and privacy-compliant, and what safeguards and enforcement exist against misuse. The minister answered that a temporary exemption from tax secrecy covers the tool, that landlords can only query their own properties and must accept usage terms, and that misuse is unlawful and subject to civil, data-protection and criminal sanctions.
Landlords may only request the information for that purpose.
Verhuurders mogen de informatie alleen maar voor dat doel opvragen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent, Bosman, van Bochove, van Raak, Recourt, Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de ticketprijzen van vliegtarieven van en naar Nederland vanaf Caribische eilanden

MPs asked why airfares from Dutch Caribbean islands to the Netherlands differ despite similar distances, how taxes apply to flights within the Kingdom, and whether the minister would discuss fares with airlines. The government answered that airlines set fares commercially under the new Kingdom aviation protocol, that intra-Kingdom flights are not subject to turnover tax, and that the aviation authorities intervene only for extremely high or low fares.
Antwoord vragen Bashir, Gesthuizen en Irrgang inzake het toezicht op goede doelen

MPs Bashir, Gesthuizen and Irrgang (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about supervision of charities after a VPRO programme found many ANBI-listed organisations did not meet the listing conditions, including missing policy plans and governance requirements. The State Secretary declined to assess the CIGD study because only an anonymised extract was provided, described the Tax Authority's supervision and revocation powers, and said legislation requiring ANBIs to publish balance sheets is being prepared for submission before summer.
If it turns out that an institution does not meet one or more conditions, the Tax Authority can ask the institution's board to remedy the omissions within a reasonable period.

Indien mocht blijken dat een instelling niet voldoet aan één of meer voorwaarden, dan kan de Belastingdienst het bestuur van een instelling verzoeken om binnen een redelijke termijn de omissies te herstellen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over de contracten van subcontractors die werken voor Post NL

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries about a Zembla broadcast on subcontracted parcel couriers working for PostNL, including whether their contracts amount to disguised employment and whether the tax authority agreed special arrangements. The government answered that the contracts are free commercial arrangements, that employment status depends on the facts and can be tested by the Tax Authority or courts, and that it cannot disclose any Tax Authority agreements with specific taxpayers due to confidentiality rules.
However, no information can be provided about any agreements with specific taxpayers.
Over eventuele afspraken met specifieke belastingplichtigen kan echter geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord vragen Koolmees en Verhoeven over het voorstel tot een ‘Slim Reisbudget’ vanuit 50 grote werkgevers

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the B50 proposals for a 'Smart Travel Budget' (Persoonlijk Mobiliteitsbudget and Bonus Malus Leasebudget), including whether the government would assess them, how they relate to the Autobrief tax study, and the expected effects on traffic and emissions. The State Secretary responded positively in principle, promised to test budget neutrality and administrative costs and to report on the proposals before the summer recess, while stating that effects depend on how employers and employees implement them.
I previously committed to sending the results of that study to your House before the summer recess.
Ik heb eerder toegezegd de resultaten van dat onderzoek voor het zomerreces aan uw Kamer te zullen toezenden.

Antwoord vragen Van der Burg en De Boer over het bericht van het CBS dat in 2012 de opbrengst uit heffingen van lokale overheden met 3,2 procent stijgt en de Onroerende Zaakbelasting (OZB) de macronorm fors lijkt te over

Two VVD MPs asked whether CBS figures showing a 3.2 percent rise in local levies and a likely overshoot of the 3.75 percent OZB macro-norm for 2012 are reliable, and what the government will do. The minister answered that the figures are preliminary, that final CBS data are due in March, that a joint analysis with the VNG will follow, and that a proportional deduction from the Gemeentefonds is possible if the norm is exceeded.
When the final figures are known in March, we as fund managers, together with the VNG, will make an analysis of the development of the OZB in 2012.
Als de definitieve cijfers in maart bekend zijn zullen wij als fondsbeheerders, samen met de VNG, een analyse maken van de ontwikkeling van de OZB in 2012.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de intrekking van de btw-vrijstelling voor steunstichtingen van sportverenigingen en van wereldwinkels

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked the state secretary of Finance about withdrawing the VAT exemption for fundraising by support foundations of sports clubs and by fair-trade shops, and about its consequences and EU compliance. The state secretary confirmed the withdrawal as required by the EU VAT Directive, with a transitional arrangement until 1 July 2012, and said the existing exemption for certain associations was preserved through a statutory change.
By withdrawing the contested policy decision, Dutch regulations have been brought into line with the VAT Directive.
Door middel van intrekking van het gewraakte beleidsbesluit is de Nederlandse regelgeving in overeenstemming gebracht met de btw-richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Ministeriele regeling bij de Geefwet

An MP asks the State Secretary for Finance about the pending ministerial regulation implementing the Geefwet, including the conditions for support foundations (steunstichtingen SBBI), the timing of publication, the ANBI status of Haagse venues such as Nieuwspoort and De Witte, and the forthcoming Uitvoeringsregeling on commercial activities. The State Secretary answers that consultations are ongoing, the draft will be submitted to both chambers at least four weeks before adoption, publication will follow as soon as possible, and no foundation can yet use the tax deduction.
The draft of the ministerial regulation will also be submitted to several representatives of tax advisers.
Het concept van de ministeriële regeling zal ook worden voorgelegd aan enkele vertegenwoordigers van belastingadviseurs
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht in de pers: De «Dutch pita»: Grieks geld in Holland (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

MP Braakhuis asked the state secretary of Finance about a press report that the Netherlands helps Greek multinationals avoid tax through 'Dutch sandwich' structures, and whether a Greek gold mine's Dutch cooperative still qualifies for dividend-tax exemption. The state secretary rejected the suggestion that the Netherlands facilitates Greek tax avoidance, promised a report on substance requirements before the summer recess, and declined to comment on the individual case under tax confidentiality rules while describing the new cooperative anti-abuse rule in general terms.
As is known, on the basis of article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot provide information on individual taxpayers.
Zoals bekend kan ik op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen geen informatie geven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Vragen van de leden Groot, Monasch (beiden PvdA) en Koolmees (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financien over de fiscale behandeling van transformatie van kantoorpanden (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Groot, Monasch and Koolmees asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax obstacles to converting office buildings into housing, including double VAT, the transfer-tax exemption period and WOZ valuation. The State Secretary rejected changes to VAT integration levy, transfer tax and other fiscal incentives, citing budgetary, EU and simplicity considerations, and gave no commitment to action.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daar ben ik niet toe bereid.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de erfbelasting over een niet verkochte woning (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Van Bochove asked whether heirs struggle to pay inheritance tax when an unsold house is the main asset, and whether payment deferral should be temporarily extended. The state secretary replied that the Tax Administration reports no such problems, points to its generous deferral practice, and sees no reason to widen the deferral rule.

In response to your question whether I am aware of signals from practice that many taxpayers have problems paying inheritance tax when the estate consists of a house that cannot be sold quickly enough, I can inform you, based on information from the Tax Administration, that such problems do not exist at all.

1 Antwoord 1 Naar aanleiding van uw vraag of mij uit de praktijk signalen bekend zijn dat veel belastingplichtigen problemen hebben om de erfbelasting te betalen als de nalatenschap uit een woning bestaat en deze woning niet snel genoeg verkocht kan worden, nu de verkooptijd is opgelopen tot 23 maanden, kan ik u op grond van informatie van de Belastingdienst meedelen dat bedoelde problemen hoegenaamd niet bestaan.

Vragen van de leden Groot en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht dat Nederland € 1 miljard aan inkomsten van Zwitserse bankrekeningen misloopt (ingezonden 7 december

Labour MPs Groot and Plasterk asked whether a Swiss deal like those with Germany and the UK could yield about €1 billion one-off, and whether the government will pursue one. The state secretary answered that the amount seems unrealistic, that such deals keep bank secrecy and conflict with automatic information exchange, and that the government is exploring the figures and conditions with Switzerland.
The Netherlands has therefore entered into consultation with Switzerland to explore which amounts could be involved and under which conditions an agreement could be concluded.
Nederland is daarom in overleg met Zwitserland getreden om te inventariseren over welke bedragen het zou kunnen gaan en onder welke condities een akkoord zou kunnen worden gesloten.
Vragen van het lid Van Vliet (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de onbelaste kilometervergoeding (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether scenarios for lowering the tax-free kilometre allowance were being calculated, whether employees would lose money, and whether the government would rule out touching the allowance. The State Secretary confirmed an exploration with the transport minister is ongoing, could not yet quantify effects or answer on public transport, electric cars and bicycles, and said the allowance is a cost reimbursement, not in-kind income.
That exploration is currently under way. On earlier occasions I promised the House that I would send the results of that exploration to the House before the summer recess.
Die verkenning vindt momenteel plaats. Bij eerdere gelegenheden heb ik de Kamer toegezegd de resultaten van die verkenning voor het zomerreces aan de Kamer te zullen zenden.
Vragen van het lid Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financien over het BTW-nummer voor een eenmanszaak dat gelijk is aan het burgerservicenummer (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why a sole proprietor's VAT number equals their citizen service number (BSN), which must appear on invoices, and what safeguards exist against identity fraude. The State Secretary confirmed the link, explained that the sofinummer was chosen as a neutral number, and argued that the BSN carries no rights or obligations so no problems are foreseen, while noting that the BSN is meant to fight identity fraud.
Given the fact that a citizen service number grants no right and imposes no obligation, I foresee no problems.
Gegeven het feit dat een burgerservicenummer geen enkel recht geeft, noch een plicht oplegt, voorzie ik geen problemen.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de erfbelasting over een niet verkochte woning (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

CDA MPs Omtzigt and Van Bochove asked the State Secretary of Finance whether he knows that heirs struggle to pay inheritance tax when an inherited house cannot be sold quickly, and whether the Tax Authority should grant flexible payment deferral and whether the deferral scheme for bare ownership of a house should be temporarily extended to estates largely consisting of unsold homes. The State Secretary's reply in this item is only a request for extension of the answer deadline citing consultation with the Tax Authority, so no substantive answer is given.
I hereby request an extension until 27 January 2012 for answering the questions
Hierbij verzoek ik u uitstel te verlenen tot 27 januari 2012 voor de beantwoording van de vragen

Vragen van de leden Groot en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Financiën en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over problemen met het verrekenen van inkomsten uit werk bij mensen in de WWB en het ove

Two MPs asked the state secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs about problems with offsetting work income against WWB benefits and the Tax Authority rejecting corrected annual statements, causing later assessments for beneficiaries. The state secretary answered that offsetting is a regular, legally provided process, that no signals of frequent problems are known, and that guidance for municipalities was issued in 2010.
On this point too there are no signals that people often receive reassessments because the Tax Authority does not accept corrected annual statements.
Ook op dit punt zijn er geen signalen dat mensen vaak navorderingen krijgen doordat de Belastingdienst aangepaste jaaropgaven niet accepteert.
Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het opeens stopzetten van toeslagen (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

SP MPs asked the state secretary of Finance why the Tax Service sent letters around 20 December 2011 stopping rent and healthcare allowances from 1 January 2012, when many recipients may still be entitled, and asked about reachability and urgent payments. The secretary answered that about 48,000 rent-allowance and 120,000 healthcare-allowance letters were sent, that around 600 people were wrongly stopped due to residence-status data and would be paid from 20 January 2012, and that the Tax Service would proactively contact people facing acute financial problems.
However, something went wrong this year with a group of about 600 allowance recipients.
Evenwel is er dit jaar iets niet goed gegaan met een groep van ongeveer 600 toeslaggerechtigden.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Groot (PvdA) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de vermogenstoets in de huurtoeslag voor 2012 (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Omtzigt, Groot and Braakhuis asked whether households with children who exceed the wealth test on 1 January 2012 could lose all their 2012 rent allowance, and why the lowered wealth test was not announced clearly. The state secretary answered that the lowered test applies by law, that the tax authority informed beneficiaries via a press release, a website notice and intermediaries, and that this was considered sufficient outreach.

Furthermore, intermediaries (e.g. housing corporations, social counsellors and municipalities) have been informed about the abolition of the child allowance in the box 3 tax-free allowance, so they can inform their clients.

Verder zijn de intermediairs (o.a. woningbouwcorporaties, sociale raadslieden en gemeenten) geïnformeerd over de afschaffen van de kindertoeslag van het heffingsvrije vermogen in box 3, zodat zij hun klanten hierover kunnen informeren.

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de problemen van dwangarbeiders met de Duitse Belastingdienst en geëmigreerde gepensioneerde

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance and the minister of Social Affairs about German tax claims on pensions earned by former forced labourers and the double taxation of emigrated Dutch ABP pensioners, including Belgian assessments and whether Germany would exempt forced labourers. The state secretary answered that German law now exempts pensions of persecuted forced labourers, that the Dutch government monitors its application, and that a structural bilateral solution on ABP pensions has been reached.
Moreover, it has been made clear that the exemption is applied pragmatically.
Bovendien is duidelijk gemaakt dat met de vrijstelling pragmatisch wordt omgegaan.
Vragen van het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de brief van bureau DUDOK aan de Eerste Kamer (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance about a letter from a building-law firm to the Senate on the corporate tax exemption for care housing associations, including whether the tax liability can be postponed and whether the exemption's removal conflicts with a parliamentary motion. The state secretary replies that the exemption was never legally repealed but ended by policy under a 2009 decision, that a generous transition period was observed, that re-introduction would likely be illegal state aid, and that no further postponement will be granted, though a closing-balance agreement is offered.
I therefore see no reason, nor possibility, to give these corporations another year of respite.
Ik zie daarom geen reden, noch mogelijkheid, om deze corporaties nogmaals een jaar respijt te geven.

Vragen van de leden Verhoeven (D66) en Hachchi (D66) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over lastenverhogingen voor ondernemers als gevolg van Digin

MPs Verhoeven and Hachchi asked whether the Tax Authority's switch to a new certificate supplier after the DigiNotar breach raised costs for businesses and whether SMS authentication would be scrapped. The government answered that the new KPN/Getronics certificates cost the same as the old DigiNotar price, so there is no increase in costs, and that the SMS authentication question rests on a misunderstanding.
So there is no increase in costs or administrative burden.
Er is dus geen sprake van verhoging van kosten en administratieve lasten.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen over de zoektocht van de fiscus naar zwartspaarders (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

Bashir (SP) asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the investigation into black-money holders is finished, whether account holders on the CD-rom were notified and whether they can still make a voluntary disclosure, and when the tax service learned that trusts and foreign foundations were being dismantled and emptied before the new anti-avoidance law took effect. Weekers answers that the investigation is still ongoing with 72 cases closed (18 with assessments totalling EUR 1 million), that notified holders can no longer rely on the voluntary disclosure rule, that a project group has produced assessments of EUR 430 million, and that signals of dismantling began in November 2009.
Tracing the data obtained from the CD-rom back to identifiable data is, as expected, a complicated and time-consuming process.
Het herleiden van de via de CD rom verkregen gegevens tot identificeerbare gegevens is zoals verwacht een ingewikkeld en tijdrovend proces.

Vragen van de leden Groot en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Financiën en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over problemen met het verrekenen van inkomsten uit werk bij mensen in de WWB en het ove

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs about municipalities mishandling the offsetting of work income against WWB benefits, causing the Tax Administration to reject corrected annual statements and issue later reclaims, and asked what will be done. The government replied only that answering requires further interdepartmental coordination and cannot be done within the usual deadline.

Answering the questions of 18 November from MPs Groot and Spekman (both PvdA) on problems with offsetting work income for people under the WWB and the Tax Administration accepting corrected annual statements requires further interdepartmental coordination.

Het beantwoorden van de vragen van 18 november jl. van de leden Groot en Spekman (beiden PvdA) over problemen met het verrekenen van inkomsten uit werk bij mensen in de WWB en het overnemen van de gecorrigeerde jaaropgave door de Belastingdienst vereist nadere interdepartementale afstemming.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (Groenlinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over belastingontwijking via de deelnemingsvrijstelling (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance about the Piping Profits report on Dutch holding companies of mining firms, the participation exemption and tax treaties, corporate shareholder transparency (Trafigura's stake in Norilsk Nickel) and whether the exemption applies to such stakes. The state secretary disputes the report's ranking, defends the participation exemption as intended by the legislator, points to existing shareholder disclosure rules under the Wft, and confirms the exemption in principle covers gains on sale unless a non-qualifying low-taxed investment holding applies.
I cannot infer from that that the Netherlands (358) is the largest host country for holdings.
Ik kan daaruit niet afleiden dat Nederland (358) het grootste gastland is voor holdings.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht «Nederland belastingparadijs voor veel multinationals» (ingezonden 18 oktober 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that many FTSE 100 multinationals, and 1,330 subsidiaries in the Netherlands, use tax havens, and whether the Netherlands should tighten treaties and act on tax avoidance. The State Secretary answered that the study does not define its criteria, that the Netherlands is wrongly labelled a tax haven and meets OECD transparency and substance standards, that no grounds exist to scrutinise those entities or tighten treaties, and that the government supports capacity building in developing countries.
There are no indications that the 1,330 subsidiaries and joint ventures in question do not comply with the law, and I therefore have no reason to 'screen' them.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat de bedoelde 1 330 vennootschappen en joint ventures zich niet aan de wet houden en ik heb dan ook geen reden deze «door te lichten».
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over artikelen in het FD over belastingontwijking (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

A GroenLinks MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about Financial Dagblad articles on tax avoidance through cooperatives, dividend tax, financing firms and accountant-professor dual roles. The State Secretary answers that cooperatives are generally not subject to dividend withholding tax, that a 2012 anti-abuse measure is proposed, that substance requirements for financing entities are judged adequate, and that dual professorship-accountant roles are permissible under university codes.
However, I do not know how many cooperatives were part of an international structure.
Het is mij echter niet bekend hoeveel coöperaties deel uitmaakten van een internationale structuur.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Neppérus (VVD) en Groot (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht «E-aangifte ondernemers veilig ondanks DigiNotar-hack» (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

MPs Omtzigt, Neppérus and Groot asked the State Secretary of Finance whether e-filing by businesses remains secure after the DigiNotar certificate hack and whether continuity was agreed with stakeholders. The State Secretary confirmed the consultation outcome, declined to take steps raising business costs, and committed to phasing out certain BAPI and FOS channel options by 2013 with stakeholder dialogue.
The intention is to phase out BAPI-PIN after the replacement operation of BAPI certificates from DigiNotar with certificates from KPN/Getronics.
Het voornemen is BAPI-PIN uit te faseren na de vervangingsoperatie van BAPI-certificaten van Diginotar door certificaten van KPN/Getronics.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de erfbelasting (ingezonden 25 oktober 2011).

Deputy Omtzigt (CDA) asked the state secretary of Finance about how article 10 of the Successiewet 1956 applies when parents transfer a home to a child subject to a usufruct or rental arrangement, including buy-outs, rent levels and transitional rules. The state secretary answered in detail, confirming that article 10 applies where enjoyment continues until death within 180 days, that the 6% rent benchmark applies, and that transitional arrangement will cover situations arising from transfers before 1 January 2010, with a study of the percentage planned for 2012.
I do not intend to take an incidental measure regarding rent-lease situations in advance of this integral study.
Ik heb niet het voornemen om vooruitlopend op deze integrale studie een incidentele maatregel te treffen met betrekking tot huur-verhuursituaties.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris Financiën over de saldering van energiebelasting bij teruglevering van duurzaam opgewekte elektriciteit (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Finance about uncertainty over netting of energy tax for sustainably generated electricity fed back above 5,000 kWh per year, the cross-reference to a repealed article in the Energy Tax Act, the correct interpretation, control mechanisms and timing. The secretary answered that the law is clear, that the reference error will be corrected via the Fiscale verzamelwet 2011, that netting is limited by the tax on consumed electricity, and that the Tax Administration checks suppliers' declarations.
If this bill is enacted and enters into force, the incorrect reference will be corrected.
Als dit wetsvoorstel tot wet wordt verheven en in werking treedt, wordt de verkeerde verwijzing gecorrigeerd.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Neppérus (VVD), Van Vliet (PVV), Koolmees (D66), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het rechtstreeks overmaken van kinderopvang

Six MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance whether childcare allowance should be paid directly to childcare providers to prevent parental arrears, and whether a system with certified payee parties would be designed with stakeholders. The State Secretary said government should in principle not intervene, that a single bank account per taxpayer is planned with an exception for childcare centres under strict conditions, and that the Minister of Social Affairs will consult the sector and report to parliament.

As I indicated at the legislative consultation of 7 November regarding the Tax Package 2012, I will include an exception for childcare centres to the mandatory use of a single bank account via an amendment.

Zoals ik in het wetgevingsoverleg van 7 november jl. over het Belastingpakket 2012 heb aangegeven, zal ik bij nota van wijziging voor kindercentra een uitzondering op het verplicht gebruik van één rekeningnummer opnemen.
Vragen van de leden Groot en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de website zorgtoeslag.nl (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MPs Groot and Heijnen asked the State Secretary of Finance whether a commercial website charging fees for applying for healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag), which they say imitates the Tax Administration, should be tackled and whether a legal framework exists. The State Secretary replied that the site transparently discloses its paid services, that a legal framework exists where misleading, and that after legal analysis the site does not imitate the Tax Administration, while the operator agreed to make its commercial nature clearer on its homepage.
Moreover, JSKS has committed to adjust the homepage of their site so that it immediately becomes clear that it is a site of a commercial service provider.
Overigens is door JSKS toegezegd, dat zij de homepage van hun site zodanig zullen aanpassen dat al direct duidelijk wordt dat het om een site van een commerciële dienstverlener gaat.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen (PvdA), Koopmans (CDA), Van Raak (SP) en Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bemoeienis van het college van B e

MPs asked whether the Roermond municipal executive improperly interfered in the sale of a former prison and court complex, and whether the state lost money when a developer with a lower bid obtained it. The state secretary replied that the highest bidder won after a second round, the state suffered no financial loss, the municipality cancelled the planned meeting with bidders after objections, and the evaluation report by the RijksAuditdienst was attached.

Although I distance myself from the wording he chose in the article, a meeting at the time could have led to unclarity about the State's position as seller of the complex and the transparency of the sales process.

Hoewel ik afstand neem van diens gekozen bewoording in het artikel, had destijds een gesprek kunnen leiden tot onduidelijkheid over de positie van de Staat als verkoper van het complex en de transparantie van het verkoopproces.

Vragen van de leden Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Van Vliet (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het gebruik van dienstauto’s door managers van de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

MPs Braakhuis and Van Vliet asked whether Tax Administration managers with homes far from The Hague are entitled to chauffeured company cars for commuting, and about the costs and justification. The state secretary confirmed that nine nationally active managers have chauffeured cars, that use is function-based and periodically reviewed, and that he considers the costs of about 797,000 euros for 2011 justified and will weigh the budget situation in future allocation decisions.
Use of a company car is function-based. Currently this concerns nine managers who have a car with a chauffeur.
Het gebruik van dienstauto is functiegebonden. Het gaat momenteel om negen managers die een auto met chauffeur hebben.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (Groenlinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over belastingontwijking via de deelnemingsvrijstelling (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance through the participation exemption, citing a PWYP report that the Netherlands hosts many mining holdings, and whether ownership of Trafigura's stake in Norilsk Nickel is transparent and taxable. The government replies only with a procedural notice that the answers cannot be given within three weeks because careful coordination is needed.
It has become apparent that a careful and consistent answering of the questions requires further coordination.
Het is gebleken dat een zorgvuldige en eensluidende beantwoording van de vragen nadere afstemming vergt.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht «Nederland belastingparadijs voor veel multinationals» (ingezonden 18 oktober 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance about an ActionAid study finding that most FTSE 100 multinationals use tax havens, with consequences for developing countries, and asked about Dutch treaties and scrutiny of Dutch subsidiaries. The government reply is only an interim notice that the answers need more time to be coordinated with related questions.
It has become apparent that a careful and consistent answer to the questions requires further coordination.
Het is gebleken dat een zorgvuldige en eensluidende beantwoording van de vragen nadere afstemming vergt.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht «Bemiddelaars in dubieuze leningen» (ingezonden 27 september 2011).

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether banks report mortgage interest, whether income data is monthly in the polisadministratie, whether fraud with provisional tax refunds is a priority, whether fake income can still obtain refunds without prior checks, whether FIOD investigates intermediaries, and whether charging fees for filing on others' behalf is punishable. Weekers answered that data is annual and not current for new buyers, that checks have been tightened with risk selection, that FIOD investigates on behalf of the Public Prosecution Service, and that no new rules for intermediaries are needed.
For that reason, oversight of this process has been considerably tightened.
Om die reden is het toezicht op dit proces aanzienlijk aangescherpt.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Schouten (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de positie van de woningcorporatie op Bonaire (

ChristenUnie MPs asked whether the turnover tax (ABB) and the introduction of the US dollar on Bonaire make social rents unaffordable for tenants of the local housing corporation, and whether the state will investigate or grant an exemption. The state secretary answered that the ABB is in principle more favourable than the former turnover tax, that no exemption is legally possible, that no separate study will be launched beyond an existing interdepartmental economic study, and that cost control is the corporation's responsibility.
I will not start a specific investigation into the impact of the ABB as such on the cost price of new-build homes.
Ik zal geen specifiek onderzoek starten naar de invloed van de ABB als zodanig op de kostprijs van nieuwbouwwoningen.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het artikel «De levensgenieter krijgt «levenslang» oftewel eens genoten altijd genoten» (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Ormel asked the State Secretary of Finance about a published critique of article 10 of the Successiewet 1956 (inheritance tax), including the lack of transitional law after withdrawal of the 1964 resolution, the 6% rent benchmark, and the consistency of Belastingdienst positions. The State Secretary defended the article's application, but agreed to introduce transitional rules for pre-2010 transfers and promised a review of the 6% percentage in 2012.
I will nonetheless introduce transitional rules for the withdrawal of the decision.
Zal ik alsnog overgangsrecht treffen voor de intrekking van het besluit.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over artikelen in het FD over belastingontwijking (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about press reports on tax avoidance through cooperatives, including dividend tax exemptions, trust offices, rulings, financing firms, substance requirements for special financial institutions, and dual roles of accountancy professors. The reply is only a notice that answers will be delayed because the questions require careful coordination.
It has become apparent that a careful and consistent answer to the questions requires further coordination.
Het is gebleken dat een zorgvuldige en eensluidende beantwoording van de vragen nadere afstemming vergt.
Vragen van de leden Groot en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de website zorgtoeslag.nl (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a private website charging fees for zorgtoeslag applications that the Tax Administration offers free, and whether it can be legally tackled and whether it misleadingly imitates the Belastingdienst. The document is a notice that the answers will be delayed until 3 November 2011, pending advice from the Landsadvocaat.
Given the advice from the Landsadvocaat that is needed, a careful answer to the questions within this period has not proven possible.
Gelet op het benodigde advies van de Landsadvocaat is een zorgvuldige beantwoording van de vragen binnen deze termijn niet mogelijk gebleken.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de gebruikelijke werkwijze bij het ontdekken en herstellen van fouten van het personeel bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen (ingezonden 23

An MP asked the state secretary how the Tax Administration's Toeslagen (benefits) unit handles staff errors, including whether staff must wait for a client to complain before correcting a wrongly stopped benefit. The state secretary denied that staff must wait, explained that errors found internally are corrected, and that systemic errors are fixed via signals from outside and reported in half-yearly reports.
If the error is discovered by the Tax Administration, it is corrected. The Tax Administration does not wait until the citizen has responded.
Als de fout door de Belastingdienst wordt ontdekt, dan wordt die hersteld. De Belastingdienst wacht daarbij niet totdat de burger heeft gereageerd.
Vragen het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de opbrengst van bijzondere financiële instellingen (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

MP Groot asks the state secretary of Finance about the fiscal attractiveness of the Netherlands for multinationals, the reported drop in tax revenue from foreign special financial institutions since 2007, and whether a withholding tax on interest and royalties should be introduced. The state secretary answers that location choices involve many factors, that the revenue figure of 1.5 billion euro was a 2004 estimate of value added, that DNB will publish updated figures in 2012, and that a withholding tax on interest and royalties is not in the Netherlands' interest, so no new memo will be sent.
If updated data are not known, why is that the case and when can you supply that data?
Indien geactualiseerde gegevens niet bekend zijn, waarom is dat het geval en wanneer kunt u die gegevens dan wel leveren?

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over een onjuiste waardebepaling van verhuurde panden in box 3 en de Successiewet, waardoor mensen extreem hoge belasting dien

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the 2010 switch to WOZ-based valuation of rented homes for box 3 and inheritance tax is causing extreme tax burdens, and proposed remedies such as a counter-evidence rule and municipal consultation. The State Secretary largely rejected the proposals, defending the WOZ valuation and existing appeal routes, while pointing to rent-cap and valuation adjustments and a few narrow changes for leased homes and service flats.
A counter-evidence arrangement was, when the mandatory use of the WOZ value was introduced and several times since, rejected with reasons.
Een tegenbewijsregeling is bij invoering van het verplicht gebruik van de WOZ-waarde en ook al enkele keren daarna, beargumenteerd afgewezen.

Vragen van het lid Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat een ontslaggolf dreigt door verhoging van het btw-tarief i

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether the temporary VAT reduction for construction renovation would be continued, given job losses feared from its expiry. The state secretary answered that the measure was temporary, that the reduced rate ends for new work from 1 July 2011 with a transition until 1 October 2011, and that the cabinet sees no reason to reverse the decision.
The cabinet sees no reason to reverse the decision, which was taken with the agreement of a majority of your House.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om de besluitvorming, die met instemming van een meerderheid van uw Kamer tot stand is gekomen, terug te draaien.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Schouten (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de positie van de woningcorporatie op Bonaire (

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about the housing association Fundashon Cas Bonairiano on Bonaire, including affordability of social rents, the effect of the APB and the introduction of the dollar, a possible exemption from the ABB, and the applicability of the Dutch Housing Act. The state secretary of Finance replied only with a notice that the questions could not be answered within three weeks because consultation with the Ministry of Interior is needed.

I hereby inform you that the questions from MPs Ortega-Martijn and Schouten (both ChristenUnie) on the position of the housing association on Bonaire (Fundashon Cas Bonairiano) cannot be answered within a period of three weeks, as parts require further coordination with the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.

Hierbij bericht ik u dat de vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Schouten (beiden ChristenUnie) over de positie van de woningcorporatie op Bonaire (Fundashon Cas Bonairiano) niet binnen een termijn van drie weken beantwoord kunnen worden, nu onderdelen nadere afstemming met het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties vergen.

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de problemen die grensarbeiders ondervinden bij de Nederlandse en Duitse belastingdienst en

Omtzigt (CDA) asks the state secretary of Finance about problems cross-border workers face with Dutch and German tax authorities, including German taxation of ABP pensions and German tax on pensions paid to Netherlands residents from 2005, asking about consultation, withholding, help, and a new treaty. The state secretary answers that the Dutch Supreme Court ruling stands, the German authorities are negotiating under Article 25, the German Rente taxation is the German legal consequence and not reversible by Dutch authorities, help is limited to GWO, and a new treaty negotiation is in its final phase with no details disclosed.
At this stage I obviously cannot go into the content of the new treaty, which hopefully can be signed within a reasonable time, as that would disrupt the negotiation process.
In dit stadium kan ik op de inhoud van het (hopelijk binnen afzienbare tijd te ondertekenen) nieuwe verdrag vanzelfsprekend niet ingaan.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over grootschalige fraude door middel van DigiD met kinderopvang-, huu

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Interior Minister about large-scale fraud with childcare, rent and care allowances via DigiD, including whether the Tax Authority deliberately did not check DigiD use, how victims would be compensated and how fraudsters would be pursued. The government answered that about 2,500 victims were involved in recent prosecutable cases, that measures blocking third-party applications and requiring written confirmation of account changes were introduced, that victims would be compensated, and that ongoing criminal investigations prevent discussing specific cases.
Victims receive a letter from the Tax Authority stating that they are victims of fraud.
Gedupeerden krijgen van de Belastingdienst een brief waarin wordt aangegeven dat zij slachtoffers zijn van een fraude.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over massale fraude (ingezonden 20 september 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about massive identity fraud in childcare and tax allowance payments, including how many files were coded for suspected identity fraud, how much money was lost, what warning signals existed, when bank account changes would be legally restricted, and what apology and victim support would be given. The State Secretary answered at length, giving approximate case numbers and amounts, describing new anti-fraud measures and a planned single-account rule in the Overige Fiscale Maatregelen 2012 bill, while leaving the exact timing of a name-number check open.
Concrete numerical information on this is not available, since fraud cases handled administratively are not broken down by type of fraud.
Concrete cijfermatige informatie daarover is niet beschikbaar, aangezien fraudegevallen die bestuurlijk worden afgehandeld niet worden onderverdeeld naar fraudesoort.
Vragen van de leden Elissen en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over fraude met DigiD (ingezonden 20 september 2011).

Two MPs asked the minister about DigiD fraude, including whether earlier claims of only a few cases were misleading, the number of cases, planned measures, whether DigiD is secure, and how victims will be helped. The state secretary answered that the fraud concerned benefit fraud enabled by the Tax Administration not checking DigiD ownership, that several hundred DigiD accounts were investigated, that a higher security level is under study with a decision promised later in the year, and that victims are supported through a single contact point and the CMI.
Measures are continuously being taken to prevent fraud with DigiD.
Er worden doorlopend maatregelen genomen om fraude met DigiD te voorkomen.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Financiën over tegenvallende kaartverkoop door de btw-verhoging in de cultuursector (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

Labour MP Klijnsma asked the State Secretaries of Education, Culture and Science and of Finance whether the VAT increase on performing arts tickets, which coincided with falling ticket sales, was counterproductive and should be reversed. The Finance State Secretary answered that a price rise can reduce demand, that it is too early to judge the full effect, that the government sees no reason to reverse the decision, and that developments will be monitored.
The cabinet sees no reason to reverse the decision, which was reached with the approval of a majority of your House.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om de besluitvorming, die met instemming van een meerderheid van uw Kamer tot stand is gekomen, terug te draaien.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de exploitatie van buitensportaccommodaties door gemeenten en sportstichtingen (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT treatment of municipal and sports-foundation sports facilities, including a planned Sportbesluit with percentage-based rental rules and the Supreme Court's case law. The State Secretary denied that only symbolic fees allow VAT deduction refusal, explained abuse-of-law structures, and said draft guidelines would be revised, with final guidelines expected in October without the percentage link.
In this context, on 11 July 2011, draft guideline texts prepared at official level were sent for comment to various interest organisations, in line with the normal procedure for policy decisions.

In dit kader zijn op 11 juli 2011 conform de normale procedure voor de totstandkoming van beleidsbesluiten op ambtelijk niveau opgestelde conceptrichtlijnteksten voor commentaar naar verschillende belangenorganisaties gestuurd.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretarissen van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Financiën over het bericht dat de verkoop van kaarten voor het komende theaterseizoen sterk is gedaald (ingezond

An MP from D66 asked the state secretaries whether theatre ticket presales fell 18% after the VAT increase on performing arts, what this means for supply, budget revenue, and whether the VAT rise should be reversed. The government said the only data are from the sector association, that demand may fall given price elasticity, that it is too early to judge effects, and that it sees no reason to reverse the decision, while promising to monitor developments.
As promised during the treatment of the Tax Plan 2011 in the Senate, developments in the performing arts sector will be monitored.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens de behandeling van het Belastingplan 2011 in de Eerste Kamer, zullen de ontwikkelingen in de podiumkunstensector gemonitord worden.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Neppérus (VVD), Van Vliet (PVV), Koolmees (D66), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het rechtstreeks overmaken van kinderopvang

Six MPs asked the state secretary of Finance whether childcare allowance could be paid directly to childcare providers or childminding agencies to prevent parents' debts, and whether a system with certified parties and a dialogue with providers would be set up before the tax plan. The government only sent a holding notice saying the questions need intensive interdepartmental coordination and cannot be answered within the usual period.

Answering the questions of 10 August from the members Omtzigt, Neppérus, Van Vliet, Koolmees, Braakhuis and Schouten on the direct transfer of childcare allowance requires intensive interdepartmental coordination.

Het beantwoorden van de vragen van 10 augustus jl. van de leden Omtzigt, Neppérus, Van Vliet, Koolmees, Braakhuis en Schouten over het rechtsreeks overmaken van kinderopvangtoeslag vereist intensieve interdepartementale afstemming.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over een onjuiste waardebepaling van verhuurde panden in box 3 en de Successiewet, waardoor mensen extreem hoge belasting dien

CDA MPs Omtzigt and Van Bochove asked the state secretary of Finance, in 14 questions, about the 2010 change in how rented property is valued for box 3 wealth tax and inheritance tax, arguing it creates extreme tax burdens and asking for counter-evidence rules, WOZ valuation consultation and deadlines. The secretary replied only that the answers could not be given within three weeks due to preparations for the Belastingplan 2012.

the answers to the parliamentary questions from MPs Omtzigt and Bochove (both CDA) on the incorrect valuation of rented property in box 3 and the Inheritance Tax Act, which makes people pay extremely high taxes (submitted 23 August 2011) cannot be answered within a three-week period

de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bochove (beiden CDA) over de onjuiste waardebepaling van verhuurde panden in box 3 en de Successiewet, waardoor mensen extreem hoge belastingen dienen te betalen (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011) niet binnen een termijn van drie weken kunnen worden beantwoord
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van de Werf (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over muziekverenigingen, die massaal hun ANBI-status kwijtraken (ingezonden 14 juli 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the mass loss of ANBI status by music associations after the Tax Office re-tested them under the stricter 90% public-benefit criterion, and whether symphony orchestras receive different treatment. The State Secretary answered that the policy is statutory interpretation, that roughly 10% of music associations still qualify, that individual reviewable decisions will follow, and that a horizontal supervision role for music federations is not feasible because ANBI status will be an exception.

Music associations that, after assessing the responses, the ANBI team considers no longer qualify will receive a reasoned written pre-notice, followed by a withdrawal decision open to objection and appeal.

De muziekverenigingen die na de beoordeling van de ontvangen reacties naar de mening van het ANBI-team niet meer kwalificeren, ontvangen schriftelijk een gemotiveerde vooraankondiging, gevolgd door een voor bezwaar en beroep vatbare intrekkingsbeschikking.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het artikel «De levensgenieter krijgt «levenslang» oftewel eens genoten altijd genoten» (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a commentary arguing that a life-interest (vruchtgebruik) arrangement under article 10 of the Successiewet 1956 ends after conversion, questioning the lack of transitional law, the inspector's position, the rent-level rules and whether the change was communicated to citizens. The State Secretary's communication only requests an extension of the answering deadline to 1 October 2011, citing coordination with the Belastingdienst.
I hereby request that you grant an extension until 1 October 2011 for answering the questions
Hierbij verzoek ik u uitstel te verlenen tot 1 oktober 2011 voor de beantwoording van de vragen
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over vertraging verliesverrekening bedrijven (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Koppejan asked the State Secretary of Finance about delays in corporate loss offset caused by a Belastingdienst system failure, and whether a 2009 relief decision should be revived. The State Secretary explained the processing delay was technical, said applications would be honoured once conditions are met, and declined to revive the relief scheme citing fiscal costs.
I am of the view that the Tax Authority must respond as quickly as possible to applications for loss offset.
Ik ben van oordeel dat de Belastingdienst zo snel mogelijk moet reageren op aanvragen van verrekening van verliezen.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de mogelijke Anbistatus, dus goed doel, van een familiebank (ingezonden 9 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether the Anthos Bank, a family bank, holds ANBI charity status, whether other banks do, and whether such institutions must publish annual reports. The state secretary answered that the article wrongly attributed ANBI status to the bank rather than to the foundation Unitas, that no banks hold ANBI status, and that charities face the same publication duties as other foundations, with a joint transparency document planned for 2012, and declined to say whether the bank uses a tax facility because of tax secrecy.

On whether this facility is actually used by Anthos Bank as a fundraising institution for the foundation holding all its shares (foundation Unitas with ANBI status), I cannot provide information due to the confidentiality obligation in article 67 of the General Tax Act.

Over de vraag of van deze faciliteit door de Anthos Bank als fondswervende instelling voor de stichting die alle aandelen van deze bank houdt (stichting Unitas met de ANBI-status) daadwerkelijk gebruik wordt gemaakt, kan ik geen mededelingen doen in verband met de geheimhoudingsplicht, bedoeld in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over aanbesteding van kerstversiering en kerstverlichting door de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance why the Tax Authority tendered Christmas decorations worth around 125,000 euro during an economic crisis and what he would do about it. The state secretary clarified the amount covers four years (about 30,000 per year), explained decorations are being scaled back to a tree and small items in public areas using standard products, and said the tender is a framework agreement without a purchase obligation.
I would add that this is not a tender of 125,000 euro per year, but an amount of 125,000 euro for a period of four years.
Ik teken er wel bij aan, dat het niet gaat om een aanbesteding van € 125 000 per jaar, maar om een bedrag van € 125 000 voor een periode van vier jaar.

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris en de minister van Financiën en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Amerikaanse Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

Deputy Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Finance about the US FATCA law, including whether it conflicts with the US-Netherlands tax treaty, whether it breaches Dutch privacy law, whether banks must ask every client about US status, and on what Dutch legal basis a 30% withholding could be imposed. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands supports an EU approach, that the privacy question awaits the Commission's review, that banks must adapt systems, and that no Dutch legal basis is needed because the withholding is a US tax.
Since the European Commission is already examining this point, I first want to await the outcome of that examination.
Aangezien de Europese Commissie dit punt al aan het onderzoeken is, wil ik eerst de uitkomst van dat onderzoek afwachten.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de energiebelasting op aardgas ten behoeve van gasmotoren in schepen (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

MPs Jansen and Bashir asked why natural gas for CNG engines in vehicles is exempt from energy tax while the same gas for vessels is not, and whether this omission would be corrected. The state secretary replied that CNG filling stations pay a fixed energy tax rate, that vessels fall under the degressive band tariff with no exemption or refund, and that the government will examine adjusting the rules and plans to raise the fixed rate to 0.16 per m3.
This natural gas is therefore not exempt from energy tax.
Dit aardgas is dus niet vrijgesteld van EB.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de staatsecretaris van Financiën over protheses (ingezonden 10 juni 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the VAT difference between exempt manual and taxed machine-made dental prostheses, as highlighted by a court ruling, is unlawful and harms innovation. The State Secretary defended the difference as required by EU law, refused to lift it before appeal, and said he would keep pressing the European Commission to end transitional regimes.

Vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de gevolgen van nieuwe belastingregels op de economie van Saba

MPs Hachchi and Koolmees (D66) ask the Interior and Finance ministers to quantify the tax burden effects on Saba and Sint Eustatius of shifting from direct to indirect taxes, including the general consumption tax (ABB), excise duties, the flat tax, customs transit via Sint Maarten and the treatment of health insurance premiums. The government replies only with a notice that the ten questions cannot be answered within three weeks due to required fact-finding and interdepartmental coordination.
Given the required fact-finding and the necessary interdepartmental coordination, a careful answer to the questions within this period has not proven possible.
Gelet op het benodigde feitenonderzoek en de noodzakelijke interdepartementale afstemming is een zorgvuldige beantwoording van de vragen binnen deze termijn niet mogelijk gebleken.

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris en de minister van Financiën en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Amerikaanse Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

MP Omtzigt (CDA) asks the State Secretary of Finance and the Ministers of Finance and Foreign Affairs about the US FATCA law: whether Dutch financial institutions must identify US persons among clients, what data they must report to US authorities, whether this conflicts with the bilateral tax treaty and privacy law, and what legal basis allows a 30% withholding.
