The government's reply is only a notice that answering will take longer than three weeks due to interdepartmental coordination, with no substantive answers yet.
that the answers to the parliamentary questions from MP Omtzigt (CDA) on the US Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) cannot be provided within the three-week period.
dat de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Omzigt (CDA) over de Amerikaanse Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) niet binnen een termijn van drie weken kunnen worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de ANBI-status (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance about uncertainty over ANBI (charitable public benefit) status and the tax-facilitated fundraising status, including whether charities may house commercial activities in a BV while keeping ANBI status. The state secretary says the Tax Authority applies the rules in line with the earlier explanation, that a separate BV does not in principle affect ANBI status, and that the government will revise the rules in the Geefwet and Belastingplan 2012.
Incidentally, it should be noted that any liability to corporate income tax is separate from ANBI status.
Overigens zij opgemerkt dat eventuele belastingplicht voor de vennootschapsbelasting losstaat van de ANBI-status.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de recente vastgoedfraude (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

MPs Recourt and Groot asked how the FIOD and Tax Authority uncovered large-scale real estate tax fraud, whether the Public Prosecution Service was involved, and whether prosecution capacity and the natural persons behind companies are pursued. The government answered that cases were handled through a tripartite consultation with a threshold for prosecution, that 8 cases went to criminal investigation involving 17 suspects, and that 9 of them are being prosecuted.
Between the participants in the tripartite consultation there is good and close cooperation.
Tussen de deelnemers aan het tripartiete overleg is sprake van een goede en nauwe samenwerking.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de miljoenenfraude en massale belastingontduiking in de vastgoedsector (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked why only eight cases in a large real-estate tax fraud investigation were referred for criminal prosecution, how decisions are made, and whether criminal law should be used more. The State Secretary explained the tripartite selection criteria, the 17 suspects and their status, and that the tax authority will keep the sector under targeted supervision, while declining to give exact detection rates.
It is not possible to state how high the probability of detection is for tax evasion.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoe hoog de pakkans is voor belastingontduiking.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over kinderopvangtoeslag (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum ask the State Secretary of Finance about blocked childcare allowance payments, parents who cannot resolve delays, wrongful full suspension after partial changes, and whether the tax service will restore regular consultation with help desks. The State Secretary answers that about 9,800 applications were halted pending registry numbers and 3,225 suspended for non-response, that wrongful suspensions would be corrected on objection, and that consultation runs through trade associations and umbrella bodies while help desks can send feedback by mail or phone.
If the applicant has responded but the Tax and Customs Administration has unfortunately not received the documents, we advise the applicant to send the documents again.
Als de aanvrager heeft gereageerd maar de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onverhoopt de stukken niet heeft ontvangen, dan raden wij de aanvrager aan de stukken nogmaals op te sturen.
Vragen van het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de zorgtoeslag (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP asks whether the care allowance (zorgtoeslag) for a surviving partner is recalculated on an annualised income the deceased never actually earned, and whether this is unreasonable. The state secretary agrees the rule can yield unreasonable outcomes, affecting about 21,000 households, and commits to abolishing the annualisation and 10% rules in the 2012 tax plan and instructing the tax authority to stop annualising in the meantime.
In anticipation of this, I will instruct the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances to refrain from annualising income upon death in situations where there is a surviving partner.

Vooruitlopend hierop zal ik de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen opdracht geven om het herleiden van het inkomen bij overlijden voortaan achterwege te laten in situaties waarin sprake is van een achterblijvende partner.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het terug moeten betalen van een toeslag na het overlijden van de partner (ingezonden 29 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance why survivors must repay allowances because the deceased partner's income is annualised to a level never actually earned, and whether this is fair. The state secretary defended the annualisation rule as reflecting the deceased's capacity, but announced that the rule will be scrapped in the Belastingplan 2012 and that Belastingdienst/Toeslagen will be instructed to stop annualising in the meantime.
In anticipation of this, I will instruct the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances to stop annualising the deceased's income in cases where a surviving partner remains.

Vooruitlopend hierop zal ik de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen opdracht geven om het herleiden van het inkomen bij overlijden voortaan achterwege te laten in situaties waarin sprake is van een achterblijvende partner.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over onterechte verlaging van de huurtoeslag bij overlijden partner (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Finance whether surviving partners are wrongly losing rent allowance after a partner's death, and whether they are automatically or actively informed about the 10% rule. The State Secretary confirms the situation affects about 16,000 households, explains the conditions of the 10% rule, and commits to examining abolition of the income-tracing and 10% rules in the 2012 tax plan and instructing the tax authority to stop income tracing in such cases.
In anticipation of this, I will instruct the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances to refrain from tracing income upon death in situations where a surviving partner remains.

Vooruitlopend hierop zal ik de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen opdracht geven om het herleiden van het inkomen bij overlijden voortaan achterwege te laten in situaties waarin sprake is van een achterblijvende partner.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Slob (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over de positie van de woningcorporatie op Bonaire (Fundashon Cas Bonairian

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Slob asked ministers about Fundashon Cas Bonairiano's rising construction costs on Bonaire after the new tax regime, including import duties, turnover tax and general consumption tax, and whether FCB could be exempted or access central housing funds. The state secretary replied that import duty rates are now zero but a general consumption tax applies with exemptions for development-aid-funded projects, that FCB is not eligible for central fund project support but could become eligible under conditions, and that no further exemptions were foreseen, while promising to inform the Chamber on Curaçao entrepot arrangements.
As soon as clarity exists on this, I will inform the Chamber about it.
Zodra daarover helderheid bestaat, zal ik de Kamer daarover informeren.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de staatsecretaris van Financiën over overdrachtsbelasting bij een van een monumentenpand (ingezonden 17 mei 2011).

MP Neppérus asked the state secretary of Finance whether, after a court ruling that individuals could not be denied the monument exemption from transfer tax while companies could claim it, the policy was changed retroactively and whether individuals who had already paid, and those who did not object, would benefit. The state secretary confirmed the policy change with retroactive effect from 1 May 2009 for both individuals and companies, excluding assessments that had become final before that date, and rejected extending retroactivity further for individuals because the transfer tax is clearly communicated via the notary's statement of account.

I decided not to appeal the ruling to cassation and approved a policy decision that the monument exemption applies with retroactive effect from 1 May 2009 to acquisitions by both natural and legal persons.

Ik heb besloten geen beroep in cassatie tegen de uitspraak in te stellen en heb in een beleidsbesluit 2 goedgekeurd dat de monumentenvrijstelling met terugwerkende kracht met ingang van 1 mei 2009, de datum van de uitspraak van het Hof, geldt voor verkrijgingen door zowel natuurlijke personen als rechtspersonen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over adviesgroep transfer pricing (ingezonden 11 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the EU Joint Transfer Pricing Forum, questioning the scale of profit shifting via transfer pricing and whether its members, largely from business, form a balanced advisory body. The State Secretary replied that Dutch rules and supervision are adequate, denied evidence of lost revenue, and argued that business experts are appropriate for the Forum's dispute-resolution purpose.
The EU Joint Transfer Pricing Forum consists of experts from both the private sector and from governments.
Het EU Joint Transfer Pricing Forum bestaat zowel uit experts afkomstig van de private sector als experts afkomstig van de overheden.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het fiscale partnerbegrip (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the 2010 narrowing of the fiscal partner concept, which no longer allows a person to have more than one partner, including the case of siblings living together in the parental home, and asks for counts and revenue figures. The State Secretary confirms the change, declines a specific count (estimating at most 100 estates a year), proposes that two persons with a notarial cohabitation contract are each other's partners even if a third person lives with them, and cites about EUR 11 million revenue from abolishing higher exemptions for multiple relations.

Because both the Tax Authority and Statistics Netherlands have indicated that research into the number of cases in which siblings currently live together in the former parental home would be very labour-intensive, it has been decided, for efficient use of resources, to refrain from such research.

Omdat zowel de Belastingdienst als het CBS hebben aangegeven dat onderzoek naar het aantal gevallen waarin op dit moment broers en zusters in de voormalige ouderlijke woning samenwonen zeer arbeidsintensief zal zijn, wordt er uit oogpunt van efficiënte inzet van middelen voor gekozen af te zien van een dergelijk onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEA’s) en belastingverdragen (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance for a list of all Dutch tax information exchange agreements and tax treaties, showing whether information was exchanged with each country in 2009 and 2010, and the same for the other Kingdom countries. The state secretary provided a list of 15 TIEAs in force (most applicable from 2011 or 2012), explained that Aruba and the former Netherlands Antilles had treaties available in those years, and said that actual use falls under the other countries' finance ministers, pointing to online sources.
Whether and how these treaties have been used falls under the responsibility of the Ministers of Finance of the other countries of the Kingdom.
Of en hoe deze verdragen zijn gebruikt valt onder de bevoegdheid van de Ministers van Financiën van de andere landen van het Koninkrijk.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over openbaarmaking van rulings (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Finance about the 2009 publication of 22 documents on tax rulings, whether confidentiality (Awr, Wob) allows fuller disclosure, and whether anonymised rulings of the 50 largest companies can be provided. The State Secretary says the documents were anonymised cooperation agreements not rulings, that tax confidentiality takes precedence over the Wob, that anonymisation of the requested data would be infeasible, and offers a technical briefing.
Adequate anonymisation is otherwise not possible, because insiders can deduce from the circumstances of the case which taxpayer is concerned.
Afdoende anonimisering is anders niet mogelijk, doordat ingewijde derden uit de omstandigheden van het geval kunnen afleiden om welke belastingplichtige het gaat.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het door DNB verstrekte getal van 12,3 biljoen euro dat in totaal jaarlijks door Nederland instroomt en uitstroomt (ingezonden 21 april

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance about DNB figures showing about 12.3 trillion euros flowing through the Netherlands yearly via special financial institutions, requesting breakdowns by offshore centre, company type, royalty income, tax paid, and international action on shell companies. The state secretary provides a 2009 breakdown by country, explains that finer detail is withheld for confidentiality, estimates the economic value of the hub, defends the innovation box, and declines to pursue an international study of such flows.
More detail cannot be provided due to confidentiality and the possible traceability to individual data.
Meer detail kan in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid en de mogelijke herleidbaarheid naar individuele gegevens niet worden verschaft.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het burgerservicenummer (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked whether the BSN may be used by government bodies only when strictly necessary, and whether sole traders must show their BSN in the VAT identification number on invoices and in their clients' bookkeeping. The state secretary confirmed the necessity principle, said VAT numbers for sole traders are derived from the BSN as required by EU rules, and declined to introduce a non-BSN VAT number because of costs and administrative burden.
Personal numbers must only be used when that is necessary.
Persoonsnummers moeten alleen gebruikt worden wanneer dat nodig is.

Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over exploitatie van buitensportaccommodaties door gemeenten en sportstic

CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance whether the reduced VAT rate for providing sports facilities is applied consistently, why tax offices refuse to rule on some cases, and whether municipalities and sports foundations can rely on the reduced rate. The state secretary said the rate applies under stated cumulative conditions, that a sale-and-leaseback structure is rejected as abusive, and promised simplified implementation guidance after consulting the VNG/VSG and NOC*NSF.
I will ensure that the implementing guidance is published as soon as possible, so that the various units can quickly settle pending cases.
Ik zal er voor zorgen dat de aanwijzingen in de uitvoeringssfeer zo spoedig mogelijk worden gepubliceerd, zodat de diverse eenheden snel lopende zaken kunnen afdoen.

Vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht dat het nieuwe belastingregels de economie van Saba

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers whether new tax rules effective 1 January 2011 are disrupting the economies of Saba and Sint Eustatius, including claimed cost-of-living rises and a claimed 18.4% wage cost increase. The state secretary replied that the tax shift was intended, that the 18.4% figure is incorrect since the employer premium is unchanged in total, and that the government will monitor the economy and inform businesses.
That labour costs on Saba and Sint Eustatius rose by 18.4% in 2011 compared with 2010 is incorrect.
Dat de loonkosten op Saba en Sint Eustatius in 2011 ten opzichte van 2010 met 18,4% gestegen is onjuist.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de vrijstelling van energiebelasting voor de mineralogische industrie (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance why the Netherlands has no energy tax exemption for mineralogical processes, unlike many other member states, which harms the competitiveness of the domestic mineralogical industry. The state secretary explains that the EU directive excludes these processes, that the earlier ceramics exemption was found to be unlawful state aid, and that a broader exemption would be possible but would need budgetary cover, without committing to introduce one.
Looking at the European Commission's judgment, exempting all mineralogical processes would probably be possible, because there would then be no state aid.
Kijkend naar het oordeel van de Europese Commissie zou vrijstelling van alle mineralogische procedés waarschijnlijk mogelijk zijn, omdat er dan geen sprake is van staatssteun.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over openbaarmaking van rulings (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about publishing tax rulings, questioning whether secrecy should extend beyond anonymising company details to exact agreements, amounts and percentages, and requests anonymised rulings of the fifty largest companies before a committee meeting. The reply is only a notice that the questions could not be answered within the set deadline because further consultation is needed.
Answering the parliamentary questions requires further consultation.
De beantwoording van de Kamervragen vergt nadere afstemming.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het door DNB verstrekte getal van 12,3 biljoen euro dat in totaal jaarlijks door Nederland instroomt en uitstroomt (ingezonden 21 april

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance for breakdowns of the DNB figure of 12.3 trillion euros flowing through the Netherlands annually by offshore centres, company types and royalty income, plus tax rates, OECD data and how often advance certainty is refused. The State Secretary only sends an interim notice that the questions cannot be answered within the set deadline because they require further coordination.
Answering the parliamentary questions requires further coordination.
De beantwoording van de Kamervragen vergt nadere afstemming.
Vragen van het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over belemmeringen bij de aanpak van zwartspaarders (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An MP asks whether the Supreme Court's KB-Lux ruling makes it harder for the tax authority to fine non-cooperating shadow earners, and what can be done to still penalise those who refuse to disclose information. The State Secretary replies that non-cooperation still leads to a reversed burden of proof for tax assessment, but fines require proof of intent or gross negligence, and he points to civil kort geding with penalty payments and criminal sanctions for withholding information, plus a planned review of whether withholding information should also be fineable.
I intend to intensify this approach.
Ik ben voornemens deze aanpak te intensiveren.

Vragen van de leden Klaver en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht van de ombudsman dat de Belastingdienst 6 miljoen euro ten onrechte niet uitbetaalt aan buitenlandse pens

MPs Klaver and Braakhuis asked the state secretary of Finance about the ombudsman's report that the Tax Authority wrongly withholds 6 million euros from foreign pensioners, and how the Tax Authority can decide itself whether to apply a law. The state secretary said the Tax Authority refunds amounts on its own initiative, that for 2010 it will use file matching, and that since 2006-2009 claimants must request refunds, with CVZ referring complaints and websites updated, plus talks with CVZ about a mailing.
Every government organisation is obliged to respect the rights of citizens.
Elke overheidsorganisatie is gehouden om de rechten van burgers te respecteren.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over bescherming van fiscale informatie van burgers (ingezonden 1 maart 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Belastingdienst fails to verify consent and record who requests citizens' tax data via help and information points (HIPs), as the CBP found, and what measures will follow. The state secretary acknowledged the CBP findings, said HIP contracts require consent checks, and announced steps including phoning sampled taxpayers, updating contact registers and revising processor agreements.
By signing those agreements these HIPs are obliged, among other things, to handle all data carefully.
Met het ondertekenen van die overeenkomsten verplichten deze HIPs onder meer om zorgvuldig met alle gegevens om te gaan.
Vragen de leden Omtzigt en De Rouwe (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de verhoging van het liggeld voor woonboten (ingezonden 29 maart 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and De Rouwe asked the State Secretary of Finance about sharp increases in mooring fees for houseboat residents, including claims of a 300% rise at Zijkanaal B in Velsen and allegations that state mooring permits were auctioned at high prices. The State Secretary answered that the average increase at Zijkanaal B is 91.7% after accounting for the VAT exemption, denied any auction took place, and said the policy was softened by lengthening the adjustment period and notice period.
No, there has been no auction.
Neen, er is geen sprake geweest van een veiling.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

The MP asks the state secretary of Finance about the Belastingdienst: whether late-filing fines were quadrupled, whether citizens are adequately informed, payment arrangements, the fictitious 4% return on savings, electronic filing with older computers and DigiD delays, and whether pre-filled returns cause missed deductions. The secretary replies that the maximum fine was already raised in 2010, that information channels are adequate, that existing payment and exemption rules suffice, that the forfeit return reflects broader asset returns, and that older operating systems and DigiD timing are citizens' responsibility, with no special regime planned.
In view of the foregoing, I see no reason to impose the fines with leniency.
Gezien het voorgaande zie ik geen aanleiding de boeteoplegging met de nodige coulance op te leggen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de vrijheid binnen een fiscale eenheid om te kiezen of er vrij van btw opleidingen worden verzorgd (ingezonden 5 april 2011).

MP Bashir asks whether the VAT exemption for vocational training, combined with fiscal unity allowing entities within one group to be exempt or taxed, enables competition through VAT and whether this conflicts with EU Regulation 1777/2005, and why the option was not removed. The state secretary replies that the choice has been abolished in favour of institution-level recognition, that fiscal unity does not create an unlawful option, and that no infringement procedure is expected.
By adopting only the recognition of the educational institution as the basis for the VAT exemption, the option to provide exempt or taxable vocational education has been abolished.

Door uitsluitend de erkenning van de onderwijsinstelling als basis voor de btw-vrijstelling aan te nemen, is de keuzemogelijkheid voor het verstrekken van vrijgesteld of belast beroepsonderwijs afgeschaft.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority: fourfold late-filing penalties without clear warning, payment arrangements failing in cases like bereavement, the fictitious 4% return on savings, electronic filing problems with older computers and DigiD delays, and the pre-filled return making deductions hard to find. The government replies only that the answers cannot be given within the three-week deadline because the information is not yet fully available.
I hereby inform you that it is not possible to answer the questions of member Braakhuis about the Tax Authority within the set three-week period.
Hierbij bericht ik u dat het niet mogelijk is de vragen van het lid Braakhuis over de Belastingdienst binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over belastingontwijkroutes die worden gebruikt door Kadhafi in Nederland (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Dutch tax authorities make special deals with multinationals and foreign firms, and how Gaddafi-linked tax avoidance routes operate, along with questions on sanctions and the Tax Authority's moral responsibility. The State Secretary answered that all firms face the same laws, that agreements are made only within legal frameworks, and that suspected misconduct would be reported to prosecutors and supervisory bodies, while describing EU sanctions freezing Libyan state entities' assets.

Should the Tax Authority, for example when assessing returns or in a possible audit, encounter the irregularities referred to in the question, it will report them to other government and supervisory bodies.

Mocht de Belastingdienst, bijvoorbeeld bij het vaststellen van de aangifte of een eventueel boekenonderzoek, stuiten op de in de vraag bedoelde onregelmatigheden, dan zal de Belastingdienst deze melden bij andere overheids- en toezichtsinstanties

Vragen van de leden Bashir, Van Bommel en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de staatssecretaris en minister van Financiën en de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over Nederland als vestigingsplek voor h

Three SP MPs asked whether the Libyan-owned Oilinvest (Tamoil) is run from the Netherlands for tax advantages, whether it has tax rulings, its structure, and whether frozen Libyan assets include it. The government declined to disclose individual taxpayer information citing confidentiality, described general APA/ATR practice and the Netherlands' investment climate, and said it would ensure Oilinvest complies with EU sanctions and has offered measures limiting shareholder influence.
In view of the duty of confidentiality, no information about individual taxpayers can be provided (article 67 of the General State Taxes Act).
In verband met de geheimhoudingsplicht kan geen informatie over individuele belastingplichtigen worden verstrekt (artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen).
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het tegengaan van fraude met Voorlopige Teruggaaf (VT) (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance about fraud with preliminary tax refunds (VT), including signals investigated, amounts withheld, a criminal case, stolen identity data and bank account controls. The state secretary confirmed the priority and measures, declined to discuss the pending criminal case, and promised to consolidate action in the Fiscal Agenda.
This case is still before the court. For that reason I cannot go into it.
Deze zaak is nog onder de rechter. Om die reden kan ik er niet op ingaan.

Vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Koolmees (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de plannen van de Europese Commissie om brandstofheffingen sterker aan energie-inhoud te koppelen (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Van Veldhoven and Koolmees asked the State Secretary of Finance about reported EU Commission plans to link fuel taxes more closely to energy content, including effects on climate goals, diesel use, air quality and the Mannheim inland shipping excise exemptions. The government answered that it has discussed the Green Paper with the Commission, will assess the effects only once a formal proposal exists, has a CE Delft/Ecofys study underway, and will discuss shipping and vehicle excise issues within the Energy Taxation Directive and Transport White Paper talks.
Should the European Commission submit a proposal, the First and Second Chamber will be informed of it through the so-called BNC fiche, along with the cabinet's initial position.

Mocht de Europese Commissie een voorstel indienen, dan zullen de Eerste en Tweede Kamer door middel van het zogenoemde BNC-fiche op de hoogte worden gebracht van dit voorstel en de eerste positie van het kabinet ter zake.
Vragen van het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de zorgtoeslag (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance whether, after a partner's death, the healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag) for the surviving partner is recalculated on an annualised income never actually earned, how many households are affected, and whether the rules will change to use actual household income. The government replies only with a holding notice saying the answers will follow as soon as possible, after the deadline was missed.
I hereby inform you that the answer cannot be given within the set deadline. You will receive the answers as soon as possible.
Hierbij laat ik u weten dat de beantwoording niet binnen de gestelde termijn kan plaatsvinden. U ontvangt de antwoorden zo spoedig mogelijk.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over onrechtmatige heffingen op bepaalde platte beeldschermen en printers (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the WTO ruling that EU import duties on certain flat screens and printers are unlawful would lead to refunds, and how much money is involved. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling, estimated Dutch duties at about 168 million euro, and said importers cannot expect refunds under the Community Customs Code because the duties were levied under still-valid EU law, while noting an earlier 85 million euro refund on LCD screens following a court ruling.
The importers concerned cannot expect a refund under Article 236 of the Community Customs Code.
De betrokken importeurs kunnen geen terugbetaling verwachten op grond van artikel 236 van het Communautair Douane wetboek.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het artikel «Het verzuim van de wetgever» (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the enforcement gap in tax fraud, including whether an administrative late-filing fine blocks later criminal prosecution and a sanction for gross negligence or intent, and about the effects of recent case law. The State Secretary answered that a fine excludes a later penalty for the same act, acknowledged the gap in imposing a serious-offence fine afterwards, and committed to a regulation in the Belastingplan 2012.
The final proposal for this arrangement will be included in the Belastingplan 2012.
In het Belastingplan 2012 zal het uiteindelijke voorstel voor deze regeling opgenomen worden.

Vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over een onbedoeld effect van de wijzigingen in de Uitvoeringsregeling loonbelasting (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

MPs Groot and Vermeij asked the State Secretary of Finance about the 2011 article 12.2a of the wage tax implementing regulation, which affected early-retirement schemes insured with insurers since 2006, and whether it was introduced unexpectedly and hurt holders of stamrecht rights. The State Secretary answered that the article is being amended retroactively to 1 January 2011 so it applies only to abusive pre-financing aimed at avoiding the higher 52% VUT levy, and that it does not affect the rights holders described.

I have therefore decided to amend article 12.2a of the URLB 2011 with retroactive effect to 1 January 2011 so that it only applies in situations where the inspector can demonstrate unusual pre-financing linked to the increase of the VUT levy rate.

Ik heb daarom besloten artikel 12.2a van de URLB 2011 met terugwerkende kracht tot en met 1 januari 2011 zodanig aan te passen dat artikel 12.2a van de URLB 2011 slechts van toepassing is in situaties waarin de inspecteur kan aantonen dat er sprake is van een ongebruikelijke voorfinanciering
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over verhoging liggeld woonboten op rijkswater (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a sharp rise in mooring fees for houseboat residents on state waters, whether it is true residents pay thousands of euros more a year and why, and whether residents who appeal are charged the full amount immediately without a transition period. The government replied by letter of 1 April 2011, answering the questions in a separate letter (Kamerstuk 32 730, nr. 1).
These questions were answered in a letter of 1 April 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 730, no. 1).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 1 april 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 730, nr. 1 ).

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over enorme kostenstijgingen voor woonboten (ingezonden 27 januari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretaries about sharp mooring-fee increases for houseboat residents, why these fees are being aligned with social rental housing, what tenancy protections houseboat residents have compared with tenants, and whether a three-year transition period should be introduced for objectors. The government answered by letter of 1 April 2011, without the answers being reproduced in the document.
These questions were answered by letter of 1 April 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 730, no. 1).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 1 april 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 730, nr. 1 ).

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een herziening van de huur van ligplaatsen van woonboten doo

MPs Jansen and Bashir (SP) asked why RVOB is replacing CPI indexation of houseboat mooring rents with a new tariff structure, whether its basis is justified, why 19% VAT applies, and whether linking a phased rent increase to waiving the tenant's statutory right to a binding rent determination is acceptable. The government answered the questions in a letter of 1 April 2011, referring to the enclosed information.
Do you consider it acceptable that RVOB links an offer to introduce a rent increase in phases to waiving the tenant's statutory right to a binding rent determination by a committee of experts?

Acht u het acceptabel dat het RVOB een aanbod om een huurverhoging gefaseerd in te voeren koppelt aan het afzien van het wettelijk recht van de huurder op bindende vaststelling van de huur door een commissie van deskundigen

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en De Rouwe (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de prijsverhoging voor een lig

CDA MPs Omtzigt and De Rouwe asked why the RVOB announced steep rent increases for houseboat moorings without the annual notice given for social housing, whether similar protection and equal rental rules apply, whether losing transitional rights on objection is lawful, and asked for a fast answer. The government answered by referring to its letter of 1 April 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 730, nr. 1) and related earlier questions, without substantive reasons in this item.
These questions have been answered in the letter of 1 April 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 730, no. 1).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 1 april 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 730, nr. 1 ).
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de Wet op de Omzetbelasting (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

Deputy Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Finance about the implementation of EU VAT directives, business consultation and information channels, B2B reverse-charge and exemption differences across member states, VAT recovery for number acquisitions, and permanent establishment issues. The state secretary answered that consultation with business was held, information is available via the Belastingdienst, and that the Netherlands applies reverse charge to all B2B services; he acknowledged differences among member states and indicated he would assess simplifying the ABC-scheme refund procedure.
I will assess to what extent it is possible to achieve a statutory simplification of this refund procedure for these cases.
Ik zal beoordelen in hoeverre het mogelijk is om voor deze gevallen te komen tot een wettelijke vereenvoudiging van deze teruggaafprocedure.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de btw-vrijstelling voor het beroepsonderwijs (ingezonden 4 maart 2011)

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the 2010 change to the VAT exemption for vocational education created uncertainty for guest teachers, and whether the exemption should be drawn as broadly as EU rules allow. The State Secretary replied that the change only concerns non-statutory vocational education, that guest teachers can be exempt via the RKBO register under a lighter audit, and that the available EU room is already used.

Because the change in VAT rules from 1 July 2010 relates only to non-statutory vocational education, I am not aware that the change has caused uncertainty about the VAT obligations of self-employed teachers and guest teachers in statutory vocational education.

Omdat de wijziging in de BTW-regelgeving per 1 juli 2010 uitsluitend betrekking heeft op het niet wettelijk erkende beroepsonderwijs is mij niet bekend dat die wijziging aanleiding is geweest voor onduidelijkheid

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) Neppérus en Van der Burg (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over informatie over Nederlandse charitatieve instellingen (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

MPs asked the state secretary of Finance about public disclosure of Dutch charitable institutions (ANBIs) compared with the UK Charity Commission, including why only name and town are published and whether the English model should inform the new Geefwet. The state secretary said only name and seat are published by design, that ANBIs face the same disclosure duties as other foundations, and that he is willing to discuss broader data and transparency of ANBI assessments with the sector and ministries.
I am willing to reconsider, in consultation with the umbrella organisations, whether extending the published data with other information is possible.
Ik ben bereid om in overleg met de koepelorganisaties opnieuw te bezien of uitbreiding met andere gegevens mogelijk is.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Van Vliet (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatsecretaris van Financiën over gemeenten die de regels voor het afhandelen van woz-bezwaarschr

PVV MPs asked the state secretary of Finance and the minister of Interior whether municipalities routinely reject WOZ property-valuation objections and only treat them seriously once citizens appeal, and what measures would be taken. The government denied evidence of standard rejection, pointed to Waarderingskamer oversight and mediation pilots, declined further investigation, and rejected shortening deadlines and a lex silencio positivo.
I have no reason to assume that municipalities do not exercise sufficient care when handling WOZ objections.
Ik heb geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat gemeenten bij de afhandeling van WOZ-bezwaren onvoldoende zorgvuldigheid in acht nemen.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over taxatierapporten bij import van auto’s (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

The MP asks the state secretary of Finance about reported continuing problems with the import of cars with appraisal reports, how this squares with earlier answers, and about lost tax court cases. The state secretary confirms the reports, says the procedure will be changed so the fiscal approval is granted right after payment of the declared BPM, with the new procedure targeted for 1 July, and acknowledges recent court losses.
This has been the reason for me to examine whether this procedure can be organised differently.
Dit is voor mij aanleiding geweest om te bekijken of deze procedure anders kan worden ingericht.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over belastingontwijkroutes (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary of Finance about tax avoidance routes, including the scale of financial flows through Dutch entities, their employment effects, whether companies are held accountable, and royalty payments in the SAB-Miller case. The state secretary answers that the large figure is not a taxable-profit measure, that existing transfer pricing and anti-abuse rules suffice, that confidentiality prevents naming companies, and that no further legislation on royalties is planned.
No, because of the duty of confidentiality I cannot name concrete examples of companies where these themes were discussed in consultations between the Tax Administration and companies.

Nee, omwille van de geheimhoudingsverplichting kan ik geen concrete voorbeelden van bedrijven noemen waarbij deze thema's aan de orde zijn geweest in het overleg tussen de Belastingdienst en bedrijven.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het Landelijk Register Kindero

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance and two ministers about the national childcare register (LRK), including unmatched parents, the welcome text on the website, multi-child households, and the lack of a real-time link to tax systems. The government answered that most parents responded, that the website text was accurate, that a study of a link will be done, and that multi-provider reporting only becomes possible from 2012.
I can commit to having a study carried out this year into the possibility of such a link.
Ik kan u toezeggen dit jaar een onderzoek te laten doen naar de mogelijkheid van een dergelijke koppeling.

Vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over een onbedoeld effect van de wijzigingen in de Uitvoeringsregeling loonbelasting (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

Two MPs ask the State Secretary of Finance about a new article 12.2a in the 2011 wage tax implementing regulation, which appears to deviate from earlier transitional rules for early retirement schemes (RVU) placed with insurers from 2006 to 2011, and which reduces payouts to holders of stamrechten on a case-by-case basis. They ask about consultation, a worked example, and whether the rule will be reversed; the minister announces the answers will be delayed beyond three weeks.
I hereby inform you that the written questions from MPs Groot and Vermeij (both PvdA) on the changes to the Wage Tax Implementing Regulation cannot be answered within the three-week period.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) over de wijzigingen in de Uitvoeringsregeling loonbelasting niet binnen een termijn van drie weken kunnen worden beantwoord.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over het wijzigen van de mogelijkheid om dieetkosten af te trekken in het kader van de B

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked why the deductibility of diet costs under the BU-regeling was changed without informing parliament or the CG-Raad, and what the savings, affected groups and income effects are. The government answered that the Nibud diet cost table was revised with new reference diets, that the change was made for accuracy rather than savings, that overall figures and macro effects cannot be quantified, and that the effects on individual incomes and allowances vary by case.
Since there is no insight into which diets are deducted to what extent, the financial consequences cannot be stated at the macro level.
Aangezien er geen inzicht bestaat in welke diëten in welke mate in aftrek worden gebracht, is op macro-niveau niet aan te geven wat hiervan de financiële gevolgen zijn.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over het wijzigen van de mogelijkheid om dieetkosten af te trekken in het kader van de B

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked whether dietary-cost deductions under the BU-regeling were changed without informing Parliament or the CG-Raad, and what the reasons, savings, and effects on affected patients and allowances are. The State Secretary answered that a revised dietary cost table from 2010 uses a healthy diet as reference, that budget was not a motive, and that individual effects vary and were not quantified at macro level.
Since there is no insight into which diets are deducted to what extent, the financial consequences cannot be stated at macro level.
Aangezien er geen inzicht bestaat in welke diëten in welke mate in aftrek worden gebracht, is op macro-niveau niet aan te geven wat hiervan de financiële gevolgen zijn.
Vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Financiën en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over kunstbeurzen (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MPs Van der Werf and Omtzigt asked about the customs guarantee for art fairs such as TEFAF, including whether the guarantee had tripled and whether it had ever been called upon. The government denied any increase in import guarantees, explained the VAT change and customs presence at the fair, and offered consultation with the fair organisers.
Customs is willing to consult with the fair organisation and the forwarders involved to jointly seek a comprehensive solution to this issue for coming years.
De Douane is graag bereid met de beursorganisatie en betrokken expediteurs in overleg te treden, om in gezamenlijkheid een integrale oplossing voor dit vraagstuk voor volgende jaren te zoeken.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over alternatieven voor rittenadministratie (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

The MP asks whether the state secretary understands complaints from smaller firms about keeping mileage logs to avoid a benefit-in-kind charge on private use of company vans, and whether budget-neutral alternatives will be explored. The state secretary says he will examine ways to abolish the mileage-registration requirement for vans, notes existing exemptions, and promises alternative schemes in a forthcoming car letter in June.
I will therefore examine the possibilities for a scheme for delivery vans in which mileage registration is no longer necessary.
Ik zal dan ook de mogelijkheden onderzoeken om te komen tot een regeling voor bestelauto's waarin een rittenregistratie niet langer noodzakelijk is.

Vragen van de leden Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD) en Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het verruimen van de fiscale aftrekbaarheid van pensioenpremie voor zelfstandigen zonder personeel (ZZP’e

MPs asked whether the three-year tax facilitation for voluntary continuation of pension accrual by former employees (including self-employed) should be extended to match the ten years allowed under civil law, in line with SER advice. The state secretary agreed the three-year cut-off is unattractive, said he is willing to extend tax facilitation to ten years from 2012, conditional on parliamentary support for budget cover.
I am willing to extend the tax facilitation of voluntary continuation from 3 to 10 years, so that the option named in the Pensions Act is also tax-facilitated.
Ik ben bereid de fiscale begeleiding van vrijwillige voortzetting te verlengen van 3 naar 10 jaar, zodat de in de Pensioenwet genoemde mogelijkheid ook fiscaal wordt gefaciliteerd.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Van Vliet (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatsecretaris van Financiën over gemeenten die de regels voor het afhandelen van woz-bezwaarschr

PVV MPs Elissen and Van Vliet ask the ministers whether municipalities routinely reject WOZ property-valuation objections without serious review, pressure citizens to withdraw them, and what measures, investigations and statutory deadlines or a positive-silence rule would address this. The government's reply is only a notice that the answers will take longer than the usual three weeks, with no substantive answers yet.
that answering the questions will take more time than usual.
dat de beantwoording van de vragen meer tijd zal vergen dan gebruikelijk.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over fraude met voorlopige teruggaaf (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Finance about fraud with provisional tax refunds (voorlopige teruggaaf), including identity fraud and vulnerable groups, and the scale of losses, pre-checks, and protective measures. The state secretary confirmed the priority, reported about 29,000 investigated and 45,000 total signals worth about EUR 135 million with roughly EUR 45 million paid out wrongly, said pre-checks are partly possible but not automated, and promised a detailed letter with further measures.
Because I want to know how successful the approach to this fraud is, I have instructed the Tax Administration to monitor the recovery of these fraud cases separately.
Omdat ik wil weten in hoeverre de aanpak van deze fraude succesvol is heb ik de Belastingdienst opgedragen de invordering van deze fraudeposten apart te monitoren.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de zoektocht van de fiscus naar zwartspaarders (ingezonden 26 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the tax authority's search for undeclared foreign bank accounts obtained from a French CD-ROM, including how many holders declared their assets, whether voluntary disclosure remains possible, expected revenue, and whether the 2010 SPF rules failed to prevent avoidance. The State Secretary answered that letters will be sent requesting information, the investigation is at an early stage so no conclusions or revenue estimates are possible, penalties apply where declarations were incomplete, and the information was shared free of charge under an EU directive.
The investigation by the Tax Authority is still in its initial phase. Conclusions about the number of taxpayers who did or did not file a correct return cannot therefore be drawn at this time.

Het onderzoek door de Belastingdienst bevindt zich nog in de beginfase. Conclusies over aantallen belastingplichtigen die al dan niet een juiste aangifte hebben gedaan kunnen op dit moment dan ook nog niet worden getrokken.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over belastingontwijkroutes (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

MP Braakhuis (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether tax avoidance routes through Dutch entities could yield more tax, whether such flows create little employment, which companies have been held responsible under CSR, how Dutch flows compare with other OECD states, and whether royalty payments for an old beer brand can be justified as innovation. The reply announced that the answers could not be given within the deadline because further coordination was needed.
The answering of the parliamentary questions requires further coordination.
De beantwoording van de Kamervragen vergt nadere afstemming.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Omtzigt (beiden CDA), Neppérus en Van der Burg (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over informatie over Nederlandse charitatieve instellingen (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

Four MPs from CDA and VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance why Dutch ANBI charity registers show only a place of establishment rather than a website, postal address or contact person, how public disclosure duties compare with England's Charity Commission, and whether the Dutch approach should follow England in the new Geefwet, including making the Tax Service's compliance reports public. The reply to this item is only a postponement notice requesting an extension to 15 March 2011, citing interdepartmental coordination, so no substantive answer is given.
I hereby request that you grant me an extension until 15 March 2011 for answering the parliamentary questions
Hierbij verzoek ik u mij uitstel te verlenen tot 15 maart 2011 voor de beantwoording van de Kamervragen

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over enorme kostenstijgingen voor woonboten (ingezonden 27 januari 2011).

An MP asks ministers why houseboat mooring fees are rising sharply, why houseboats are treated like social rental housing, what tenant protection houseboat residents have, and whether a three-year transition period will be introduced for those objecting. The government replies that the rent review is pending, no irreversible steps will be taken during dialogue with parliament, and only 13 owners have received concrete revision proposals, which will be aligned with the outcome of that dialogue.
No irreversible steps are being taken pending the dialogue with your House.
Er worden geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet hangende de dialoog met uw Kamer.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een herziening van de huur van ligplaatsen van woonboten doo

MPs Jansen and Bashir (SP) asked why the RVOB is departing from CPI indexation for houseboat mooring rents, how the new tariff tiers and 19% VAT are justified, whether tying a phased increase to waiving the right to a binding expert rent ruling is acceptable, and how many boats and how much revenue are affected. The government replied that no irreversible steps have been taken pending dialogue with the House, that 13 owners have received or will receive concrete proposals which will be aligned with that dialogue, and asked for a three-week extension to answer.
No irreversible steps are being taken pending the dialogue with your House.
Er worden geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet hangende de dialoog met uw Kamer.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en De Rouwe (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de prijsverhoging voor een lig

Christian Democratic MPs Omtzigt and De Rouwe asked why the state property agency RVOB announced large rent increases for houseboat mooring places without the protections given to social housing tenants, and whether transitional rights are lost upon objection. The government requested a three-week extension, said no irreversible steps are being taken pending dialogue with parliament, and said RVOB will align any revised rent proposals with that dialogue.
No irreversible steps are being taken pending the dialogue with your House.
Er worden geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet hangende de dialoog met uw Kamer.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de kinderopvangtoeslag (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked why childcare-allowance applicants had to re-enter whole forms after failing to match the national childcare register, and about digital copies, confirmation timelines, reminder letters and real-time register checks. The state secretary defended the matching process, admitted the application program is not user-friendly but cannot be fixed with current software, and committed to a reminder deadline of 28 February 2011 while rejecting a real-time register check as infeasible.
The application program is unfortunately not user-friendly in this respect.
Het aanvraagprogramma is hierin helaas niet gebruikersvriendelijk.
Vragen van het lid Koolmees (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over aftrekbaarheid van boetes (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether it is right that taxpayers partly fund settlements and which fines are tax-deductible, after press reports on the Klimop property fraud case and a Supreme Court ruling on NMa fines. The government answered that fines are not deductible under the income and corporate tax acts, while confiscation of unlawful gains and damages are computed under normal profit rules so taxpayers do not contribute to those parts of transactions.
An amount paid as a fine is not deductible.
Een bedrag dat wordt betaald als boete is niet aftrekbaar.
Vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over fiscale belemmeringen bij het fuseren van pensioenfondsen (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether transfer tax hinders mergers of pension funds, which the Pensioenfederatie says is unjustified given their non-profit nature and unchanged ownership, and whether the government will exempt pension funds as it does associations and cooperatives. The State Secretary answered that the merger exemption does not apply to pension funds organised as foundations, estimated the annual yield at EUR 2 million, and said he will examine broadening the business facilities to be legal-form neutral, to be decided in the coming budget cycle.

Apart from the specific pension fund issue, there is therefore an intention to examine whether the existing business facilities can be made more legal-form neutral and thus opened to other legal persons.

Reeds los van de specifieke pensioenfondsenproblematiek bestaat daarom het voornemen om te bezien of het mogelijk is om de bestaande ondernemingsfaciliteiten meer rechtsvormneutraal te maken en derhalve open te stellen voor andere rechtspersonen.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over doorgifte van het registratienummer van de kinderopvang (ingezonden 18

Two CDA MPs asked why the Tax Administration sent about 114,000 childcare allowance applicants letters requiring them to provide the Dutch childcare register number by 28 January, under threat of losing the allowance, and questioned the short deadline, the burden on parents, and why Parliament was not informed earlier. The State Secretary answered that the letters were a planned step to link the register to the Tax Administration's system, that registration is a legal condition for the allowance, that the 14-day deadline is reasonable, and that the matter had been discussed with the ministry.
This is therefore not a response to an acute, unforeseen problem.
Het gaat hier dus niet om een reactie op een acuut, niet voorzien probleem.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Verburg (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over hoge regeldruk bij de innovatiebox (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the innovation box's regulatory burden is too high for SMEs and how many firms use it, and whether he would ask Actal to reduce administrative costs. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the burden is too high, cited strong SME interest and helpful tax office support, reported about 500 users through 2009, and saw no reason for further steps while monitoring the scheme and planning a 2013 evaluation.
In view of the above, I see no reason to take further steps.
Gezien het bovenstaande zie ik geen aanleiding nadere stappen te ondernemen.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de vrijwilligersvergoeding voor vrijwilligerswerk (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

Member Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance why some tax inspectors accept volunteer compensation waivers as deductible gifts while others reject identical declarations, and whether past returns are being revised. The State Secretary answers that deductibility depends on factual tax conditions, not on an ANBI declaration alone, that the assessment framework was circulated to inspectors in March 2009, and that earlier years may be reassessed within the statute of limitations.
The assessment framework outlined in the answer to questions 4 and 5 was widely circulated to the inspectors in March 2009.
Het beoordelingskader zoals geschetst in het antwoord op de vragen 4 en 5 is in maart 2009 breed bekend gemaakt aan de inspecteurs.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het toeslagensysteem van de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 31 december 2010).

The MP asks the state secretary of Finance about delays in the Tax Administration's VAT refund system, including how many requests were forwarded, which problems were known by 1 May 2010, whether other countries had similar issues, and how much late-payment interest is paid. The state secretary answers that 96 requests were sent in January 2010, 10 were rejected abroad, about 5,000 entrepreneurs will receive late-payment interest with procedures set in January 2011, and the disruption has been resolved.
Preparations are currently underway for the payment of late-payment interest.
Voor betaling van de coulancerente zijn thans de voorbereidingen gaande.

Vragen van de leden Koolmees en Van der Ham (beiden D66) aan de minister van Financiën en de staatsecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de financiële gevolgen van de BTW-verhoging op kunst voor alternatie

MPs Koolmees and Van der Ham asked whether art dealers importing art via the UK to avoid the 2011 VAT increase is legal, and about the revenue loss and competitiveness effects. The government answered that such imports are legal if genuine transactions, that no evasion was factored into revenue estimates, and that the revenue loss cannot yet be quantified, while giving illustrative examples and an EU rate overview.
If supervision by the Tax Authority shows that sham constructions are being used to avoid VAT on imports that actually take place in the Netherlands, these constructions will be tackled.

Indien in het toezicht door de Belastingdienst blijkt dat sprake is van schijnconstructies met het doel te voorkomen dat btw wordt geheven over de invoer die feitelijk in Nederland plaatsvindt, zullen deze constructies worden aangepakt.
Vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over fiscale belemmeringen bij het fuseren van pensioenfondsen (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

Two PvdA MPs ask the State Secretary of Finance whether transfer tax on merging pension funds' real estate portfolios is a financial obstacle to mergers that are socially desirable, and whether pension funds should be exempt like associations and cooperatives. The reply is only a notice that the answers need more time and information, with no substance yet.
To be able to answer the questions, further information is needed that is not immediately available.
Om de vragen te kunnen beantwoorden is nadere informatie nodig die niet direct voorhanden is.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over taxatierapporten bij import van auto’s (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

A parliamentarian asked the state secretary of Finance about fraud and delays in BPM (car import tax) cases involving appraisal reports, including bona fide imports. The secretary answered that appraisals from certified appraisers are normally accepted, that suspicious valuations trigger requests for explanation with a 14-day deadline, and that bona fide declarations are processed quickly, with new documentation requirements planned.

Soon I will explicitly include in the BPM Implementation Regulation the obligation that a declarant who prepared the declaration based on an appraisal report must, if requested, provide a copy of the purchase invoice and proof of payment.

Binnenkort zal ik in de Uitvoeringsregeling BPM expliciet de verplichting opnemen dat een aangever die de aangifte heeft opgesteld op basis van een taxatierapport desgevraagd een kopie van de inkoopfactuur en het betalingsbewijs moet overleggen.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht «Concerns ontwijken Afrikaanse fiscus» (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary of Finance whether Dutch tax rules let multinationals shift profits out of developing countries through royalties and conduit companies, and requests an audit of the Dutch fiscal system as earlier motions asked. The State Secretary replies that Dutch rules are part of an international network, that unilateral Dutch measures would have limited effect and could harm the real economy, and that OECD and G20 initiatives plus capacity building in developing countries are the preferred route.

Vragen van de leden Koolmees en Van der Ham (beiden D66) aan de minister van Financiën en de staatsecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de financiële gevolgen van de BTW-verhoging op kunst voor alternatie

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance Minister and the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the financial effects of the planned VAT increase on art, including whether dealers would route imports via the UK, expected revenue losses, and effects on small dealers and international competitiveness. The government only sent a procedural notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within three weeks because parts require further coordination.
Vragen van de leden Straus en Neppérus (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over megafraude met subsidie kinderoppas (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a newspaper report on large-scale fraud with childcare subsidies, asking about its size, the planned double checks, whether controls would be intensified, and what structural measures and recovery steps were envisaged. The State Secretary answered that millions of euros are likely involved, described the risk-based checks and a doorlichting of rules and implementation, and said all means including forced recovery and prosecution would be used.
Depending on the outcome of this review, it will be examined whether and which further measures should be taken.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomst van deze doorlichting, zal bezien worden of en welke maatregelen verder moeten worden genomen.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over gedwongen ontslagen bij de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Finance Minister about reports that the Tax Administration director-general warned of forced dismissals, the size and cost of any social plan, and whether an independent body such as the Court of Audit should examine if tax collection can be maintained under the budget cuts. The state secretary confirmed the cuts of about EUR 400 million structural by 2015, said no decision on implementation had yet been taken and that an independent study was not appropriate, but promised to inform parliament once clearer.
An independent study into the consequences of the budget cuts for the Tax Administration's performance is therefore not appropriate.
Een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de consequenties van de taakstellingen voor de taakuitoefening van de Belastingdienst is dan ook niet aan de orde.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over het terugbetalen van huurtoeslag in het geval van een papieren inkomen (ingezonden 1 oktober 2010).

MPs Spekman and Monasch asked the Finance Minister whether people repaying housing allowance because of a paper income from a BBZ self-employment benefit should be protected, and whether the law should be changed. The state secretary replied that a BBZ benefit is income, that the rules on retroactive payments will be abolished in line with simplification, and that creating a new exception for BBZ benefits is not opportune.
Simplifying taxes and allowances also has high priority in my policy.
Het vereenvoudigen van belastingen en toeslagen heeft ook hoge prioriteit in mijn beleid.
Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken over het niet doorberekenen van lage marktrentes aan klanten (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

MP Weekers asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether high mortgage margins, a limited competitive market and the passing-on of low market rates were addressed, and how cross-border competition has developed. The minister confirms high Dutch mortgage margins in the NMa quick scan, promises follow-up talks with stakeholders, and says more information on competition will follow after the second NMa study phase.
I do not want to wait until spring and will shortly consult various parties to consider how these signals should be followed up.
Ik wil dan ook niet afwachten tot het voorjaar en zal op korte termijn in overleg treden met verschillende partijen om te bezien hoe er opvolging gegeven moet worden aan deze signalen.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Financiën over tekortschietende fiscale stimulering leerwerkbedrijven bij kleine ondernemingen (ingezonden 27 oktober 20

An MP asked whether the Wet Afdrachtvermindering Onderwijs unintentionally excludes small firms and self-employed people without staff, and whether the government will act on the Hoofdbedrijfschap Ambachten advice. The state secretary answered that the exclusion is an inherent, expected consequence of a tax instrument under the 'no taxes no gains' principle, that no change is currently warranted, and that the advice's alternatives would raise costs and create inequality.
As long as it is a fiscal instrument there is no reason to now revisit the choice made and the consequences attached to it.
Zolang er sprake is van een fiscaal instrument is er geen aanleiding om thans op de gemaakte keuze en de daaraan verbonden consequenties terug te komen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over constructies waarbij bedrijven zoals Google via Nederland massaal belasting ontwijken (ingezonden 26 oktober 2010).

The MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about profit-shifting structures (Google via Ireland, the Netherlands and Bermuda) that reportedly lower effective tax to 2.4%, whether a special 0.2% arrangement exists, and whether the US has asked for changes. The minister refuses to discuss individual taxpayers citing confidentiality, defends the Dutch system as a financial hub, denies a fixed 0.2% policy, says the US never asked for changes, and points to treaty anti-abuse clauses and information exchange without committing to new action.
First, I would note that because of the duty of confidentiality it is not possible to go into the tax position of individual taxpayers.
Allereerst wil ik opmerken dat het vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht niet mogelijk is om in te gaan op de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Vragen van de leden Smeets en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Financiën over de problemen tussen de belastingdienst en ZZP-ers (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

MPs Smeets and Groot asked ministers about conflicts between the Tax Authority and self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including alleged witch-hunts, how many VAR certificates are refused or revoked, and whether postal deliverers hold VARs. The state secretary denied any witch-hunt, stated that no data exist on zzp'ers with problems, gave VAR statistics for 2009, and declined to provide breakdowns by sector or by postal operator.
No, there is certainly no question of a witch-hunt by the tax authorities.
Nee, van een heksenjacht van de fiscus is zeker geen sprake.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over het terugbetalen van huurtoeslag in het geval van een papieren inkomen (ingezonden 1 oktober 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Finance whether rent allowance (huurtoeslag) recipients who must repay it because of a 'paper income' such as a Bbz benefit, which is not real income, should be exempted, as is possible for back-payments, and whether the law should be amended. The reply is only an interim notice that the answers will take longer than three weeks.
I hereby inform you that answering will take longer than three weeks.
Hierbij laat ik u weten dat de beantwoording langer duurt dan drie weken.
Vragen van het lid Koolmees (D66) aan de minister van Financiën over de rentebetaling bij belastingen (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

MP Koolmees asks the Finance Minister whether the cabinet plans to cut the interest the state pays on tax refunds to 1% while taxpayers keep paying 2.5%, and whether the government should pay the same rate. The state secretary confirms the 1.5-point differential is a Coalition Agreement measure meant to discourage using the tax authority as a savings account, and says the rate design will be discussed when the bill is submitted, but rejects equal rates as unnecessary.
I am happy to exchange views with your House, when the bill to be submitted is discussed, on the interest scheme then before it.
Ik ben graag bereid bij de behandeling van het nog in te dienen wetsvoorstel nader met uw Kamer van gedachten te wisselen over de dan voorliggende renteregeling.

Vragen van de leden Smeets en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over de aangekondigde bezuinigingsmaatregelen bij de Belastingdienst in Limburg (ingezonden 23 sept

MPs Smeets and Groot asked why 162.3 fte in Limburg's tax region were declared surplus, why motions on regional employment and the allocation of cuts were not followed, and how the works council was involved. The state secretary replied that 109 fte surplus in Limburg is handled through voluntary mobility like other regions, that regional employment is not the main criterion for office location, and that the works council was informed and approved the steps.
We will inform your House once there is clarity on this.
Wij zullen uw Kamer informeren als hierover duidelijkheid is.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de tijdelijke maatregelen voor de woningmarkt (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

Labour MPs Monasch and Groot asked whether the temporary VAT cut on renovation labour costs will be passed on to consumers, and about its effectiveness, architects' exclusion, woonboten/woonwagens exclusion, funding from the EIA underspend, the NHG increase and bank lending. The state secretary answered that government cannot guarantee pass-through but obtained commitments from industry bodies, explained the scope limits under EU VAT rules, and promised an EIB evaluation in 2011.
I am not in favour of that.
Ik ben daar geen voorstander van.

m: Motie van het lid Flach c.s. over het Presidium vragen om de Koning verantwoordelijk te maken voor het aanwijzen van personen om een opdracht uit te voeren tijdens de kabinetsformatie
Asks the Presidium to propose a Reglement van Orde change making the King responsible for appointing formateurs during cabinet formation.
requests the Presidium to bring forward an amendment to the Standing Orders making the King responsible for appointing persons to carry out an assignment during cabinet formation

verzoekt het presidium een wijziging van het Reglement van Orde aanhangig te maken die ertoe leidt dat de Koning verantwoordelijk is voor het aanwijzen van personen om een opdracht uit te voeren tijdens de kabinetsformatie
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tijs van den Brink, Boswijk en Zwinkels over het bericht 'Trollenlegers uit buitenland versterkten politieke en opruiende berichten rond verkiezingen'

CDA MPs asked the government about a RTL Nieuws report that foreign fake accounts (from Nigeria, Ghana and elsewhere, possibly linked to Russia) influenced debate around the Dutch Tweede Kamer election, and what measures will prevent this. The minister answers that the impact was limited, that the government is in talks with platforms and the EU, that FIMI detection capacity is being developed with a report after the summer recess, but that it cannot discuss individual cases or confirm Russian involvement publicly.
In public I cannot go into individual cases.
In het openbaar kan ik niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.

qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van den Brink over het bericht dat Europese voetbalclubs sinds het uitbreken van de oorlog in Oekraïne zo’n 40 miljoen euro aan transfer– en huursommen aan hun Russische tegenha

MPs Boswijk and Van den Brink asked whether European football clubs should be barred from paying transfer and loan fees to Russian clubs since the war in Ukraine, and what the government is doing about it. The minister replied that such transactions are not banned under current sanctions, clubs must screen ownership, and the government will not disclose future sanction plans.
The cabinet does not provide information on possible future sanction measures, as this would undermine the effectiveness of the sanctions instrument.
Het kabinet verstrekt geen informatie over mogelijke toekomstige sanctiemaatregelen, daar het de effectiviteit van het sanctie-instrument ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Boswijk en Ceder over het rapport Vrijheid van Godsdienst Wereldwijd 2023 van Kerk in Nood

MPs Van der Staaij, Boswijk and Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about Kerk in Nood's 2023 religious freedom report, covering persecution of religious minorities, impunity, Nigeria, ICC follow-up, Sahel spread, India, Nicaragua, child marriage and Western cancel culture.
