The minister acknowledged the concerns, described diplomatic and programmatic responses, and noted that formal ICC investigation depends on the prosecutor's judgment, while declining to interfere with his prosecutorial policy.
The cabinet respects the independence of the Court and therefore refrains from interfering in the prosecution policy of the Court's prosecutor.
Zoals bekend, respecteert het kabinet de onafhankelijkheid van het Strafhof en om die reden onthoudt het kabinet zich van inmenging in het vervolgingsbeleid van de aanklager van het Strafhof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Hammelburg en Van der Lee  over het bericht dat het moederbedrijf van Douwe Egberts en Pickwick, JDE Peet's, weigert om zich terug te trekken uit Rusland

MPs Boswijk, Hammelburg and Van der Lee asked whether JDE Peet's, parent of Douwe Egberts and Pickwick, should exit Russia, whether government contracts with such firms are acceptable, and whether the Russia sanctions package should ban non-essential goods. The minister answered that firms may trade in Russia if they comply with EU sanctions, that existing government contracts will not be ended while compliance holds, that a list of firms with government contracts will be sent confidentially, and that the luxury goods list may be broadened without disclosing future measures.
This overview will be sent to the House for confidential inspection.
Dit overzicht wordt ter vertrouwelijke inzage aan de Kamer nagezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het artikel in Politico waarin er wordt bericht dat de civiele EU-missie aan de grens tussen Azerbeidzjan en Armenië onder vuur zou zijn genomen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Politico report that an EU civilian monitoring mission on the Armenia-Azerbaijan border came under fire, and about the risk to monitors, Azerbaijan's conduct, the Lachin corridor blockade and EU-led peace talks. The minister answered that the shooter could not be identified, outlined mitigation measures, condemned Azerbaijan's escalation and said the EU is engaged diplomatically.
EUMA could not determine who fired at the time or what the exact target was, because the distance from the shots to the monitors present was too great.
EUMA kon niet vaststellen door wie er destijds geschoten is en wat het exacte doelwit was, omdat de afstand van de schoten tot de aanwezige waarnemers te groot was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over een Nederlander die vast zit in Spanje vanwege een ongegronde plaatsing op een lijst

An MP from DENK asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about a Dutch citizen detained in Spain on a terrorism-related listing that Dutch authorities said did not stem from any Dutch suspicion, asking why Spain held this information, how data sharing and signalling work, and what consular help was given. The ministers declined to discuss the individual case in detail, citing ongoing proceedings, privacy rules and Spain's sovereignty, stated that the man was not suspected or signalled in the Netherlands, described consular support and contacts with Spanish authorities, and noted he has since been expelled and returned to the Netherlands.
The case of the person concerned is currently before the court.
De zaak van betrokkene is op dit moment onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de rol van meesterdiplomaat Frans Timmermans bij de vrijlating Venezolaanse drugsbaron Hugo Carvajal

A Groep Van Haga MP asked whether the then foreign minister Timmermans' 2014 release of Venezuelan Hugo Carvajal in Aruba, criticised by US and Aruban officials, would be investigated and why it was ordered. The minister answered that the matter had been explained in detail to parliament in 2014, that Carvajal was entitled to consular immunity under the Vienna Convention, and that justice in Aruba is autonomous.
The matter, including the role of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, was explained in detail in 2014 through answers to parliamentary questions.
De kwestie is, inclusief de rol van de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken, in 2014 uitvoerig toegelicht aan de hand van antwoorden op Kamervragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Fritsma over de Nederlandse inzet bij Operation Inherent Resolve in Irak

PVV MPs De Roon and Fritsma asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the Dutch contribution to Operation Inherent Resolve in Iraq, citing a US inspector general report on limited progress in training Iraqi and Kurdish forces, and whether Dutch advisers should be withdrawn. The ministers answered that progress is incremental and security sector reform is slow, that Iraqi authorities still need the international presence, and that Dutch troops should not be withdrawn.
The cabinet considers a more stable and secure Iraq to be of undiminished strategic importance to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet acht een stabieler en veiliger Irak van onverminderd strategisch belang voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Gündoğan en Brekelmans over het bericht 'België verbiedt aankoop van Chinese röntgencamera’s voor de douane, Nederland (nog) niet'

MPs Rajkowski, Gündoğan and Brekelmans asked whether Dutch customs should stop using Chinese Nuctech scanners after Belgium's Council of State upheld exclusion of Nuctech from a tender, and whether this and EU and intelligence warnings should prompt a rethink. The state secretary answered that about 70 of roughly 100 customs scanners are Nuctech, that national security is not currently endangered under a TNO study, that procurement law limits exclusion of EU suppliers, and that stricter security requirements, a supplier-diversification effort and further research are underway.

The first part of the study indicated that national security is currently not endangered if the confidentiality, integrity or availability of the customs scan and detection processes is not compromised.

In het eerste deel van het onderzoek is aangegeven dat de nationale veiligheid op dit moment niet in gevaar komt als de vertrouwelijkheid, integriteit of beschikbaarheid van scan- en detectieprocessen van de Douane worden aangetast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de haatactie van Pegida in Den Haag

An MP asked ministers whether they condemn Pegida's planned Koran-burning action in The Hague, whether they would press the mayor to ban it, and how it affects relations with Turkey. The government called the act provocative but said freedom of expression is a fundamental right, that the mayor is responsible for demonstrations under the Wom, and that Turkey was raised in bilateral talks.
The Public Demonstrations Act (Wom) places responsibility for facilitating demonstrations with local authorities.
De Wet openbare manifestaties (Wom) legt de verantwoordelijkheid voor het faciliteren van demonstraties bij het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het rapport van Human Rights Watch over mensenrechtenschendingen door de Saoedische grenswacht

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Human Rights Watch reports of Saudi border guards killing Ethiopian migrants, and whether it would launch international investigation or impose economic sanctions. The minister said the government raised the findings bilaterally with Saudi Arabia, supports the Saudi-announced investigation, and will keep pressing for it without committing to sanctions or a leading role in international inquiry.
The Netherlands raised this in bilateral contacts with Saudi Arabia following this report.
Nederland heeft dit naar aanleiding van dit rapport in bilaterale contacten met Saoedi-Arabië geuit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gebrekkige betrokkenheid bij de sanctiehandhaving

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the ministry failed to participate in sanctions enforcement talks after the invasion of Ukraine and whether oligarch assets were missed, and questioned the implementation of the Blok report recommendations. The minister denied the ministry was absent, said sanctions meetings were attended with delegations chosen per topic, reported that most of the 19 recommendations were realised with the rest pending legislative modernisation, and stated that coordination does not transfer responsibility from lead ministries.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over de vernieling van kerken in Pakistan

Members Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked the government about the destruction of over twenty churches in Jaranwala, Pakistan, the failure of local police to protect Christians, and possible Dutch and EU action. The minister acknowledged serious concern, noted that Pakistan has arrested over 130 people and set up an inquiry, and described existing Dutch and EU support including humanitarian aid and human rights engagement, without committing to new diplomatic steps.
The cabinet therefore currently sees no need to also request clarification from the Pakistani authorities, but will closely follow the outcomes and follow-up of the investigation.
Het kabinet ziet daarom vooralsnog geen noodzaak om ook opheldering te vragen aan de Pakistaanse autoriteiten maar zal de uitkomsten en de opvolging van het onderzoek nauw volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Nederlandse positie ten aanzien van de SLAPP-richtlijn

MP Sjoerdsma asks why the Netherlands supports keeping domestic SLAPPs outside the EU directive, why the directive's protection is weaker than the Commission recommendation, and whether the narrow early-dismissal mechanism and the omission of a damages provision weaken protection for journalists. Minister Weerwind replies that Dutch procedural law already offers remedies against abusive suits, that the Council position improves early dismissal, and that a general liability regime makes a specific damages provision unnecessary.

For the situation in the Netherlands, the cabinet is of the view that Dutch procedural law provides sufficient safeguards to protect journalists and human rights defenders against SLAPPs at national level.

Voor de situatie in Nederland is het kabinet van mening dat het Nederlandse procesrecht voldoende waarborgen biedt ter bescherming van journalisten en mensenrechtenverdedigers tegen SLAPPs op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de levering van clustermunitie door de Verenigde Staten aan Oekraïne

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands, as a signatory to the Convention on Cluster Munitions, condemns the US supply of cluster munitions to Ukraine. The government confirmed the treaty is binding on the Netherlands and said it does not endorse Ukraine's use of cluster munitions while stressing Ukraine's right to self-defence, and that it discourages any use or transfer of such munitions.
Without approving Ukraine's use of cluster munitions, the cabinet emphasises that Ukraine is defending itself against ongoing Russian aggression, in line with Article 51 of the UN Charter.

Zonder de Oekraïense inzet van clustermunitie goed te keuren, hecht het kabinet eraan te benadrukken dat Oekraïne zich verdedigt tegen de voortdurende Russische agressie, in lijn met artikel 51 van het VN-Handvest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Piri en Van der Lee over de levering van F-16’s aan Oekraïne

Three MPs asked the government about the timeline, conditions, pilot training and number of F-16 aircraft to be delivered to Ukraine. The Minister of Defence answered that delivery depends on completed training, infrastructure, coalition coordination and US approval, that the Netherlands expects to make 12 to 18 aircraft available for a training centre in Romania, and that the exact numbers are not yet fixed.
Your House will be informed in due course about the envisaged delivery timeline.
Uw Kamer wordt op termijn nader geïnformeerd over het beoogde tijdpad van levering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over clustermunitie

An SP MP asks the foreign minister whether the Netherlands attends the 2023 Cluster Munitions Convention meeting, whether it will condemn cluster munition use by all parties including Russia and Ukraine, and whether it will condemn supplies of cluster munitions to Ukraine by Turkey and the US. The minister says the Netherlands discourages all cluster munition use, places Ukraine's use in the context of Russian aggression, and states that non-parties are not bound by the convention's ban.
The Netherlands discouraged any use of cluster munitions in its opening statement.
Nederland heeft in de openingsverklaring ieder gebruik van clustermunitie ontmoedigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Fritsma over de gebrekkige digitalisering van de Duitse landmacht en de gevolgen daarvan voor de samenwerking met Nederland

PVV MPs De Roon and Fritsma asked the Defence Minister about digital interoperability problems in the German army, whether Dutch capabilities must be downgraded to cooperate, and whether Germany is being pressed on its NATO spending pledges. The minister denied any downgrading, said modernisation programmes are ongoing on both sides, and stressed that cooperation strengthens the Dutch armed forces.
No, the development and operation of the Dutch army is not hindered by the organisation of the German army.
Nee, de ontwikkeling en het opereren van de Nederlandse landmacht wordt niet gehinderd door de inrichting van de Duitse landmacht.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Ceder over het gebruik van digitale technologie voor de repressie van religieuze minderheden en andersdenkenden in China en andere landen

MP Ceder asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands can keep raising China's human rights situation, why no export licences for cybersurveillance technology were granted in 2022, how the EU dual-use ad hoc licensing power is being implemented, how due diligence and forced-labour rules will be enforced, and about the latest on repression of Uyghurs and Christians. The minister answered that China concerns are raised bilaterally and multilaterally, that no such licences were requested in 2022, that the EU guidelines and national framework are delayed but in progress, that the Netherlands does not supervise due diligence until EU legislation applies, and that the situation remains very worrying.
Until that legislation is in force, the cabinet does not supervise the application of due diligence by companies.
Totdat die wetgeving van kracht is houdt het kabinet geen toezicht op de toepassing van gepaste zorgvuldigheid door bedrijven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk, Boswijk, Ceder, Belhaj, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Sylvana Simons, Dassen en Christine Teunissen over de evacuatie van lokale oud-medewerkers van de Nederlands

MPs from many parties asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the evacuation and resettlement of local former Afghan Security Guards and other local staff, including whether guards were excluded and why EUPOL staff were refused. The government answered that individual requests are assessed under the 2014 interpreter arrangement and special scheme, that criteria were not tightened, and that the resettlement project was folded into the ministries' standing organisations while the remaining group of about 100 people is still being pursued.
Defence aims to take current insights into account in implementing policy and will therefore examine these signals further.
Defensie streeft ernaar actuele inzichten te betrekken bij de uitvoering van beleid en zal deze signalen derhalve nader onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Valstar over het artikel ''You don’t survive that': Ukraine sappers dice with death to clear Russian mines'

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Ukrainian demining needs, Dutch deliveries of mine-clearance systems, and funding for cheap local demining innovation. The government answered that it supplies demining capabilities in line with Ukraine's requests, supports local production and humanitarian demining, and that EU instruments are not open to Ukrainian participation.
The cabinet gives as much as possible effect to Ukrainian requests for the delivery of (additional) mine-clearing systems, in line with the Brekelmans and Sjoerdsma motion.
Het kabinet geeft zo veel mogelijk gehoor aan de Oekraïense verzoeken tot de levering van (aanvullende) mijnruimsystemen, in lijn met motie Brekelmans en Sjoerdsma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Draft EU plans to allow spying on journalists are dangerous, warn critics'

MP Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether the Council's draft European Media Freedom Act, which would allow member states to deploy spyware against journalists, is acceptable, and why the Netherlands sought carve-outs for law enforcement and intelligence services. The government answered that the draft introduces the first EU-level safeguards against unlawful spyware use against journalists, that the Netherlands opposes unlawful use and does not support surveillance of journalists or their sources, and that it had supported the compromise text and will not change its position.

The current version of the proposal contains, for the first time at Union level, safeguards on the use of intrusion software by governments in relation to journalists to protect media freedom in all member states.

De huidige versie van het voorstel bevat, voor het eerst op Unieniveau, waarborgen omtrent het gebruik van binnendringingssoftware door overheden in verhouding tot journalisten ten behoeve van het beschermen van mediavrijheid in alle lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat illegaal teakhout uit Myanmar gebruikt is bij de renovatie van de Groene Draeck

An MP asked whether illegal Myanmar teak was used in the publicly co-funded renovation of the royal yacht Groene Draeck, whether its origin can be verified, and whether an independent investigation will be held. The Prime Minister replied that the renovation is a matter for the Royal Household, that the wood was bought from a German supplier within the EU with a due diligence declaration, that its origin cannot be traced because records were discarded, and that no independent investigation is warranted.
The public interest is not at stake, and I therefore see no reason for an investigation.
Het openbaar belang is niet aan de orde, en ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding voor onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Brekelmans over het artikel ‘Internationale boksbond gaat olympische status verliezen om Russische invloeden’

MPs Heerema and Brekelmans asked the ministers about the IOC withdrawing recognition of the boxing body IBA over Russian influence, and whether the Netherlands should back World Boxing and cut ties with the IBA. The minister agreed on excluding Russian athletes, officials and trainers, supported the IOC decision, but said it is not yet clear whether World Boxing will gain Olympic recognition and only committed to keeping in contact with NOC*NSF.
It is currently not yet clear whether World Boxing already has prospects of Olympic recognition; that is a matter for the IOC.
Het is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk of World Boxing al zicht heeft op de Olympische erkenning, daar gaat het IOC over.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door het lid Ceder over de voortdurende blokkade van de Lachin-doorgang naar Nagorno-Karabach

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Azerbaijan's checkpoint and blockade of the Lachin corridor to Nagorno-Karabakh, contrary to the ICJ ruling, and what the Netherlands will do about it, including genocide prevention, UN fact-finding, prisoner repatriation and EU pressure. The minister acknowledges the checkpoint, says the Netherlands urges Azerbaijan to comply and supports EU mediation, but offers no new concrete measures, declines to share any independent investigation outcome, and refuses to disclose content of internal EU Foreign Affairs Council discussions.
Exchanges within the Council are confidential, therefore no further comment can be given on this.
Uitwisselingen binnen de Raad zijn vertrouwelijk, derhalve kan hier niet verder op worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kroger en Piri over de berichtgeving rondom de Tunesië-deal

MPs Kroger and Piri asked about the formal status, accountability and human rights safeguards of the EU-Tunisia memorandum of understanding on migration and partnership. The government answered that the MoU is a non-binding political commitment agreed by the European Commission, with no formal role for the European Parliament, and that existing human rights obligations are unchanged, while committing to press Tunisia on rights and to keep the House informed on implementation and funding.
There is no formal role for the European Parliament in the drafting of MoUs.
Er is geen formele rol van het Europees parlement bij de totstandkoming van MoU’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de aanstaande verkiezing van een nieuw onafhankelijk VN-expert op het gebied van seksuele oriëntatie en genderidentiteit

An MP asked the government whether it would back a successor to the UN independent expert on sexual orientation and gender identity, and what criteria should apply to the selection. The minister agreed the mandate is important, described the transparent selection process run by OHCHR and the Human Rights Council, and noted the three shortlisted candidates and the proposed appointment of Graeme Reid, without committing to specific Dutch support beyond the existing mandate.
The process for appointing Victor Madrigal-Borloz's successor is organised independently and transparently.
Het proces rondom de benoeming van de opvolger van Victor Madrigal-Borloz is onafhankelijk en transparant georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het artikel 'Ik dacht: ze gaan ons vermoorden. Ze gaan alle zwarte mensen in Tunesië vermoorden'

An MP asks the ministers whether they are aware of reports that Tunisian authorities expelled Black migrants without food, water or phones into the desert near the Libyan border, whether this breaches the EU-Tunisia MoU and human rights law, and what steps will be taken. The government says it is aware of worrying reports but that it is unclear what exactly happened, notes the MoU is not legally binding, and says it will keep raising migration management and human rights with Tunisia through EU and bilateral channels.
Based on the information known to the cabinet, it is unclear exactly what happened.
Op basis van de bij het kabinet bekende informatie is onduidelijk wat er precies is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over urgente waarschuwing door voormalig hoofdaanklager van het Internationaal Strafhof over zeer nijpende situatie in Nagorno-Karabach

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a warning by former ICC prosecutor Ocampo on the dire situation of Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh and what the government would do. The minister acknowledged the report and serious humanitarian concern, said genocide recognition requires authoritative findings that are currently absent, and described EU mediation and calls on Azerbaijan, while stating the ICC lacks jurisdiction and referral by the UN Security Council is unlikely.
The Netherlands is closely following the situation together with European partners and is considering, within the European framework, how further contributions to stability in the region can be made.
Nederland volgt de situatie samen met Europese partners nauwlettend en bekijkt in Europees verband hoe verder kan worden bijgedragen aan stabiliteit in de regio.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat huurlingen voor het front op de loonlijst staan van Russische bedrijven waartegen nog geen sancties zijn ingesteld

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister whether Russian firms (Rusal, Novatek, PIK Group) that pay mercenaries should be sanctioned, whether the EU should extend sanctions to more sectors, and whether the Wagner group should be listed as a terrorist organisation. The minister answered that sanctions discussions are ongoing in the EU, declined to comment on specific persons or entities, noted existing Wagner sanctions, and explained that terrorism listing requires conditions not currently met.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch position in these negotiations to make public statements about specific persons and entities.
Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse inzet in deze onderhandelingen om publiekelijk uitspraken te doen over specifieke personen en entiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Russische bedrijven die de oorlog financieren en tevens actief zijn in Europa

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister why Russian companies allegedly financing the war in Ukraine, including Novatek, Rusal and Pik Group, are not under EU sanctions, whether Dutch subsidiaries should be confiscated, and why such firms can still do business in Europe. The minister answered that these companies are not currently on EU sanctions lists, declined to comment on specific cases, said all options remain open, and explained that confiscation is only possible through a criminal conviction decided by a judge.
The cabinet cannot go into casuistry regarding specific companies.
Het kabinet kan verder niet ingaan op casuïstiek aangaande specifieke bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over religie en buitenlands beleid

Lawmaker Ceder asked the Foreign and Justice ministers how the 2018 recommendations on religion and foreign policy were implemented, what role religion plays in peacebuilding in six countries, whether freedom of religion will be raised in bilateral dialogue, and how IND staff religious literacy is ensured. The minister replied that implementation is progressing (strategy days, training, a special envoy), outlined a JISRA programme in the named countries, committed to raising freedom of religion in bilateral contacts, and described IND training improvements.
Yes. Freedom of religion and belief is one of the priorities of the Netherlands' foreign human rights policy and is always raised where necessary
Ja. Vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging is een van de prioriteiten in het buitenlands mensenrechtenbeleid van Nederland en wordt waar nodig altijd te berde gebracht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanpak van Russische oligarchen in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers why Russian oligarchs' Dutch assets, including VS Energy's operations, remain active and unconfiscated despite sanctions, and what the government is doing about confiscation and Ukrainian legal assistance requests. The minister replied that individual cases cannot be discussed, that confiscation is possible only through criminal-law titles, that legal assistance requests are assessed under treaties, and that Parliament will be updated after the summer.
The cabinet cannot go into individual case matters.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de veroordeling tot 3 jaar cel van oud-premier Imran Khan van Pakistan

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister about the three-year prison sentence of former Pakistani PM Imran Khan, whether the trials were politically motivated, the crackdown on protesters and party members, and whether the Netherlands would speak out internationally. The minister said the government has no view on Khan's claims, raised concerns about arrests and rule of law in EU and bilateral talks, but stated it does not intervene in other countries' court proceedings.
However, the Netherlands does not intervene in the course of justice in other countries.
Nederland intervenieert echter niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de totstandkoming van de kritische depositiewaarden en de rol van het Coordination Center for Effects

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers about the origins of Dutch critical deposition values, the role and legal status of the UNECE Coordination Center for Effects (CCE), its financing and relation to RIVM, and the TFIAM chair and protocol obligations. Minister van der Wal-Zeggelink answered at length that CCE advice is non-binding, that Dutch values derive partly from CCE work, and that the Netherlands took on the CCE and TFIAM roles in 1990 as part of international cooperation, with the answers largely restating historical policy and referring to UNECE documentation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over ruimhartige subsidie voor gedetineerdenbegeleiding in het buitenland

MPs Van der Staaij and Sjoerdsma asked whether the two-year extension of subsidies for detainee support abroad, on unchanged terms, honours the November 2022 motion on continuity and generosity, and whether financial pressure on foundations and consular staff was considered. The minister answers that the extension follows the motion's continuity request, that an evaluation will precede a revised framework from 2026, that the legal support is supplementary to local counsel, and that organisations may index budgets up to 5% per year.
Any policy changes arising from the evaluation I will send to your House in writing before 1 January 2026.
Eventuele beleidswijzigingen volgend uit de evaluatie zal ik vóór 1 januari 2026 aan uw Kamer schriftelijk doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over recente gebeurtenissen in Jenin

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli military raid on the Jenin refugee camp, Palestinian refugee return, UNRWA funding, Elbit and military cooperation, and whether Nederland's statements of concern have any real effect. The minister expressed concern, declined to endorse sanctions, and largely restated established policy, while saying the Netherlands does not prefer impunity over enforcing international law.
The cabinet has no insight into the equipment Israel deploys in military operations.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op het materieel dat door Israël wordt ingezet bij militaire operaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het migratiepakket

An MP asks the state secretary of Justice and Security for a list of migration measures considered during failed coalition talks, of measures the four parties could agree on, and of measures the demissionary cabinet plans to implement, and whether a package can still be agreed. The government answers that no list of agreed measures exists, that the demissionary cabinet is exercising restraint so no list can be given, and that agreement on a package is not expected, while pointing to earlier letters containing internal documents.
Anticipating that, it is not possible to provide a list of measures or to give a precise date.
Vooruitlopend daarop is het niet mogelijk een lijst van maatregelen te bieden of een precieze datum aan te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, De Roon, Klink, Eppink en Omtzigt over de bescherming van mensen die met de dood bedreigd worden door wetten tegen geloofsafvalligheid en godslastering

MPs asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands is doing to press states that retain the death penalty for apostasy and blasphemy, including via UN resolutions, UPR reviews, and an international campaign, and how it protects people threatened in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and in UN fora, made statements and visits, supports a moratorium in principle, and cited Dutch criminal law and support for ex-believers, but gave no concrete new commitments.
The Netherlands is against the death penalty in all cases and under all circumstances and therefore gives extensive attention to these resolutions and parliamentary motions.
Nederland is tegen de doodstraf in alle gevallen en onder alle omstandigheden en geeft daarom uitgebreid aandacht aan deze resoluties en Kamermoties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over een inval van Albanese politie in een Iraans vluchtelingenkamp in Albanië

Member Eppink (JA21) asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns the Albanian police raid on the Iranian PMOI refugee camp, whether human rights were violated, and whether EU funds, sanctions or EU action should follow. Minister Hoekstra answered that the government has no information that human rights were violated, sees no reason to block EU funds or impose sanctions, and expects Albanian authorities to respect human rights.
The cabinet has no information that this did not happen during this raid.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie dat dat bij deze inval niet is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Podt over financiering van grensbewakingsprojecten in Soedan

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers whether EU border-control funding in Sudan indirectly benefited the RSF militia, why projects ended only in 2019-2020, and what lessons apply to future projects. The minister denied that EU funds or equipment went to the RSF or army, said safeguards and monitoring existed, and committed to no new action beyond raising risks in Brussels.
The EU, however, provided no financial support for that security training either in 2017 or in the years after.
De EU heeft echter noch in 2017 noch in de jaren daarna financiële steun gegeven aan genoemde veiligheidstraining.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de stijging van het aantal afwijzingen van visumaanvragen van Surinamers en het bericht dat de Minister op het matje is geroepen over het gebruik van algoritmen in visum

MP Sylvana Simons asked the Foreign Minister about the sharp rise in refused Surinamese visa applications, the role of VFS Global and the IOB profiling algorithm, and privacy concerns. The minister answered that refusals mostly reflect incomplete applications, that profiling never uses age, nationality and sex alone, and that the data protection authority review is ongoing.
The outcome of the exchange with the AP will be communicated to the House in a letter, which will also give a further illustration of the IOB working method.
Over de uitkomsten van de uitwisseling met de AP zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd in een brief, waarbij ook een nadere illustratie van de IOB werkwijze zal worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over laten doen van onderzoek door externe bureaus, denktanks of lobbyclubs

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about commissioning research from think tanks such as HCSS and Clingendael, including transparency about clients, framework contracts worth about 800,000 euro per year, and whether a mandatory transparency register should be introduced. The ministers answered that their think-tank research is independent and publicly disclosed, that the framework contract is publicly available, and that a mandatory register is not necessary given existing transparency law, while noting a planned evaluation of transparency measures.
Dat is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de eenzijdige agenda van de VN-onderzoekscommissie (COI) inzake Israël en de Palestijnse gebieden

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked whether the government still considers the UN Human Rights Council Commission of Inquiry on Israel and the Palestinian territories to have an overly broad, open-ended mandate, whether it will join a US critical statement, and what it has done against disproportionate attention to Israel in UN bodies. The minister answered that the government holds these objections, raised them in a national statement calling for periodic review of the mandate, chose its own statement over a joint US one, and pursues balanced resolutions and fewer reporting obligations in EU coordination.
The cabinet is of the view that the mandate of the Commission of Inquiry (CoI) is formulated too broadly and that it is undesirable that the commission has been established for an indefinite period.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het mandaat van de Commission of Inquiry (CoI) te breed is geformuleerd en dat het onwenselijk is dat de commissie voor onbepaalde tijd is ingesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het artikel 'Naar Nederland verhuizen helpt organisaties niet altijd om aan hun eigen overheid te ontkomen', dat gaat over zorgelijke ontwikkelingen in de Albanese rechts

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report that Albanian organisations relocate to the Netherlands to escape state interference, including the closure of Turkish-linked schools allegedly under Turkish pressure and concerns about judicial independence in Albania. The minister answered that the embassy monitors the school closure and the court case, that Albania's judicial reform is progressing but political influence remains a challenge, and that EU accession will proceed only when conditions are met.
The cabinet will continue to closely monitor developments within the Albanian judiciary and the measures taken by the Albanian authorities in this regard.
Het kabinet blijft de ontwikkelingen binnen de Albanese rechtspraak, en de maatregelen die door de Albanese autoriteiten worden genomen in dit verband, nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de Israëlische wetswijziging voor het vergemakkelijken van het vestigen van nederzettingen in bezette gebieden

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns Israel's amendment easing settlement approval in occupied territories, supports a two-state solution, opposes BDS-type policy, backs an ICC investigation and joins the West Bank Protection Consortium. The minister condemned the change publicly, reaffirmed Dutch opposition to settlements while rejecting BDS, and said joining the consortium is being examined.
The possibilities of joining the West Bank Protection Consortium are currently being examined.
De mogelijkheden om toe te treden tot het Westbank Protection Consortium worden op dit moment onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Israël maakt bouw van illegale nederzettingen een stuk gemakkelijker'

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Foreign Minister about Israel's move to ease the approval process for settlement construction in the occupied West Bank, and what the Netherlands will do about it, including EU action and an independent review of Dutch discouragement policy toward companies. The minister condemns the change, says the Netherlands and EU have voiced opposition and will keep supporting a two-state solution, but declines an independent review, saying Dutch firms are already informed of the discouragement policy.
On behalf of the cabinet, I have publicly expressed my concerns about this development.
Ik heb namens het kabinet publiekelijk mijn zorgen geuit over deze ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het definitief invoeren van de anti-LHBTIQ+ wet in Oeganda

An MP asked whether the government would impose targeted sanctions and visa bans on Ugandan politicians responsible for the anti-LGBTIQ+ law, halt trade-promotion instruments with Uganda, and ensure do-no-harm and backlash risks are weighed, plus the status of Equal Rights Coalition action. The minister answered that national sanctions are not possible without an EU or UN basis and the matter is under discussion in Brussels, that trade instruments will not be stopped, that backlash risks are weighed, and that the coalition sent a letter and joint statement.
The Netherlands cannot impose national sanctions in this matter.
Nederland kan geen nationale sancties instellen in dezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Klink over het bericht 'Eindhovense toeleverancier van Philips en ASML opent vestiging in China'

Two VVD MPs asked whether a Dutch chip-supplier opening a plant in China could evade US restrictions, whether export controls, EU Chips Act goals, IP protection and screening of outward investment were adequate, and what sanctions were possible. The government answered that production abroad is not bound by Dutch law, that dual-use exports remain licensable, that outward-investment screening is awaiting an EU Commission analysis, and that no concrete measures against the firm were planned.
The cabinet has taken note of the European Commission's intention to examine the risks that may arise from outbound investments.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van het voornemen van de Europese Commissie om de risico’s die mogelijk voortkomen uit uitgaande investeringen te gaan onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Dassen over de Zuid-Afrikaanse plannen om de wet aan te passen zodat zij Poetin niet hoeven uit te leveren

MP Dassen asked the Foreign Minister about South Africa's planned law change to avoid arresting Putin, Pentagon withholding of Russia war-crimes evidence from the ICC, and US ICC membership. The government declined to speculate on South Africa's intentions, defended the ICC's independence, said it cannot judge US Defence's evidence-sharing choices, and expects no near-term change in US ratification stance.
The cabinet does not consider it appropriate to anticipate the possible future conduct of the South African authorities.
Het kabinet vindt het niet gepast om vooruit te lopen op het mogelijke toekomstige handelen van de Zuid-Afrikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over geweld tegen christenen in India

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister about violence against Christians in Manipur, India, and about Dutch engagement on religious persecution there. The minister answered that the unrest is rooted in longstanding Meitei-Kuki ethnic tensions, described Indian government measures, and outlined human rights dialogue and EU/UN engagement, including the Karnataka repeal of anti-conversion law.
The Netherlands conducts a human rights dialogue with India bilaterally, within the EU and within the UN.
Nederland voert een mensenrechtendialoog met India in bilateraal, EU- en in VN-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het nog steeds open zijn van een Chinees politiebureau in Rotterdam

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why a reportedly illegal Chinese police station in Rotterdam still appears operational, whether closures were properly checked, whether the investigation into intimidation of Chinese nationals has progressed, and whether a new investigation and an approach to the Chinese ambassador will follow. The minister answered that the government tentatively concludes the stations have ceased activity, that involvement in intimidation was not established and could be briefed confidentially, that further research will start only if signals warrant it, and that the issue was raised with China.

The cabinet has not established, in the investigation, the involvement of the so-called Chinese police stations in the Netherlands in such practices. In a confidential technical briefing, the House can be informed further on this if desired.

Betrokkenheid van de zogenaamde Chinese politiebureaus in Nederland bij dergelijke praktijken is door het kabinet in het onderzoek niet vastgesteld. In een besloten technische briefing kan de Kamer desgewenst hier nader over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Turkse Nederlanders mogen opnieuw in Amsterdam stemmen, extra aandacht voor veiligheid’

Two VVD MPs asked about reports that Turkish voters in Amsterdam could vote again amid safety concerns, including who organised the polling locations, the role of Turkish and Dutch authorities, campaign rules and possible foreign interference. The government answered that foreign states organise their own elections with local authorities advising on safety, that Turkish consulates submitted security plans, that campaigning by foreign officials is restricted, and that it would not commit to changing how voting is organised.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was informed in a timely and complete manner, both in writing and orally, by the Turkish embassy about how the voting process for the 2023 Turkish presidential and parliamentary elections would be organised in the Netherlands.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is tijdig en volledig, zowel schriftelijk als mondeling, door de Turkse ambassade op de hoogte gebracht van de wijze waarop het stemproces voor de Turkse presidentiële en parlementaire verkiezingen van 2023 in Nederland wordt georganiseerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over bepalingen ten tijde van het afsluiten van het Non-Proliferatieverdrag over het delen van kernwapens en de controle over kunstmatige intelligentie in geval van beveiliging ke

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about documents on nuclear sharing arrangements under the NPT, whether they comply with NPT article 2 and the Vienna Convention, and about AI use and cyber risks in nuclear weapons. The government answered that nuclear sharing was discussed during NPT negotiations, no party objected, and that it is not in conflict with the NPT; it did not provide the documents, offered only general commitments to transparency, and said it cannot comment on US systems.
Can you provide openness about the documents drawn up during the negotiations on the Non-Proliferation Treaty?
Kunt u openheid verschaffen over de documenten die zijn opgesteld ten tijde van de onderhandelingen over het Non-proliferatieverdrag

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport van de onafhankelijke Fact Finding Mission (FFM) van de Hoge Commissaris Voor de Rechten van de Mens van de Verenigde Naties, over de mensenrechtensituatie in Libië

An MP asked the government about the UN Fact-Finding Mission's findings on abuses against migrants in Libyan detention centres and about Dutch and EU support to the Libyan coast guard, including whether that support contributes to abuses and whether independent monitoring exists. The government answered that EU support (training, vehicles, equipment) aims to strengthen interception capacity, acknowledged the risks and limited instruments, pointed to third-party monitoring whose reports are not shared, and said IOM's registration system is not in use.
For the safety of the actors carrying out the monitoring and for the continuity of the monitoring, the EU does not share reports.
Omwille van de veiligheid van de actoren die de monitoring verrichten alsook voor de continuïteit van de monitoring deelt de EU geen rapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het artikel 'De denktank van Rob de Wijk heeft een heldere visie op de wereld, maar is er ook transparantie in eigen huis?

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about transparency at The Hague Centre for Strategic Studies after a newspaper article, requesting the framework contract, tender documents, individual commissions since 2020, and secondments. The minister said the EUR 2 million per year framework contract is co-funded with Defence and is public via a WOO decision, listed smaller commissions since 2020, and stated no Foreign Affairs officials are seconded to HCSS.
The Programme of Requirements and the PROGRESS 2.0 framework contract can be found on open.overheid.nl; they were made public in a recent WOO decision.
Het Programma van Eisen en de raamovereenkomst van PROGRESS 2.0 zijn te vinden via open.overheid.nl, deze zijn in een recent WOO-besluit openbaar gemaakt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Maeijer over het bericht dat “EU-bobo’s gesubsidieerd naar Straatsburg vliegen”

PVV MPs asked the government about the subsidised Amelia flights between Amsterdam and Strasbourg, EU travel costs, private jet use, the Strasbourg seat, the air passenger tax and the IBO climate report. The minister answered that the route is a Public Service Obligation, that EU travel rules favour the most cost-effective option, that the government has no say over MEP travel, and that private jets are largely covered by existing aviation climate policy.
Enquiries show that the current European Parliament rules for business travel are based on choosing the most cost-effective option.
Navraag leert dat de huidige regels van het Europees Parlement voor dienstreizen zijn gebaseerd op de keuze van de meest kosteneffectieve optie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het met voeten treden van de wet door ambassades

Van Haga asked the Foreign Minister why foreign embassies in the Netherlands ignore Dutch court rulings in labour disputes with local staff, invoking diplomatic immunity, and what concrete help victims will get. Minister Hoekstra answered that embassies must respect Dutch labour law, that the state is not itself a party to these disputes, and that the ministry lobbies, sends notes, holds information sessions and offers only a mediating role, without committing to a new concrete remedy.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs regularly points to this duty, as laid down in Article 41 of the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken wijst geregeld op deze plicht, zoals deze in artikel 41 van het Verdrag van Wenen inzake diplomatiek verkeer («Wenen diplomatiek») is vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee, Dassen en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Germany unsure if Orbán fit to be ‘EU president’'

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks, Volt and VVD asked whether Hungary's upcoming EU Council presidency in July–December 2024 is acceptable given its unresolved rule-of-law and corruption problems, its Article 7 procedure, and risks to the MFF and Ukraine solidarity, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister replied that the rotation follows the agreed Council decision, that the cabinet will stress Hungary's presidency duties and keep pressing on rule of law, that it will not seek to change the rotation, and that it has no information on Germany opposing the presidency.
In the run-up to the Hungarian EU presidency, the cabinet will, together with as many like-minded member states as possible, emphasise that it expects Hungary to meet these responsibilities.
Het kabinet zal in aanloop naar het Hongaarse EU-voorzitterschap, samen met zo veel mogelijk gelijkgezinde lidstaten, benadrukken te verwachten dat Hongarije deze verantwoordelijkheden nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de Nederlandse evacuatie-vluchten uit Khartoum

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch evacuation flights from Khartoum, including a case where an evacuee was reportedly refused for lack of a marriage certificate and whether people left behind can still be helped. The minister declined to discuss individual cases for privacy reasons, said remaining contacts are being kept informed, and said evacuees now must bear their own travel costs.
For privacy reasons I cannot go into individual cases.
Omwille van privacyredenen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over methaanemissies in Turkmenistan

CDA MPs asked the government about very high methane emissions from Turkmenistan's largest oil and gas fields and how the Netherlands and EU could press for reductions ahead of COP28. The minister said the emissions figure uses a GWP-20 metric (about 128 Mt CO2-eq on GWP-100, below Dutch national emissions), and outlined EU and Dutch dialogue, technical assistance and the Global Methane Pledge as the response.

The Netherlands will also raise this methane issue in its own bilateral contacts with the Turkmen authorities and point out that several Dutch companies have expertise in detecting and preventing methane leaks.

Nederland zal deze methaan-problematiek ook opbrengen in de eigen bilaterale contacten met de Turkmeense autoriteiten en daarbij aangeven dat bij verschillende Nederlandse bedrijven expertise is voor het detecteren en tegengaan van methaanlekkages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het stoppen van subsidies aan de Palestijnse Autoriteit en het United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA) vanwege antisemitisme

De Roon (PVV) asks why the EU keeps funding Palestinian textbooks containing antisemitic content, and whether the Dutch government will stop subsidies to the Palestinian Authority and UNRWA. Minister Hoekstra answers that the EU funds teacher salaries rather than textbooks, that Dutch support to UNRWA is important and will not be stopped, and that dialogue and a second EU study on textbooks are the chosen route.
The cabinet supports the European Commission's efforts in the dialogue on this with the Palestinian Authority.
Het kabinet steunt de inzet van de Europese Commissie in de dialoog hierover met de Palestijnse Autoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Erkens over het bericht ‘Gezonde leefomgeving als grondrecht’

MPs Brekelmans and Erkens asked the Foreign Minister about adding a right to a healthy environment to the European Convention on Human Rights, the Reykjavik summit outcome, Dutch positions, and risks of politicised ECtHR rulings and competence conflicts with the EU Court. The minister answered that Dutch positions await the CDDH-ENV feasibility study due in 2024, declined to pre-judge ECtHR rulings, and saw no risk of competence conflict regarding the EU's accession.
Only once the need for and feasibility of a further instrument on human rights and environment, including climate change, have been mapped can the cabinet formulate a well-informed position.

Pas wanneer de noodzaak en haalbaarheid van een nader instrument op het gebied van mensenrechten en milieu, waaronder klimaatverandering, in kaart zijn gebracht, kan het kabinet een goed geïnformeerd standpunt formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van Wijngaarden over het wetsvoorstel wat het verkrijgen van Servisch burgerschap makkelijker zou maken voor Russen

MPs Piri and Van Wijngaarden asked the Foreign Minister about a Serbian bill easing citizenship for Russians, its security risks, Russian influence, and EU/bilateral pressure on Serbia over sanctions and its alignment with EU foreign policy. The minister answered that the Commission has raised the bill, the Serbian parliament has postponed it, the government sees no signs of Russian influence, and it presses Serbia bilaterally and at EU level on sanctions and visa-related concerns.
The government continues to press Serbia bilaterally to adopt the sanctions.
Het kabinet blijft er bilateraal op aandringen dat Servië de sancties overneemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Sjoerdsma en Wuite over stemregistratie voor de Europese Parlementsverkiezingen in de Caribische Landen van het Koninkrijk

D66 MPs asked how the government will make European Parliament elections as accessible in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom as in the Netherlands, how it will involve Caribbean citizens in EU engagement, and how the planned dialogues and events will reach them. The minister says a policy paper will set out options (more voting locations, abolishing the registration requirement) with consultation of the Caribbean countries, and that the dialogues and events will be digital and open to all, with extra effort for youth and hard-to-reach groups.
The policy paper will set out a number of routes to increase the accessibility of the EP elections in the countries and to facilitate voters as much as possible in casting their vote.

In de hoofdlijnennotitie wordt een aantal sporen uitgewerkt waarlangs de toegankelijkheid van de EP-verkiezingen in de landen kan worden vergroot en kiesgerechtigden zoveel mogelijk kunnen worden gefaciliteerd in het uitbrengen van hun stem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Podt over het bericht over het visumbeleid door het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Podt (D66) asked about press reports that the Foreign Ministry's visa profiling algorithm (IOB) may discriminate, including objections from the data protection officer and questions on transparency, the algorithm register, the Dutch DPA's role and waiting times at VFS Global. The minister replied that the IOB uses rule-based profiles, that legal advice from external counsel found the use of nationality lawful and non-discriminatory, that the algorithm will be added to the register by 1 January 2024, and that a new data protection officer will focus on oversight of the IOB.
The algorithm is not yet included in the Algorithm Register. The ministry will ensure that the algorithm is included and explained in the register by the set deadline of 1 January 2024.

Het algoritme is op dit moment nog niet in het Algoritmeregister opgenomen. Het ministerie zal er zorg voor dragen dat het algoritme voor de hiervoor vastgestelde uiterlijke datum van 1 januari 2024 in het register is opgenomen en toegelicht.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de petitie van Yezidi-vrouwen

MPs Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg (D66) asked the Justice, Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about justice and support for the Yezidi community, including aid in camps, missing Yezidis, evidence gathering with UNITAD, a Joint Investigation Team and the petition by Yezidi women. The government answered that it funds psychosocial aid, the Yezidi Survivors Law implementation and UNITAD, that it cannot verify figures or conditions in Al Hol, and that cooperation agreements and expertise contributions are still being explored.
It is not possible for the cabinet to determine how many Yezidis are staying in the Al Hol camp.
Het is voor het kabinet niet mogelijk om vast te stellen hoeveel Yezidi’s verblijven in kamp Al Hol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Zelensky wil actie tegen Russische gokbedrijven op Curaçao’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that Ukraine sanctioned Curaçao-based online gambling firms, and about oversight of those firms. The minister answered that Curaçao is autonomous in licensing and supervision, that Nederland has no direct role, and that a new independent gaming regulator is planned under the Landspakket with a target of end-2023.
Curaçao is an autonomous country within the Kingdom and has its own gambling legislation and regulations.
Curaçao is een autonoom land binnen het Koninkrijk en heeft eigen kansspelwet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over toegang tot DigiD voor Nederlanders in het Buitenland

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why Dutch citizens abroad struggle to obtain DigiD access and why only AOW recipients abroad were proactively informed about login changes. The government acknowledged the problems, described expanded video-call appointments and planned fixes for ID activation, but declined to mail letters to citizens abroad because their addresses are unreliable.
I share the view that Dutch nationals abroad must have access to (digital) government services.
Ik deel de mening dat Nederlanders in het buitenland toegang moeten hebben tot (digitale) overheidsdienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over VN-resolutie 2664 die humanitaire uitzonderingen mogelijk maakt in VN-sanctieregimes

A Dutch MP asked the Foreign Minister about UN Security Council Resolution 2664, which introduces humanitarian exemptions across UN sanctions regimes, including its effects, implementation via the EU and bank cooperation. The minister answered in detail that the EU has implemented the exemption in several regimes, that early signals suggest positive humanitarian effects, and that the government consults NGOs and banks on implementation.
The cabinet will continue to actively monitor the effects.
Het kabinet zal de effecten actief blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over de verlengde VN-sessie over het wereldzeeënverdrag

Two PvdD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Nature and Nitrogen about the extended UN session on the high seas biodiversity treaty (BBNJ), including whether RFMOs and fisheries interests would be bound and whether EIAs apply to RFMO-regulated vessels. The minister confirmed agreement on the treaty text on 4 March 2023, explained that the treaty coordinates with existing bodies without undermining them, and apologised for missing the requested answer deadline.
Unfortunately it was not possible to answer the questions within the set deadline.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de vragen binnen de gestelde termijn te beantwoorden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het recente bezoek aan Saoedi-Arabië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why he visited Saudi Arabia despite past human rights concerns, and what the visit achieved on geopolitics, human rights, corporate due diligence and individual cases. The minister defended the visit on regional stability and economic grounds, said human rights were raised in a critical dialogue, and declined to discuss individual cases in detail.
For these reasons, I cannot go into detail on this.
Om die redenen, kan ik hierover niet in detail treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Sjoerdsma over sanctie-ontwijking door Iran

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Sjoerdsma asked about alleged Iranian sanctions evasion via Dutch trade shown in a Zembla broadcast, including whether the government investigated, whether a reported case was acted on, and whether enforcement is adequate. The ministers say they cannot comment on individual cases, that enforcement and investigation occur where indications exist, that sanctions on the IRGC are in place, and that existing enforcement structures are being strengthened with EU proposals shared with parliament.
The cabinet cannot make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de arrestatie van Pakistaanse oud-premier Imran Khan

Rep. Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of former Pakistani PM Imran Khan, the alleged mistreatment of his lawyers, the Section 144 assembly ban, and whether the Netherlands would speak out internationally. The minister answered that the government cannot judge proportionality of the measures, regrets any mistreatment of lawyers, supports the EU statement, and discussed the matter with his Pakistani counterpart.
The cabinet cannot give a judgement on whether the measures taken are proportionate to the threat to public order and security.
Het kabinet kan geen oordeel geven over de vraag of de genomen maatregelen in verhouding staan tot de dreiging voor de openbare orde en veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het programma op de Duitse publieke zender ZDF op 17 februari jl. over het functioneren van de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger in Bosnië Christian Schmidt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a ZDF documentary alleging that High Representative Christian Schmidt in Bosnia is biased toward Croat nationalists, weakens democracy, and imposed a retroactive electoral law change. The minister answered that the HV acts autonomously within the Dayton mandate, the government shares concern about ethnic divisions and has raised them with the Office of the HV, but it rejects condemning Schmidt and will keep working through diplomatic channels.
The cabinet considers it important that the HV fulfils that task in an independent manner.
Het kabinet acht het van belang dat de HV die taak op onafhankelijke wijze invult.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over Soedanese paspoorten op de Nederlandse ambassade

MP Piri asked the Foreign Minister about dozens of Sudanese passports left at the closed Dutch embassy in Khartoum, whether holders were warned, how many were contacted, and whether the government will ensure their safety. The minister answered that the embassy closed suddenly due to fighting, staff could not retrieve the passports, holders are being contacted individually, and support options such as official statements are being explored.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has by now contacted several dozen passport holders individually by phone and email.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft inmiddels op individuele basis telefonisch en per email contact met enkele tientallen paspoorthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Thijssen over het vermoeden van het afnemen van Russisch uranium door de Nederlandse kerncentrale in Borssele

Opposition MPs asked whether the Borssele nuclear plant (EPZ) may be supplying Russia's war effort through fuel-element trade and reprocessing of uranium in Russia, and asked about export controls, EU sanctions and oversight. The minister answered that EPZ says it no longer trades directly with Russia, that the regulator sees no signs of irregularities, that EU sanctions on Russian nuclear supplies lack support, and that Euratom and the IAEA do not oversee Russian nuclear revenues.
In general, the cabinet makes no statements regarding commercially confidential information.
Antwoord 2 In het algemeen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken ten aanzien van bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Fritsma over het bericht dat Iran gesprekken voert met Rusland en China over het kopen van raketbrandstof

PVV MPs De Roon and Fritsma asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether they knew of reports that Iran was negotiating with Russia and China to buy missile propellant, whether NATO discussed it, whether this breaches sanctions, and how the Netherlands would pressure Iran. The government confirmed awareness, noted UN resolution 2231 bars such transfers until October 2023, and said it is consulting allies and the EU on a joint response while declining to detail proposed sanctions.
Statements about specific proposals, for example new sanctions, undermine the element of surprise and thereby the effectiveness of such measures.
Uitlatingen over specifieke voorstellen voor bijvoorbeeld nieuwe sancties, ondermijnen het verrassingseffect en daarmee de effectiviteit van dergelijke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij 'De komst van Marokkaanse staatsimams naar Nederland'

MPs Stoffer and Van der Staaij asked whether the Moroccan state-funded Fondation Hassan II sends state imams to the Netherlands, what messages they spread, whether the government was informed in advance, and whether entry could be refused. The government answered that the imams provide religious support to the Moroccan diaspora during Ramadan within permitted diaspora policy and freedom of religion, that visas are assessed individually, that there is no current reason to refuse them, and that it will report on the revamped Taskforce later.
There is currently no reason to take action or to refuse the visa applications of the imams.
Er is op dit moment geen aanleiding om op te treden of de visumaanvraag van de imams te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over gedwongen huisuitzettingen, de vernietiging van woningen en arrestatie van journalisten in Ethiopië

MP Ceder asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about forced evictions and demolition of homes around Addis Ababa, arrests of human rights council members and journalists, and entry restrictions for people from other regions. The minister confirmed awareness, said the scale is unclear, said the human rights council members were released on bail, and said the Netherlands would raise concerns or seek clarification through the EU or like-minded countries where possible.

The Netherlands is co-chair of the Media Freedom Coalition (MFC) and will, where possible and in good cooperation with other MFC members and/or like-minded countries, continue to ask for attention to press freedom and the safety of journalists in Ethiopia.

Nederland is medevoorzitter van de Media Freedom Coalition (MFC) en zal indien mogelijk en in goede samenwerking met andere leden van de MFC en/of gelijkgezinde landen aandacht blijven vragen voor het belang van persvrijheid en de veiligheid van journalisten in Ethiopië.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Koerhuis, Rajkowski en Valstar over het bericht ‘‘Verdachte’ Chinese kranen staan ook in Nederlandse havens: zorgen om spionage’

The VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Chinese ZPMC cranes in Dutch ports could enable Chinese digital access, espionage, or disruption of military transports, and about Logink data links and subsidies. The government answered that the risks are being investigated in an interdepartmental review due in autumn 2023, that port facilities are responsible for securing their systems, that no Logink cooperation exists in Rotterdam, and that EU rules and NIS2/CER directives may address the risks.

Whether it is possible for the ZPMC facilities in China to gain digital access to the cranes, or whether they are connected in any way or have access to information in the port of Rotterdam, is being investigated in consultation with the Port of Rotterdam Authority.

Of het mogelijk is om vanuit de ZPMC-faciliteiten in China digitale toegang te krijgen tot de kranen, of dat deze op enigerlei wijze verbonden zijn of toegang hebben tot informatie in de Rotterdamse haven, wordt onderzocht in afstemming met het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerseboom en Van Houwelingen over de houding van Nederland wat betreft Europese strategische autonomie ten opzichte van de Verenigde Staten

Two FvD MPs asked the Foreign Minister to define 'strategic autonomy' and state Dutch and EU positions relative to the United States, including reactions to remarks by Rutte, Macron and Michel. The minister gave a substantive but largely policy-restating reply, defining open strategic autonomy as an EU concept, stressing continued NATO and US cooperation, and declining to interpret the remarks of other leaders.
The cabinet is not in a position to further interpret the statements made by the President of the European Council.
Het kabinet is niet in de positie om deze door de voorzitter van de Europese Raad gedane uitspraken nader te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heerema en Brekelmans over het bericht 'ISU brengt Nederland in verlegenheid: Overleg met Russische bondsvoorzitter tijdens WK Afstanden in Heerenveen wekt wrevel’

VVD MPs Heerema and Brekelmans asked the Foreign Minister whether it is acceptable that the Russian skating federation chairman attended an ISU meeting during the World Single Distance Championships in Heerenveen despite calls to exclude Russia and Belarus from international sport. The government replied that the ISU, not the KNSB, was responsible for the invitation, that the KNSB protested in writing, and that international sport is autonomous so it has no means to block such decisions.
The ISU was therefore responsible for the invitation, not the KNSB.
De ISU was dan ook verantwoordelijk voor het uitnodigen, niet de KNSB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu (DENK) over het van overheidswege uitschakelen van internet terwijl de autoriteiten jagen op een Sikh-prediker

DENK MP Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about the Indian Punjab state's internet shutdown during the hunt for a Sikh preacher, and whether this collectively punishes about 30 million Punjabis and violates their rights. The minister said the government sees internet access as part of free expression, that such shutdowns should be used only in extreme emergencies, cannot judge the threat from available information, and that Netherlands raises minority and free-expression rights with India through human rights dialogue.
The cabinet is of the view that access to online media and services is an essential part of media freedom and freedom of expression, and can therefore be counted among human rights.
Het kabinet is van mening dat toegang tot online media en diensten een essentieel onderdeel van mediavrijheid en vrijheid van meningsuiting vormt, en daarmee tot de mensenrechten gerekend kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over de werkwijze van de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO)

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee ask whether DUO misuses the Passport Act to list former students abroad and whether a former student must repay study finance despite timely graduation. The minister denies misuse, explains the conditions for passport signalling, says the hardship clause is theoretically available, and promises a review of statutory deadlines.
I intend to conduct a study into the various deadlines in the law and whether they still fit how we now view our citizens and their capacity to act.
Ik ben voornemens om een onderzoek te doen naar de verschillende termijnen in de wet en of die nog passen bij hoe we nu naar onze burgers kijken en hun doenvermogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Vestering over het feit dat diepzeemijnbouw onnodig blijkt te zijn

MPs Teunissen and Vestering (Partij voor de Dieren) asked whether deep-sea mining is unnecessary given circular economy options, whether the Netherlands has an official position, and how the precautionary principle applies before the ISA Council meeting. The government answers that it has not yet formed a definitive position, will inform parliament before summer 2023, is conducting an exploratory study on deep-sea mining's contribution to critical raw material supply, and that exploitation should only proceed strictly within the ecosystem's carrying capacity.

The cabinet is still deliberating on a further substantive position on deep-sea mining and expects to inform the House shortly, and no later than before summer given the July meeting of the Authority's Council.

Het kabinet beraadt zich momenteel nog op een nader inhoudelijk standpunt over diepzeemijnbouw en verwacht Uw Kamer hier op korte termijn, en uiterlijk voor de zomer gelet op de juli bijeenkomst van de Raad van de Autoriteit, over te informeren.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de vele berichten van ongeregeldheden, excessief geweld en het nederzettingenbeleid van de nieuwe Israëlische regering in de bezette Westelijke Jordaanoever

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister to answer again, with urgency and separately, his earlier questions on violence and settlement policy in the occupied West Bank, given that the US had summoned Israel's ambassador. The minister referred to his earlier answers, said the government urged both sides to calm and asked Israel not to pursue planned cabinet measures, and that he had raised this personally with his Israeli counterpart.
For accountability I refer to the answers already given to these parliamentary questions.
Voor de verantwoording verwijs ik naar de reeds gegeven beantwoording van deze Kamervragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Ukraine accuses Hungary of funding Russian war crimes with energy deals'

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Brekelmans asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hungary's new Russian gas and oil deals fund Russian war crimes, and how the government responds to Hungary's position in the EU. The minister says the government consistently presses Hungary bilaterally and in the EU to reduce energy dependence on Russia, while noting the gas deal is not contrary to EU rules and that no concrete sanctions or conditionality tools are available beyond continued pressure.
The financial instruments offer no basis for attaching conditions to the disbursement of funds to promoting strategic autonomy.
Het financiële instrumentarium biedt geen aanknopingspunten om voorwaarden te stellen om de uitkering van fondsen te koppelen aan het bevorderen van strategische autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de definitieve fatwa en de oproep aan Nederlandse moslims mij te vermoorden

An MP from the PVV asked the government to condemn a Pakistani fatwa calling for the MP's murder, to explain how such threats are handled, and to consider expelling the Pakistani ambassador. The government condemned the threats, said it raised concerns with Pakistan, noted a prosecution decision, and declined to discuss threat cases or intelligence assessments in public.
As is known to your House, I cannot publicly make statements about the working methods of the intelligence and security services, or about concrete threat cases and personal security measures.

Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend kan ik over de werkwijze van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten, alsmede informatie over concrete dreigings-casuïstiek en beveiligingsmaatregelen van personen, in het openbaar geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Piri over visumaanvragen van Surinamers

MPs Ceder and Piri asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about high refusal rates for short-stay visa applications from Surinamese applicants, capacity, processing times and communication. The minister answered that refusals stem mainly from insufficient information, doubts about return and weak ties to the country of origin, that refusal rates rose to 17.44% in 2022, and that processing capacity is being rebuilt with a target of 2019 production levels by Q2 2023.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs assesses every visa application in accordance with the rules of the EU Visa Code.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken beoordeelt elke visumaanvraag conform de voorschriften van de EU-visumcode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de training door de Europese Unie van het Oekraïense leger

An MP asked whether the EU trains the Ukrainian army, whether there is or will be a European army, and whether the Dutch army is involved in training.
