The ministers answered that no European army is being formed, that EU missions use contributions from member states, and that the Netherlands has contributed to training Ukrainian soldiers via EUMAM since its creation in late 2022.
There is no question of forming a European army.
Er is geen sprake van de vorming van een Europees Leger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over de ophanden zijnde juridische hervormingen in Israël

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister about proposed Israeli judicial reforms curbing the Supreme Court, their effect on democracy and on Palestinians' legal recourse, and what Netherlands and EU steps are possible. The minister called the reforms concerning for judicial independence, said Netanyahu paused them for talks, and described raising concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
An independent judiciary is the foundation of a democratic constitutional state.
Een onafhankelijke rechterlijke macht is het fundament voor een democratische rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de verblijfplaats van ‘Bolle Jos’

An MP from the VVD asked why a record reward was offered for information on fugitive Jos L. while he is believed to be in Turkey, whether he was briefly arrested there and released, and how Turkey could be made to arrest and extradite Dutch fugitives. The Minister of Justice explained the reward rules and the high severity of the suspicions, declined to comment on the individual case or the alleged Turkish arrest, and described the general extradition process under the European Convention on Extradition.
I cannot make statements about ongoing criminal proceedings.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke procedures kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de aangenomen anti-LHBTI-wet in Oeganda

MP Hammelburg asked ministers how the Netherlands would respond to Uganda's anti-LGBTI law adding the death penalty, including pressure on the president, sanctions, aid to civil society and joint action. The ministers answered that they have voiced strong concern, are working with the Equal Rights Coalition and partners, are reviewing some aid such as the JLOS programme, and would not publicly disclose specific measures.

Given that the situation is still developing, it is not in the interest of the matter to make public statements about which specific measures are under consideration if the legislation is definitively adopted.

Mede gezien de situatie nog in ontwikkeling is, is het niet in het belang van de zaak om publieke mededelingen te doen over welke maatregelen concreet in beeld zijn als de wetgeving definitief wordt aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de stijging van het aantal afwijzingen van visumaanvragen van Surinamers

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why refusal rates for Surinamese short-stay visa applications rose sharply after decision-making moved from Paramaribo to The Hague, and about outsourcing to VFS Global, urgent cases, institutional racism and costs. The minister denied any link between location and refusal rates, attributed rising refusals mainly to incomplete applications, defended the external service fee and centralisation, and declined further investigation or reversal.
There is no reason to investigate this further.
Er is geen aanleiding dit verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Nederlandse journalisten in Rusland

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Wall Street Journal reporter in Russia and about the safety of Dutch journalists working there. The minister condemned the arrest, called for release, and said journalists and media outlets decide for themselves whether to work in Russia while the ministry provides travel advice and contact.
The cabinet will continue to call for his release, and that of Russian journalists arrested for doing their work as independent journalists.
Het kabinet zal blijven oproepen tot zijn vrijlating, en die van Russische journalisten die gearresteerd zijn omdat zij hun werk als onafhankelijke journalisten deden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijgaarden en Rajkowski over het artikel ‘Draagvlak voor hulp Oekraïense vluchtelingen in Slowakije staat onder druk’

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign minister about a press report that public support for aid to Ukrainian refugees in Slovakia is under pressure, and about Russian disinformation, upcoming Slovak elections, a possible Fico win, EU responses and the revised EU disinformation code. The minister answered that Russian disinformation is concerning, outlined EU tools (FIMI toolbox, DSA co-regulation) and the revised code signed by 34 organisations, but said the government does not track national support figures and could not give a clear list of at-risk member states.
The Netherlands does not keep an overall overview of public support in EU member states for financial aid to Ukraine.
Nederland houdt geen totaaloverzicht bij van steun onder de bevolking in EU lidstaten voor financiële steun aan Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over abortus als “mensenrecht”

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign and Development Ministers whether abortion is being treated as a human right, whether the right to life of unborn children is protected, and how partner organisations delivering abortion services are monitored for coercion. The ministers answered that international law does not settle whether human rights apply to the unborn, that Dutch policy supports safe abortion as part of SRGR, and that partners monitor care quality against WHO guidelines.
Your questions have been answered with all due care, attention and transparency.
Uw vragen zijn met alle zorgvuldigheid, aandacht en transparantie beantwoord.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de voortgang richting een verbod op volledige autonome wapensystemen en de daar aan gelieerde, door de regering georganiseerde, conferentie 'Responsible AI in the Military D

An MP asked the ministers about progress toward a ban on fully autonomous weapons and the government-organised REAIM summit on responsible AI in the military domain. The government reaffirmed its commitment to a ban on weapons that cannot be used lawfully and to regulation of other autonomous systems within the CCW/GGE LAWS framework, while defending the broader REAIM approach as a way to build wider support.

The cabinet remains committed to pursuing an international ban on autonomous weapons systems that cannot be deployed in line with international law, and to regulating other systems with autonomous features within the UN framework (CCW/GGE LAWS).

Het kabinet blijft zich inzetten voor een internationaal verbod op autonome wapensystemen die niet in lijn met het internationaal recht kunnen worden ingezet en regulering van overige wapensystemen met autonome kenmerken in VN-verband (CCW/GGE LAWS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Ceder over sekse- en familie-gerelateerde aspecten rondom christenvervolging

Two MPs (SGP and ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the 2023 Open Doors gender report on Christian persecution, its pressure points, and how Dutch religious-freedom and human-rights efforts take it into account. The minister says the findings are serious, that Nederland raises rights violations bilaterally and multilaterally, and lists existing programmes such as Shelter City and Safety for Voices without committing to a new concrete step.
The Netherlands firmly stands for the human right to freedom of religion and belief.
Nederland staat pal voor het mensenrecht op vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Brekelmans over de berichten 'Nederlands standpunt Russische sporters', 'Aziatische sluiproute voert Russische sporters wellicht alsnog naar Olympische spelen 2024', en '

Two VVD MPs asked the government what role it can play in excluding Russian sports officials and sports-governing bodies, and whether it knows the international boxing federation is dominated by Russian officials, sponsored by Gazprom and allows Russian athletes under their own flag. The minister answered that the government has spoken out with international partners, confirmed awareness of these facts, said the Dutch boxing federation will skip certain IBA events, and stated that Dutch athletes will suffer no disadvantage.
I have, together with my international colleagues, expressed myself on this in several statements to international sport.
Ik heb mij samen met mijn internationale collega’s daar in meerdere statements richting de internationale sport voor uitgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Piri over vergiftiging van schoolmeisjes in Iran

MPs Van der Lee and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about the poisoning of about 700 Iranian schoolgirls, whether the regime is responsible, and whether the Netherlands will push for ICC investigation and evidence-gathering programmes. The minister condemned the poisonings, said the perpetrators are unknown though Iranian authorities announced an inquiry and arrests, and explained that an ICC referral is legally unavailable while Nederland supports the UN Fact Finding Mission and evidence guidelines.
The cabinet will continue to closely follow this.
Het kabinet zal dit op de voet blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de werking van de economische sancties in relatie tot noodhulp en wederopbouw in de door de aardbeving getroffen gebieden in Syrië

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked whether EU sanctions on Syria obstruct NGO relief, Syrian Red Crescent appeals, bank transfers to relatives, and heavy machinery imports for earthquake recovery. The minister replied that humanitarian goods and transfers are generally permitted, exemptions exist, the EU eased rules on 23 February, and the government is talking to banks and raising the issue with the Commission.
Humanitarian aid goods and activities are in principle not sanctioned.
Humanitaire hulpgoederen en -activiteiten zijn in principe niet gesanctioneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gündoğan over het bericht 'How China’s police are ensnaring thousands of suspects abroad'

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about reports of Chinese police targeting suspects and dissidents abroad, including the detention of the mother and sister-in-law of a Dutch air force officer, and whether the government will act on the surveillance, intimidation, and his security clearance. The minister says unwanted foreign interference is unacceptable, that the Chinese 'overseas police stations' have been closed, that individual cases cannot be discussed for privacy and security reasons, and that the government will not intervene in Chinese legal proceedings or offer the family refugee status, while pointing to EU coordination and efforts to raise awareness.
On individual cases, however, the cabinet cannot go into detail for privacy and security reasons.
Op individuele gevallen kan het kabinet evenwel om privacy- en veiligheidsredenen niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Eppink over het lokaliseren van Joodse gemeenschappen over de hele wereld door Iran om daar moordaanslagen op te kunnen plegen

MPs Van der Staaij and Eppink asked whether Iran is mapping Jewish communities abroad for attacks, whether threats exist in the Netherlands, and about terror listing of the IRGC and nuclear risks. The government answered that it will act against any concrete threat, declined to detail security measures, said the IRGC cannot legally be listed nationally and lacks EU legal basis, and called a diplomatic solution the best way to prevent an Iranian bomb.
The cabinet cannot make statements about whether, and if so which, security measures are being taken.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over of, en zo ja, welke beveiligingsmaatregelen getroffen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over uitspraken van de Israëlische Minister van Financiën en verdere escalatie van het geweld

MP Van der Lee asks the Foreign Minister to confirm and condemn Israeli Finance Minister Smotrich's call for the Palestinian village of Hawara to be wiped out, and asks what concrete steps the Netherlands and the EU will take to halt escalating violence, protect Palestinians, and secure accountability. The minister confirms the remarks, calls them unacceptable, and repeats calls for de-escalation and support for regional initiatives, but says Dutch options for concrete protection are limited and EU action remains under discussion.
It is in the interest of both parties to prevent further escalation.
Het is in het belang van beide partijen om verdere escalatie te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoersma over de protesten in Georgië en de omstreden ‘Russische wet’

MPs Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about protests in Georgia against the 'foreign agents' law and whether it resembles Russia's 2012 law, along with Dutch responses. The minister confirmed the bill was withdrawn via a second-reading rejection, noted similarities to Russia's law, and said the Netherlands has voiced concerns and will raise them with Georgia.
The Netherlands will continue to closely follow this, keep speaking out against such a law, and keep supporting independent media and a strong civil society.
Nederland zal dit nauwgezet blijven volgen, zich tegen een dergelijke wet blijven uitspreken en steun blijven uitspreken voor onafhankelijke media en een krachtig maatschappelijk middenveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Dekker over de militaire steun aan Oekraïne

MPs Baudet and Dekker asked for an overview of Dutch military aid to Ukraine, its legal conditions, possible violations of the laws of war, Ukraine's compliance with agreements, Dutch troop involvement, and disclosure of related documents under Article 68 of the Constitution. The government answered that deliveries are donations reported in periodic letters, that no signals of misuse exist, that each delivery is vetted under EU arms export criteria with end-user certificates, and that operational security limits full public disclosure.
Operational security nonetheless remains the overriding consideration in deciding whether to inform the House publicly.
De operationele veiligheid blijft echter te allen tijde leidend in de afweging uw Kamer in het openbaar te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een dubieuze promotiecampagne van de EU

MP Jasper van Dijk asks the Foreign Minister whether he finds the EU's 'You are EU' promotional campaign pathetic and ineffective, whether expanding EU powers should be a political debate rather than a campaign topic, and what the campaign costs. The minister replies that the Netherlands is not involved, the Commission controls its own communication and the Netherlands sees no reason to comment on it, that any expansion of EU powers requires treaty change under Article 48 TEU, and that the total campaign cost is EUR 34.5 million across 27 member states.
As a member state, the Netherlands is not involved in this campaign. The European Commission is responsible for its own communication.
Als lidstaat is Nederland niet betrokken bij deze campagne. De Europese Commissie gaat over haar eigen communicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de aangekondigde wet in Georgië over het aanmerken van media en maatschappelijke organisaties als buitenlandse vertegenwoordigers

MP Piri asked the Foreign Minister about Georgia's proposed 'foreign influence' law that would label media and civil society organisations receiving foreign funding as foreign agents, asking about consequences for press freedom, EU accession and Dutch diplomatic action. The minister answered that the law would have been harmful, that it was formally withdrawn on 10 March, and that the Netherlands is raising press freedom and civil society concerns with Georgian authorities and within the EU.
On 8 March I conveyed the Dutch concerns about the first-reading adoption of this law via a tweet.
Ik heb op 8 maart jl. middels een tweet de Nederlandse zorgen over het aannemen in eerste lezing van deze wet overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over het bericht dat teakhout uit Myanmar illegaal bij Nederlandse superjachtbouwers belandt

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked the ministers about reports that illegal teak from Myanmar reaches Dutch superyacht builders despite EU sanctions on Myanmar Timber Enterprise, and about enforcement differences across member states, a total import ban, and humanitarian support. The government answered that sanctions are strictly implemented in the Netherlands, that enforcement is a national competence, that companies are responsible for compliance, and that it is pursuing EU-level clarification, while offering no commitment to a total ban beyond the existing de facto ban via MTE sanctions.
The Netherlands interprets and implements EU sanctions in a strict manner. Enforcement of sanctions is a national competence.
Nederland interpreteert en implementeert EU-sancties op een strikte manier. Handhaving van sancties is een nationale competentie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Ceder over het voornemen van Vanuatu om het Internationaal Gerechtshof te vragen om een Advisory Opinion over de verantwoordelijkheden van staten op het gebied van klimaat

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Dutch government whether it would support Vanuatu's draft UN General Assembly resolution requesting an ICJ advisory opinion on state responsibility for climate change, and how it would use diplomacy to build support. The government answered that it intends to support and co-sponsor the resolution, that the resolution has broad support, and that no additional diplomatic effort is needed.

Given the Netherlands' ambitious national and international climate policy, the cabinet intends, like the UK, Japan, and nearly all EU countries, to support the resolution if it is put to a vote in the UN General Assembly.

Gelet op het ambitieuze nationale en internationale klimaatbeleid van Nederland is het kabinet voornemens om, net als het VK, Japan, en vrijwel alle EU landen, de resolutie te steunen als deze in stemming wordt gebracht in de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Staaij, Ceder, Piri, Van der Lee, Koekkoek, Teunissen, Eppink en Van der Plas over de uitspraak van het Internationaal

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will ensure Azerbaijan complies with the ICJ provisional measures order to reopen the Lachin corridor, and whether it has raised this with Azerbaijan. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Azerbaijan to comply through bilateral talks, the ambassador, and EU and multilateral channels, but gives no new concrete commitment beyond continued advocacy.
Following this ruling, the Netherlands called on the Azerbaijani authorities to comply with the ruling.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak de Azerbeidzjaanse autoriteiten opgeroepen om de uitspraak na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht dat Iran Nederlandse organisaties als het CIDI en Christenen voor Israël als terroristische organisaties heeft bestempeld

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked whether the Foreign Minister would summon the Iranian ambassador over Iran placing Dutch organisations CIDI and Christenen voor Israël on a terrorism list, what else could be done, how the threat to members is assessed, whether this is part of an antisemitic agenda, and whether the IRGC should be listed in the EU. The minister condemned the step, said security responsibility lies with organisations and is decentralised, framed the Iranian listing as a response to EU human rights sanctions, and said the IRGC cannot legally be listed by the EU at present while the government keeps pushing for it.
On specific threats, and the measures taken in response, I cannot make statements for security reasons.
Over specifieke dreigingen, alsmede de maatregelen die daartegen naar aanleiding daarvan worden genomen, kan ik vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen geen uitlatingen doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de vele berichten van ongeregeldheden, excessief geweld en het nederzettingenbeleid van de nieuwe Israëlische regering in de bezette Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about violence by settlers and the army in the occupied West Bank, settlement expansion, arms licensing for settlers, and whether the government will take concrete measures. The minister condemned the violence and settlement policy, called for de-escalation and proportionality, but largely restated existing policy and offered no new concrete sanctions.
The Netherlands calls on both parties to this end, publicly and in bilateral contacts.
Nederland roept beide partijen hiertoe op, publiekelijk en in bilaterale contacten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Iran en de Mensenrechtenraad

Mr De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister why Iran's foreign minister was welcome to speak at the UN Human Rights Council and urged Dutch withdrawal from it and a walkout. Minister Hoekstra answered that every UN member may speak at the High Level Segment, that the minister used his own video message to raise Iranian rights abuses, and that the Netherlands will decide per meeting and will not withdraw support from the Council.
Every UN member state is allowed to speak during the High Level Segment.
Het is elke VN-lidstaat toegestaan om tijdens het High Level Segment te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het nieuws dat het CIDI op een Iraanse terrorisme- en sanctielijst is geplaatst

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked what measures the government takes after Iran listed CIDI and its chairman on a terrorism and sanctions list, and whether that is not a reason for a harder line on Iran. Minister Hoekstra condemned the listing, said the threat level in the Netherlands is unchanged and security is a decentralised responsibility, and promised to raise dissatisfaction internationally and keep monitoring Iran.
The cabinet will express displeasure about the imposed sanctions and condemn them when the occasion arises.
Het kabinet zal bij gelegenheid ongenoegen uitspreken over de ingestelde sancties en deze veroordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de Moldavische premier Dorin Recean bevestigt dat Rusland het internationale vliegveld van Chi?inau in handen probeert te krijgen om Russische militairen het

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Russia may be trying to take Chisinau airport to bring in troops into Moldova, and about the consequences for Ukrainian refugees, aid transit, EU/NATO responses and travel advice. The minister said the government cannot independently confirm the reports, noted Russian destabilisation efforts, and declined to speculate on scenarios while promising to monitor the situation and adjust travel advice if needed.
The cabinet does not speculate about possible scenarios that could unfold in Moldova, or about a response by the EU and NATO.
Het kabinet speculeert niet over mogelijke scenario's die zich in Moldavië kunnen ontplooien, en over een reactie door de EU en de NAVO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Treasury Targets Global Sanctions Evasion Network Supporting Russia’s Military-Industrial Complex’.

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a US Treasury sanctions action against a network evading Russia sanctions, including whether EU rules are violated, why the persons were not listed by the EU, and what Cyprus and Bulgaria have done. The minister answered that enforcement is a national competence, that the cabinet has no separate information on the specific cases, and that it cannot comment on specific listing proposals, while describing EU mechanisms and the proposed harmonisation of criminal penalties.
Enforcement is a national competence of the individual member states and their relevant authorities, as well as the decision to proceed with enforcement and prosecution.
Handhaving is een nationale competentie van de individuele lidstaten en hun relevante autoriteiten, evenals het besluit om over te gaan tot handhaving en vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over kinderontvoeringen naar Polen en het negeren van een Europees Aanhoudingsbevel

An MP asked about a Dutch mother who allegedly abducted four children to Poland, Polish courts' use of Hague Convention refusal grounds, and Poland's refusal to execute a European Arrest Warrant. The government acknowledges some enforcement problems rooted in Polish national law, cites an EU Court ruling and a Commission infringement procedure, and promises a protocol on holding states accountable by summer 2023.
I cannot comment on a judicial decision of another EU member state in an individual case.
Op een rechterlijke beslissing van een andere lidstaat van de Europese Unie in een individuele zaak kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de situatie in Myanmar

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg asked about the crisis in Myanmar: the lack of political attention, EU-UN efforts toward a ceasefire, ASEAN's role, sanctions coordination, aviation fuel sanctions, a Myanmar funding overview, a Human Rights Council resolution and an emergency summit. The minister answers that the Netherlands is active through EU, UN and ASEAN channels, supports humanitarian aid and inclusive dialogue, will lead on a strong Council resolution, and gives a funding table, while declining to publish 2021-2022 Human Rights Fund project details for security reasons.

The projects supported from the Human Rights Fund in 2021 and 2022 cannot be publicly shared, given the high security risk to the persons and organisations involved since the military coup of 1 February 2021.

De projecten die in 2021 en 2022 zijn ondersteund vanuit het MRF, kunnen gezien het hoge veiligheidsrisico dat betrokken personen en instanties lopen sinds de militaire staatsgreep op 1 februari 2021, niet publiekelijk worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over fatwa’s en bedreigingen

An MP asks the Prime Minister and several ministers what has concretely been done to identify, prosecute or extradite people who issued fatwas and death threats against him, and how many threat cases were prosecuted. The minister replies that individual cases cannot be discussed, that Pakistan has not answered legal assistance requests, that the Public Prosecution Service decides prosecution case by case, and that threats are forwarded to the intelligence services.
I cannot go into individual cases; the Public Prosecution Service is the designated body to inform you confidentially about such matters.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken, het Openbaar Ministerie is de aangewezen instantie om u, als betrokkene, vertrouwelijk over dergelijke zaken te informeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over het stopzetten van Erasmusbeurzen voor Hongaarse studenten

The MP asks whether it is fair that Hungarian students lose Erasmus grants because of EU measures against Hungary's rule-of-law problems, and whether Erasmus should stay free of political sanctions. The minister replies that the Dutch government supports the Council measures under the MFK rule-of-law regulation, that the measure targets Hungary's budget and not students, and that Hungary should continue paying the grants until the measure is lifted.
The cabinet supports the Commission's decision of 15 December 2022 to impose measures on Hungary via the MFK rule-of-law regulation.
Antwoord 3, 4 en 5 Het kabinet staat achter het besluit van de Commissie op 15 december 2022 om maatregelen op te leggen aan Hongarije via de MFK-rechtsstaatsveror dening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Eppink, Van der Staaij, Van der Plas en Agnes Mulder over de ontmoeting tussen de minister-president en de Azerbeidzjaanse president Aliyev

MPs asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the January 2023 meeting with Azerbaijani President Aliyev in Davos, including gas deliveries, the Lachin corridor blockade, ECHR rulings and Armenian prisoners. The government answered that the meeting raised Dutch concerns about the humanitarian situation and the Lachin blockade, that it did not address the ECHR interim measures or Armenian prisoners, and that it did not condemn Azerbaijan's occupation of Armenian territory, while promising continued calls for compliance.
During the conversation, the Prime Minister conveyed the Dutch concerns about the humanitarian situation in Nagorno-Karabakh resulting from the de facto blockade of the Lachin corridor.
Tijdens het gesprek heeft de Minister-President de Nederlandse zorgen over de humanitaire situatie in Nagorno-Karabach als gevolg van de de facto blokkade van de Laçın-corridor overgebracht.
Antwoord op de leden Hammelburg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Miljoenen chips Nederlandse fabrikanten belanden in Rusland ondanks sancties’

MPs Hammelburg and Sjoerdsma asked when the cabinet learned that Dutch chips were found in Russian military equipment, why the media were answered but not Parliament, what was done about Iranian drones, how sanctioned intermediaries could still supply Russia, and what measures could curb resale. The ministers answered that the government was first informed in March 2022, that the goods were added to EU sanctions after a Dutch proposal, that sanctions are being pursued via EU listings and a non-paper, and that full control over trade in these components is not feasible.
The ministry sent the relevant news editors a written response to a specific request for clarification.
Het ministerie heeft de betreffende nieuwsredacties een schriftelijke reactie gestuurd op een specifiek verzoek om verduidelijking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de opmerkingen van de Duitse minister van Buitenlandse Zaken, ’we are fighting a war against Russia’’ en ‘’We can fight this war only together’

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether German minister Baerbock's remarks that 'we are fighting a war against Russia' mean the Netherlands is at war with Russia, and how article 96 of the Constitution is safeguarded if the conflict escalates. The minister answered that neither Germany, NATO nor the Netherlands is a party to the armed conflict, that the Netherlands supports Ukraine at its request, and that the cabinet respects the Constitution.
No, the Netherlands is not a party to the armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine.
Nee, Nederland is geen partij bij het gewapend conflict tussen Rusland en Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Brekelmans over moorden in Nederland en de Iraanse Revolutionaire Garde

MPs Ellian and Brekelmans asked whether investigations into the 2015 Almere and 2017 The Hague killings of Iranian-origin Dutchmen could qualify for EU terrorist listing of the IRGC, and whether the government would act on Iranian involvement. The government said the AIVD had strong indications of Iranian involvement and expelled two embassy staff in 2018, but that criminal investigations contain no proof of Iranian involvement, so the IRGC cannot currently be listed, and it continues to press for listing where legally possible.
In public, the AIVD cannot go into the nature of these indications.
In het openbaar kan de AIVD niet ingaan op de aard van deze aanwijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de aanslag op de Nord Stream pijpleidingen

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government itself holds evidence or indications about who may be responsible for the Nord Stream pipeline attack, and if so, whether and when it will share this with the House. The government replied that it is awaiting the outcomes of the German, Danish and Swedish investigations, will share information in a timely and complete manner, but will not comment publicly on intelligence services' knowledge, methods or sources.
Regarding the level of knowledge, the working methods or the sources of the Intelligence and Security Services, the cabinet, as you know, makes no public statements.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten doet het kabinet, zoals bij u bekend, in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over ‘het bericht dat Nederland honderd Leopard-1 tanks aan Oekraïne zal leveren’

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the costs of supplying one hundred Leopard-1 tanks to Ukraine, the cost split with Denmark and Germany, and whether the Netherlands would get the tanks back after the war. The minister answered that total costs are not yet known and depend on how many tanks industry can make usable, that the cost split is still being negotiated, and that the tanks are a donation with no Dutch ownership retained.
The total costs of the delivery are not yet known at this time and depend, among other things, on the number of vehicles that industry can make operational.
De totale kosten van de levering zijn op dit moment nog niet bekend en hangen onder meer af van de hoeveelheid voertuigen die inzetbaar kunnen worden gemaakt door de industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over buitensporig geweld op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the reported killings and alleged disproportionate force by Israeli forces in the West Bank (Jenin), requesting a position, measures under the 2020 Karabulut motion, and whether to suspend the EU association agreement with Israel. The minister answered that the government is concerned, urges de-escalation and proportionality, lacks independent information beyond UN confirmation, and rejects suspending the association agreement or boycotting Israel.
The Netherlands, however, does not have independent information on this.
Nederland beschikt echter niet over eigenstandige informatie hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de gewelddadige aanslagen in Palestina en Israël en de dreiging van escalatie van het conflict

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about the lethal Israeli operation in Jenin, a deadly attack on a Jerusalem synagogue, calls for condemnation and EU follow-up, and why the Netherlands abstained on the UN resolution referring the occupation to the ICJ. The minister expressed concern, called on both sides to de-escalate and to respect international law, and explained the abstention by late timing and wording concerns, without committing to new concrete steps.
The Netherlands actively works within the EU to bring balance to the designation of the holy sites.
Nederland zet zich actief in binnen EU-verband om balans in te brengen in de aanduiding van de heilige plaatsen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de plaatsing van organisaties op terreurlijsten

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister whether organisations can be placed on terrorist lists by government decision rather than only by court rulings, and how the PKK listing and the IRGC listing relate to EU court judgments. The minister replied that listings can rest on national executive decisions as equivalents to judicial decisions, that EU court rulings did not find the PKK listing legally unsupported, and that under current EU law the IRGC cannot yet be listed, while the government keeps pressing for other measures.
Organisations cannot be placed on the EU terrorism list solely on the basis of court rulings.
Organisaties kunnen niet alleen op grond van rechterlijke uitspraken op de EU-terrorismelijst geplaatst worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van der Lee, Ceder, Teunissen, Piri, Kuzu en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de overdracht van Singh aan Nederland gebaseerd is op politieke onwil

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Foreign Ministers whether the government has done enough to bring detained Dutch national Jaitsen Singh from the United States to the Netherlands, and why a transfer (WOTS procedure) was not pursued after a parole denial. The government answers that a WOTS transfer does not meet the policy criteria because of insufficient ties to the Netherlands, that a pardon route on humanitarian grounds remains open, and that the family's willingness to take him in does not change the assessment.
The cabinet continues to make efforts to bring Mr Singh to the Netherlands on humanitarian grounds because of his advanced age and fragile health, provided he poses no danger to society.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen om de heer Singh op humanitaire gronden vanwege zijn hoge leeftijd en fragiele gezondheid naar Nederland te brengen, mits hij geen gevaar voor de samenleving vormt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Piri en Mutluer over het bericht dat de Duitse Rijksoverheid overweegt om mensen uit Turkije en Syrië die getroffen zijn door de aardbeving tijdelijk een visum te geven

MPs from the PvdA asked the Foreign Minister whether, following Germany and Belgium, the Netherlands would grant quick and simple visas to Turkish and Syrian earthquake victims with relatives in the Netherlands, and how visa policy is coordinated in Europe. The minister answered that first and second-degree relatives of Dutch residents already get priority visa processing under existing EU rules, with individual assessment and a 90-day Schengen visa, and described coordination with Schengen partners and EU bodies.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in close consultation with the Ministry of Justice and Security, facilitates first and second-degree relatives of Dutch residents from the earthquake area in applying for a Schengen visa.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken faciliteert, in nauwe samenspraak met het Ministerie van JenV, eerste/tweede graads-familieleden van Nederlanders uit het aardbevingsgebied bij de aanvraag van een Schengenvisum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over het actieplan Nederland-Marokko

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked about the Netherlands-Morocco action plan, its timing relative to journalist Omar Radi's conviction, a clause on non-interference in internal affairs, and advance notice of NGO funding. The minister answered that the Netherlands took the initiative, that the plan is a non-binding cooperation document, that human rights remain part of dialogue despite the non-interference clause, and that the parties agreed to inform each other in advance of project funding, without inspection or approval.
The cabinet sees no link between the date of Mr. Radi's conviction and the date of signing of the action plan
Het kabinet ziet geen verband tussen de datum van de veroordeling van dhr. Radi en de datum van ondertekening van het actieplan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de mobilisatie in Rusland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Foreign Minister about reports of a new Russian mobilisation and whether Russians fearing mobilisation should receive asylum protection or a suspension of decisions. The State Secretary answered that mobilisation was declared finished in October 2022 but incidental recruitment continues, that individual asylum assessments will proceed without a new moratorium, and that a new country report is due in spring.
This concerns a confidential source. It will not be made public.
Het betreft hier een vertrouwelijke bron. Deze wordt niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Pouw-Verweij, Ceder en Van der Staaij over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2023

MPs from CDA, JA21, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the foreign minister about Open Doors' 2023 persecution-of-Christians ranking, Dutch initiatives on violence and impunity, Nigeria, Sahel mercenaries, China, North Korea and dual-use exports. The minister largely acknowledged the concerns, described existing programmes and dialogues, and said that prospects for change in North Korea are small and that dual-use risks are handled by export control and corporate due diligence.
I receive the same signals from the embassies that concern me.
Ik krijg vanuit de ambassades dezelfde signalen die mij zorgen baren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de aanslag op de Nord Stream pijpleidingen

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether, given a Seymour Hersh report, the government considers US involvement in the Nord Stream sabotage plausible, and whether the US should withdraw from the ongoing investigation. The minister declined to speculate, pointing to the Swedish, Danish and German investigations, which are responsible for the inquiry.
The cabinet does not speculate on the cause of the explosions at the Nord Stream 1 and 2 pipelines and awaits the results of the investigation by the Swedish, Danish and German authorities.
Het kabinet speculeert niet over de toedracht van de explosies bij de Nord Stream 1 en 2 pijpleidingen en wacht de resultaten af van het onderzoek van de Zweedse, Deense en Duitse autoriteiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de ambassadeur van Azerbeidzjan in Nederland

An MP from JA21 asked the Foreign Minister about the accreditation criteria and procedure for foreign ambassadors, including whether inflammatory tweets by the new Azerbaijani ambassador were considered, and whether the Netherlands had ever refused an agrément. The minister explained the agrément process, stated that the Netherlands does not make political judgements on nominees, that freedom of expression applies to diplomats, and that both countries should return to negotiations.

In doing so, it is expressly the case that the Netherlands does not pass a political judgement on the merits of a proposed ambassador and likewise plays no role in the selection of the candidate ambassador.
Hierbij geldt uitdrukkelijk dat Nederland geen politiek oordeel velt over de merites van een voorgedragen ambassadeur en evenmin een rol speelt bij de selectie van de kandidaat-ambassadeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Brekelmans over het artikel ‘Serbia calls on Russia to stop recruiting its citizens as mercenaries for war in Ukraine’

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Serbian citizens fight for Russia in Ukraine and that the Wagner Group opened a 'cultural centre' in Serbia. The minister answered that Serbian law bans fighting abroad, some returnees have been prosecuted, the Wagner centre's presence is not confirmed, and the Commission is studying conditionality for Serbia's EU accession over weak CFSP alignment.

Question 2: How many Serbians have reportedly joined the Russian side since February 2022? Answer 2: The cabinet is aware of reports that Serbians are fighting for Russia in Ukraine but has no independent information on the numbers.

Vraag 2 Hoeveel Serviërs hebben zich naar schatting sinds de Russische aanval op Oekraïne in februari 2022 bij de Russische zijde van de strijd aangesloten? Antwoord 2 Het kabinet heeft kennis genomen van de berichten dat er Serviërs aan Russische zijde meevechten in Oekraïne, maar heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over de aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over import van uranium uit Rusland

An MP asked the government whether EU states import about 200 million euro of Russian uranium, whether Dutch nuclear operators still have Russian contacts, whether Dutch sanctions should cover uranium and Rosatom-linked firms, and what it would cost to stop such imports. The government answered that the Dutch import value is not dependent on Russian uranium, that no uranium was exported from Russia to the Netherlands since the invasion, that no EU-wide ban on uranium imports has sufficient support, and that it cannot comment on individual cases or negotiating positions.
The cabinet cannot address the negotiating position of individual member states.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op de onderhandelingspositie van individuele lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Ceder over het bericht dat Nagorno-Karabach kampt met een tekort aan voedsel en medicijnen door wegblokkade.

MPs Mulder and Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about reports of food and medicine shortages in Nagorno-Karabakh caused by the blockade of the Lachin corridor, including humanitarian options, EU/US pressure on Azerbaijan, Russian peacekeepers' role and an EU monitoring mission. The minister answered that the ICRC delivers aid, a airlift is not feasible without Azerbaijani consent, Azerbaijan has not complied, and the government is pressing Azerbaijan and considering an EU monitoring mission.
The Netherlands will continue to press for this in the relevant EU bodies.
Nederland zal hierop blijven aandringen in relevante EU-gremia.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over “Sponsoring van het EU-voorzitterschap door bedrijven”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether corporate sponsorship of the Swedish EU presidency, which opens the door to business funding, is acceptable and whether the Netherlands will ban such sponsorship during its own presidency. The minister answered that each presidency decides sponsorship autonomously, that the Council issued non-binding guidelines in 2021, that sponsorship is not in principle undesirable, and that the Dutch government values the guidelines and principles of impartiality and transparency.
Do you agree that safeguarding the integrity of European decision-making must take precedence over 'cutting the costs' of the EU presidency?
Deelt u de mening dat het waarborgen van de integriteit van Europese besluitvorming boven het «drukken van de kosten» van het EU-voorzitterschap moet worden gesteld?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de sterk toegenomen militaire uitgaven in de Europese Unie sinds de oorlog in Oekraïne en de hoge winsten voor de wapenindustrie

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the surge in EU military spending since the war in Ukraine, and the profits of the arms industry, are justified, including questions on the EU taxonomy, arms export policy and investment in nuclear weapons makers. The government defended higher defence spending as necessary for security and Ukraine support, rejected that the arms industry is the main beneficiary, said export policy is not being loosened, and said investment decisions are for companies and asset managers, though they are expected to follow OECD guidelines.
The cabinet is exploring options for better cooperation on this point and for aligning with the growing consensus on mutual recognition of licences.
Het kabinet onderzoekt mogelijkheden om op dit punt tot betere samenwerking te komen en om aan te sluiten bij de groeiende consensus over wederzijdse erkenning van vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Ceder over de inzet van explosieve wapens in Jemen

MPs Jasper van Dijk (SP) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Minister about civilian harm from explosive weapons in Yemen, the ten incidents in a Mwatana/PAX report, whether Yemen, Saudi Arabia and the UAE should sign the explosive weapons political declaration, how to revive UN accountability investigations, and whether arms-supplying states should be pressed to stop deliveries. The minister said Nederland supports better IHL implementation and promotes the declaration, supports accountability through Dutch funding and the High Commissioner for Human Rights, and has raised concerns over arms transfers, but gave no concrete new commitment to restart UN investigations or halt arms supplies.
Nederland has called in various international fora for signing this declaration, and Yemen, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates were also present there.
Nederland heeft in verschillende internationale fora opgeroepen tot het ondertekenen van deze verklaring, daar waren Jemen, Saudi-Arabië en de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten ook bij aanwezig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Agnes Mulder over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat 6 jaar geleden is ontvoerd naar India

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Dutch girl Insiya, abducted to India six years ago, and what has been done to restore her contact with her mother and return her to the Netherlands. Minister Hoekstra answered that the government raises the case with Indian authorities, relies on Indian court proceedings with no timeline for return, and that India has said the father's pending cases cannot be pursued in the local courts.
Unfortunately, no timeframe can currently be given for Insiya's return.
Er is helaas op dit moment geen termijn te geven voor de terugkeer van Insiya.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Haga over de protesten in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch contacts with Iranian democratic and human rights activists, support for protesters, EU and UN measures against Iran's repression, detained Dutch nationals, refugee policy, and an investigation into Mahsa Amini's death. The minister answered that the government has summoned the Iranian ambassador several times, urged an independent investigation, backed sanctions and a UN fact-finding mission, granted consular help in one detained case, and stated that asylum claims are assessed individually.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is also in contact with the family of this Dutch national, but makes no (public) statements about individual cases.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken staat tevens in contact met de familie van deze Nederlander, maar doet geen (publiekelijke) uitspraken over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de medische toestand van de in gevangenschap gehouden voormalig president van Georgië Mikheil Saakashvili

MP Sjoerdsma asks the Foreign Minister about the deteriorating health of detained former Georgian president Saakashvili, including possible poisoning, Dutch contacts with Georgia, a medical evacuation and consequences for Georgia's EU candidacy. The minister confirms serious concern and that the Netherlands raises it bilaterally, but says it cannot interfere in Georgian judicial proceedings and that the EU statement holds Georgia responsible for his health.
However, the Netherlands cannot interfere in the judicial process of another country.
Nederland kan zich echter niet mengen in de rechtsgang van een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het rapport dat het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zich schuldig maakt aan institutioneel racisme

MP Sylvana Simons asks the Foreign Affairs Minister to confirm that the ministry is institutionally racist, to explain the reassurance in the management response, and to commit to investigations, dismissals and a broader government-wide review. The minister acknowledges the institutional racism finding, apologises, promises an internal project group, a whistleblowing evaluation and leadership accountability, but declines to commit to a detailed plan timeline, to further specific investigations, or to broader ministry-wide review.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de documentaire 'Het laatste woord' en de straf die Jurriën in erbarmelijke omstandigheden uitzit in Tunesië

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked about the documentary 'Het laatste woord' and the harsh detention of a Dutch national, Jurriën, sentenced to 20 years in Tunisia. The minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the ministry provides consular assistance, has visited him 54 times, supported clemency requests, and cannot assess the legal proceedings abroad.
It is for the detainee and his lawyer to raise the aspects regarding the legal proceedings and legal remedies, and for the judge to then decide on them.
Het is aan de gedetineerde en zijn advocaat de aspecten ten aanzien van de rechtsgang en rechtsmiddelen aan de orde te stellen en aan de rechter hierover vervolgens te beslissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de opstelling van Nederland tegenover Israël

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands abstained on a UN General Assembly resolution requesting an ICJ advisory opinion on Israel's occupation, whether the court's views are authoritative, and whether the Dutch chess federation's choice of an East Jerusalem hotel for a tournament was appropriate and had been discussed with the federation. The minister confirmed the abstention citing late drafting and wording concerns, affirmed the advisory opinion's authority, confirmed contact with the chess federation, and declined to condemn the venue, referring back to the earlier answer.
That is correct. The Netherlands abstained from voting on the resolution.
Dat klopt. Nederland heeft zich onthouden van stemming over de resolutie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen en Leijten over Chinese inmenging in Nederland

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen and Leijten asked about reports of Chinese 'police service stations' in the Netherlands, whether those staff can stay and be prosecuted, whether the AIVD knew, where the limits of foreign interference lie, what infrastructure Chinese state actors hold and how to prevent its use as leverage, and whether cruciale sectors should be under Dutch control. The government said the stations have been closed after diplomatic protests, that no evidence yet shows staff were sent from China, that investigation continues and prosecution is not ruled out, declined to comment on AIVD knowledge, pointed to its three-track anti-interference approach and a planned espionage bill, and described the Vifo screening law and a reinforced vital-infrastructure approach while citing partial Chinese ownership of Rotterdam container terminals.
Regarding the knowledge level, working methods or sources of the intelligence services, the AIVD, as you know, makes no public statements.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten doet de AIVD, zoals bij u bekend, in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Chinese infiltratie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he would summon the Chinese ambassador, pursue sanctions in the EU, and close Chinese 'police stations' and expel their staff over alleged Chinese infiltration in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the ambassador was told the stations must close, which China confirmed, that no action toward China was needed now, that a review and better cooperation were pushed at EU level, and that investigations are ongoing with results expected in 2023.
Further investigation on this matter is being carried out by the relevant Dutch authorities.
Nader onderzoek ter zake wordt gedaan door de relevante Nederlandse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Dekker-Abdulaziz over Nederlanders in het buitenland die mogen stemmen op het Kiescollege niet-ingezetenen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked about low registration by Dutch citizens abroad for the Kiescollege niet-ingezetenen election and what outreach is planned. The minister reports 23,427 registrations as of 22 December, describes the information campaign and notes that reasons for non-registration will be examined in the evaluation later.
As part of the evaluation of the Kiescollege election, this will be done among voters in the permanent register who have not registered for the Kiescollege election.
In het kader van de evaluatie van de kiescollegeverkiezing zal dit wel worden gedaan onder kiezers in de permante registratie die zich niet voor de kiescollegeverkiezing hebben geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Piri over het bericht ‘Bedreigde Iraans-Nederlandse activist kreeg telkens nul op rekest bij Nederlandse politie voordat hij werd vermoord’

MPs Van der Lee and Piri asked how police failed to protect an Iranian-Dutch activist who reported repeated threats before being murdered, whether a reporting point for diaspora threats and stronger measures against foreign-regime intimidation are planned, and whether embassies of Morocco, Turkey, China and Iran were confronted. The minister declined to discuss the specific case for security reasons, said protection responsibility lies with local authorities, outlined diplomatic sanctions and a three-track approach, and promised further information on a reporting point.
For security reasons I cannot go into a specific case or the considerations made or not made.
Omwille van veiligheidsredenen kan ik niet ingaan op een specifieke casus en de afwegingen die wel of niet gemaakt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het standpunt van het kabinet inzake mensenrechten en internationale sporttoernooien

MPs Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk and Van Nispen asked the government how it will respond to calls from KNVB and FNV to improve migrant worker rights in Qatar ahead of the World Cup, and how it intends to influence sports federations and FIFA on human rights and compensation. The ministers answered that constructive-critical diplomacy and dialogue with Qatar are the chosen approach, noting reforms but ongoing concerns, and largely pointed to sports federations, companies and the KNVB for further action while expressing openness to compensation and diplomatic support.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to operate in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij ondernemen in lijn met de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen en de VN-richtlijnen voor bedrijfsleven en mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Van Strien en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Chipmaker Nexperia koopt Delftse start-up’

MPs asked the government about the acquisition of Delft start-up Nowi by Nexperia, a Chinese-owned chipmaker, and how the pending Wet Vifo investment screening law applies, including comparisons with UK and German blocking decisions. The minister said the Wet Vifo is not yet in force so no assessment of the Nowi takeover has been made, that it will examine the deal once the law takes effect given its retroactive reach, and that the government is not commenting on UK or German decisions.
Because there is no legal basis yet, I have not been able to carry out any investigations under this law, and therefore no assessment of the Nowi takeover has taken place.
Vanwege het ontbreken van een wettelijke basis, heb ik op dit moment nog geen onderzoeken kunnen doen op grond van deze wet en heeft er dus geen beoordeling plaatsgevonden van de overname van Nowi.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Piri over het bericht dat Israël een recent gebouwde Palestijnse basisschool heeft verwoest

MPs Van der Lee and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Israeli forces demolished a Palestinian primary school in Masafer Yatta, its legality under the UN Children's Rights Convention, the threatened forced relocation of residents, and the Netherlands' settlement discouragement policy. The minister said the Netherlands and the EU have raised serious concerns bilaterally and in EU statements, reiterated Israel's international obligations, and described the settlement discouragement policy's scope without listing concrete annual targets or results.
The Dutch discouragement policy applies to activities of Dutch companies when they directly contribute to the establishment and maintenance of settlements.
Het Nederlandse ontmoedigingsbeleid is van toepassing op activiteiten van Nederlandse bedrijven als zij direct bijdragen aan de aanleg en instandhouding van nederzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over Iraanse demonstranten die de doodstraf opgelegd hebben gekregen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about death sentences against Iranian protesters, the adequacy of EU sanctions, trade measures and Dutch dependencies on Iran. The minister answered that Netherlands condemns the repression, supports EU sanctions packages and a UN fact-finding mission, but judges trade sanctions limited in effect and declined to name future sanction targets.
The cabinet cannot make statements about concrete (and whether or not future) targets of EU sanctions, as this would undermine the effectiveness and surprise effect of sanctions.
Over concrete (en al dan niet toekomstige) doelwitten van EU-sancties kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen, omdat dit de effectiviteit en het verassingseffect van sancties zou ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de berichtgeving dat Iraanse demonstranten worden gevangengezet, gemarteld en de doodstraf wordt opgelegd.

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to reports of torture, detention and death sentences against Iranian protesters, including whether it will push for further EU sanctions and for Iran's removal from the UN Commission on the Status of Women. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the violence, has raised the issue bilaterally and at the UN, supports additional EU sanctions, helped secure Iran's removal from the CSW, and provides consular assistance to a detained Dutch national.
The Netherlands has condemned the violence against peaceful demonstrators from the outset and continues to strongly condemn all human rights violations in Iran.
Nederland heeft het geweld tegen vreedzame demonstranten van meet af aan veroordeeld en blijft alle mensenrechtenschendingen in Iran ten sterkste veroordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over investeringen in illegale nederzettingen

An SP MP asks the foreign minister about a report alleging Dutch banks, pension funds and asset managers invested EUR 12.5 billion in firms tied to Israeli settlements, and whether the government will press pension funds to withdraw. The minister says the government discourages economic activity that directly facilitates settlements, expects due diligence under IMVO, and has already held talks with pension funds, leaving divestment decisions to the funds themselves.
The cabinet does not itself keep track of such specific investments and leaves these figures to the authors of the report.
Het kabinet houdt dergelijke specifieke investeringen zelf niet bij en laat deze cijfers voor rekening van de opstellers van het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de rente aanvallen van Turkije op Koerdische gebieden

MP Sylvana Simons asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish airstrikes on Kurdish areas in Syria and Iraq, the humanitarian and IS risks, alleged chemical weapons use, the arrest of a Turkish academic, and possible sanctions and no-fly zones. The minister replied that the government shares Turkey's security concerns but urges proportionality and civilian protection, raises rights concerns bilaterally and multilaterally, and rules out sanctions as not the most effective tool.
The cabinet continues to stress to Turkey that its operations must be proportionate and take place within existing international legal frameworks.
Het kabinet blijft binnen het optreden van Turkije benadrukken dat dit proportioneel moet zijn en plaats moet vinden binnen de bestaande internationaal rechtelijke kaders.
Antwoord op op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Akkoord over beperken export chiptech naar China'

D66 MPs asked whether the cabinet agreed to export restrictions on chip-making machinery and technology to China, why parliament was not informed, and about security effects, consultation with Brussels and Dutch firms, and China's WTO complaint against the US. The ministers refused to share the content of talks with partners citing confidentiality, pointed to the 1 December letter and a confidential briefing, said no policy change is currently at stake, and declined to speculate on Chinese reactions or possible complaints against the Netherlands.
I cannot go into the content of discussions the Netherlands holds with partner countries because of confidentiality.
Op de inhoud van gesprekken die Nederland voert met partnerlanden kan ik vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over het bericht dat er Chinese politiebureaus in Nederland zijn

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van der Werf asked the government about reports of Chinese 'overseas police service stations' in the Netherlands, including their financing, legality, and protection of the Chinese diaspora. The minister answered that the stations were closed after the Chinese ambassador was summoned, that the financing and activities were still under investigation, and that the investigation results would be shared with the House if necessary.
When the investigation is concluded, the House will be informed about it (if necessary confidentially).
Wanneer het onderzoek is afgerond zal de Kamer hierover (indien noodzakelijk vertrouwelijk) worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Wijngaarden over het nieuws dat alle ambtenaren in Brussel een grote loonsverhoging krijgen.

Two MPs asked the government about reports that EU civil servants in Brussels receive a 7 percent pay rise and whether this is defensible, including its budget impact. The minister explained the automatic salary method, said the Netherlands has objected and asked the Commission to study its sustainability, but gave no commitment to lower top salaries.
The cabinet believes it should be examined to what extent this method is sustainable in times of high inflation, as is currently the case.
Het kabinet vindt dat gekeken moet worden in hoeverre deze methode duurzaam is in het geval van hoge inflatieperioden, zoals nu het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Brekelmans, Piri en Omtzigt over de podcast uitzending ‘Kim Lane Scheppele on Viktor Orbán’s Hungary’

Four MPs (Van Wijngaarden, Brekelmans, Piri, Omtzigt) asked the Foreign Minister about a podcast on Hungary's democratic decline, covering rule of law, EU sanctions, Russian diplomats, the IIB bank, Ukrainian refugees, EU funds, the state of emergency, EPPO membership and the EU's rule-of-law toolkit. The Minister answered that Hungary is not currently a fully democratic rule-of-law state, that the Commission should use all EU instruments, and that the Netherlands has consistently raised concerns and urged EPPO accession, while noting several questions fall to member states or the Commission.
Hungary violates fundamental values set out in Article 2 of the EU Treaty.
Hongarije schendt fundamentele waarden genoemd onder artikel 2 van het EU Verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht ‘Hoe CDA-politicus René van der Linden een pion van de Russen werd’

MPs Eppink asked the Foreign Minister about media reports that former CDA politician René van der Linden had close ties with the Kremlin and Azerbaijan's Aliyev regime, and how the government reflects on this. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, declined to comment on ties between former MPs and a foreign power, and said the government cannot respond to individual cases.
It is not for the cabinet to comment on the ties between (former) members of parliament and a foreign power.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om in te gaan op de banden tussen (voormalige) volksvertegenwoordigers en een buitenlandse mogendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Jasper van Dijk over een Europees programma ter ondersteuning van de evacuatie van bepaalde bijzonder kwetsbare personen uit Afghanistan

MPs Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the Netherlands implemented the EU Council decision on evacuating vulnerable Afghans, how many were transferred, why others were not, and whether pending court-case applicants were checked for eligibility. Minister Hoekstra answered that 24 of a maximum 25 agreed journalists, human-rights defenders and judges and their core family were transferred, one more may follow, the national family definition was unchanged, and the government did not examine the EDEO list because it was compiled by the EDEO and not shared with it for privacy reasons.
The cabinet has not examined whether persons in the group belong to the category that would be eligible for the EDEO list.
Het kabinet heeft niet onderzocht of er personen tot de groep behoren die in aanmerking zouden komen voor de EDEO lijst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Wijngaarden over de migratieroute via Servië

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the rise in irregular migration via the Western Balkan route through Serbia, including EU pressure on Serbia's visa regime and possible consequences for its visa-free arrangement. The government shares concern, reports Serbia's recent visa changes after EU diplomatic pressure, says it will monitor progress, and supports EU steps such as Frontex status negotiations and an action plan for the route.
The cabinet will closely monitor progress on this commitment and continue to press for progress.
Het kabinet zal de voortgang op deze toezegging nauwlettend monitoren en op voortgang blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat een Nederlands vrachtschip betrokken is bij een illegaal wapentransport naar Libië

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder asked whether a Dutch-flagged cargo ship carried a shipment of armoured vehicles to Libya in breach of the UN arms embargo, who was responsible, whether the cargo was sanctioned, why the ship had documentation, whether Dutch shipping firms will be prevented from future involvement, and whether an investigation has started. The government confirms the ship was inspected in October and the cargo seized pending a UN Panel of Experts investigation that has not concluded, declines to name the client or judge the documentation, says any criminal investigation is for the Public Prosecution Service, and does not name individual cases.

The investigation by the UN Security Council Sanctions Committee Panel of Experts into the client, the cargo, the required documentation including licences, and the possible breach of the arms embargo is still ongoing.

Het onderzoek door het Panel of Experts van het VN Veiligheidsraad Sanctiecomité naar de opdrachtgever, de lading van het schip, de benodigde documentatie – waaronder vergunningen – en de mogelijke schending van het wapenembargo is nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over Iraanse studenten in Nederland

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked how many Iranian students and academics are in the Netherlands, how institutions support them amid protests in Iran, and what consequences the protests have for cooperation with Iranian institutions. The minister gave counts (424 Iranian first-nationality HBO and 475 WO students), described existing support services and cooperation, and provided no commitments to new action.
For staff data, educational institutions are bound by privacy legislation. Nationality is a special category of personal data that may not simply be disclosed.
Voor de personeelsgegevens geldt dat onderwijsinstellingen gehouden zijn aan de privacywetgeving. Nationaliteit is een bijzonder persoonsgegeven dat niet zondermeer mag worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien, Rajkowski en Brekelmans over de Chinese investeringen in Nederlandse bedrijven

VVD MPs asked the ministers about Chinese investments in Dutch firms, the risk of espionage, screening tools such as the Vifo Act, and the EU foreign subsidies regulation. The government answered that existing tools are being strengthened, that it keeps no active overview of ownership structures, and that the Rotterdam port issue is under study, with a country-neutral approach preferred.
The cabinet does not keep an active overview of companies' ownership structures.
Het kabinet houdt geen actief overzicht bij van eigendomsstructuren van bedrijven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de berichtgeving dat Oeganda kampt met een nieuwe ebola-uitbraak

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg asked the government about reports of a new Ebola outbreak in Uganda, including flight links, airport screening, WHO response capacity and Dutch assistance. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that screening protocols are being strengthened, that the WHO has an emergency programme and funding gap, and that Dutch contributions go via WHO funds.
The cabinet is concerned about the Ebola outbreak in Uganda.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over de Ebola uitbraak in Oeganda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het jaarverslag van de Europese Rekenkamer over 2021 en de dechargeprocedure

Rep. Van Wijngaarden (VVD) asked the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors' 2021 annual report, including rising error rates in EU spending, risks from loans to third countries, and whether the Court receives all information it needs. The government answered that error rates remain too high (3.0% against a 2.0% tolerance), that it will push for tougher Council recommendations on discharge and may vote against them, and that it will raise transparency for the Court in general terms.
The cabinet will again this year push hard in the Council discussion for Council recommendations that sufficiently reflect the Court's conclusions.
Het kabinet zal zich ook dit jaar in de discussie in de Raad hard maken voor Raadsaanbevelingen die de conclusies van de ERK in voldoende mate reflecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘UK to issue ‘threat alert’ over China’s attempts to recruit RAF pilots’

MPs Valstar and Brekelmans asked whether the Dutch government knows of former military pilots training Chinese forces, whether Dutch personnel are linked to a South African flight school, and whether current law can prosecute former military personnel who work for foreign states. The minister answered that the matter is concerning and under investigation by the MIVD, that details cannot be given publicly, that the government is in contact with UK authorities and is considering further measures, and that existing laws (including Articles 101 and 205 of the Criminal Code) offer possibilities.
Because of the classified nature of this investigation, no statements can be made publicly about its nature and content.
Vanwege het gerubriceerde karakter van dit onderzoek kunnen over de aard en inhoud in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het voortbestaan van een onrechtmatige toestand van huwelijkse gevangenschap en de mogelijke verjaring

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the ongoing unlawful state of forced marriage (huwelijkse gevangenschap) can become time-barred, how many women sought legal aid or consular help, and what the government will do about funding, training and international cooperation. The minister answers that a pending bill makes the duty to cooperate in dissolving such a marriage legally enforceable and not subject to limitation, that the register cannot show how many cases were funded, that the fee point increase was raised to 19 points in 2022 but no further increase is planned, and that consular help is limited and the topic will be raised in EU and bilateral channels.
It can never, and therefore also not after a lapse of time, be required of anyone to remain bound in a religious or belief-based union that they do not wish to maintain.
Het kan nooit, en dus ook niet na verloop van tijd, van iemand worden gevergd dat hij blijft vastzitten in een religieuze of levensbeschouwelijke verbintenis die hij niet wenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Agnes Mulder, Dassen en Boucke over het bericht “COP27: Egypt pressed to make human rights move before climate summit”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, CDA, Volt and D66 asked the government about reports that Egyptian authorities restrict civil society and that many Egyptian organisations could not register for COP27, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about shrinking civic space, has raised accreditation inclusiveness and human rights with Egypt bilaterally and at EU level, but stressed that UNFCCC and Egypt as host carry the responsibility for participation.
The Netherlands, like other European countries, urges both bilaterally and multilaterally for an inclusive COP27 without participating organisations having to fear oppression or repercussions.

Nederland dringt, net als andere Europese landen, zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband, aan op een inclusieve COP27 zonder dat deelnemende organisaties hoeven te vrezen voor onderdrukking of repercussies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het recent uitgebrachte VN rapport over de mensenrechtenschendingen jegens de Oeigoeren in Xinjiang

MP Van der Lee asked the government about the UN OHCHR report on serious human rights violations against Uyghurs in Xinjiang, whether it changes Dutch policy, the share of Dutch trade with Xinjiang, and whether trade measures or mandatory supply-chain due diligence should follow. The ministers answered that the report is credible, Dutch policy is unchanged, Xinjiang accounts for under 1% of trade with China, and they pointed to EU and national due diligence and forced-labour proposals, while stating Nederland cannot unilaterally impose trade measures and that Dutch efforts continue in the Human Rights Council.
As an EU member state, the Netherlands cannot independently introduce a trade measure.
Nederland kan als EU-lidstaat niet zelfstandig een handelsmaatregel introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de nieuwe Amerikaanse wet die de export van geavanceerde chips en machines naar China verder aan banden wil leggen

Volt MP Dassen asked the Dutch ministers whether the US had requested Dutch-style export bans on chipmaking technology to China, whether a Dutch DUV machine ban was under discussion, and about the geopolitical implications. The government answered that it regularly consults the US on export controls but would inform parliament of relevant policy changes, declined to disclose the content of a confidential meeting, acknowledged economic interests, and said export control is a national competence while Dutch policy aims for European coordination.
Due to the confidentiality of this conversation, I cannot make statements about the precise content discussed.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van dit gesprek kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de precieze besproken inhoud.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de berichten dat er een superjacht van de Russische oligarch Potanin in Nederland ligt en een omstreden Rus met vastgoed in Amsterdam buiten schot van sancties blijft

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether a superyacht linked to Russian oligarch Potanin, and property in Amsterdam linked to a sanctioned Russian, could evade sanctions, and asked about ownership structures, listings and seizure. The government answered that yachts may not be sold or delivered to Russian persons, that frozen assets are not the same as seizure, and that it will not comment on individual cases, while promising to inform parliament about sanctions enforcement and the Blok report.
