The cabinet does not make any statement about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doet het kabinet geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over ‘Nederland kan weer migranten uitzetten naar Marokko - maar mag geen kritiek meer geven op het land’

MPs Piri and Kröger asked whether the Netherlands has stopped publicly criticising human rights abuses in Morocco in exchange for renewed cooperation on migrant returns, and about a possible extradition treaty. The minister replied that the relationship is constructive, denied any agreement to refrain from public criticism, said human rights are discussed case by case and that exploring an extradition treaty is at official level, while committing only to keep the Chamber informed.
No agreements have been made that the Netherlands will no longer publicly voice criticism regarding human rights.
Er zijn geen afspraken gemaakt dat Nederland niet langer openbaar kritiek uit ten aanzien van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de mobilisatie in Rusland

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about Russian mobilisation, refugees fleeing it, Baltic border closures, and whether the departure and decision moratorium should be extended. Minister Hoekstra answered that IND assesses each asylum claim individually, the Netherlands backs a coordinated EU approach, and extending the moratorium is not ruled out while the situation is examined.
In the meantime, we are not taking irreversible steps in asylum and return procedures where a genuine appeal is made on grounds related to the mobilisation.
In de tussentijd nemen we geen onomkeerbare stappen in asiel- en terugkeerprocedures waarin een reëel beroep wordt gedaan op gronden gerelateerd aan de mobilisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de door Poetin aangekondigde gedeeltelijke mobilisatie en het Europees verbod op toeristenvisa voor Russen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Russian mobilisation, the Russian narrative of 'russophobia', and whether the EU should admit fleeing Russian men, plus security risks and a visa exemption. The government answered that member states control border entry under EU and international law, that it supports a coordinated EU approach, and that it will not seek an exemption from the visa suspension for men aged 18-55.
The cabinet supports the EU agreement to reach a joint approach that takes into account both international obligations and security aspects.
Het kabinet steunt de in de EU gemaakte afspraak om te komen tot een gezamenlijke aanpak, waarbij zowel de internationale verplichtingen als veiligheidsaspecten in acht worden genomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Sjoerdsma, Boulakjar en Boucke over het bericht dat beide Nord Stream pijpleidingen vlak na elkaar zijn stuk gegaan en dat seismologische bureaus van Denemarken en Zweden hevig

MPs from D66 asked whether the Nord Stream pipeline explosions were sabotage, whether Russia could invoke force majeure, whether the Netherlands would push the EU to phase out Russian gas, and how Dutch offshore pipelines and infrastructure would be protected. The government answered that sabotage is almost certain but attribution is not yet possible, outlined EU gas-reduction measures and infrastructure protection plans, and promised a separate letter on North Sea protection.
It is almost certain that this was a sabotage action.
Het staat vrijwel zeker vast dat het hier een sabotageactie betrof.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Erkens, Brekelmans over het bericht 'Norway oil safety regulator warns of threats from unidentified drones'en het bericht 'Duitse media: lek Nord Stream vrijwel zeker sabotage 'do

MPs Valstar, Erkens and Brekelmans asked the government about reports of unidentified drones near Norwegian offshore gas infrastructure and reports that sabotage by a state actor was likely behind the Nord Stream leak, including questions on Russian vessel activity and NATO protection. The Foreign Minister answered that a real threat to vital undersea infrastructure exists but declined to disclose suspicious activity, said the Baltic and Nordic investigations must determine responsibility, and described NATO and Norwegian protective measures and Dutch work on mapping vulnerabilities.
For security reasons, the Netherlands in principle never makes statements about suspicious activities.
Nederland doet vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen in principe nooit mededelingen over verdachte activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Marokkanen 'ten einde raad' door problemen en fraude bij visa'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about long visa waiting times, slot resale fraud and the ministry's responsibility for outsourced visa processing for Moroccan applicants. The minister acknowledged ministry responsibility, cited capacity constraints and technical anti-fraud measures, and committed to raising processing capacity to 80% of pre-COVID levels by year end.
Yes. Increasing the processing capacity for visa applications submitted worldwide is an important priority.
Antwoord 5 Het verhogen van de capaciteit van de behandeling van de wereldwijd ingediende visumaanvragen is een belangrijke prioriteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Kuzu, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Brekelmans, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons en Piri over het bericht dat waarnemers van de Organisatie voor Veiligheid en Samenwerkin

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about two Ukrainian OSCE staff members sentenced to over ten years by courts in the unrecognised Luhansk region, asking about their detention conditions, pressure on Russia, evacuation of local staff, and whether Turkey could help secure their release. The minister confirmed the sentences, said detention location is unknown, listed joint EU and OSCE calls for release, and said the OSCE Secretary General is working on their release.
At this time it is not known where the detainees are being held.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend waar de gevangenen worden vastgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over MH17-verdachte Igor Girkin

The MP asks whether the government knows of Ukraine's bounty for Igor Girkin, whether Ukrainian measures are coordinated with the Netherlands, whether Ukraine was warned about the Tsemach transfer, and whether the government has secured or will press for Girkin's extradition. The government confirms the bounty, declines to discuss ongoing criminal matters and inter-state communication, says extradition has been requested via the prosecutor and communicated to Ukraine, and says the questions will be answered within the usual period.
On ongoing criminal cases and inter-state communication within that framework, I cannot make any statements.
Over lopende strafzaken en interstatelijke communicatie in dat kader, kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj en Jasper van Dijk over de voortgang overbrenging uit Afghanistan

Three MPs asked whether the 1 November deadline for evacuations from Afghanistan applies only to people with passports who refused the offer, and whether people unable to travel through no fault of their own remain eligible. The minister confirmed both points: the deadline covers only passport holders who refused earlier, four of 28 such people did not respond, and those unable to travel for reasons beyond their control keep their eligibility with no deadline set.
For this group, no deadline has been set for the time being.
Voor deze groep is vooralsnog geen deadline gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over groeiende uitgaven van bedrijven voor de lobby in Brussel

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Corporate Europe Observatory report showing that the 50 largest corporate lobbying budgets in the EU rose from about 90 to 120 million euros since 2015, and about the imbalance with NGO lobbying and transparency of corporate lobbying. The minister replied that companies may decide freely how to lobby, that the EU transparency register and codes of conduct are the relevant rules, and that the Dutch Permanent Representation's contacts with stakeholders are a legitimate part of its work, without committing to new measures.
The cabinet is of the view that individual companies are free to decide whether and how they give substance to lobbying activities as part of business operations.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het individuele bedrijven vrij staat om te bepalen of en hoe zij invulling geven aan lobbyactiviteiten als onderdeel van de bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over het reisadvies voor Rusland

MP Brekelmans asks the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands keeps its Russia travel advice at orange rather than red, as the US and UK have done, and whether it will urge Dutch nationals to leave Russia more actively. The minister answers that orange fits the specific, non-nationwide risks, that the Netherlands coordinates with EU partners and has been in contact with the US and UK, and that Dutch nationals have been advised to leave since February via the travel advice and embassy channels.
For the Dutch travel advice, the orange colour code is currently the most appropriate.
Voor het Nederlandse reisadvies geldt dat de oranje kleurcode op dit moment het meest passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het openen van een EU-attractie in Den Haag

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether he could stop the planned EU 'Europa Experience' exhibition in The Hague, and questioned the cost given the cost-of-living crisis. The minister replied that it is a European Parliament initiative in which the member state has no role, that costs are not yet known pending a public tender for a building, and that the Council urges restraint on EU administrative spending.
The member state concerned has no role in it, neither in approval or budget, nor in implementation.
De desbetreffende lidstaat heeft daar geen rol bij, noch in de accordering of begroting, noch in de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj en Ceder over de voortgang overbrengingen Afghanistan

MPs Piri, Belhaj and Ceder asked the foreign and defence ministers about the progress of evacuations from Afghanistan, including whether an end date applies, how applications are assessed, and why former Dutch embassy guards were not evacuated. The minister answered that no end date has been set yet, that the criteria are applied as consistently as possible, and that the decision on the guards was made earlier and remains unchanged.
As promised during the debate of 31 March, the cabinet's intentions regarding a possible end date for the evacuation operation will be communicated to your House in advance.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het debat van 31 maart jl. zullen voornemens van het kabinet met betrekking tot een eventuele einddatum van de overbrengingsoperatie vooraf aan uw Kamer worden gecommuniceerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Sjoerdsma over de Europese Parlementsverkiezingen van 2024 naar aanleiding van het kabinetsstandpunt over het initiatiefvoorstel van het Europees Parlement over de verk

The MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Sjoerdsma asked how many non-Dutch EU residents registered to vote in the 2019 European Parliament elections, how they were informed, whether turnout was evaluated, and about the timeline and direction of the European Electoral Act reform. The Minister answered that 56,637 registered in 2019, that municipalities are legally obliged to inform them, and that the Netherlands does not track their actual turnout, while promising further outreach and noting Council negotiations on the Electoral Act have only just begun.
The Netherlands does not keep track of how many of these persons actually went to vote.
Nederland houdt niet bij hoeveel van deze personen daadwerkelijk zijn gaan stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Studieschuld niet afbetaald? Dan geen paspoort. 'Ik begrijp niet waarom Duo dit doet''

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked the ministers about DUO withholding passports from former students with unpaid study debt, including whether this is a fair pressure tool and how often hardship clauses are used. The government answered that DUO uses passport signalling only as a last resort, that the Paspoortwet legally allows it to protect state finances, and that the Staatssecretaris of BZK will evaluate the system.
DUO does not register how often a tailored solution is reached or how often the hardship clause is applied.
DUO registreert niet hoe vaak een maatwerkoplossing getroffen wordt of de hardheidsclausule wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de strijd tussen Azerbeidzjan en Armenië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands condemns Azerbaijan's attacks on Armenia, supports Armenia, provides funding to Azerbaijan, and would sanction its government or visit Armenia. The minister answered that the government prioritises de-escalation and EU mediation, does not take sides, gave details on EU aid, trade and a planned monitoring mission, and will answer within three weeks.
The Netherlands is first focusing on EU mediation.
Nederland zet nu eerst in op EU-bemiddeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het PAX rapport betreffende foute investeringen van de ING en andere grote banken in de wapenindustrie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about a PAX report finding that major European banks, including ING, financed arms producers supplying states with high risk of using weapons against civilians, such as Saudi Arabia. The government answered that banks must apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and UNGP, that exporters with valid licences operate within legal frameworks, and that it sees no reason to meet ING, while pointing to forthcoming due diligence legislation.

The government expects Dutch banks such as ING, in line with the OECD Guidelines and the UN Guiding Principles, to map risks to people and the environment in their value chain for their investments in the defence industry.

Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse banken zoals ING dat zij, conform de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen (OESO-richtlijnen) en UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's), voor hun investeringen in de defensie-industrie de risico's voor mens en milieu in hun waardeketen in kaart brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de dood van de 22-jarige Mahsa Amini na mishandeling en door de Iraanse religieuze politie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government judges the death of Mahsa Amini after abuse by Iran's religious police and the violent suppression of protests, whether it will condemn Iran and push for EU Magnitsky-type sanctions. The minister answered that the Netherlands has strongly condemned the violence, urged an impartial investigation and will repeat this at the Foreign Affairs Council, and that existing EU Iran sanctions exist but the government does not comment in advance on new sanctions proposals.
The cabinet in principle makes no statements about concrete proposals for new sanctions, so as not to undermine the element of surprise and thereby the effectiveness of such measures.
Het kabinet doet in beginsel geen uitlatingen over concrete voorstellen voor nieuwe sancties, om zo het verrassingseffect en daarmee de effectiviteit van dergelijke maatregelen niet te ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van der Woude over de dood van Mahsa Amini en de protesten in Iran

Two VVD MPs asked the government how it condemns the death of Mahsa Amini and the repression of protests in Iran, and what it is doing on demonstrators' rights, an independent inquiry, sanctions, women's rights, the nuclear deal and travel advice. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly condemned the violence and urged Iran bilaterally and multilaterally to respect peaceful protest and conduct an impartial inquiry, and that it supports EU human rights sanctions while not pre-announcing specific measures.
In principle, however, the cabinet does not comment on concrete proposals for new sanctions, so as not to undermine the element of surprise and thus the effectiveness of such measures.

Het kabinet doet in beginsel echter geen uitlatingen over concrete voorstellen voor nieuwe sancties, om zo het verrassingseffect en daarmee de effectiviteit van dergelijke maatregelen niet te ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de recente aanslag op Nord Stream 1 en 2

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister about the sabotage of Nord Stream 1 and 2, including possible state actors, Russia's ability to cut gas, and remarks by Sikorski and Biden. The minister declined to speculate on perpetrators while the Swedish, Danish and German investigation is ongoing, and said Nord Stream was not in use so the sabotage had no direct effect on EU supply security.
While this investigation is ongoing, I do not wish to speculate about possible perpetrators or stakeholders.
Lopende dit onderzoek wil ik niet speculeren over mogelijke daders of belanghebbenden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Kuzu, Van der Lee en Piri over het feit dat Taiwan graag waarnemend lid wil worden van de Internationale Burgerluchtvaartorganisatie

MPs from seven parties asked the government about Taiwan's wish to become an observer at the ICAO, including whether it could be invited under the Council's rules, its safety relevance for flights, and whether the Netherlands would support its participation at the 41st Assembly. The minister answered that Taiwan could in principle be invited as an 'other body' observer to the Council only if China agreed, is excluded from the Assembly under Taiwan's non-state status, and that the Netherlands supports meaningful Taiwan participation in coordination with like-minded countries while respecting its one-China policy.
Taiwan is not considered a state by the Netherlands and most other states in the world and therefore cannot in principle participate as an observer in these meetings.
Taiwan wordt door Nederland en de meeste andere staten in de wereld niet als staat beschouwd en kan daarom in principe niet als waarnemer aan deze vergaderingen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de aanzwellende protesten in Iran na de dood van de vrouw Mahsa Amini

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about protests in Iran after Mahsa Amini's death, her treatment by the religious police, and the protests' economic dimension. The minister says Netherlands has repeatedly called for an impartial investigation, condemned the repression, and will push for EU human rights sanctions and an EU statement at the Foreign Affairs Council.
The Netherlands further works towards introducing EU human rights sanctions.
Nederland zet zich voorts in voor het instellen van EU-Mensenrechtensancties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'The backdoor that keeps Russian oil flowing into Europe’

An MP asked the ministers whether Shell and other firms blend Russian fuel into diesel to evade the appearance of Russian origin, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that origin is assessed case by case under EU customs rules, that no signals of breaches by Shell were found, that indirect Russian oil may still enter the mix, and that the government is preparing possible further sanctions and a phase-out plan, but the answer was given late.
I have no signals that Shell, or other European parties, are not complying with the European sanctions rules.
Ik heb geen signalen dat Shell, of andere Europese partijen, zich niet aan de Europese sanctieregels houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de dood van Mahsa Amini in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the death of Mahsa Amini in Iran, whether Nederland condemns it, what it is doing to protect Iranian women, whether it will engage the Iranian ambassador and recall its own ambassador, and about trade, travel advice and the nuclear deal. The minister answered that Nederland has condemned the violence, called for an impartial investigation, raised the matter in multilateral forums and at EU level, and gave concrete answers on travel advice and aid, while declining to recall the ambassador.
The Netherlands has no figures on the number of Dutch companies that trade with Iran.
Nederland heeft geen cijfers over het aantal Nederlandse bedrijven dat handelt met Iran.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over de VN-conferentie over het wereldzeeënverdrag

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked how the Netherlands is pushing, at the UN conference on the high seas treaty (BBNJ), for ambitious and effective marine protection, including binding area-based measures, mandatory environmental impact assessments and a scientific body. The minister replied that the EU and member states negotiate with one voice, that no agreement was reached on the full package in August 2022, and that the Netherlands supports binding area protection, mandatory EIAs with a two-tiered threshold approach, and access and benefit sharing for marine genetic resources.
The Netherlands, together with the EU and the other member states, will again actively work toward finalising an effective and future-proof treaty at the next UN conference.
Nederland, gezamenlijk met de EU en de andere lidstaten, zal zich tijdens de volgende VN-conferentie wederom actief inzetten voor de afronding van een effectief en toekomstbestendig verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Von der Leyen blijft zwijgen over vaccinonderhandelingen met Pfizer'

The MP asks whether the European Commission refuses to comply with the European Court of Auditors' information requests on the May 2021 Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine contract, and whether Dutch oversight powers are weaker than EU ones. The minister answers that the Court's report only notes missing documents on the preparatory negotiations, that the EU Treaty and Financial Regulation give the Court broad access powers comparable to the Dutch Algemene Rekenkamer, and sees no reason to tighten them.
From these provisions it follows that the European Court of Auditors has extensive powers to inspect all documents it considers necessary for carrying out its tasks.
Uit deze bepalingen volgt dat de Europese Rekenkamer uitgebreide bevoegdheden heeft tot inzage in alle documenten die zij voor de uitvoering van haar taken noodzakelijk acht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over ‘Kiev wacht op tanks, Duitsland we wachten op uw belofte’

MP Agnes Mulder asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence why Germany has not supplied tanks to Ukraine despite prior commitments, and what the Netherlands can do to change this, including through NATO. The ministers answered that Ukraine needs more material support, that the Netherlands coordinates with allies including Germany, that NATO has no agreements on the type of equipment allies supply, and that they will keep urging partners to support Ukraine, without making commitments about Germany's decisions.
The cabinet makes no statements about the considerations of allies regarding military support.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over de overwegingen van bondgenoten ten aanzien van militaire steun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat “Turkije lid wil worden van de ‘NAVO van het Oosten’

MP De Roon asks the Foreign Minister about Turkey's reported bid to join the China-led Shanghai Cooperation Organisation, how SCO members cooperate militarily, and whether this threatens NATO membership or warrants Turkey's expulsion from NATO. The minister answers that SCO cooperation is limited and not a joint military concept, that states decide their own partnerships provided obligations do not conflict with NATO duties, and that expelling Turkey is neither possible nor in the Netherlands' interest.
It is up to countries to make an independent sovereign decision regarding their participation in international cooperation arrangements.
Het is aan landen om een eigenstandige soevereine beslissing te nemen ten aanzien van hun deelname aan internationale samenwerkingsverbanden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over aanvallen op Armeens grondgebied en de deelname van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Azerbeidzjan aan een door de Azerbeidzjaanse regering georganiseerd bezoek aan de stad Sushi in

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about Azerbaijani attacks on Armenian territory and whether the Dutch ambassador in Baku joined a government-organised trip to Shusha in Nagorno-Karabakh, questioning Dutch support for OSCE Minsk Group mediation and calls for accountability. The minister said the Netherlands condemns the violence and backs EU mediation, that the ambassador joined the trip to observe the situation without endorsing it, and that the Netherlands opposes an independent investigation as counterproductive.
The cabinet has neither the capacity nor a presence on the ground to establish who started the fighting or who first violated the ceasefire.
Het kabinet heeft noch de capaciteit, noch de presentie ter plaatse, om vast te stellen wie de gevechten is begonnen, alsook wie het staakt-het-vuren als eerste schond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de opgelaaide militaire agressie van Azerbeidzjan tegen Armenië

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the renewed fighting between Azerbaijan and Armenia, including Russia's peacekeeping role, EU engagement with Aliyev, and financial support to Azerbaijan. The minister answered that the government cannot establish who started the fighting, outlined EU mediation and his own calls, rejected that the EU is passive, and said the EU's MoU with Azerbaijan creates no binding financial obligations.
No binding legal and financial obligations have been entered into.
tekenden zijn geen bindende juridische en financiële verplichtingen aangegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de wapenstilstand tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan is mislukt

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about renewed fighting between Armenia and Azerbaijan, including spread beyond Nagorno-Karabakh, possible Azerbaijani leverage from its gas supplies to the EU, the status of peace talks, and the EU-Azerbaijan memorandum. The minister answered that the government is concerned, supports EU-led mediation and the restart of talks, and that the memorandum creates no binding obligations.
The Netherlands supports the EU in the mediation process.
Nederland steunt de EU in het bemiddelingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de internationale campagne om de klimaatcrisis naar het Internationale Gerechtshof (ICJ) te brengen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Vanuatu's campaign to seek an ICJ advisory opinion on the climate crisis, Australian and New Zealand support, Kingdom SIDS representation at the UN General Assembly, and whether the government would back a UN resolution requesting such an opinion. The minister confirmed awareness, described Kingdom efforts on SIDS and climate at the UN, and said the Netherlands would decide after the legal question is formulated, in principle supporting advisory requests that are relevant to international law and not bilateral or essentially political.
The Netherlands is awaiting the formulation of the specific legal question before taking a position.
Nederland is in afwachting van de formulering van de specifieke rechtsvraag alvorens stelling ingenomen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Sylvana Simons over de ernstige situatie in Suriname ten aanzien van ziekenhuiszorg

MPs Ceder and Sylvana Simons asked ministers about severe staff shortages in Surinamese hospitals, possible recruitment of Surinamese nurses by Dutch hospitals causing brain drain, and Dutch support for staffing, funding and training. The government answered that it supports Suriname via the Makandra programme, a seconded expert, about EUR 8 million from the Verdragsmiddelen for a Zorg Transitie Fonds, expert travel budgets via PUM, and an extended training agreement for Surinamese doctors, while stating it does not actively recruit non-EEA labour and that hospitals may hire under existing rules.
The cabinet, however, does not actively pursue labour migration from outside the EEA (except knowledge migration).
Het kabinet zet echter niet actief in op arbeidsmigratie van buiten de EER (met uitzondering van kennismigratie).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de moord op een Palestijnse journaliste

The MP Jasper van Dijk asks the Foreign Minister how he views the Israeli army's conclusion that the killer of journalist Shireen Abu Akleh cannot be identified, whether independent investigation is still needed, and what more diplomacy could achieve. The minister responds that the Netherlands continues to press Israel for accountability and prosecution, notes Israel's forensic investigation under US oversight, and defends diplomatic dialogue as an effective instrument.
Together with like-minded partners, the Netherlands continues to press Israel for accountability and for the prosecution of those responsible for the death of Shireen Abu Akleh.
Samen met gelijkgezinde partners blijft Nederland bij Israël aandringen op verantwoording en op berechting van degenen die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de dood van Shireen Abu Akleh.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het Nederlandse stemgedrag in de World Health Assembly

An MP asks why the Netherlands voted against the annual WHA resolution on health conditions in the occupied Palestinian territory and Syrian Golan in 2021 and 2022, while supporting the resolution on Ukraine, and whether this double standard undermines credibility. The minister answers that each resolution is judged on its merits, that the Palestinian/Golan resolution diverges from its underlying report and is handled separately from other emergencies, and that the government recommended folding it into the general emergency agenda item, without committing to change its vote.
The government assesses every resolution on its content and merits.
Het kabinet beoordeelt iedere resolutie op inhoud en merites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de komst van het energiebedrijf Gunvor naar Nederland met mogelijke betrokkenheid van Vladimir Poetin

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked whether President Putin has a stake in Gunvor, which plans a green hydrogen terminal in Rotterdam, and whether its establishment is acceptable given sanctions. The minister answered that no indications of Putin ownership were found, that Gunvor's ownership is held by Torbjorn Törnqvist, that existing screening and investment checks cover sanctions compliance, and that no measures against the plan are currently justified.
Based on the currently available information, there are no indications that this is the case.
Op basis van de thans beschikbare informatie zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat hiervan sprake is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de arrestatie van Steve Bannon

The MP Baudet asked the Dutch foreign minister whether the arrest of Steve Bannon in the US, and related remarks by Biden advisers, raise concerns about political prosecution and the rule of law. The minister answered that the government has confidence in the American rule of law, declined to characterise Bannon's role, and said asylum requests from the US are assessed individually while the US is a designated safe country of origin.
I have confidence in the American rule of law.
Ik heb vertrouwen in de Amerikaanse rechtstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de situatie in Suriname

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked the ministers about Suriname's flooding, the strained health system including infant deaths in the single NICU, shortages of nurses, and the critique by Kruijt and Maks of past Dutch aid under the Verdragsmiddelen. The minister confirms awareness, describes UNICEF and DRR water support, Dutch health advisers and a Zorg Transitie Fonds, and says Makandra technical assistance supports sustainable capacity building.
Through the Makandra programme of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, technical assistance is financed.
Via het Makandra-programma van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken wordt technische assistentie gefinancierd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat advocatenkantoor Houthoff nog steeds zaken doet met Russische klanten

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether law firm Houthoff still serves Russian clients despite sanctions, whether the Amsterdam dean (a partner at Nauta-Dutilh) can independently oversee it, what the investigation into Houthoff found, and when legal aid to Russian clients is exempt from sanctions. The minister answered that legal aid is permitted for non-sanctioned Russian clients, that aid necessary for litigation to a sanctioned party is exempt from the prohibition under a line still awaiting European Commission confirmation, that the dean's conflict of interest is addressed by a professional statute and planned reforms creating a national supervisory authority, and declined to detail the internal investigation citing confidentiality.
As I indicated in answer to earlier parliamentary questions, given the special position of the legal profession in our society, supervision of lawyers takes place independently of the government.

Antwoord 3 Zoals ik in antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen 6 heb aangeven vindt, gelet op de bijzondere positie van de advocatuur in onze samenleving, het toezicht op advocaten onafhankelijk van de overheid plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Van der Graaf over de noodsituatie in Pakistan wegens overstromingen

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked whether the government knows of the flood emergency in Pakistan and whether it will provide emergency aid and involve local and civil society organisations. The minister confirmed awareness, pointed to over EUR 3.5 million via the Dutch Red Cross and Dutch Relief Alliance plus expert deployments and flexible funding to UN and Red Cross partners, and said local organisations are engaged in line with Grand Bargain commitments.
The Netherlands has already made emergency aid available for Pakistan.
Nederland heeft reeds noodhulp beschikbaar gesteld voor Pakistan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over misstanden binnen de United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS)

An MP asked the Foreign Trade and Development minister about mismanagement at UNOPS, including Dutch funds linked to the WSSCC, the S3i initiative, a whistleblower not being heard, and suspension of payments. The minister answered that Dutch payments were paused and resumed under conditions, that whistleblowers are always heard, and that a temporary payment freeze and stricter commitment procedure were introduced while external investigations proceed.
Whistleblowers who report to Foreign Affairs are always heard.
Klokkenluiders die zich melden bij Buitenlandse Zaken worden altijd gehoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het direct of indirect volgen van politiek geëngageerde burgers op de social media en het mogelijk plegen van censuur

MP Van Haga asked ministers whether government monitors politically engaged citizens on social media, coordinates counter-disinformation with platforms, and whether a police home visit and a later account removal involved state interference. The government answered that platform contacts concern how platforms tackle disinformation with no formal minutes, that no structural policy targets citizens' posts, and that it cannot discuss individual cases such as the Enschede visit.
As indicated in the answer to question 13, individual cases cannot be discussed.
Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 13 kan er niet worden ingegaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de rol van Frontex bij illegale pushbacks door de Griekse kustwacht

An MP asked the government about reports that Frontex knew of and concealed illegal pushbacks by the Greek coast guard, and what the Dutch contribution to those operations was. The government answered that OLAF's mandate covers only integrity breaches by three managers, that Nederland pleaded for disciplinary action without a majority, that Dutch personnel were deployed in Greece without vessels or aircraft, and that suspending Dutch participation would not be appropriate under the EGKW regulation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over Albanië wil ‘gouden paspoorten’ verkopen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Albania's plan to sell 'golden passports' and the risks this poses for EU accession and sanctions evasion. The minister agreed with the Commission that such schemes create security and corruption risks, said the Netherlands opposes them within the EU and bilaterally, and noted the issue will be raised with Albania and in Brussels where appropriate.
The cabinet has no insight into how many passports are issued through such schemes within EU member states.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op hoeveel paspoorten via dergelijke regelingen verstrekt worden binnen EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over de spendeerdrift en baantjescaroussel van het Europees Parlement

An MP from the PVV asks the Foreign Minister about the European Parliament's proposed budget increases, staff numbers, and an alleged informal pact among EU institutions not to scrutinise each other's administrative spending. The minister answers with budget and staffing figures, explains the Council's critical position and call for restraint, and says the Netherlands will push for a prudent EU budget in line with the MFF agreement.
The European Parliament proposed a budget of 2,268 million euros in the Commission proposal for the 2023 budget.
Het Europees Parlement heeft in het Commissievoorstel voor de begroting van 2023 een budget voorgesteld van 2.268 miljoen euro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat Hongarije toestemming geeft voor de bouw van twee Russische kerncentrales

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Hungary approving two Russian-built nuclear reactors, the Hungarian decision's conflict with EU sanctions aims, and whether Rosatom should be sanctioned. The minister said the decision does not breach EU law, that the cabinet will keep raising EU unity and energy dependence, and that he supports further sanctions but will not comment on specific listing proposals.
The cabinet supports additional sanctions measures but makes no statements about specific listing proposals.
Het kabinet is voorstander van aanvullende sanctiemaatregelen, maar doet geen uitlatingen over specifieke listingsvoorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Piri over het annuleren van Europride

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Piri asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would protest Serbia's cancellation of Europride and press for it to go ahead under police protection, and whether this should weigh in EU accession assessments. The minister agreed that freedom of assembly must be upheld and said the Netherlands has raised the issue bilaterally and with EU partners, with the Commission expected to address it in its progress report.

Since the reports on Europride, the Netherlands has consulted closely with civil society partners in Serbia, the EU and like-minded countries on possible options for action both publicly and behind the scenes.

Nederland heeft sinds de berichtgeving over Europride nauw overleg gevoerd met maatschappelijke partners in Servië, met de EU en met gelijkgezinde landen over mogelijke handelingsopties voor zowel voor als achter de schermen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de trage uitvoering van sancties

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister why the implementation of sanctions against Russian-linked persons was delayed by over a month, and whether authorities acted too slowly. The minister answered that data sharing was legally blocked until an April amendment, that no violations were found, and that legislative and structural reforms to the sanctions regime are underway.
The cabinet does not recognise the picture that it acted slowly.
Het kabinet herkent zich niet in het beeld dat er traag is opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Chinese bedrijven de Russische oorlogsmachine steunen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Chinese firms supply Russia's military, including the role of Poly Technologies, Chinese state media propaganda, and calls for chip and dual-use export bans and sanctions on Chinese firms. The minister answered that the government works to curb Russia's military-industrial capacity within EU sanctions, that enforcement against third-country entities is legally limited, that export licences are checked for diversion risk, and that the Netherlands supports adding semiconductors to EU sanctions while keeping consultations with partners ongoing.
The Netherlands continues to work for expanding controls on electronic components containing semiconductors.
Nederland blijft zich inzetten voor het uitbreiden van controles op elektronische componenten die semiconductoren bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over het artikel ‘Sancties tegen Russen bleven maand liggen.’

An MP asked the ministers why Dutch enforcement of Russia sanctions was delayed by more than a month after the Chamber of Commerce held relevant data, and whether the delay was caused by legal issues and how recurrence will be prevented. The minister answered that the data could not be shared without a legal basis, that the legal gaps are being closed through changes to the sanctions regulation and modernisation of the sanctions system, and that a permanent sanctions team has been set up.

The sharing of these personal data was partly addressed with the amendment of the sanctions regulation in April, but it became clear that a more structural modernisation of the sanctions system would be needed.

Het delen van deze persoonsgegevens is met de wijziging van sanctieregeling territoriale integriteit Oekraïne 2014 in april deels ondervangen, maar duidelijk werd dat een meer structurele modernisering van het sanctiestelsel nodig zou zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over oliewinning in het Virunga Nationaalpark in de Democratische Republiek Congo en de dreiging daarvan voor het voortbestaan van berggorilla’s

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether oil extraction in Virunga National Park threatens the mountain gorillas, whether EU/CAFI funding to Congo should be conditioned or frozen, and what Dutch companies and the state did regarding oil exploration there. The minister acknowledges the risks to the park and gorillas, says oil licences have not yet been issued and CAFI donors will press Congo, but declines to freeze Dutch funds, says the state had no role in the exploration study, and lists existing gorilla protection support.
Ik houd de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over ecocide door Russische militaire agressie in Oekraïne

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the Foreign Minister about ecocide and environmental damage from Russia's aggression in Ukraine, including whether the ICC investigation covers the Rome Statute's environmental clause and whether Nederland will support evidence gathering. The minister answered that the government respects ICC independence, offers forensic support on request, and maintains its earlier position against a standalone ecocide crime, while saying it has no information on the reported number of environmental complaints.
The Dutch government respects the independence of the International Criminal Court and therefore does not interfere substantively with criminal investigations by the ICC Prosecutor.

De Nederlandse regering respecteert de onafhankelijkheid van het Internationaal Strafhof en bemoeit zich derhalve niet inhoudelijk met strafrechtelijke onderzoeken van de Aanklager van het Internationaal Strafhof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ellemeet en Dassen over het vastleggen van het recht op abortus in het Europees Handvest van grondrechten van de Europese Unie

MPs Sjoerdsma, Ellemeet and Dassen asked the Foreign Minister about the US Dobbs ruling restricting abortion, funding of anti-abortion groups, and whether abortion access should be anchored in the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights. The minister expressed concern, said abortion is mainly a member-state competence, and noted that anchoring it in the Charter would require treaty change, which support among member states may lack.
The cabinet is closely following the discussion on anchoring the right to abortion in the Charter and will further examine the feasibility of this initiative.
Het kabinet volgt de discussie over het verankeren van het recht op abortus in het Handvest op de voet en zal zich verder verdiepen in de haalbaarheid van dit initiatief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht dat er 8 olietankers met Russische fossiele brandstof op weg zijn naar de havens van Rotterdam en Amsterdam

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether eight tankers carrying Russian fossil fuels bound for Rotterdam and Amsterdam could be refused entry, and whether the government would act against such vessels. The government answered that Dutch law under current EU sanctions does not allow refusal of non-Russian-flagged tankers, that an EU oil import ban will take effect after transition periods, and that it has no further legal grounds to block the ships.
At present it is not possible for the government to refuse non-Russian-flagged ships carrying Russian oil products.
Van regeringswege is het op dit moment niet mogelijk om niet-Russisch gevlagde schepen met Russische olie(producten) te weren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over belemmering van de Russische wapenindustrie

An SP MP asked the Dutch ministers whether Russian arms-industry figures and firms were left off EU sanctions, whether Western electronics feeding Russian weapons were being curbed, and whether Dutch and EU arms and dual-use exports to Russia had been stopped. The government answered that the EU has listed major Russian defence firms and related persons, that no military exports to Russia have been licensed or made since 2014, and that no dual-use export licences have been granted since February 2022, while declining to comment on specific new sanction proposals and noting that a universal UN arms embargo is unlikely given Russia's veto.
The cabinet supports additional sanctions measures but does not comment on specific proposals for new sanctions.
Het kabinet is voorstander van aanvullende sanctiemaatregelen, maar doet geen uitlatingen over specifieke voorstellen voor nieuwe sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over verslag van staatskasfraude in Suriname

An MP asks the government whether it accepts the findings of a report on alleged state-treasury fraud in Suriname, whether Suriname's economy has collapsed, and whether the Prime Minister should make a state visit given these allegations. The minister answers that prosecution of alleged fraud is for the Surinamese prosecutor, that IMF and Paris Club debt steps are underway, and that the visit is a working visit within good bilateral relations.
It is not for the Netherlands to establish the truth regarding a matter occurring in another sovereign country and to pass judgment on it here.
Het is niet aan Nederland om aan waarheidsvinding te doen ten aanzien van een zaak die in een ander, soeverein land speelt en hier een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het geweld tegen Hindoes in Bangladesh en India

Wilders (PVV) asks the government about violent attacks on Hindus in Bangladesh and India, including the killing of a tailor who supported Nupur Sharma, and about threats against himself, and whether it will condemn the violence and press both governments on protection. The minister condemns all violence against religious minorities, says Dutch policy raises the issue through bilateral and EU human rights dialogue, and notes that the perpetrators are being prosecuted and that the threats from Pakistan are raised with its authorities.
The cabinet firmly condemns all forms of violence against religious minorities and monitors global developments on this, including in Bangladesh.
Het kabinet keurt iedere vorm van geweld tegen religieuze minderheden nadrukkelijk af en monitort de wereldwijde ontwikkelingen hieromtrent, zo ook in Bangladesh.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over felicitaties aan Pakistan in een week vol doodsbedreigingen en een moordaanslag op het vrije woord

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Dutch chargé d'affaires in Pakistan publicly congratulated Pakistan on its independence day amid death threats against Geert Wilders and the attack on Salman Rushdie, and what the government will do about the threats. The minister answered that the greeting is customary for countries Dutch relations with, that the government has repeatedly raised its concerns with Pakistani authorities at both The Hague and Islamabad levels, and that the ambassador continues to represent Dutch interests.
The cabinet is in contact with the Pakistani authorities about this, both in Islamabad and in The Hague.
Het kabinet staat hierover in contact met de Pakistaanse autoriteiten, zowel in Islamabad als in Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over Taiwan en China

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister about China's military drills around Taiwan after Speaker Pelosi's visit, Chinese claims over Taiwan and the South China Sea, Dutch diplomatic steps, and Taiwan's participation in international bodies. The minister answered substantively, calling the drills an escalation, restating Dutch one-China policy and calls for restraint, and describing Dutch efforts on WHO observer status for Taiwan.
In line with the EU's calls through HR Borrell, the Netherlands has called on China to show restraint in the Taiwan Strait.
In lijn met de oproepen van de EU bij monde van HV Borrell, heeft Nederland China opgeroepen terughoudendheid te betrachten in de Straat van Taiwan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het Verdrag inzake de Voltrekking en de Erkenning van de Geldigheid van Huwelijken

An MP asked the government about the Hague marriage recognition convention and a case where a Dutch woman's marriage concluded at the British embassy in Beijing was not recognised under Article 10:31(2) of the Civil Code. The minister answered that the municipality applied an existing reading of that article, that its interpretation may conflict with scholarly views, and that the question will be put to the Commission of Advice on civil status, while stating the convention does not bar recognition of same-sex marriages.
This gives me reason to submit the question about that application in such cases to the Commission of Advice on civil status and nationality.
Dit vormt voor mij aanleiding de vraag omtrent die toepassing in dit soort gevallen voor te leggen aan de Commissie van advies voor de zaken betreffende de burgerlijke staat en de nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Agnes Mulder over de actie van het Israëlische leger om de kantoren van zeven ngo’s te sluiten

MPs Sjoerdsma and Agnes Mulder asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's raid on the offices of seven Palestinian NGOs, the legal grounds for the designations, and whether the Netherlands would act with the EU to protest and secure the NGOs' ability to continue their work. The minister condemned the raid as a serious blow to civil society, said the underlying terrorism evidence remains non-public and unconvincing to the Netherlands and eight EU partners, and reported a joint demarche and continued EU and bilateral engagement.
As indicated in parliamentary questions 736 (member van Dijk, 27 October 2021), the information underlying these listings is not public.
Zoals aangegeven in Kamervragen 736 (lid van Dijk, 27 oktober 2021) is de informatie die ten grondslag ligt aan deze listings niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het rapport van Nils Melzer

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers for all written communication between the two ministries about UN rapporteur Nils Melzer's report. The minister provided a selection of inter-ministerial correspondence as an annex and noted that the rapporteur's letter has since been answered, with the government's reply sent separately.
Based on those parliamentary questions, I have made a selection of the written communication between my ministry and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Op basis van die Kamervragen heb ik een selectie gemaakt van de schriftelijke communicatie tussen mijn ministerie en het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het rapport Death in Slow Motion: Women and girls under Taliban rule van Amnesty International van 27 juli 2022

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Amnesty International's report on women and girls under Taliban rule, including the lifting of the asylum decision and departure moratorium for Afghans, the treatment of Afghan women asylum seekers, and sanctions and humanitarian aid. The government said it is pursuing diplomatic and financial support focused on women's and girls' rights, will give the benefit of the doubt in individual asylum cases involving (imputed) Westernised women, and that the UN sanctions regime does not block health care or food supplies.
The Cabinet has great concerns about the increasing repressive measures against women and girls in Afghanistan.
Het Kabinet heeft grote zorgen over de toenemende repressieve maatregelen tegen vrouwen en meisjes in Afghanistan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Roon over VN-rapporteur die sanctiebeleid onderzoekt en haar donateurs

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about UN rapporteur Alena Douhan's study of sanctions and its funding by China, Qatar and Russia, and whether Dutch funding to the OHCHR should stop. The minister answers that the mandate concerns negative impacts of sanctions rather than the broader human rights situation, that the Netherlands values rapporteur independence, and that he will share the forthcoming report and the Dutch assessment with parliament.
The Netherlands will take note of the report and, after studying it, will express a response during the discussion of the report.
Nederland zal kennis nemen van het rapport en na bestudering een reactie uitspreken tijdens de bespreking van het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie van de Russische oppositiepoliticus Vladimir Kara-Murza

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Russian opposition figure Vladimir Kara-Murza, his prison conditions, fair trial, access for diplomats and journalists, and possible EU sanctions. The minister called the arrest a serious violation of political freedoms, said Russia denies consular access so conditions are known only from public reports, and committed to advocating for fair trial and detention conditions and supporting human rights defenders, while noting Dutch diplomatic staffing problems and not commenting on sanctions listings.
In its human rights policy the cabinet works to protect human rights defenders and promote freedom of expression, including in Russia.
Het kabinet zet zich in zijn mensenrechtenbeleid in voor de bescherming van mensenrechtenverdedigers en bevordering van de vrijheid van meningsuiting, ook in Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bezoek van de Europese Commissie aan Azerbeidzjan

Parliamentarian Sjoerdsma asked whether the European Commission's visit to Azerbaijan aimed at a gas deal and whether human rights and political prisoners, including Elvin Isayev, would be raised. The minister answered that the visit produced an energy MoU and that human rights concerns are raised in EU dialogues and will continue to be raised, without committing to a specific new step.
The cabinet will continue to raise concerns about the human rights situation in Azerbaijan, including that of political prisoners.
Het kabinet zal de zorgen over mensenrechtensituatie in Azerbeidzjan, waaronder die van politieke gevangenen, blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Moroccan authorities accused of trying to cover up Melilla deaths’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Moroccan authorities tried to cover up deaths at the Melilla border, including calls for an independent investigation and questions on EU funding and mistreatment of migrants. The minister condemned the events, said Spanish and Moroccan investigations are underway, and that the government lacks independent information on several allegations.
At this moment the cabinet does not have information on exactly what happened during the tragic events of 24 June
Op dit moment beschikt het kabinet niet over informatie over wat zich precies heeft afgespeeld tijdens de tragische gebeurtenissen op 24 juni

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de inform

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister-President and Foreign Affairs Minister what measures the ministry has taken, following the childcare benefits scandal, on hardship-causing laws, prior inventories, the handling of new proposals, the baseline measurement for digital information management, the chat-message retention policy, and the number of FOI requests. The government answered that departments are conducting inventories of hardship-causing rules, outlined the methodology and timelines, described the retention rules for chat messages, and referred to attached overviews for FOI request data.
Question 2: Has this research, or have these studies, been shared with the House? If not, can you explain in detail why not and send the research to the House without delay?
Vraag 2 Is dit onderzoek of zijn deze onderzoeken met de Kamer gedeeld? Zo nee, kunt u uitgebreid motiveren waarom niet en kunt u het onderzoek onverwijld naar de Kamer sturen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het Kremlin aan de Zuidas

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether law firm Houthoff profited from work for sanctioned Russian state banks such as Sberbank, whether it should have done client due diligence, and whether prosecution, confiscation, and a legal framework for supervising lawyers are possible. The minister answered that the Amsterdam bar supervisor found no sanctions breach, declined to comment on the individual case, said prosecution depends on concrete signals, and said a legal framework for lawyer sanctions supervision is being prepared with an outline letter promised before the budget debates.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie met betrekking tot de Oeigoeren

MP Sjoerdsma asked the government about the Xinjiang Police Files, whether the Uyghur situation should be called genocide, UN and ICC follow-up, business complicity, protection of Uyghurs in the Netherlands and family reunification. The minister condemned the abuses, joined a 47-country UN statement, said genocide recognition is under EU-level review, and outlined existing measures while noting limits on information and responsibility lying elsewhere.
The cabinet has noted the visit of UN High Commissioner Bachelet to Xinjiang and the fact that the visit was not an investigative mission.
Het kabinet heeft nota genomen van het bezoek van de VN Hoge Commissaris van de Mensenrechten Bachelet aan Xinjiang en het feit dat het bezoek geen onderzoeksmissie was.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitnodiging per email aan minister Kaag voor de virtuele meeting van de Regional Action Group for the Middle East and North Africa van het World Economic Forum (WEF)

An MP asks whether the minister should have noticed that a WEF invitation sent on US election day anticipated a major change in global trade and presumed the outcome of the election, and whether the 2000 Mules documentary proves fraud. The minister answers that the WEF's intention is unknown, that the US ambassador was not informed, that the email has no predictive value, and that the documentary is unknown to her.
I am not aware of the underlying intention of this WEF sentence in the email you cite.
Ik ben niet bekend met de achterliggende bedoeling van deze zin van het WEF in de door u aangehaalde email.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Wederopbouw van Oekraïne met Russisch geld? Dat is mogelijk'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether frozen Russian assets could be confiscated for Ukraine's reconstruction, including via a UN compensation commission and national legislation on state immunity. The minister answered that international law on state immunity and the Freeze & Seize taskforce limit such options, and that the government is still exploring possibilities without identifying concrete legal steps.
For now, no concrete legal steps have been identified that would make it possible to confiscate frozen assets and use them for Ukraine's reconstruction.
Vooralsnog zijn er geen concrete juridische stappen geïdentificeerd die het mogelijk maken om bevroren tegoeden te confisqueren en deze vervolgens in te zetten voor de wederopbouw van Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de lange wachttijden bij het aanvragen van een Schengenvisum voor Nederland

MP Piri (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister why Schengen visa applications from Suriname and Morocco take four to six months, despite a 15-day standard, and what will be done. Minister Hoekstra attributed the delays to a Covid-era reduction in processing capacity, a capped intake of applications in high-volume countries, and recruitment of staff, with a target of 80% of 2019 output by year-end.
The aim is for Schengen visa issuance to reach 80% of pre-Covid 2019 output by the end of this year, so that visa applicants can again submit their applications within the applicable deadline.

Het streven is dat de Schengenvisumverlening eind dit jaar 80% bedraagt van de productie in het pre-Covid jaar 2019, waarmee visumaanvragers in staat worden gesteld hun visumaanvraag weer binnen de geldende termijn te kunnen indienen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het verschijnen van de Annual Review of the Human Rights Situation of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Intersex People covering events that occurred in Europe and Central Asi

An MP from Volt asked several ministers about the ILGA Europe 2021 review of LGBTI rights, including Dutch LGBTI conditions, asylum treatment of transgender applicants, violence, intersex surgery, transit leave and bi+ visibility. The government broadly recognises the report's account of the Netherlands, declines to assess other states' asylum procedures, and outlines ongoing measures and studies while promising letters on several items later.
The cabinet considers it too early to anticipate the outcomes of these processes.
Het kabinet vindt het te vroeg om op de uitkomsten van deze trajecten vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekoek en Van der Lee over noodvisa voor journalisten

MPs Koekkoek and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister how Dutch posts in Russia can continue supporting human rights defenders and journalists after the expulsion of diplomats, and why emergency visas for at-risk journalists are not more readily available given EU guidelines and a parliamentary motion. The minister answered that support continues in limited form, that humanitarian visas remain possible in exceptional cases, that a band-with-the-Netherlands criterion applies under the Visa Code, and that ministries are still studying how to implement the motion.
The Ministries of Foreign Affairs and of Justice and Security are jointly examining the possibilities to implement the above-mentioned Dassen and Van der Lee motion.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid bekijken gezamenlijk de mogelijkheden om uitvoering te geven aan de bovengenoemde motie-Dassen en Van der Lee
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Medewerkers die klaagden over seksueel geweld binnen de VN werden ontslagen’

MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about a report that UN staff who complained about sexual violence were dismissed, and about reporting, retaliation, sanctions and whistleblower protection. The minister acknowledged concerns about inaction and a culture of fear, pointed to UN mechanisms (Clear Check, OIOS, immunity waiver, whistleblower reforms) and said the Netherlands can cut funding, as recently done with UNOPS.
It is concerning that a number of UN staff still experience that the procedures fall short and speak of a culture of fear and impunity.
Het baart zorgen dat een aantal VN-medewerkers nog steeds ervaart dat de procedures tekortschieten en spreekt over een cultuur van angst en straffeloosheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de bescherming van Russische vluchtelingen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government should be more generous toward Russian asylum seekers, including conscientious objectors and deserters, given Russia's repression and the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, and whether it would impose a moratorium or designate them as a risk group. The State Secretary answered that Russian asylum policy is adequate and not strict: the existing country-specific policy covers activists, journalists, LHBT people and others, a six-month decision and departure moratorium was introduced for Russian male conscripts aged 18-27 who refuse or desert, and a new general country report is expected in early 2023.
For this reason it was decided to introduce a decision and departure moratorium for a period of six months after entry into force for Russian conscripts who refuse military service or desert.

Om deze reden is er besloten om een besluit- en vertrekmoratorium in te stellen voor een periode van zes maanden na inwerkingtreding voor Russische dienstplichtigen die dienstweigeren of die deserteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klink en Kamminga over het bericht dat de Britten een wetsvoorstel hebben ingediend om Brexit-afspraken Noord-Ierland eenzijdig te wijzigen

Two MPs from the VVD asked the government about a UK bill that would allow unilateral changes to Brexit Northern Ireland Protocol arrangements, including its impact on trade, Ireland, Dutch-UK relations and the role of the EU Court of Justice. The Minister answered that the government shares EU concerns, supports Commission dialogue and pressure measures, and urges the UK to honour its international obligations, while the bill's final content and implications remain uncertain.
The cabinet has, in the EU and in contacts with the UK, expressed its concerns about any form of unilateral action.
Het kabinet heeft de afgelopen periode in de EU en in de contacten met het VK zijn zorgen uitgesproken over iedere vorm van unilaterale actie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Sylvana Simons en Belhaj over het bericht ‘Afghaans ambassadepersoneel moet betalen voor verblijf in azc's’

MPs asked whether it is fair that former Afghan embassy staff must pay a contribution for asylum reception from their severance pay, given they still lack permanent housing and job offers fell through. The Minister says BZ provided extensive psychosocial and job support, that job offers were cancelled in 14 cases due to distance from housing, that 18 of 37 have been allocated housing, and that the small contribution under the REBA rules is justified.
A small contribution under the REBA scheme is realistic and justified, partly in light of all the efforts BZ as former employer has made and is still making.
Een geringe eigen bijdrage conform de REBA-regeling is reëel en gerechtvaardigd, mede in het licht van alle gedane en nog lopende inspanningen die BZ als voormalig werkgever heeft gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het eerste rapport van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad naar het geweld tussen Israël en Palestijnse terroristen

An MP from the PVV asks the Foreign Minister about a UN Human Rights Council inquiry report on violence between Israel and Palestinian groups, criticising its focus on Israel, the leadership of the inquiry, and its mandate, and asks whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister answers that the Netherlands opposes disproportionate attention to Israel, joined US and EU statements criticising the inquiry's broad mandate, and will not oppose the inquiry's existence outright, but does not commit to dissolving it.
The cabinet will continue to speak out against one-sided anti-Israeli positions, in line with the Van der Staaij motion.
Het kabinet zal zich blijven uitspreken tegen eenzijdige anti-Israëlische standpunten, conform de motie-Van der Staaij (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 2374 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de moordpartij op honderden Amhaarse burgers in Ethiopië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a massacre of hundreds of Amhara civilians in Oromia, Ethiopia, attributed to the OLA, and about EU contacts with TPLF and the stance on the conflict. The minister condemned the violence, said the EU and Netherlands support negotiations and an inclusive national dialogue, but gave no commitment to a formal EU condemnation.

I strongly condemn this act of violence and join the call of the Ethiopian Human Rights Commission for the Ethiopian government to do everything possible to prevent new attacks on civilians or outbreaks of violence.

Ik veroordeel deze gewelddaad ten zeerste, en sluit mij aan bij de oproep van de Ethiopische Mensenrechtencommissie (EHRC) aan de Ethiopische regering om al het mogelijke te doen om nieuwe aanvallen op burgers of uitbarstingen van geweld te voorkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Ceder over kritiek op het mandaat, de werkwijze en het eerste rapport van de onderzoekscommissie (COI) naar Israël en de Palestijnse gebieden binnen de VN-Mensen

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about criticism of the UN Human Rights Council's Commission of Inquiry on Israel and the Palestinian territories, including its mandate, its first report and Dutch voting behaviour. The minister replied that the Netherlands abstained in 2021 because the mandate was too broad and open-ended, supported a US-initiated joint statement criticising the mandate, and gave limited responses on the legal critiques, while declining to share answers before the 14 June debate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de hint van premier Johnson dat hij uit het Europees mensenrechtenverdrag dreigt te stappen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about UK Prime Minister Johnson's hints at leaving the European Convention on Human Rights, the Rwanda deportation plan, and the Assange extradition case. The minister said the UK remains bound by the ECHR, the government is monitoring the UK's Bill of Rights and its compliance, and it would raise any breach of international law bilaterally and multilaterally.
The cabinet closely follows these developments during the parliamentary approval process.
Het kabinet volgt deze ontwikkelingen gedurende het parlementaire goedkeuringsproces nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Strolenberg, Sjoerdsma en Sneller over de mogelijkheid tot online stemmen voor Nederlanders in het buitenland

Four MPs from VVD and D66 asked whether Dutch citizens abroad could be allowed to vote online, citing France's online voting for expats. The Minister of Interior replied that internet voting is rejected because it creates cyber risks to secrecy, freedom, and integrity of elections, that no steps are planned, and that no new study will be commissioned.
Introducing internet voting makes the electoral process vulnerable to cyber risks that put these safeguards at risk, such as ballot secrecy, freedom of voting and integrity.
Het introduceren van internetstemmen maakt het verkiezingsproces kwetsbaar voor cyberrisico's waarbij er risico's zijn voor deze waarborgen, zoals het stemgeheim, de stemvrijheid en de integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Piri over het bericht ‘’Honderden gemartelde homo’s in Tsjetsjenië, toch doen PwC, Deloitte en KPMG er zaken’

MPs Thijssen and Piri asked the ministers about reports that PwC, Deloitte and KPMG do business in Chechnya despite serious human rights abuses, and whether the Dutch government will hold these firms to account under OECD guidelines and due diligence rules. The ministers said the government has concerns about Chechnya, that sanctions target individuals rather than firms, that the firms are largely not Dutch-registered, and that the government will pursue IMVO legislation at EU level without committing to a specific action against the firms.
The cabinet cannot assess whether these companies have insufficiently met their due diligence obligation.
Het kabinet kan niet beoordelen of deze bedrijven hun due diligence-verplichting onvoldoende zijn nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over “de door Nederland uitgesproken steun aan diepzeemijnbouw”

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked about Dutch support for deep-sea mining, scientific uncertainty about deep-sea ecosystems, how the Dutch position was formed and who was involved, and the timeline for ISA decisions. The government answered that Dutch aims are environmentally strict conditions and a precautionary approach before exploitation, that the final position will be sent to parliament in Q3 2022, and gave partial detail on the process.
The cabinet will inform the House further about the Dutch position in the third quarter of 2022.
Het kabinet zal Uw Kamer in het derde kwartaal van 2022 nader informeren over het Nederlands standpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Nauwere samenwerking tussen Nederlandse en Marokkaanse politie’

MPs Piri and Mutluer asked the government why it pursued closer police cooperation with Morocco before answering earlier questions, and whether this could intimidate Moroccan political opponents in the Netherlands given past torture and spyware allegations. The minister answered that Morocco is an important partner against organised crime, that an extradition treaty would only be explored, and that the government finds the alleged spyware use unacceptable, while leaving the allegations to Moroccan authorities and deferring the written consultation answers to a later date.
The visit of the police chief to Morocco was intended as a get-to-know-you meeting, to strengthen relations and discuss mutual interests in better cooperation to combat organised crime.

Het bezoek van de korpschef aan Marokko stond in het teken van nadere kennismaking, het aanhalen van de relaties en het bespreken van de wederzijdse belangen in betere samenwerking om georganiseerde criminaliteit te bestrijden.
Antwoord op van het het lid Jasper van Dijk over het gebrekkige toezicht op Russische bedrijven

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign and Finance Ministers about weak oversight of Russian-linked companies, illegal trust services and sanctions enforcement capacity, citing a newspaper article and a 31-50% estimate of unlicensed trust providers. Minister Hoekstra replied that the government is aware of the issues, announced six measures and a trust-sector study, explained that DNB enforces mainly on signals, and said capacity is being reallocated pending new staff.
The outcome of the study will be communicated to the House as soon as possible after the summer.
Over de uitkomst van het onderzoek wordt uw Kamer na de zomer zo snel mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de steun aan een Nederlander die in Syrië gevangen zat en gemarteld is

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers why the government did little to find and help a Dutch citizen from Arnhem detained and tortured in Syria, and whether his case could support prosecution or state liability proceedings. The government answered that consular options in Syria were extremely limited, that it kept the family informed and explored options, and that it follows the family's decision on whether the case is used in the liability claim.
The Dutch policy of not entering into diplomatic contacts with the Syrian government is motivated by the war crimes and human rights violations committed by the Assad regime.
Het Nederlandse beleid om geen diplomatieke contacten met de Syrische overheid aan te gaan is ingegeven door de oorlogsmisdrijven en mensenrechtenschendingen door het regime van Assad.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Ceder en Van der Staaij over ‘digitale vervolging’ door in elk geval China en Rusland, en over de arrestatie van een 90-jarige priester door de Chinese autoriteiten

Two MPs (Ceder and Van der Staaij) asked the Foreign Minister about digital persecution by China and Russia, including surveillance of religious minorities, China's social credit system, export controls on surveillance technology, and the arrest of Cardinal Zen. The minister acknowledged the risks, described existing EU and Dutch export controls and corporate due diligence expectations, and said the Netherlands and EU are monitoring the Zen case closely and will raise it in the Foreign Affairs Council if needed.
The Netherlands and the EU are following the case closely.
Nederland en de EU volgen de zaak nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de aanwezigheid dit jaar bij de Bilderbergconferentie

An MP from FvD asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister why they attended the 2022 Bilderberg conference, which sessions they joined, what was discussed, and whether minutes could be released. The government confirmed attendance for the full conference, deferred to the conference secretariat for invitation policy and reasons, and refused to share Nederlandse input or minutes, citing Chatham House Rules that Rutte said he accepted by attending.
No, see the answer to question 6.
Nee, zie het antwoord op vraag 6.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de Bilderberg-conferentie

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the Bilderberg conference, including what was discussed and decided, costs to taxpayers, and whether full transparency will be provided. The government answered that discussions fall under Chatham House Rules, no decisions are taken there, the total cost of the minister's participation was EUR 8,837.99 and is publicly disclosed, and that voters influence the government through elected MPs.

As also indicated in the answers to the questions from the member Van Houwelingen, the discussions during the conference fall under the Chatham House Rules in order to promote an open exchange of ideas and opinions.
