Zoals ook aangegeven in de beantwoording op de vragen van het lid van Houwelingen vallen de besprekingen tijdens de conferentie onder de Chatham House Rules om zo een open uitwisseling van ideeën en meningen te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Omtzigt over de olietanker Sunny Liger

MPs Piri and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the tanker Sunny Liger carrying Russian oil, including contacts with buyers, options to block docking, shipment lists, and monthly import figures. The minister answered that the government had no contact with the owners, the ship had left Dutch waters, no shipment list was available, and some import data was withheld on competition grounds.
Some of this information cannot be made available by Statistics Netherlands due to competitive interests.
Een deel van deze informatie kan door het CBS niet beschikbaar worden gesteld vanwege concurrentiebelangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Eppink over het instellen van de doodstraf in Irak voor mensen die normalisatie of vrede met Israël nastreven

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Eppink asked the Foreign Minister about Iraq's 2022 law criminalising normalisation with Israel, including possible life imprisonment or death penalty, and whether the Netherlands would object bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN. The minister answered that the law raises serious concern under international law, that the Netherlands has voiced concerns bilaterally and in the EU, will keep monitoring implementation, and will consider sanctions only after the law takes effect.
The Netherlands will continue to proactively speak out against this law bilaterally and within the EU, keep pressing Iraq on it, and closely monitor the law's implementation.
Nederland zal zich bilateraal en in EU-verband proactief blijven uitspreken tegen deze wet, Irak hierop blijven aanspreken en de uitvoering van de wet aandachtig en nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een dreigende Turkse invasie in Syrië

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a possible new Turkish military operation in northern Syria, Turkish plans to resettle Syrian refugees there, Turkey's democratic record, and whether Turkey still qualifies for NATO membership. The minister said the Netherlands shares US concern, urges de-escalation, holds that Syria does not yet meet standards for safe return, supports a Syrian-led political process under UNSCR 2254, raises human rights with Turkey, and sees NATO as the forum for discussing Turkish conduct.
The cabinet, including in talks with the Turkish authorities, stresses the importance of refraining from escalation in Syria to prevent further destabilisation.
Het kabinet onderstreept, ook in gesprekken met de Turkse autoriteiten, het belang van afzien van escalatie in Syrië om verdere destabilisering te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Brekelmans over het indienen van een VN-resolutie bij de Emergency Special Session over Oekraïne

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Russia's blockade of the Black Sea ports, which keeps Ukrainian grain from leaving, is a deliberate form of starvation and whether the government will convene an Emergency Special Session of the UN General Assembly to adopt a resolution condemning it and declaring a humanitarian corridor. The minister condemned the blockade and said it is not yet clear the government will call such a session, pointing instead to ongoing Turkish and UN negotiations and promising to sound out other UN members.
In addition, I will explore with other UN General Assembly members whether and how convening such a session has a chance of success.
Daarnaast zal ik onderzoeken bij andere AVVN-leden of en hoe het bijeenroepen van een dergelijke sessie kans van slagen heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over over de Russische componist en vriend van Poetin, Valery Gergiev

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister why Russian conductor Valery Gergiev, reportedly a friend of Putin, is not on EU sanctions lists, how he obtained Dutch nationality and a royal honour, and whether the government will propose him for listing. The minister answered that Gergiev does not meet the listing criteria yet, that nationality of individuals cannot be discussed, that the 2005 honour was for classical music merits, and that proposing him is not opportune at present.
The cabinet cannot make statements about the nationality of individual persons.
Over de nationaliteit van individuele personen kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over de VN-conferentie over de VN-conferentie over het wereldzeeënverdrag

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether slow BBNJ treaty negotiations threaten the 30% ocean protection target, and about Dutch positions on MPAs, RFMOs, EIA thresholds, and genetic resources. The minister answered that negotiations are complex and ongoing, that the Netherlands seeks an ambitious outcome coordinated within the EU, and that no final decisions have been taken, while declining to commit to specific positions beyond general ambitions.
The process must ultimately lead to adoption of the treaty text by the UN General Assembly.
Het proces moet uiteindelijk leiden tot vaststelling van de verdragstekst door de AVVN.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Piri, Kuzu, Teunissen, Stoffer, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Brekelmans en Dassen over het gebrek aan humanitaire toegang in de Tigray-regio in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the lack of humanitarian access to Tigray, Ethiopia, including calls for UN investigations, sanctions, safe zones and press freedom. The minister answered that Nederland supports independent investigation and humanitarian access, has pressed for sanctions and an arms embargo within the EU without sufficient support, and will raise press access with the EU Special Envoy.
The Netherlands will continue to press, in EU and international contexts, on the three priorities mentioned above.
Nederland zal zich in blijven zetten, in EU- en internationaal verband, op de hierboven genoemde drie prioriteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Jasper van Dijk over het besluit van het Israëlisch Hooggerechtshof dat de weg vrijmaakt voor gedwongen uitzetting van een grote groep Palestijnen uit Masafer Yatta

MPs Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands will condemn and act against an Israeli Supreme Court ruling enabling forced eviction of about 1,000 Palestinians from Masafer Yatta. The minister said the Netherlands respects Israeli judicial independence but is concerned, has urged Israel bilaterally and with EU partners not to act on the ruling, and will keep monitoring the case without announcing new concrete measures.
The Netherlands respects the independence of the judiciary in Israel, but is very concerned about the possible consequences of this ruling.
Nederland respecteert de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtspraak in Israël, maar is zeer bezorgd over de mogelijke gevolgen van deze uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de moord op Al-Jazeera’s journalist Shireen Abu Aqleh

An MP asks the government how it views the killing of Al-Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Aqleh, Israel's reported refusal of an inquiry, and what concrete steps it takes toward truth-finding and accountability. The minister condemns the killing, denies that Israel refused an inquiry, and says the government supports a transparent joint investigation, without listing concrete steps beyond raising the matter with counterparts.
As I understand it, there is no question of an Israeli refusal.
Naar mijn begrip is er geen sprake van een Israëlische weigering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Israëlische ordetroepen gebruiken geweld bij begrafenis Al Jazeera-journalist’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli security forces disrupting the funeral procession of Al Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Akleh and whether an independent investigation could be pursued. The minister condemned the excessive conduct, welcomed Israel's own police inquiry, and said the Netherlands supports a joint investigation with possible international third-party support.
The conduct of the Israeli security forces that day was excessive.
Het optreden van de Israëlische veiligheidstroepen was die dag buitensporig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ceder en De Roon over het bezoek van de minister aan de Palestijnse ngo Al-Haq

MPs Van der Staaij, Ceder and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister why he met Palestinian NGO Al-Haq, which Israel has designated a terrorist organisation, and whether this sends a problematic signal, and about contacts with Israel and EU association council talks. The minister answered that the meeting was part of a dialogue with civil society, that Netherlands does not accept the unproven Israeli listings, that he was transparent about his discussions, and that Netherlands supports an EU association council with Israel but lacks EU-wide consensus.
I consider it important to be transparent about meetings such as those with Al-Haq and other civil society organisations, and the considerations underlying them.
Ik vind het belangrijk om transparant te zijn over ontmoetingen zoals met Al-Haq en andere maatschappelijke organisaties, en de afweging die daaraan ten grondslag liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat Nederland dictatoriaal Rwanda ondanks mensenrechtenschendingen financieel bleef steunen

The MP Eppink asked why the Netherlands financed Rwanda with nearly 140 million euros despite alleged human rights abuses, and whether Rwanda is a dictatorship, among ten questions. The minister explained that Dutch support focused on rebuilding Rwanda's justice sector after the 1994 genocide, that aid is being phased out, and that the government does not maintain lists of dictatorships but raised human rights concerns bilaterally.

After the genocide, the Netherlands focused on the justice sector because ending the culture of impunity, and attention to the rule of law generally, was seen as a requirement for lasting peace in the country.

Nederland richtte zich na de genocide op de justitiesector omdat het beëindigen van de cultuur van straffeloosheid, en aandacht voor het recht in den brede, werd gezien als vereiste voor duurzame vrede in het land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Klaver over de oorlogsmisdaad in Boetsja

MPs Ploumen and Klaver asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands would do after the Bucha killings, including UN action, ICC and ICJ steps, sanctions on sexual violence, and an energy boycott of Russia. The minister answered that the Netherlands backs UN and ICC efforts, that a UN sanctions regime on sexual violence is unlikely due to a Russian veto, and that further EU energy sanctions are being prepared, but no national boycott is planned.
In UN contexts the Netherlands works to stop the aggression of the Russian Federation, reject it and attach consequences where possible.
Nederland zet zich in VN-verband in om de agressie van de Russische Federatie een halt toe te roepen, te verwerpen en waar mogelijk consequenties hieraan te verbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over een mogelijk antisemitisch Wob-verzoek van The Rights Forum

An MP asked whether a Wob information request by The Rights Forum about university ties with Israeli and Jewish institutions is antisemitic under the IHRA definition, whether the group has links to designated terrorist organisations, whether it remains a ministry interlocutor, and whether its ANBI tax status should be reviewed. The government rejected the antisemitism framing, said it has no evidence of terror links, said the group remains a legitimate dialogue partner, and explained in general terms ANBI criteria while citing tax secrecy and declining to comment on the individual organisation.
Under the tax authority's confidentiality obligation (Article 67 General Tax Act), it is however not possible to make statements about the handling of an individual organisation.

Ingevolge de geheimhoudingsplicht van de Belastingdienst (Artikel 67 Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen) is het echter niet mogelijk om mededelingen te doen over de behandeling van een individuele instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Nederlandse steun voor een evenement van de BDS-beweging

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs whether the ministry funds a 23 May event in The Hague by a BDS-linked coalition on ICC justice for Palestinians, and whether the funding should be cancelled. The minister replied that the cabinet was neither involved in nor present at the event, that the ministry had no involvement (an earlier incorrect reference was corrected), and that answers could not be provided before the event.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs had no involvement in this event. The erroneous reference to involvement has been rectified.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken had geen betrokkenheid bij dit evenement. De foutieve verwijzing naar betrokkenheid is gerectificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij en De Roon over de subsidiëring van een conferentie waar een NGO die gelieerd is aan terreurorganisatie PFLP aan deelneemt

MPs Ceder, Van der Staaij and De Roon asked whether the Foreign Ministry co-funded a May 2022 conference featuring Al-Haq director Shawan Jabarin, whom Israel links to the PFLP, and whether Dutch funds reach Al-Haq. The minister answered that the ministry's name was wrongly listed as a funder and corrected, that the government has received no evidence for Israel's designation and sees no reason to change policy, and that Nederland has only a limited, indirect relationship with Al-Haq as an implementing partner, while awaiting EU anti-fraud review.
The cabinet has so far received no evidence for Israel's qualifications of the six NGOs and has no reason to revise its policy towards these NGOs on the basis of the Israeli decision.

Het kabinet heeft tot op heden geen bewijs voor de Israëlische kwalificaties van de zes ngo’s ontvangen en heeft geen reden om het beleid ten aanzien van deze ngo’s, op basis van het Israëlische besluit, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Segers over de oproepen tot de doodstraf tegen een Nederlands Tweede Kamerlid door een Pakistaanse geestelijke

MPs Ceder and Segers asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to calls by a Pakistani cleric for the execution of MP Geert Wilders, including whether Pakistan has responded to Dutch mutual legal assistance requests and how the government handles threats from abroad. The minister says threats are unacceptable, the government has raised concern bilaterally with Pakistan, Pakistan has not responded to the 2018 legal assistance requests, and the government will keep working with Pakistan and the security services on the threat.
The cabinet is doing everything within its power to end these threats and mitigate the risks to Mr Wilders.
Het kabinet doet er alles aan wat in zijn macht ligt om een einde te maken aan deze bedreigingen en de risico’s ervan voor de heer Wilders te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bikker over de situatie van Nederlandse kinderen in Syrische kampen

Two MPs asked the government about the situation of Dutch children in Syrian Kurdish camps, including their numbers, access to education, radicalisation prevention and repatriation. The government answered that about 60 children with a Dutch link are in the camps, that the Netherlands supports humanitarian aid without direct control over services, and that repatriated children are placed in youth care facilities.
I cannot make statements about individual cases, the numbers per camp and the ages.
Over individuele gevallen, de aantallen per kamp en leeftijden kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Omstreden Chinese camera’s hangen overal in Nederland, ook bij ministeries'

MPs from the VVD asked whether Chinese Hikvision and Dahua cameras are used at government buildings, including police and ministries, and what security checks apply when procuring them. The government answered that it does not know how many Chinese cameras are in use, that procurement follows general information-security rules with each organisation assessing national-security risks itself, and that a cross-government study into such risks will be carried out.
It is not known how many cameras this specifically concerns.
Het is niet bekend om hoeveel camera's het specifiek gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Kuzu , Sylvana Simons en Sjoerdsma over straffeloosheid voor oorlogsmisdaden in Jemen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about rising Saudi-led coalition airstrikes in Yemen after the UN Human Rights Council ended its war-crimes investigation, and whether Netherlands would push to resume an UN-mandated inquiry. The minister said the April ceasefire is holding, that Netherlands supports UN envoy efforts, but will not launch an initiative at the Council because the chance of success is very small, instead funding local accountability efforts.
The Netherlands will continue to emphasise the importance of combating impunity in international fora and in bilateral talks.
Ook zal Nederland het belang van het tegengaan van straffeloosheid in internationale fora en in bilaterale gesprekken blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over mogelijke ontkenning van de Armeense Genocide door de regering

Van der Plas (BBB) asks whether the government has recognised the Armenian Genocide and whether the cabinet's communication and visit to Yerevan were consistent with the Tweede Kamer's motions recognising it. Minister Hoekstra answers that the cabinet has not yet decided on implementing the Voordewind motion, will consult like-minded EU states on recognising genocides, and gives no recognition or denial.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de grove uitzetting van journalist Dulmers uit Oekraïne

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the government relied on Ukraine's account of the expulsion of Dutch journalist Dulmers, why no official charge exists, and why the government has not pressed harder or sought apologies and lifting of a ten-year entry ban. The minister replied that the ministry requested information but Ukrainian authorities could not provide it due to wartime conditions, that the case was raised with Foreign Minister Kuleba who promised to look into it, and that Dulmers can pursue domestic legal remedies.
The ministry has asked the Ukrainian authorities for further information.
Het ministerie heeft de Oekraïense autoriteiten gevraagd om nadere informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het VN-Onderzoek naar oorlogsmisdaden in Jemen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the UN Group of Eminent Experts' mandate on war crimes in Yemen ended, whether Saudi lobbying was responsible, and whether the Netherlands would push to renew it. The minister confirmed the mandate lapsed for lack of a vote majority, acknowledged the value of such investigations, but said the Netherlands will not table a new initiative, instead funding local efforts and seeking other UN-mandated options.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de naleving van sancties tegen Russische oligarchen

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Finance Ministers about the enforcement of sanctions against Russian oligarchs, including a halted investigation, trust-sector oversight, reporting frequency and a sanctions coordinator. The minister declined to comment on individual investigations, pointed to existing and pending transparency and anti-money-laundering measures, and committed to further letters and the appointment of a coordinator's recommendations, without giving a timetable for a single contact point.
I cannot give a judgement on individual criminal investigations, as I do not have information about them.
Ik kan geen oordeel geven over individuele opsporingsonderzoeken, aangezien ik niet beschik over informatie daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Journalist Al Jazeera doodgeschoten op Westelijke Jordaanoever'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the shooting of Al Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Akleh on the West Bank, whether it condemns the act, and whether it will press Israel for an independent investigation and better protection of journalists. The minister said the government is shocked, has called publicly and to Israeli and Palestinian counterparts for a thorough, transparent investigation, and will raise concerns with authorities, but gave no firm commitments beyond that.
In addition, I have called for a thorough and transparent investigation with the aim of bringing the facts to light.
Daarbij heb ik tevens opgeroepen tot een grondig en transparant onderzoek met als doel de feiten boven tafel te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de doodgeschoten journalist van Al Jazeera op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP from DENK asks the Foreign Minister about the killing of Al Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Akleh in the West Bank, including who fired, whether international law was breached, and whether the Israeli ambassador should be summoned. The minister answers that the facts are unclear, calls for a transparent and thorough investigation, says he raised this with Israeli and Palestinian counterparts, and declines to make judgements on international law violations.
The cabinet does not agree with your characterisation that Israel is an apartheid state.
Het kabinet gaat niet mee met uw bewoordingen dat er sprake is van een apartheidsstaat in Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over een lijst van 6.000 mensen die het regime van de Russische president Poetin steunen, gepubliceerd door de gevangen oppositiepoliticus Navalny

MP Van der Graaf asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of a list of about 6,000 people linked to Putin's regime that falls outside EU sanctions, and whether he would expand sanctions to cover them and coordinate with other countries. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the EU listing criteria, said the Netherlands is in ongoing discussion about adding names, and noted that third-party suggestions including this list are being considered, without committing to a specific listing.
The Netherlands is in discussion with partners both inside and outside the EU about adding names to the sanctions list, also considering suggestions from third parties, including this list.

Nederland is in gesprek met partners zowel binnen als buiten de EU over het toevoegen van namen aan de sanctielijst, waarbij ook gekeken wordt naar suggesties aangedragen door derde partijen, inclusief deze lijst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Brekelmans over de afhankelijkheid van Russisch gas voor Poetins oorlogsdrift

MPs Erkens and Brekelmans asked how dependent the Netherlands is on Russian gas and oil, who owns or operates related infrastructure, and how quickly dependence could be cut. The government answered that Russian gas is an estimated 15% of consumption, that Gazprom holds a usage right and gas cushion gas at Bergermeer storage but no ownership of key infrastructure, that commercial data cannot be shared, and that it will inform the House further on Bergermeer and work with EU partners and the REPowerEU plan.
The share of Russian gas in the purchasing portfolios of European energy companies is private commercially sensitive information and not publicly accessible.
Het aandeel Russisch gas in de inkoopportefeuilles van Europese energiebedrijven is private commercieel gevoelige informatie en niet publiekelijk toegankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs asked the government about human trafficking risks for Ukrainian refugees at the border, including unaccompanied children, and whether it would press for EU coordination and raise the issue in Council meetings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, has raised them in EU and UN contacts, and describes registration, monitoring and awareness measures in the Netherlands.
The cabinet generally shares UNHCR's concerns about signals of human traffickers in Europe exploiting vulnerable people, including unaccompanied children fleeing Ukraine.

Het kabinet deelt in algemene zin de zorgen van UNHCR over signalen van mensenhandelaren in Europa die misbruik maken van kwetsbare personen, inclusief alleenstaande kinderen die uit Oekraïne vluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over individuele ambtsberichten

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked about how Dutch individual intelligence reports (ambtsberichten) on Rwanda are produced, whether they can be verified, whether lawyers of genocide suspects get access, and the state of Rwanda's rule of law after Dutch aid ends. The government answered that the process uses vetted informants and independent sources, that courts can inspect underlying files confidentially, that ICJ monitoring of trials continues until final judgment, and that development aid is being phased out while human rights funding continues.

The competent court and/or the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State can obtain confidential access to the underlying documents to assess whether they support the conclusions of the individual intelligence report.

De bevoegde rechtbank en/of de Afdeling Bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State kan op vertrouwelijke basis inzage krijgen in de achterliggende stukken om te bezien of die de conclusies van het individuele ambtsbericht kunnen dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het 'New Crisis Response Mechanism'

An MP asks the Minister whether the DSA's new crisis response mechanism (Article 27a), letting the Commission impose measures on very large platforms without parliamentary or member-state control, is acceptable, and whether Article 25a and digital services coordinators pose risks. The government answers that the Commission needs a Board recommendation and a genuine crisis, that measures are limited to three months and subject to necessity and proportionality tests, that its proposal for qualified-majority member-state control was not adopted, and that national security remains a national competence.
The cabinet successfully urged the French EU presidency to include robust safeguards regarding the exercise of this provision.
Het kabinet heeft bij het Franse EU-voorzitterschap ... er succesvol op aangedrongen om robuuste waarborgen op te nemen met betrekking tot de uitoefening van deze bepaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over beschoten Palestijnen

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about settler violence against Palestinians in the West Bank, including a shooting near Surif, rising incidents, and lack of prosecution, and about Israel's new government and diplomatic steps. The minister answers that the government consistently raises settlements and settler violence with Israel, notes concern but limited policy change, and promises a letter on his visit.
The cabinet is very concerned about the violence by settlers.
Het kabinet is zeer bezorgd over het geweld door kolonisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het advies ‘keuzes voor de krijgsmacht’ van de Adviesraad Internationale Vraagstukken

Valstar (VVD) asked ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs ten questions on the AIV advisory report on defence choices, covering NATO strengthening, defence spending of two percent of GDP, readiness, specialisation and legal embedding of defence budgets. The government broadly agreed with the AIV's analysis, pointed to a structural 5 billion euro extra for Defence and a forthcoming Defensienota, and committed to responding to the AIV advice after that.
The AIV advice comes at a relevant moment and contains good starting points.
Het advies van de AIV komt op een relevant moment en bevat goede aanknopingspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Maeijer en Wilders over het bericht dat Brussel van plan is een fonds op te richten voor de wederopbouw van Oekraïne

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU plans a reconstruction fund for Ukraine that Dutch taxpayers would largely fund, and under what conditions Ukraine could access it. The minister answered that the Commission has only outlined principles (a mix of grants and loans, linked to reform and anti-corruption), has named no amounts, and that the Dutch contribution is not yet clear.
To what extent and in what form the Netherlands will contribute is not yet clear at this time, and will depend partly on a joint assessment of needs.
In welke mate en vorm Nederland daaraan zal bijdragen is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk, en zal mede afhankelijk zijn van een gezamenlijke inventarisatie van de noden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk asielzoekers een enkele reis Rwanda geeft

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked whether the government shares concerns about the UK plan to send some asylum seekers one-way to Rwanda, including human rights and refugee convention compliance, and whether it would confront the UK. The government answered that the UK is outside EU asylum law but bound by the Refugee Convention and ECHR, that Rwanda's human rights concerns depend on implementation, and that it would raise the matter bilaterally or internationally only if international law were shown to be breached.
Should it turn out that the UK is thereby violating international law, the cabinet will raise this both bilaterally and internationally.
Wanneer zou blijken dat het VK hiermee internationaal recht schendt, zal het kabinet dit aankaarten op zowel bilateraal als internationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een artikel in Trouw over mogelijke betalingen aan IS, corruptie en fraude door Ericsson in Irak

An MP asked ministers about a Trouw report on alleged payments to IS, corruption and fraud by Ericsson in Iraq, including the role of IMVO due diligence rules and alternatives to Huawei and Ericsson for 5G. The minister said terrorism financing is unacceptable and already criminal, that KPN and Ericsson are handling the matter, and that the government has no plans to contact the Swedish government.
Financing terrorism is worrying, unacceptable and punishable.
Het financieren van terrorisme is zorgelijk, onaanvaardbaar en strafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de hongersnood in Sri Lanka

MP Van der Plas asks the government about Sri Lanka's forced shift to organic farming, Dutch knowledge-sharing, possible lessons for Dutch policy, and lobby influence on fertiliser and pesticide policy. The minister answers that the Netherlands raised concerns with Sri Lanka, offered knowledge exchange and webinars, sees no lessons warranting a study, and states the government's own pesticide transition strategy.
To begin with, it is of course up to a country itself to make its own policy choices.
Vooropgesteld is het uiteraard aan een land zelf om de eigen beleidskeuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de sancties van het Verenigd Koninkrijk aan Bosnisch Servische politici Milorad Dodik en Zeljka Cvijanovic

An MP asked whether the Netherlands would impose sanctions like the UK's on Bosnian Serb politicians Dodik and Cvijanovic and why the EU had not acted; the minister said the Netherlands had pushed for targeted EU sanctions without success, Hungary opposes them, and the government keeps the option open via EU and bilateral channels. The answers acknowledge the UK acted bilaterally but do not commit the Netherlands to comparable national measures, since no legal basis exists.
In the Netherlands there is currently no legal basis for imposing bilateral sanctions such as trade measures or an entry ban.
In Nederland bestaat er op dit moment geen juridische basis voor het instellen van bilaterale sancties als handelsmaatregelen of een inreisverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mogelijk gebruik van Nederlands defensiematerieel door Egyptische speciale eenheden tegen Palestijnse burgers

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade whether Dutch defence equipment supplied to Egypt has been used against Palestinian civilians and whether the government knew of naval support to Egyptian units in Sinai. The ministers answered that no independently verified link has been established between licensed military goods and the incidents, that naval support is acknowledged but no concrete link to abuses is found, and that there is no basis to revoke the licence.
Information on the use of the licence is commercially confidential and under customs legislation may not be disclosed publicly.
Het gebruik van de vergunning betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie die conform de douanewetgeving niet openbaar mag worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Ceder en De Roon over de brief  ‘Uitkomsten en kabinetsappreciatie extern onderzoek UAWC’

MPs asked the government to disclose the Proximities report on UAWC, defend its definition of the PFLP and the choice to treat Palestinian civil society organisations as PFLP-linked, and explain aid transparency and due diligence. The government declined to publish the report, citing a do-no-harm principle, said it does not share Proximities' broader definition, and promised further EU-level assessment and tightened due diligence.
The cabinet believes that publication of the report could cause disproportionate harm to the civil society organisations concerned.
Het kabinet meent dat openbaarmaking van het rapport de betreffende maatschappelijke organisaties onevenredige schade zou kunnen toebrengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Piri over de mishandeling van asielzoekers uit Wit-Rusland in Polen

MPs Simons and Piri asked about reported mistreatment, arbitrary detention and possible racism against asylum seekers from Belarus in Poland, and how the government presses Poland and the EU to ensure equal treatment and enforce EU law. The minister said the government finds the reports worrying, supports border detention under EU rules with safeguards, has raised rule-of-law and humanitarian concerns bilaterally and in EU bodies, and noted that the European Commission, as guardian of the treaties, can act under Article 258.
The government attaches importance to member states complying with Union law, especially where fundamental rights are concerned.
Het kabinet hecht eraan dat lidstaten het Unierecht naleven, in het bijzonder wanneer dit fundamentele rechten betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de internationale onderhandelingen in Ierland over de gevolgen van explosieve wapens in bevolkte gebieden

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Irish-led international negotiations on explosive weapons in populated areas, including whether the Netherlands would support an ICRC-backed avoidance principle. The minister answered that the Netherlands largely agrees with the ICRC, would support such a principle if it does not reinterpret existing law, and reported on the April consultations, which reached no consensus yet.
Due to the short time between the submission of the parliamentary questions and the negotiations, it was not possible to inform your House before the negotiations began.
Vanwege de korte tijdspanne tussen het indienen van de Kamervragen en de onderhandelingen is het niet gelukt om uw Kamer voor aanvang van de onderhandelingen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over dwangarbeid in relatie tot het WK voetbal in Qatar

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about forced labour linked to the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, including Amnesty's report, whether pressure on Qatar should increase, and whether a diplomatic boycott should be implemented. The minister answered that the government continues critical dialogue and engagement with Qatar, rejects a boycott in line with EU partners and human rights organisations, and will return to the 2021 boycott motion before the World Cup starts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het voldoen aan inreisregels van andere landen rondom corona

An MP asked the health and foreign affairs ministers how Dutch travellers can meet foreign COVID entry rules that do not recognise Dutch recovery certificates or AstraZeneca/Janssen vaccinations, and whether reiseVaccinaties will be offered. The minister answered that travellers must check destination rules themselves, referred to testing and EU-level talks, and said a study on COVID vaccines as travel vaccinations is ongoing.
Once the study is completed, I will inform the House about it.
Als het onderzoek afgerond is, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de aanstaande uitlevering van Assange aan de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would oppose the extradition of Julian Assange to the United States, citing press freedom and the rule of law and the earlier government position on Britain's legal safeguards. The minister replied that the Netherlands trusts the independence of the British courts, that press freedom is not at stake given the protection of state secrets, and that any decision now rests with the British government, so the Netherlands will not intervene.
The Netherlands has full confidence in the British rule of law.
Nederland heeft het volste vertrouwen in de Britse rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het bericht dat Polen niet-Oekraïense vluchtelingen opsluit in detentiecentra

MP Sylvana Simons asked the Dutch ministers whether they knew of reports that Poland detains non-Ukrainian refugees, including Africans, in detention centres without papers, confiscates phones and forces unsigned documents, and what the government would do about this and the discrimination. The government said it is concerned, that UNHCR and IOM confirmed some detentions, that it raised human rights concerns bilaterally and in EU fora, and that it will press the European Commission to act under Article 258 TFEU.
The cabinet considers the reports of possible violations of human rights safeguards during the asylum procedure worrying.
Het kabinet acht de berichtgeving over mogelijke schendingen van mensenrechtelijke waarborgen tijdens de asielprocedure zorgelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, die 5 jaar geleden ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneemt om haar terug te krijgen in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Legal Protection what concrete steps the government has taken to bring Dutch child Insiya back from India, whether Dutch court rulings oblige her return, and whether the state visit from India would be used to raise the case. The ministers answered that diplomatic requests, repeated raising in bilateral talks, and handing over Dutch rulings to Indian authorities continue, but that Dutch rulings are not automatically binding in India and the mother must seek enforcement before an Indian court.
The Netherlands closely monitors the rulings in the proceedings in India.
Nederland volgt uitspraken in de procedures in India nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de wederopbouw van Oekraïense steden en dorpen

An MP asked the government whether it would commit to Ukraine's reconstruction, to a reconstruction plan showing Dutch involvement, and to exploring partnerships between Dutch municipalities and Ukrainian towns. The minister answered yes to each point and promised letters to parliament on a European recovery programme and on the Kuzu motion.
Yes, your House will be informed by letter in the short term about the Dutch contribution in line with the Amhaouch et al. motion on a European recovery programme for Ukraine.
Ja, uw Kamer zal op korte termijn per brief geïnformeerd worden over de Nederlandse inzet conform motie Amhaouch c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Turkse zakenman Kavala veroordeeld tot levenslange gevangenisstraf'

An MP from the PvdA asks the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the life sentence imposed on Turkish businessman and activist Kavala, including demands to press Turkey for his release, to remove Turkey from the Council of Europe, and to halt accession talks and customs union modernisation. The minister replies that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the case, supports the EU statement and the Council of Europe infringement procedure, backs a rule-of-law condition in customs union talks, and supports suspending pre-accession aid, but gives no firm commitment on sanctions or bilateral steps beyond waiting for the Council of Europe process.
The cabinet will continue to convey this message in various forums and at various levels as described above, and will also do so at the next appropriate bilateral contact moment.

Het kabinet zal deze boodschap blijven uitdragen, in verschillende fora en op verschillende niveaus zoals beschreven in bovenstaande antwoorden, en zal dit ook doen bij het volgende passende bilaterale contactmoment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gebrekkige uitvoering van sancties

An SP MP asked why Dutch authorities have not seized real estate of Russians on the sanctions list and how the sanctions enforcement is organised. The government answers that sanctioned property is frozen rather than seized, that the Kadaster found no matches, and that a data team, a national sanctions coordinator and additional capacity are being set up.
Voor inbeslagname is een strafvorderlijke titel nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas, Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht "Sanctie-experts: Nederland niet doeltreffend met opsporen Russisch vastgoed"

VVD MPs asked the government why sanctions enforcement on Russian-linked real estate in the Netherlands was unclear, whether other countries were more effective, and when concrete results would be reported. The minister answered that roles are divided among ministries, the Kadaster checks found no sanctioned persons as registered owners so far, and the government will continue reporting on progress.
From time to time the cabinet will continue to do this.
Op gezette tijden zal het kabinet dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Van der Lee en Omtzigt over de stroperige implementatie van sancties in Nederland

MPs Klaver, Van der Lee and Omtzigt asked why sanctions implementation in the Netherlands is slow and fragmented, covering ministerial responsibility, the tax secrecy exemption, APA/ATR rulings linked to sanctioned persons, frozen assets held by trust offices, and supervision gaps for non-financial assets. The government answered that sanctions coordination and enforcement are split across ministries and the OM, that the Belastingdienst obtained an exemption from tax secrecy and is reviewing rulings, and that a national coordinator's report with recommendations will follow in May.
The national coordinator is preparing a report with recommendations, to be submitted in mid-May and shared with your House.
De nationaal coördinator is bezig met een rapport met aanbevelingen dat medio mei zal worden aangeboden en met uw Kamer zal worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat voor de derde keer 500 miljoen euro wordt vrijgemaakt voor wapens aan Oekraïne via het Europees Vredesfonds

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about a third EU European Peace Facility tranche of 500 million euros for weapons to Ukraine, the transparency of such decisions, which weapons qualify, Dutch declarations, the budget ceiling in relation to a parliamentary motion, and conditions on use. The ministers answered that the Council approved the increase, that the Dutch parliament is informed through letters, that declarations so far total 36 million euros, that the 5.7 billion ceiling is maintained by spreading payments, and that end-use declarations restrict use to self-defence.
The cabinet has kept your House informed in writing in recent period about the support measures financed under the European Peace Facility.
Het kabinet heeft uw Kamer in de afgelopen periode schriftelijk op de hoogte gehouden over de steunmaatregelen die worden gefinancierd onder de Europese Vredesfaciliteit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de additionele steun vanuit de Europese Vredesfaciliteit aan Oekraïne

Van Haga asked whether the EU's proposed extra 500 million euro military aid to Ukraine via the European Peace Facility exceeds the 2022 ceiling, whether member states fund it, and whether Dutch opt-out or refusal is possible. The ministers confirmed the Council's approval, said the total ceiling of 5.7 billion would be kept by spreading payments, noted the EPF sits outside the EU budget and is funded by member states, and explained constructive abstention rules.
Given the extremely unpredictable course of the war in Ukraine, the cabinet cannot rule out a future discussion on the level of the European Peace Facility.
Gezien het uiterst onvoorspelbare verloop van de oorlog in Oekraïne kan het kabinet een toekomstige discussie over de hoogte van de Europese Vredesfaciliteit niet uitsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Activist Defending Safe Abortion Risks Jail'

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of Polish activist Justyna Wydrzyńska for providing abortion medication, whether this sets a dangerous precedent and chills aid groups, and whether a Dutch diplomat would attend the trial. Minister Hoekstra said the government opposes regressive pressure on women's rights, that health care is a member-state competence, that the Netherlands promotes SRGR including safe abortion within EU frameworks, and that an embassy staff member plans to attend the hearing.
An employee of the Dutch representation in Warsaw intends to attend the hearing.
Een medewerker van de Nederlandse vertegenwoordiging in Warschau is voornemens aanwezig te zijn bij de zitting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht dat 45 miljard euro Russisch vermogen van personen en organisaties op sanctielijsten in Nederland staat

MPs Heinen and Brekelmans asked the government about a report that EUR 45 billion of Russian assets held by sanctioned persons and entities sits in the Netherlands, and why freezes have been limited, how other countries compare, what has been done to clarify sanctions implementation, and how evasion is prosecuted. Minister Hoekstra rejected the EUR 45 billion estimate as overstated because ownership runs through layered foreign structures, stated that over half a billion euro has been frozen and that prosecutors and the FIOD act on evasion, and described outreach to businesses and a new steering group, while noting that some implementation questions remain.
Twenty yachts under construction are also under enhanced Customs supervision.
Ook staan er twintig jachten in aanbouw onder verscherpt toezicht van de Douane.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat 30 miljard euro aan bezittingen van Russische oligarchen is bevroren door de Europese Freeze and Seize Taskforce

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the EU Freeze and Seize Taskforce, Dutch frozen assets, and reports on the King's villa in Greece, a Putin villa, and the yacht Scheherazade in Italy. The minister answered that detailed lists are not public, that the Dutch share is about 632.9 million euros, that Greece and Italy are cooperating, and that individual supervisory cases cannot be discussed.
The requested information is unfortunately not public.
De gevraagde informatie is helaas niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Piri over de Russische 'sigarettenkoning' die onder Europese sancties uitkomt, omdat Nederland er niet in slaagt om zijn vermogen te bevriezen

MPs Kuzu and Piri asked whether Russian oligarch Kesajev's assets can be frozen under EU sanctions, given his resignation from a supervisory board, and how control, ownership, UBO identification and supervision by DNB work. The government answered that resignation alone does not avoid sanctions, that control can be decisive, that DNB confidentiality limits disclosure of individual cases, and that Netherlands will keep pressing for lowering the ownership threshold from 50% to 25%.
Furthermore, no funds, economic resources or other benefits may be made available, directly or indirectly, to sanctioned persons, such as shareholders.
Daarnaast mogen er (direct en indirect) geen tegoeden en economische middelen of andere voordelen ter beschikking worden gesteld aan gesanctioneerde (rechts)personen zoals aandeelhouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij en Peters over het bericht dat enkele tientallen christenen in Noord-Korea standrechtelijk zijn geëxecuteerd

MPs Ceder, Van der Staaij and Peters asked the Foreign Minister about reports that dozens of Christians in North Korea were summarily executed, including whether the government can verify this, press for clarification, condemn it, and push for a new EU religious freedom envoy. Minister Hoekstra answered that Dutch information access is very limited, that the government raises human rights violations bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, supports the UN Special Rapporteur, expects an EU envoy appointment soon, and relies mainly on EU sanctions.
The Netherlands has no embassy in Pyongyang, there are currently no EU embassies open in Pyongyang, and the UN no longer has access to the country.
Nederland heeft geen ambassade in Pyongyang, er zijn momenteel geen EU ambassades meer open in Pyongyang en ook de VN heeft geen toegang meer tot het land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Ploumen en Paternotte over het recht op abortus in Polen

MPs Ellemeet, Ploumen and Paternotte asked the government about the abortion ban in Poland, prosecutions of activists, the lack of access for Polish and Ukrainian refugee women, and what the Netherlands can do. The minister stated that Dutch clinics can treat foreign women without state financial support, that funding goes to rights organisations rather than individual abortions, and that the government shares concern over regressive pressure in Poland.
However, this is not a right and the Dutch state does not provide financial support to these individual women.
Dit is echter geen recht en de Nederlandse staat biedt deze individuele vrouwen geen financiële ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over het bericht dat China door middel van samenwerkingen met Europese bedrijven en universiteiten haar krijgsmacht moderniseert

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg asked whether China's use of technology from European firms and universities to modernise its military is undesirable, and whether reporting duties, legal blocking powers, or US-style policy should be introduced for risky cooperation. The government acknowledges the risks of unwanted technology transfer, points to existing screening, export control and knowledge-security instruments, and declines to introduce a reporting obligation for now, while noting universities' academic freedom and that no legal basis currently exists to force termination of such cooperation.
Against this background, the cabinet currently considers introducing a reporting obligation not opportune.
Tegen deze achtergrond acht het kabinet invoering van een meldingsplicht op dit moment niet opportuun.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij over de uitwerking van de plannen inzake het toevoegen van ‘hate speech’ onder Artikel 83 Verdrag betreffende de werking van de Europese Unie (VWEU)

MPs Stoffer and Van der Staaij asked the government how it assesses the European Commission's plan to add hate speech and hate crime to the EU crimes list under Article 83 TFEU, covering necessity, legal basis, proportionality, free speech, and the link to Dutch law. The Minister of Justice answered that the government supports the proposal in principle, considers Dutch law largely adequate but benefits from EU-level harmonisation, and will assess any later directive against fundamental rights and Dutch criminal law when it appears.
The cabinet will guard the balance between, on the one hand, the importance of combating crime and, on the other, a possible infringement of fundamental rights.
Het kabinet zal waken voor de balans tussen enerzijds het belang van de criminaliteitsbestrijding en een mogelijke inbreuk op grondrechten anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het rapport 'Israel’s apartheid against Palestinians: Cruel system of domination and crime against humanity' van Amnesty International.

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government accepts Amnesty International's conclusion that Israel commits apartheid, a crime against humanity, and what it will do about it, including whether it will seek advice on the matter and how it reconciles intensified relations with that. The minister referred to a separate Kamerbrief for most substantive answers, rejected labelling the Amnesty report antisemitic as inappropriate, and said it is not for the government to obtain a court ruling on the apartheid qualification.
It is not for the cabinet to obtain a ruling from the Dutch court on such qualifications, or to make statements on how a ruling could be obtained.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om bij de Nederlandse rechter een uitspraak te verkrijgen over dergelijke kwalificaties, of uitspraken te doen hoe een uitspraak verkregen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Agens Mulder over de stand van zaken rondom het Midden-Oosten Vredesproces

MPs Sjoerdsma and Mulder asked about the postponed Palestinian elections, the humanitarian and water situation in Gaza, Israeli designations of Palestinian NGOs, settlements, and Dutch business involvement in settlements. The minister answered that elections remain postponed pending a new PA date, that Dutch policy on settlements and business ties is unchanged, and that a joint donor assessment of the NGO listings will be completed before the summer recess.
The cabinet aims to complete this joint assessment before the summer recess and inform the House.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om voor het zomerreces deze gezamenlijke appreciatie af te ronden en uw Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over noodvisa voor journalisten door de situatie in Oekraïne

An MP asks the government whether Russian and Belarusian journalists fleeing to Ukraine can receive emergency visas or temporary protection, citing risks of arrest and Kosovo's precedent, and asks about EU border treatment and relocation. The minister answers that the EU Temporary Protection Directive covers certain third-country nationals, that Russian-speaking journalists are supported through Shelter City and a EUR 2 million fund, that specific cases are considered individually, and that the Netherlands will not commit to mandatory relocation or extra border staff.
Due to the safety of these persons, the cabinet cannot make further statements about this.
Vanwege de veiligheid van deze personen kan het kabinet hierover geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de aanwezigheid van Gazprom in Nederland

MPs from the SP asked the government about Gazprom's presence in the Netherlands, including its asset holdings via shell companies, Dutch investment ties with Russia, tax avoidance, tax rulings for state-owned firms, and frozen Russian assets. The State Secretary answered that sanctions freezes apply, the cabinet opposes facilitating Russian-linked shells and is banning certain trust services, tax secrecy limits detailed answers on individual taxpayers, and a rulings termination clause exists for sanctioned entities.
Under the tax secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerseboom en Van Meijeren van Forum voor Democratie over oorlogsmisdaden door het Oekraïense leger

MPs Kerseboom and Van Meijeren asked the government whether it recognises alleged war crimes by Ukrainian soldiers against Russian prisoners of war, whether Dutch military support makes it complicit, and whether it will halt support. The ministers answered that the footage has been examined by organisations and that judging authenticity is for prosecutors and courts, that all parties must respect humanitarian law, and that Ukraine's self-defence is supported with no confirmed violations so far, so support will continue.
It is for the competent investigative and prosecuting authorities and ultimately the competent court to judge the authenticity of the footage and what it shows.
Het is aan de daartoe bevoegde opsporings- en vervolgingsinstanties en uiteindelijk aan de bevoegde rechter om een oordeel over te vellen over de echtheid van de beelden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat een Nederlandse journalist hardhandig Oekraïne is uitgezet

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Dutch journalist was forcibly expelled from Ukraine, whether this was legitimate, and whether his accreditation loss was proportionate. The minister answered that Ukrainian authorities cite wartime rules and endangering civilians, that the handling would be disproportionate if as described, and that the matter was raised with Ukraine, though the facts could not be verified.
Due to the current war situation, the Ukrainian authorities could not establish how Mr Dulmers was treated during the expulsion.
Wegens de huidige oorlogssituatie konden de Oekraïense autoriteiten niet achterhalen op welke wijze de heer Dulmers is behandeld tijdens de uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de grove uitzetting van journalist Dulmers uit de Oekraïne

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the forced expulsion of Dutch journalist Robert Dulmers from Ukraine, including reports he had a loaded pistol pressed to his head, and whether the ambassador should be summoned and a full report requested. The minister answers that Ukrainian authorities cite wartime security rules and claim Dulmers endangered lives by revealing details of an attack; the ministry raised press freedom and proportionality with Ukraine, but said a full report is not possible due to the war.
Due to the current war situation, it is not possible to prepare and hand over a full report.
Wegens de huidige oorlogssituatie is het niet mogelijk om een volledig rapport op te stellen en te overhandigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke transnationale kieslijsten in de EU

MPs Sjoerdsma and Sneller asked about the reported March 2022 deal in the European Parliament's constitutional affairs committee on transnational lists (28 extra seats, 3.5% threshold) and lowering the voting age to 16, and how it relates to the Conference on the Future of Europe and the coalition agreement. The government answered that the proposal is not yet final, that it is too early to state a Dutch position, and that the Dutch government will inform parliament once the Council receives the proposal.

Since the final initiative proposal has not yet been published, may still be amended by the EP, and must obtain a majority in the EP plenary, the cabinet considers it premature to determine the Dutch position and stance on this initiative proposal.

Aangezien het definitieve initiatiefvoorstel nog niet is gepubliceerd, het mogelijk nog geamendeerd wordt door het EP, en een meerderheid dient te halen in de plenaire van het EP, acht het kabinet het voortijdig om de Nederlandse positie en inzet ten aanzien dit initiatiefvoorstel te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de banden van leden van het Nederlandse kabinet met het World Economic Forum

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Foreign Affairs about cabinet members' ties to the World Economic Forum, including the Great Reset, the Covid Action Platform, and the Global Action Group, and asks whether the government shaped policy in these fora and why documents were redacted. The Minister answers that participation was a prerogative of the minister, that the WEF does not set policy or agenda, that the government is not bound by WEF principles, and that some documents cannot be shared for privacy or confidentiality reasons.
The WEF offers a platform for the exchange of ideas and knowledge.
Het WEF biedt een platform voor ideeënvorming en kennisuitwisseling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over racisme aan de grens tussen Polen en Oekraïne

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about reports that non-white refugees were refused entry or mistreated at the Poland-Ukraine border and in Ukraine, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that no evidence of discrimination on the EU side was found, that border authorities say everyone is admitted, and that the government raised the issue with international organisations and will keep monitoring the situation.
After verification of the reports, the available information provided no indications of discrimination on the EU side of the border.
Na verificatie van de berichtgeving zijn er op grond van de beschikbare informatie geen aanwijzingen gevonden dat er sprake is van discriminatie aan de EU zijde van de grens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs from ChristenUnie and PvdA asked the government about long border waits for Ukrainian refugees, humanitarian funding, reported discrimination against Roma at the Hungarian border and trafficking risks. The government answered that it finds long waits undesirable, is supporting neighbouring states via Frontex, EUAA and EU civil protection, increased humanitarian funding, and found no evidence of discrimination on the EU side while stating it monitors the situation closely.
The Netherlands intends to respond positively to this.
Nederland is voornemens hier positief op te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Rajkowski inzake berichten omtrent cyberaanvallen op Oekraïne en Nederlandse servers

Two VVD MPs asked whether Russia used Dutch servers to launch cyberattacks on Ukraine, whether hosting firms screen tenants, and what police can do. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that hosting firms have no legal duty to screen clients, police lack screening powers, and the government supports EU Digital Services Act rules for notice-and-takedown and reseller abuse, while ruling out stricter police checks on hosters.
Screening of clients by hosting providers is not a legal obligation.
Het screenen van klanten door hostingproviders is geen wettelijke verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het subsidiëren van een oppositiekrant in Hongarije door de Nederlandse ambassade

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch embassy in Hungary subsidised an opposition newspaper and whether this amounts to foreign interference, and also raised press freedom and disinformation in the EU. The minister replied that the EUR 10,000 per year support went to an independent NGO project printing news articles for distribution, not an opposition newspaper, and that the government sees press freedom as fundamental.
So it is not an opposition newspaper.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over een vrijwillige bijdrage aan het Internationaal Strafhof ten behoeve van een onderzoek naar oorlogsmisdrijven, misdrijven tegen de menselijkheid en genocide geple

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government knows of the ICC prosecutor's opening of an investigation into Ukraine and the prosecutor's call for extra funding, and whether it will provide extra money. The government confirmed awareness, supports the investigation, and will pay a voluntary contribution of 1 million euro to the ICC's trust fund while pushing partners for more funding.
The Netherlands will transfer a voluntary financial contribution of 1 million euros to the Trust Fund recently established for the Office of the Prosecutor.
In dat licht zal Nederland een vrijwillige financiële bijdrage van 1 miljoen euro overmaken aan het Trust Fund dat recent ten behoeve van het Parket van de Aanklager is opgericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat het leger van Burkina Faso een staatsgreep heeft gepleegd

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the military coup in Burkina Faso, the status of ousted president Kaboré, travel advice, embassy and citizen safety, regional spillover, Wagner Group involvement, EU missions and development cooperation. The minister condemned the coup, described the transition timetable and Kaboré's release to his home, and answered the remaining questions largely on substance, with some matters left to EU-level discussions.
The cabinet condemns every seizure of power through the use of force.
Het kabinet keurt elke machtsovername met gebruik van geweld af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Olie, gas, graan en geld - Oekraïne laat zien hoe de wereld werkt'

An MP from BBB asked ministers in 19 numbered questions about the effects of the war in Ukraine on food supply, input prices, farm viability and the EU's dependence on imports, and whether the Green Deal transition should be postponed. The minister answered mostly on substance, noting no structural food shortage is expected in the EU, commitments to monitor and share a Wageningen study, and rejected postponing the sustainability transition.
I monitor the situation closely and am also in close contact with the European Commission and the agriculture ministers of the EU member states on this.
Ik monitor de situatie nauwlettend en heb hieromtrent ook nauw contact met de Europese Commissie en de landbouwministers van de EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over transvrouwen Oekraïne

An MP asked whether the government knows that transgender women in Ukraine cannot leave the country because their documents say male, and what it will do to protect them. The ministers confirmed the situation is distressing, said they raise the issue with UN agencies and the Equal Rights Coalition, and agreed to raise it with European and Ukrainian counterparts.
Yes, I am willing to bring this issue further to the attention of European and Ukrainian counterparts.
Ja, ik ben bereid om dit onderwerp verder onder de aandacht te brengen bij Europese en Oekraïense counterparts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over verdrinkingen bij «pushbacks» bij de Egeïsche eilanden

MPs Piri and Kröger asked the Foreign Minister about alleged violent pushbacks in the Aegean that led to drownings, and what the government would do to stop them and to press Greece and the Commission. The minister answered that the Netherlands actively raises concerns about alleged pushbacks bilaterally and with the Commission, that the Commission can start infringement proceedings, that a Greek prosecutor's investigation is pending, and that a state visit to Greece is postponed.
The cabinet therefore actively takes a position against alleged pushbacks and raises this both in multilateral and bilateral contexts.
Het kabinet neemt dan ook actief stelling tegen vermeende pushbacks en kaart dit, zowel in multilateraal als bilateraal verband aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over “de ongekende invloed van Blackrock op de Europese klimaatplannen”

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the government about lobbying influence by BlackRock and financial-sector groups on EU sustainable finance and taxonomy rules, including BlackRock's role as a Commission adviser. The minister answered that lobbying must follow transparency rules, that the Ombudsman found no maladministration but urged stricter conflict-of-interest checks which the Commission has accepted, and that the government has no further information on BlackRock's budget or meetings.
The European Ombudsman concluded there was no maladministration because the European Commission had complied with the procurement rules.
7 De Ombudsman concludeerde dat er geen sprake was van wanbestuur omdat de Europese Commissie aan de aanbestedingsregels had voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kroger over capaciteit en bereidheid van Nederland voor de opvang van eventuele vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

MPs Ellemeet and Kroger asked about Dutch capacity and willingness to receive refugees from Ukraine, including EU solidarity, reception numbers at COA, and activation of the Temporary Protection Directive. The government answered that Afghan evacuees are being transferred despite capacity concerns, that municipalities and safety regions are preparing thousands of reception places, and that the Temporary Protection Directive was activated at the JBZ Council.
The cabinet is receiving the first reports that surrounding countries are reaching the limits of their reception capacity.
Het kabinet ontvangt de eerste berichten dat omringende landen aan de grenzen van de opvangcapaciteit zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het nieuws dat de Frontex baas een privévlucht boekte naar een meeting in Brussel

An SP MP asked the government about reports that the Frontex director booked an 8,500 euro private flight to a Brussels meeting, whether cheaper commercial flights were available, and what the government will do about wasteful spending and Frontex's wider credibility problems. The State Secretary answered that the government does not judge individual cases, that Frontex bears its own responsibility, that the Management Board is the body where the Netherlands can exert influence on budget execution, and that the government will keep raising the matter in EU channels.
It is not for the cabinet to pass judgement on individual casuistry and the specific considerations involved.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel te vellen over individuele casuïstiek en de specifieke afwegingen daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de Argos-uitzending 'Drama bij evacuatie Kabul'

An SP MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about an Argos broadcast on chaotic evacuations from Kabul, including whether two sisters were on the evacuation list, why about a hundred people were removed from the list, and whether the ministry obstructs court access and appeal decisions. The government declined to discuss individual cases citing privacy, explained the removals as post-evacuation verification, and denied that appeals and court access are obstructed.
In line with the objectives of the GDPR, I will not address questions relating to specific individual cases.
In lijn met de doelstellingen van de AVG ga ik niet in op vragen die betrekking hebben op specifieke casuïstiek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ceder, Kuik, Eppink en De Roon over de vernietiging van Armeens cultureel en religieus erfgoed door Azerbeidzjan in relatie tot de uitspraak van het Internationaal Gerechts

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie, CDA, JA21 and PVV asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses Azerbaijan's destruction of Armenian cultural and religious heritage and its failure to comply with the ICJ's 2021 provisional measures, and what concrete steps it will take, including on EU aid and sanctions. The minister answered that the ICJ ruling is binding and that the Netherlands urges compliance and a UNESCO fact-finding mission, but declined to judge Azerbaijan's conduct, ruled out unilateral EU sanctions, and gave no firm new commitments.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that cultural and religious heritage is protected, as regularly emphasised in statements and conversations.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat cultureel en religieus erfgoed beschermd wordt, zoals regelmatig onderstreept in verklaringen en gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Strien over het bericht 'Streep door Haarlems Tsjaikovski en Stravinsky-festival: 'Dit lijken wel Sovjetpraktijken''

MPs Brekelmans and Van Strien asked whether the government would distinguish between state-linked Russian cultural institutions and independent Russian culture when Dutch venues reprogram Russian art after the invasion of Ukraine. The State Secretary answered that sanctions should target the Russian state, not Russian culture or people, and that formal cooperation with state-linked institutions is being suspended while individual artists remain welcome.
At this moment I leave it to Dutch institutions themselves to adjust their programming or not, as they see fit.
Ik laat het op dit moment aan Nederlandse instellingen zelf om hun programmering al dan niet aan te passen naar eigen inzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de zorgelijke situatie bij de voormalige kerncentrale in Tsjernobyl

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the government about the Chernobyl plant's staffing, power supply and radiation monitoring, and what diplomatic routes exist to fix them. The minister answered that the IAEA coordinates on-site risk mitigation, that the plant's grid connection was restored on 14 March, and that short-term radiological risk is considered low, with no new staff rotation yet possible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over een luchtbrug voor zieke kinderen in Oekraïne

An MP asked the ministers whether they would prioritise evacuating sick Ukrainian children, including children with cancer, by airlift to hospitals with capacity, and whether Dutch hospitals would be made available. The minister answered that evacuation is coordinated by the European Commission, that the Netherlands is willing to help, that a national inventory of hospital capacity is underway, and that a decision on Dutch coordination will follow.
On that basis I will make a decision on coordination and organisation on the Dutch side.
Op basis daarvan zal ik een besluit nemen over de coördinatie en organisatie aan Nederlandse zijde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Sjoerdsma over de mensenrechtensituatie in Oeganda

Two MPs (Simons and Sjoerdsma) asked the ministers about the human rights situation in Uganda, including police violence, detention of opposition MPs, election observation and the use of aid conditionality. The ministers answered at length, describing EU and bilateral diplomatic pressure, a withheld EUR 850,000 payment to the justice sector, and a planned evaluation of Dutch support, while giving no details on the detained MPs' case.
Because it is an ongoing case, the Ugandan government provides no explanation of it.
Omdat het een lopende zaak betreft wordt er door de Oegandese overheid geen toelichting op gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat topfuncties op het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken te vaak naar mannen gaan

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about reports that senior posts at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs go too often to men, including whether the ABD's unanimous recommendation for the DG Political Affairs post was overridden and whether informal selection practices exist. Minister Hoekstra affirmed the commitment to diversity and gender balance and said the ABD-related selection details are personnel-confidential, while pointing to the existing procedures and planned research into women's career progression.
