Regarding the considerations and conclusions within a selection process concerning employees, I do not make any statements because of their confidential personnel nature.
Over de afwegingen en conclusies binnen een selectieproces ten aanzien van medewerkers doe ik vanwege het personeelsvertrouwelijke karakter geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de cultuur bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken over het artikel: ‘Een old boys-network: over de ‘zwijg- en angstcultuur’ bij Buitenlandse Zaken’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the choice of a man over a woman for a top post, the diversity strategy at the ministry, and claims of a culture of silence and fear. The minister declined to discuss the selection on personnel-confidentiality grounds, and otherwise stated commitments to diversity, a 50% female leadership target by 2025, and gender parity in the top within five years.
Regarding the considerations and conclusions within a selection process concerning employees, I do not provide statements due to the confidential nature of personnel matters.
Over de afwegingen en conclusies binnen een selectieproces ten aanzien van medewerkers doe ik vanwege het personeelsvertrouwelijke karakter geen mededelingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het meedoen van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken aan de Nationale Week Zonder Vlees & Zuivel en het invoeren van het principe 'Carnivoor? Geef het door!'

MP Ouwehand asked the Foreign Minister whether the ministry would join the national meat-free week and adopt a plant-based default catering principle, citing climate and health benefits. The minister said the ministry's catering follows government sustainability criteria and the Schijf van Vijf, that its canteen participates in the meat-free week, and that circular catering with protein transition is applied in new tenders, without committing to a plant-based default.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, like many other ministries, has joined the Government-wide vision on circular catering in which plant-based food is an important component.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft zich net als veel andere ministeries aangesloten bij de Rijksbrede visie circulaire catering waarin plantaardige voeding een belangrijk onderdeel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Superjachten van rijke Russen in beslag genomen door Frankrijk en Duitsland’

MPs Kamminga and Brekelmans asked whether Russian oligarchs' superyachts in Sint Maarten waters should be seized as France and Germany had done, and why the Kingdom had not acted. The Minister replied that the Kingdom must implement EU sanctions, that action would follow if listed owners' vessels were found there, that no such case currently exists, and that the government is in contact with Sint Maarten and monitors the situation.
If vessels owned by persons on the EU individual sanctions list are located in Sint Maarten waters (or other parts of the Kingdom), action will be taken.

Indien schepen van eigenaren, die voorkomen op de EU-sanctielijst voor individuen, zich bevinden in de wateren van Sint Maarten (of andere delen van het Koninkrijk) zal hiertoe actie worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Heinen over ‘Defensie-industrie vangt vaker bot bij banken die reputatieschade vrezen’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Heinen asked why banks refuse defence-industry firms accounts over reputational risk, whether the government will talk to banks and industry, whether firms can be exempted from ESG rules, and whether the EU has discussed clashes between sustainability and defence capacity. The minister says banks set their own client policy, the government will first meet the defence sector and then the Dutch Banking Association, has no data on closed accounts, will push for ambitious EU sustainability standards while noting the special position of defence, and reports EU discussion of the issue.
Enquiries with the NVB show that it does not have these figures at its disposal.
Navraag bij de NVB leert dat zij deze cijfers niet tot hun beschikking hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over de oproep om Rusland uit te sluiten van INTERPOL

Two MPs from D66 asked whether the government supports calls to exclude Russia from INTERPOL over fears of misuse of its systems against critics. The Minister of Justice and Security confirmed awareness of the calls, explained INTERPOL's corrective measures against Russia's National Central Bureau, and said the Netherlands requested a review, noting that measures were adopted and apply until the next Executive Committee meeting.
The Minister of Justice and Security on 4 March sent a letter asking the Secretary General of INTERPOL to assess the need for corrective measures against the Russian Federation.

De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid heeft op 4 maart jl. per brief de Secretaris Generaal van INTERPOL verzocht de noodzaak tot het opleggen van corrigerende maatregelen ten aanzien van de Russische Federatie te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het weigeren van Europese Wob-aanvragen door de Europese Commissie over het Europees Herstelfonds

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the European Commission's refusal of Wob-style access requests for documents on talks over the EU Recovery Fund, and about the broader transparency of EU decision-making. The minister replied that it is not for the Dutch government to judge the Commission's application of the EU access regulation, that complainants can go to the EU Ombudsman or the General Court, and that the Netherlands pushes for modernisation of the regulation.
It is not for the cabinet to comment on whether the European Commission correctly applied Regulation EC 1049/2001 (the Eurowob).
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te treden in de vraag of de Europese Commissie verordening EG 1049/2001 (hierna: de Eurowob) correct heeft toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Sjoerdsma over VN Intergovernmental Conference on Marine Biodiversity of areas Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ)

Two MPs (D66) asked the ministers about marine biodiversity in areas beyond national jurisdiction (BBNJ), including protection gaps, Dutch participation and ambition at the UN conference, and environmental impact assessment standards. The government answered that the BBNJ treaty process is ongoing, that Dutch ministerial participation is not yet appropriate at this stage, that it supports the High Ambition Coalition statement and 30% protection goals, and that it favours strategic and project environmental impact assessment in the treaty.
Participation at political level is not yet on the table at this stage of the negotiations.
Deelname op politiek niveau is in deze fase van de onderhandelingen nog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de consul van Rusland in Maastricht

An MP asked whether the minister would summon the Russian honorary consul in Maastricht over his public refusal to condemn Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and whether he supported a petition to close the consulate. The minister said the honorary consul's stance is firmly rejected, that Maastricht sent him a letter, and that the Russian ambassador was summoned and held responsible for the consul's statements, without committing to a separate summons or closure.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly rejects the honorary consul's position.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken keurt het standpunt van de honorair consul ten zeerste af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het kabinetsbesluit UAWC niet langer te financieren en Israëls criminalisering van Palestijnse maatschappelijke organisaties

An MP from DENK asks the government about its decision to end funding for the Union of Agricultural Work Committees (UAWC) over alleged links to the PFLP and about the consequences for Palestinian civil society, including UN rapporteurs' objections. The ministers answer that the government found individual ties to the PFLP, sees no basis to classify UAWC as terrorist, has consulted the Palestinian side, and will coordinate with other donors and the EU without giving a timeline.
Based on the external investigation, the cabinet has no reason to classify UAWC as a terrorist organisation.
Het kabinet heeft op basis van het externe onderzoek geen reden om UAWC te kwalificeren als een terroristische organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het bericht 'U en ik werken mee aan de mishandeling van migranten'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that EU support to the Libyan coast guard contributes to abuse of migrants, and what action follows from the FIDH 'No Way Out' report. The government rejects the claim that the EU actively contributes to torture, describes calls for detention reform and third-party monitoring, and lists sanctions, prosecutions and funding measures without committing to new steps beyond existing ones.
The Netherlands funds organisations such as FIDH to conduct research into human rights violations and report on them.
Nederland financiert organisaties als FIDH om onderzoek te doen naar mensenrechtenschendingen en hierover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Boucke over het bericht ‘Groot-Brittannië doet Aeroflot in de ban als gevolg van Russische agressie’

MPs Boucke and Sjoerdsma asked whether Britain closed its airspace to Aeroflot, how many Russian airlines fly from Dutch airports, whether the Netherlands will investigate an EU-level ban, and whether Dutch airlines still fly over Russia. The minister confirmed the UK closure, said no Russian airlines currently fly from Dutch airports due to the EU airspace closure, and said Dutch airlines no longer fly over Russia because Russia banned them.
Due to the current closure of European airspace to Russian airlines, no Russian airlines fly from Dutch airports.
Door de huidige sluiting van het Europese luchtruim voor Russische luchtvaartmaatschappijen vliegen er geen Russische luchtvaartmaatschappijen op Nederlandse luchthavens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops en Agnes Mulder over de toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops and Mulder asked about the status of the EU's accession to the European Convention on Human Rights, the remaining legal and political objections, and when talks would resume. The minister replied that negotiations are progressing slowly through seven rounds since 2020, that several legal objections remain (partly resolved), the next round is scheduled for May 2022, and the Netherlands will actively push to speed up accession.
The Netherlands wishes to fulfil the treaty obligation for the EU's accession to the ECHR as quickly as possible.
Nederland wenst de verdragsrechtelijke verplichting tot toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM zo snel mogelijk te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Boucke over het bericht dat Rusland BUK-afweersystemen bij de grens met Oekraïne plaatst

Two D66 MPs asked the government about reports that Russia placed BUK and S-300/S-400 air defence systems near the Ukrainian border and what this means for civil aviation safety, including IFALPA and ECA warnings and recommendations from the Dutch Safety Board on airspace closure criteria. The ministers answered that monitoring continues, that KLM and other airlines suspended Ukraine flights, that Dutch airspace-closure powers for airlines face legal and practical objections, and that the government is working on international criteria.
Dutch airlines did not fly there.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Teunissen, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Simons en Dassen over het lot van de Afghaanse ambassadebewakers

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Afghan guards employed by an external contractor at the Dutch embassy in Kabul were not evacuated, when the Belhaj motion called for evacuating those who assisted the Dutch government, and whether the contractor was informed of the decision. The minister answered that the guards were not embassy employees and guarded other states' diplomatic missions, so they fell outside the evacuation criteria; he acknowledged the contractor received no timely written reply and that the lists and correspondence are shared only confidentially.
The request of 15 August and both reminders are shared with you on a confidential basis.
Het verzoek van 15 augustus en beide rappels worden op vertrouwelijke basis met u gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat politieke oppositie in Azerbeidzjan wordt mishandeld of vastgezet

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of beatings and detention of Azerbaijani opposition figures, their health, pending court cases, the embassy's access, the independence of the judiciary and EU/Council of Europe responses including sanctions. The minister answered that the government finds the reports very concerning, lacks confidential medical data, has limited capacity to monitor cases, and relies on dialogue, quiet diplomacy and Council of Europe supervision without committing to sanctions in individual cases.
Regarding whether a sanctions measure is being considered in individual cases, the cabinet cannot make statements for reasons of confidentiality.
Over de vraag of in individuele gevallen al dan niet een sanctiemaatregel wordt overwogen kan het kabinet om redenen van vertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ambassadeurs op de fraudelijst van de Belastingdienst

An MP asked why two ambassadors were on the Tax Authority's fraud list (FSV) and why they were not informed, under which GDPR exemption, and who they are and why they are listed. The State Secretary answered that the ambassadors will be informed like others unless an exemption applies, that the Tax Authority consulted the Foreign Ministry, and that the tax secrecy duty prevents him from identifying individuals or their tax position.
The ambassadors will, like other people registered in FSV, be informed, unless an exemption ground applies.
De ambassadeurs zullen net als andere mensen die in FSV stonden geregistreerd, worden geïnformeerd, tenzij er sprake is van een uitzonderingsgrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie van Nederlanders in Rusland en het reisadvies van de rijksoverheid voor Rusland

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether the threat of Russian military action against Ukraine endangers Dutch nationals in Russia, how likely retaliation against Western citizens is, and whether the Dutch travel advice for Russia is adequate compared with the US advice. The minister replied that the advice was tightened (urgent call to consider necessary stay, pinning and flight uncertainties noted), that no specific threats against Dutch citizens are known, and that the advice is in line with other EU countries.
The answer to this question will be included in the reply by the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management
Het antwoord op deze vraag zal worden meegenomen in de beantwoording door de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Piri over het artikel 'VN: Taliban hebben al ruim honderd voormalige functionarissen gedood in Afghanistan'

MPs Simons and Piri asked the Foreign Minister whether a UN report of over a hundred killings of former officials by the Taliban proves risks despite their amnesty, and what this means for evacuation policy and protection of Afghans. The minister calls the reports deeply concerning, notes the Taliban deny central policy and attribute killings to personal disputes, says evacuation criteria remain unchanged while alternative routes are explored, and outlines UN human rights monitoring steps including a Special Rapporteur.
These reports are extremely worrying and point to gross violations of human rights.
Deze berichten zijn uiterst zorgelijk en duiden op grove schendingen van de mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Jasper van Dijk over het besluit om financiering aan de Palestijnse organisatie UAWC stop te zetten

MPs Simons and Van Dijk asked why the government ended funding to the Palestinian organisation UAWC, whether the external Proximities report clears it of terrorism links, and why the government does not apply the same scrutiny to Israeli entities or the EU-Israel Association Agreement. The ministers answered that the decision rests on documented individual ties between UAWC staff and the PFLP, that the government will not revisit it, that no external study of Israeli firms is planned, and that suspension of the Association Agreement is not on the table.
The cabinet found that the individual ties, including within the UAWC board and the dual mandates with the PFLP, were widespread and covered the entire 2007–2021 research period.

Het kabinet heeft geconstateerd dat de individuele banden – zeker ook binnen het bestuur van UAWC en de daar geconstateerde dubbelmandaten met de PFLP – wijdverbreid waren en de gehele onderzoeksperiode 2007–2021 bestreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over een ontmoeting met de Taliban

An MP asked whether Dutch diplomats would meet a Taliban delegation visiting Geneva, whether such a meeting would amount to de facto recognition, and whether the Chamber would receive a report of any meeting. The minister said no Dutch diplomats would meet the delegation, that contacts can be necessary to defend Dutch interests without recognising the Taliban, and that the Chamber is informed regularly about Afghanistan in general.
See answer to question 1. The cabinet informs the Chamber regularly about the Dutch engagement in Afghanistan and the status of various files in this area.
Zie antwoord op vraag 1. Het kabinet informeert de Kamer met enige regelmaat over de Nederlandse inzet in Afghanistan en de stand van zaken van diverse dossiers daaromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Maeijer over de berichten dat Nederland miljarden minder ontvangt en meer mag betalen aan de EU

MPs Tony van Dijck and Maeijer asked whether Dutch receipts from the EU recovery fund (RRF) will fall and whether the Dutch EU contribution will rise through the Social Climate Fund and MFF revision, and whether the government will oppose higher contributions. The ministers answered that the RRF allocation will be finalised by the Commission by 30 June and the Dutch plan will then be fixed, provided tables of allocations and disbursements, and that the government is cautious about higher contributions but will assess the total package and aims for prudent EU budget development.
The cabinet is pursuing a prudent development of the EU budget, with more attention to policy areas that are a priority for the Netherlands.
Het kabinet zet in op een prudente ontwikkeling van de EU-begroting, met meer aandacht voor beleidsterreinen die voor Nederland prioritair zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Lee en Sjoerdsma over de acties van China tegen Litouwen naar aanleiding van het openen van een Vertegenwoordiging van Taiwan in Vilnius

MPs Van der Lee and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister how the government supports Lithuania against Chinese economic coercion after Taiwan opened a representative office in Vilnius, and whether these measures breach WTO rules. The minister replies that the Netherlands expresses solidarity, raised concerns with China, backs the EU's WTO consultation request and the EU anti-coercion instrument, and says businesses are responsible for their own risk analysis while the government monitors the situation.
The cabinet fully supports this step by the EU.
Het kabinet staat volledig achter deze stap van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Rudmer Heerema en Rajkowski over de verplichte MY2022 app bij de Olympische Spelen

VVD MPs asked whether data from the mandatory MY2022 Olympic app could be used for surveillance, whether it is securely transmitted and shared with third parties, whether the government will press the IOC and Chinese authorities to make it compliant or optional, and what measures the Netherlands will take. The minister answered that the risks fit a broader picture of Chinese data collection, that the app's encryption lacks authenticity checks, that data is shared with Chinese companies, that Dutch athletes are not obliged to use the app but must use the HMS function (which can be used online), that concerns were raised with the Chinese ambassador, and that briefings for NOC*NSF will be repeated.
Our concerns about this app were therefore conveyed to the Chinese ambassador in The Hague prior to the Games.
Onze zorgen over deze app zijn dan ook voorafgaand aan de Spelen overgebracht aan de Chinese ambassadeur in Den Haag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Laan over het bericht dat de Chinese app MY2022 voor de Olympische Spelen 2022 gevoelige data van o.a. de Nederlandse Olympiërs verzamelt en politiek sensitieve conten

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Chinese MY2022 Olympic app collecting sensitive data of Dutch athletes and storing politically sensitive content, including IFlytek links, university ties, a security audit, mandatory use, censorship, and raising the issue with the IOC and EU. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described the security flaws found by Citizen Lab, said athletes were not obliged to use the app but had to provide personal health data, and noted the government had raised concerns bilaterally, through briefings and with the Chinese ambassador, while answers to the questions were delayed.

Given the technical aspects of the questions asked and the interdepartmental coordination they required, it has unfortunately not proved possible to answer these questions before the start of the Olympic Games.

Gezien de technische aspecten van de gestelde vragen en de interdepartementale afstemming die deze vergden, is het helaas niet mogelijk gebleken om deze vragen voor de aanvang van de Olympische Spelen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over het bericht 'Verhuren koophuis frustreert starters'

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Eerdmans asked about the rise of keep-to-let and buy-to-let housing, its effects on starters, and whether mortgage conditions are being breached. The minister said keep-to-let is stable at about 4% of transactions, outlined measures such as the transfer tax differentiation and a box 3 reform, and declined further research on unreported rental, citing lender estimates below 10%.
I therefore see no reason to commission additional research.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor het laten uitvoeren van aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Ook 200 belastingadviseurs bestempeld als fraudeur: onterecht volgens Achmed, die nu dak- en werkloos is'

An MP asked the government about the Combiteam Aanpak Facilitators (CAF), which labelled about 200 tax advisers as fraudsters, and about asset seizure and compensation for affected advisers and clients. The State Secretary answered that the CAF handled 218 cases, that an external investigation into its working method will be commissioned, and that there is no separate compensation scheme for tax advisers while the restoration operation concerns mainly childcare-benefit victims.
I have decided to have this investigation carried out by an external party.
Ik heb besloten dit onderzoek door een externe partij te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de verduurzaming van de financiële sector

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Finance Minister about DNB's finding that the Dutch financial sector is greening too slowly, with climate-transition risks rising, weak integration of sustainability risk in risk management, and a low share of firms reporting CO2 impact under the financial sector climate commitment. The minister agrees the findings are concerning, promises stronger expectations from DNB, sector action plans by 2022, and further steps including a summer letter, while stopping short of binding measures and placing the commitment on a voluntary basis.
I therefore call on the sector to go a step further than the current commitment.
Ik roep de sector daarom op een stap verder te zetten ten opzichte van het huidige commitment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over politieke gevangenen in Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about political prisoners in Turkey, including the detention of Osman Kavala, reports of sick prisoners not receiving adequate care, and the case of Aysel Tuğluk. The minister answered that reliable figures are unavailable, that the Netherlands has raised Kavala's case in the Council of Europe and urged compliance with the European Court ruling, and that the embassy is monitoring Tuğluk's health without committing to specific intervention.
However, the cabinet cannot establish with certainty how many people are imprisoned for political reasons or what the trend is.
Het kabinet kan echter niet met zekerheid vaststellen hoeveel personen om politieke redenen vastzitten en wat hierbij de trend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het artikel 'Zijn mensenrechten nou universeel of niet?'

MP Piri asked the Foreign Minister whether human rights are universal, whether national variation is allowed, and whether the 'receptor approach' has a place in foreign policy. The minister answered that human rights are universal and indivisible, that national implementation may differ but must rest on internationally developed principles, and that the receptor approach is undesirable and has no place in Dutch foreign policy.
Yes, human rights are universal, indivisible and mutually dependent.
Ja, mensenrechten zijn universeel, ondeelbaar en onderling afhankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Mali expels Paris envoy over 'hostile and outrageous' French comments'

VVD MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about Mali's expulsion of France's envoy, the junta's postponed elections, and the effects on Dutch participation in MINUSMA and Takuba. The ministers answered that the junta is illegitimate, that Takuba will be withdrawn, and that the impact on Dutch missions and EU coordination is under close review.
The cabinet is also holding intensive consultations with partners in the UN and EU on the possible consequences of the deteriorating conditions in Mali for the UN mission MINUSMA.
Het kabinet voert daarnaast intensief overleg met partners in de VN en de EU over de mogelijke gevolgen van de verslechterende omstandigheden in Mali voor de VN-missie MINUSMA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over de situatie in Mali

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the situation in Mali, including the future of MINUSMA, the Takuba task force, French withdrawal, Russian paramilitaries, and Dutch evacuation planning. The government answered that it is very concerned, that the Dutch MINUSMA contribution is not under review for now, that Takuba is being withdrawn, and that it is monitoring developments and maintaining diplomatic contacts.
Suspending the Dutch civilian and military contribution to the UN mission MINUSMA is currently not on the table.
Het stopzetten van de Nederlandse civiele en militaire bijdrage aan de VN-missie MINUSMA is momenteel niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over de laatste ontwikkelingen in Oekraïne

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about the security risks for Dutch citizens in Ukraine, the absence of planned state evacuation, and evacuation routes, following a US advisory to leave. The minister answered that the travel advice was raised to red for all of Ukraine, that no government-organised evacuation would take place if the situation deteriorated, and gave road and registration details.
Dutch citizens were informed that if they decide to stay and the situation deteriorates, no government-organised evacuation will take place.
Nederlanders zijn geïnformeerd dat als ze besluiten te blijven en de situatie zou verslechteren er geen door de overheid georganiseerde evacuatie zal plaatsvinden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht van het mogelijk samenspannen van EU-commissaris voor Nabuurschap en Uitbreiding, Olivér Várhelyi, met Milorad Dodik, de leider van de Bosnische Serviërs

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that EU Commissioner Olivér Várhelyi may have colluded with Bosnian Serb leader Milorad Dodik, about the EU's response, and about possible sanctions. The minister said the government could not verify the reports, stated that EU sanctions proposed under the Kuzu motion did not gain support in the Council, and described diplomatic steps and a pending High Representative options paper.
The cabinet does not have information to verify the indications in the EU Observer report.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie om de aanwijzingen uit het bericht van de EU Observer te kunnen verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het Politico interview van Eurocommissaris Reynders

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Commissioner Reynders' Politico interview on the timing of the EU rule-of-law conditionality regulation against Hungary, and whether payments could be suspended earlier. The minister answered in detail that the procedure takes at least three months, that no delay before the Hungarian elections is intended, and that the government keeps pressing the Commission to use the instrument fully.
The cabinet continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation, by adopting guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payment of EU funds.

Antwoord 7 Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaat verordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Ellemeet, Van der Graaf, Piri, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu en Teunissen over het bericht 'Polish coalition dynamics complicate rule-of-law talks, says EU’s justi

MPs asked the government whether the EU rule-of-law conditionality mechanism would be activated before Hungary's April 2022 elections and why it had not yet been used, and urged the Netherlands to press the Commission. The minister replied that the Commission had delayed the mechanism pending guidelines and a Court of Justice ruling (issued 16 February 2022), that the procedure takes at least three months so cannot be finished before the Hungarian vote, and that the Netherlands continues to urge swift guidelines and activation.

The government continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation by establishing guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payments of EU funds.

Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaatverordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat verzekeraars jagen op miljarden in het nieuwe pensioenstelsel.

An SP MP asked the government about reports that insurers are targeting pension assets of company pension funds under the new pension system, including the effects on participants, solidarity, insurer profits, lobbying and meetings with insurers. The Minister replied that the choice of pension provider is for employers and funds, that a careful process with DNB oversight and fund-body rights applies to transfers, and that the government does not expect pension interests to be harmed, while many questions were answered only generally or said the information is not available.
It is not possible to provide an overview of the requested information, because this information is not available.
Het is niet mogelijk om een overzicht van de gevraagde informatie te geven, omdat deze informatie niet beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga, Ephraim en Smolders over juridisch bindende overeenkomsten met het World Economic Forum en aanverwante zaken

MPs Van Haga, Ephraim and Smolders asked whether the government has binding agreements with the World Economic Forum and whether Parliament can inspect them. The minister confirmed binding implementation agreements and grants under Dutch law, said the subsidy decisions are attached, and stated that the WEF is a private Swiss foundation and that the agreements fall within the budget Parliament approves.
Annex 3 contains the subsidy decisions issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to the WEF.
In de bijlage 3 treft u de aan het WEF verstrekte subsidiebeschikkingen van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over een reis naar Israël in 2019 door de nieuwe minister van Justitie en Veiligheid en medewerkers van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a 2019 trip to Israel by the current Justice Minister and Foreign Ministry staff, probing funding (including possible Maror funds), CIDI involvement, and gift rules. The government answered that the trip was private, that the involved staffer had no link to the Middle East file and got leave from the employer, that the government lacks full insight into funding, and that the trip was recorded in the Tweede Kamer's side-activity registers.
The cabinet has only limited insight into how this private trip was financed for the whole group of participants, and that is not for the cabinet to determine.
Het kabinet heeft slechts beperkt inzicht in de wijze waarop deze privéreis voor de gehele groep van deelnemers is gefinancierd, en dat is ook niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over landonteigening zonder compensatie in Zuid-Afrika

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Zondo Commission findings on ANC cadre deployment in the judiciary and on state capture under Ramaphosa change Dutch policy opposing land expropriation without compensation in South Africa. The minister rejected the MP's conclusions, stated the interim report does not conclude the JSC or IEC are captured, said Dutch policy on expropriation without reasonable compensation remains unchanged, and committed to no new action.
I therefore see no reason to revise Dutch policy on land expropriation without compensation in South Africa.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor een herziening van het Nederlandse beleid inzake landonteigening zonder compensatie in Zuid-Afrika
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, Eppink en Omtzigt over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2022 van Open Doors

MPs Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, Eppink and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2022 Christian persecution ranking, covering Afghanistan, Nigeria, China, India, Algeria, digital surveillance exports, and religious freedom diplomacy. The minister answered that the trends are worrying, outlined existing diplomatic, UN, EU and export-control measures, and promised no new concrete action beyond continued engagement and a future subsidy policy framework.
The Netherlands, together with like-minded countries, raises publicly and behind the scenes at every suitable opportunity the importance of protecting human rights for everyone.

Nederland vraagt, samen met gelijkgezinde landen, zowel publiek als achter de schermen bij iedere gelegenheid die zich daarvoor leent aandacht voor het belang van het beschermen van mensenrechten voor iedereen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gedwongen huisuitzettingen van Palestijnse families in Oost-Jeruzalem

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about forced evictions of Palestinian families in East Jerusalem, Israel's policy on demolitions, Dutch responses and possible measures against settlement business. The minister condemns the evictions as contrary to international law, says the Netherlands and EU raise the issue bilaterally, but declines to support a ban on trade with settlements, following EU policy.
The Netherlands fundamentally disagrees with the Israeli government on the evictions and demolitions in East Jerusalem.
Nederland verschilt op het punt van de uithuiszettingen en sloop in Oost-Jeruzalem fundamenteel van mening met de Israëlische regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het verslag van de Europese Rekenkamer ‘EU-steun voor de rechtsstaat in de Westelijke Balkan’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the European Court of Auditors report finding that EU support for rule-of-law reform in the Western Balkans has had little effect, and what the government would do about it. The minister agreed the findings are serious, committed to pressing for the auditors' recommendations (conditionality, civil society and media support, better monitoring) and to raising them in EU and bilateral channels.
The cabinet takes the ERK's conclusions and recommendations very seriously and will actively use them in current and future efforts on rule-of-law reforms in the Western Balkans.
Het kabinet neemt de conclusies en aanbevelingen van de ERK zeer serieus en zal hier actief gebruik van maken bij de huidige en toekomstige inzet op rechtsstaatshervormingen in de Westelijke Balkan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over de ineffectiviteit van Europese bestedingen richting de Balkan betreffende de rechtsstaat

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how to respond to a European Court of Auditors report finding that EU spending of about 700 million euros on rule of law in Western Balkan candidate countries had little lasting effect, including inconsistent enforcement of conditionality and weak monitoring. The minister answered that the findings are concerning, that the government will push for stricter conditionality, better monitoring and a shift toward fundamental rule-of-law reform, and that the recommendations will be raised in EU forums.
The cabinet will strongly advocate that the EU in future focuses more on this fundamental strengthening of the rule of law, partly based on the ECA's recommendations.
Het kabinet zal zich er hard voor maken dat de EU zich in de toekomst meer richt op deze fundamentele versterking van de rechtsstaat, mede op basis van de aanbevelingen van de ERK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de vaccinatieplicht voor Oostenrijkers

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Austrian COVID-19 vaccine mandate, with fines up to 3,600 euro from 1 February 2022, amounts to coercion and whether the Netherlands would object. The minister answered that public health is a national competence, that Austria must justify its measures under EU values and proportionality, and declined to judge or to summon the Austrian ambassador.
It is up to Austria to determine which measures are necessary in the interest of public health.
Het is aan Oostenrijk om te bepalen welke maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn in het belang van de volksgezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Stoffer, Segers en Mulder over gewonde burgers als gevolg van Turkse militaire activiteiten in Noordoost-Syrië

MPs asked the government whether Turkish military attacks in northeast Syria injuring civilians, including children, were lawful, and about Turkey's strategy and humanitarian protection of minorities. The government said it lacks details to judge the legality of specific attacks, condemned the Turkish operation, and described ongoing diplomatic efforts and support programmes for religious minorities.

The cabinet states that all countries, including Turkey, must act in accordance with international law, but does not have the details of the attacks in question and therefore cannot make statements on their lawfulness.

Het kabinet stelt voorop dat alle landen en dus ook Turkije conform het internationaal recht moeten handelen, maar beschikt niet over de details van de betreffende aanvallen en kan dus ook geen uitspraken doen over de rechtmatigheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Ellemeet over het bericht ‘China financiert onderzoek naar mensenrechten aan VU’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science about Chinese funding of a human rights research centre at the VU, raising concerns about academic independence and Chinese influence in Dutch universities. The minister answered that academic freedom can coexist with third-party funding, that the national knowledge security guideline was published, that the RUG Hanban chair was not renewed, and that the government is concerned about human rights in Xinjiang.
I will, together with other ministries and services, keep a close eye on this.
Ik zal daarbij, samen met andere ministeries en diensten, een vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘China financiert onderzoek naar mensenrechten aan VU’

MPs Van der Woude and Brekelmans asked whether the VU's China-funded human rights research centre (CCHRC) was transparent about its Chinese funding, whether ministers knew, and whether such funding threatens academic independence and Uyghur safety in the Netherlands. The minister answered that funding was recorded internally but not individually in external reports, that the ministries were unaware, that academic independence must be safeguarded through risk assessment without blanket exclusion, and that a foreign-agent register like Australia's is not the answer, while the motion on such a register is still being implemented.
The Ministry of OCW and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs were not aware of this funding.
Het Ministerie van OCW en het Ministerie van BZ waren niet op de hoogte van deze financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wapenleveranties aan Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about arms deliveries to Ukraine, including transparency about Ukraine's request, the defensive/offensive distinction, and consistency with export criteria. The government answered that it cannot disclose Ukraine's specific needs, will inform parliament quickly if deliveries proceed above 2 million euro, and is welcoming toward supporting Ukraine's self-defence while still pursuing diplomacy.
Should the Netherlands decide to supply military goods to Ukraine, the cabinet is willing to inform the House of this in an expedited letter.
Mocht Nederland overgaan tot het leveren van militaire goederen aan Oekraïne dan is het kabinet graag bereid om de Kamer hierover versneld per brief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over Oekraïne

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands is not withdrawing embassy staff and families from Ukraine while the US, UK and Australia are, and about the risk assessments and travel advice. The minister answered that the situation in Kyiv is calm, that the Netherlands follows EU-aligned policy, withheld the other countries' risk analyses as confidential, and tightened travel advice.
I have not been given full insight into these countries' risk analyses, which is also not customary.
Van deze landen heb ik geen volledige inzage gekregen in hun risicoanalyse, dat is ook niet gebruikelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over jongeren die in crypto’s beleggen

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether young people are exposed to excessive, unwelcome risky crypto investment and advertising, and how the existing rules and the forthcoming MiCA regulation protect them. The minister answers that the risks are concerning, points to existing conduct rules, the AFM's supervision and product intervention powers, and MiCA's fair-conduct and advertising requirements, but does not commit to new measures beyond monitoring and European initiatives.
To protect investors, there are strict requirements for advertising.
Om beleggers te beschermen bestaan er strenge eisen voor reclame-uitingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de ongewenste effecten van strengere regelgeving met betrekking tot het tegengaan van fraude en witwassen

MP Stoffer asks how the effects of anti-fraud and anti-money-laundering rules are monitored, whether research into their negative effects will be done, and how bank account access for charities, churches and associations can be secured. Minister Kaag answers that evaluations are underway (EU, FATF, national, Algemene Rekenkamer), that banks and DNB are working on the knelpunten case by case, and that a general legal right to a bank account for associations is not appropriate, while the evaluation of the Wwft will be shared with parliament in the first half of 2022.
Are you of the opinion that it should be legally mandatory for associations and foundations, including many charities and churches, to be able to open a bank account at every bank?
Bent u van mening dat het wettelijk verplicht moet zijn dat verenigingen en stichtingen ... de mogelijkheid hebben een bankrekening te openen bij elke bank
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Sneller en Ephraim over de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over de benoeming van een nieuw Nederlands lid van de Europese Rekenkamer

MPs Sneller and Ephraim asked whether the government would delay launching the recruitment procedure for a new Dutch member of the European Court of Auditors until parliament could discuss it, and whether the process had adequate checks and balances and peer-based selection. The minister replied that the open procedure through Bureau Algemene Bestuursdienst is already underway, that an independent selection committee will advise ministers before nomination by the Council of the EU after consulting the European Parliament, and that the process is independent with adequate checks.
After the procedure has concluded, the cabinet will consult the relevant parties to consider whether the procedure needs further shaping in the future.
Het kabinet zal na afloop van de procedure in overleg met de relevante spelers bezien of de procedure in de toekomst nog verdere vormgeving behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Alkaya en Dassen over het bericht ‘Belasting besparen: zo doen Zuidas-partners dat’

MPs asked whether Zuidas partners' use of BV structures and DGA arrangements lets them pay less tax than employees, whether the Tax Authority's agreements on reasonable salaries are acceptable, and whether a 20-partner BV constructions should be banned. The State Secretary acknowledges a possible gap, describes the excessive-lending bill and the reasonable-salary rules, says new policy options are unnecessary, and states that ministers' business interests were disclosed under a motion.
The Tax Authority does not address individual cases because of its statutory duty of confidentiality.
De Belastingdienst gaat in verband met zijn wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over mogelijke impact van Europese ESG-standaarden op de defensie- en veiligheidssector

CDA MPs asked the government about the EU EcoLabel draft criteria for financial products, which would exclude firms earning over 5% of revenue from conventional weapons or military products used in combat, and how this affects Dutch defence firms' access to financial services. The state secretary said the criteria are voluntary for banks, that the government will raise the risk of blanket sector exclusion within the EU and talk with the defence sector and the banking association, but gave no commitment to change the criteria.
The current revenue share from trade or production of weapons and/or military products for combat of individual Dutch companies is not known.
Het huidige omzetaandeel van de handel of productie van wapens en/of militaire producten voor « combat » van individuele Nederlandse bedrijven is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Van Wijngaarden en Koerhuis over de actuele veiligheidsrisico’s voor Nederlanders in Oekraïne

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Infrastructure about security risks for Dutch nationals in Ukraine, including travel advice, evacuation preparations and airspace safety. The government answered that there is no reason yet to speak of a threatening situation, kept the current travel advice, said evacuation is not being organised, and pointed to existing EU and national airspace risk assessments.
That number need not be representative of the actual number of Dutch nationals in Ukraine, because there is no registration obligation for Dutch nationals abroad (due to privacy).
Dat getal hoeft niet per se representatief te zijn voor het daadwerkelijke aantal Nederlanders in Oekraïne, omdat er geen registratieplicht is voor Nederlanders in het buitenland (vanwege privacy).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Onderzoekscommissie: DNB schoot tekort in toezicht op verzekeraar Conservatrix'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the evaluation committee's findings that DNB fell short in supervising insurer Conservatrix, and about relief for 92,000 affected policyholders. The minister said a fuller response, including DNB's input on implementing the recommendations, will follow in March, and that the curators are responsible for winding up the insurer and policyholder outcomes are not yet settled.
The aim is to send a comprehensive response to the report to the House in March.
Het streven is om een uitgebreide reactie op het rapport in maart aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Ephraim over de benoeming van het Nederlandse lid van de Europese Rekenkamer

MPs Sneller and Ephraim asked why former European Court of Auditors member Brenninkmeijer resigned early, what criteria apply to the Dutch successor, and whether parliament will be involved in the appointment. The minister explained the Treaty criteria, noted Parliament's role via the European Parliament consultation, and said an open selection procedure via the Algemene Bestuursdienst will be used, with the ministerraad deciding and normal parliamentary control applying.
The conduct of a cabinet in this matter is subject to normal parliamentary control.
Het handelen van een kabinet in dezen is aan de normale parlementaire controle onderworpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over een door FMO gefinancierd bedrijf dat is veroordeeld voor een moordcomplot in Honduras

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the ministers about FMO's financing of the company behind the Agua Zarca project in Honduras, whose CEO was convicted of involvement in the murder of activist Berta Cáceres, and whether FMO and the ministry ignored repeated civil-society warnings and how to improve FMO's due diligence and transparency. The minister answered that a civil lawsuit against FMO is pending so no judgement is given on FMO's role, that the ministry has pressed for improvements, and that FMO's transparency and IMVO policies have been and are being tightened.
Pending this procedure, I make no statements about FMO's role.
Hangende deze procedure doe ik over de rol van FMO geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over ‘de afschaffing van het directe klachtrecht van consumenten bij de Tuchtraad Financiële Dienstverlening’

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Verbond van Verzekeraars removed consumers' direct complaint right to the Tuchtraad Financiële Dienstverlening against his criticism, and questioned AFM oversight and self-regulation. The minister denied any restriction, explained the single-counter design via Kifid, and refused an independent investigation, though he promised to urge insurers to make the complaint route more visible.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de gesprekken die de Nederlandse gezant voor Afghanistan voert met de top van het Taliban regime in Afghanistan over financiering van zorg- en onderwijssalarissen

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Development Cooperation and Finance about talks the Dutch envoy held with Taliban leaders on financing health and education salaries, including mandate, sanctioned persons, budget articles and sanctions compliance. The government answered all 14 questions in substance, confirming contacts with sanctioned Taliban figures under a no-direct-funding approach while noting salary payments might be channelled via NGOs and international organisations.
The cabinet does not provide financial support to the Taliban, as also requested in the De Roon motion.
Het kabinet verleent geen financiële steun aan de Taliban, zoals tevens is verzocht in de motie-De Roon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Soms lang reizen om geld te pinnen'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about reports that people must travel far to withdraw cash after cash machines disappeared, and whether the five-kilometre access norm still holds. The minister affirms cash access as important, states the norm is met (99.62% coverage) and that Geldmaat places machines where demand is, while noting that longer trips can be inconvenient.
I attach importance to good access to cash machines.
Ik hecht belang aan een goede toegang tot geldautomaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het bericht dat De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) een handhavingstraject is gestart tegen de Rabobank

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that DNB had started an enforcement track against Rabobank over weak anti-money-laundering controls, and about steps taken since the ABN AMRO settlement. The minister said the enforcement was initiated by DNB rather than the OM, described the broader anti-money-laundering plan and DNB's findings on the sector, and said the government would keep working on it and inform parliament.
The article referred to in question 1 describes an enforcement track initiated by De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) against Rabobank, not an enforcement track by the OM.
Het artikel waar in vraag 1 naar wordt verwezen beschrijft een handhavingstraject geïnitieerd door De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) bij Rabobank, geen handhavingstraject van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het stopzetten van ondernemerskrediet door ABN AMRO

MP Alkaya asks the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO can unilaterally end its business credit product during the coronavirus crisis, whether shareholders including the state were involved in the strategy, and whether customers are guaranteed tailored options. The minister answers that the bank decides its own product range, he has no role in the commercial strategy due to ACM measures, and he has asked the bank for good communication, while disputes are for Kifid or the courts.
I cannot get involved in assessing agreements between an individual financial institution and its customers.
Ik kan niet treden in de beoordeling van overeenkomsten tussen een individuele financiële instelling en haar klanten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het advies van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) dat ten grondslag ligt aan zijn brief over actieve provisietransparantie en het Besluit financiële markten 2021

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Finance whether the AFM advice behind the active commission-transparency proposal (Wijzigingsbesluit Financiële Markten 2021) really supports the claim that it is feasible, and whether it is legally sound and avoids information overload and reduced competition. The Minister answers that the AFM, after talks with industry, judged the proposal feasible with its three recommendations adopted, that the proposal is consistent with the IDD and proportionate, and that an evaluation report will follow within three years.
I have adopted the AFM's conclusion on feasibility.
Ik heb de conclusie van de AFM over uitvoerbaarheid overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de risico’s van CFD's

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the risks of CFDs, the apparent fraud and conflicts of interest in their sale, and why they are not banned. The minister explains the existing product-intervention rules, notes that a ban can only be imposed by European or national supervisors rather than by himself, and commits to pushing for consumer protection in the EU Retail Investment Strategy.
The Minister of Finance does not have a statutory power to adopt a product intervention measure to prohibit the marketing, distribution or sale of CFDs to non-professional clients in the Netherlands.

De Minister van Financiën beschikt niet over een wettelijke bevoegdheid om een productinterventiemaatregel vast te stellen teneinde het op de markt brengen, verspreiden of verkopen van CFD’s aan niet-professionele cliënten in Nederland te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Gündoğan over het artikel 'Clash Hoekstra en Wiebes over plan Europees noodfonds'

MPs Dassen and Gündoğan asked about an RTL report of a clash between the Finance and Economic Affairs ministries over the Dutch Recovery and Resilience Plan and how the plan will be prepared and approved. The minister replied that the plan will be decided by the next cabinet, that a Finance-led programme directorate will draft it with Parliament consulted before formal submission, and that the plan is not yet fixed on reforms or spending.
Your House was informed of this on 27 November 2020 by means of a letter.
Uw Kamer is hier op 27 november 2020 over geïnformeerd middels een brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Nijboer over de activiteiten van NS-dochter Abellio in Noordrijn-Westfalen (NRW)

MPs De Hoop and Nijboer asked the government about NS subsidiary Abellio's losses and insolvency procedure in Germany, particularly the North Rhine-Westphalia contracts, and whether Dutch travellers and taxpayers would bear the costs. The minister explains the losses stem from external factors, that NS-backed restructuring keeps risk within the agreed framework, and that Abellio's NRW concessions will end on 31 January 2022 with emergency tenders.
With this solution NS stays within the risk framework ('Capital at Risk') that I agreed with your House for NS's foreign activities.
NS blijft met deze oplossing binnen het risicokader («Capital at Risk») dat ik met uw Kamer heb afgesproken voor de buitenlandse activiteiten van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de gebrekkige beheersing van duurzaamheidsrisico’s door Europese banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister about ECB findings that most significant European banks inadequately manage climate and environmental risks, and about progress, Dutch banks' exposure, EU coordination, the climate commitment, and the CRR/CRD proposals. The minister answered that progress is slow but banks have started, that DNB and the ECB oversee Dutch banks, that the climate commitment focuses on CO2 impact rather than risk, and that the CRR/CRD proposals would embed ESG risk in supervision.
Information on the material climate and environmental risks for individual Dutch systemically important banks therefore lies in the first instance with the supervisor.
De informatie over de materiële klimaat- en milieurisico's voor individuele Nederlandse systeemrelevante banken ligt zodoende in eerste instantie bij de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de artikelen “Toezichthouder waarschuwt voor risico’s onverstandig beleggen” en “AFM vreest financiële problemen bij deel “doe-het-zelfbeleggers”

The CDA MP asks the Finance Minister about AFM warnings that many execution-only retail investors act unwisely and are vulnerable if markets or housing turn, and about the status of banning negative savings rates. The minister acknowledges the risks, points to financial literacy, European retail investment strategy work and existing mortgage measures, and says the negative-rate ban question remains open with a commitment to revisit it if access to non-negative-rate banks is significantly restricted.
I consider it important that consumers realise they must always keep a liquid savings buffer to absorb an unforeseen expense or a drop in income.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat consumenten beseffen dat zij altijd een liquide spaarbuffer moeten aanhouden om een onvoorziene uitgave of terugval in inkomsten op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over uitspraken van de Griekse premier Mitsotakis over het Stabiliteits- en Groeipact

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Greek PM Mitsotakis's confidence that EU fiscal rules will be loosened, the coalition formation document's call to 'modernise' the Stability and Growth Pact, and Greece's 207% debt ratio. The minister answered that the SGP's core aim is sustainable public finances, that reform proposals will be judged on that basis, that the SGP should be simplified, and that Greece's debt cannot realistically reach 60% of GDP soon, with the position on reform left to the next cabinet.
The determination of the position on the conclusions of the consultation sessions and any legislative proposals to amend the SGP is left to the next cabinet.
De positiebepaling ten aanzien van de conclusies uit de consultatiesessies en eventuele wetsvoorstellen voor aanpassing van het SGP is aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Een miljoen 'ongebruikelijke' transacties maar weinig aanhoudingen''

An MP asked the government about a report of a million unusual transactions yet few arrests, the mismatch between bank reporting staff and the limited FIU and police capacity, the effectiveness of the anti-money-laundering law, and steps to improve it. The minister answered that reporting is a key preventive part of the system, that capacity at the FIU is being expanded to 90 fte, that a 2019 action plan and pending FATF and Court of Audit reviews are underway, and that the government will keep monitoring but could not say how often reports lead to convictions.

For the reasons above, it cannot be stated how often a report of an unusual transaction that the FIU-Nederland has declared suspicious ultimately leads to a concrete criminal investigation or conviction.

Om bovenstaande redenen kan niet worden aangegeven hoe vaak een melding van een ongebruikelijke transactie die door de FIU-Nederland verdacht is verklaard, uiteindelijk leidt tot een concreet opsporingsonderzoek of veroordeling.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat de acceptgiro verdwijnt

An SGP MP asked the Finance Minister about the planned discontinuation of the paper acceptgiro, its effects on charities, elderly and digitally excluded people, and how banks' accessibility duties are guaranteed. The minister answered that the acceptgiro ends on 1 June 2023, that paper alternatives exist, that the matter was discussed in the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer, and that the phase-out will be monitored.
The Betaalvereniging will, on behalf of Currence, report on practical experiences and statistics, such as stakeholder suggestions, end-user reactions and experiences with the switch to alternatives.

De Betaalvereniging zal in opdracht van Currence rapporteren over de praktische ervaringen en statistieken, zoals suggesties van stakeholders, reacties van eindgebruikers en ervaringen met de overstap naar alternatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over spanningen bij toepassing van de Wwft

MP Grinwis asks the Finance Minister about tensions between Wwft anti-money-laundering rules and Dutch coffeeshop toleration policy, civil-law duties of care that require banks to keep accounts, notaries' confidentiality conflicts, the absence of a hardship clause, and the proportionality of bank de-risking, including whether to apply the Toeslagenaffaire lessons. The Minister answers that the tensions are for national legislators to resolve, that Wwft obligations are preventive and separate from criminal enforcement, that banks must assess risk individually, and that a notaries' confidentiality analysis and evaluation of the implementing act are underway.
We will inform your House further when conclusions have been reached with the parties involved in this matter.
Wij zullen uw Kamer nader informeren wanneer met de betrokken partijen tot conclusies in deze kwestie is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over de internetconsultaties ‘Wet toekomst accountancysector’ en het Consultatiedocument ‘Audit Quality Indicators’ – Kwartiermakers Toekomst Accountancysector

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the Wet toekomst accountancysector and Audit Quality Indicators are needed, and raised concerns about SME accountants, the burden of indicators, the NBA's representativeness and fraud/continuity reporting. The minister answered that the reforms respond to AFM and Cta findings, that the indicators aim at transparency, that the Kwartiermakers will give a final proposal considering SME burden, and that NBA representativeness is not presently a problem.
I am awaiting the final proposal from the Kwartiermakers toekomst accountancysector.
Ik wacht het definitieve voorstel van de kwartiermakers toekomst accountancysector af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de dreigende ondergang van Evergrande

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the risk of Evergrande's collapse, its effects on China and the world economy, possible state rescue, the analogy with Lehman Brothers, monitoring, and criticism of austerity and MMT. The minister answered that Evergrande's exposure to foreign parties is limited, that the government monitors China's economy through diplomatic channels and experts, and that any support package depends on the crisis type, while largely declining to comment on analysts' views and speculating on China's intervention.
Statements by analysts or other parties on whether the Chinese government will intervene are their own assessments.
Uitspraken van analisten of andere partijen over het al dan niet ingrijpen van de Chinese overheid zijn hun eigen inschattingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het rapport van Reclaim Finance met de titel ‘Banks fuelling expansion of oil-and-gas Arctic extraction’

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about a Reclaim Finance report showing Dutch banks and investors still fund oil and gas firms active in the Arctic, and whether the government would act on it. Minister Knapen answered that the government opposes Arctic oil and gas exploitation, expects financial institutions to follow OECD and UNGP standards, and will raise the issue in EU and Arctic Council channels, but could not provide an overview of investments or policies and deferred several points.
The cabinet does not have such an overview.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over onduidelijkheid bij gemaakte afspraken door banken inzake het vergoeden van spoofingfraude

An SP MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about unclear bank commitments on compensating spoofing fraud, including the undefined term 'gross negligence' and possible differences between banks. The minister replied that banks use voluntary compensation criteria, that individual banks may be more generous, and that he will raise compensation with the banks again while working on an integrated approach to online fraud.
Given the customer confidentiality that applies to individual cases, I am not familiar with the details of individual spoofing cases and how the different banks have handled them.
Gezien de klantvertrouwelijkheid die geldt rondom individuele gevallen, ben ik niet bekend met de details van individuele spoofinggevallen en hoe deze door de verschillende banken zijn afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het toezicht op de cryptosector

MP Alkaya asked the Minister of Finance about a dispute between the ministry and DNB over supervising the crypto sector, the high costs charged to small crypto firms, the status of a motion on monitoring administrative burden, and how Dutch fees compare with France and the level playing field. The Minister denied a dispute, acknowledged that fees can cause unwanted effects and proposed a reserve for one-off costs, promised to inform the House on the motion by end of the year, and argued Dutch supervision costs are not decisive for FinTech location.
I will therefore, in line with the motion, inform the House no later than July 2022.
Ik zal de Kamer dan ook, conform de motie, uiterlijk in juli 2022 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het gastekort en de exploderende gas- en stroomprijzen

An MP from JA21 asked the government whether it would act immediately to halt rising gas and electricity prices, lower household energy taxes, assess risks to gas supply and jobs, and whether the energy transition and climate policy caused the price surge. The state secretary answered that the government is cutting energy taxes for 2022 but rejects price caps, sees supply security as adequate, attributes high gas prices mainly to global supply and demand factors, and argues the energy transition is part of the solution.
The cabinet has no direct influence over supply tariffs; these are set by the market.
Het kabinet heeft geen directe invloed op de leveringstarieven, deze worden door de markt bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de problemen bij het Chinese vastgoedconcern Evergrande
