MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about the problems at Chinese property developer Evergrande, including missed debt payments and exposure of Dutch banks and pension funds, and the consequences for China and the Dutch economy. The minister answered that direct Dutch exposure is limited, that uncertainty remains about China's economy, and that DNB and others monitor the situation.
Enquiries with DNB show that direct exposures of Dutch banks (and EU banks in general) to Evergrande are limited.
Navraag bij DNB wijst uit dat directe uitzettingen van Nederlandse banken (en EU-banken in het algemeen) op Evergrande beperkt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de vraag waarom de gastarieven voor huishoudens stijgen terwijl de gasvoorraden toch voldoende waren

An MP asked why household gas tariffs are rising when Dutch gas storage was reportedly sufficient, and whether government energy policy leaves households exposed to price volatility. The state secretary answered that gas prices are set on a global market, that the L-gas storage is over 80% full and sufficient for households, and that the government is offering temporary energy-tax relief while monitoring affordability.
With a fill level of over 80%, the L-gas storage facilities on which households depend are more than sufficiently filled for a normal or cold winter.
Met een vulgraad van ruim 80% zijn de L-gasopslagen, waar de huishoudens van afhankelijk zijn ruim voldoende gevuld voor een normale of koude winter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Aanscherping leenregime banken zet boeren in de kou’

MPs Heinen and Van Campen asked whether the planned Basel IV bank capital rules would make financing agricultural investment harder, and what the government was doing about it. The Finance Minister answered that the impact depends on how the EU implements the rules and on banks' choices, that talks with banks and DNB have taken place, and that the Commission's proposal and impact analysis will be awaited before the government sets its position.
The cabinet acknowledges the importance of ensuring that agricultural sector financing remains guaranteed now and in the future.
Het kabinet erkent het belang dat de financierbaarheid van de agrarische sector nu en in de toekomst gewaarborgd blijft
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Hoge leeftijd mag toegang tot krediet niet blokkeren?’

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether banks unilaterally tighten credit terms when customers reach an older age, and whether this amounts to age discrimination, asking for supervision and possible legal measures. The minister answers that banks may adjust terms on age-linked income changes if agreed in advance and customers are informed, that supervisors (AFM, DNB) oversee conduct and complaints go to Kifid or civil courts, and sees no need for legal measures.
I therefore ask banks to look together with the customer at what is still possible based on the individual situation.
Ik vraag banken dan ook om samen met de klant te kijken wat er wél mogelijk is op basis van de individuele situatie.
Antwoord op vragen Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Banken huilen krokodillentranen om negatieve spaarrente'

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance whether small savers below €100,000 will face negative interest rates, how to view bank profits alongside negative savings rates, and whether banks can be pressed to pass benefits to savers, and asked about anti-money-laundering costs and Denmark's threshold. Minister Hoekstra answered that he will reconsider legislation if savers' options at non-negative-rate banks become significantly limited, that banks are private and set their own pricing, and that he will share an updated DNB report on the low-rate environment.
If those options are significantly restricted, I will take up the matter again and consider legislation, where appropriate.
Indien die mogelijkheden significant worden beperkt neem ik het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand en overweeg ik, indien opportuun, ook wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Alkaya over de gebrekkige compensatieregeling voor woekerrentes van ABN AMRO

Parliamentarian Alkaya (SP) asked the Minister of Finance why ABN AMRO's compensation scheme for usurious interest on consumer credit is inadequate, whether the state as major shareholder can intervene, and whether the final release clause should be dropped. The Minister answered that compensation is a matter for the bank and Kifid or the courts, that the state as certificate holder has no insight into individual client files, and that he welcomes the scheme agreed with the Consumentenbond Claimservice while leaving the choice to clients.
It is not for me to assess a compensation scheme.
Het is niet aan mij om een compensatieregeling te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Wordt Evergrande China’s Lehman Brothers’

MPs Heinen and Brekelmans asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the risks of the Evergrande debt problems for Chinese and global financial markets, Dutch institutions and Dutch crisis scenarios, and about contact with China. Minister Hoekstra answered that risks are mainly contained in China with limited direct Dutch exposure, outlined DNB and CPB scenario analyses, and said there was no reason yet to contact China beyond FSB discussions.
My ministry has no insight into individual (foreign) exposures of Dutch institutions.
Mijn ministerie heeft geen inzicht in individuele (buitenlandse) blootstellingen van Nederlandse instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de opmars van ondergronds bankieren

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the rise of underground hawala banking, its size, police capacity to trace it, and international action. Minister Grapperhaus acknowledged the trend, said exact volumes are unknown, described police capacity and international cooperation efforts, and gave no concrete new commitment.
There are no exact figures on the size of underground banking in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen exacte cijfers over de omvang van ondergronds bankieren in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het verloop rond het ontslag van oud-staatssecretaris Mona Keijzer en de afwezigheid van kabinetsleden bij de hoofdelijk stemming over de invoering van de QR-toegangspas

An MP asked several ministers how they were informed of and consented to the dismissal of State Secretary Mona Keijzer, whether the cabinet's rules of procedure were followed, and why a minister was absent from a vote on the QR access pass. The government answered that the dismissal was materially in line with cabinet procedure via consultation with the vice-prime ministers, and that the ministers' disagreements were part of normal cabinet deliberation.
This materially guarantees that the decision was taken in accordance with the sense of the Council of Ministers and does justice to its rules of procedure.
Hiermee is materieel gewaarborgd dat het besluit is genomen in overeenstemming met het gevoelen van de ministerraad en recht gedaan aan het reglement van orde van de ministerraad.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Heinen over het bericht dat Belarus bijna USD1 miljard krijgt toegekend van het Internationaal Monetair Fonds (IMF), in de vorm van speciale trekkingsrechten

MPs Brekelmans and Heinen (VVD) asked why Belarus would receive nearly USD 1 billion in IMF special drawing rights when countries like Venezuela and Myanmar do not, and whether the government would oppose or block this allocation given sanctions. The government answered that the SDR allocation was generic, proportional to quota, and followed IMF procedures recognizing the Belarusian executive, so Belarus is eligible; it said it cannot revoke the allocation for one country and would instead work with partners to limit Belarus's ability to convert SDRs into hard currency, though it made no firm commitment to block conversion.

In contacts with the EU, the US and other international partners, the Netherlands is working to limit as much as possible Belarus's options for converting SDRs, in line with existing sanctions policy.
Nederland zet in contacten met de EU, de VS en andere internationale partners erop in om, in lijn met het staande sanctiebeleid, de mogelijkheden daartoe voor Belarus zoveel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Gezondheidslobby casht jackpot in gokbranche'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked about reports that health-sector organisations such as MIND promoted state-run lotteries, the role of the Nederlandse Loterij, gambling reclame rules, and monitoring of gambling addiction. The government answered most questions substantively, committing to talks with MIND and asking the Kansspelautoriteit to act, while noting data gaps (LADIS not operational) and that some questions fall under other ministries or are commercially confidential.
Regarding the budgeted financial returns of any participation, we do not share information because it may concern commercially sensitive and competition-sensitive business information.
Over begrote financiële opbrengsten van welke deelneming dan ook, delen wij geen informatie omdat dit mogelijk bedrijfs-commerciële en concurrentiegevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over het bericht dat Belarus ongeveer 1 miljard euro ontvangt van het Internationaal Monetair Fonds

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked whether the IMF's SDR allocation to Belarus, its conditions, monitoring and sanctions impact were acceptable given Dutch sanctions. Ministers Hoekstra and Knapen answered that SDR allocations are unconditional and generic, that the Netherlands will try to limit Belarus's ability to convert SDRs on capital markets, and that no reversal of the allocation is planned.

The Netherlands will seek, in line with existing sanctions policy and in contacts with the EU and other international partners, to limit as far as possible Belarus's options to convert SDRs on the capital market.

Nederland zet erop in om, in lijn met het staande sanctiebeleid, in contacten met de EU en andere internationale partners de mogelijkheden voor Belarus om SDR's te verzilveren op de kapitaalmarkt zo veel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het rapport van de Eerlijke Bankwijzer waaruit blijkt dat banken onvoldoende verantwoordelijkheid nemen in de eiwittransitie

An MP asked ministers whether banks are doing enough to finance the protein transition, citing an Eerlijke Bankwijzer report on barriers such as farmer access to capital and vested interests. The minister agrees banks can play a crucial role, points to existing and planned measures, acknowledges voluntary IMVO covenants are insufficient, and says the government will pursue due-diligence rules at EU level or national measures if needed, but declines to set measurable targets for banks yet.
Supplementing and tightening the IMVO measures is therefore necessary.
Aanvulling en aanscherping van de IMVO-maatregelen is daarom nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over schatkistbankieren door zorginstellingen

An MP asks whether care institutions such as youth care providers can join voluntary treasury banking as education institutions can, and whether conditions could be relaxed to shield them from negative interest. The Minister answers that care institutions generally are not statutory-task legal persons and that legal form, care commissioning structure and EU state aid rules preclude participation, so no broader conditions are planned.
Given these criteria and national and European regulations, we also see no possibilities to further broaden the conditions for treasury banking.
Gegeven deze criteria en nationale en Europese regelgeving zien wij ook geen mogelijkheden om de voorwaarden voor het schatkistbankieren verder te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het bericht dat er mogelijk tientallen miljoenen publieke gelden voor coronatesten naar bedrijven in belastingparadijzen zouden zijn gevloeid

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and finance ministers whether public funds for COVID tests reached tax-haven companies, and whether the ministry had acted on information from two entrepreneurs. Minister De Jonge replied that there was no evidence of misuse, that invoices are checked and that the ministry did not investigate because no factual proof was provided.
This conversation gave no reason to investigate whether public money had leaked away, because no factual evidence was presented in the conversation.
Dit gesprek heeft geen aanleiding gegeven om te onderzoeken of publiek geld is weggevloeid, omdat in het gesprek geen feitelijk bewijs is overlegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het Paper ‘Common views on the future of the Stability and Growth Pact’

MP Heinen asked why the position paper on reforming the Stability and Growth Pact, co-signed by the Netherlands, was not in the agenda and was sent only after the debate, and what concrete changes the government considers. Minister Hoekstra answered that the decision to co-sign was taken late once co-signatories were clear, that the paper keeps the same Dutch position, and that the government will inform parliament before deviating from its line.

Should the cabinet intend to take a line in the European debate that deviates from the existing Dutch position, I will of course inform the House Chamber in advance, so that there is an opportunity to exchange views on it.

Mocht het kabinet voornemens zijn om in het Europese debat een lijn te kiezen die afwijkt van de bestaande Nederlandse inzet, dan zal ik de Tweede Kamer vanzelfsprekend voorafgaand hierover informeren, zodat er gelegenheid is om daarover van gedachten te wisselen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht in de Financial Times dat uit onderzoek in opdracht van de Wereldbank blijkt dat de huidige IMF MD personeel heeft gepusht om de ranglijst van China te verbeteren

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the World Bank inquiry finding that IMF chief Georgieva pressed staff to boost China's Doing Business ranking, and whether she should remain in post and whether the Netherlands would raise this in the IMF board. The minister said the methodology allowed outcomes to be adjusted in favour of individual countries, endorsed the report's recommendations, called the allegation serious, and said the IMF Ethics Committee and board would review it, while contact with Dutch constituency countries takes place at the constituency office.
I consider it important that the matter is examined thoroughly by an independent body, and that the Managing Director herself is given the opportunity to respond substantively to the matter.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat grondig naar de zaak wordt gekeken door een onafhankelijk orgaan, en dat Managing Director zelf ook de gelegenheid krijgt om inhoudelijk te reageren op de zaak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch, en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Coronacrisis kost overheid tot dusver al 76,2 miljard euro' en het bericht 'Een vijfde van de coronasteun ging naar bedrijven met omze

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Finance, Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about reports that a fifth of corona support went to firms with year-on-year revenue growth, asking how much support was paid, how much was repaid, and whether firms would be asked to voluntarily repay. The government answered that support was not conditioned on annual revenue loss, estimated the share going to growing firms from partial data (TVL about 9%, NOW about 16% per ESB researchers), reported repayment figures, and committed to informing parliament and to a moral appeal to firms to repay.
Having an annual revenue decline was not a condition for using the generic support measures such as the TVL and NOW schemes.
Het hebben van een omzetdaling op jaarbasis is geen voorwaarde geweest om gebruik te maken van de generieke steunmaatregelen zoals de TVL en de NOW-regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het omzeilen van het provisieverbod door enkele aanbieders van financiële producten

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether a fee-withdrawal facility that lets advisers collect commissions from clients' investment accounts circumvents the commission ban and distorts advice, and whether lijfrente products are treated unequally. The minister answered that the ban allows such facilities under conditions, that the AFM will be consulted on their effects, and that lijfrente account and insurance costs are treated equally.
I will ask the AFM to keep monitoring whether negative side effects arise from investment firms' use of the facility.
Ik zal de AFM vragen om in de gaten te blijven houden of er negatieve bijeffecten optreden als gevolg van het gebruik van de faciliteit door belegginsondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het toezicht op en van advocatenkantoor Houthoff op haar cliënten

The MP asked the ministers whether a major Dutch law firm, Houthoff, was adequately supervised for client due diligence and anti-money-laundering compliance after press reports of weak checks and profit over compliance. The government answered that the firm was inspected in 2019 with no irregularities found beyond administrative recommendations, that supervision lies with the local bar dean and the BFT, and that it is not for the minister to order further investigation.
Houthoff was inspected by the supervisor in 2019 as part of a thematic investigation into law firms' compliance with the Wwft.
Houthoff is in het kader van een thematisch onderzoek naar de naleving van de Wwft door advocatenkantoren in 2019 doorgelicht door de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ouderen in geldproblemen door sluiting bankkantoren: 'Grote stille armoede aan het ontstaan".

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that closures of bank branches and digitalisation are causing financial problems for elderly people, and how many banks and access points remain. The minister acknowledged the signals, pointed to a Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer action plan on accessibility, and said the threshold is accessibility of services rather than a number of branches.
My lower limit therefore lies in the accessibility of the service, not specifically in the number of bank branches.
Mijn ondergrens ligt dan ook in de toegankelijkheid van de dienstverlening, niet specifiek in het aantal bankkantoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘De complotdenker bankiert maar elders, zegt de bank’

An MP asked whether banks may close accounts of clients who spread controversial messages without breaking the law, and how freedom of expression is protected against bank blocking. The government answered that banks act under AML rules, prudential integrity requirements and private contract law, that controversial views alone are insufficient grounds, and that banks must be transparent about reasons and clients can complain to Kifid or the courts, without committing to a concrete new step.
The cabinet therefore considers it important, with a view to freedom of expression, that banks are transparent when they take action based on a breach of their intention.
Het kabinet vindt het daarom, met het oog op de vrijheid van meningsuiting, van belang dat banken transparant zijn als zij actie ondernemen op basis van een overtreding van hun voornemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het onderzoek ‘Grenzeloze Verzorgingsstaat: De gevolgen van Immigratie voor de Overheidsfinanciën’

Dutch MP Eppink asked the Finance Minister whether he endorses a study claiming immigration cost the Dutch budget 400 billion euros over 1995-2019 and whether the government will measure immigration costs. The minister declined to confirm the study's conclusions, arguing the government does not track costs by population group, and refused to add an immigration cost analysis to the 2022 budget documents or commission its own study.
Ik kan deze conclusie niet bevestigen.

Antwoord op van het lid Tony van Dijck over de berichten dat bedrijven voor ruim €4 miljard aan loonsteun moeten terugbetalen en dat dit voor veel ondernemers dreigt uit te draaien op een financiële strop

MP Tony van Dijck asked ministers whether reports that firms must repay over 4 billion euro in NOW wage subsidy, with a risk of financial ruin due to delayed accountant certificates, are accurate, and about the scope of repayments in other Covid schemes and conditions for repayment. The government answered that the repayment estimate is uncertain and partly based on incomplete data, that a 14-week extension is available for accountant and third-party certificates, that repayment terms are generous and interest-free, and that no compensation for accountant costs is planned.
The determination process for the NOW is still ongoing, so it is still unclear how much NOW support will ultimately be paid out.
Het vaststellingsproces van de NOW loopt nog, waardoor het nog onduidelijk is hoeveel NOW-steun er uiteindelijk wordt uitgekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Portugal, België en Luxemburg ontvangen eerste geld EU-herstelfonds'

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility, including the status of the Dutch recovery plan, stakeholder consultation, deadlines and competitiveness effects. Minister Blok answered that the plan will be drafted after the new cabinet decides its content, that consultation with stakeholders will follow, and that the Netherlands still has time to submit before summer 2022.
That is why it was chosen to let the new cabinet decide on the content of the plan.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen om het nieuwe kabinet een besluit te laten nemen over de invulling van het plan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over een exportkredietverzekering voor een baggerschip van IHC in Myanmar

Two MPs (Van Raan and Teunissen, PvdD) asked why the Dutch state gave export credit insurance for an IHC dredger to a Myanmar ministry after the 2021 coup and given the Rohingya genocide allegations, and whether due diligence and the parliamentary motion against such cover were respected. The state secretary answered that the deal was insured before the coup, that the risks were judged acceptable under OECD and IFC standards, that Myanmar's country policy was tightened to exceptional cover in May 2021, and that the insurance was not retroactively withdrawn.
Legally it is not possible to retroactively withdraw a cover commitment as a result of a change in country policy.
Juridisch gezien is het niet mogelijk om met terugwerkende kracht een dekkingstoezegging in te trekken als gevolg van een wijziging van het landenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht ‘ECB geeft zichzelf hoger inflatiedoel’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the ECB's revised inflation target and whether it means longer negative rates, more bond purchases, and effects on Dutch pensions, housing and financial markets. The minister answers that the ECB adopted a symmetric 2% target, that the effects of a looser policy are uncertain, and that the government expects low long-term rates and rising inflation in the Netherlands, with the ECB's policy left to its independent decision.
It is up to the ECB to independently determine which instruments it uses to achieve its price stability mandate.
Het is aan de ECB om in onafhankelijkheid te bepalen welke instrumenten zij inzet om haar mandaat van prijsstabiliteit te bereiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over mogelijke overheidssteun voor Formule 1 races

Two PvdD MPs asked whether the government would rule out financial support for the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, citing earlier promises, the organiser's request for compensation, and fly-past plans. The state secretary answered that the organiser does not qualify for the event guarantee scheme, that no state financial support was given, and that the fly-past was cancelled.
However, the DGP does not meet the requirements of the event guarantee scheme, because the event was not prohibited by the central government.
De DGP voldoet echter niet aan de eisen van de garantieregeling evenementen, omdat het evenement niet door de rijksoverheid is verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over ernstige misstanden bij 'duurzame' palmoliebedrijven in Liberia

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan ask the government about serious abuses on palm oil plantations in Liberia (Golden Veroleum, MOPP) that are linked to RSPO membership and FMO financing, including land grabs, labour and environmental violations, and FMO's due diligence. The minister answers that FMO applies due diligence standards, RSPO is a private initiative outside government, FMO's action plan for SIFCA/MOPP is being monitored with an independent review planned, and the government is pursuing broader mandatory due diligence rules at EU level.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies, including those in the palm oil sector, to apply due diligence in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.

Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven, waaronder bedrijven in de palmoliesector, dat zij gepaste zorgvuldigheid (due diligence) toepassen in lijn met de OESO-Richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over invoeren prijsopdrijvende startersvrijstelling

An MP asks why the government introduced the first-time buyer exemption from transfer tax despite advice from officials and Dialogic reports warning of price effects and inefficiency, and why it did not consult the market. The State Secretary answers that the effect on house prices is too early to judge, that the final design differs from the studied variants, that the scheme was introduced quickly in line with a parliamentary motion, and that a 2024 evaluation will follow.
In 2024 the Act on differentiated transfer tax will be evaluated.
In 2024 zal de Wet differentiatie overdrachtsbelasting worden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de stijgende inflatie en de Europese Centrale Bank

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about rising eurozone inflation, the ECB's bond-buying and low-rate policy, and whether these push up Dutch house prices. The minister answered that the ECB decides its monetary policy independently, that energy prices drive much of the rise and may fade, and that low rates reflect structural factors alongside ECB policy.
It is for the ECB to determine independently which monetary policy measures are needed to achieve its price stability mandate.
Het is verder aan de ECB om in onafhankelijkheid te bepalen welke monetaire beleidsmaatregelen nodig zijn om haar mandaat van prijsstabiliteit te bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht ‘DNB: Amerikaanse BigTech vormt gevaar voor Europese financiële stabiliteit’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about DNB's warning that US BigTech firms threaten European financial stability, including risks from Chinese tech firms, the digital yuan, privacy, cooperation between supervisors, and whether banks must innovate. The minister acknowledged concentration and lock-in risks, pointed to EU proposals (Digital Markets Act, DORA, MiCA) and possible EU-level supervision, but gave no concrete new national oversight step.
The cabinet shares the concerns about the possible concentration of market power of large tech firms in the financial sector as described in both the DNB report and the ACM report.
Het kabinet deelt de zorgen omtrent de mogelijke concentratie van marktmacht van grote techbedrijven in de financiële sector zoals omschreven in zowel het rapport van DNB, als het rapport van de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bikker over de verplichte acceptatie van een coffeeshop door ABN AMRO als klant

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked whether coffee shops buying cannabis in cash fall under the Dutch anti-money-laundering law (Wwft), how many unusual-transaction reports coffee shops filed, whether prosecutions followed, and why supervision differs from other traders. The minister says coffee shops may fall under the Wwft above EUR 10,000 but that Wwft supervision of their soft-drug purchases is not applied in line with the tolerance policy, no coffee shop reports appear in FIU data, and a regulated cannabis supply experiment is planned.
Wwft supervision of coffee shops is carried out in line with the tolerance policy.
Het Wwft-toezicht op coffeeshops wordt in lijn met het gedoogbeleid uitgeoefend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over verzekeraars die wateroverlastschade van ondernemers in Valkenburg niet vergoeden

MP Ploumen asked ministers whether they would compensate Valkenburg business owners whose flood damage is not covered by their insurers, and whether they would press insurers such as Lloyd's to pay. The government answered that it is in contact with the insurers' association, that the Wts disaster compensation scheme can cover damage that is not reasonably insurable, that Lloyd's is mapping its exposure and will report back, and that other schemes are being examined.
Lloyd's will inform the Minister of Finance about the progress of this process.
Lloyd’s zal de Minister van Financiën informeren over de voortgang van dit proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over tegemoetkoming gedupeerden wateroverlastschade Limburg

An MP asked the ministers whether flood victims in Limburg, many not sure their insurer will pay, should get generous support under the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen regardless of water source, and when the scheme's details and advance payments would be clarified. The minister answered that the Wts was declared applicable, that flood damage from the Maas is not reasonably insurable for private persons so they can claim compensation, that the RVO opened a damage reporting form on 9 August, and that advance payments were deferred because they would slow down assessments, with a regulation to follow as soon as possible.
The cabinet decided to declare the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) applicable to the disaster in Limburg.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) van toepassing te verklaren op de ramp in Limburg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het naleven van de Europese privacyregels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) bij (uitvoerings)instanties

An MP asks multiple ministers whether a long list of public bodies (DUO, CBR, SVB, IND, DJI, UWV, OM, FIOD and others) collect and process personal data in line with GDPR, and whether any are not yet compliant. The government replies per organisation, generally stating compliance, while noting ongoing work and specific gaps such as UWV's SONAR system, SVB processes still in development, and CAK access management.
UWV is working hard to comply with the GDPR.
Het UWV werkt hard om aan de AVG te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over banksaldi van overleden dierbaren

An MP asks the Finance Minister about bank practices when releasing deceased relatives' account balances, including inconsistent requirements, mandatory verification via a certificate of inheritance even for small sums, and tying payout to opening an ING account. The minister acknowledges the burden, notes banks set their own policy within reasonableness limits, points to a 2012 NVB form and ongoing industry talks, and says ING is evaluating its practice.
However, I believe this must not come at the expense of people who need or are compelled to handle their banking matters in person.
Ik vind echter dat dit niet ten koste mag gaan van mensen die behoefte hebben of genoodzaakt zijn om hun bankzaken fysiek te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het Stabiliteits- en Groeipact

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether joining Austria's push for a coalition to shape any revision of the Stability and Growth Pact conflicts with the caretaker government's position that substantive stances should be left to the next cabinet, and whether blocs forming between northern and southern member states are undesirable. The minister confirmed the letter from Austria, said the caretaker cabinet stands by its earlier position but that it will still engage in the debate on sound public finances, and that cooperation with other member states should not be ruled out.
The caretaker cabinet stands behind the content of the parliamentary letter 'Broad reflection on the Stability and Growth Pact (SGP)'.
Het demissionaire kabinet staat achter de inhoud van de Kamerbrief «Brede bespiegeling inzake het Stabiliteits- en Groeipact (SGP)»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het essay van Pieter Hasekamp (CPB) in het FD over het in de ban doen van bitcoin

MP Alkaya asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about a CPB director's essay calling for a ban on bitcoin, including whether it is appropriate, whether a national ban is feasible, and whether bitcoin is poor money. Minister Hoekstra answered that the CPB is independent and may publish opinions, that a national ban would be ineffective and only EU-level action could work, and that crypto's volatility, energy use, and money-laundering risks justify MiCA regulation rather than a ban.
The CPB is independent as a planning bureau in terms of content.
Het CPB is als planbureau inhoudelijk onafhankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Aartsen over het bericht 'Booking paste bonusregels aan voor miljoenenbeloning top'

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary about plans for a reception centre for 200 asylum seekers and housing for 400 labour migrants in Deelen, questioning whether residents' concerns about nuisance and crime would be taken into account and whether the plan would be stopped. The State Secretary said talks with the municipality of Ede, COA and the owner are ongoing, that residents' concerns are being addressed in operating agreements, and that she rejects generalising asylum seekers as criminals while welcoming the extra reception capacity.
I dissociate myself from the suggestion that all asylum seekers are guilty of nuisance, crime or terror.
Ik neem afstand van de suggestie dat alle asielzoekers zich schuldig maken aan overlast, criminaliteit of terreur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Stoffer over de gevolgen van het UBO-register voor ondernemers, kerken en goede doelen

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about costs of the UBO register for entrepreneurs, churches and charities, the handling of ANBI board members, and privacy risks. The government answered in detail, describing registration costs, a planned explanatory note on ANBI board members, and measures against scraping and privacy leaks.
To implement the Bruins motion, consultation with SBF examined ways to clarify the position of ANBI (charity) board members.
Ter uitvoering van de motie-Bruins is in goed overleg met SBF bezien welke mogelijkheden er zijn om de positie van (bestuurders van) ANBI's te verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over winsten die worden gemaakt met publiek geld voor verduurzaming

SP MPs asked the government about private profits from publicly subsidised wind and solar, electricity bills, overcompensation under the SDE+ scheme, and the Court of Audit's findings. The State Secretary maintained that overwinsten are limited by the tender design and PBL cost estimates, committed to a new evaluation and to monitoring participation, but refused to quantify private profits and rejected socialising renewable energy.
I have no direct insight into the amount of private profit made with SDE+ subsidies.
Ik heb geen direct inzicht in de hoeveelheid private winst die is gemaakt met SDE+-subsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink naar aanleiding van het bericht uit het Financieele Dagblad over de winstgevendheid van banken in het klimaat van lage rentes

An MP from JA21 asked the Finance Minister whether low interest rates squeeze Dutch bank margins, whether banks are taking excessive risks in search of yield, and whether European bank consolidation should be prepared for. The minister acknowledged margin pressure and a dilemma for banks, said prudential rules and supervisors can address excessive risk, and said consolidation is hard to predict and should be watched by supervisors and competition authorities.
I will continue to monitor this topic closely and, in answer to written questions from Van Dijk (CDA), have asked DNB to update its 2019 report on negative interest rates.
Ik blijf dit onderwerp dan ook nauwgezet volgen en heb in antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van Van Dijk (CDA) 5 aan DNB gevraagd haar rapportage over negatieve rente uit 2019 te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat ABN AMRO kosten in rekening gaat brengen voor opname van contant geld

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO's plan to charge fees for large cash withdrawals (above EUR 12,000 a year) is acceptable, and whether banks should be barred from charging for cash withdrawals of their own customers' money. The minister answered that the fee is ABN AMRO's own decision, that a DNB-commissioned study on cash infrastructure is pending, and that concrete measures will be decided only after its results, without committing to a ban.
A study commissioned by De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) is currently underway into what the cash infrastructure should look like in the future and what its costs would be.
Momenteel loopt er in opdracht van De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) een onderzoek naar hoe de infrastructuur voor contant geld er in de toekomst uit moet zien en wat de kosten hiervan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht 'NS schrapt 341 banen; station zonder personeel wordt de norm'

SP MPs asked the government about news that NS would cut 341 station staff jobs, questioning whether this conflicts with its stated view that staff are essential and whether volunteers or temporary agency workers are displacing paid work. The minister and state secretary answered that NS decides its own staffing, cites falling counter sales and online ticketing, says safety is covered by camera monitoring and concession obligations, and commits only to help affected staff find other work within NS.
It is up to NS to determine where NS can deploy its personnel most effectively, taking into account the changing needs of travellers.
Het is aan NS om te bepalen waar NS haar personeel het meest effectief kan inzetten, waarbij NS rekening houdt met de veranderende behoefte van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Beruchte NSB’ers kochten Joodse huizen op in Arnhem’

Two PVV MPs asked ministers about reports that NSB members bought up Jewish houses in Arnhem during the war, asking how much property Arnhem seized, for a full restitution overview, for restitution of looted property, and for investigation of municipal and professional roles. The government answered that Arnhem's own investigation is ongoing, that no federal additional research or restitution is planned, and that post-war restitution was already addressed through the 2000 compensation fund.
This investigation is complex because much administration was lost, partly due to the destruction of Arnhem in the last year of the war.
Dit onderzoek is complex, omdat veel administratie verloren is gegaan, onder meer door de verwoesting van Arnhem in het laatste oorlogsjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Nederlands pensioengeld betrokken bij illegale veehandel en ontbossing Amazone’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance Minister whether ABP, a public-sector pension fund that signed the IMVB covenant, should stop financing deforestation linked to meat supplier JBS, and how this fits government biodiversity policy. The government answered that investment decisions and engagement are the responsibility of individual pension funds, that it expects them to follow OECD and UNGP standards, and that it is pursuing a due diligence obligation at EU level.

How individual pension funds give effect to compliance with these international guidelines, and which companies they invest in or not, is the responsibility and choice of the individual pension funds.

Hoe individuele pensioenfondsen invulling geven aan de naleving van deze internationale richtlijnen en in welke bedrijven zij wel of niet investeren is de verantwoordelijkheid en keuze van de individuele pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Paul over de brief van de regering over de bekostiging van investeringsvoorstellen uit het Nationaal Groeifonds

Two VVD MPs asked how regional balance was ensured in Groeifonds investment allocations, why the advisory commission rejected the Rotterdam–Chemelot pipeline proposal, what the Flemish Antwerp–Chemelot pipeline consultation means for Rotterdam's competitiveness, and whether the government will act on the commission's advice for a pipeline bundle. The government answered that regional spread is not a goal in itself but a consideration, that the commission advised independently, that a Rotterdam-led follow-up study is underway with IenW, and that it endorses making capacity available but it is too early to commit budget.
The fund managers do not interfere in the commission's substantive weighing of proposals, in order to safeguard the commission's independent role.
De fondsbeheerders mengen zich niet in de inhoudelijke weging van voorstellen door de commissie, om zo de onafhankelijke rol van de commissie te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en van der Lee over duurzaamheidsrisico’s van staatsobligaties

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked the Finance and other ministers about the climate and sustainability risks of sovereign bonds, transparency on those risks, and how Nederland compares internationally on green recovery spending. The government answered that it supports transparency and integrating climate risks into IMF and World Bank debt analyses, that no current sovereign debt runs past 2060 and climate risks do not yet directly affect Dutch creditworthiness, and that it will raise climate risks more proactively with investors.
The Agency will therefore also proactively address climate risks and how the Netherlands tackles them in future presentations to prospective investors.
Het Agentschap zal daarom ook in de toekomst proactief in de presentaties voor beoogde investeerders aandacht besteden aan klimaatrisico’s en de wijze waarop Nederland deze risico’s adresseert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over negatieve rentes voor particulieren

MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about negative interest rates on private savings after ING announced charging negative rates on balances above 100,000 euro, asking about trust, alternatives for savers, reasonable thresholds, a statutory ban and effects on schools, hospitals and non-profits. The minister answered that no negative rate is currently charged to ordinary savers, that DNB advised against a legal ban on balance thresholds for economic and monetary policy reasons, and that he is reluctant to engage banks on pricing given competition rules.
Should those options in future be significantly restricted, I will take up the subject again and consider legislation where appropriate.
Mochten die mogelijkheden in de toekomst significant worden beperkt, dan neem ik het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand en overweeg ik indien opportuun ook wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat banken negatieve rente voor kleinere spaarders niet uitsluiten

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether he would act, cooperate with the ECB, or legislate a ban so that banks cannot impose negative interest on small savers after reports that they no longer exclude this. The minister answered that negative rates are not currently charged to ordinary savers, that the ECB is independent, and that a legal ban is not necessary or proportionate now, though he would revisit legislation if options for savers became significantly limited.
Should those options be significantly restricted in the future, I will take up the matter again and, where appropriate, consider legislation.
Mochten die mogelijkheden in de toekomst significant worden beperkt dan zal ik het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand nemen, en indien opportuun ook wetgeving overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Banken sluiten negatieve rente voor kleinere spaarders niet uit’

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asks the Finance Minister about banks possibly charging negative interest to small savers, the government's role, state-owned bank options, margins, and whether a ban is needed. The minister answers that most savers face no negative rate, DNB is updating its analysis, and a legal ban is not proportionate at present, though legislation will be reconsidered if options for ordinary savers significantly narrow.
Should those options significantly narrow in the future, I will take up the subject again and, where appropriate, consider legislation.
Mochten die mogelijkheden in de toekomst significant worden beperkt dan zal ik het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand nemen, en indien opportuun ook wetgeving overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over negatieve spaarrente

An MP from JA21 asked the Finance Minister about the risk of negative savings rates, whether Belgium-style bans or thresholds should be introduced, tax deductibility, capital flight, pension sector risks and why savers should bear the cost. The minister answered that negative rates are not yet applied to ordinary savers, that DNB sees no signs of large deposit outflows, that a legal ban has mostly disadvantages, and that he will monitor developments and update DNB's analysis this summer.
As I explained above, by far most savers currently do not face a negative interest rate.
Zoals ik hiervoor heb toegelicht hebben veruit de meeste spaarders op dit moment niet te maken met een negatieve rente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over schadelijke beleggingen van pensioenfondsen

An MP from GroenLinks asks ministers whether pension funds investing in harmful sectors such as weapons, alcohol, cannabis and firms linked to land rights violations breach statutory duties on sustainability and beneficiary preferences, and whether the IMVB covenant is adequate. The minister replies that funds decide their own investments, points to the IMVB covenant, the Pensioenwet and IORP II reporting duties, and EU non-financial reporting reform, and promises no new binding measures.
Pension funds decide for themselves what they invest in; the cabinet does not decide that.
Pensioenfondsen bepalen zelf waarin zij beleggen, daar gaat het kabinet niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de miljoenenboete voor ABN AMRO vanwege ernstige langdurige tekortkomingen bij het bestrijden van witwassen

An MP (D66) asks the Minister of Finance about the 480 million euro fine on ABN AMRO for serious, long-running anti-money-laundering failures, including what the minister meant by the OM's findings and whether DNB's Wwft supervision will be explained, and how often the state shareholder NLFI, the ministry and the bank's boards discussed compliance. The minister answers that the findings are painful, that DNB will be asked for an explanation and a letter will follow, and that exact meeting counts cannot be reconstructed, while describing NLFI's and the ministry's contacts with the bank and the bank's remediation steps.
It is up to NLFI to determine what contact (and what intensity) is appropriate and necessary for carrying out its role as shareholder in ABN AMRO.
Het is aan NLFI om te bepalen welk contact (en welke intensiteit) passend en noodzakelijk is voor de uitvoering van haar rol als aandeelhouder in ABN AMRO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht ‘Witwasboete van €480 miljoen voor ABN AMRO’

MPs Heinen (VVD) asked the Finance Minister about the status of the anti-money-laundering action plan, bank obstacles to data sharing and privacy limits, TMNL transaction monitoring, and whether the ABN AMRO fine would hit dividends and taxpayers. The minister answered that the 49-measure plan is largely implemented but remains ongoing, outlined data-sharing legal bases and the AP's limits on UBO-register access, described TMNL as a private initiative, and said the fine goes to the treasury though dividend impact cannot be guaranteed.
The plan cannot in addition be seen as a conclusion of the anti-money-laundering policy.
Het plan kan daarnaast niet gezien worden als een afronding van het anti-witwasbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Woude over het opnemen van studieschulden in het BKR-register

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Woude asked whether student debts would be registered with the BKR credit register, as the AFM proposed, and whether the government would keep its promise not to do so. The minister answered that the government will not move to BKR registration of student loans, noting that lenders can already verify loans via Mijn DUO and that student loans have different social repayment terms.
Yes, the cabinet will not proceed with BKR registration for student debts.
Ja, het kabinet gaat niet over tot een BKR-registratie voor studieschulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de situatie bij de Volksbank

The MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister about governance problems at the state-owned Volksbank, including a supervisory report on board dynamics, the minister's knowledge of it, his passive stance, and delays in NLFI's progress reports. The minister answers that the report was confidential and not shared with him or NLFI, that board and supervisory board changes are underway, and that a new NLFI report is expected around summer.
Supervisory authority reports are confidential under supervision.
Rapportages van de toezichthouder zijn toezichtsvertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Snels, Inge van Dijk en Grinwis over de noodzaak om zo snel als mogelijk financiële instellingen verplichten over klimaatrisico’s te rapporteren

MPs asked the Finance Minister about speeding up mandatory climate-risk reporting by financial institutions, including the TCFD framework, its alignment with the EU's proposed revision of the non-financial reporting directive, and the timing of EU and IFRS standards. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports EU-level harmonisation over a national patchwork, and that it will assess the Commission proposal via a BNC-fiche and pursue international convergence rather than launch national legislation now.
The cabinet wants to work towards a swift and prompt completion of the European process and its implementation in our national laws and regulations.
Het kabinet wil zich inzetten voor een voortvarende en spoedige afronding van het Europese traject en implementatie daarvan in onze nationale wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt hebben gesteld over de witwaspraktijken bij ING

MPs Slootweg and Omtzigt asked the Finance and Justice ministers about money-laundering practices at ING, including whether DNB re-tested the top leadership's fitness after the settlement, what conditions attached to the state capital injection, what DNB, ECB or prosecutors told ING's board, and whether ING's compliance department was cut. The minister declined to comment on individual prosecution and supervisory matters, citing supervisory confidentiality, and said the archive shows no such letters to the ministry, while promising to check officials' mailboxes and report back.

Under the legally anchored supervisory confidentiality, the competent supervisor cannot and may not make statements, not even to me, on whether re-testing in individual cases was considered, takes place or has taken place.

Op grond van de wettelijk verankerde toezichtsvertrouwelijkheid kan en mag de bevoegde toezichthouder geen uitspraken doen, ook niet naar mij, over de vraag of hertoetsing in individuele gevallen is overwogen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het aanwenden van zijn invloed, als gevolg van de staatsdeelneming Schiphol, om de behandeling van de aangevraagde natuurvergunning voor Lelystad Airport op te schorten

MP Van Raan asked whether the state, as shareholder of Schiphol, could pressure the Lelystad Airport permit applicant to accept a delay in the nature permit so that the House's controversial-declaration request not to take irreversible steps is respected. The government answered that operational permit matters are the responsibility of Schiphol's management, that shareholders have no direct role, and that the permit concerns legal ecological criteria rather than political decisions requiring parliamentary involvement.
There would only have been a disregard of a controversial declaration if the decision-making involved political considerations and parliament had involvement.

Er zou echter pas sprake zijn geweest van het negeren van een controversieel-verklaring als het besluitvorming zou betreffen waarbij politieke afwegingen een rol spelen en het parlement betrokkenheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ABN Amro, dat klanten teveel rente liet betalen over hun doorlopend krediet

MPs Nijboer asked the Finance Minister how ABN Amro could keep variable interest on a credit line out of step with market rates, after a Kifid appeals ruling, and what consumers, the bank, and the minister would do about compensation, a possible law change, and wider investigation. The minister answered that no specific rules govern how banks set variable rates beyond disclosure duties, that the ruling obliges ABN Amro to recalculate and refund, that compensation and the bank's conduct are matters for the bank, Kifid and courts, and that he will monitor developments and talk with lenders.
The consequence of this ruling is that the credit provider must recalculate for the consumer concerned how much interest was owed on his or her revolving credit.
Het gevolg van deze uitspraak is dat de kredietverstrekker voor de betrokken consument opnieuw moet berekenen hoeveel rente verschuldigd was over zijn of haar doorlopend krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat de topman van Air France-KLM een bonus van twee miljoen euro ontvangt

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister about a 2 million euro share bonus for the Air France-KLM CEO, whether it fits the state aid conditions, and about dismissals, pay cuts and flexible staffing at KLM. The minister says the bonus is unacceptable in a crisis, that the aid conditions suspend bonuses at KLM but not the parent company, and that the government has conveyed its position to the company, while leaving the details of KLM's employment terms to its management and unions.
The support package stipulates that during the period of support the variable remuneration (bonus) for the board and top management of KLM is suspended.
In het steunpakket is bepaald dat gedurende de steun de variabele beloning (bonus) voor het bestuur en top management van KLM wordt opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Miljoenenbonus topman Air France KLM, ondanks recordverlies en staatssteun’

MPs Heinen and Michon-Derkzen asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether a large bonus for the Air France-KLM chief, despite record losses and state aid, conflicts with state-aid conditions and their own letters suspending bonuses. Minister Hoekstra answered that the bonus is not linked to arranging wage support, that bonuses are unacceptable in this crisis, that the suspension applies to KLM as recipient, and that the European Commission must enforce the Temporary Framework, with the Economic Affairs minister to probe for possible further tightening.
I have informed the company that I am not happy with the suggestion created and that this gives an incorrect picture.
Ik heb aan de onderneming laten weten niet gelukkig te zijn met de gewekte suggestie en dat dit een onjuist beeld geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Bromet over de schuldbekentenis van de Rabobank

GroenLinks MPs Snels and Bromet asked ministers how banks financing intensive agriculture share responsibility for unsustainable farming, for insufficient disclosure of transition risks, and for blocking farmers' green transition, following a Zembla broadcast. The ministers answered that all agricultural chain parties share responsibility, that banks must consider foreseeable risks, that they call on financiers to act, and that new public instruments such as an investment fund and working-capital scheme are being developed.
I call on Rabobank, and also on the other financial institutions active in the agri-sector, to explicitly take on their role in financing the transition to more sustainable agriculture.

Ik roep de Rabobank, en ook de andere financiële instellingen die actief zijn in de agrosector, op om hun rol in de financiering van de omschakeling naar een duurzamere landbouw nadrukkelijk op zich te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de Rabobank die erkent dat het landbouwsysteem failliet is, maar verandering tegenwerkt,

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked the ministers about Rabobank acknowledging co-responsibility for agricultural problems while allegedly resisting change, and about financing barriers for farmers seeking sustainable transition and the use of subsidies that may flow to banks. The minister acknowledged shared responsibility of financiers, pointed to voluntary initiatives, the Omschakelprogramma and Investeringsfonds, the SER exploration, and declined to pursue additional legislation or new reporting, leaving banks' lending decisions to them.
I do not intend to work towards an additional reporting cycle at company level, but I consider it very important to have good insight into developments in this area.
Ik ben niet voornemens naar een additionele rapportagecyclus op bedrijfsniveau toe te werken, maar ik vind het wel heel belangrijk om goed inzicht te hebben in de ontwikkelingen op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over slapende rekeningen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about dormant bank accounts, including the seven-year record-keeping rule, the twenty-year limitation period after which funds may fall to banks or the State, and whether banks should trace owners and return funds. The minister replied that existing rules suffice, that the seven-year retention period does not apply to dormant accounts, that funds are paid out on proof of ownership, and that a covenant on unclaimed estates with the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is nearing completion.
There is no central administration of banks' efforts regarding dormant accounts.
Er bestaat geen centrale administratie van de inspanningen van banken ten aanzien van slapende rekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Schonis, Bruins en Van der Graaf over de jaarcijfers 2020 van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen gepresenteerd op 25 februari 2021

MPs from D66 and the ChristenUnie asked the Finance Minister about NS's 2020 losses, planned cost cuts, state support and the public-transport concession. The Minister answered that talks with NS on financial support are ongoing, that the availability fee has been extended to end-2021, and that he will inform parliament once concrete results exist.
As indicated in the answer to question 11, the talks are still ongoing. If these have produced concrete results, I will inform your House of them as already promised.
Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 11 lopen de gesprekken nog. Als deze concrete resultaten hebben opgeleverd zal ik uw Kamer zoals reeds toegezegd daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het bericht ‘Hoekstra: NS zal ‘op termijn’ minder moeten gaan rijden’

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked why the Finance Minister says NS (Dutch Railways) must run fewer trains when more sustainable public transport is needed, and why Air France-KLM is not held to the same standard, including whether a motion on capacity growth is being implemented. The minister answers that NS faces financial pressure from COVID-19, that a public-transport availability fee has been extended to end-2021, that talks on further support and a post-2021 scheme are ongoing, and that Air France-KLM is not bound by concession obligations, but gives largely general answers without committing to specific new steps beyond continued consultation.
In doing so we look at what NS can do itself, and at what the shareholder and concession authority can do.
Daarbij kijken we naar wat NS zelf kan doen, en naar wat de aandeelhouder en concessieverlener kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over ‘de compensatie van Shell en Exxon voor het verlagen van de gaswinning’

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether Shell and ExxonMobil received at least 1.5 billion euros in compensation for the Groningen gas closure, and pressed on the NAM's payments for damage and reinforcement costs, the stuwmeer scheme, the Norg storage dispute and possible taxation of the oil companies. The minister denied the 1.5 billion figure, said the profit-split change was about 1.3 billion for 2018-2023 but much lower in practice, and explained the cost recovery from NAM and the ongoing arbitration, while declining to disclose commercially confidential information and promising to inform parliament on a levy.
All agreements with Shell, ExxonMobil or the NAM are public, except for commercially confidential information.
Alle overeenkomsten met Shell, ExxonMobil of de NAM zijn, behoudens bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie, openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘Kabinet maakt vertrouwelijke notulen ministerraad openbaar.’

Volt MP Dassen asked whether the ministers of Finance and Foreign Trade, who also sit in parliament, would take part in the urgent debate on publicised cabinet minutes, and how this dual role affects the separation of power and countervailing power amid the childcare benefits scandal. The government answered that the dual role is permissible under article 57(3) of the Constitution during the caretaker period, that the questions about party-group deliberations cannot be answered by the cabinet, and that the ministers will participate in the debate as cabinet members.

Parliamentary questions are addressed to members of the cabinet. Questions concerning meetings of parliamentary party groups cannot be answered by the cabinet and must be raised in the parliamentary debate.
Kamervragen worden gesteld aan leden van het kabinet. Vragen die zien op de vergaderingen van Kamerfracties, kunnen niet door het kabinet beantwoord worden en moeten gesteld worden in het Kamerdebat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Amsterdam stoot Londen van de troon als Europees handelscentrum’

MPs Groothuizen asked whether the shift of share trading from London to Amsterdam raises the risk of illicit money entering the Dutch capital market, and about the FIOD's leadership and innovation. The government answered that AFM supervision and anti-money-laundering rules cover trading venues, that no signals of increased laundering have been received, that an interim director has led the FIOD since February 2021, and that anti-laundering measures continue.
The AFM therefore indicates that possible money-laundering risks are sufficiently covered by this and that there is sufficient insight into these risks.
De AFM geeft daarom aan dat hiermee mogelijke witwasrisico’s voldoende ondervangen zijn en dat er hiermee voldoende zicht bestaat op deze risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst weer op zijn kop werd gezet

The MP asks why the Minister of Finance decided to split the Belastingdienst into separate Douane, Toeslagen and Belastingdienst organisations, on what advice, how workers were involved, and whether the promised feasibility test will be sent to parliament. The government answers that the split improves focus and span of control, relies on earlier reports, involves staff in working groups, and promises feasibility tests in Q2 2021, while stating that ministerial responsibility for the Belastingdienst is shared with the state secretaries.
Once the feasibility tests have been carried out, we will inform your House of the results and send the tests to the House.
Wanneer de haalbaarheidstoetsen zijn uitgevoerd zullen wij uw Kamer over de resultaten van deze toetsen informeren en de toetsen aan de Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht 'KLM maakt werk van pakketreizen, touroperators boos: ‘Dit mag de overheid nooit toelaten’'

An MP asked whether the state, as a 6% shareholder and creditor-supported rescue provider of KLM, should accept KLM's acquisition of a majority stake in AirTrade while it depends on state aid, and about the moral and state-aid implications including possible double support via BCD Group. The minister answered that acquisitions are a matter for KLM's board under Dutch corporate law, that Finance was only informed in outline as the aid conditions required, that the state agent was not informed, and that acquisition costs are for the parties to disclose.
The state agent was not informed by KLM and not involved in the decision-making on this acquisition.
De staatsagent is door KLM niet geïnformeerd en betrokken bij de besluitvorming over deze acquisitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over 'onduidelijkheid bij gemaakte afspraken door banken inzake het vergoeden van spoofingfraude'

MP Van Nispen asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the current state of compensation for spoofing fraud victims, the banks' agreement on what counts as gross negligence, and whether differing bank assessments are acceptable. The minister answered that banks have compensated about 96% of telephone-number spoofing cases, that a joint framework defining gross negligence is being finalised, and that a further letter will follow in May.
To be able to assess future cases of spoofing properly, it is important that the banks quickly establish the definition of the coulance assessment criteria.
Om ook toekomstige gevallen van spoofing goed te kunnen beoordelen is het belangrijk dat de banken snel de definitie van de toetsingscriteria voor coulance vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Banken draaien duimschroeven mkb’er strakker aan in tweede lockdown'

MPs Van der Linde, Lodders and Aukje de Vries (VVD) asked whether banks are becoming less willing to finance SMEs during the second lockdown, what this means for post-crisis credit, and what the government is doing to improve bank lending and use of guarantee schemes. The minister answered that banks report limited additional credit demand, that prudential rules are not seen as blocking lending, that ministries and banks meet regularly and agreed joint action, and that guarantee uptake lags initial forecasts for some schemes while the government promises further steps such as a fiscal review of equity versus debt financing.
No formally adopted minutes are drawn up of the administrative consultation with the banks, which is chaired by EZK.
Van het bestuurlijk overleg met de banken, dat wordt voorgezeten door EZK, worden geen formeel vastgestelde verslagen opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Leijten over fraude met tegemoetkoming vaste lasten-subsidie

SP MPs asked the government about suspected fraud with the TVL fixed-cost subsidy, including suspicious bank transactions, the number of FIOD-handled reports, weak controls and the use of dormant company registrations. The State Secretary answered that the government is in close contact with FIU-Nederland, the FIOD and banks, has tightened risk controls and checks against tax data, and will revoke subsidies, file reports and seize accounts where fraud is confirmed, while withholding some figures pending ongoing investigations.
The investigation into the reports is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de meldingen loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over het transparantiebeleid van ontwikkelingsbank FMO en door FMO gefinancierde misstanden in de Democratische Republiek Congo

MPs Van Raan and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked about FMO's transparency policy and alleged abuses (land rights, wages, complaints handling) linked to the Feronia-PHC palm oil plantations in DR Congo. The minister's answers largely describe FMO's ESAP, debt write-down conditions, the complaints mechanism process and monitoring, while declining to share the confidential due diligence report and stating there is no list of companies guilty of land grabbing.
This study contains confidential business information and for legal reasons FMO cannot share or publish this document.
Dit onderzoek bevat bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en om juridische redenen kan FMO dit document niet delen of openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over werkzaamheden onder Europese aanbestedingsregels bij Schiphol

D66 MP Van Weyenberg asked ministers whether Schiphol's security tendering under EU rules, with contracts of at least four years and a change of providers in December 2020, shifts the collapse in passenger-related demand onto security firms who cannot claim the NOW wage subsidy, and whether Schiphol as a state-owned company should take responsibility. The ministers answered that Schiphol handled the tender and rebalancing under EU rules, that the NOW wage subsidy does not cover staff not on the payroll and the firms' eligibility rules apply, and that Schiphol says security remains adequately guaranteed and works with the firms to manage capacity risks.
Schiphol tenders the work under the European procurement rules and thereby takes responsibility for properly tendering the security work at Schiphol, as may be expected of a state-owned company.

Schiphol besteedt de werkzaamheden aan via de Europese aanbestedingsregels en neemt daarmee de verantwoordelijkheid voor het juist aanbesteden van de beveiligingswerkzaamheden op Schiphol zoals van een staatsdeelneming mag worden verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het terugtrekken van Nederlandse banken uit de BES-eilanden

Diertens (D66) asked whether ABN AMRO's plan to close euro accounts held by residents of the Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba) affects access to banking, and whether residents have a right to a basic payment account. The minister confirmed the risk of higher costs, said residents have no EU basic-account right as overseas territories, and reported ongoing talks with banks and a planned regulatory change to ease euro account offerings.
I am therefore preparing an amendment to the Besluit financiële markten BES so that Dutch European banks may offer payment accounts in the Caribbean Netherlands without an additional licence.
Ik bereid daarom een wijziging van het Besluit financiële markten BES voor waardoor Europees Nederlandse banken betaalrekeningen in Caribisch Nederland mogen aanbieden zonder extra vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en van der Linde over het bericht ‘Ook ING stopt met inning coronasteun uit VS’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister why Dutch banks stopped cashing US COVID stimulus cheques for dual nationals and why the US-Dutch FATCA reciprocity commitment has not been met. The minister said the cheques can be claimed back via a US tax Recovery Rebate Credit, that banks are free to stop offering services such as cheque cashing, and that he keeps raising reciprocity with the US and European partners.
I remain in discussion with the US embassy on this subject.
Ik blijf in gesprek met de Amerikaanse ambassade over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat nog altijd flitskredieten tegen torenhoge kosten worden aangeboden

An MP asks the Finance Minister about flash-credit firm Ferratum charging fees above the legal 10% maximum, asking why the AFM has not acted, whether this is criminal, and about municipal credit banks. The minister replies that the maximum applies to all fees including guarantee costs, the AFM is bound by secrecy and must decide itself on enforcement, criminal prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and EU rules limit national action on cross-border online lenders.
The AFM cannot provide information about individual parties and is bound by the statutory duty of confidentiality.
De AFM kan geen informatie over individuele partijen verstrekken en is gebonden aan de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over het bericht 'De computer mag de taxateur straks niet meer vervangen bij bepalen waarde woning'

Two MPs from the VVD asked about reports that the EBA guidelines will bar purely computer-generated valuations for mortgages, raising concerns about higher costs and longer waiting times. The Minister of Finance answered that a hybrid valuation (model checked by a valuer) will remain permitted, that cost and duration effects are expected to be limited, and that DNB and the ECB will decide how to apply the guidelines in supervision.
It is for DNB and the ECB, as independent and autonomous authorities, to determine how they will apply the guidelines in supervision.
Het is aan DNB en de ECB als zelfstandige en onafhankelijke autoriteiten om te bepalen hoe zij de richtsnoeren zullen toepassen in het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over ING als huisbankier van de overheid

MP Van Raan asks the Finance Minister how the tender that awarded ING the government's current-account banking contract applied sustainability criteria, and whether ING's climate, human-rights and sustainability record was weighed given its financing of controversial sectors and clients. The minister replies that MVO criteria carried 24% of quality points, that ING met the sustainability threshold on external ratings, and that the government will keep engaging the financial sector on climate commitments without committing to specific sanctions on ING.
In a tender, the information bidders provide and its assessment are confidential.
In een aanbesteding heeft de informatie die de inschrijvers bieden en de beoordeling hiervan een vertrouwelijk karakter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de invloed van de negatieve rente op zorg- en onderwijsinstellingen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about negative interest rates costing care and education institutions money and whether public funds could be shifted to the state treasury. The minister said there is no data on care institutions' negative-rate costs, that banks set their own rates, and that education institutions can voluntarily bank with the treasury, while refusing to open talks with banks on pricing.
There is no insight into the costs that care institutions in the Netherlands incur from negative interest.
Er is geen inzicht in de kosten die zorginstellingen in Nederland kwijt zijn aan negatieve rente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Subsidie voor fossiele brandstoffen ongekend groot’

An MP asks the ministers why the government's estimate of 4.5 billion euro in annual fossil fuel subsidies differs from an article's estimate of 17.5 billion, and what it will do about fiscal stimulation of fossil energy use. The minister answers that CBS data cannot be used one-to-one because it requires arbitrary benchmark choices, that the 4.5 billion figure is incomplete but not distorted, and that the government intends to phase out such incentives, with reviews of energy tax and renewable levy pending and decisions left partly to a new cabinet.
In addition, several national processes are currently underway in which the financial incentives relating to fossil fuels are being examined.
Daarnaast lopen er op dit moment meerdere nationale trajecten waarin de financiële prikkels met betrekking tot fossiele brandstoffen worden bekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het IMVB-convenant Pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the ministers about the slow implementation of the IMVB pension fund covenant, including the monitoring commission's findings, passive investments and accountability. The minister acknowledged the shortfall, attributed it partly to the late toolkit, promised an action plan and enhanced support, and said the covenant has no legal consequences.
Failing to meet the agreed commitments has no legal consequences.
Het niet halen van vastgelegde afspraken heeft geen juridische consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over toezicht op grondspeculanten

An MP asked ministers about oversight of land speculators, notaries' duties, AFM supervision and fragmentation of land ownership after reports of disputes over dubious land deals. The government answered that existing consumer law, notarial duties and AFM rules apply, that no new oversight is needed, and that the Wet beleggingsobjecten decision is left to the next cabinet.

From the statutory framework and the professional body's regulations in general, and from the disciplinary procedure in particular, it cannot be inferred that the role of notaries (in general) in pointing out risks in land transactions needs improvement.

Uit de wettelijke regeling en de verordeningen van de beroepsorganisatie in het algemeen en uit de tuchtprocedure in het bijzonder valt dan ook niet te herleiden dat de rol van notarissen (in het algemeen) bij het wijzen op risico's bij grondtransacties verbetering behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs, Sneller en Schonis over het bericht 'Particuliere beleggers slepen notarissen voor de rechter vanwege rol in dubieuze grondhandel'

MPs asked whether land speculation rules changed since 2019, whether notaries adequately protect private investors, and how buyers are protected against speculators. The minister replied that no relevant legislative changes occurred, that fragmentation is limited (about 0.13% of farmland), that notaries' independence rules and disciplinary oversight apply, and that consumer protection and AFM oversight exist, promising a further answer.
Since May 2019 there have been no legislative amendments aimed at bringing land positions under AFM supervision or at countering land speculation.
Sinds mei 2019 zijn geen wetswijzigingen geweest die erop gericht waren grondposities onder het AFM-toezicht te brengen of gericht waren op het tegengaan van grondspeculatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat verzekeraars mogelijk meer dan 1 miljoen euro schade door de avondklokrellen gaan vergoeden

An SP MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers about estimated insured damage from the curfew riots, whether insurers pay out fairly rather than referring claimants to the government damage fund, and whether oversight or recovery of fund costs from insurers is possible.
