Minister Grapperhaus replied that insured damage is estimated at 1 million euro, that claims are primarily a matter between insurer and insured with no government role or steekproef planned, and that the government will monitor the split between insurers and the fund and speak to the insurers' association if complaints arise.
I see no role for the government in this and see no reason to carry out a sample-based check.
Ik zie hierin geen rol voor de overheid en zie geen aanleiding om een steekproefsgewijze controle uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de commodificatie van water en waterroof door Nederlandse financiële instellingen

An MP asks the government about financial institutions and water commodification and water grabbing, and whether the financial sector can regulate itself, citing Follow the Money reporting. The government recognises the right to water, says a binding corporate due diligence obligation (ideally at EU level) is preferred over single-theme criminalisation or a ban, and points to voluntary initiatives such as the Valuing Water Initiative and existing sector covenants.
In the policy note of 16 October 2020 the cabinet states that evaluations show the existing CSR policy is insufficiently effective.
In de beleidsnota van 16 oktober 2020 geeft het kabinet aan dat uit evaluaties blijkt dat het bestaande IMVO-beleid onvoldoende effectief is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het SchuldenLabNL

MPs asked why the government appointed former finance minister Zalm, who is under OM investigation for money laundering, as chair of SchuldenLabNL, and whether private creditors would cooperate on debts of parents in the childcare benefits affair. The state secretary replied that SchuldenLabNL is an independent foundation the cabinet had no role in appointing its board, that the board is unpaid, and that talks with public and private creditors are ongoing to give affected parents a fresh start.
The cabinet has no involvement whatsoever in appointing Mr Zalm as chair or in appointing the other board members of SchuldenLabNL.
Het kabinet heeft geen enkele bemoeienis met het benoemen van de heer Zalm als voorzitter alsmede met de benoeming van andere leden van het bestuur van SchuldenlabNL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'HTM-directeur Bruno Bruins wordt commissaris bij vaccin-instituut'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether appointing former minister Bruno Bruins as a supervisory board member of Intravacc, shortly after leaving office, creates conflict of interest given the lobbying ban and his role in planning its privatisation. The minister replied that the Corporate Governance Code and the lobbying circular were applied, that Bruins was recruited for his political-administrative experience and had no role in the operational decision, and that the post pays EUR 27,500 per year.
The appointment process took into account the Dutch Corporate Governance Code and the Circular on the lobbying ban for ministers and state secretaries.
In het benoemingsproces zijn de Nederlandse Corporate Governance Code en de Circulaire lobbyverbod Bewindspersonen meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het op omvallen staan van de snelle trein Eurostar van Rotterdam naar Londen

A D66 MP asked the state secretary about reports that Eurostar, facing collapsing passenger numbers during COVID-19, may be unable to meet payment obligations, and about support and cross-border cooperation to keep the Amsterdam-London rail link. The government confirmed the precarious financial situation, said talks with Belgium, France and the UK on support were ongoing and promised to inform parliament of effects on Dutch rail services, while noting the NOW wage subsidy and the TVL support scheme are available.
I will of course follow these talks and will inform your House should this have consequences for rail transport to and from the Netherlands.
Ik zal deze gesprekken uiteraard volgen, en uw Kamer informeren mocht dit gevolgen hebben voor het treinvervoer van en naar Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het groeiende aanbod van verhuurhypotheken

An MP asks the ministers about the growing supply of buy-to-let mortgages and their effects on starters and house prices. The minister answers that there are about 15 providers, that the government sees no problem with more providers but requires responsible lending, that it differentiated transfer tax to favour starters, and that it will introduce purchase protection and cap rent increases, while rejecting a numeric threshold for treating landlords as entrepreneurs.
In addition, I will cap the annual rent increase in the free sector, so that tenants in the free sector are also protected against unexpected excessive rent increases.
Daarnaast zal ik de jaarlijkse huurprijsstijging in de vrije sector maximeren, waardoor ook de huurders in de vrije sector worden beschermd tegen onverwachte excessieve huurverhogingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over oliehandelaren, corruptie en de financiële sector

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance Minister about oil trader Vitol's alleged bribery and tax avoidance, bank financing of such firms, and whether the government would enforce OECD guidelines and mandatory due diligence. The government acknowledged the allegations, said it expects Dutch firms and banks to follow the OECD guidelines, and pointed to a planned broad due diligence obligation, mostly without committing to specific enforcement of the named companies.
On questions about how the above or other companies handle these matters and what their tax position is, I cannot go into detail.
Op vragen over hoe bovengenoemde of andere bedrijven hiermee omgaan en wat hun belastingpositie is, kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de wenselijkheid van vermenging van accountancy en advocatuur

MP Van Nispen asked the Finance and Justice ministers whether accountancy firms offering legal services and combining audit with advisory work is desirable, and whether the law permits it. The ministers answered that the two professions serve different interests, that the audit-advisory separation rules and professional codes constrain such combinations, and that they will monitor developments and examine the Cta and Kwartiermakers' structural alternatives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het rapport ‘Basel III Reforms: Updated Impact Study’ van de Europese Bankenautoriteit

Three VVD MPs asked the Finance and Agriculture ministers about the EBA's Basel III updated impact study, including the claimed 21% capital increase for Dutch banks, the effect on agricultural and mortgage lending, and whether the impact is unfairly borne by farm credit. The minister answered that the impact depends on the EU implementation proposal expected in H1 2021, that interministerial talks with banks continue, and that a Commission impact analysis will follow.
Once the Commission presents a legislative proposal, the cabinet will inform the House of its position via the usual BNC fiche procedure.
Zodra de CIE met een wetgevend voorstel komt, zal het kabinet uw Kamer informeren over haar inzet volgens de gebruikelijke weg van een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over "hedge funds en vermogensbeheerders die NOW steun ontvangen"

An MP asked whether hedge funds and asset managers receive NOW wage-subsidy support, whether bonuses to non-board traders are paid with public money, and whether support should be restricted or clawed back. The minister replied that eligibility is sector-neutral, no separate register of such firms exists, the bonus ban covers only management and board, and no clawback or new restrictions are planned beyond existing rules.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Mag de bank weigeren om je een bankrekening te geven? Dat gaat AFM onderzoeken’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about press reports that banks may refuse or close accounts of Accidental Americans lacking a US TIN, and whether the AFM's investigation is justified. The minister answered that the AFM has started an exploratory investigation into banks' FATCA-related account practices, that banks should assess individual cases rather than exclude a group, and that he is discussing the issue with the banks and will report by letter.

I have therefore asked DNB, as supervisor of compliance with the Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Act (Wwft), and the AFM, as supervisor of the rules on the basic payment account, to respond on the closing or freezing of bank accounts.

Ik heb daarom gevraagd aan DNB, als toezichthouder op de naleving van de Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financiering van terrorisme (Wwft), en aan de AFM, als toezichthouder op de naleving van de regels over de basisbetaalrekening, om een reactie over het sluiten dan wel bevriezen van bankrekeningen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de beslissing van de rechtbank Midden-Nederland in de casus van een Accidental American tegen de Volksbank en het bericht 'Annie Brouwer uit Harkema is Amerikaan tegen wil en d

MPs Lodders asked the Finance Minister about a court ruling allowing a bank to close the account of an accidental American, the AFM investigation into banks refusing basic accounts for lack of a TIN, FATCA-IGA privacy and double taxation, and access to basic payment accounts. The minister answered that banks may refuse accounts only on legal grounds, that the FATCA obligation stems from US law and cannot be unilaterally changed, and that banks have promised not to close accounts solely for lack of a US TIN in 2021.
The AFM supervises compliance with the rules on the basic payment account.
De AFM houdt toezicht op de naleving van de regels over de basisbetaalrekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat slachtoffers van woekerrente in het MKB niet geholpen worden door het Kifid

Opposition MP Alkaya asked the Finance Minister why Kifid does not hear SME complaints about allegedly excessive interest (woekerrente) from before 1 July 2018, and what the government will do to recover such payments and prevent future abuses. The minister replied that Kifid's SME jurisdiction is limited by the Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering to credit agreed or raised after 1 July 2018, that courts remain open, and that he cannot estimate bank costs or judge overcharging, leaving that to Kifid or the courts.
The assessment of whether a bank has charged an SME client excessive costs is, where that route is open, for Kifid or the courts.
De beoordeling of een bank te hoge kosten in rekening heeft gebracht aan een mkb-klant is indien deze weg open staat, aan het Kifid of aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over Conservatrix

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked the Finance Minister about the 2017 transfer of insurer Conservatrix to Trier Holding for 1 euro, the promised capital injection, and why funds ended up with a Barbados reinsurer. The minister confirmed the promised recapitalisation was legally binding, described the injections and later deterioration, withheld the transfer plan and related documents from public disclosure (available confidentially), declined responsibility for the supervised firm, and committed to an independent evaluation of DNB and ministry conduct from 2017 onward, with the scope and evaluators to be reported to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'ECB veroorzaakt twijfel over 'groen' en 'bruin' schuldpapier'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that the ECB may exclude bonds from polluting issuers, asking about green and brown bond definitions, the legal mandate, market neutrality and whether such choices should be made by democratically elected bodies. The minister answered that the ECB's monetary strategy review is ongoing, that EU taxonomy work is underway, that the ECB has a mandate with policy discretion, and that he will forward the ECB review report when available.
I do not want to anticipate the outcomes of the review.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de herziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Slootweg en Amhaouch over het gedrag van Centric-topman Gerard Sanderink

CDA MPs asked ministers about Centric executive Gerard Sanderink's alleged threats to an inspector, destruction of evidence, ignored court rulings, and DNB's reliance on Centric software. The government answered that it would not publish his correspondence absent a request from investigators, that DNB as a contract partner monitors Centric, and that it cannot judge a private firm, while describing supervisory board powers in general terms.
At this moment I see no reason to make the correspondence in question public without a request from the bodies you mention.
Ik zie op dit moment geen redenen om bedoelde correspondentie openbaar te maken zonder dat daar een verzoek ligt van door u genoemde instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de dividenduitkering van een Finse bankragen

An MP asks the Finance Minister about a Finnish bank paying out 59% of its 2019 profit as dividend despite ECB and Finnish supervisor recommendations against dividends during COVID-19, and whether such recommendations can be made binding. The minister says the ECB advice is not legally enforceable but supervisors expect compliance, that supervisors can already impose individual dividend bans, and that he has no signals of Dutch banks defying the recommendations.
This concerns an ECB recommendation with an urgent advice to the banking sector. Supervisors expect institutions to follow the advice, but this is not legally enforceable.
Het betreft een aanbeveling van de ECB met een dringend advies aan de bankensector. Toezichthouders verwachten dat instellingen het advies volgen, maar dit is niet juridisch afdwingbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het nieuwe investeringsbeleid van de Nederlandse ontwikkelingsbank (FMO)

An MP asks the Dutch government about FMO's proposed phase-out of fossil fuel investments, including gas, and whether the state as shareholder should require alignment with the Climate Agreement. The minister answers that FMO has not yet decided, that the state is a distant shareholder leaving individual investment choices to FMO, and that the government is pursuing gradual phase-out in multilateral finance.
However, the state is a distant shareholder. It is up to the holdings themselves to determine how individual investments relate to climate-related and other (impact) objectives.

De staat is echter aandeelhouder op afstand. Het is aan deelnemingen zelf om te bepalen hoe individuele investeringen zich verhouden tot klimaat gerelateerde doelstellingen en andere (impact) doelstellingen.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat Holland Casino wedpartner wordt van de Eredivisie en de Keuken Kampioen Divisie

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Holland Casino's planned multi-million sponsorship deal with the Eredivisie and Keuken Kampioen Divisie while the company receives state COVID support and considers layoffs. The State Secretary replied that the sponsorship supports the company's entry into the online gambling market, that the government approved it, and that Holland Casino must set a responsible-gambling example.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over belemmeringen voor verduurzaming van de financiële sector

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Finance about deforestation linked to soy and cattle supply chains, biodiversity risks in the financial sector, and whether regulation beyond self-regulation is needed. The Minister answered that the government supports EU taxonomy, due diligence and non-financial reporting initiatives and sees no need for further research at this stage, while declining to commit to new binding measures.
I therefore see no need for additional research at this moment.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen noodzaak tot aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de betrokkenheid van de minister-president bij de compensatieregeling voor gedupeerden van de toeslagenaffaire

An MP asks the government about the Prime Minister's involvement in designing the compensation scheme for childcare benefit victims, including the crisis structure, the Bewindsliedenoverleg meetings, withheld Wob documents, precedent concerns, and the scope of the advisory committee. The Secretary of State answers that the Prime Minister attended three ministerial preparation meetings in February and March 2020, releases several previously withheld documents, but refuses some details and says the questions could not be answered by the deadline.
This ministerial consultation on possible compensation scenarios convened three times.
Dit BWO met als onderwerp «mogelijke scenario’s compensatieregeling» is driemaal bijeengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Rabobank sluit helft filialen om winst op peil te houden'

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the decline in bank branches, including Rabobank's closures, is desirable and what the role of the state and DNB is in keeping banking accessible to vulnerable groups. The minister answered that digital banking explains most closures, that banks are primarily responsible with DNB chairing the MOB to monitor accessibility, and promised a mid-2021 interim evaluation and a DNB study on cash infrastructure.
I do not have information on how many full-time equivalents are involved in this.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over hoeveel fte hiermee gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer (SGP) over het bericht dat Holland Casino wedpartner wordt van de Eredivisie en de Keuken Kampioen Divisie

An SGP MP asked the Finance Minister whether Holland Casino's planned large sponsorship deal with the Eredivisie and Keuken Kampioen Divisie, while it received NOW wage support and possibly faces layoffs, is acceptable and whether the state shareholder can impose conditions or block it. The State Secretary answered that NOW funds are used only for wages, that the sponsorship serves an online market entry goal, and that as shareholder the government will assess the deal under the statutes (above EUR 10 million requires shareholder approval), promising to inform parliament of its decision.
Once I have made the assessment and taken a decision, I will inform your House of it.
Als ik de beoordeling heb gedaan en een besluit heb genomen, zal ik uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over de beperkte dekking van asbestdaken

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Linde asked whether insurers such as Centraal Beheer and Achmea are limiting coverage of asbestos roof damage, leaving homeowners uninsured or underpaid, and whether the government will press insurers to reverse this. The minister (Finance) answered that he has no overview of insurers' conditions, that Achmea phases out coverage of asbestos roofing by 5% a year, that policy terms govern payouts, and that the government is asking the asbestos programme office to talk with insurers.
I have no insight into insurers' conditions.
Ik heb geen zicht op voorwaarden van verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Otterloo over de weigering van ex-kankerpatiënten door uitvaartverzekeraars waarbij de coronapandemie als argument wordt gebruikt

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether insurers refusing former cancer patients on Covid-19 risk grounds is legal, why recent agreements and the new decree do not solve this, and whether the minister will act. The minister said the new decree from 1 January 2021 removes cancer history from health declarations, that insurers may still weigh Covid-19 as a risk factor, and that he will talk with insurers and asks them to review individual cases.
I will also discuss this with insurers.
Ik zal hier ook met verzekeraars over in gesprek gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Volksbank houdt vol: we moeten rekening 'onbedoelde Amerikaan' afsluiten'

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether banks may close the accounts of 'accidental Americans' who do not obtain a US TIN or CLN, and whether this is fair and consistent with the basic payment account right. The minister answers that closing such accounts is premature and unnecessary where banks have made sufficient efforts, that talks with the banking association and US authorities are ongoing, and that the lack of a US TIN alone is not a ground to refuse a basic account, though other facts may be.
I therefore cannot go into the substance of that. It is for the court to judge the lawfulness of the Volksbank's conduct.
Ik kan daar daarom niet inhoudelijk op ingaan. Het is immers aan de rechter om te oordelen over de rechtmatigheid van de handelwijze van de Volksbank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de reactie van de Europese Ombudsman op de gunning van een onderzoeksopdracht aan BlackRock door de Europese Commissie

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Finance Minister how he views the European Ombudsman's finding of serious shortcomings in controlling conflicts of interest around BlackRock's award of a sustainable finance advisory contract by the European Commission. The minister replied that the Ombudsman found no maladministration, that the Commission should strengthen its procurement framework, and that he will encourage the Commission to act and inform the House.
I will encourage the European Commission in the relevant bodies to take this up promptly and ask how it intends to take forward the Ombudsman's recommendations.
Ik zal de Europese Commissie in de relevante gremia aanmoedigen dit voortvarend op te pakken en vragen hoe zij voornemens is de aanbevelingen van de Ombudsman verder te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het proefschrift ‘Public funding of failing banks in the European Union

The MP Aukje de Vries asks the Finance Minister about Marije Louisse's dissertation on public funding of failing EU banks, including gaps between state aid rules and the resolution framework, the Monte dei Paschi case, and concrete steps to strengthen the banking sector. The minister welcomes the dissertation's relevance, agrees the frameworks should be better aligned, outlines Dutch proposals and the planned Commission review, and declines to back some of Louisse's more far-reaching recommendations.

I am less convinced of the desirability of Louisse's proposals, for example to give the SRB a large role in winding down banks in (national) bankruptcy or to create a harmonised insolvency mechanism for banks alongside the resolution framework.

Ik ben minder overtuigd van de wenselijkheid van voorstellen van Louisse om bijvoorbeeld de SRB een grote rol te geven bij het afwikkelen van banken in (nationaal) faillissement of om naast het resolutie-raamwerk een geharmoniseerd insolventiemechanisme voor banken in het leven te roepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de Italiaanse overheid die de ECB zou verzoeken schulden kwijt te schelden

MP Slootweg asked the Finance Minister whether Italy had formally asked the ECB to write off sovereign debt, and asked about ECB holdings, euro-area debt levels, the legal basis for ECB bond purchases, and ESM options. The minister answered that the ECB cannot cancel government debt, that no formal Italian request is known, and that the ESM reform will require debt sustainability checks and single-limb CACs.
The ECB cannot decide to write off government debts.
De ECB kan niet beslissen om schulden van overheden kwijt te schelden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de berichten ‘Italië wil dat de ECB staatsschuld kwijtscheldt, maar Frankfurt peinst er niet over’, ‘Gratis geld, het blijft een aantrekkelijk idee’ en ‘Italië pleit voo

An MP asked the Finance Minister about press reports that Italy and France want the ECB to cancel COVID-era government debt, and about ECB emergency bond purchases, debt sustainability and the EU fiscal rules. The minister answered that ECB debt cancellation would breach Article 123 TFEU, that the ECB's PEPP flexibility is its own monetary policy choice, and that debt reduction is the responsibility of member states, with no commitment beyond a forthcoming broader note on the Stability and Growth Pact.
Debt cancellation by the European Central Bank would constitute a breach of Article 123 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU).
Het kwijtschelden van schulden door de Europese Centrale bank zou een schending van artikel 123 het Verdrag betreffende de werking van de Europese Unie (VWEU) betekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over schadevergoedingen door banken bij spoofing

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked ministers about bank compensation for spoofing victims, whether banks should be obliged to compensate as with phishing, and how police can trace stolen funds. The minister replied that banks are legally bound to compensate only bancaire fraude, that spoofing falls outside this, and that he is negotiating with banks and exploring legal changes with reports due in early 2021.
I will inform the House in the first quarter of 2021 on progress on both points.
Ik informeer uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 over de voortgang op beide punten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Nederlands kabinet vindt eisen Europees coronafonds lastig’

An MP asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs why the cabinet would not submit a national recovery plan in the first EU window and whether Dutch firms would lose EU coronavirus recovery funds as a result. The minister replied that the final decision is left to the incoming cabinet, that Dutch funds are not lost because later submission windows remain open, and that the government is taking other steps to protect the level playing field.
The cabinet deliberately chooses to leave the final decision on the reforms and investments to be included in the Recovery and Resilience Plan to the new cabinet.

Het kabinet kiest er bewust voor om het definitieve besluit over de hervormingen en investeringen die in het Recovery and Resilience Plan ( RRP) worden opgenomen door het nieuwe kabinet te laten nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de brandbrief van cryptocurrencybedrijven in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about crypto firms' complaint that DNB registration demands are excessive, delayed approvals and the 21 November deadline. The minister answered that DNB is an independent supervisor applying the Sanctions Act uniformly, that firms can appeal, that DNB will try to finish near-complete applications quickly, and that an evaluation of the law will be considered in early 2021.
DNB, as supervisor, is independent and has a statutory mandate to give content, within the limits of the law, to the open norms in this legislation.
DNB is als toezichthouder onafhankelijk en heeft een wettelijk mandaat om, binnen de grenzen van de wet, invulling te geven aan (open) normen in deze wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Krotbeleggen: ‘triest’ spel van een beursfonds drijft gemeentes tot wanhoop’

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether the government would act against a listed fund that lets listed monuments decay to gain land positions, and whether exchange listings could be refused. The minister answered that municipalities already have enforcement powers under the Wabo and Woningwet, that Wassenaar has taken action, and that exchange exclusion and new general coercive measures are too far-reaching, so no further steps are planned.
For that reason we see no reason for follow-up steps.
Om die reden zien wij geen aanleiding voor vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat Euronext flitshandelaren een onzichtbare voorsprong geeft

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Euronext gives high-frequency traders an early information advantage through its private order-confirmation channel, whether this amounts to insider trading, and what measures will be taken. The minister answered that all market parties involved in a trade receive confirmation microseconds earlier via the private channel regardless of HFT use, that whether insider trading occurred is for the AFM or courts to judge, and that the AFM will be involved in Euronext's consultation on adjusting the system.
Whether a specific case involves (trading on) inside information is for the supervisor or, where applicable, the court to establish.
Of in een specifieke casus sprake is van (handel met) voorwetenschap is aan de toezichthouder of in voorkomend geval aan de rechter om vast te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de klimaatplannen van olie- en gasbedrijven

An MP asks the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Finance whether oil and gas companies' climate plans are adequate for 1.5°C, about Shell's greenwashing, fossil fuel licensing, tax incentives, export credit and FMO financing, advertising, and the Climate Day platform for Shell and BP. The minister largely defends continued gas extraction from small Dutch fields, says a review of fossil fuel fiscal incentives will be completed in Q1 2021, and declines to ban fossil fuel advertising or remove Shell and BP from the Climate Day.
Unfortunately, this overview cannot yet be provided with sufficient care at this time.
Dit overzicht kan op dit moment helaas nog niet met voldoende zorgvuldigheid worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de speech van ESM-directeur Klaus Regling 'The response to the Covid-19 crisis and remaining vulnerabilities in EMU'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about ESM director Klaus Regling's call for a permanent Recovery and Resilience Facility and the EMU integration agenda, and whether the government will oppose a permanent facility. The minister answers that the government opposes a permanent RRF or any permanent stabilisation mechanism, will raise this in meetings, and sees member states' own budget buffers and the banking and capital markets unions as the right tools.
The cabinet sees the RRF as a one-off and temporary instrument.
Het kabinet ziet de RRF als een eenmalig en tijdelijk instrument.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Slootweg over de berichten 'Mkb'ers maar matig op de hoogte van financieringsmogelijkheden' en 'Kredietverzekeraar: Nederland wacht volgend jaar grote faillissementsgo

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about SMEs' limited awareness of financing options and about a predicted bankruptcy wave, including whether insolvency law could intervene earlier and whether a temporary protection for healthy firms should be introduced. The state secretary answered that many support schemes exist, that bankruptcies remain low due to support packages and court delays, that the WHOA restructuring law is the chosen tool, and that a general protection measure is rejected as too broad, while committing to a Kamer report on the annual SME action plan and a bank-data analysis.

I have not made a commitment that, in addition to the existing CBS monitoring commissioned by EZK, periodic reporting will be provided on the use of the guarantee schemes in general and specifically on rejections.

Ik heb geen toezegging gedaan dat er aanvullend op de bestaande monitoring door het CBS in opdracht van EZK (periodiek) gerapporteerd wordt over het gebruik van de garantieregelingen in het algemeen en specifiek over afwijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Bankenautoriteit vreest dat de witwasregels doel voorbij schieten’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether anti-money-laundering rules are causing banks to refuse clients such as startups, international organisations, embassies, foreign companies and politically exposed persons, and what the government will do about onboarding problems. The minister acknowledged de-risking signals, argued that banks must assess each case individually, pointed to a planned evaluation by mid-2021 and to a legislative proposal on information sharing between banks, but gave no quantitative data on refusals.
Banks, however, do not keep quantitative data, because each case is treated and assessed separately.
Banken houden echter geen kwantitatieve data bij, omdat elke zaak apart wordt behandeld en beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van der Linde over een tweede betaalpauze door banken

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether banks' refusal of a second generic payment holiday during the second lockdown, and the shift to case-by-case support, endangers viable firms, and how DNB's financial stability warnings and the Tax Authority's payment arrangements are handled. The minister answered that banks now assess clients individually, that the financial sector is resilient, and that the government is extending support schemes and debt-relief measures for entrepreneurs.

The cabinet will make efforts in the coming period to develop joint guidelines with large creditors, including banks, for a more flexible treatment of restructuring requests from entrepreneurs affected by the corona crisis.

Het kabinet spant zich de komende periode in om met grote schuldeisers, waaronder de banken, gezamenlijke richtlijnen te ontwikkelen voor een soepelere behandeling van saneringsverzoeken van ondernemers die door de coronacrisis zijn geraakt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Paris opposé au retour des règles budgétaires européennes d’avant-crise (ministre à l’AFP)’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that France opposes returning to pre-crisis EU budget rules and whether this threatens the eurozone after COVID-19. The minister answered that the Stability and Growth Pact should be revised for effectiveness, the general escape clause should be withdrawn once the recession ends, and a broader reflection letter will follow by year-end.
During the General Consultation on the Eurogroup and Ecofin Council on 9 September I committed to send a broad reflection on the SGP before the end of the year.
Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Eurogroep en Ecofinraad op 9 september jl. heb ik toegezegd om voor het einde van het jaar een brede bespiegeling ten aanzien van het SGP te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Bosman over bepaalde Britse banken die rekeningen van klanten in Nederland opheffen

MPs Van der Linde and Bosman asked the Finance Minister why British banks are closing accounts of Dutch customers after Brexit, whether this can be prevented, and why retail customers have less protection than professional market parties. The government answers that UK institutions must manage their own transition under UK supervision, that existing preparation is considered sufficient so no additional legislation is needed, and that EU rules protect retail clients by requiring proper authorisation for cross-border services.
It is up to British institutions themselves to determine which steps they take in response to the end of the transition period.
Het is aan Britse instellingen zelf om te bepalen welke stappen zij ondernemen in reactie op het aflopen van de overgangsperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over gedupeerde consumenten door wurgkredieten

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about consumers harmed by revolving credits with allegedly excessive interest, the slow compensation, Kifid's appeal rules and whether banks should be pressed to drop appeals and cover legal costs. The minister answered that compensation should be arranged accessibly, that appeals are part of a fair process, that he will not intervene in operational decisions, and that the AFM has taken steps on locked-up credits.
I therefore do not interfere in the choice of a party to a proceeding whether or not to appeal.
Ik meng mij daarom niet in de keuze van een procespartij om al dan niet in beroep te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘ECB to consider allowing inflation to exceed target, Lagarde says’

An MP asked the Finance Minister how he assesses the ECB's possible move to a higher or more symmetric inflation target, whether it is consistent with the price stability mandate, and related risks and effects. The minister answered that the ECB has independent policy freedom within the treaty framework, that its strategy review is ongoing with stakeholder consultation, and that the government will not comment on substance.
The ECB has policy freedom to give content to the price stability mandate within the treaty framework.
De ECB beschikt over beleidsvrijheid om invulling te geven aan het mandaat van prijsstabiliteit binnen de verdragsrechtelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van der Linde over het experiment van DNB met uitgifte betaalrekeningen

VVD MPs Lodders and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about a Dutch bank closing an Accidental American's account under FATCA, where Accidental Americans may lose their bank access, and about the DNB digital euro experiment. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to basic payment account options and the Convenant Basisbankrekening, said the digital euro is separate from this problem, and promised to press the US and EU for talks on FATCA.
I cannot go into individual cases in which accounts have been terminated.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken waarin sprake is van stopzetten van rekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat 80% van de witwasmeldingen bij Nederlandse toezichthouder Financial Intelligence Unit in een la verdwijnen

MPs Alkaya (SP) asked the Minister and State Secretary of Finance about a report that 80% of money-laundering reports at the FIU-Nederland are left unactioned, asking about backlogs, reliance on automated matching, digitalisation, and staffing relative to neighbouring countries. The Minister (Justice and Security) answers that FIU-Nederland screens all reports automatically against police and CJIB data, prioritises risk-based analysis, reports are held for five years, and staffing is being expanded by about 19 fte alongside technology investment.
FIU-Nederland has indicated, when asked, that it does not recognise the journalists' conclusion that 80% of unusual transaction reports from banks are not acted upon by FIU-Nederland.

FIU-Nederland heeft desgevraagd aangegeven zich niet te her- en erkennen in de conclusie van de journalisten dat op 80% van de meldingen van ongebruikelijke transacties afkomstig van banken niet zou worden geacteerd door de FIU-Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Laçin over de staatssteun aan KLM

MPs Alkaya and Laçin asked the Finance Minister whether the state will expand its influence in Air France-KLM as motioned, whether a capital injection is planned, and whether KLM may make lower-paid staff pay for the restructuring. The minister answered that state guarantees and a state agent give the state more influence, that a capital injection is not ruled out but cannot be discussed further for listed-company reasons, and that employment terms are part of the support conditions under assessment.
Because Air France-KLM is a listed company, I cannot share anything further on this at this moment.
Omdat Air France – KLM een beursgenoteerde onderneming betreft, kan ik hier op dit moment verder niets over delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'WhatsApp-fraude explodeert: 'Ik snap niet hoe ik erin ben getrapt''

MPs Van der Linde and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked about the rise of WhatsApp 'friend in need' fraud, its scale, perpetrators, bank liability, prevention and FIU information. The minister replied that reports have surged since 2019 but exact numbers are unknown, outlined prevention campaigns, bank security rules and new financial investigation tools, and said banks are generally not liable for authorised payments.
The exact scale of 'friend in need' fraud is not known, because not all victims report to the police, their bank or the Fraud Helpdesk.

De exacte omvang van hulpvraagfraude (ook wel vriend-in-nood-fraude genoemd), is niet bekend, omdat niet alle slachtoffers aangifte doen bij de politie of een melding maken bij hun bank of de Fraudehelpdesk (FHD).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘EU-hof: Amerikaanse privacybescherming onvoldoende’

An MP asked whether the EU Court's invalidation of the Privacy Shield (Schrems II) affects personal data transfers to the US, including by Dutch banks under FATCA and by organisations with US-national signatories. The minister answered that transfers now need AVG safeguards such as standard contractual clauses, that the Commission is negotiating a replacement adequacy decision, and that the Data Protection Authority is the route for complaints about unlawful transfers.
The Court based its finding that the Privacy Shield contains insufficient safeguards for EU citizens on the role US investigative and intelligence services can play after a transfer has taken place.

Het Hof heeft zijn oordeel dat het Privacy Shield onvoldoende waarborgen bevat voor EU- burgers, onderbouwd met een verwijzing naar de rol die opsporings- en inlichtingendiensten in de VS kunnen spelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Kent over het bericht dat banken mogen discrimineren op leeftijd

MPs Alkaya and Van Kent asked the Finance Minister whether banks may discriminate by age after a Kifid ruling upheld a bank's refusal of an overdraft facility to a customer aged 61-67 due to income uncertainty linked to retirement. The minister said discrimination is prohibited and the government opposes it, but declined to comment on individual Kifid rulings, excluded this case from the Kifid evaluation, and only appealed to banks to take a human-centred approach.
As Minister of Finance, I do not comment on rulings in individual cases of independent dispute resolution bodies, including this Kifid ruling.
Als Minister van Financiën spreek ik mij niet uit over uitspraken in individuele gevallen van onafhankelijke geschillenbeslechtingsinstanties, waaronder deze uitspraak van het Kifid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Kifid: bank mag betaalrekening beëindigen als consument geen US TIN of CLN wil aanvragen' en het bericht 'Wijziging annex II FATCA-verdrag'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Kifid ruling allowing a bank to close a basic payment account when a US-linked consumer will not supply a US TIN, and about an amendment to Annex II of the FATCA agreement affecting sponsored entities. The minister answered that the Kifid case has specific facts and that banks and the Belastingdienst have provided FATCA information, and that the amendment preserves the status quo for Dutch sponsored entities without extra reporting.
I will ask banks to keep paying attention to clear information provision about FATCA.
Ik zal banken vragen aandacht te blijven houden voor duidelijke informatieverstrekking over FATCA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het invoeren van een directe WA-verzekering

Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers of Finance and Legal Protection about the insurers' plan for direct motor liability insurance, the ACM's role, and foreign examples. Minister Hoekstra answered that no prior ACM approval is needed, that direct insurance has pros and cons, that Europe requires compulsory liability insurance but permits this arrangement, and that he will leave the initiative to the insurance sector for now.

I see a possible role for myself and my colleague for Legal Protection only if the desirability of direct insurance is firmly established and insurers are unable to offer this product without changes to laws or regulations.

Ik zie pas een mogelijke rol voor mijzelf en mijn ambtsgenoot voor Rechtsbescherming weggelegd als de wenselijkheid van een directe verzekering zonder meer vaststaat en verzekeraars niet in staat zijn dit product aan te bieden zonder aanpassingen in wet- of regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Lodders over het bericht ‘Tienduizenden Amerikaanse Nederlanders kunnen Trumpcheque niet verzilveren’

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that tens of thousands of Dutch-American citizens cannot cash US Trump stimulus cheques in the Netherlands, and whether banks or the US ambassador could resolve it. The minister answered that ING offers cheque cashing until end-2020, that Dutch banks have largely stopped the service for commercial and fraud reasons, and that he has raised the issue with the US embassy.

I have already raised this point with the American embassy in the Netherlands and will ask in a follow-up conversation whether, and if so what, options exist to cash a cheque if this is not possible at a Dutch bank.

Ik heb dit punt reeds onder de aandacht gebracht bij de Amerikaanse ambassade in Nederland en zal in een vervolggesprek vragen of en zo ja welke mogelijkheden er zijn om een cheque te verzilveren als dit bij een Nederlandse bank niet lukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over het bericht  dat honderden Nederlandse economen meer investeringen aanraden in sociale gelijkheid en verduurzaming

MPs Marijnissen and Alkaya asked whether the government shares economists' call for more investment in social equality and sustainability, whether debt can safely rise, whether Groeifonds should prioritise jobs, and whether austerity is off the table. The ministers answered that existing support, investment acceleration and the Nationaal Groeifonds already address these goals, that debt must stay manageable, and that no choice is made between corporate tax and social security, while offering no new proposal.
The cabinet will submit a recovery plan for the RRF to the Commission in spring 2021.
Het kabinet zal in het voorjaar van 2021 een herstelplan voor de RRF bij de Commissie indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Amhaouch en Palland over het met contant geld kunnen blijven betalen in winkels

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether shops are increasingly refusing cash, whether COVID plays a role, what is done for groups dependent on cash, and how costs for small businesses will develop. The minister answered that no current data exist, a DNB/Panteia study is pending, cash acceptance is a commitment under MOB agreements, and further research on cash infrastructure is planned.
There is currently no up-to-date data available on the number of retail outlets concerned and the extent to which corona plays a role.
Er zijn op dit moment geen actuele gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal toonbankinstellingen dat dit betreft en in hoeverre corona hierbij een rol speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over investeringen in de plasticindustrie

MP Van Raan asked the government about investments in the plastics industry, including Shell and financial institutions, recyclate requirements, a tax on virgin plastic and OECD guidelines. The government answered that it expects firms to follow OECD and UN guidance, will raise the plastics pact and recyclate use at EU level, sees no national import levy as current, and will not yet decide on additional measures.

The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally, including banks, insurers and pension funds, to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal ondernemen, waaronder banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen, dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen (OESO-richtlijnen) en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's) naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Brussels plans attack on low tax member states'

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the European Commission was considering using Article 116 TFEU to attack low-tax member states, and whether this threatens national tax competence. The State Secretary answered that the proposal is still at an exploratory stage, that the Netherlands has taken many anti-avoidance measures, and that the Chamber will be informed via a BNC fiche once a concrete proposal is published, but did not address the Commission's inconsistent legal-basis position.
At this moment there is therefore no proposal yet and it is, in my view, too premature to respond to this subject.
Op dit moment ligt er dus nog geen voorstel en is het, naar mijn mening, te prematuur om op dit onderwerp te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het aanstellen van een directeur voor het stafbureau van het Nationaal Groeifonds

MP Krol asks the Finance Minister why a director was appointed to the Nationaal Groeifonds staff bureau before the 2021 budget for the fund was approved by parliament, and questions the appointee's track record and the fund's oversight. The minister answers that preparatory work must start now, that the appointment followed a profile and a selection conversation, that costs will fall under the fund's budget from 2021, and declines to discuss individual officials' past contributions while refusing to stop the preparations.
It is for the House to decide whether or not to approve the budget of the Nationaal Groeifonds.
Het is aan de Kamer om al dan niet goedkeuring te geven aan de begroting van het Nationaal Groeifonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht ‘Brussels ready to clamp down on sweetheart corporate tax deals’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Minister and State Secretary of Finance about a Financial Times report that Brussels is ready to clamp down on sweetheart corporate tax deals, including whether the Commission will use Article 116 TFEU to remove member-state vetoes on tax. The State Secretary answered that he supports Commission efforts against tax avoidance, that the Article 116 proposal has not yet been published, and that he will uphold parliamentary motions opposing giving up the Dutch veto on tax.
I have no intention other than to respect these motions in my position in the EU.
Ik heb geen ander voornemen dan deze moties bij mijn inzet in de EU te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over het bericht dat huizenbezitters honderden euro’s extra kwijt zijn aan taxaties

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Interior ministers about reports that homeowners pay hundreds of euros more for valuations, and whether an EBA guideline banning computer-generated valuations was legally binding. The minister answered that the guidelines follow a comply-or-explain principle, that DNB and the ECB will apply them from 30 June 2021, and that a working group is exploring hybrid valuations and reforms to the appraisal process.
For the guidelines the comply-or-explain principle applies, whereby national authorities have room to deviate from the guidelines with reasons.
Voor de richtsnoeren geldt het «pas toe of leg uit» principe, waarbij nationale autoriteiten de ruimte hebben om gemotiveerd af te wijken van de richtsnoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de werkwijze van taxateurs

An MP asks the Interior and Finance Ministers about the independence and quality of mortgage valuations (taxaties), the DNB finding of systematic overvaluation, EU rules on model-based valuation, and costs to consumers. The minister acknowledges quality and independence concerns, points to a working group, sector self-regulation and new hybrid valuation options, but does not commit to a regulatory fix beyond further reporting later in the year.
I will inform you further about the outcomes of this process later this year.
Over de uitkomsten van dit traject zal ik u later dit jaar nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over FATCA en de Accidental Americans

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about banks closing or blocking accounts of Dutch citizens who also hold US nationality (Accidental Americans) due to FATCA, and about the costs and procedures for renouncing US citizenship. The government answered that banks must follow Dutch rules, that talks with the US and EU partners are ongoing, that complaints can go to Kifid or courts, and that the government will not advise on US law or costs but will keep pressing the US to lower them.
I cannot go into individual cases involving the closure or blocking of accounts or threats thereof.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken waarin sprake is van stopzetten van rekeningen, het blokkeren van rekeningen of dreiging daarmee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over investeringen van ontwikkelingsbanken in de vee-industrie

MP Van Raan asks the Finance and Foreign Trade and Development ministers why development banks such as IFC and EBRD finance industrial livestock, which he considers harmful to climate goals and to developing countries. The minister replies that such investments are limited, are screened against strict environmental and climate criteria, serve food security, and that Nederland pushes banks to align portfolios with Paris goals; he gives a detailed overview of Dutch shareholdings and sector financing by other banks, without committing to halting livestock investments.
The Netherlands exerts influence through its representation on the institutions' executive boards, participation in replenishment negotiations for the banks' funds, and contributions to Trust Funds.

Nederland oefent onder meer invloed uit via de vertegenwoordiging in de uitvoerende raden van de instellingen en door deelname aan overlegrondes over middelenaanvullingen van de fondsen van de banken en door bijdragen aan Trust Funds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘dat een problematische gokker veel te lang zijn gang kon gaan in het casino’

An MP asked the Ministers of Justice and Finance about reports that a problem gambler lost a quarter million euros at Holland Casino, including whether the casino tracks and informs customers of their losses, whether it has adequate tools and oversight for addiction prevention, and whether there are daily limits on casino card payments. The Minister answered that Holland Casino does not systematically record wins and losses, that the Gambling Authority supervises its addiction-prevention duty and is finishing a review in 2020, that compulsory referral of a relative or to addiction care is not imposed, and that the Wet Koa will tighten rules.
The Gambling Authority supervises Holland Casino and checks whether it takes sufficient measures and provisions to prevent gambling addiction as far as possible.
De Kansspelautoriteit houdt toezicht op Holland Casino en controleert daarbij of het voldoende maatregelen en voorzieningen treft om kansspelverslaving zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over de berichten 'Nederland moet haast maken met groen economisch herstel na de coronacrisis' en 'We staan op een kantelpunt voor het klimaatbeleid'

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the government about green economic recovery after the COVID-19 crisis, including investment advice from the PBL, IEA, DNB and SER, hydrogen competitiveness, the CO2 levy, KLM sustainability conditions, and workforce retraining for the energy transition. The minister responded that the Klimaatakkoord forms the basis for green recovery, that additional investments via the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility and accelerated projects (about EUR 2 billion) are being prepared, and that the CO2 levy for industry proceeds from 1 January 2021 without delay.
The cabinet wants to make room for additional investments via the European Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF).
Het kabinet wil ruimte maken voor aanvullende investeringen via de Europese Recovery and Resilience Facility (RFF).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Slootweg over het bericht 'Verstrekken van leningen/kredieten zonder vergunning is strafbaar'

MPs Van Dam and Slootweg asked about a report that unlicensed high-interest lending in Bonaire is criminal, the trend in this crime, consumer protection, and whether enforcement bodies are adequately equipped amid COVID-related financial distress. The minister answered that the case was already prosecuted, outlined existing licensing and interest-rate rules, planned a law amendment, extra prosecutorial capacity and training, and noted that bank de-risking is being addressed through tighter AML rules.
In addition, the fight against undermining and financial-economic crime is also being intensified in the Caribbean Netherlands.
Daarnaast wordt de bestrijding van ondermijning en van financieel economische criminaliteit ook op Caribisch Nederland geïntensiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de berichten 'La Bce vuole dal Tesoro 700 milioni di fondi per Mps' en 'ECB tells Monte dei Paschi to boost capital for bad loan deal'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that the ECB wants Italy to inject 700 million euros into Monte dei Paschi and whether state aid rules and banking union rules would be respected, and about Italy's NPL reduction and exit from its stake in MPS. The minister answered that no state aid approval has been given, that the rules remain fully in force and are for supervisors and the Commission to enforce, and gave an overview of Italian bank indicators and the commitment to exit the stake by end 2021 without knowing concrete steps.
It is for the supervisors, resolution authorities and the European Commission to apply and enforce the banking union rules.
Het is aan de toezichthouders, de resolutieautoriteiten en de Europese Commissie om de regels van de bankenunie toe te passen en te handhaven.

Antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over “het bericht dat vier van de vijf gemeenten niet weten of ‘tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog Joods vastgoed is onteigend en doorverkocht terwijl dat

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked ministers whether the government will map all looted Jewish property during WWII, return unlawfully collected taxes and fees, and open the Nederlands Beheersinstituut archives. The government replied that the Kordes commission and the 2000 settlement already addressed postwar restitution, that no new investigation or restitution is planned, and that most Verkaufsbücher archive material is already digitised and open.
In view of the outcomes of this research and the government's response, there is no reason to conduct new research into looted real estate.
Gezien de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en de reactie van het kabinet is er geen aanleiding om opnieuw onderzoek te doen naar geroofd onroerend goed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Slootweg over de berichten 'Banken zijn 180.000 ondernemers en consumenten tegemoetgekomen’ en ‘Bedrijven bij nieuwe bank krijgen geen krediet’

CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that banks prioritise existing clients over new business customers, which may block new credit to firms during the coronavirus crisis, and about the lack of published rejection figures and the status of a Qredits loan. The government partly recognises the picture, says banks are now also serving new customers, promises to report on rejection data after the summer recess, and says the Qredits transaction should close at the end of July.
I am periodically in consultation with the banks regarding the corona monitoring they publish.
Ik ben periodiek in overleg met de banken ten aanzien van de coronamonitoring die zij uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de «Fraude Signalering Voorziening» (FSV) en de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance how the Tax Authority's Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV) and its data protection impact assessment related to GDPR duties to consult the data protection officer and the Dutch DPA. The answers explain the timeline, that FSV was switched off after a critical assessment, that the DPA was informed on 2 March 2020 and is investigating, and commit to further information, redesign of processes and a letter on the matter.
The Tax Authority informed the Dutch DPA on 2 March 2020 about FSV because an application was in use for which the mitigating measures were insufficiently implemented.
De Belastingdienst heeft op 2 maart 2020 de AP geïnformeerd over FSV omdat er een applicatie in gebruik was waarbij de mitigerende maatregelen onvoldoende geïmplementeerd waren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Banken klagen over hoge kosten Geldmaat’

MPs Van der Linde and Aartsen asked why Geldmaat's ATM fee rates are confidential, whether smaller banks pay the same per-transaction fees, and how this fits competition law. The minister answered that the rates are kept confidential for commercial reasons, that smaller banks should keep open and non-discriminatory access, and that the government and ACM are monitoring the issue, with no firm new measure yet.
These mutually agreed rates were not published because of their commercially confidential nature.
Deze onderling overeengekomen tarieven werden niet gepubliceerd vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke karakter hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de btw-verlaging op o.a. groente en fruit in Duitsland

An MP asks whether the temporary German VAT cut on vegetables and fruit and other goods will harm Dutch border-region businesses, and whether the Netherlands should cut VAT or reverse the 2019 rise on fruit and vegetables to boost healthy eating. The government says effects on the Dutch economy are expected to be limited, rejects a temporary Dutch VAT cut for now, and points to existing prevention programmes without committing to reversing the VAT rise.
Currently the cabinet does not intend to temporarily lower VAT rates in the Netherlands.
Momenteel is het kabinet niet voornemens de btw-tarieven in Nederland tijdelijk te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Huizenkopers betalen straks bedrag aan notaris voor negatieve rente’

An MP from the CDA asks whether notaries' clients should bear negative interest that banks charge on notaries' third-party-funds accounts, and whether a consultation or legal exemption is possible. The Minister of Finance answers that he sees no reason to intervene in pricing now, that notaries are legally required in principle to net interest but may agree otherwise with clients, and that price arrangements with banks are restricted by competition law.
I will take up the subject again if the options for ordinary savers to bank at a bank that does not charge negative interest are significantly restricted.
Ik zal het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand nemen indien de mogelijkheden voor gewone spaarders significant worden beperkt om te bankieren bij een bank die geen negatieve rente rekent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Wie doet na 400 jaar binnenkort het licht uit bij onze financiële sector?'

CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister about a newspaper piece claiming the Dutch financial sector is being handed to foreign parties, and about foreign acquisitions, procurement, government banking, FinTech and critical infrastructure. The minister rejects the premise, says there is no overview of acquisitions by nationality, notes that EU procurement rules bar selecting on location, and states that existing legal tools allow intervention in unwanted foreign takeovers.
There is no overview of how many and which Dutch financial institutions have passed to foreign parties over the past ten years, or the reverse.
Er is geen overzicht van hoeveel en welke Nederlandse financiële instellingen de afgelopen tien jaar zijn overgegaan naar buitenlandse partijen en andersom.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Aartsen en Van der Linde over het bericht 'AFM waarschuwt voor schulden bij leasen van een auto of wasmachine’

MPs asked the government about AFM warnings on debt risks from private leasing of cars and appliances, including its size, contract terms, consumer information, BKR registration and whether it should fall under AFM supervision. The minister answered that private lease is unregulated and growing, outlined existing self-regulation and information, and committed to talks with market parties and the AFM on possible measures.
I will ask the AFM and other relevant parties to provide more insight into, among other things, the growth of private lease, the causes of this growth and the risks for consumers.
Ik zal de AFM en andere relevante partijen vragen om meer inzicht te geven in onder andere de groei van private lease, de oorzaken van deze groei en de risico's voor consumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Groothuizen over het bericht dat de compliance bij ABN AMRO gedurende lange tijd tekortschoot

MPs Sneller and Groothuizen asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO's compliance failures in 2015–2017 were known to the board of commissioners, to NLFI and to the ministry, and what the state did about it. The minister answered that compliance is the responsibility of the management and supervisory boards, that he cannot comment on the ongoing Public Prosecution Service investigation, and that NLFI and the ministry had regular contacts with the bank without compliance necessarily being on the agenda.
I therefore cannot go into the circumstances from the bank's past described in the article.
Ik kan daarom niet ingaan op de geschetste omstandigheden uit het verleden van de bank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over de uitzending van NPO Radio 1 Reporter Radio over het bericht 'Bitcoinbedrijven sluiten de deuren door te hoge kosten'

MPs Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about a radio report that crypto firms are closing because supervision costs of at least EUR 20,000 a year are too high, and why these costs were only announced in May, and how this relates to a motion, the treatment of other sectors, and a European anti-money-laundering supervisor. The Minister replied that supervision is necessary to prevent crypto misuse, that costs for 2020 are about EUR 18,000 per firm, that costs will be allocated by turnover from 2021, and that the Netherlands supports a phased European supervisor.
From next year, supervision costs will be allocated according to capacity to pay.
Vanaf volgend jaar worden de kosten voor het toezicht naar draagkracht verrekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het terugstorten van heffingen door de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM)

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Finance about the AFM refunding about 555,000 euros in levies to Today's Tomorrow after it failed twice to issue an extension decision for a curator, and what follow-up measures were taken. The minister confirmed the omission was acknowledged and corrected, that the refund is spread across supervised institutions with minimal tariff effect, and that internal measures and a central enforcement unit were introduced.
An internal measure has been taken that ensures timely signalling when an extension decision needs to be taken.
Er is intern een maatregel genomen die zorgt voor een tijdige signalering indien een verlengingsbesluit genomen dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over gemeenten die in geldnood dreigen te komen

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether municipalities face financial distress from COVID-19 revenue losses and how they could absorb it, and whether the government would help. State Secretary Knops replied that compensation measures were agreed with local governments, no liquidity problems are known, a regiegroep is assessing the costs, and the accres is frozen for 2020-2021.
The number of municipalities under preventive enhanced supervision in 2020 is still limited and does not deviate strongly from the figures of the past ten years.
Het aantal gemeenten dat in 2020 onder verscherpt toezicht staat (preventief) is nog beperkt en wijkt niet sterk af van de aantallen van de afgelopen tien jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Alkaya over de berichtgeving dat KLM-piloten aan belastingontwijking doen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether they would stop KLM pilots living abroad (reportedly Spain) from avoiding Dutch income tax, given state aid to KLM, and asked for data on how many such pilots there are and the revenue lost. The minister said he would raise the matter with KLM, that the data is not systematically available, and that state support will come with conditions on pay and bonuses, with details still to follow.
Conditions will be set, among other things, on working conditions and bonuses.
Er zullen o.a. voorwaarden worden gesteld op het gebied van arbeidsvoorwaarden en bonussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over een bonus voor zorgverleners

An MP asked the ministers whether they will provide clarity and quick payment of a promised bonus for healthcare workers, and whether structural pay increases are planned. The minister replied that an independent explorer is working with unions and employers on the form of the bonus, expected within weeks, and pointed to recent collective agreements and the annual government contribution to labour cost growth.
I hope to be able to tell the House, and especially the people in healthcare, within a few weeks what the reward will look like.
Ik hoop de Kamer en vooral de mensen in de zorg over enkele weken te kunnen melden hoe de beloning er uit gaat zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het rapport ‘Aandelenverwerving Air France-KLM’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the Court of Audit report finding the purchase of Air France-KLM shares comptably unlawful, and about budget and information rights of parliament. The minister confirmed the unlawfulness under the Comptabiliteitswet, disputed the application of article 2.27, acknowledged the Eerste Kamer was not informed in advance, and said he would seek further advice from the Raad van State, but gave no clear commitment on future conduct.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over het afsluiten van Nederlandse betaalrekeningen van Nederlanders buiten Nederland

MPs Sneller and Sjoerdsma asked the Finance Minister whether banks may close current accounts of Dutch citizens living outside the EU, and about related costs, French rules and possible legal changes. The Minister answered that banks set their own risk policy within the law, that basic payment account rights apply only to those lawfully residing in the EU, and that no further study is planned for now.
At present I see no added value in a study into the possibility of legally giving Dutch nationals outside the EU the option of a (basic) payment account.
Antwoord 17 Op dit moment zie ik geen toegevoegde waarde in een onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid om Nederlanders buiten de EU wettelijk de mogelijkheid te geven tot een (basis)betaalrekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘China laat het oog vallen op (verzwakte) Nederlandse bedrijven’

An MP asked ministers about reports that Chinese investors are eyeing weakened Dutch maritime firms, including the role of state aid and risks of takeovers during the COVID-19 crisis. The government denied seeing a rise in such takeovers, pointed to existing protective instruments and forthcoming investment-screening legislation, and committed to monitoring the sector and exploring measures.
The cabinet is developing both sector-specific and generic instruments for this.
Het kabinet ontwikkelt hiervoor zowel sectorspecifiek als generiek instrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over strenge voorwaarden aan staatssteun voor de luchtvaartsector in het perspectief van een sector die stevig moet krimpen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked ministers why state aid to KLM is not conditioned on shrinking aviation to within climate limits, and about stranded assets, Lelystad Airport, job losses and the closed briefing on state holdings. The government answered that conditions for KLM aid are still under negotiation, that climate targets and noise measures will be pursued regardless of aid, that the state's Air France-KLM shares lost value, and that the closed briefing was justified by the company's listed status.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat voetbalclubs met succes een beroep deden op de regeling waarbij de overheid maximaal 9.538 euro van een maandsalaris betaalt

Van Raan (PvdD) asked whether the NOW wage subsidy, capped at twice the maximum daily wage, gave pro football clubs excessive compensation compared with support for self-employed workers, and about pay levels in football. The minister answered that NOW is a wage subsidy to employers to preserve jobs, not individual compensation, that the cap applies equally to all sectors, and that the government lacks detailed salary data for football, giving medians instead.
The UWV, which implements this scheme, does not have information at this level of detail.
Het UWV, dat deze regeling uitvoert, beschikt niet over informatie op dit detailniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over mkb’s die sluiten vanwege hoge toezichtkosten

MP Alkaya asked the Finance Minister whether high DNB supervision costs forcing crypto small businesses to close are acceptable, and whether this conflicts with parliament's motion on small firms and what will be done to relieve the burden. The Minister replied that AML supervision of crypto services is necessary, that costs are spread across registered firms and based on proportionality, and that from 2021 costs will be allocated by turnover, with an earlier evaluation not yet warranted.
However, it is important that supervision is also exercised over this sector.
Het is echter wel belangrijk dat ook op deze sector toezicht wordt gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat andere Europese landen 10 miljard dollar aan belastinginkomsten mislopen door belastingontwijking via Nederland

An SP MP asked the Dutch Finance ministers about a Tax Justice Network report claiming the Netherlands costs other EU countries about $10bn a year in corporate tax through avoidance, and whether Dutch anti-avoidance measures, a withholding tax, and limits on loss deductions would be adopted. The State Secretary disputes the scale of the claim, notes the data's limitations, and lists measures already taken (a withholding tax from 2021, the multilateral instrument, ATAD implementation, loss-deduction limits) while rejecting an unconditional withholding tax and promising a cabinet response to the advisory committee report in summer.
The cabinet considers an unconditional withholding tax undesirable.
Het kabinet acht een onvoorwaardelijke bronbelasting ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Kent over de toepassing van werktijdverkorting en de economische gevolgen van de coronacrisis

MPs Alkaya and Van Kent asked about the uptake and processing of werktijdverkorting applications, UWV capacity, payment delays, and compensation for self-employed workers during the coronavirus crisis. Minister Koolmees answered that the wtv scheme was withdrawn in favour of the NOW scheme run by UWV, that 130,000+ employers had applied, that WW payments remain on time, and that self-employed workers are covered via the Tozo.
Therefore it was decided to withdraw the wtv scheme and to work on introducing and opening the new temporary Emergency Measure for Bridging Employment Retention (NOW).
Daarom is besloten om de wtv-regeling in te trekken, en te werken aan de invoering en openstelling van de nieuwe tijdelijke Noodmaatregel Overbrugging voor Werkbehoud (NOW).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het ECB-beleid

An FvD MP asked the Finance Minister about ECB bond-buying, Italian debt sustainability, potential losses for the Netherlands, and whether ECB purchases amount to monetary financing or eurobonds. The minister answered that the IMF and Commission do not deem Italian debt unsustainable, that Dutch exposure to losses is limited, that ECB purchases are not monetary financing per CJEU rulings, and that joint debt issuance is undesirable.
The total amount of Italian government bonds currently on the Eurosystem's balance sheet under the PEPP is therefore not yet known.
De totale hoeveelheid Italiaanse staatsobligaties die momenteel op de balans van het Eurosysteem onder het PEPP staat is daarom nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Ronnes en Palland over de website coronaverlies

MPs Van Dam, Ronnes and Palland (CDA) asked the government about the website coronaverlies.nl, which offered claim-recovery services to businesses hit by COVID-19, and whether it was a scam exploiting entrepreneurs. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the site is now offline, that it is not for the cabinet to judge whether such services are legitimate, and that victims can file a police report for the Public Prosecution Service to assess.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether services offered on websites such as coronaverlies.nl are legitimate.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of diensten die worden aangeboden op websites als coronaverlies.nl legitiem zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het kabinet met miljarden komt voor KLM

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about a planned state rescue package of up to 4 billion euros for KLM, including its share price, asset and debt values, state aid compliance, bank comparisons, conditions on climate and safety, and timing of answers before a debate. The minister answered most questions substantively, explaining the support as liquidity via guarantees and a loan, citing EU temporary aid rules, and saying conditions were still being finalised before any payment.
The support will only be provided once everything is settled, including the conditions.
De steun wordt pas verstrekt wanneer alles rond is, waaronder de voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sneller over het bericht ‘Verzekeringsreus Aon vraagt personeel om loonoffer van 20% vanwege corona’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Sneller asked whether the government finds it acceptable that insurer Aon requests a 20% pay cut from staff due to COVID-19 while still paying dividends, and what role works councils and unions play. The minister declined to judge individual companies, explained that employees can refuse such requests and that works councils have only advisory or consent rights in limited cases, and noted that pay levels affect NOW subsidies and unemployment benefits.
I do not think it appropriate to go into individual cases.
Ik vind het niet passend om in te gaan op individuele gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over het feit dat vermogensbeheerder BlackRock de Europese Commissie gaat voorzien van advies over duurzaamheidsbeleid bij bankenbeleid op Europees niveau
