SP MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers why the European Commission chose BlackRock, a major investor in fossil fuel companies, to advise on ESG and sustainability in bank regulation, and whether this is a conflict of interest. Minister Hoekstra answered that the contract was awarded through a transparent public tender with nine bids, that expert input is customary, that the Netherlands as a Council member will co-decide EU legislation, and that he sees no reason to intervene in the procurement.
The European Commission awarded the research assignment through a public tender procedure.
De Europese Commissie heeft de onderzoeksopdracht uitgezet via een openbare aanbestedingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Nijboer en Sneller over het uitblijven van resultaten na de aankoop van aandelen van Air France – KLM

MPs asked the Finance Minister about the state's stake in Air France-KLM, IATA board seats, the Franse pilot agreements and KLM dividend policy. The minister answered that IATA matters are for airlines, that the Franco-Dutch talks are ongoing without interim detail, and that KLM's dividend is decided by its supervisory board and priority shareholders.
Besides the fact that Air France-KLM is a listed company, it is also not constructive to share interim information about these talks.
Naast het feit dat Air France-KLM een beursgenoteerde onderneming is, is het ook niet constructief om tussentijds iets te delen over deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het uitstellen van klimaatmaatregelen en het bericht dat de CO2-heffing mogelijk wordt uitgesteld

An MP asked whether the CO2 levy for industry and the aviation tax were being postponed due to the COVID-19 crisis, and how climate and biodiversity goals fit with the economic recovery. The minister denied that the CO2 levy is postponed, said the aviation tax may be delayed under its entry-into-force clause, and gave only general answers on the broader questions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de bonus voor de topman van Air France-KLM

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Air France-KLM tied its CEO's bonus to securing state aid and whether Dutch support would be conditional on bonus, dividend, buyback and sustainability limits, with retroactive effect. The minister said a bonus increase does not fit the crisis, that aid conditions (no bonuses or dividends while aid is outstanding, emissions and night-flight commitments) are being negotiated, and that the Dutch state learned of the bonus proposal only when the AGM documents were published.
Thus the cabinet wants that, if the company receives aid, no bonuses and dividends are paid out as long as the aid has not yet been repaid.
Zo wil het kabinet indien de onderneming steun ontvangt dat er geen bonussen en dividenden worden uitgekeerd zolang de steun aan de onderneming nog niet is terugbetaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitvoering van de aangenomen motie inzake de verruiming van de verliesverrekening van de Vpb

MP Van Haga asked how and when the adopted motion to extend corporate tax loss carry-back and carry-forward periods would be implemented, and which tax year would be first affected. Staatssecretaris Vijlbrief answered that the government instead introduced a fiscal corona reserve in the Besluit noodmaatregelen, to be legislated in Belastingplan 2021, and sees no reason for now to extend the loss-offset periods because they do not quickly improve liquidity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Kwint over verzekeringen in de culturele sector

MPs Alkaya and Kwint asked the ministers of Finance and OCW about insurers refusing payouts to festivals, artists and travel customers during the COVID-19 crisis, and about support for small cultural entrepreneurs and suppliers. The government answered that pandemic losses are often excluded from cover depending on policy terms, that insurers say they will pay event-cancellation claims, and that a support package and talks with insurers are underway, while travel-insurance refusals depend on policy type.
I have no signals that insurers are on a large scale failing to pay out where this is warranted.
Ik heb geen signalen dat verzekeraars op grote schaal niet uitkeren waar dit wel op zijn plaats is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over mogelijke bezuinigingen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether spending cuts would follow the coronavirus crisis, how large they would be, and whether they would hit public services, social schemes or businesses. The minister answered that cuts are not on the table during the crisis, that nothing can be excluded given uncertainty, and that the government will keep assessing fiscal sustainability.
It is still too early to assess how large the effect on public finances will be, and what is needed to reach sound public finances in the longer term.
Het is nog te vroeg om te kunnen beoordelen hoe groot het effect op de overheidsfinanciën zal zijn, en wat nodig is om te komen tot gezonde overheidsfinanciën op langere termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over het bericht 'Ondernemers in krediet-ellende'

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the ministers about reports that small business credit applications face long waits, heavy paperwork and high costs, and whether banks are committed to fast processing for small loans, whether 100% state guarantees or a role for Qredits would help. The state secretary replied that processing times are improving, points to the new small-loan guarantee scheme and optimisations to existing schemes, argues a 100% German-style guarantee is unsuitable for the Netherlands, and notes the reply came late.
The cabinet has also recently announced a separate guarantee scheme for small entrepreneurs with limited credit needs, where the credit assessment process can largely be carried out automatically.

Het kabinet heeft daarnaast recent een aparte garantieregeling aangekondigd voor kleine ondernemers met een beperkte kredietbehoefte, waarbij het kredietbeoordelingsproces grotendeels automatisch kan worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over de planning van het onderzoek budgetneutrale overstap WLTP

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked why the results of the study on budget-neutral WLTP transition would only be shared in July 2020, who would conduct it, and how independence is guaranteed, following a motion requesting an independent review by early summer. The state secretary answers that the timing was an estimate of the time needed, names Prof. C. Koopmans (SEO, VU) as independent second-opinion reviewer, and sets out the research questions, including macro and top-ten-car budget neutrality, with a request to complete it before 1 June 2020.
Prof. dr. C. Koopmans will carry out an independent review, in the form of a second opinion, of the budget-neutral conversion of the bpm table to CO2 emissions under the WLTP test method.
Prof. dr. C. Koopmans zal in de vorm van een second opinion een onafhankelijke toets uitvoeren op de budgettair neutrale omzetting van de bpm-tabel naar de CO 2 -uitstoot volgens de WLTP-testmethode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Groothuizen overde gevolgen van de Luanda Leaks voor Nederlandse bedrijven en beleid

MPs Sneller and Groothuizen asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the consequences of the Luanda Leaks for Dutch firms and policy, including trust offices, Dutch shell companies, consultancy due diligence and anti-corruption enforcement. The minister answered most questions substantively but declined to say whether investigations are ongoing, citing the prosecution service and FIOD procedures, and promised to study trust-sector evasion and the government procurement leverage.
I cannot go into questions concerning what the Public Prosecution Service, the FIOD and supervisors are doing in terms of (whether or not) ongoing investigations.
Ik kan niet ingaan op vragen die zien op hetgeen door het OM, de FIOD en toezichthouders wordt gedaan in de zin van (al dan niet) lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans (WAB) voor werknemers die gevraagd worden om als zzp’er verder te werken

MP Van Weyenberg asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about reports that workers were asked to continue their work as self-employed contractors after the WAB took effect, and about enforcement via the Belastingdienst and where affected workers can report it. The minister answered that no trend data exists yet, a quick scan is underway, that employers may generally structure relationships within law but cannot force self-employment against an employee's will, and pointed to inspection and reporting channels, with a half-yearly enforcement report promised.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this in May or June.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer hierover in mei of juni te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de dwangsom bij niet tijdig beslissen door de overheid

SP MPs asked whether the government should decide on time, whether the penalty-for-delay (dwangsom) regime still works as intended, why the Tax Administration has a different regime, and how much penalties were paid out in 2015-2019 per organisation. The minister agreed timely decisions matter, reported the regime has a preventive effect with some side effects, explained the Tax Administration's separate rules, and gave incomplete, non-uniform payment figures while noting the IND's sharp rise.
It turned out that these figures are not kept everywhere or in a uniform way.
Gebleken is dat deze cijfers niet overal en niet uniform worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Leijten over de berichten dat grootschalige kapitaalverschaffing aan banken een risico vormen voor de stabiliteit van de (Europese) bankensector

MPs Van Raan and Leijten asked the Finance Minister whether ECB liquidity support to banks and shadow banks, repo funding and the ban on monetary financing create risks to financial stability and fairness during the COVID-19 crisis. The minister answered that the ECB's measures are within its independent monetary mandate, that the ECB monitors risks, that monetary financing of governments is prohibited and that the EU's 500 billion euro package and Commission funds are the chosen route for support.
In addition, the ECB continuously monitors the financial system to detect potential risks and vulnerabilities early.
Daarnaast monitort de ECB voortdurend het financiële systeem om potentiele risico's en kwetsbaarheden vroegtijdig te detecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht dat er een bankrun gaande is binnen de financiële sector

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked the Finance Minister about a reported bank run, the ECB's bond-buying and its effects on inequality, state aid reaching banks rather than households and firms, a temporary cap on overdraft rates, the role of private banks and a public money or digital central bank currency, and inequality from the crisis response. The minister answered that the ECB sets its own monetary instruments, that aid reaches firms via guarantees and direct schemes, that overdraft rates were urged down by banks, and that the government aims for balanced income distribution.
It is up to the ECB to decide independently on the most effective and efficient approach to achieve its price stability mandate.
Het is aan de ECB om onafhankelijk te beslissen over de meest doeltreffende en doelmatige benadering om haar mandaat op prijsstabiliteit te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor het urencriterium, de zelfstandigenaftrek en de startersaftrek

An MP asked whether the government could relax the 1,225-hour test for the self-employed deduction and starter deduction given COVID-19 lockdown effects, and whether it would use crisis-year leniency as in 2009-2010. The Secretary of State answered that the government will relax the test by treating entrepreneurs as having worked 24 hours per week from 1 March to 31 May 2020, and that the questions were answered late due to ongoing studies.

The cabinet has however preferred a variant under which an entrepreneur in the period from 1 March 2020 to 31 May 2020 is deemed to have spent at least 24 hours per week on his business, even if he did not actually spend those hours.

Het kabinet heeft echter de voorkeur gegeven aan een variant waarbij een ondernemer in de periode van 1 maart 2020 tot en met 31 mei 2020 geacht wordt ten minste 24 uren per week aan zijn onderneming te hebben besteed, ook als hij die uren niet daadwerkelijk heeft besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Futselaar en Alkaya over ondersteuning voor zelfstandigen en de culturele sector

MPs Kwint, Futselaar and Alkaya asked the government about support for self-employed workers and the cultural sector during the COVID-19 crisis, including eligibility criteria, compensation for cancelled events, and a guarantee fund. The government answered that existing general measures apply, cited extra funding of 300 million euro for culture, and explained why certain sectors were included or excluded from the TOGS scheme.
On Tuesday 7 April the extension to non-food retail and a second extension were communicated to the House.
Op dinsdag 7 april jl. is de uitbreiding met non-food retail en nog een tweede uitbreiding aan uw Kamer gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Renkema, Kröger, Diks en Snels over de coronacrisis

GroenLinks MPs asked the government about COVID-19 testing supplies (the Roche lysis buffer recipe and shortages), protective equipment, support for healthcare and other vital workers, homeless shelter rules, transport measures, and international debt relief and aid for developing countries. The minister answered in detail: the Roche recipe was made available to government, testing capacity is being coordinated through a taskforce and special envoy, and Nederland committed EUR 100 million to COVID-19 response in developing countries.
One of the first concrete results of the Special Envoy's efforts is that the company Roche has made the recipe available to the government.
Eén van de eerste concrete resultaten van de inzet van de Speciaal Gezant is dat de firma Roche het recept ter beschikking heeft gesteld aan de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Taxibedrijven kunnen fluiten naar 4.000 euro tegemoetkoming’

An SP MP asked the ministers about the COVID-19 impact on the taxi sector, including whether a ban on taxi travel should apply, payment of school and medical transport, support for self-employed drivers, and protective equipment. The State Secretary answered most questions in substance, referring some to municipalities and health insurers, and said the answer to question 11 could not be given by the 7 April deadline.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Krol, Sazias, Van Brenk en Van Otterloo over alle berichtgeving omtrent het coronavirus

Four 50PLUS MPs asked a range of questions about COVID-19 coverage, care for the elderly and family carers, unemployment benefits, the economy and EU financing, and emergency powers and enforcement. The government answered most questions substantively, commits to several concrete steps, and declines to say whether a state of emergency will be declared, pointing instead to ordinary crisis structures.
The cabinet took a decision on this on Tuesday 31 March.
Het kabinet heeft hier op dinsdag 31 maart jl. een besluit over genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Nederland dankzij Belgen al twee jaar niet vertegenwoordigd in EIB-top»

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the Benelux vice-presidency of the European Investment Bank being vacant for two years, its consequences for Dutch projects and what the government will do to fill it. The minister says the vacancy is undesirable, that Nederland keeps pressing Belgium for a quick nomination, that the nomination process cannot be accelerated beyond the statutes, and that the Netherlands will keep raising the issue bilaterally.

For the Benelux, and therefore for the Netherlands, the absence of a vice-president is undesirable, and that is why the cabinet has for some time been urging Belgium to make a nomination as soon as possible.

Voor de Benelux, dus ook voor Nederland, is het uitblijven van een vicepresident niet wenselijk en daarom dringt het kabinet er al enige tijd bij België op aan dat er zo snel mogelijk een voordracht wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van der Graaf over het weigeren door Knab van religieuze organisaties als zakelijke klant

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked whether Knab's policy of refusing religious organisations as business clients complies with Dutch and European anti-discrimination and anti-money-laundering rules, and what can be done for those affected. The government answered that the Wwft does not allow refusing a whole category of clients without an individual risk assessment, that assessing discrimination is not for the cabinet, and that affected organisations can use the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, anti-discrimination bodies, courts or Kifid.
Under the Wwft, banks are not permitted to refuse an entire type of organisation as a client across the board.
Het is banken op grond van de Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme (Wwft) niet toegestaan om een bepaald type organisatie integraal als klant te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Schonis over het meenemen van schadevrije jaren voor autoverzekeringen binnen de Europese Unie

MPs Sneller and Schonis asked the Finance Minister whether no-claims years (schadevrije jaren) for car insurance can be carried across EU member states and whether they should be harmonised, given that people moving to another EU state may pay higher premiums. The minister answered that insurers set their own risk weighting, that cross-border no-claims statements are mandatory but applied differently per country, and that EU-wide harmonisation is not desirable, while the related claims-history form is being negotiated in the MID revision.
I will continue the consultation jointly with the parties involved to examine further whether they can reach a solution and how.
Ik zal met de betrokken partijen gezamenlijk het overleg verder voeren om nader te onderzoeken of de partijen tot een oplossing kunnen komen en op welke wijze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de belastingen voor woningcorporaties die Vestia willen helpen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about tax and policy measures for housing corporations, including the Vestia rescue, the transfer of Vestia homes to other corporations, property transfer tax exemptions and the Tweebosbuurt case. The minister answered that a Vestia housing transfer study is pending, that abolishing the rental levy only for corporations is not an option, and declined to comment on several local or ongoing legal matters.
This concerns a local matter on which Vestia must weigh considerations in consultation with the municipality.
Het betreft hier een lokale aangelegenheid waarover Vestia in samenspraak met de gemeente een afweging moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de spoedbijeenkomst van de Eurogroep van 24 maart naar aanleiding van de geannoteerde agenda

An MP (Leijten, SP) asks the Finance Minister about the 24 March 2020 extraordinary Eurogroup meeting, including whether irreversible steps on EMU deepening are being taken, the use of the general escape clause and ESM conditionality, and the coordination of economic measures against COVID-19. The Minister answers that no irreversible EMU steps were taken, that the escape clause is an existing SGP provision the Netherlands supports, that no new ESM mandate is needed, and that coordination follows existing Council and Eurogroup processes.
No irreversible steps have been taken regarding the deepening of the Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).
Hierbij zijn geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet aangaande de verdieping van de Economische en Monetaire Unie (EMU).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over de gevolgen van het coronavirus en de dalende olieprijzen op de economie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs how the coronavirus and falling oil prices will affect the economy, whether governments should act themselves, and about stimulus plans in Germany, France, Italy and Spain, mortgage relief, the investment fund and support for small businesses. The minister answered that the impact is not yet predictable, that the government is taking measures such as short-time work and liquidity support, and that further measures will follow if needed.
Depending on developments, the cabinet will take necessary and appropriate follow-up measures if the situation so requires.
Afhankelijk van de ontwikkelingen zal het kabinet noodzakelijke en passende vervolgmaatregelen treffen indien de situatie daartoe noopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het monitoren van mogelijke liquiditeitsproblemen in de financiële sector als gevolg van COVID-19

An MP asked the Finance Minister about short-selling bans and liquidity monitoring in the financial sector during COVID-19, including how DNB and AFM would use regulatory flexibility. The minister answered that the AFM sees no reason for a short-selling ban now, explained the available tools, described DNB's temporary capital relief measures, and said the ministry monitors the sector closely with DNB and AFM.
The AFM, however, sees no reason to date to take measures against short selling.
De AFM ziet tot op heden echter geen aanleiding tot het nemen van maatregelen tegen short selling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over een economisch stimuleringspakket om de gevolgen van het coronavirus zoveel mogelijk op te vangen

Labour MP Asscher asked the Finance Minister whether he would adopt a broad economic stimulus package against the coronavirus, including sector-specific and vulnerable-group measures and a rescue fund, and asked for a reply before the next day. Minister Hoekstra answered that the government is taking far-reaching measures, referred to two earlier letters to parliament for details, and said the emergency package implements the Asscher motion.
That is why on 12 and 17 March two letters to parliament announced far-reaching measures to address the economic consequences of the virus.
Daarom zijn op 12 en 17 maart jl. in twee Kamerbrieven vergaande maatregelen aangekondigd om de economische gevolgen van het virus te ondervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de berichten ‘Royal Floraholland: sierteeltsector ongekend hard geraakt’ en ‘Coronavirus treft vooral logistiek en sierteelt hard

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether she was aware of reports that the flower sector was hit hard by the coronavirus, what steps were being taken on trade impact, credit guarantees, support for affected firms, and sector-specific measures. The minister answered that ongoing contact with sector representatives continues, that expanded guarantee schemes and tax payment deferrals are available to all firms including flower growers, and that she will ask the European Commission for market-support measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen, Beckerman en Alkaya over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis op huishoudens

Three SP MPs asked the government how it monitors the economic effects of the coronavirus on households, and whether utilities, landlords, mortgage lenders, the Waarborgfonds and the NHG should suspend evictions, disconnections and payments. The minister answered that utilities will not disconnect for arrears, evictions are postponed during the crisis by agreement with landlords, existing income and rent support measures are pointed to, and emergency support for homeless people is being arranged with municipalities.
Landlords have agreed as a common line that evictions will be postponed for the time being during the crisis period, unless there are evident reasons such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance.

Er is met de verhuurders als gezamenlijke lijn afgesproken dat huisuitzettingen voorlopig worden uitgesteld gedurende de crisisperiode, tenzij er evidente redenen zijn, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Overheid is te slap tegen witwassen’

An MP from the VVD asked the Justice and Finance Ministers whether the state is too weak against money laundering, citing criticism from the NOB and Transparency International, and questioned FIU capacity (19 FTE), the judicial capacity bottleneck and the implementation of a motion on stricter penalties. The minister replied that capacity has been increased through funding and public-private cooperation, that the extra funds were not used for structural FIU expansion, and that the motion will be considered in an ongoing evaluation of the Wet verruiming mogelijkheden bestrijding financieel-economische criminaliteit.

As also indicated in the progress letter on the money laundering action plan, the implementation of the motion will be taken into account in assessing the outcomes of the ongoing evaluation of the act.
Zoals ook in de voortgangsbrief over het plan van aanpak witwassen is aangegeven, zal de uitvoering van de motie worden betrokken bij de beoordeling van de uitkomsten van de lopende evaluatie
Antwoord op vragen de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht dat banken het mkb leegmelken

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked whether banks may unilaterally raise interest margins on SME loans, including for sector-wide risk, and what has improved since the banking sector's self-regulation. The minister answered that such changes are allowed under contract terms and the 2018 Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering, that information duties are now set, that complaints to Kifid about such changes are absent, and that the code will be evaluated in 2021.
I have no figures on the extent to which banks do this.
Ik heb geen cijfers over in hoeverre banken dat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat banken het mkb leegmelken

SP MP Alkaya asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that banks are squeezing SMEs through interest margin increases, asking about justification, legitimacy, the scope of the Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering and AFM oversight. Minister Hoekstra answered that banks must communicate margin changes under the code, that margins can reflect generic or client-specific risk, and that the code will be evaluated in 2021 with possible tightening if information is inadequate.
I will ask the NVB to pay attention to including interest margins in the evaluation of the Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering in 2021 mentioned above.
Ik zal bij de NVB aandacht vragen voor het meenemen van renteopslagen in de hierboven genoemde evaluatie van de Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de inzet van het ESM en Eurobonds

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister whether the ESM should be deployed and whether eurobonds should be issued to counter turbulence in Italian and Spanish government bond markets during the COVID-19 crisis. The minister answered that the ESM is available on request under strict conditionality, that joint eurozone debt issuance is undesirable, and that the Eurogroup will meet more often with the Commission and other finance ministers, with information to parliament through regular channels.
Your House will be informed about this through regular channels.
Uw Kamer zal hierover via reguliere kanalen worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over ‘de economische gevolgen van het coronavirus’

MPs from the PvdA asked the government about the economic effects of the coronavirus, including supply and demand shocks, short-time work, public investment, support for small businesses, and comparisons with Germany and Italy. The government answered that it is monitoring the situation, has announced a noodpakket of support measures (NOW wage subsidy, BMKB loan guarantees, tax deferrals, self-employed support), says a robust forecast is not yet possible, and defers further details to a CPB scenario publication.
The cabinet of course closely monitors economic developments.
Het kabinet houdt de economische ontwikkelingen vanzelfsprekend nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Nederlandse investeringen in dierenleed

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether Dutch banks, including ABN AMRO and ING, finance animal welfare-harming meat producers such as WH Group and MHP, and how the government will respond. The minister says he lacks insight into the companies financed, expects banks to apply OECD and UN due diligence standards, notes ABN AMRO is bound by law and its board is responsible, and states that bank financing choices are their own responsibility while pointing to the IMVO convenants and a forthcoming animal welfare framework.
I have no insight into the companies that banks finance and the extent to which animal welfare standards are complied with within those companies.
Ik heb geen inzage in de bedrijven die banken financieren en de mate waarin dierenwelzijnsstandaarden binnen die bedrijven worden nageleefd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Weyenberg en Lodders over banken die op grond van de FATCA-wetgeving financiële dienstverlening weigeren aan Nederlanders met (ook) de Amerikaanse nationaliteit

Three MPs asked whether banks may block or close accounts of Dutch citizens who also hold US nationality (Accidental Americans) for lacking a US TIN under FATCA, and what the government will do. The Secretary of State answers that closure is not required by FATCA or the IGA, that supervisors DNB and AFM apply case-by-case rules, that no closures had yet occurred, and that the government keeps pressing the US for solutions while declining to restrict data exchange unilaterally.
I am aware of what my predecessor wrote to the House.
Ik ben bekend met hetgeen mijn ambtsvoorganger aan uw Kamer heeft geschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over verworven rechten in de huurtoeslag

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Ronnes, CDA) asked about the Supreme Court-era ruling that lost acquired rights to rent allowance (huurtoeslag) can revive, and why the Tax Administration did not disclose that an automation error had applied a different practice from 2012 to 2017 affecting about 185 households in 2017 and an unknown number elsewhere. The State Secretary answered that the error was discovered and corrected only for 2017, that the figures were not fully known, that communication was late, and that the government will examine how the Council of State ruling can apply retroactively to the remaining households, reporting back by May.
Due to the duty of confidentiality, I cannot address individual cases.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting kan ik niet op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht dat ontwikkelingsgeld van de Wereldbank deels bij belastingparadijzen belandt

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether World Bank aid to 22 highly aid-dependent countries is leaking to tax havens, how widespread this is, which countries and elites are involved, and what the government will do. The minister acknowledges concern, notes the study is preliminary and not causal, describes Dutch and World Bank anti-corruption measures, and says the findings will be used to push for stronger action, without announcing a policy change.
It does not lend itself to drawing conclusions about individual countries, specific persons or bilateral aid flows.
Het leent zich niet om conclusies te trekken over individuele landen, specifieke personen of bilaterale hulpstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de cofinanciering door ING van een Indonesische kolencentrale

MP Van Raan asks the ministers whether ING's financing of a new Indonesian coal plant in Cirebon breaches international responsible business standards, whether ING should have refused the contract and handle complaints from local NGOs, and how this fits with climate goals. The government answers that banks are expected to follow the OECD guidelines and UN guiding principles, that ING monitors projects and handles complaints under the banking covenant, that binding measures are being considered, and that ING intends to phase out coal financing, while declining to judge ING's specific case.
I expect ING (and other banks) to take investigations such as the FFGI study into account in their considerations.
Ik verwacht van ING (en andere banken) dat zij onderzoeken zoals het onderzoek van FFGI meenemen in hun afwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de daadwerkelijke inkomensongelijkheid in Nederland

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister about actual income inequality in the Netherlands, including a critique of the official income statistics, wealth inequality, regressivity of taxes and whether the government will change how inequality is measured. The minister partly disputes the article's assumptions, defends CBS conventions, says wealth inequality is not a policy target, and declines to change the measurement method.
I am aware of the article. I agree that wealth is distributed more unequally than income.
Ik ben bekend met het artikel. Ik onderschrijf dat vermogens ongelijker verdeeld zijn dan inkomens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten inzake CAF onderzoeken bij de inkomstenbelasting

SP MP Leijten asked about the CAF (Commissie Afzonderlijk Fiscaal?) fraud investigations at the tax authority, including the Hoorn case of tax consultants accused of systemic fraud, the reversed burden of proof, algorithmic risk selection, and remedies for consultants. The state secretary declined to discuss individual cases citing confidentiality, explained that risk signals are only starting points and are checked by staff, noted civil and criminal remedies and the 2019 algorithm oversight report, but did not commit to new measures.
Due to the confidentiality obligation in article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot address the specific circumstances of individual cases.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op de concrete omstandigheden van specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht inzake SGP flexibiliteit voor Italië

MP Slootweg asked the Finance Minister about reports that Italy seeks more flexibility under the Stability and Growth Pact to address COVID-19 economic effects, the flexibility Italy received in past crises, and EU/Eurogroup financial measures. The minister confirmed Italy's request is pending with the Commission, listed past flexibility clauses, outlined Eurogroup and Commission measures, and pointed to the meeting minutes.
It is now up to the European Commission to assess this request.
Het is nu aan de Europese Commissie om dit verzoek te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Leijten en Futselaar over nieuwe berichten van belangenverstrengeling en corruptie in het falende Europese Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid (GLB)

MPs Leijten and Futselaar asked whether EU agricultural subsidies enabled fraud and oligarch enrichment, citing reports on Czech PM Babiš and Italian mafia fraud, and whether the CAP should be cut and capped. The minister called the allegations serious, said the Commission should investigate, declined to comment on individual cases, denied that CAP subsidies destroyed markets for small farmers, and said the Netherlands favours a smaller MFF and a cap on support per farm.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual cases under ongoing investigation.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen waarnaar onderzoek nog lopende is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ronnes en Amhaouch over de problemen bij Centric en Oranjewoud

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about governance problems at Centric, Oranjewoud and Strukton, including an unlicensed investigator, the departure of Centric's top management, and board supervision. The government answered that Centric's services to DNB and BNG are unaffected for now, that no investigator licence exists, that FIOD received and declined to treat a complaint due to criminal proceedings, and explained the legal duties of supervisory boards, while noting the answers were delayed.
Due to overlap with investigation and prosecution under article 9:8(1)(f) of the General Administrative Law Act, this complaint, in consultation with the Public Prosecution Service, was not handled.
Wegens samenloop met opsporing en vervolging conform art. 9:8 lid 1 onderdeel f Awb is deze klacht, in afstemming met het Openbaar Ministerie, niet in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over ongunstige fiscale regels voor de landbouw

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked about unfavourable tax rules for farmers facing volatile incomes from drought and animal disease, comparisons with Belgium, France, Denmark and Ireland, and whether a tax-free climate reserve or wider use of the reinvestment reserve is possible. The state secretary pointed to income averaging, loss relief, the tax exemption for broad weather insurance, and a sector proposal on a climate reserve that is still being studied.
The proposal was sent by the sector representatives on 16 January 2020 and will be studied further.
Het voorstel is op 16 januari 2020 door de vertegenwoordigers van de sector toegezonden en zal nader worden bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Groothuizen over hoe Nederlandse bedrijven een mogelijk zeer schadelijke rol spelen bij uitbuiten van Angola

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers how Dutch companies and shell companies may have helped drain Angolan state funds, and what tools exist to tackle foreign bribery, consultancy oversight, and corporate liability. The government answered that existing criminal law is adequate, that investigations are ongoing and cannot be discussed, that trust-office rules and consultancy regulation are under review, and that it will study a remediation programme for companies.
I cannot make statements about any ongoing investigations.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over eventuele lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Diks over de over recente berichtgeving omtrent het Marginal da Corimba-project in Angola

MPs Snels and Diks asked about press reports on the Marginal da Corimba project in Angola, including Atradius export credit insurance due diligence, forced evictions, the Dutch embassy's knowledge, trust office supervision and Dutch anti-bribery enforcement. The state secretary answered that the state's involvement in the evictions could not be established, that due diligence did not include commercial pricing, and that the government would evaluate CSR policy and enforcement measures, with some questions referred to later reports.
Based on its own investigation, the Dutch state has not been found to be directly involved, via Atradius DSB, in the alleged human rights violations in June 2013 in Luanda.
Op basis van eigen onderzoek is niet gebleken dat de Nederlandse staat via Atradius DSB rechtstreeks betrokken is bij de vermeende mensenrechtenschendingen in juni 2013 in Luanda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over leeftijdsdiscriminatie bij WA- en VC-autoverzekeringen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Finance and Justice ministers about age-based surcharges and age limits in car insurance, citing evidence that older drivers cause less damage yet pay more premiums, and asked whether this is unlawful age discrimination and what action will be taken. The minister said insurers set their own risk models, that insurance is cancellable so consumers can switch, that the government will not judge insurer contracts or prescribe discounts, and that the discrimination question is for civil courts, Kifid or insurers' complaint procedures, not the Human Rights Commission.
It is not for me to assess whether there is unjustified distinction in car insurance.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of er bij autoverzekeringen sprake is van ongerechtvaardigd onderscheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over erfpacht in Amsterdam

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers for Environment and Housing and for Finance about leasehold (erfpacht) in Amsterdam, including sudden canon increases, the residual land-value method, unclear information for leaseholders, and consumer protection. The ministers answered that leasehold is a property right rather than a financial product, that Amsterdam offers conversion schemes and a three-expert procedure, and that existing local oversight and dispute mechanisms apply.
Leasehold is therefore not comparable to a predatory insurance policy.
Erfpacht is derhalve niet vergelijkbaar met een woekerpolis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst heeft geen btw-id voor starters: 'Ik zit weken op zwart zaad'

Two VVD MPs asked why startup sole traders were waiting weeks for VAT identification numbers and what the government would do about backlogs, staffing and the Belastingtelefoon. The State Secretary answered that the two-week target is not being met for some, that backlogs have been cleared, that extra capacity was deployed, and that the new number system was introduced for privacy reasons with a fully new system timing still undetermined.
There is currently no exact date that can be given for when the entirely new system will be built and implemented.
Er is op dit moment nog geen exacte datum aan te geven wanneer het geheel nieuwe systeem gebouwd en geïmplementeerd gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Van Otterloo over het bericht ‘Ouderen onwetend over huurtoeslag; ANBO schiet te hulp’

Two 50PLUS MPs asked the ministers about reports that many seniors do not claim housing and care allowances and whether the government has acted on the 2018 Krol motion. The minister says non-take-up is being addressed through information campaigns with pensioner organisations, expects a reaction to the IBO report in Q1 2020, and says CPB models do not account for non-take-up.
From the Ministry of BZK an information text will be distributed to various organisations with the request to pay attention to it via their own websites and magazines.

Vanuit het Ministerie van BZK zal een voorlichtingstekst naar verschillende organisaties worden verspreid met het verzoek hier via bijvoorbeeld de eigen websites en magazines aandacht aan te besteden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘European Banking Authority plans overhaul of EU bank stress test'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about EBA proposals to restructure the EU bank stress test, including a bank-run component with more room for banks' own models, and whether this weakens supervision. The minister explained the two-component idea, said the supervisory leg remains the starting point for capital requirements, stressed that the proposal is only a consultation, and said the new approach would apply from 2022 at the earliest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht dat ANBI’s belastingregels niet naleven

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that charities with ANBI status do not comply with tax rules, including how many are checked, the criteria, and the process for granting or revoking status. The answers describe limited inspection capacity, periodic checks of publication duties with status revocations, and a planned law change on the integrity requirement, but say no full annual control or per-year breakdown is available.
A breakdown per year is not available.
Een overzicht per jaar is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Nederland een belastingparadijs is voor organisaties die een «algemeen nut» dienen, omdat ze moeilijk te controleren zijn

An MP asked why many ANBI charities fail legal requirements, such as publishing annual accounts, and why the Tax Authority does not enforce this more strictly. The State Secretary answered that oversight is risk-based and resources are limited, that non-compliance does not automatically mean loss of ANBI status, and that a central portal is a possible future ICT addition.
Failing to meet the publication obligation also does not directly lead to revocation.
Het niet voldoen aan de publicatieplicht leidt ook niet direct tot een intrekking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Gehandicapte mag werkbonus nog steeds niet houden, Kamerleden boos'

Two VVD MPs asked why a disabled worker (Wajong recipient) must hand a 12.5-year service bonus to UWV and whether the Wet LB 1964 could be amended for this group, and whether alternatives will be explored. The State Secretary answered that the bonus counts as wage and is offset against the Wajong benefit, that amending the Wet LB 1964 is not the appropriate instrument, and that a harmonised income rule keeps at least 30 percent of extras while UWV lacks reliable data to exempt them fully.
A one-off payment after at least 12.5 years of service is wage within the meaning of the Wet LB 1964 and therefore falls under the income concept.
Een eenmalige verstrekking bij ten minste 12,5 jaar in dienst is loon in de zin van de Wet LB 1964 en valt daarmee onder het inkomensbegrip
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over miljonairs tegen belastingontwijking en voor hogere belastingen

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about a petition by wealthy individuals calling for higher taxes on the very rich and action against tax avoidance, and whether the cabinet supports it. The government answered that it combats tax avoidance as a priority and taxes high incomes more heavily, but sees no need for further tax increases on the very rich in the Dutch context, and gave detailed answers on tax avoidance, wealth inequality and box 2.
The cabinet considers it important that everyone in the Netherlands benefits from economic growth.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat iedereen in Nederland profiteert van de economische groei.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Sienot en Lodders over het bericht dat de prijs van elektriciteit van snelladers wordt verhoogd naar 79 cent/kWH voor passanten

MPs asked whether the government will investigate market power and cartel formation among fast-charger operators after Ionity raised guest charging prices to 79 cent/kWh, and whether a maximum price should be set. The government answered that ACM is independent and has heightened attention for the sector, that the market is open and competitive, and that a maximum price is not currently under consideration.
The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is an independent regulator.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over de nieuwe Kleine Ondernemersregeling (KOR)

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked the State Secretary for Finance about the low uptake of the new small-business VAT scheme (KOR), the basis for the 200,000 estimate, the lack of VAT on invoices, the EUR 20,000 threshold and the three-year lock-in, and whether the scheme would be adjusted. The State Secretary answered that the scheme is an administrative simplification, that the threshold was chosen for budget neutrality, that uptake will only be assessed in an evaluation in 2021, and that no change is currently planned.

As indicated in the answer to question 6, it can only be determined after the announced evaluation to what extent the number of registered entrepreneurs (positively or negatively) deviates from the expected number and what the possible cause is.

Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 6 kan pas na afloop van de aangekondigde evaluatie vastgesteld worden in hoeverre het aantal aangemelde ondernemers (positief of negatief) afwijkt van het verwachte aantal en wat daar mogelijk de oorzaak van is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Europe braces for new fiscal battles'

MP Aukje de Vries asks the Finance Minister about proposals reported by the Financial Times to make EU fiscal rules more symmetrical and to exempt green spending, and about enforcement and reform of the Stability and Growth Pact. The minister answers that the Commission has made no concrete proposals yet, that the government questions a green golden rule, and that it will not accept any change to the Pact before it is submitted to parliament, with an appraisal promised once the Commission's evaluation is published.
If not, why not? The cabinet is of the view that a number of member states have done too little to strengthen public finances in both good and bad times.
Het kabinet is van mening dat een aantal lidstaten zowel in goede als in slechte tijden onvoldoende heeft gedaan om de overheidsfinanciën te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de aangekondigde evaluatie van het monetaire beleid

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the ECB's announced evaluation of its monetary policy strategy, including its consequences, the role of Dutch bodies and Eurogroup/Ecofin, whether the government would contribute, the effects on Dutch pension funds, housing and savings rates, and whether the ECB's mandate is being stretched (e.g. climate). The minister answered that the evaluation concerns how the mandate is implemented, not the mandate itself, that the ECB is independent and the government will not contribute input, and that the role of other bodies and their input is still unclear.
The cabinet will therefore not contribute any input to the evaluation.
Het kabinet zal dan ook geen inbreng leveren op de evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Omtzigt over eHerkenning

Two MPs (Bruins and Omtzigt) asked the government about eHerkenning, the electronic login required for tax filing by legal entities, including whether foreign organisations, churches and small entities are excluded and whether the rollout is legally and availability-wise sound. The State Secretary answered at length, largely defending the scheme, outlining workarounds for excluded groups and promising a study on availability and interim reports before summer, while not answering all questions one by one.
Due to the care required in answering, and the need for further coordination with the Minister of BZK, it proved not feasible to answer these questions one by one and by 31 January 2020.

In verband met de zorgvuldigheid van de beantwoording, waarvoor ook nadere afstemming met de Minister van BZK noodzakelijk was, is het niet haalbaar gebleken om deze vragen één voor één en voor 31 januari 2020 te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de verzekering van zonnepanelen

PvdA MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether high insurance premiums are hindering solar panel installation, whether the government should intervene if private parties do not solve the insurance problem, and what rules govern fire safety and location choice. Minister Wiebes answered that the effect of premiums is unknown but likely small, that talks with insurers are constructive so no larger government role is planned, that fire safety rules exist and a standards review has started, and that the government supports prioritising rooftops in regional planning.
I have no information on the extent to which the level of insurance premiums hinders the installation of solar panels.
Ik heb geen informatie over in hoeverre de hoogte van verzekeringspremies belemmerend werkt op de aanleg van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Middendorp en Aartsen over de eHerkenning en het artikel ‘MKB en VNO-NCW: gedupeerden nieuw aangiftesysteem compenseren’

MPs Lodders, Middendorp and Aartsen (VVD) asked the Finance, Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about internal resistance at the Tax Administration to eHerkenning, its costs, the fate of about 60,000 businesses lacking a suitable login, and whether small firms can keep filing free. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that concerns were addressed, that about 540 organisations cannot obtain eHerkenning, that proactive deadline extensions and an older portal for VAT remain, and that a further letter on support for small firms would follow.
The Tax Administration proactively grants extensions to employer-liable businesses that are legal entities and last filed via the old business portal.

De Belastingdienst verleent proactief uitstel voor ondernemers die aangifteplichtig zijn voor de loonheffingen, rechtspersoon zijn en hun laatst ingediende aangifte hebben gedaan via het oude ondernemersportaal van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het nog zeker een jaar gaat duren tot de toeslagenaffaire is opgelost

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that the childcare benefits (toeslagen) affair could take another year to resolve, and about compensation, verjaring, case handling and how ministry contact with affected parents was arranged. The government answered that files will be handled step by step with speed and care, promised a progress letter after the Donner and ADR reports, and said the ministry did not steer parents' contact with the media.
I undertake to send your House a progress letter to this group of parents after the final Donner Commission report, the ADR report and the cabinet's response to them.
Ik zeg uw Kamer toe aan deze groep ouders, na het uitkomen van het eindrapport van de Commissie Donner het rapport van de ADR en de kabinetsreactie daarop, een voortgangsbrief te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de samenwerking van het ministerie van Financiën met kinderopvangbranchevereniging BOinK

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about the ministry's engagement of parents' organisation BOinK to select and host affected parents of the childcare benefits scandal, including a press restriction and the basis for the collaboration. The government replied there is no formal agreement with BOinK, explained the selection and collaboration, and said it does not track all contacts with the organisation.
I do not have figures on how often BOinK has been spoken with about the suspension and recovery of childcare benefits.
Ik beschik niet over aantallen hoe vaak er met BOinK gesproken is over het stopzetten en terugvorderen van de kinderopvangtoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de spaarrente van 0%

An SGP MP asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO's move to a 0% savings rate for ordinary savers and charging wealthy savers was in line with prior talks with banks, whether savings should be protected from zero or negative rates, what it means for saver willingness to keep saving, whether other banks will follow, and whether talks with banks continue. The minister answered that he expects banks to avoid negative rates for small savers, that he will monitor developments and revisit the matter (even considering legislation) if access to non-negative-rate banks is significantly restricted, and that a Box 3 reform bill is planned before summer 2020.

If the options for ordinary savers to bank with a bank that does not charge negative interest are significantly restricted, I will take up the matter again and, where appropriate, consider legislation.

Indien de mogelijkheden voor gewone spaarders om te bankieren bij een bank die geen negatieve rente rekent significant worden beperkt, dan zal ik het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand nemen, en indien opportuun ook wetgeving overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sneller over het bericht ‘Financiële sector loopt miljarden mis door focus op de man als klant’

Two MPs (D66) asked the Finance Minister about a report that the financial sector misses large sums by focusing on men as customers, including gender differences in products, lending and advice. The minister said a broader focus on women is plausible and commercially sensible, noted that advisers must consider relevant life circumstances, and said he will address the issue within the Consumer Choices Action Plan.
I will also address this point within the framework of the Consumer Choices Action Plan.
Ik zal dit punt ook in het kader van het Actieplan Consumentenkeuzes adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over box 2 als klusbox

An MP asks the Finance Minister about box 2 of the Dutch tax system, focusing on directors' profit retention, tax planning, borrowing from their own company, and macro-economic and fairness effects. The minister acknowledges the DNB analysis, says fiscally driven profit retention is a possible problem to be examined in the building-blocks study, notes the planned excessive-lending bill, and gives partial figures while declining to break down loan uses.
Alongside the elaboration of this measure, the building-blocks study will further examine the desirability of the possibility to borrow from one's own company.
Naast de uitwerking van deze maatregel wordt in het bouwstenenonderzoek de wenselijkheid van de mogelijkheid tot lenen van de eigen vennootschap nader onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “European Taxpayers Once Again Are Bailing Out Bankers”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Bloomberg article on taxpayers bailing out banks, including the EU approval of state support for NordLB and several other bank rescues. The minister answered that bail-in by shareholders and creditors comes first, explained how bail-in rules were applied in each case, and said the banking union framework is being reviewed and the 2013 banking communication may be updated.
In the first place, it is always up to the shareholders and creditors of a bank to absorb losses through bail-in.
Het is in de eerste plaats altijd aan de aandeelhouders en schuldeisers van een bank om door middel van bail-in verliezen te incasseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Linde over het niet verkopen van ABN AMRO en het miljardenverlies op deze aandelen

MPs Sneller and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister why the state has not sold ABN AMRO shares since September 2017, how the sale procedure and NLFI's advice work, and what the timing criteria are. The minister answered that NLFI advises on strategy and that the minister approves each step, but he declined to disclose confidential advice, the number of sale meetings, and the reasoning behind timing, citing market sensitivity, while promising to publish some advice after transactions.

Disclosing NLFI's considerations, now or in the past, when advising on the share sale strategy and my own considerations, both then and now, could lead to expectations among investors that allow them to anticipate a state transaction.

Het openbaar maken van de afwegingen van NLFI, nu of in het verleden, bij het adviseren over de verkoopstrategie van de aandelen en mijn afwegingen hierbij, zowel destijds als nu, kunnen leiden tot mogelijke verwachtingen bij beleggers waardoor zij mogelijk kunnen anticiperen op een transactie van de staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over het bericht dat een dubieuze afbouwverzekeraar het project in Brielle niet af bouwt

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Linde asked whether a dubious completion insurer leaving a Brielle housing project unfinished leaves buyers unprotected, how often the AFM receives signals about such insurance, how many providers operate, when providers must account, and what specific rules apply. The minister says the insurer lacked a licence and used unusual terms, that buyers may be unable to claim, that the AFM has received very few signals which led to no follow-up, that DNB regulates prudential supervision of 18 insurers offering the branch, and that no specific rules for completion insurance are known beyond general insurance law.
The Minister for Environment and Housing will therefore work with the supervisor to map how the risk of such situations can be further limited in the future.
De Minister voor Milieu en Wonen gaat daarom met de toezichthouder in kaart brengen hoe het risico op dergelijke situaties in de toekomst verder kan beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de berichten ‘Taxirijden op Schiphol, in ruil voor een envelop vol cash’ en ‘SchipholTaxi verliest kort geding tegen NRC’

MP Ziengs asked the ministers whether they knew of and found worrying press reports that Schiphol taxi drivers were pressured to pay cash for concessions, whether earlier complaints were handled, and whether investigation and safeguards against conflicts of interest are adequate. The ministers answered that Schiphol, as the responsible company, started its own investigation including the concession award, found no irregularities, and that the Marechaussee and Openbaar Ministerie are considering further steps.
In consultation with the Openbaar Ministerie Noord-Holland, the Koninklijke Marechaussee is considering whether a preliminary investigation should be started based on the new information.
In overleg met het Openbaar Ministerie Noord-Holland bekijkt de Koninklijke Marechaussee of er op basis van de nieuwe informatie een oriënterend onderzoek gestart dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht dat slechts 6 op de 10 Nederlanders weten wat de termen ‘budget’, ‘inflatie’ en ‘rente’ betekenen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a survey finding that many Dutch people do not understand basic financial terms, and about how the government will improve financial literacy and consumer choices. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to education curricula, the Week van het geld, Wijzer in geldzaken and the Actieplan Consumentenkeuzes, and largely declines to set concrete SMART targets beyond facilitating partnerships.
Yes, I am aware of that.
Ja, daar ben ik mee bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Alkaya over het bericht dat AstroTV in 2020 van tv verdwijnt

MPs Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister about misuse of non-compete clauses, including the AstroTV case where Talpa ended broadcasting in 2020 and the producer continued via phone and app. The government answered that media companies decide their own programming without prior oversight, that consumer-protection rules still apply via the ACM and Reclame Code Commissie, and that it sees no need to act on the broadcast.
The ACM makes no statements about any ongoing investigations.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken doet de ACM geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘KLM moet krimpen ten faveure van Franse piloten’

MPs Nijboer and Paternotte asked the Finance Minister whether a production-balance agreement between Air France, KLM and pilot unions forces KLM to shrink, whether the state as shareholder was informed, and how it will use its stake to prevent agreements against Dutch interests. The minister answered that the agreement is an operational matter for company management, the state has no formal role as shareholder, but it discusses the issue with KLM and will protect the Dutch public interest through its board representation.
Agreements on operational activities, however, are the responsibility of the company's executive management.
Afspraken over de operationele activiteiten zijn echter een verantwoordelijkheid van het uitvoerend bestuur van de onderneming.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Bosman, Kerstens, Bruins, Voordewind en Stoffer over de berichtgeving ‘Nieuwe onderzeeboten: Nederlandse marine-industrie dreigt alleen kruimels te krijgen’

MPs from several parties asked the Defence, Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about press reports that the Dutch naval shipbuilding industry risks getting only scraps from the new submarine order, and about risks to knowledge retention, intellectual property, competition and the Defence Industry Strategy. The government answered at length, largely restating its procurement approach: competitive selection under Article 346 TFEU, IP and maintenance guarantees to be negotiated in the next phase, and no decision yet on a single preferred bidder.
As I stated in the B-letter, I will implement the Bruins Slot et al. motion.
Zoals ik in de B-brief heb vermeld zal ik uitvoering geven aan de motie Bruins Slot c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Schonis over het kunnen meenemen van schadevrije jaren

MPs Sneller and Schonis asked the Finance Minister whether foreign no-claims years can be transferred to Dutch insurance, whether partners and regular drivers can build no-claims years, and whether no-claims years can be split on divorce. The minister answered that transfer depends on each insurer's rules, that children and partners build no-claims years only if registered, and that no change is planned because some insurers already offer splitting.
I do not intervene in the acceptance conditions of individual insurers.
Ik treed niet in de acceptatievoorwaarden van individuele verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over de UN Climate Action Summit van 23 september

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government knows banks and insurers invest heavily in shale gas and plastics, whether it will press for action at the UN Climate Action Summit, and whether it will pressure financial institutions to restrict such financing. The minister confirmed awareness, pointed to national climate policy, the ban on new shale gas exploration permits, plastics programmes, and the Platform for Sustainable Finance, but made no commitment to restrict financing directly.

It is a good thing when insurers, banks and other financial institutions are open about the environmental and climate effects of their investments, so that their customers can make an informed choice.

Het is een goede zaak wanneer verzekeraars, banken en andere financiële instellingen open zijn over de milieu en klimaateffecten van hun investeringen, zodat hun klanten een gefundeerde keuze kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Maak van onze bankrekening een telefoonnummer’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about making bank accounts portable via phone-number-style aliases and IBAN portability, and about the status of DNB research and the EU payment account directive evaluation. The minister answered that IBAN portability is technically complex and best pursued at EU level, that the EU evaluation may finish by late 2020, and that DNB alias research is expected in Q1 2020.
I expect the evaluation by the European Commission to be completed at the earliest by the end of 2020.
Ik verwacht dat de evaluatie door de Europese Commissie op zijn vroegst eind 2020 wordt afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Nederland draait op voor Antilliaanse douanefraude'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the ministers about reports that the Netherlands is liable for customs fraud by the Antilles (Curaçao and Aruba), including the case's timeline, the Kingdom's legal status as an EU member, LGO status, and the division of competences within the Kingdom. The government explained the liability under the EU's Court of Justice ruling, stated that the ruling does not change obligations of the Caribbean countries, and said that the implications are being examined under a parliamentary motion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Drugskartel waste opbrengsten wit: Nederlandse banken hadden moeten ingrijpen’

MPs Van der Linde and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether simple loanback money-laundering constructions are a serious problem, how often they occur, whether authorities have enough capacity, and how cooperation with the prosecution service and gatekeepers can improve. The ministers answered that the scale of money laundering is hard to pin down, that loanback constructions are a known phenomenon without data on their share, and pointed to the anti-money-laundering action plan, public-private cooperation pilots, extra funding and a new multidisciplinary intervention team.
The exact scale of money laundering flows through the Netherlands cannot be determined definitively.
De exacte omvang van witwasstromen door Nederland is niet definitief vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over kredietwaardigheidsonderzoeken

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about creditworthiness checks by credit bureaus, including use of postcode and age data, transparency, and redress. The minister answered that existing GDPR rules and the AP and NVH complaint routes apply, that the government will seek EU-level safeguards for algorithmic decisions, and that no new national rules are announced.
These third parties may only provide this data if a valid legal basis exists, with the necessity of the processing motivated and demonstrated.
Deze derden mogen deze gegevens alleen verstrekken indien hiertoe een geldige grondslag bestaat waarbij de noodzaak van de verwerking wordt gemotiveerd en aangetoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de berichten ‘Italian banks rush to profit from ECB negative rates’ en ‘Italiaanse banken lenen extra miljarden uit noordelijke landen’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Finance about reports that Italian banks exploit an ECB tiering arbitrage to lend surplus reserves while northern banks are at their exemption limit, asking about effects, risks and whether the government will act. The Minister answers that banks must set their own funding mix within prudential rules, that the ECB independently chooses its policy instruments, that the arbitrage effect was small and quickly eliminated, and that no further steps are needed.
It is up to the ECB to determine whether the effects of tiering are disproportionate and whether adjustment of the tiering system is necessary.
Het is aan de ECB om te bepalen of de gevolgen van tiering disproportioneel zijn en of aanpassing van het tieringstelsel nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Slootweg over negatieve spaarrente

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister about negative deposit rates in Germany and whether Dutch banks will pass them on to savers, and about bank stress tests, ECB liquidity reserves and the Consumentenbond's call for a ban. The minister answered that banks set their own pricing, that the MFI statistics do not show higher pressure in Germany than in the Netherlands, that a ban on negative rates is discussed in a separate letter, and that Dutch reserves at the central bank have only slightly changed.
At the general meeting on the effects of ECB policy on 24 September 2019 I committed to your House to hold talks with banks.
Bij het algemeen overleg effecten van het ECB-beleid op 24 september 2019 heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd om in gesprek te gaan met banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het verzekeren van zonnepanelen tegen hagelschade

PvdA MPs asked whether insurers dropping cover for invisible hail damage to solar panels leaves homeowners unprotected, and what the government will do about it. The Minister of Finance answered that some insurers have excluded this risk in their terms, that the share of uninsured owners is unknown, and that the matter is primarily for insurers and the market, with no concrete government action committed.
I consider this primarily a matter between insurers, market parties and owners of solar panels.
Ik beschouw dit primair als een zaak tussen verzekeraars, marktpartijen en eigenaren van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het artikel gepubliceerd door de NOS op 21 november ‘‘ABN AMRO was blind voor smeergeld van Braziliaanse Odebrecht’’

MP Alkaya (SP) asked the Finance Minister about NOS reporting that ABN AMRO failed to screen about 5 million clients for bribery money from Odebrecht, and whether shareholder action, a public alternative to commercial banks, and enforcement can prevent repeat failures. Minister Hoekstra declined to comment on the ongoing OM criminal investigation, pointed to DNB's supervisory role and enforcement tools, said NLFI would monitor the bank's measures at arm's length, and referred to the government's broader financial sector agenda.
I have asked NLFI to closely monitor the measures the bank is taking and to inform me about them.
Ik heb NLFI gevraagd de maatregelen die de bank gaat nemen nauwgezet te volgen en mij daarover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht 'De Goudse goochelt met getallen in beleggingsverzekeringen'

MP Krol asked the Finance Minister about a Radar broadcast alleging that insurer De Goudse used misleading illustrations and flawed actuarial assumptions in investment insurance offers, and whether consumers face an unequal fight and whether collective redress should follow. The minister stated that the AFM supervises compliance with the Wft and may enforce, that consumers can turn to Kifid or the civil courts, that the government has introduced consumer-protection rules, and that insurers offer ongoing aftercare and case-by-case coulance, while declining to comment on individual cases.
For completeness, I note that the AFM, given its duty of confidentiality, cannot make statements about individual cases.
Voor de volledigheid merk ik hierbij op dat de AFM gelet op haar geheimhoudingsplicht geen mededelingen kan doen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de toenemende schuld van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven

Senator-level MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Finance Minister about rising corporate debt in the Netherlands, its comparison with the IMF analysis, parallels with the financial crisis, zombie firms, ECB bond-buying effects, pensioner exposure to CLOs, and whether the government is prepared for domino failures. Minister Hoekstra answered that the debt level is explained largely by multinationals, that Dutch firms are relatively sound, that the government has no active policy to reduce corporate debt beyond the earnings-stripping interest deduction limit, and that the effects of ECB policy are hard to isolate.
This information is not directly available.
Deze informatie is niet direct beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Verhoeven over paspoorthandel op Malta

Three D66 MPs asked the government about passport sales in Malta, including whether they enable crime, the role of the Maltese state, AIVD warnings, and Dutch positions in the EU. The government answered that Malta conducts due diligence but this is no guarantee, that it sees such sales as undesirable but that citizenship remains national competence, that it will await an EU Commission process before dialogue, and that the Dutch investor residence scheme will be reviewed for added value.
As indicated in the answer to question 6, it is wise to await the outcome of these Commission initiatives and then engage in dialogue, preferably at EU level, on these schemes.

Zoals in de beantwoording van vraag 6 is aangegeven, is het verstandig om de uitkomst van deze initiatieven van de Commissie af te wachten en op basis daarvan de dialoog – bij voorkeur op EU-niveau – over genoemde regelingen aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat FMO landroof en andere misstanden financiert

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Development and of Finance how FMO, the Dutch development bank, could finance projects linked to killings, land grabs and other abuses, which projects were investigated, and whether the exit strategy and due diligence are adequate. The minister answered that these projects are known and in dialogue with FMO, that existing standards and recent policy tightening apply, that the list of watch-list projects is confidential, and that the next five-yearly evaluation (2013-2018) is due in Q2 2020.
FMO closely monitors which projects may be experiencing problems.
FMO houdt intensief in de gaten bij welke projecten zich mogelijk problemen voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de rechten van consumenten bij fusies en overnames in de financiële sector

An MP asks the Finance Minister what rights consumers have when banks or insurers merge, are taken over, or transfer portfolios, including deposit guarantee, switching costs, poor service and tax consequences. The minister describes existing safeguards (DNB approval, policyholder objection rights, deposit guarantee notice and withdrawal rights, tax-neutral transfers) and declines to commission a new study, while promising continued dialogue with stakeholders.
A further study into strengthening consumer rights in mergers and takeovers is therefore not necessary at this time in my view.
Nader onderzoek naar het versterken van de rechten van consumenten bij fusies en overnames acht ik om die reden op dit moment dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Nijboer over “de uitzending van Radar over ANW-hiaatverzekeringen”

MPs Slootweg and Nijboer asked about a Radar broadcast on ANW survivor-gap insurance that ABN AMRO stopped paying at age 65 despite policy terms tying payments to the AOW age, and about how widespread this is, how UPO and Mijn Pensioenoverzicht display the AOW change, and how to enforce compliance. The minister said ABN AMRO corrected the case and reviewed similar cases, that sector data on policy numbers is insufficient, that supervision by DNB and AFM is risk-based and will act on structural signals, and that complaints go through internal procedures and alternative dispute bodies, while calling on insurers to explain payment durations clearly.
This led ABN AMRO Levensverzekering to acknowledge that this woman was not correctly informed and ABN AMRO Levensverzekeringen has remedied this.
Dit heeft ertoe geleid dat ABN AMRO Levensverzekering heeft erkend dat deze mevrouw niet correct is voorgelicht en ABN AMRO Levensverzekeringen dit heeft hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Nijboer over financiële overschotten op de Najaarsnota

Two PvdA MPs asked why a fiscal surplus of nearly 14 billion euros in mid-2019 coexists with shortages in police, healthcare and education, and whether part of it will be spent on those sectors or underspending moved to later years. The Finance Minister replied that the 2019 surplus is largely incidental, that the government has added billions structurally to these sectors, that some underspending will go to priorities such as education and undermining crime, and that underspent investment budgets were shifted to 2022-2024 via a ceiling correction.
The cabinet has now decided to spend part of the 2019 underspending on social priorities such as education, undermining crime, the nitrogen problem, legal aid, and safety and protection.

Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om een deel van de onderuitputting van 2019 uit te geven aan maatschappelijke prioriteiten als onderwijs, ondermijning, de stikstofproblematiek, de rechtsbijstand en veiligheid en beschermen.
