Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over door de Nederlandse Ontwikkelingsbank FMO gefinancierde misstanden

An MP asks the ministers whether they know of reports that the Dutch development bank FMO finances land grabbing, tax avoidance and non-transparent arbitration, and what they will do about it, including independent investigation and transparency on land-rights risks. The minister answers that the cases are known and discussed with FMO, that independent evaluations and a complaints mechanism exist, but declines to share a list of land-grabbing companies citing client confidentiality and commits only to ongoing dialogue and policy tightening.
It is generally not in the interest of the ongoing investigation to share information about this with external parties.
Het is doorgaans niet in het belang van het lopende onderzoek om informatie hierover te delen met externe partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de berichten ‘Smith: Air France en KLM nog meer integreren’ en ‘France Hits Out at Dutch in Feud Over Air France-KLM Holdings’

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about press reports that Air France-KLM's CEO wants further integration and about a French official's public demand that the Netherlands choose between its holding and KLM stakes, including how KLM's position, jobs, foundations and state guarantees are protected. The minister answered that the government will monitor the agreements and guarantees, that the Franch-Dutch working group is ongoing, and that he will not disclose talks or comment on specific operational matters because Air France-KLM is listed.
Beyond that, I will not go into the content of the talks, as in my view this does not serve the talks.
Verder ga ik niet in op de inhoud van de gesprekken in de werkgroep, dit komt mijns inziens de gesprekken niet ten goede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘McKinsey: kaalslag dreigt onder banken bij nieuwe crisis’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a McKinsey report warning of bank consolidation and weakness in Western Europe, and whether Dutch banks are prepared for a new crisis and whether buffers should be raised. The minister disputed the framing, said Dutch banks are better prepared through higher capital and leverage requirements, and said consolidation is primarily a matter for banks, with supervisors able to act on concrete risks.

It is first and foremost up to the banks themselves to explore for their own organisations the pros and cons and the possibilities for mergers and acquisitions, and to weigh opportunities against risks.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan banken zelf om voor hun eigen organisaties de voor- en nadelen en de mogelijkheden voor fusies en overnames te verkennen en kansen en risico’s tegen elkaar af te wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Italiaans begrotingstekort groeit in 2020'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Italy's rising 2020 budget deficit, debt trajectory and compliance with the Stability and Growth Pact, and whether the Commission should act. The minister answered that the Commission will assess Italy's draft budget in its autumn forecast, that Italy's growth forecast is in line with international institutions, and that the government remains committed to strict enforcement of EU fiscal rules.
At present the European Commission is calculating the plans that euro area countries have included in their draft budgets and is incorporating them into the autumn forecast.
Op dit moment rekent de Europese Commissie de plannen door die Eurolanden hebben opgenomen in hun ontwerpbegrotingen en verwerkt deze in de herfstraming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Donatiewebsite plotseling offline: tienduizenden euro’s verdwenen'

An MP asked the government about a donation website that went offline with tens of thousands of euros missing, and whether crowdfunding donation platforms should face the same registration and AFM oversight as investment crowdfunding. The government answered that existing consumer protection applies, that donation crowdfunding differs from investment crowdfunding and needs no AFM supervision, and that the sector and CBF are exploring a code of conduct rather than new government measures.
Crowdfunding through donation is therefore comparable to donating to more traditional charitable institutions, for example via a collection box.
Crowdfunding door middel van donatie is daarom vergelijkbaar met doneren aan meer traditionele charitatieve instellingen, bijvoorbeeld via een collectebus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over toezicht op crowdfundingplatforms zoals Dream or Donate

An SP MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether oversight of crowdfunding platforms like Dream or Donate was adequate after the site went offline with donations apparently lost. The government answered that donation-based crowdfunding falls outside AFM supervision, that the sector should self-regulate with CBF-related talks underway, and that fraud is for police and prosecutors.
Crowdfunding through donation is therefore comparable to donating to more traditional charitable institutions, for example via a collection box.
Crowdfunding door middel van donatie is daarom vergelijkbaar met doneren aan meer traditionele charitatieve instellingen, bijvoorbeeld via een collectebus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Maeijer over het bericht er een akkoord is bereikt over de financiering van de eurozonebegroting

PVV MPs Tony van Dijck and Maeijer asked whether the agreement on financing a eurozone budget (BICC) is a first step toward a separate eurozone budget and whether the Netherlands can veto spending or block new own resources. Minister Hoekstra answers that the instrument will be part of the regular EU budget under the MFF ceiling, that the Netherlands opposes new own resources, and that participation in any intergovernmental agreement is voluntary, while the detailed size and distribution remain unresolved.
It has been agreed that the discussion on the necessity, content, modalities and size of a desired intergovernmental agreement will continue in the preparatory working groups of the Eurogroup.
Afgesproken is dat de discussie over de noodzaak, inhoud, modaliteiten en omvang van een door een aantal lidstaten gewenste IGA zal doorgaan in ambtelijke voorportalen van de Eurogroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over kosten en opbrengsten in de belastingsfeer van Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify the tax revenue and costs attributable to (non-Western) people with a migration background, including tax, benefits and exports of pensions. The minister replied that individual tax contributions cannot be traced for indirect taxes, the Tax Administration does not record migration background, and the requested breakdowns are not available.
For no single person or household can it be determined exactly how much tax money they pay.
Van geen enkele persoon of geen enkel huishouden is exact vast te stellen hoeveel belastinggeld door hem of haar wordt betaald.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het uitblijven van een akkoord met de Franse Staat over het waarborgen van de Nederlandse publieke belangen na de aandelenaankoop van Air France-KLM

Two MPs (D66) asked why the agreed June 2019 target for a deal with the French state on guarantees and protecting Dutch public interests after the Air France-KLM share purchase was missed, and about the Aigle Azur bid and convertible bond. Minister Hoekstra replied that a working group is in place, talks are complex and confidential, the state exercises shareholder rights, it declined to discuss the Aigle Azur case as price-sensitive, and it did not subscribe to the convertible bond.
This may concern price-sensitive information, so the substance of this case cannot be addressed.
Dit betreft mogelijk koersgevoelige informatie, dus op de inhoud van deze casus kan niet worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over de nieuwe interne regels van de Europese Investeringsbank (EIB) voor het uitlenen van geld aan energieprojecten

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked whether the government would oppose the EIB's revised Energy Lending Policy, specifically the loopholes for gas plants with 'credible' low-carbon gas plans and a one-year extension for gas infrastructure projects, and whether it would push for a firm emissions limit before the 15 October 2019 Board meeting. The Minister answers that the Netherlands supports a firmer policy, prefers the original emissions limit definition, and will push for phasing out fossil fuel financing and for an ambitious outcome, while noting the decision is still under negotiation.
The Netherlands is strongly committed to this in the negotiations and will work to bring other countries along to a clear and ambitious policy.
Nederland maakt zich hier in de onderhandelingen hard voor en zet zich in om andere landen mee te krijgen voor een beleid dat helder en ambitieus is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de stijgende kosten van taxaties

An MP asked the Interior and Finance Ministers whether draft EBA guidelines requiring physical appraisals, and rising appraisal costs, are acceptable given house prices. The Minister answered that quality appraisals matter, that model valuations (about 30 euro versus 400-500 euro for physical ones) are a good alternative when used responsibly, and that it is too early to judge consumer cost effects.
I previously informed the House that I see model-based valuation, when used responsibly, as a good alternative to a physical appraisal.
Ik heb eerder aan uw Kamer gemeld dat ik modelmatig waarderen bij verantwoord gebruik zie als een goed alternatief voor een fysieke taxatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over de buitensporige subsidie van de luchtvaartsector

MPs Van Raan, Kröger and Laçin asked the government about claimed excessive subsidies to the aviation sector, including tax treatment of kerosene, Schiphol's accessibility costs, WTO rulings on Airbus and Boeing, and airport charges. The minister disputed the subsidy calculation, provided partial figures and data on Schiphol-related spending, and promised a forthcoming overview of external costs of aviation.
Question 2: Do you endorse the subsidy of 86.29 euros per person calculated in this article?
Vraag 2 Onderschrijft u de in dit artikel berekende subsidie van 86,29 euro per persoon
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over mogelijke belangenverstrengeling door de overstap van de directeur van de Europese Bankenautoriteit (EBA) naar een financiële lobbyclub

MP Leijten asks the Finance Minister whether the move of the EBA executive director to the lobby group AFME creates conflicts of interest, and about AFME membership, lobbying and Eurofi attendance. The minister answers that EBA staff are bound by confidentiality and a two-year cooling-off period, that the director is barred from lobbying and advising AFME for set periods, and that the ministry keeps no overview of financial-sector lobby organisations.
To counter (the appearance of) conflicts of interest, the EBA runs an active integrity policy and is transparent about its contact with stakeholders.
Om (de schijn van) belangenverstrengeling tegen te gaan voert de EBA een actief integriteitsbeleid 3 en is zij transparant over het contact met stakeholders 4 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Deutscher Widerstand gegen Europäische Einlagensicherung bröckelt'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about reports of waning German resistance to a European deposit insurance scheme (EDIS), the risk-reduction measures still pending (such as zero-weighting of sovereign bonds), and the timing of EDIS. The minister answers that EDIS should only follow once sovereign bond treatment and bank health checks are improved, and sets out the status of the banking package and the High Level Working Group.
The Netherlands therefore continues to press, at European level, for better treatment of sovereign bonds on bank balance sheets and for testing bank health through asset quality reviews (AQRs).

Nederland blijft daarom in Europees verband inzetten op een betere behandeling van staatsobligaties op bankbalansen en het toetsen van de gezondheid van banken door middel van asset quality reviews (AQRs).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Linde over het bericht dat de overheid op één dag meer dan een miljard heeft verloren op de aandelen van ABN AMRO

MPs Sneller and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about reports that the state lost over a billion euros in one day on its ABN AMRO shares, why no shares have been sold since his appointment, and how democratic control over the holding via NLFI is organised. The minister confirms the regeerakkoord goal of full market sale as soon as responsible, declines to explain sale timing for market-sensitivity reasons, and describes the NLFI governance and ministerial approval arrangements.
This information could be price-sensitive and disclosing it could have a negative effect on intended transactions.
Deze informatie zou koersgevoelig kunnen zijn en openbaarmaking daarvan zou een negatief effect op voorgenomen transacties kunnen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de race naar de bodem van beveiligers op Schiphol

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether Schiphol's security tender, split among seven companies and excluding the sector CAO, risks a race to the bottom on security guards' pay and whether the state as shareholder should intervene. The minister replied that Schiphol's management is responsible for operations and labour conditions, that he will not pressure Schiphol, and gave Schiphol's reasons for multiple contractors and quality-based awarding.
It is not for me to call Schiphol to account on this.
Het is niet aan mij om Schiphol hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over negatieve rentes voor particulieren

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether he is concerned that Dutch banks might impose negative interest rates on savings accounts, whether this would harm trust and access to bank accounts, what risks cash hoarding and a run on cash would pose, how this fits with cash payment limits, which banks are considering it, whether a legal ban is possible, and whether he will coordinate with Germany and EU finance ministers. The minister replies that negative rates on household deposits are not currently applied, that a hard ban is a far-reaching market intervention with drawbacks, that he will monitor developments and talk to banks, that the box 3 regime will be adjusted, and that he will raise the issue with European counterparts if Germany's legal study produces results.
A hard ban on negative interest rates is, however, a very far-reaching intervention in the market, which also has drawbacks.
Een hard verbod op negatieve rente is echter een zeer forse ingreep in de markt, die ook nadelen kent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht 'Negatieve spaarrente voor consumenten lijkt onvermijdelijk'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that negative deposit rates for consumers were becoming unavoidable, and whether Belgium-style bans should be considered. The minister answered that negative rates on consumer deposits are not currently at issue, that a hard ban is a far-reaching intervention with drawbacks, and that he will talk with banks and monitor developments.
I will enter into discussions with the banks about the low interest rate and the concern that exists about a possible negative interest rate on savings deposits.
Ik zal met de banken in gesprek gaan over de lage rente en de onrust die bestaat over een mogelijke negatieve rente op spaardeposito's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat de schaderegeling voor het derivatendrama handjeklap zou zijn met de banken

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister whether the compensation scheme for the interest rate derivatives scandal was negotiated too much in the banks' favour, including exclusion of large semi-public institutions and capping of goodwill payments. The minister rejects claims of undue bank influence, defends the independent expert committee's framework, and says the framework and its versions were already published.
In drawing up the Uniform Recovery Framework (UHK), both the banks and SME and claimant organisations were involved.
Bij het opstellen van het Uniform Herstelkader (UHK) zijn zowel de banken als MKB- en claimorganisaties betrokken geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over extra kapitaal voor TenneT voor investeringen in het Duitse netwerk

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether TenneT's raised investment outlook of 35 billion euro, of which 23 billion is for the German grid, and talks with German parties or a stock listing, were correct, and whether the state should take a stance. The minister confirmed the figures, said capital needs arise from the energy transition and German obligations, and said the government will explore options such as a state capital injection, partial sale or cooperation with Germany while ruling out a stock listing as unlikely.
Guided by the above conditions and objectives, the cabinet will over the coming months develop various options for the capital requirement and examine whether these options are feasible in practice.

Met als leidraad de bovenstaande randvoorwaarden en doelstellingen zal het kabinet de komende maanden verschillende opties voor de kapitaalbehoefte uitwerken en onderzoeken of deze opties in de praktijk ook realiseerbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht dat de EU mogelijk de fiscale regels wil versoepelen vanwege uitblijven van de groei

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the EU intends to loosen fiscal rules due to lack of growth, and whether a document on this exists and can be shared. The minister answered that the document is a Finnish presidency issues note facilitating discussion, not a proposal to loosen rules, that it has already been shared with parliament, and that his position is unchanged.
It is not aimed at loosening rules, but gives a broad overview of the issues at play in discussing the budget rules.
Het is niet gericht op het versoepelen van regels, maar geeft een breed overzicht van de vraagstukken die spelen bij het bespreken van de begrotingsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het bericht dat het witwasbeleid van ABN Amro volgens de toezichthouder faalt

SP MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about reports that DNB found ABN Amro's anti-money-laundering policy deficient and ordered a re-screening of retail clients, and asked why DNB's instruments and the bank's treatment differ from ING's settlement. The minister answered that DNB cannot disclose supervisory-confidential directions or specific measures against ABN Amro, that enforcement responsibility lies with DNB and the Public Prosecution Service, and that he expects banks to comply and reports DNB's annual oversight accountability.
DNB itself cannot make public information about directions because it concerns supervisory-confidential information.
DNB kan zelf geen informatie naar buiten brengen over aanwijzingen omdat dit toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oijk en Snels over de ‘Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank’

Two MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers how Netherlands has used its shareholding in the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank to push human rights and environmental standards, complaints mechanisms, transparency and oversight. The minister answered that the Netherlands has pushed for these standards and transparency within the bank's board, that the complaints and disclosure rules have gaps the government will raise in the upcoming framework review, and promised to report annually to parliament.

I propose to share a report with the House of Representatives annually after the meeting of the bank's highest governing body, the Board of Governors, to inform the House of the most important developments at the AIIB.
Ik stel voor om jaarlijks na de bijeenkomst van het hoogste bestuursorgaan, de Board of Governors , van de AIIB een verslag met de Tweede Kamer te delen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol, Van Otterloo, Van Brenk en Sazias over "de Augustusraming van het CPB"

Four 50PLUS MPs asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister why the CPB's August forecast cut pensioners' purchasing-power gains sharply, whether pension cuts were included, why the share of households gaining or losing was dropped from the table, and the size of interest-rate windfalls. The Minister answered that the changes stem from updated inflation and interest-rate assumptions, that the presentation was changed to avoid misreading, and that interest windfalls feed into the budget decision on Budget Day.
The percentage of households with a positive or negative purchasing-power development has been removed from the boxplot.
Het percentage huishoudens met een positieve of negatieve koopkrachtontwikkeling is geschrapt uit de boxplot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over bodemwende

MP Van Eijs (D66) asked whether the government finds the bodemwende erfpacht-based financing model acceptable, whether the erfpacht canon should be tax-deductible when used for home improvement, and when clarity on this would be given. The minister said the Klimaatakkoord research into erfpacht financing will be reported to parliament in autumn, and declined to comment on the tax treatment of an individual provider's product, which lies with the Belastingdienst.

This factual assessment is reserved for the Belastingdienst and, under the duty of confidentiality, I cannot comment on or anticipate the outcome of the assessment of the position on an individual provider's product.
Deze feitelijke beoordeling is voorbehouden aan de Belastingdienst en in het kader van de geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik niet ingaan of vooruitlopen op de uitkomst van de beoordeling

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Lodders over de berichten “Criminelen wassen 1 miljard wit via export tweedehandsauto’s” en “Autobedrijven frauderen voor miljoenen bij export ex-leaseauto’s”

MPs Van der Linde and Lodders asked about press reports of money laundering through export of second-hand and ex-lease cars, asking about the scale of fraud, reporting figures, FIU access to customs data, and enforcement capacity. The Ministers answered that a criminal investigation into four dealers covers roughly 120 million euro in exports and a 21 million euro VAT loss, that no overall figures exist, and that existing cooperation and a new anti-money-laundering plan are being strengthened, while withholding further details due to the ongoing investigation.
Because this criminal investigation is still ongoing, further details cannot be disclosed.
Omdat dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog loopt, kunnen verdere details niet worden vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘soepelere begrotingsregels Europese Unie’

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the EU is considering loosening budget rules (the Stability and Growth Pact) after a press report, and how the government would respond. The minister answers that there is no concrete proposal, only a routine Commission evaluation, and that the Netherlands opposes loosening and favours tighter enforcement and less flexibility.
In general terms, the Netherlands believes that poor compliance and the inability of member states to reform can never be a reason to loosen the SGP.
In algemene zin is Nederland van mening dat een gebrekkige naleving en het onvermogen van lidstaten om te hervormen nooit een reden kan zijn om het SGP te versoepelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over berichten dat de Europese Commissie voorstellen zal doen om het Stabiliteits-en Groeipact (SGP) aan te passen

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether the government had seen Commission plans to loosen the Stability and Growth Pact, whether any loosening had been proposed, and what position the Netherlands takes. Minister Hoekstra answered that no proposal had been made, that the Netherlands wants the pact reformed for stricter enforcement and less flexibility, and that it opposes loosening.
No. No proposal has been made to amend the European budget rules.
Nee. Er is geen voorstel gedaan om de Europese begrotingsregels aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de problemen bij Yarden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Finance about Yarden's weak solvency, the use of a clause to cut funeral-insurance policy terms, and whether policyholders would be protected in a bankruptcy. The minister explained the recovery plan approved by DNB, said a bail-in was not applicable under the interventieladder, and gave a partial answer on policyholder losses, referring to earlier documents.
It is up to the company itself to decide whether the policy terms will be restored to their 'old' form in better times.
Het is aan de onderneming zelf om te bepalen of de polisvoorwaarden in betere tijden weer worden hersteld in hun «oude» vorm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de kandidatuur van oud-minister Dijsselbloem als directeur van het IMF

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister how the cabinet chose and backed former minister Dijsselbloem as IMF managing director candidate, including the selection process, lobbying, MPs' contact and the cost of his travel. The minister answered that the decision was made in July, the process was intensive but confidential so no full overview is given, and the candidacy was not publicly discussed to protect its chances.
Given the number of conversations and their confidential nature, no overview can be provided of the conversations that took place.
Gezien het aantal gesprekken en het vertrouwelijke karakter kan geen overzicht geven worden van de gesprekken die hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de kosten van het klimaatbeleid

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers whether citizens are entitled to full information on the costs of climate policy, including PBL and CPB cost figures for the Klimaatakkoord, the effects of road pricing on remote residents, and whether existing climate policy should be included in the calculations and a second opinion obtained. Minister Wiebes answered that PBL puts national extra costs at 1.6 to 1.9 billion euros in 2030, CPB puts household burdens of the draft accord at 0.3 billion and total household energy and climate burdens at 3.3 billion, that road-pricing effects cannot yet be assessed, and that the planning bureaus themselves decide on their work programmes and no separate budget was set aside.
Because it is not yet clear whether and in what form road pricing will be introduced in the future, this question cannot be answered.
Omdat het nog niet duidelijk is of en welke vorm van rekeningrijden op termijn wordt ingevoerd is deze vraag niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over hoe de sterke zekerheidsrechtelijke positie van banken alternatieve financiers belemmert

MPs Sneller, Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked whether banks' strong security positions in bankruptcy and the ban on pledging assets hinder alternative lenders, and whether the government will investigate, legislate or address this in the bankruptcy law revision. The minister answered that a study of Dutch financing practice will be commissioned, that the bankruptcy law revision is examining secured creditors' position, and that the bill to lift pledging bans will go to the Council of State shortly after the summer recess.
We are willing to commission a study into this, which will also address collateral provision in SME financing, in view of the motion adopted by your House on 18 June.

Wij zijn bereid om een opdracht tot een onderzoek daarnaar te geven, waarbij tevens, mede gelet op de op 18 juni door Uw Kamer aangenomen motie, 2 de zekerheidsstelling bij MKB-financiering aan de orde zal komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over digitaal Facebookgeld

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister about Facebook's planned digital currency Libra, including whether it needs licences, risks to financial stability and consumers, data-protection and PSD2 implications, and tax payment. The minister answers that Libra's licensing status is still under examination with supervisors, that a DNB study on digital central bank money is pending, and that a range of risks will be assessed before any measures are taken.
I will investigate this in the coming period together with the supervisors.
Ik ga dit de komende tijd onderzoeken met de toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de libra

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about Facebook's planned Libra digital currency, including its workings, which supervisors apply, data use, consumer protection, systemic risks and whether an analysis would be sent by September 2019. Minister Hoekstra answered that little is known yet, that supervisors will be consulted and DNB is studying digital central bank money, but he cannot promise a September analysis.
I therefore cannot promise to inform the House further about Libra by September.
Ik kan u daarom niet toezeggen om voor september de Kamer verder te informeren over de Libra.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over Nederlandse burgers die de dupe zijn van Amerikaanse regelgeving

D66 MPs Van Weyenberg and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government would press the US for a solution for Dutch citizens who are also US citizens ('Accidental Americans') harmed by FATCA, including whether banks may refuse basic payment accounts when no US SSN is held, and whether a coordinated European approach would be pursued. State Secretary Snel answered that the issue is high on the government's agenda, that a missing US TIN/SSN is not a valid ground to refuse a basic payment account, and that Netherlands is seeking a coordinated European action, with a follow-up letter promised after the summer.
The cabinet will continue to work on behalf of this group of people.
Het kabinet zal zich blijven inzetten voor deze groep mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Nijboer over het sluiten van bankrekeningen van Nederlanders die in het buitenland wonen

MPs Ploumen and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether banks are increasingly closing accounts of Dutch citizens living abroad, why, and whether additional rules apply. The minister confirmed the trend, said banks set their own client strategy and risk profile within existing law, and committed to consulting banks on access to services for Dutch citizens abroad.
I will consult with banks to discuss developments regarding access for Dutch citizens abroad to banking services.
Ik zal in overleg treden met banken om te spreken over de ontwikkelingen rond de toegang van Nederlanders in het buitenland tot dienstverlening van banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Alkaya over een rapport over beleggingen in wapenproductie en wapenhandel

MPs Karabulut and Alkaya asked the ministers whether Dutch banks ING, ABN AMRO and Van Lanschot Kempen investing in arms makers supplying Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt is compatible with Dutch arms export policy, and whether the IMVO banking covenant and the government should act. The government answered that banks are individually responsible for due diligence under OECD guidelines and UN principles, that export licensing is a national competence, and that it would not ban such investments or add covenant commitments.
The cabinet therefore does not consider it necessary to prohibit the said investments.
Het kabinet acht het verbieden van de genoemde investeringen daarom niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Tientallen kleine bedrijven failliet door hoge kosten crowdfunding'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Finance and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that small firms went bankrupt due to high crowdfunding costs, and whether existing rules protect SMEs from excessive interest rates. The minister answered that crowdfunding is a valuable financing option, that the government relies on self-regulation codes for business clients, and that the AFM oversees certain crowdfunding forms, with a possible national framework deferred to the pending EU regulation.
As indicated in the answer to question 3, the cabinet is relying on self-regulation to improve protection for small business clients.
Zoals in de beantwoording op vraag 3 is aangegeven, zet het kabinet wat betreft de verbetering van de bescherming voor kleinzakelijke klanten in op zelfregulering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Bosman over de berichten ‘Sint Maarten heeft nog paar maanden voor wetgeving rond witwassen’ en ‘Sint Maarten weigert strijd tegen witwassen en terrorismefinanciering aan

MPs Van der Linde and Bosman asked the government about reports that Sint Maarten was lagging on anti-money-laundering legislation and about the scale of the problem and possible political obstruction. The State Secretary answered that AML is a national responsibility of Sint Maarten, that several laws were recently adopted, that a CFATF public statement was withheld as a confidential draft, and that Dutch support and monitoring continue.
The statement in question concerns a confidential internal draft of an international body that was not adopted after CFATF deliberation and therefore was not published.
De genoemde verklaring betreft een vertrouwelijk intern concept van een internationaal orgaan, dat na besluitvorming in de CFATF niet is vastgesteld en daarom niet is gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de berichten 'Sint Maarten niet ver verwijderd van een blokkade internationaal betalingsverkeer' en 'FATF geeft Sint Maarten ervan langs'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked whether FATF pressure could block international payments for Sint Maarten and affect the BES islands, and about the status of anti-money-laundering laws and the Team Bestrijding Ondermijning. The State Secretary answered that a public warning would bring extra due diligence or, at worst, transaction refusals, that Sint Maarten has adopted some laws with others still pending, and that the government will report on BES banking by year end.
At the end of this year, your House will be informed about the progress.
Eind dit jaar wordt uw Kamer over de voortgang geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Van der Linde en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Veel schade door ‘bitcoin-advertenties’ met nepuitspraken BN’ers’

MPs from the VVD asked ministers about misleading bitcoin advertisements using fake quotes from well-known Dutch people, the scale of resulting harm, whether police, prosecutors, the AFM and social media platforms can act, and what tools exist to identify advertisers and protect consumers and the persons whose names are misused. The government answered that the advertisers are unknown, reported about 1.7 million euro in reported damage, explained existing criminal, consumer-law and civil remedies, and said crypto-assets generally fall outside AFM supervision and no new national regulation is advised.
It is not known who or which organisations commissioned the placement of these misleading advertisements.
Het is niet bekend wie of welke organisaties opdrachtgever zijn van plaatsing van deze misleidende advertenties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Nijboer en Van den Hul over Nederlandse verzekeraars die meer kunnen doen om medicijnen betaalbaar te maken

Three PvdA MPs asked whether Dutch insurers such as Aegon and Allianz, which invest heavily in pharmaceutical firms, should press those firms on medicine prices, tax payment and the Access to Medicine Index investor pledge. The minister answered that insurers are responsible for their own investment policy, pointed to existing IMVO covenant commitments and the OECD guidelines, encouraged signing the pledge, and saw no reason for further measures on transparency.
Institutional investors, including insurers, are responsible for their own investment policy and decide themselves in which companies to invest.
Institutionele beleggers, waaronder verzekeraars, zijn verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen beleggingsbeleid en bepalen zelf in welke bedrijven belegd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over een gelijk speelveld voor alternatieve kredietverleners en banken bij de financiering van het midden- en kleinbedrijf

MPs Sneller and Sjoerdsma asked about the level playing field between banks and alternative lenders in financing SMEs, including differing SME definitions, the professionalisation of alternative lenders, implementation of a motion, and why certain subsidy schemes channel funds only through banks. The government replied that bank financing remains dominant but non-bank finance is growing, that a study on SME financing is underway with a report expected in the second half of the year, and that schemes will be reviewed for level-playing-field effects.
What matters is that SMEs have a sufficiently diverse financing landscape available that meets their legitimate credit needs.
Van belang is dat mkb'ers een voldoende divers financieringslandschap ter beschikking staat dat voorziet in hun legitieme kredietbehoeften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat ING betaalgegevens gebruikt voor persoonlijke reclame

An MP asked the Finance Minister about ING's plan to use payment transaction data for personalised advertising, whether this complies with the GDPR and PSD2, and whether opt-out defaults are acceptable. The minister answered that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is the competent supervisor and has already requested justification from ING, referred to its published guidance, and declined to give substantive views on the bank's balancing or on opt-in defaults.
It is therefore not for me, but in the first instance for the AP (and ultimately possibly the judge), to determine whether ING's practice complies with privacy legislation.
Het is dan ook niet aan mij, maar in eerste instantie aan de AP (en uiteindelijk eventueel de rechter) om te bepalen of de werkwijze van ING in overeenstemming is met de privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over de middelen die het notariaat ter beschikking heeft om fraude te bestrijden

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether the notariat has enough tools to combat fraud, including BV fraud after the removal of preventive checks, EU digital incorporation, a VAT-number pre-check scheme and a central shareholder register. The minister acknowledges the notary's gatekeeper role, is in talks with the KNB, denies a clear causal link to simplified BV law, rejects the VAT pre-check idea because of the fiscal confidentiality duty, and says the government will prepare a position on the shareholder register initiative.
I am in discussion with the KNB about the instruments the notariat needs, given its gatekeeper role.
Ik ben in gesprek met de KNB over het instrumentarium dat voor het notariaat, vanwege diens poortwachtersrol, nodig en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over afschaffing van het 500 euro biljet

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the 500-euro note, which is rarely used for payments but common in criminal money flows, should be abolished, and about its circulation outside the eurozone. The minister answers that the government will push via DNB for an end date at the ECB and raise acceptance limits in the MOB, noting that the ECB stopped issuing the note in 2019 and that its legal tender status is set in EU law.
As also announced in the anti-money-laundering action plan sent to the House today, Minister Grapperhaus and I will work to abolish the 500-euro note.
Zoals ook aangekondigd in het plan van aanpak witwassen dat vandaag naar de Tweede Kamer is verzonden, gaan Minister Grapperhaus en ik ons inzetten voor het afschaffen van het 500 eurobiljet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘U.S. sanctions Congo election officials, says they obstructed vote’

MP Ploumen asks the government whether it knows of US sanctions on Congolese election officials for obstructing the vote, and about corruption, the effects of EU and US sanctions, network-based sanctioning and criminal money flows in the DRC. Minister Blok answers that the Netherlands is in contact with the US, that EU and US sanctions target individuals obstructing the election, that network-based sanctions were not an EU criterion, and that tracing illicit money flows is being pursued with partners such as The Sentry.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het depositogarantiestelsel

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the deposit guarantee scheme (DGS) fund, reaching only 0.8% of guaranteed deposits by 2024, would suffice in a systemic bank crisis and who would ultimately pay. The minister replied that the DGS is adequate for most consumer savings, cited resolution tools, ex post levies, credit lines and planned EDIS, and rejected that taxpayers necessarily bear the costs, while acknowledging a government pre-financing role cannot be fully excluded.
Despite these lines of defence, it cannot be fully ruled out that in the extreme case recourse to the government may be made to provide pre-financing for a certain period.

Ondanks deze verdedigingslinies kan niet volledig worden uitgesloten dat in het uiterste geval een beroep op de overheid wordt gedaan om voorfinanciering te verstrekken gedurende een bepaalde periode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Snels over het bericht dat het kabinet €2 miljard per jaar kan besparen op diabeteszorg (voor type 2) door betere, meer duurzame en goedkopere diabeteszorg

Greens MPs Ellemeet and Snels asked whether the government would pursue lifestyle medicine and demedicalisation to cut type 2 diabetes costs, and how this fits budget rules and prevention commitments. The minister responded that lifestyle interventions can help but their savings are not yet proven, pointed to a ZonMw research programme of 1 million euro, said GLI is in the basic package and expects further steps via the Preventieakkoord, and promised an inventory with stakeholders by year end.
I want to work with relevant field parties to inventory why certain lifestyle interventions (e.g. interventions for diabetes) are not getting off the ground or are not being scaled up.
Ik wil samen met betrokken veldpartijen inventariseren waarom bepaalde leefstijlinterventies (bijv. interventies bij diabetes) niet van de grond komen of niet worden opgeschaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Snels over het bericht dat  KLM medeoprichter is van een maatschappij die vluchten tussen Antwerpen en Londen wil verzorgen

MPs Kröger and Snels asked whether the government knows KLM co-founded Air Antwerp, a Antwerp-London flight venture, and how this fits KLM's talks on phasing out short flights. The minister confirms awareness, says the Antwerp-London route falls outside the Dutch phase-out process, and promises to urge the sector to favour rail on short routes.
The fact that KLM holds a minority interest in the new airline Air Antwerp, which wants to (re)open the Antwerp-London route, does not detract from the above process.

Het feit dat de KLM een minderheidsbelang heeft in de nieuwe luchtvaartmaatschappij Air Antwerp – die de route tussen Antwerpen en Londen wil (her)openen – doet geen afbreuk aan het bovengenoemde proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Sneller over berichten dat Sint Maarten niet optreedt tegen witwassen

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary and Finance Minister about reports that Sint Maarten is not acting against money laundering, including the economic consequences of FATF non-compliance, EU and Kingdom implications, casino transaction reporting, and the Integrity Chamber. The government answered that Sint Maarten is responsible for implementing FATF recommendations, outlined possible CFATF countermeasures and grey-list risks, noted Dutch and World Bank technical support, and described the Integrity Chamber's powers, while stating that money laundering prosecution falls outside that chamber.
Foremost, anchoring the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) recommendations in legislation is a responsibility of the country of Sint Maarten.
Voorop staat dat de verankering van de aanbevelingen van de Financial Action Task Force (FATF) in wetgeving een verantwoordelijkheid is van het land Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Tony van Dijck over hypotheken voor ‘duurhuurders’

PVV MPs Kops and Tony van Dijck asked whether tenants paying high rents should be able to get mortgages based on actual monthly costs, and whether stricter income rules should be relaxed given lost wealth-building. The minister defended current income-based mortgage rules, saying individual case-by-case exceptions (the explain option) are possible and that the pilot by BLG Wonen is being monitored, while refusing a general loosening of income requirements.
I am not in favour of generally relaxing the income requirements for mortgage credit, because this would increase the risk of over-lending to consumers.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het generiek versoepelen van de inkomenseisen voor hypothecair krediet, omdat dit het risico van overkreditering van consumenten doet toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Dik-Faber over de berichten ‘NBA bezorgd over daling aantal oob-kantoren’ en ‘Woningcorporaties worden al streng genoeg gecontroleerd’

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Finance and Interior ministers about NBA concerns that the number of accountancy firms licensed to audit public-interest entities (oob) is falling, and about extending that status to large housing corporations. The minister answers that the decline is regrettable but not yet a shortage, rejects tailored rules for small oob firms, and says the oob status for housing corporations above 5,000 units will go ahead, while promising to await the CTA recommendations on the audit market.
Applying tailored treatment for smaller oob accountancy organisations does not seem desirable to me from that point of view.
Het toepassen van maatwerk voor kleinere oob-accountantsorganisaties lijkt mij vanuit dat oogpunt niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over een mogelijk op handen zijnde fusie tussen ING en Commerzbank

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch and German governments discussed a possible ING-Commerzbank merger, how large the banks are, whether such a merger is desirable, and what the government will do about too-big-to-fail risks. The minister declined to discuss the content of contacts with German counterparts, said bank mergers are for banks and supervisors (ECB, DNB) to assess, and pointed to existing resolution and capital tools without committing to new action.
I cannot go into the content of individual conversations.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de inhoud van individuele gesprekken.
Àntwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Van Eijs en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘800.000 Nederlanders kregen kanker, na ‘genezing’ houden zij problemen’

Three D66 MPs asked the health, finance and social affairs ministers about reports that many cancer survivors face lasting problems, including ongoing fatigue, lack of aftercare and advice, difficulties returning to work, and problems obtaining mortgages and insurance. The ministers answered that care providers should be doing more, that existing initiatives such as a no-risk insurance pilot and a Taskforce Cancer Survivorship are underway, and that the government sees little need for its own intervention, while promising to review mortgage and insurance issues with the sector.

In preparation for the next Platform meeting in 2020, I will ask how lenders handle the life insurance requirement and whether parties experience other bottlenecks in mortgage provision to (ex-)cancer patients.

Ik zal in voorbereiding op de volgende Platform bijeenkomst in 2020 uitvragen hoe kredietverstrekkers omgaan met de overlijdensrisicoverzekering en of partijen andere knelpunten ervaren op het gebied van hypotheekverstrekking aan (ex)kankerpatiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Sneller over het bericht 'ING en milieuorganisaties bepleiten klimaatrichtlijnen voor financiële sector'

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government will act on an NGO and ING call for climate guidelines for banks, including requesting IEA scenarios and a single carbon measurement method. The minister answered that the IEA Sustainable Development Scenario already suffices, that the Dutch financial sector's commitment to Paris-aligned targets is welcomed, and that a single measurement method is premature while harmonisation proceeds.
However, in my view it is still too early to introduce a single standard measurement method for the climate impact of investments at this time.
Het is echter wat mij betreft nog te vroeg om op dit moment één standaard meetmethode in te voeren voor de klimaatimpact van investeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over betere samenwerking tussen banken in de strijd tegen witwassen

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about bank customer due diligence against money laundering, whether banks must check prior banks for new clients, and whether they may share information on suspected launderers, plus the idea of a blacklist for convicted launderers. The minister explained the Wwft duties, said banks may share limited transaction information but not account or mortgage data, and said a review of data sharing and a register of high-risk clients is underway, with results in a plan of action.

I am examining not only the legal (im)possibilities and the added value for the effectiveness of customer due diligence and transaction monitoring, but also the proportionality and desirability of the information exchange.

Ik onderzoek niet alleen de juridische (on)mogelijkheden en de toegevoegde waarde voor de effectiviteit van het cliëntenonderzoek en de transactiemonitoring, maar ook de proportionaliteit en wenselijkheid van de informatie-uitwisseling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over onbetrouwbare geldautomaten en stortingen

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how often cash deposits at ATMs go wrong to the customer's detriment, whether DNB supervises this and sets error norms, and whether the government will act on banks' handling of such claims. The minister answered that banks handle complaints first, escalating to Kifid or courts, that structural problems are not known, that DNB tests ATMs for counterfeit detection, and that he will raise the matter with the NVB.
Nevertheless, I will ask the NVB for its attention to this.
Desalniettemin zal ik de aandacht van de NVB hiervoor vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het bericht ‘Open letter on climate-related financial risks’

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked the finance and economic affairs ministers how they respond to a central bank open letter with four recommendations on climate-related financial risks, and whether the government will engage with the NGFS and open up climate data. The minister answers that the recommendations are valuable and largely in line with government policy, citing DNB stress tests, the Klimaatakkoord, and EU and international initiatives, while stating that the NGFS is a central bank network in which ministers are not directly involved.
I therefore strongly advocate, together with DNB and the AFM, at European and international level for integrating climate risks into banks' risk management and supervision.
Ik maak mij dan ook – samen met DNB en de AFM – in Europees en internationaal verband hard voor het integreren van klimaatrisico’s in het risicobeheer van banken, alsmede in het toezicht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de opvatting van het financieel stabiliteitscomité over het Klimaatakkoord en over de niet gepubliceerde achtergronddocumenten van het Klimaatakkoord

CDA MPs asked the ministers whether the Financial Stability Committee's warnings about mortgage lending norms and green building-linked finance conflict with the draft Climate Agreement, and why the PBL analysis's background documents and reviewer access were incomplete. The ministers replied that AFM and DNB concerns are being taken into account in designing new financing options, that the PBL published three of five background documents, and that the government holds no unpublished background documents.
It is up to the PBL to make the background documents public.
Het is aan PBL om de achtergronddocumenten openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Raak over het bericht dat buitenlandse bedrijven Europese partijen sponsoren

MPs Leijten and Van Raak asked whether buying influence over parties through foreign corporate donations and Dutch shell companies is undesirable, and what the government will do to make European party financing more transparent and block corporate funding. The minister agrees buying influence is undesirable, announces a bill banning non-EU donations to Dutch parties, and says EU-level changes to Regulation 1141/2014 can only come via the scheduled 2021 review.

Given the increased risk of foreign influence, the cabinet will, in addition to the existing transparency rules in the Wfpp, prohibit donations from outside the EU (except from Dutch voters residing abroad) and require full transparency for donations from other EU countries.
Gelet op het toegenomen risico van buitenlandse beïnvloeding zal het kabinet in aanvulling op de bestaande transparantieregels in de Wfpp giften van buiten de EU verbieden

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Sneller over de berichten ‘Grondspeculant belemmert bouwplannen van gemeenten’, ‘Dubieuze handel in kavels veel omvangrijker dan gedacht en ‘Niemand wil bouwen op versnipperde

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Finance and of the Interior about reports that land speculation obstructs municipal building plans, that land trading in plots is more extensive than thought, and that fragmented land is hard to build on, asking about municipal pre-emption rights, the reach of the Wvg after the Omgevingswet, and AFM supervision of speculative land offerings. The minister acknowledged speculation can delay projects but could not assess how many municipalities are affected, said the pre-emption right is an effective tool and that she had received no signals of municipal unawareness, and explained that land offerings structured as leases or self-managed fall outside AFM supervision, with a bill on investment objects planned for late 2019.
However, I cannot assess to what extent and in how many municipalities concrete (firm) building plans are actually obstructed by land speculation.
Ik kan echter niet beoordelen in hoeverre en in hoeveel gemeenten daadwerkelijk door grondspeculatie concrete (harde) bouwplannen worden bemoeilijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sneller over het verkrijgen van inzicht in de gevolgen van maximumsnelheden

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government gains insight into the effects of speed limits, including the 130 km/h motorway limit, on road safety, air quality, costs, liveability and congestion, and whether evaluation and cost-benefit analyses are adequate. The minister answered that effects are tracked in annual monitors, that road safety is a priority but the speed limits will be kept, that the Court of Audit has a study pending, and that a French-style study in the Netherlands is not needed.
If not, do you agree that it would be desirable to have these insights?
Zo nee, deelt u de mening dat het wenselijk zou zijn om wel over deze inzichten te beschikken?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nog steeds tekortschieten van het tuchtrecht voor banken

MP Alkaya asks whether the banking disciplinary system (Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken) is accessible, whether banks as organisations should fall under it, and whether it can change banking culture. Minister Hoekstra answers that the sector is responsible for public awareness, that a checklist and referral practice are in place, that bank-level liability is better handled by DNB, AFM and civil law, and that the oath has raised awareness though more is needed.

I therefore see no reason – and this would also deviate greatly from other disciplinary systems, such as medical disciplinary law – to extend the scope so that the bank as an organisation can also be held to account under disciplinary law.

Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding – en dit zou ook zeer afwijken van andere tuchtrechtelijke stelsels, zoals het medisch tuchtrecht – de reikwijdte uit te breiden zodat ook de bank als organisatie tuchtrechtelijk kan worden aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de kosten van stimulering van fossiele brandstoffen

An MP asked the state secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure about the cost of fossil fuel subsidies, aviation fuel and car tax exemptions, carbon pricing and related environmental damage (34 questions). The government answered that it favours pricing polluting activities, acknowledged existing exemptions bound by international treaties, and promised a study into definitions of environmentally harmful subsidies, but did not provide several requested figures.
To nevertheless implement the motion as well as possible, the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate will commission a study into the various definitions of environmentally harmful subsidies.

Om toch zo goed mogelijk uitvoering te geven aan de motie zal de Minister van Economische zaken en klimaat een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de uiteenlopende definities van milieuschadelijke subsidies
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Eurozone budget likely to play stabilizing role: Moscovici'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about a Reuters report that a eurozone stabilisation function is likely and that Dutch officials privately agree it is needed, and asks whether the Netherlands will challenge Commissioner Moscovici. The Minister replies that the Netherlands opposes a stabilisation function, that the eurozone budget should focus only on convergence and competitiveness within the MFF, and that he will raise the issue in the Eurogroup.
The cabinet is not in favour of a stabilisation function for the eurozone, as it has stated several times in earlier letters to the House.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van een stabilisatiefunctie voor de eurozone, zoals ook meermaals is aangegeven in eerdere brieven aan uw kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Spaargeld in de zak van de bank: ‘Ik voel mij zwaar belazerd door ABN AMRO’’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Radar report on ABN AMRO's Meegroeihypotheek, where a customer's savings could be lost on death and the risk was not disclosed, and asked whether consumers are adequately informed and whether the AFM should investigate. The minister said the product is no longer sold by ABN AMRO, pointed to the complaints route via Kifid and courts, noted the AFM sets its own priorities, and saw no reason for further action.

On a risk-oriented basis, for example based on consumer complaints or advertising by mortgage providers and insurers, the Netherlands Authority for the Financial Markets as an independent supervisor determines its own supervisory priorities.

Op basis van een risicogeoriënteerde inzet, bijvoorbeeld op basis van meldingen van consumenten of reclame-uitingen van hypotheekaanbieders en verzekeraars, bepaalt de Autoriteit Financiële Markten als onafhankelijk toezichthouder haar eigen toezichtprioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Italy raises deficit target, risking fresh conflict with the EU’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about Italy's raised deficit forecast, its growth projections over the past year, whether Italy still complies with the Stability and Growth Pact, and whether the Commission should open an excessive deficit procedure sooner. The minister says the Italian forecasts were endorsed by an independent fiscal body, that the Commission will assess compliance in June, that a procedure now is not warranted, and that he will keep pressing for strict enforcement at Ecofin/Eurogroup.
As I have also done in recent times, I will continue to work at European level for strict compliance with and consistent enforcement of the SGP.
Zoals ik ook de afgelopen tijd heb gedaan, zal ik mij in Europees verband blijven inzetten voor een strikte naleving en consequente handhaving van het SGP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht dat de beantwoording van Kamervragen is afgestemd met het BKR

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about reports that the ministry coordinated its answers to earlier parliamentary questions with the credit registration bureau BKR, and whether this undermined trust in politics. The minister replied that consulting BKR was necessary to check the feasibility of the measures it was asked to take, that the ministry has no control over the independent BKR, and that the BKR has since published a balancing-of-interests guideline, free access to personal data, and dispute-committee rulings.
The picture painted in the report is not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat in het bericht wordt geschetst, herken ik niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Ronnes en Van der Linde over het bericht dat het Ministerie van Financiën de beantwoording van Kamervragen over het handelen van het Bureau Kredietregistratie (BKR) met dat bureau

MPs Sneller, Ronnes and Van der Linde asked whether the Ministry of Finance aligned its answers to earlier parliamentary questions on BKR (credit registration bureau) conduct with BKR itself, whether measures were agreed with BKR, and about free access to personal data. The minister replies that BKR was consulted on factual points and a proposed approach was adjusted, that BKR remains independent and decides on measures, and that free access under the GDPR is provided, with no limit on the number of requests.
It is customary that, to answer parliamentary questions, contact is sought with involved parties both inside and outside government.
Het is gebruikelijk dat ten behoeve van de beantwoording van Kamervragen contact wordt gezocht met betrokken partijen van binnen en buiten de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over betere richtlijnen voor een lager maatschappelijk OZB-tarief voor bij voorbeeld sportverenigingen en buurthuizen

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked whether the government will help municipalities set a lower property tax (OZB) rate for sports clubs, community centres and similar non-profit organisations, and whether they agree such organisations should be taxed differently from businesses. The minister answered that talks with the VNG are ongoing, that OZB taxation follows the property rather than the owner so a lower rate for organisations does not fit its objective character, and that the government will consider the problems the VNG identifies.
Introducing the lower OZB rate for sports clubs and similar organisations does not fit the objective nature of this levy.
De invoering van het lagere ozb-tarief voor sportverenigingen e.a. sluit niet aan bij het objectieve karakter van deze heffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat de Minister van Financiën en de premier in het Catshuis overleggen met de top van de bancaire sector

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about a Catshuis dinner with bank executives, asking who attended, what was discussed, whether minutes exist, whether structural reforms like a public bank were raised, and whether banks have restored trust. The minister named the attendees, said the meeting focused on restoring trust, anti-money-laundering shortcomings and information sharing, declined to produce minutes as a matter of practice, and said the WRR report was not on the agenda.
No minutes are made of the informal meetings in the Catshuis.
Er worden geen verslagen gemaakt van de informele bijeenkomsten in het Catshuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over een zwartboek waaruit blijkt dat verzekeraars letselschadezaken niet altijd goed afhandelen

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked about a Radar black book showing insurers do not always handle personal injury claims properly under the GBL code, and proposed statutory deadlines, sanctions, an independent tribunal and easier court access. The minister said a University of Utrecht study is under way, that the Tuchtraad already exists, that deelgeschillen procedures are available, and that responsibility is shared between two ministries, promising to decide on measures after the study results.
Based on the outcomes of the University of Utrecht study, I will engage with the various stakeholders involved.
Aan de hand van de uitkomsten van voornoemd onderzoek van de Universiteit Utrecht zal ik in gesprek gaan met de verschillende betrokken stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Snels over het Eerlijk Pensioenlabel

MPs Smeulders and Snels asked ministers about the Eerlijk Pensioenlabel ranking of Dutch pension funds' sustainability policies, including the methodology, the poor grades, lagging disclosure, follow-up under the IMVB convenant, and whether climate reporting should be mandatory. The government defended the pension funds' own responsibility, pointed to the IMVB convenant and existing reporting duties, declined to assess the study's methodology, and said the sector would be given time to improve before any further regulation.
It is not for the government to assess the methodology of the research, nor to assess the outcomes of the research or come up with alternative grades.
Het is niet aan de overheid om de methodologie van het onderzoek te beoordelen, noch om de uitkomsten van het onderzoek te beoordelen of met alternatieve rapportcijfers te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over de berichten ‘ING ook in Italië laks met controle tegen witwaspraktijken’ en ‘Hoekstra: affaire ING in Italië verontrustend’

MP Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING was lax in anti-money-laundering controls in Italy and about the Minister's view of the gatekeeper failures, including whether the problem is broader than ING, what the Minister's contacts with other countries revealed, whether ING informs him of progress, and what role ING's supervisory board played. The Minister answered that he finds such signals worrying, that DNB supervises Dutch-based ING and Dutch branches while foreign subsidiaries fall under their home supervisors, that a post-mortem review of several European bank cases is underway, and that the supervisory board backed a recovery programme.
I have worked at European level to carry out a post-mortem review of these money-laundering cases at European banks.
Ik heb mij in Europees verband ingezet voor het uitvoeren van een post-mortem review naar deze witwaszaken bij Europese banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht ‘Franse staat koopt nieuwe aandelen Air France-KLM’

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether the French state was increasing its Air France-KLM stake, how the Dutch state protects its voting and governance position, and whether the stake purchase affects existing guarantees and cooperation arrangements. The minister answered that the French state is only participating in a convertible bond whose conversion would raise its stake by about 1%, that the Dutch state chose not to participate, and that no consequences follow for governance, guarantees or the 2003-2004 agreements, while cooperation talks are ongoing.
We cannot anticipate the outcomes of this.
Wij kunnen op de uitkomsten hiervan niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat de topman van ING mogelijk alsnog vervolgd wordt

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING's top executive may still be prosecuted, and why he had not been prosecuted earlier. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service has referred complaints to the Court of Appeal, that a complaint has been filed against natural persons, and that the settlement with ING did not bar prosecution of individuals.
The Court of Appeal will rule on these complaints. I will not anticipate that.
Het Gerechtshof zal over deze klachten oordelen. Daar loop ik niet op vooruit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het blijven zitten met restschulden na overlijden

MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister whether banks sold spaargroeihypotheken with life-risk insurance under which part of the savings can fall to the bank on early death, whether consumers were properly informed, whether the AFM reviewed these products, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answers that the product was sold 2004-2010, that the AFM received no prior complaints and PARP rules only came into force in 2013, that ABN-AMRO has contacted customers with options, and that no further action with banks is planned.
As far as I am aware, such a product was offered by several lenders, but I have no overview of which lenders these were.
Voor zover mij bekend werd een dergelijk product door verschillende kredietverstrekkers aangeboden, maar ik heb geen overzicht van welke kredietverstrekkers dit betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over misbruik van crowdfundkanalen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about misuse of crowdfunding platforms, including platform obligations to identify users, AFM supervision, fee transparency, victim remedies and police capacity. The government said the scale is unknown, platforms must follow civil and consumer law without new legislation, reward and donation crowdfunding fall under ACM rather than AFM, and victims can report to police and that investigative capacity is sufficient.
The scale of misuse of crowdfunding campaigns is not known.
De schaal van het misbruik van crowdfundingacties is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Linde over het bericht dat een Russische bank miljarden witwaste, ook via Nederlandse banken

MPs Sneller and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about reports that a Russian bank laundered billions, partly through Dutch banks, and about ING's role and the EU high-risk third-country list. The minister said supervisory information on individual institutions is confidential, outlined DNB's AML enforcement powers, and explained the Netherlands' objection to the Commission's list on procedural grounds while declining to comment on individual cases or diplomatic communications.
Information on individual institutions is subject to supervisory confidentiality. DNB therefore cannot share this information, not even with your House or with me.
Informatie over individuele instellingen is toezichtsvertrouwelijk. DNB kan deze informatie daarom niet delen, ook niet met uw Kamer of met mij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Slootweg over Nederlandstalige informatie over de staatsschuld

MPs Van der Molen and Slootweg asked why the annual Outlook on state debt financing is published only in English, whether this obscures the per-capita debt burden, and whether essential information should also be available in Dutch. The minister answered that the Outlook is in English since 2008 because its audience is English-speaking, that the essential content is available in Dutch elsewhere, and that Dutch press releases and publications on debt are issued, while rejecting the suggestion of deliberate obscuring.
Only information on turnover in the so-called secondary market regarding maturity, type of investor and geographic location of trading activity is not separately published in Dutch.
Alleen informatie over omzet op de zogenaamde secundaire markt inzake de looptijd, type investeerder en geografische locatie van de handelsactiviteit wordt niet apart in het Nederlands gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels, Sneller, Bruins en Nijboer over de ING-witwasaffaire

Four MPs asked the Finance Minister whether his ministry suggested wording to DNB on its letter about the ING money-laundering case, whether it steered answers, and how ministerial responsibility for DNB is exercised. The minister answered that his officials only asked clarifying questions, that DNB decides its own wording, that he holds only system responsibility for DNB, and that he was first informed of the case on 31 August 2018.
DNB is independent in carrying out the tasks assigned to it as an independent administrative body: it judges individual cases autonomously and is not subordinate to the Minister of Finance.

DNB is onafhankelijk in de uitvoering van de taken die haar als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan zijn opgedragen: zij oordeelt zelfstandig over individuele gevallen en is niet ondergeschikt aan de Minister van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Snels en Nijboer over ING als huisbankier van de Staat

MPs Bruins, Snels and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister when he learned of legal options to terminate state contracts with ING after the money-laundering settlement, why the September letter did not explain them, and when the Chamber would be informed. The minister answered that legal options were mapped from September 2018, advice was finalised in late September, the Chamber received the analysis in earlier answers, and a further letter on additional exclusion and termination grounds was sent with this answer.

Simultaneously with answering these questions, I am informing your Chamber by letter about the possibilities of including additional exclusion grounds in new tender procedures for payment services and about additional termination grounds in contracts.

Gelijktijdig met de beantwoording van deze vragen informeer ik uw Kamer per brief over de mogelijkheden voor het opnemen van aanvullende uitsluitingsgronden bij nieuwe aanbestedingsprocedures betalingsverkeer en over aanvullende opzeggingsgronden in overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het discrimineren door banken van klanten met een spaarhypotheek

An MP asked whether banks such as ING and Rabobank unfairly charge a rate surcharge to customers renewing an expiring savings mortgage, how much tax deduction is involved, and what the government will do to make banks prioritise customer interests. The Minister of Finance answered that rate differences between mortgage types are permitted, that the surcharge reflects higher interest and refinancing risk and is treated as ordinary deductible interest, that the amount of deduction involved is unknown, and that the sector should itself show more regard for customers.
I am of the view that it is primarily up to the sector to show that they have more regard for the interests of the customer.
Ik ben van mening dat het primair aan de sector is om te laten zien dat zij meer oog hebben voor het belang van de klant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'EBRD overweegt opnieuw miljoenenlening MHP'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the EBRD's proposed EUR 100 million loan to Ukrainian poultry producer MHP for acquiring a Slovenian poultry integrator raises concerns about unfair competition, state aid and lower production standards, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that the loan is not state aid, that EBRD rules require additionality, that the Netherlands abstained and objected to earlier MHP loans on environmental and animal welfare grounds, and that the EU is seeking to curb duty-free poultry imports from Ukraine through the Association Agreement.
Because it concerns an acquisition, the EBRD is bound by rules on handling market-sensitive information.
Omdat het een overname betreft is de EBRD gebonden aan regels ten aanzien van de omgang met marktgevoelige informatie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over fraude met bankrekeningnummers

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about direct debit fraud, including how often it occurs, how it can be prevented, how victims can recover money, and whether payment descriptions can be made clearer. The minister answered that fraud losses are small (EUR 89,000 in 2018), that banks and creditors bear control duties and customers have refund rights, and that the market and the consultation body MOB are sufficient to improve transaction clarity.
The MOB discussed this topic at its autumn meeting.
Het MOB heeft dit onderwerp besproken in haar najaarsvergadering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Raak over het bericht dat de topman van ABN AMRO niet wil dat de overheid treuzelt met de verkoop

MPs Alkaya and Van Raak asked the Finance Minister to request that ABN AMRO publish any future scenarios it drew up in 2018, including ones assuming a sales halt, and whether the parliamentary information duty applies to state-majority companies. The minister said he is not aware of such scenarios, that a sales halt is not on the table under the coalition agreement, that publishing them is not opportune, and that the information duty applies only to ministers and state secretaries, not to companies in which the state holds a majority stake.
I therefore do not consider it opportune to ask ABN AMRO to make such scenarios public, should they exist.
Ik vind het dan ook niet opportuun om ABN AMRO te verzoeken dergelijke scenario’s, mochten deze al bestaan, openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de één miljoen euro boete voor Rabobank vanwege gebrekkig witwastoezicht

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about a 1 million euro DNB fine on Rabobank for weak anti-money-laundering checks, including why DNB did not inform parliament, how many measures it has taken against banks, and whether informal enforcement is adequate. The minister said DNB is bound by confidentiality for pre-July 2018 sanctions, cited DNB's enforcement counts, and declined to comment on the individual case.
DNB is subject to a statutory duty of confidentiality in its integrity supervision, which also applies towards me and your House.
Op DNB rust in het kader van haar integriteitstoezicht een wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht, die ook richting mij en uw Kamer geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Alkaya over Uber

The SP MPs asked the government about a series of accidents involving Uber drivers, driver age and insurance, and whether Uber's safety measures and competition rules are adequate. The state secretary answered that police investigations are ongoing, that SWOV research on taxi accidents was commissioned, that Uber's measures are a good first step, and that existing rules apply equally to all taxi operators.
The police are currently investigating the various accidents. We cannot anticipate the outcomes of that.
De politie onderzoekt momenteel de verschillende ongevallen. Op de uitkomsten daarvan kunnen wij niet vooruitlopen.
