Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een schikking met KPMG

An MP asked ministers why KPMG's Curaçao affiliate received a small settlement for facilitating money laundering, whether the settlement should have waited for ongoing cases, and whether the Dutch prosecution service was involved. The minister answered that the decision lies with the Curaçao prosecution service, which is outside Dutch responsibility, and gave no further commitment.

In this case it is for the Curaçao prosecution service to decide whether to proceed to prosecution of the suspect in an individual criminal case and which disposal modality is appropriate and warranted.
Het is in dit geval aan het OM Curaçao om te beslissen of in een individuele strafzaak tot vervolging van de verdachte wordt overgegaan en welke afdoeningsmodaliteit passend en geboden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over een item in het programma Kanniewaarzijn

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether the government shares concern that older people and people on benefits struggle to get small mortgages, and whether lenders' duty of care and a 'no-fuss' rule for mortgages under 20-30% of WOZ value should be added. Minister Hoekstra answered that lenders choose their target groups, that a bagatelle rule is not responsible because home value does not reveal income, and that the government will raise remaining bottlenecks at the next Platform hypotheken meeting.
From the Platform hypotheken I currently have no signals that people with modest incomes lack mortgage options while this would be responsible.
Vanuit het Platform hypotheken heb ik op dit moment geen signalen dat mensen met een bescheiden inkomen geen hypotheekmogelijkheden hebben terwijl dit wel verantwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over medewerkers van ABN AMRO die de bonuswet omzeilen

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about ABN AMRO staff holding private-equity participations via ABN AMRO Participaties, apparently circumventing bonus rules, and asked about payouts, risk, and carried-interest-like status. The minister answered that the fund had been spun off, that individual payouts are confidential, and that tax qualification is for the tax inspector.
Information on the investment and payout per person cannot be provided due to the personal confidential nature of this information.
Informatie over de inleg en uitkering per persoon kan niet gegeven worden in verband met het persoonsvertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het opiniestuk van eurocommissaris Moscovici in de Financial Times

An MP asked the Finance Minister about an op-ed by Commissioner Moscovici arguing the Commission is political, and about how the Commission applied the Stability and Growth Pact to Italy and France. The minister said the Pact allows limited discretion but must be applied strictly, called the Italy case a clear breach, and said France's case is still open pending the spring forecast, while supporting a more independent enforcement body.
The cabinet is of the view that less flexibility, stricter enforcement of the rules and greater predictability in applying them can increase the effectiveness of the SGP.

Het kabinet is van mening dat minder flexibiliteit, een striktere handhaving van de regels en het vergroten van de voorspelbaarheid bij de uitvoering van de regels, de effectiviteit van het SGP kan vergroten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Wörsdörfer over de financieringsmogelijkheden van het midden- en kleinbedrijf en de financieringsmonitor van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about SME financing difficulties, the CBS Financing Monitor, and possible policy responses. The State Secretary answered that SME financing is riskier, that Dutch figures are broadly in line with European surveys, and that the government is supporting schemes such as BMKB, Qredits and financing tables, with a CPB study and a Kamerbrief promised.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht 'Hoge winst voor banken, extreem lage spaarrente: kan dat niet anders?'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Finance about banks' high profits and very low savings rates, including whether banks' conduct and the ECB's negative deposit rate are consistent with capital buffers, competition and consumer choice. The Minister answered all 13 questions, arguing that low savings rates reflect market conditions, that banks' role in lending is their core task, that competition authority ACM oversees the market, and that the government will respond later to a WRR report on money and debt.
The cabinet attaches importance to competition and a diverse banking landscape.
Het kabinet hecht aan concurrentie en een divers bankenlandschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

An MP asked the government about the Week zonder vlees, the ministry's role in promoting it, meat externalities, and a Canadian dietary recommendation, and whether ministry diners could be made meat-free by default. The government answered jointly and the answers cited earlier written answers (Aanhangsel Handelingen 1896) rather than addressing the questions in substance.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2019Z03359, on a week without meat, were answered by way of Aanhangsel Handelingen, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1896.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD), vraagnummer 2019Z03359 , inzake een week zonder vlees, zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Italy’s recession strains EU to make the budget numbers add up’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about downward revisions to Italy's 2019 growth forecast (from 1.2% to 0.2% by the Commission) and the implications for Italy's compliance with EU fiscal rules and the timing of Commission assessment. The minister said the revision will likely worsen Italy's fiscal position, that the Commission will reassess in its spring forecast, and that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged strict application of the Stability and Growth Pact.
It is not for the Netherlands to make its own estimate of Italy's budgetary situation.
Het is niet aan Nederland om zelf een raming te maken van de Italiaanse budgettaire situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over het plegen van identiteitsfraude

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked how easy it still is to commit identity fraud, how banks verify identity when opening accounts and granting credit, and whether remote and outsourced checks are adequately supervised. The minister explained the Wwft verification rules, DNB's supervision and the fraud-prevention initiatives, but gave no commitment to new measures.
DNB supervises banks' compliance with the Wwft and has named preventing institutions' involvement in financial-economic crime as a priority of its supervision.

De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) houdt toezicht op de naleving van de Wwft door banken, en heeft het voorkomen van betrokkenheid van instellingen bij financieel-economische criminaliteit benoemd als speerpunt van haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Overheid stimuleert roken: ondernemers kunnen sigaretten aftrekken van belasting’

An SP MP asked whether business owners being able to deduct tobacco costs from tax, and the government's preventive stance on smoking, are consistent, and about the economic case for a smoke-free society. The government answered that tax law is in principle value-neutral, that tobacco costs for owners are non-deductible or limited as mixed costs, that no data exist on how often tobacco deductions are claimed, and that the existing tax rules can coexist with prevention policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Ronnes over het bericht dat sommige kleine Europese landen in trek zijn voor licenties van nieuwe betaaldiensten

MPs Sneller and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about reports that small EU states attract payment-licence applicants and about supervisory capacity, money-laundering risks linked to citizenship-by-investment schemes in Malta and Cyprus, and whether supervision should be centralised at EU level. The minister answered that PSD II harmonises supervision, that Dutch supervisors can escalate to the EBA, that the Commission is monitoring citizenship schemes, and that the government favours only gradual, criteria-based centralisation, so EU-level supervision of payment services is not warranted for now.
The cabinet therefore favours a gradual transfer of supervisory tasks away from national supervisors.
Het kabinet is daarom voorstander van een geleidelijke overgang van toezichttaken van nationale toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over de stijgende energierekening

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked why the cabinet's estimate of a 108 euro rise in household energy bills differs from the CBS figure of 334 euro, and whether the cabinet will correct its distributional and purchasing-power estimates using CPB findings. The minister attributes most of the gap to market price assumptions and differing energy-use assumptions, says current inflation data give no reason to doubt the purchasing-power figures, and promises a CPB analysis of the Klimaatakkoord income effects and to improve information with PBL, CBS and others.
The cabinet considers it important to keep a clear view of how energy costs affect different households.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om goed zicht te houden hoe de energielasten neerslaan bij verschillende huishoudens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Agnes Mulder, Sienot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Ministerie erkent blunder met energierekening: Tweede Kamer boos’

MPs from VVD, D66, ChristenUnie and CDA asked why the government had used outdated 2017 PBL projections of household energy bills, which underestimated rising prices, and what the consequences are for the 2019 budget, koopkracht and the Klimaatakkoord analysis. Minister Wiebes acknowledges the government should have been less categorical and that the PBL did not update its outlook in 2018, attributes the price rise to market developments and existing policy, and promises a new PBL estimate within weeks.
The cabinet should have been less categorical at the end of last year and should have stressed more that this was a 2017 estimate.
Het kabinet had zich eind vorig jaar minder stellig moeten uitlaten en meer moeten benadrukken dat het hier ging om een raming uit 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de Nederlandse zuinigheid tegenover de Franse spilzucht

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about the Dutch versus French fiscal stance, including whether the Netherlands would reward citizens with a comparable gesture to France's 10 billion euro concessions to yellow-vest protesters. The Finance Minister replied that the Dutch and French contexts are not directly comparable, that the government is pursuing tax cuts and higher public spending, and that EU fiscal rules favour building buffers in good economic times.
The Dutch and French contexts are not directly comparable, so it is not possible to attach an amount for the Netherlands.
De Nederlandse en Franse context zijn niet direct te vergelijken, waardoor het niet mogelijk is hieraan een bedrag te koppelen voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bezoek van de topman van Air France-KLM

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether ministers discussed declining public support for aviation, climate targets and possible aviation shrinkage with the Air France-KLM CEO during his January 2019 visit. The government confirmed the meeting covered the network, public interests and agreements, and said climate and safety were not discussed at group level but are raised regularly with KLM and Transavia.
These topics were not discussed at Air France-KLM group level in this meeting.
Deze onderwerpen zijn in dit gesprek op Air France-KLM groepsniveau niet aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het mogelijk faillissement van SecurCash

MP Alkaya (SP) asked the Finance Minister about the handling of SecurCash's bankruptcy request, DNB's role beforehand, contacts with competitors, and worker protection. The minister said the bankruptcy process is for the courts and parties involved, described DNB's coordination with banks and cash-transport firms to bridge the wind-down, and outlined existing statutory protections for employees while promising to report back on systemic risks.
Once DNB has completed this analysis, I will come back to your House on it.
Nadat DNB deze analyse heeft afgerond, kom ik hier bij uw Kamer op terug.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Linde, Bruins, Stoffer, Tony van Dijck, Leijten, Baudet en Van Rooijen over de brief van de Minister van Financiën d.d. 5 februari 2019 over het op handen zijnde akkoord b

MPs asked the Finance Minister when the PEPP pension regulation would be finalised, what delegated acts it contains, whether Dutch pension rules could be affected without Dutch influence, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister said the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text because of the number of delegated-act powers and the EIOPA role, though the second-pillar pension system and tax rules are unaffected, and that the Chamber's view will be weighed in the vote.

As I announced in my letter of 5 February, I informed the Romanian presidency yesterday that the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text of the PEPP regulation at Coreper this coming Wednesday.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 5 februari jl. heb aangekondigd, heb ik gisteren aan het Roemeense voorzitterschap kenbaar gemaakt dat Nederland op Coreper aanstaande woensdag niet kan instemmen met het onderhandelaarsakkoord inzake de PEPP-verordening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Four Trends that Blockchain will Dominate in Emerging Tech in 2019’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister of Finance about blockchain developments, government funding, legal frameworks, regulatory sandboxes, bank account access for blockchain firms, a business complaints desk, and regulation abroad. The government answers that blockchain is still maturing, about 2.8 million euros is spent on blockchain research, several legal studies are underway, and it will examine EU financial rules and crypto regulation without finding clear domestic barriers so far.
A cabinet response to the report is expected before the summer recess.
Naar verwachting zal vóór het zomerreces een kabinetsreactie op het rapport volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over bancaire investeringen in fossiele energie

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked whether banks should speed up green investment, how the government monitors fossil versus renewable financing, and whether a complaint was filed with the OECD National Contact Point over bank human rights concerns in oil and gas. The minister said DNB monitors financial sector exposure to CO2-intensive sectors, the sector committed to measuring and reporting CO2 emissions from 2020, no OECD complaint has been filed, and an oil and gas value chain analysis under the banking IMVO covenant is in preparation.
No, following the Eerlijke Bankwijzer research no complaint has been filed with the National Contact Point (NCP) for the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
Nee, er is naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van de Eerlijke Bankwijzer geen klacht ingediend bij het Nationaal Contact Punt (NCP) voor de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Alkaya, Snels en Bruins over het bericht dat banken financiering van fossiele energie niet hebben teruggebracht

MPs from D66, SP, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks and insurers still invest far more in fossil energy than in renewables, and about the transparency and comparability of financial institutions' climate investments. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to DNB monitoring, the sector's climate commitment within the Klimaatakkoord, and EU sustainability disclosure work, without committing to new mandatory reporting rules.
At the request of a motion by MPs Snels and Sneller, I have asked DNB to continue monitoring the Dutch financial sector's exposures to CO2-intensive sectors.
Ik heb DNB, mede naar aanleiding van een motie van de leden Snels en Sneller 3 , gevraagd de uitzettingen van de Nederlandse financiële sector op CO 2 -intensieve sectoren te blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het te grabbel gooien van onze bankgegevens door Brussel

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether fintech firms can access bank data of people who never consented (silent party data), whether banks and the AP can go to court over misuse, and whether PSD2 favours big tech and risks reversing the burden of proof for consumers. The minister replied that silent party data may only be used to perform the payment service, that the AP can enforce directly and parties can appeal to courts, and that he will monitor competition effects and report in spring.
I will inform you in the spring about the progress on the implementation of this and other commitments I made in the plenary debate on PSD2.
Ik informeer u in het voorjaar over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de uitvoering van deze en andere toezeggingen die ik heb gedaan in het plenaire debat over PSD2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat de topman van ABN-Amro niet wil dat de overheid treuzelt met de verkoop

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether he agrees with ABN AMRO's CEO that a sale of the state's stake must not be delayed, and whether ABN AMRO's scenarios on non-sale should be published. The minister replied that there is no sales stop, that timing depends on market factors, and that he is unaware of any such scenarios.
Further statements on the rationale for the timing of transactions cannot be made, as they could be price-sensitive.
Verdere mededelingen over de rationale van de timing van transacties kunnen niet gedaan worden, aangezien die koersgevoelig zouden kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk, Van Rooijen en Geleijnse over berichten dat de Scandinavische schuldenindustrie zich met woekerrentes richt op de Nederlandse zzp'er

Three 50PLUS MPs asked the ministers whether Scandinavian lenders charging 18% to 200% interest to Dutch self-employed people (zzp'ers) are a problem requiring a rate cap, a duty of care, AFM supervision and standard creditworthiness checks. The Finance Minister answered that the government takes such signals seriously but that the scale of the problem is unclear, so it will first map the issue and rely on the industry's self-regulatory code for now, with no concrete measures yet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kosten van stimulering van elektrische auto’s en de totaal onderschatte vooruitgang in batterij technologie

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder ask whether EV tax subsidies (company car supplement, BPM, MRB, MIA) are cost-effective, how much they cost over five years, and how battery price assumptions in the CarbonTax model compare with forecasts. The government answers in detail, defending EV incentives as necessary for the transition, admitting past forecasting errors, and giving battery price figures while promising monitoring and an evaluation in 2023.
The cabinet is currently awaiting the costing of these proposals.
Het kabinet is op dit moment in afwachting van de doorrekening van deze voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘The illusion of UK bank capital strength’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about an article claiming UK banks, including RBS, have excess capital, and about low leverage ratios, and asks for Dutch bank capital figures, rules on capital distributions, and whether the minimum leverage ratio should be raised to 10%. The minister answers with the EBA-based figures and explains the strict conditions on dividends and buybacks, while stating that Dutch leverage requirements are set at EU level and that stricter EU measures are being pursued.
I think it is sensible for banks to hold high buffers.
Ik vind het verstandig dat banken hoge buffers aanhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asked the government, in 21 questions, whether it agrees with and will respond to numerous statements by Greta Thunberg at COP24 criticising climate policy, business-as-usual growth, and political inaction, and what concrete steps it will take. The ministers replied collectively and the answer is reproduced by reference to the Aanhangsel Handelingen rather than in full, so no substantive response is visible in the text.
The written questions from MP Van Raan (PvdD), question number 2018Z24291, have been answered by way of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raan (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24291 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het artikel 'Macron laat teugels Frankrijk vieren’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about France's new measures after the gilets jaunes protests, their cost, the effect on France's deficit and EU fiscal rules (SGP), and Italy's budget. The minister answers that the measures cost about 0.4% of GDP, that France's 2019 deficit would reach about 3.2%, and that the Commission will assess this in the spring forecast, while he has consistently pressed for strict SGP enforcement.

I have always advocated strict compliance with and enforcement of the Stability and Growth Pact, both in bilateral talks with my European colleagues and in plenary meetings of the Eurogroup and Ecofin Council.

Ik heb altijd gepleit voor een strikte naleving en handhaving van het Stabiliteits- en Groei Pact zowel tijdens bilaterale gesprekken met mijn Europese collega’s als tijdens de plenaire vergadering van de Eurogroep en de Ecofinraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de berichten 'Ingreep ECB bij probleembank Carige is een oplossing ‘all’italiana’' en 'Italian populists dodge first big banking test'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the ECB's early-intervention action at Banca Carige, and the possible Italian support route, complies with EU banking recovery and resolution rules, given concerns about bail-in and a possible deviation from BRRD. The minister answered that the ECB intervention is not a solution in itself, that the rules are being applied as agreed, that Carige does not currently meet the failing-or-likely-to-fail test, and that no concrete parliamentary action is planned beyond raising framework improvements in European meetings.
I have no reason to assume that the BRRD rules are being deviated from.
Ik heb geen reden om aan te nemen dat wordt afgeweken van de BRRD-regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘De Nederlandsche Bank laat bewust leemte in toezicht op witwaswet’

MPs Ronnes and Van Dam asked whether differences in unusual-transaction reporting between banks, and ING's sharp rise in 2017, prompted DNB to check other banks' monitoring systems. The minister answered that reports are not comparable across banks, that DNB conducts risk-based AML supervision and thematic investigations (2016 and 2018) that found weaknesses at several institutions, and that enforcement follows where violations occur.
DNB continuously conducts risk-based Wwft supervision of banks, including the effectiveness of transaction monitoring.
DNB houdt doorlopend risicogebaseerd Wwft-toezicht op banken, met inbegrip van de effectiviteit van de transactiemonitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ABN AMRO-medewerkers die de bonuswet omzeilen

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO employees were circumventing the bonus law through participations in its private-equity arm AAP, and asked for disclosure of profits, dividends, and individual stakes. The minister answered that individual data cannot be given for confidentiality reasons, that AAP profits are not yet determined, and that the arrangement is not a prohibited variable pay but DNB and AFM will act if circumvention is found.
Information on the investment and payout per person cannot be provided because of the personal confidential nature of this information.
Informatie over de inleg en uitkering per persoon kan niet gegeven worden in verband met het persoonsvertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de bankierseed

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the banker's oath, whether it is effective, what sanctions apply for not taking it, whether banks' conduct harms trust, and why supervision is left to banks. The minister replied that banks are responsible for administering the oath, that DNB and AFM supervise risk-based with fines or orders available, that the Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken has clarified referral procedures with KiFiD, and that no change to supervision is planned.
I see no reason to change this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding hierin verandering te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over het bericht “ING top niet getoetst op witwaszaak”

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING's top management was not re-vetted after the money-laundering settlement of EUR 775 million, and whether supervisors should conduct the assessment themselves. The minister answered that re-vetting is solely for the independent supervisor (the ECB for ING board members), that supervisory confidentiality prevents comment on whether re-vetting was considered, and that he has no power to direct the ECB.
It is solely for the independent supervisor to proceed to re-vetting when the facts and circumstances give cause for it.
Het is uitsluitend aan de onafhankelijke toezichthouder om tot hertoetsing over te gaan, wanneer de feiten en omstandigheden daartoe aanleiding geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de activiteiten van lobbyplatform Eurofi en de deelname van Nederlandse toezichthouders en overheid aan die activiteiten

MP Leijten asks the Finance Minister whether it is concerning that Eurofi, a platform with paying financial-sector members, lobbies, whether civil servants and officials attending its conferences is desirable, who decides on attendance, and why the ministry stopped Holland Financial Centre but continues attending Eurofi. The minister answers that Eurofi members are financial institutions, that the ministry bears its own travel costs, that attendance is weighed case by case and useful for diverse views, that no overview of attendance exists within the ministry, and that he sees no reason to refrain from attending or to urge others to do so.
There is no overview of this within the ministry.
Hier is geen overzicht van binnen het ministerie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de merkwaardige bewering van de Belastingdienst bij de Hoge Raad dat hoofdfondsen en onroerende zaken een stabiele beleggingsvorm vormen met weinig risico’s

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the tax authority told the Supreme Court that main-share funds and real estate are stable, low-risk investments, and whether that matches AFM supervision and government policy. The State Secretary answered that the remark was incidental, that the 4% return test does not depend on the risk level of assets, that the AFM does not treat such investments as risk-free, and that a real-return box 3 system is being examined alongside other tax reform work.
It is now up to the Advocate-General to give her opinion in a conclusion on the question put before the Supreme Court.
Het is nu aan de Advocaat-Generaal om in een conclusie haar mening te geven over de kwestie die aan de Hoge Raad is voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Alkaya over Astro TV

MPs Sneller and Alkaya asked whether the psychic programme 'Astro TV' and similar shows that promise financial good fortune to callers, aimed at vulnerable people, amount to misleading practice and whether the Authority for Consumers and Markets or other supervisors should act. The government answered that the programme cited is actually RTL's 'Dit is mijn toekomst', that responsibility for assessing misleading practices lies with the ACM and the courts, that the AFM and Commissariaat have no clear remit, and that RTL has agreed limits on advice and is reconsidering the programme.

Ultimately it is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the courts to determine whether the practices of Astro TV, 'Dit is mijn toekomst' and similar media are misleading in that context.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) en de rechter om te bepalen of de praktijken van Astro TV, «Dit is mijn toekomst» en soortgelijke media in dat kader misleidend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over voortdurende misstanden bij ABN Amro

Member Alkaya (SP) asked the Finance Minister about continuing misconduct allegations at ABN Amro, including whether the state would investigate integrity violations and whether the share sale should continue. The Minister answered that the matter is for the bank's management and supervisory board, that NLFI manages its stake adequately, and that the plan to fully privatise ABN Amro stands.
This is not a matter for the shareholder, but for the management board and the supervisory board.
Dit is geen zaak van de aandeelhouder, maar van de raad van bestuur en de raad van commissarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de koopkrachtplaatjes van middeninkomens niet kloppen

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the purchasing-power projections for middle incomes are accurate, given claims that middle-income households gain little from economic recovery, and asked about income trends, wage growth and government action. The government rejects the criticism, says the projections are the best available estimates, and attributes weak income growth mainly to taxes, premiums and slow wage growth linked to productivity, while promising further study of productivity without committing to a concrete new step.
I do not share the view of Mr Castelein.
Ik deel de mening van de heer Castelein niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het Frans-Duitse voorstel over de architectuur van een eurozonebegroting

An SP MP asks Finance Minister Hoekstra why the Netherlands opposes the Franco-German eurozone budget proposal, what his 'not immediately opposed' stance means, whether he will keep Dutch opposition in talks, and whether he agrees a eurozone budget is part of a transfer union. The minister answers that the cabinet opposes a stabilisation function and any new own resource, that the mandate covers only a convergence and competitiveness instrument within the EU27 budget under strict conditions, and that Dutch opposition to stabilisation was stated clearly in bilateral meetings.
For the Netherlands it was and is important that no mandate was given to develop an instrument for stabilisation.
Voor Nederland was en is van belang dat er geen mandaat werd gegeven om een instrument uit te werken voor stabilisatie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de investeringen van Nederlandse levensverzekeraars in wapenbedrijven die aan Saoedi-Arabië leveren

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Dutch life insurers investing in arms makers supplying Saudi Arabia, used in Yemen, conflicts with Dutch arms export policy and the insurers' covenant on responsible business, and whether the government will act to restrict such investments. The minister answered that insurers decide their own investments under OECD and UN guidelines, that no EU sanctions apply to Saudi Arabia, and that the government will continue talks with the insurers under the covenant, which sets a two-year deadline for controversial arms trade frameworks.
Insurers in principle decide for themselves in which companies to invest.
Verzekeraars bepalen in principe zelf in welke bedrijven belegd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Stresstest voor banken moet veel effectiever'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister whether EU bank stress tests are effective enough, following EBA chair Enria's criticism, and about Italian banks and possible gaming. The minister agreed there is room to improve methodology, defended the bottom-up EU approach and the disclosure of results, noted the EBA cannot impose capital requirements itself, and said that further changes are for supervisors and the Council, with the Netherlands pushing for balance-sheet reviews.
I cannot go into the results of individual banks in stress tests.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de resultaten van individuele banken in stresstesten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het witwassen van miljarden euro’s door criminelen in Nederland

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about estimates that some 16 billion euros is laundered yearly in the Netherlands, and whether banks can keep criminal money out, including the ING Curaçao transactions. The minister acknowledged the scale, pointed to DNB's supervision and deficiencies at banks, listed ongoing anti-money-laundering legislation and EU initiatives, and promised an integral policy response in Q1 2019.
It has already been promised to the House that an integral policy response will be sent in the first quarter of 2019.
Aan uw Kamer is reeds toegezegd dat een integrale beleidsreactie in het eerste kwartaal van 2019 zal worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het eenvoudig uitgeven van zwart geld in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the ease of spending black money in the Netherlands after an undercover broadcast showed many shopkeepers accepting suspicious cash, and asked about FIU outreach, sector supervision and the chance of SME audits. The government answered that kitchen and bathroom sellers only came under Wwft supervision recently, outlined risk-based supervision and an integral policy response due in early 2019, and declined to give a percentage chance that an SME is audited.
The Wwft Supervision Bureau will pay attention to this.
Het Bureau Toezicht Wwft zal hier aandacht voor houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de beleggingen van banken in regenwoud vernietigende palmoliebedrijven zonder dat hun klanten hiervan op de hoogte zijn

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch banks investing clients' money in funds linked to palm oil companies that destroy rainforest, without clients' knowledge, is acceptable, and what will be done about transparency and stricter rules. The minister answered that banks should map client sustainability preferences and communicate fund policies clearly, that the EU sustainable finance proposals are supported, that the banking sector covenant on palm oil is being pursued, and that a financial sector agenda will follow.
I am of the view that greater clarity is necessary in applying the concept of sustainability.
Ik ben van mening dat meer eenduidigheid noodzakelijk is bij de toepassing van het begrip duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het bericht ‘DNB maakt zich zorgen over afnemend gebruik contant geld’

Van Rooijen (50PLUS) asked the Finance Minister about DNB's concern over declining cash use, including whether vulnerable groups risk exclusion from payments and why a promised letter on cash use was delayed. Minister Hoekstra acknowledged the decline and the importance of cash for vulnerable groups, and said the promised letter is now complete and sent with the answers.
The research has now been completed and I am sending the letter to your House together with this answer.
Het onderzoek is inmiddels afgerond en ik bied de brief tegelijk met deze beantwoording aan uw Kamer aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over doorvoer van militaire goederen via Schiphol en andere Nederlandse havens

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Trade, Finance and Justice about fines on airlines at Schiphol for illegally transporting strategic goods, prosecution figures, Customs capacity and procedures, and an alleged shipment of Dagaie missile defence parts to Saudi Arabia. The government answered that courts have fined some transporters since 2013 but that OM does not register such cases by sector, that Customs stopped 19 military shipments to Saudi Arabia since 2014 (two illegal exports found), that the current enforcement approach has been policy since 2013, and that carriers are legally obliged to assist Customs.

It is not possible to provide an overview of convictions by sector (such as transport companies) or an overview of the number of investigations per year, because the illegal transit of military goods is not registered as such in the OM's systems.

Het is niet mogelijk een overzicht te geven van veroordelingen per branche (zoals die van vervoersbedrijven) dan wel een overzicht van het aantal onderzoeken per jaar, omdat het illegaal doorvoeren van militaire goederen niet als zodanig wordt geregistreerd in de systemen van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over fraude met de dividendbelasting

An MP asked the Finance Minister and State Secretary about alleged large-scale dividend tax fraud (cum-ex/dividend stripping) involving Dutch banks, the Tax Authority's role, and whether banks and the Public Prosecution Service would be held to account. The government replied that it lacks sufficient information on the scale and on the involvement of specific banks, that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating potential fraud, and that the Tax Authority bears the burden of proof and could recover unlawfully refunded tax, while declining to comment on individual cases.
The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements about individual investigations.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen uitspraken over individuele onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over ING, dat de balans met 180 miljard euro bijstelde, de accountant die niet weet wat onder die post valt, de bank die zo bankenbelasting bespaarde en vervroegd staatss

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about ING's 180 billion euro balance sheet restatement, the auditor's knowledge of its components, leverage ratio compliance, early repayment of state aid and resulting bonuses. The Minister answered that netting of cash pooling is permitted under international standards, that the components are not further known to him beyond public reporting, and that the matters are for the bank, auditor, AFM and DNB rather than the ministry.
It is up to the auditor to check the annual accounts against the standards.
Het is aan de accountant om de jaarrekening te controleren op basis van de standaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Nijboer over de grootste belastingfraude in de Europese geschiedenis

MPs Snels and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister and State Secretary about the CumEx dividend tax fraud, including prosecutions, bank involvement, the Belastingdienst's systems and whether Dutch dividend stripping continues. The government answered that it cannot judge the Dutch share or the scale abroad, referred to an ongoing OM investigation, said the Belastingdienst does not systematically track fines, and outlined limits on enforcement due to the heavy burden of proof, with a commitment to inventory dividend stripping practices.
As the cover letter shows, situations of dividend stripping also occur in the Netherlands.
Zoals blijkt uit de aanbiedingsbrief doen zich in Nederland ook situaties van dividendstripping voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de positie van een naast geassocieerde/zakelijk relatie van een PEP in samenhang met de wijziging van de UBO-regeling

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether under the Wwft co-owners and board members of an entity with a PEP are treated as close associates, and how far that extends to various board and ownership cases and to debtors or creditors of a PEP. The Minister confirmed that other UBOs of a PEP-linked entity are classed as known close associates, said the EU directive leaves no room to narrow this, and said the status of creditors or debtors depends on the circumstances, with institutions applying risk-based enhanced due diligence.
The directive leaves no room to narrow the scope on this point.
De richtlijn biedt geen ruimte om de reikwijdte op dit punt te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Rabobank en ABN AMRO missen derivatendeadline’

MPs Van der Linde and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about reports that Rabobank and ABN AMRO missed the deadline for compensating SME clients affected by the derivatives scandal, and why the backlog persists. The minister acknowledged the delay, said the AFM is monitoring process optimisations and that banks have been told of parliament's displeasure, and noted that roughly 10,980 SME clients still lacked a definitive offer.
For that reason, I will, together with the AFM, continue to closely monitor that banks do everything possible to provide this clarity as quickly as possible.
Om die reden zal ik, samen met de AFM, goed blijven monitoren dat banken al het mogelijke blijven doen om deze duidelijkheid zo snel mogelijk te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Geurts over het bericht ‘Geld kan soms toch groeien op lapjes landbouwgrond’

MPs Ronnes and Geurts asked the Finance Minister whether land speculation schemes escape AFM financial supervision because the land is formally leased out, and where misled investors can turn. The minister confirmed the practices, explained that formal contract arrangements do not settle whether a land investment is a financial product since the substance of management is assessed, pointed investors to the ACM and civil remedies, and said a bill strengthening investor protection is being prepared for 2019.
I am currently preparing a bill that will strengthen the protection of investors in investment objects.
Momenteel bereid ik een wetsvoorstel voor waarmee de bescherming van beleggers in beleggingsobjecten wordt versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over het bericht dat Nederlandse grootbanken miljarden uitleenden aan bedrijven die betrokken zijn bij ernstige mensenrechtenschendingen

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked the Finance and Foreign Trade ministers whether Dutch banks lend billions to firms implicated in serious human rights abuses, and what rules and enforcement apply. The government answered that banks must apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and UN principles, that complaints go to bank grievance mechanisms or the National Contact Point, and that enforcement under the IMVO banking covenant relies on joint monitoring and voluntary dialogue rather than sanctions.
Banks generally do not inform third parties about the amount and conditions under which they agree financing with individual clients.
Banken informeren doorgaans geen derde partijen over de omvang en voorwaarden waaronder zij financiering met individuele klanten overeenkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘De Nederlandsche Bank laat bewust leemte in toezicht op witwaswet’

CDA MPs Ronnes and Van Dam asked about the ING money-laundering settlement with the Public Prosecution Service, DNB's supervision of ING's remediation plan, IFI system use, unusual-transaction reporting figures by major bank, accountants' comments, and criminal liability of managers for omissions. The government answered that DNB monitors ING's remediation closely and will use supervisory tools if needed, withheld DNB information on ING's IFI use citing confidentiality, provided reporting statistics, and rejected the view that the criminal law is too focused on active conduct, declining a scientific study.
If it appears that ING has not implemented the imposed improvements in a timely and complete manner, DNB will use its supervisory instruments.
Indien blijkt dat ING niet tijdig en volledig de opgelegde verbeteringen heeft doorgevoerd, zal DNB haar toezichtinstrumentarium benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Sneller over het bericht dat de Nederlandse cultuur rond vrouwemancipatie en deeltijdwerken achterhaald is

MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Education and Finance about a report that Dutch culture on women's emancipation and part-time work is outdated, covering women's access to extra hours, sector shortages, McKinsey's estimate of GDP gains, parental role models, pay gaps and childcare flexibility. The minister answered that the government is studying part-time work through an interdepartmental policy review, cites measures such as tax changes and parental leave, and says concrete outcomes depend on individual employers and employees.
The cabinet has commissioned an interdepartmental policy review on part-time work (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Het kabinet heeft opdracht gegeven tot een interdepartementaal beleidsonderzoek deeltijdwerk (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over witwaspraktijken van Europese banken

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about money-laundering through Danske Bank and European banks, the supervision of anti-money-laundering rules in Denmark and the Netherlands, and whether the ING settlement and fine would be enough. The minister answered that the facts of the Danske case are not yet known, that DNB and AFM supervise under the Wwft, that ING's profits were disgorged, and that DNB and AFM's independence limits his involvement in individual cases.
As Minister of Finance I do not intervene in individual cases, but I do have regular contact with DNB to assess whether the supervisory system as a whole functions properly.
Als Minister van Financiën treed ik niet in individuele zaken 9 maar heb ik wel regulier contact met DNB om te bezien of het toezichtsysteem als geheel (d.w.z.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer en Snels over de ING als huisbankier van de staat

MPs Bruins, Nijboer and Snels asked the Finance Minister whether ING, the state's house bank, remained eligible in tender procedures after a recent OM transaction under article 74 of the Criminal Code, and whether this should affect future tenders. The minister answered that the transaction is not a final conviction, so no mandatory exclusion ground applies, ING may still bid, and stricter anti-money-laundering criteria will be considered in upcoming tenders, including the credit card contract and a planned reassessment before any 2020 extension.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de Nederlandse verantwoordelijkheid voor offshore in het Koninkrijk

MP Van Raak asked the Finance Minister about Dutch responsibility for offshore financial services in the Kingdom, including the Nieuw Fiscaal Raamwerk, possible links to online gambling operations and Malta, and whether agreements were kept secret. The minister answered that tax and financial regulation is the autonomous responsibility of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, that Dutch tax confidentiality and lack of administration prevent disclosure of many details, and that the Netherlands supports the countries via law-enforcement cooperation.
No Dutch government body keeps records of which companies in the Netherlands, whether or not providing financial services, also hold e-gaming licences in those countries.

Er wordt niet door een Nederlandse overheidsinstantie geadministreerd welke bedrijven in Nederland, die al dan niet financiële dienstverlening verrichten, tevens e-gaminglicenties bezitten in de genoemde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over financiële problemen NS op het Britse spoor

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes (CDA) asked about NS's financial problems on its British rail activities, including a £80 million PCS guarantee draw for East Anglia, the CLE risk-sharing mechanism, and whether Dutch fares could rise. Minister Hoekstra answered that Abellio UK has been profitable overall, that the PCS guarantees are capped by a €500 million ministerial ceiling and that the CLE index is no longer applied to new concessions, while declining to comment on ongoing negotiations with DfT.
We do not wish to anticipate the outcomes of those discussions and their consequences for the remainder of the concession term.
Wij willen niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van die gesprekken en de gevolgen daarvan voor de rest van de looptijd van de concessie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over bedrijfsovernames en de stakingsgolf bij AkzoNobel

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked about strikes at AkzoNobel over wages and pensions while shareholders receive large payouts, the treatment of employees in the sale of the chemicals division (now Nouryon), tax on capital repayments, and private equity sales of Dutch firms. Minister Wiebes answered that wages and pensions are for social partners, that the Rijnlands governance model and works council rights apply, that the Corporate Governance Code does not bind Nouryon or foreign investors, and that a legislative cooling-off period for listed boards is being prepared.
The cabinet attaches great value to this Rhineland model.
Het kabinet hecht grote waarde aan dit Rijnlandse model.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het verhuren van dakruimte voor zonnepanelen

MPs asked whether mortgage lenders' ban on subletting blocks business owners from leasing roof space for solar panels, and whether government will intervene. The minister says lenders may set conditions, that the banking association has drafted a model deed to ease such leases, that existing subsidies suffice and that the matter is a private contractual relationship where government will not intervene.
There is no reason for the government to intervene in this contractual relationship.
Er is geen aanleiding voor de overheid om in te grijpen in deze contractuele relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘bij crisis helpt Italië banken’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about Italian Finance Minister Tria's remark that government intervention in troubled banks is not strange, and whether this undermines the banking union rules and future risk-sharing. The minister replied that no Italian state aid to banks is currently at issue, that EU rules remain in force, that the Commission assesses state aid, and that Dutch negotiating positions are unchanged, but declined to answer the last question by the deadline.
It is for the European Commission to assess whether any measures for the banking sector involve state aid and, if so, whether it is permissible aid.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie om te beoordelen of er bij eventuele maatregelen voor de bankensector sprake is van staatssteun en zo ja of het geoorloofde steun is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over energiecoöperaties

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked how the Wft applies to small energy cooperatives, including thresholds for membership, capital and transferability, and whether a licensing requirement exists. The government answered that cooperatives mostly qualify as businesses rather than investing, that prospectus rules apply only above a €5 million threshold with exemptions below it, and that it does not intend to burden small initiatives with unreasonable bureaucracy.
Small-scale citizen initiatives to generate sustainable energy are welcomed.
Kleinschalige initiatieven van bewoners om duurzame energie op te wekken worden toegejuicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Italy’s government agrees sharply higher public spending plan'

MP Aukje de Vries asks the Finance Minister about Italy's 2019 draft budget with sharply higher spending and a 2.4% deficit, questioning its credibility, the SGP compliance, and the eurozone implications. The minister answers that the draft raises spending and worsens the deficit, that the Commission has sent it back for revision, and that Netherlands has raised concerns in the Eurogroup while stressing the need to respect the SGP rules.
I therefore find it worrying that the Italian draft budget does not comply with the budgetary obligations.
Ik vind het dan ook zorgelijk dat de Italiaanse ontwerpbegroting niet aan de budgettaire verplichtingen voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Begrotingscomité laakt te grote Europese toegeeflijkheid tegenover Italië'

MP Aukje de Vries asks Finance Minister Hoekstra how to respond to the European Fiscal Board's criticism that the European Commission was too lenient toward SGP violators such as Italy, and how the SGP can be simplified and made enforceable. The minister agrees the Commission was too lenient, supports strengthening the EFB and reducing SGP flexibility, notes that the reform outlook is uncertain, and stresses that enforcement depends on political will.
I have already pressed for the EFB to have its own financial resources, and I will continue to do so.
Ik heb eerder al aangedrongen op eigen financiële middelen voor de EFB, en zal dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Italië en de Euro

An MP asked the government about Italy's rising bond yields, its stress scenario in the MEV 2019, a pension plan, and banking union risk reduction. The government answered that the scenario is not overly optimistic, reported its talks with Italy's prime minister on the budget, and said it would send a new letter on banking risk before April 2019.
The intention is to send your House a new letter on risk reduction in the European banking sector before April 2019.
Het voornemen is om uw Kamer vóór april 2019 een nieuwe brief te sturen inzake risicoreductie in de Europese bankensector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over omkoping door Nederlandse bedrijven in het buitenland

An MP asked the government about bribery by Dutch companies abroad, the weak enforcement criticized by Transparency International, and the lack of independent judicial review and transparency of OM settlements (transacties). The Minister says enforcement has increased with new FIOD and OM capacity, and that the high-transaction practice and Aanwijzing will be reviewed and made more transparent within the Wet OM-afdoening evaluation.
At present the current practice is being reviewed.
Op dit moment wordt de huidige praktijk tegen het licht gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over flitskredieten die worden aangeboden tegen woekerrentes

MPs Azarkan and Öztürk asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about flash loans offered to businesses at usurious rates, their exclusion from consumer credit rules, and whether research into their effects would be done. The minister answered that no serious abuses are known, that the sector is developing self-regulation, and that a general market study is planned, but declined specific research and extension of consumer credit protection to small businesses.
At present I have no signals of serious abuses or major problems in this sector due to high interest rates or other costs.
Op dit moment heb ik geen signalen over ernstige misstanden of grote problemen in deze branche vanwege hoge rentes of andere kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over ING dat haar balans over 2014 en 2015 aanpaste met meer dan 180 miljard euro

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister why ING restated its 2014 and 2015 customer loans by over 180 billion euros, and whether supervision, accounting standards and the ECB were involved. The minister answered that the change reflects a shift from net to gross presentation of cash pooling in ING's accounts, that the accounting rules allow netting, and that the prudential supervisor, not the ministry, oversees such matters and does not comment on individual banks.
The ministry is not responsible for the content of the annual publication of individual banks' financial statements.
Het ministerie is niet verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud van de jaarlijkse publicatie van de jaarrekening van individuele banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over de opmerkingen van president van De Nederlandsche Bank

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Finance whether banks' return-on-equity demands are too high and too risky, following remarks by the DNB president, and what the government is doing about it. The minister answered that bank profitability has recovered with the economy, that risk-weighted capital rules and buffers already penalise risky activity, that supervision of individual banks rests with DNB, and that Dutch returns (9.1%) exceed the EU average (5.8%).
It is up to DNB, as an independent supervisor, to supervise the risks of individual banks.
Het is aan DNB, als onafhankelijke toezichthouder, om toezicht te houden op de risico's van individuele banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Ernstige zorgen over Brussels gemorrel aan boekhoudregels'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that the European Commission wants to change international accounting rules (IFRS). The minister answered that the Commission is running a broad public consultation on corporate reporting, that Dutch government supports consistent IFRS application for international comparability, and that no formal proposal exists yet.
I cannot answer questions about French positions, since I cannot disclose positions that other member states take in EU meetings.
Vragen over Franse standpunten kan ik niet beantwoorden, aangezien ik standpunten die andere lidstaten in EU-vergaderingen innemen, niet naar buiten kan brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat een investeerder zeker tien keer witwaspraktijken had aangekaart bij ING, waar vervolgens niets mee werd gedaan

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether ING ignored a financier's repeated reports of money laundering, whether the gatekeeper system worked given that both the bank and a trust office failed, and what would be done to protect whistleblowers and review bank compliance. The minister answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined Wwft duties and DNB supervision, pointed to tightened rules and the pending trust office bill, noted whistleblower protection under the fourth anti-money-laundering directive, and said investigating individual banks' procedures is for the supervisor DNB.
Supervision of banks' compliance with these statutory obligations is carried out by De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Het toezicht op de uitvoering van deze wettelijke verplichtingen door banken wordt uitgevoerd door De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Ronnes over het bericht dat financiële bijsluiters niet geschikt zijn voor consumenten

MPs Sneller and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about a University of Groningen study finding financial information documents (bijsluiters) hard for consumers to understand, and about whether the EU KID and WRR-recommended measures strengthen consumers' position against financial institutions. The minister acknowledged comprehension problems, described KID improvements, pointed to the provision ban, duty of care and product oversight, and said the EU evaluation has not yet started, promising to push for a swift evaluation.
I will work to push for a swift evaluation at European level and stress that the evaluation should consider the user-friendliness and effectiveness of the KID for consumer choices.

Ik zal mij inzetten om in Europees verband een snelle evaluatie te bepleiten en benadrukken dat in de evaluatie oog is voor de gebruiksvriendelijkheid en de effectiviteit van het KID voor consumentenkeuzes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer en Snels over de ING als huisbankier van de staat

MPs Bruins, Nijboer and Snels asked the Finance Minister how ING's admission of structural anti-money-laundering violations fits with its role as the state's house bank, whether it meets the sustainability criteria, whether contracts can be terminated, and whether evaluation moments exist. The minister replied that the tenders were carefully drafted, ING still meets the criteria, the contract allows termination for specified breaches, and periodic review occurs, while stating a transaction under the Criminal Code offers no basis for terminating the contract.
The requirements and wishes in the tender were at the time carefully and adequately formulated.
De eisen en wensen in de aanbesteding zijn destijds zorgvuldig en adequaat geformuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts en Slootweg over de voorbereiding van Nederland op een keiharde Brexit

MPs Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts and Slootweg asked the government how prepared the Netherlands is for a no-deal Brexit, including whether the added customs, NVWA and justice capacity will be operational by 29 March 2019 and what risks remain. The government answered that NVWA and customs will only partly be staffed by that date, with temporary service reductions expected, and that departments are taking mitigating measures with the Foreign Affairs minister coordinating.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het bericht dat de Italiaanse bank UniCredito mogelijk ABN AMRO wil overnemen

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch state might sell its ABN AMRO shares, including via NLFI, given reports that UniCredit was interested in acquiring the bank, and how cross-border bank mergers and too-big-to-fail risks would be handled. The minister said he could not say in advance under what circumstances shares would be sold, that any transaction would be assessed when it arose, that he was unaware of other parties' interest, and pointed to existing EU measures on bank supervision, resolution and capital.
I cannot state in advance in which situation I would sell ABN AMRO shares via NLFI, because this could be disadvantageous to the state's position when selling a stake in ABN AMRO.
Ik kan op voorhand niet aangeven in welke situatie ik via NLFI aandelen in ABN AMRO verkoop, omdat dit nadelig kan zijn voor de positie van de staat bij de verkoop van een belang in ABN AMRO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Amhaouch over de halfjaarcijfers van NS

MPs Ronnes and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about NS half-year results, including the 1% net return, the normrendement band and its history, the gap with the 7% target, and a 400 million euro working-capital swing linked to student transport payments. The government answered that the normrendement is 4%-6% since 2017, that the working-capital swing is mainly timing of the OV-studentenkaart payment, and that the state keeps a watchful eye on NS's return on equity.
The timing of payment by the state is therefore partly determinative of NS's working capital.
Het moment van uitbetaling door het Rijk is dus medebepalend voor de hoogte van het werkkapitaal van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Ongeplande uitval kerncentrale Borssele kost zeker tien miljoen’

An MP asked about the unplanned outage of the Borssele nuclear plant, the decommissioning fund, cost estimates, ageing risks and the finances of the shareholders. The government answered that the decommissioning fund is on schedule (EUR 201.4 million by end 2017), that the plant's reliability is not expected to decline, and that closing early would cost more than the planned 2033 closure.
I do not have the requested information for each central plant in Europe.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie per centrale in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het bericht dat ex-studenten geen hypotheek krijgen bij een studieschuld

MPs Ronnes and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers whether banks wrongly count the original rather than remaining student debt when assessing mortgage applications, and whether DUO should improve information to students. The government answered that annuity repayment makes the monthly burden constant so the original debt is weighted via fixed factors, that the explain exception exists, that information will be improved, and that excluding student debt would raise over-indebtedness risk.

At the next Platform Hypotheken in 2019, where the sector and the supervisor discuss possible bottlenecks in mortgage lending, it will be inventoried how providers use this explain possibility and whether bottlenecks are encountered.

Tijdens het volgende Platform Hypotheken in 2019, waar met de sector en de toezichthouder wordt gesproken over mogelijke knelpunten in de hypotheekverstrekking, zal worden geïnventariseerd op welke wijze aanbieders gebruik maken van deze explain-mogelijkheid en of hier knelpunten worden ondervonden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Meenen over het studievoorschot en het effect op de maximale hypotheek

Two D66 MPs asked whether mortgage lenders correctly account for student debt, how the Rijk, AFM and lenders agreed on this, and whether lenders could offer more tailored mortgages to starters. The minister replied that student loan repayments are annuity-based so current balance is not relevant, lenders weight student debt at 0.75% (pre-studievoorschot) or 0.45% (post) of principal, explain options exist, and the issue will be reviewed at the 2019 Platform Hypotheken.

At the next Platform Hypotheken in 2019, where the sector and the supervisor discuss possible bottlenecks in mortgage provision, it will be inventoried how providers use this explain option and whether bottlenecks are encountered.

Tijdens het volgende Platform Hypotheken in 2019, waar met de sector en de toezichthouder wordt gesproken over mogelijke knelpunten in de hypotheekverstrekking, zal worden geïnventariseerd op welke wijze aanbieders gebruik maken van deze explainmogelijkheid en of hier knelpunten worden ondervonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Griekenland wil af van pensioenafspraken met Europa’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about Greece's reported wish to revise pension cuts agreed with Europe, including what the measures are, Greece's fiscal room, the post-programme surveillance procedure and the timing of the next review. The minister confirmed the 2019 pension recalibration and inflation-indexation suspension, said Greece has made no formal request to revise commitments, and described enhanced surveillance with quarterly reporting by the Commission.
At this moment Greece has not made any formal proposal to amend any agreement as agreed for the post-programme period.
Op dit moment heeft Griekenland geen formeel voorstel gedaan tot aanpassing van enige afspraak zoals overeengekomen voor de post-programma periode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘banken ontdekken driehonderd mogelijke terrorismebetalingen’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a reported bank-government pilot on terrorism financing data sharing, including its results, legal limits (Wpg article 20) and whether the law is too rigid. The minister answered that about 300 unusual transactions were reported in one year, over 60% passed to investigators, the pilot was extended to July 2019, and multilateral private data sharing is still being explored.
Your House is regularly informed about progress on initiatives to combat money laundering and terrorism financing.
Uw Kamer wordt regelmatig geïnformeerd over de voortgang van initiatieven op het gebied van het tegengaan van witwassen en terrorismefinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over de voortgangsrapportage rentederivaten, waaruit blijkt dat twee banken alle deadlines missen

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes (CDA) asked the Finance Minister why ABN AMRO and Rabobank are missing the deadline for the interest rate derivatives redress framework for SMEs, and about related issues such as advance payments, limitation periods, the mandate of the complaints committee, the withdrawn AFM fine on ABN AMRO and whether banks should pay higher interest. The Minister answered that the framework's timelines are being monitored with the AFM, that banks are contacted and committed to finishing by end 2018, and that he sees no grounds for further mandates, investigations or a higher interest rate.
I currently see insufficient reason to conduct further research into this.
Ik zie op dit moment onvoldoende aanleiding om hier verder onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de besluitvorming rondom het beloningsbeleid bij bedrijven met een Stichting Administratiekantoor

An MP asked whether the Stichting Administratiekantoor (STAK) vote was decisive in approving higher executive pay at Van Lanschot Kempen, and whether its use of voting rights for pay matters is consistent with the Corporate Governance Code and the law. The minister answered that the STAK's votes could not be shown to be decisive, that the STAK's governance meets the Code, that the law gives voting rights to the shareholder, and that the government is consulting on tighter pay rules.
It is not known how the certificate holders who did not use their power to vote by proxy would have voted had they invoked that power.
Het is niet bekend hoe de certificaathouders die geen gebruik hebben gemaakt van hun bevoegdheid om door middel van een volmacht hun stem uit te brengen zouden hebben gestemd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de stijging van de huizenprijzen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Finance Minister whether faster-than-expected house price rises exceed forecasts and what the consequences are for the Treasury, the EWF forfait, municipal property tax and housing supply. The minister confirmed the WOZ-value rise is now projected at about 8.5% versus 7% previously, said the EWF revenue estimate stays roughly unchanged because the rate falls as WOZ values rise, and noted municipalities set property tax rates autonomously.
There is indeed a difference between the expected rise in the WOZ value for 2018 estimated at the end of 2017 and what is currently expected.
Er is inderdaad sprake van een verschil tussen de verwachte stijging van de WOZ-waarde in 2018 die eind 2017 geraamd werd en momenteel verwacht wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het afschaffen van de dividendbelasting veel meer kost dan de 1,4 miljard euro die in het regeerakkoord voorzien was

Van Raan (PvdD) asked the Finance Minister whether the cost overrun of abolishing the dividend tax, reported as far above the 1.4 billion euro in the coalition agreement, counts as an unplanned tax cut that must be compensated, and whether the compensation falls on businesses and passes through to households and foreign shareholders. The Staatssecretaris answered that the higher revenue estimate is a tax cut to be fully offset by a higher burden on business (mainly by limiting the top corporate tax rate reduction), with uncertain pass-through, and declined to comment on media coverage.
That is correct: the tax cut from the higher estimated dividend tax revenue is fully offset by a compensating increase in the burden on businesses.
Dat is juist, de lastenverlichting door de hoger geraamde opbrengst van de dividendbelasting is volledig gedekt door compenserende lastenverzwaring bij het bedrijfsleven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het bericht dat de Oostenrijkse bankentoezichthouder zijn toezicht op Turkse banken verscherpt en over het toezicht op Turkse banken in Nederland, waarvan tegoeden o

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch supervisors are monitoring Turkish-owned banks in the Netherlands, how much of their deposits are covered by the Dutch deposit guarantee scheme, and whether limits apply to their deposit-taking and lending. The minister answered that the five Dutch-licensed banks with Turkish ownership are fully subject to Dutch supervision and EU rules, that DNB does not publish bank-specific splits, and that a cap on foreign exposures relative to guaranteed deposits applies, while no absolute deposit cap exists.
DNB publishes financial data of individual banks on its website.
DNB publiceert financiële gegevens van individuele banken op haar website.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de uitspraken van Duitse Minister Altmaier inzake de Energiewende

An MP asked the ministers about German Minister Altmaier's claims that renewable energy is costly, that the EU target is unreachable and that subsidies could end within five years, plus a critical report on wind-energy cost sharing. The minister rejected the cost claims as based on outdated feed-in tariffs and flawed assumptions, agreed subsidies may phase out in four to five years at the optimistic end, and defended the gas and nuclear positions.
With the intentions in its own coalition agreement, Germany is one of the most ambitious EU member states regarding the share of renewable energy in the total energy mix.
Met de voornemens in haar eigen regeerakkoord is Duitsland één van de meest ambitieuze EU-lidstaten als het gaat om het aandeel hernieuwbare energie als onderdeel van de totale energiemix.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Linde over het bericht ‘ING sluit een megaschikking met OM in witwaszaken’

Parliamentarian Van der Linde asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the ING settlement with the Public Prosecution Service over money laundering, including how it occurred, whether other banks are being engaged, why individuals were not prosecuted, and when the WODC report will be sent. The ministers answered that the case is exemplary for ING's shortcomings, that they will discuss integrity with the sector and will issue a policy response by year-end, and that individual prosecution was not possible under Dutch case law.
The Public Prosecution Service therefore attributes the criminal offences to the organisation as a whole.
Het OM rekent de strafbare feiten dan ook toe aan de organisatie als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over het bericht 'ING treft miljoenenschikking met OM in witwaszaken' (Herdruk)

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about ING's record 775 million euro settlement with the Public Prosecution Service over money laundering, including how the amount was set, why prosecution was avoided, and whether individuals and the bank's leadership face consequences. The ministers answered that the settlement combined a 665 million fine with 100 million in disgorgement, that the OM chose a transaction for its enforceable compliance measures under DNB supervision, and that individual criminal liability could not be established, while the bank's supervisory board has announced personnel consequences at board level.
The OM therefore attributes the criminal offences to the organisation as a whole.
Het OM rekent de strafbare feiten dan ook toe aan de organisatie als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de sterke rechtspositie van banken in het geval van insolventie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Ministers of Justice and Finance about banks' strong legal position as secured creditors in insolvency, the disadvantage to other creditors, and whether the balance is still desirable. The Minister answered that the government will discuss the balance with insolvency practitioners within the ongoing faillissementsrecht reform, while defending the current pledge rules and noting that other creditors have their own protections.

Whether the above is still sufficient to keep the positions of the various parties in a bankruptcy in balance, I will discuss with practitioners within the reorganisation pillar of the bankruptcy law revision programme.

Of het voorgaande nog steeds voldoende is om de positie van de verschillende betrokkenen in een faillissement in evenwicht te houden, zal ik in het kader van het laatste wetsvoorstel in de reorganisatiepijler van het wetgevingsprogramma herijking faillissementsrecht bespreken met vertegenwoordigers uit de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Verzekeraars gooien deur dicht voor taxichauffeurs’

MP Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about reports that insurers are refusing or pricing out taxi drivers and other high-risk businesses, and about Van Lanschot dropping certain clients. The minister acknowledges similar problems for recycling and agricultural firms, argues the taxi market is not as bleak as described, points to the Vereende pool and existing market mechanisms, and says competition authority ACM is watching.
I do not recognise the picture that since 1 January 2018 only a single insurer still provides insurance to taxis.
Het beeld dat vanaf 1 januari 2018 slechts een enkele verzekeraar nog verzekeringen verstrekt aan taxi’s herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van den Berg en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Centrale Bank van Curaçao plaatst Ennia onder curatele’

MPs Van den Berg and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister whether DNB had earlier warnings about Ennia, what steps it took, whether policyholders were informed, and about Ennia's market share and hurricane claims. The minister declined to give details on DNB's warnings and actions citing its statutory confidentiality duty, said Curaçao's central bank (CBCS) is responsible for prudential supervision of Ennia, and refused to comment on consequences for policyholders in another country.

Partly because of this statutory confidentiality duty, and because as Minister I in principle do not receive information on individual institutions supervised by DNB, it is not possible to answer the questions about the content of warnings and any steps taken.

Vanwege onder meer deze geheimhoudingsplicht -en vanwege mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid als Minister – waarbij geldt dat ik in principe geen informatie over individuele onder toezicht staande instellingen van DNB ontvang – is het niet mogelijk om de vragen over de inhoud van waarschuwingen en eventueel genomen stappen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de risico’s van de sterk dalende koers van de Turkse lira

An MP asked the Finance Minister about direct and indirect credit risks for Dutch systemic banks from a collapse of Turkey's financial system, ING's and Rabobank's Turkish exposures, and lessons from Greece 2008. The minister replied that Dutch banks carry credit risk on Turkish exposures covered by capital requirements, that ING's Turkish subsidiary's exposure is about 1.8 billion euro and Rabobank's about 1.3 billion, and that EU risk-reduction measures and supervision by the ECB, DNB and SRB apply.
It is up to the supervisor to ensure that these rules are complied with.
Het is aan de toezichthouder om ervoor te zorgen dat deze regels worden nageleefd.
