Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de koersval van de Turkse lira

SP MP Leijten asked the Finance Minister about the consequences of the Turkish lira's collapse for Dutch and European banks, contagion risk, ING's exposure, causes of the sell-off, the risk of a Turkish bank run, and a possible EU bail-out. Minister Hoekstra answered that exposure is mainly indirect and manageable under prudential rules, attributed the crisis to Turkey's domestic macroeconomic policy, and ruled out an EU bail-out.
It is not for me to speculate on the amount of any possible losses.
Het is niet aan mij om te speculeren over de hoogte van eventuele verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de invloed van accountantskantoren Deloitte, KPMG, EY en PwC op Europees niveau op belastingbeleid en belastingontwijking

Leijten (SP) asked the Finance Minister about the influence of the Big Four accountancy firms on EU tax policy, revolving-door movement between their advisory practice and the European Commission, and EU contracts awarded to them. State Secretary Snel answered that career moves are possible but do not by themselves show lack of integrity, that EU tenders follow transparent rules allowing exclusion of conflicted bidders, and that the government sees no reason to act in Brussels.
I rely on the expertise, independence and integrity of the Commission and on the procedures that counter conflicts of interest and promote transparency.
Ik vertrouw op de deskundigheid, onafhankelijkheid en integriteit van de Commissie en de procedures die belangenverstrengeling tegengaan en transparantie bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de aanstelling van Wouter Bos als bestuursvoorzitter van Invest-NL

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the appointment of Wouter Bos as CEO of Invest-NL, including whether his appointment was irreversible, how it fits the draft articles, how the selection was run, and whether his salary as an official exceeds the Prime Minister's. The government answered that the appointment is a temporary official post pending incorporation, that the state appoints the first board members, that a search agency selected from nine candidates by published criteria, and that his salary matches the future CEO pay scale.
The State is the entity that incorporates the company and thereby appoints the first board members and supervisory directors.
Het is de Staat die de vennootschap opricht en daarmee de eerste bestuurders en commissarissen benoemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Recordbedrag aan verdachte transacties gemeld bij FIU’ en het onderliggende jaaroverzicht van de FIU

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about the record value of suspicious transactions reported to the FIU, the FIU's share of undetected transactions, reporting compliance by sector, FIU capacity, and crypto-currency laundering patterns. The minister explained the 2017 rise by more reports and high-value transactions, stated the FIU does not itself detect transactions, pointed to supervisors for compliance, announced capacity expansion, and referred to the upcoming policy response.
Yes, I have hereby done so.
Ja, dat heb ik bij deze gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inzet van privéjets voor buitenlandse bezoeken

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister why a chartered private jet was needed for his February 2018 Brussels-Berlin trip, whether that and a Paris trip were efficient use of public money, and which rules govern private jet use. The minister answered that scheduled flights and government aircraft were unavailable or too inflexible, that chartering was the most efficient option, that internal criteria and priority rules apply, and listed prior charter use.
For this specific trip on 13 and 14 March, the government aircraft was not available.
Voor deze specifieke reis op 13 en 14 maart jl. was het regeringsvliegtuig niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat hypotheekverstrekkers nog altijd te hoge boeterente berekenen

Member Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister why mortgage lenders still overcharge early-repayment penalties, after the AFM found errors at nine of fifteen lenders, and what consumers can do and how compliance can be enforced. The minister acknowledged the errors and disappointing compliance, said banks promised to compensate affected customers, and noted that the AFM is monitoring and considering enforcement measures, leaving the timing of fines to the AFM.
It is up to the AFM as an independent supervisor to decide whether and when these follow-up steps are taken.
Het is aan de AFM als onafhankelijk toezichthouder om te bepalen of en wanneer deze vervolgstappen worden gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Becker over het bericht 'Chinese betaaldienst Alipay komt twintig Europese landen veroveren'

MPs Van der Linde and Becker asked about the expansion of Chinese payment service Alipay into Europe, its effects on the market, whether EU and Dutch rules (PSD2, GDPR) safeguard against unfair competition and privacy risks, and any link to China's social credit system. The minister answered that Alipay operates in NL under a UK licence via EU passporting, that PSD2 and GDPR apply equally to non-EU firms, and that Alipay denies involvement in the social credit system.
Whether Alipay intends to also offer the new payment services in the Netherlands is not known.
Of Alipay voornemens is om in Nederland ook de nieuwe betaaldiensten aan te bieden is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over internationale energiebedrijven die Nederland gebruiken om miljoen te eisen

Dutch MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether international energy investors use the Energy Charter Treaty to claim compensation from states over energy policy, and whether Dutch shell companies are used for such claims. The government answered that investors can bring arbitration under the treaty for unlawful state conduct, that Nederland has never been sued, and that it will work to amend the treaty to stop shell-company claims.
The cabinet is therefore committed to amending the Energy Charter Treaty on this point.
Het kabinet zet zich dan ook in om het Energiehandvestverdrag op dit punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over de lobby voor een hogere beloning voor bestuurder(s) van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM)

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked whether the AFM supervisory board chair lobbied for a higher pay for the AFM chair and a future board member, when pay was discussed, whether correspondence exists, and whether the pay issue affected the late reappointment of the chair. The Minister says pay was discussed in normal reappointment contact, the WNT exception for the chair was corrected to allow indexation, the correspondence is personnel-confidential and will not be shared, and the board's recruitment process was thorough.
Given the considerations above, I cannot provide these documents to your House.
Gegeven de bovenstaande overwegingen kan ik deze stukken niet aan uw Kamer verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Paternotte over het bericht in het FD ‘Fintechs nog langer buitenspel door discussie tussen toezichthouders’

MPs Van der Linde and Paternotte asked the Finance Minister whether the delayed PSD2 implementation, linked to a dispute between the Dutch data protection authority and DNB over supervision, harms Dutch fintechs and what the ministry is doing to resolve it. The minister admitted the deadline was missed, explained a amendment making the AP the supervisor for the privacy consent requirement, and said there are no concrete signals of fintechs relocating abroad.
In addition, to better safeguard privacy protection, I have prepared an amendment to the bill implementing PSD2.
Daarnaast heb ik, om de bescherming van de privacy beter te borgen, een aanpassing van het wetsvoorstel ter implementatie van PSD2 voorbereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het opkopen van staatsobligaties door de ECB

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how many government bonds the ECB has bought under the PSPP per member state, whether ECB bond buying affects creditworthiness, and whether the ECB deliberately reduced Italian bond purchases during Italian coalition talks, and whether bond buying amounts to political conduct or Europeanises risk. The minister answered that purchases are driven by monetary policy and liquidity rather than political cycles, that the ECB is independent with no evidence of political conduct, and that risk-sharing under the PSPP is limited, while rejecting the claim of a transfer union via TARGET2.
I have no indications that the ECB engages in politics through its purchasing policy.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de ECB via het aankoopbeleid politiek bedrijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen dat de Staat heeft gesloten met Shell en ExxonMobil

An MP asks why the Groningen gas settlement with Shell and ExxonMobil was not submitted to parliament in advance, why NAM's liability and the confidentiality of the deal were handled as they were, and how costs, dividends and the Groningen compensation fund are divided. Minister Wiebes answers that the agreement was lawful without prior parliamentary approval, that NAM remains liable through the Staat-run fund, and gives partial figures while deferring the year-by-year breakdown to later.
Now that the negotiations are concluded, you can debate the agreement with me and use parliament's budgetary powers to check its financial consequences.
Nu de onderhandelingen zijn afgerond kunt met mij in debat gaan over het akkoord en aan de hand van het parlementaire budgetrecht de financiële gevolgen hiervan controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de dekking van de verminderde gasopbrengsten

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the cabinet had already found cover for a 1.1 billion euro shortfall in gas revenue and why this was not disclosed in the Spring Memorandum. The minister confirmed the interview quote, said the cover for later years will be shared on Prinsjesdag under the regular budget process, and declined to give details now.
As is customary, the multi-year budgetary cover for the gas decision will be communicated on Prinsjesdag through the Miljoenennota and the associated departmental draft budgets.
Zoals gebruikelijk wordt de meerjarige budgettaire dekking van het gasbesluit op Prinsjesdag via de Miljoenennota en de bijbehorende departementale ontwerpbegrotingen gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Ouwehand over het bericht dat het ABP 174 miljoen euro in de palmolie-industrie investeert

MPs Van Raan and Ouwehand asked whether the government finds the ABP's EUR 174 million investment in palm oil plantations in Papua, linked to rainforest clearance and human rights abuses, acceptable and whether it will press the fund to divest. The minister says the content is worrying, points to existing programmes on deforestation and land rights, and states that ABP decides its own investment policy while the government will pursue responsible-business covenants with the financial sector.
The pension fund ABP decides on its own investment policy and applies a specific responsible-investment policy.
Het pensioenfonds ABP gaat over het eigen beleggingsbeleid en hanteert specifiek beleid inzake verantwoord beleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘ABN Amro stuurt buitenlanders terecht weg’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether ABN Amro's refusal to serve clients permanently residing outside the EU, reported in the press, was an intended result of anti-money-laundering rules and whether such low-risk clients could be exempted, and raised questions on Dutch nationals' access to bank accounts, pensions, expatriates and the investment climate. The Minister answered that banks decide their own risk profiles, that EU rules give residents a right to a basic account, that other major banks may still serve such clients, and that the measures do not appear to harm the investment climate, without committing to change the rules.
It is up to the bank itself to decide whether it considers it possible and expedient to comply with the laws and regulations of the third country.
Het is aan de bank zelf om te beslissen of zij het mogelijk en opportuun acht om aan de wet- en regelgeving van het derde land te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘ABN Amro wil klantdata gebruiken voor advertenties’

Opposition MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about reports that ABN Amro wants to use customer data from its budgeting app for personalised advertising, including rules on consent, what ads would be shown, and whether this is undesirable. The minister answered that GDPR consent is required for third-party ads, that the bank proposes only its own product suggestions for now, and that he sees no reason to adopt a proposed ban on sharing utility-derived bank data.
If the bank also wants to use the customer's data for direct marketing in the form of sending personalised advertisements from third parties, separate consent from the customer is required.

Als de bank de gegevens van de klant ook wil gebruiken voor direct marketing in de vorm van het sturen van gepersonaliseerde advertenties van derden dan is daarvoor afzonderlijk toestemming nodig van de klant.
Antwoord op van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘IT-controleurs: te weinig investeringen in cyberbeveiliging’

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked whether accountant reports give enough attention to cybersecurity and ICT, whether rules exist requiring accountants to check companies' cybersecurity measures, and whether supervision should assess effectiveness. The state secretary agreed cybersecurity matters, pointed to existing audit-related rules and the NIS Directive, and said the government prefers to leave organisations free to choose their own instruments.
I want to give organisations further room for now to choose for themselves the right instruments to make their business cybersecure.
Ik wil organisaties verder vooralsnog de ruimte geven om zelf de juiste instrumenten te kiezen om hun bedrijf cybersecure te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over de berichten dat er snel hulp nodig is bij KLM en dat de Franse overheid niet van plan is Air France te redden

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the ministers about reports that KLM needs quick help and that the French government will not rescue Air France, probing leadership risks, French influence, possible transfer of KLM assets to Paris, and the possibility of splitting the group. The minister answered that the leadership crisis is being addressed, that the Dutch public interest is safeguarded through informal contacts and board representation, that transfer to Paris is unlikely, and that he does not share the French minister's stance on a bailout.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het budgetrecht van de Kamer ten aanzien van een nieuwe deal met Shell en Exxon

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers why the cabinet refuses prior parliamentary approval of the Shell and Exxon Groningen gas deal, despite a motion, and how this fits parliament's budget power and the ministers' competence to bind the state. The minister replied that prior publication would endanger negotiations, that Article 4.6 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 allows ministers to conclude agreements without prior consultation, and that parliament will be informed once a framework agreement is reached, but the cabinet will not seek prior approval.
For these reasons, the cabinet will immediately inform the House of Representatives once a framework agreement with Shell and Exxon has been concluded.
Om die redenen zal het kabinet de Tweede Kamer terstond informeren op het moment dat een akkoord op hoofdlijnen is afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het bericht dat Rabobank haar zorgplicht voor bouwbedrijf Midreth schond

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister whether Rabobank breached its duty of care toward construction firm Midreth, whose house bank allegedly abused its position, and what the banking code and oversight of small-business lending mean for affected firms. The minister declined to judge the specific case, which is pending before the courts, pointed to the new small-business lending code and monitoring, and said the AFM's earlier review found no structural disadvantage, so no further steps were planned.
This specific case is still before the courts; an appeal in cassation is still open.
Deze specifieke zaak is nog onder de rechter; beroep in cassatie staat nog open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Duizenden indextrackers afgesloten voor Nederlanders’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the PRIIP key information document rules, which led many index trackers to stop being offered to Dutch investors, conflict with free movement of capital and whether a foreign-language option should be allowed. The minister answered that the rules are EU-harmonised, that most withdrawn products simply lack a KID, and that the AFM deliberately did not use the option to accept other languages, so no change is planned.
The purpose of the key information document is to give the consumer insight into, among other things, the workings, risks, costs and expected return of the product
Het doel van het essentiële-informatiedocument is om de consument inzicht te geven in onder andere de werking, risico's, kosten en het verwachte rendement van het product
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het financiële fiasco rondom het Haagse Institute for Global Justice (IGJ)

MPs Baudet and Hiddema asked about the financial collapse of the Hague Institute for Global Justice (IGJ), its government subsidies, the oversight failures of its supervisory board chair Dick Benschop, and whether his nomination as Schiphol CEO should be suspended. The government answered that the subsidy was properly spent on the basis of accountability documents, that the Rijk is not liable for debts, that IGJ was declared bankrupt, and that it sees no reason for an investigation or to suspend Benschop's appointment.
Based on the accountability documents, there are no indications that the subsidy was not spent in accordance with its purpose and conditions.
Op basis van de verantwoordingsdocumenten zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat de subsidie niet conform het doel waarvoor en de voorwaarden waaronder deze verleend is, is besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht “CM en SuperRebel lanceren Qrtsjing”

MP Van Raan (PvdD) asked the Finance Minister whether the 16-digit payment reference required by the Tax Authority and CJIB is unnecessarily complicated, and whether a more user-friendly government payment system is planned. The Minister answered that the reference is needed for reconciliation, that the market rather than government should develop payment systems, and that iDEAL is being offered as an alternative, with no new government simplification announced.
The exact figure for payments reported as errors due to incorrect entry of the payment reference is not available.
Het exacte cijfer van betalingen die als fout worden gerapporteerd door incorrecte overname van het betalingskenmerk is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht ‘Kleine ondernemers in actie voor lagere pinkosten’

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether small businesses and SMEs are being used as cash cows through higher card-payment fees and what will be done to lower them. The minister answered that fee differences reflect volume-based pricing in a competitive market, that existing convenant arrangements freeze tariffs, and that no intervention is needed for now, though the parties will be asked to pay attention to small merchants in the 2018 evaluation.
I do not currently know which providers charge which costs to which customer segments.
Het is mij op dit moment niet bekend welke aanbieders precies welke kosten rekenen voor welke klantsegmenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat consumenten bot vangen bij Tuchtrecht Banken

An MP asked the Minister of Finance why consumen complaints to the Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken are rarely heard, and whether banks as organisations should be subject to disciplinary law. The minister answered that disciplinary law targets individual employees, that most consumer complaints concern disputes better handled by KiFiD or civil courts, and that no change to bank disciplinary liability is planned, though a checklist and referral practice were introduced.
There are sufficient other options for holding the bank as an organisation to account.
Voor het aanspreken van de bank als organisatie bestaan voldoende andere mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Groeiend aantal gemeenten weigert contant geld aan balie’

MPs asked whether the government knows of the growing number of municipalities refusing cash at service counters, for a list of those municipalities, and how people who cannot pay by card can still pay. The minister confirmed awareness, gave a 2016 list of 21 pin-only municipalities noting others have since adopted it, and said exceptions are made in practice, such as bank transfers, authorisations or home visits, while affirming access to cash must be preserved.
There is no complete and conclusive overview of all municipalities that apply a pin-only policy at municipal public counters.
Er is geen compleet en sluitend overzicht van alle gemeenten die een pin-only beleid hanteren bij gemeentelijke publieksbalies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het afschaffen van de dividendbelasting

Green-Left MP Snels asks the State Secretary of Finance to answer earlier questions one by one about abolishing the dividend tax, its employment effects at Unilever, who benefits, and whether foreign treasuries gain most. The State Secretary largely defers to a forthcoming bill, argues the measure is part of a fiscal package for the investment climate, and says the net revenue mostly flows to foreign investors and governments, which cannot be quantified precisely.
It is therefore my preference in such situations to refer to the forthcoming bill, so as to keep the risk of incomplete and/or incorrect answers as small as possible.
Het heeft daarom mijn voorkeur om in dergelijke situaties te verwijzen naar het aankomende wetsvoorstel, om zo het risico op onvolledige en/of foutieve antwoorden zo klein mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de sterke rechtspositie van banken in het geval van insolventie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers for Legal Protection and of Finance whether banks enjoy a privileged position in insolvency, whether this disadvantages other creditors, and whether enforcement practices such as collective pledge deeds and irrevocable powers of attorney should be curbed. The government answered that secured creditors' rights are a necessary condition for cheap credit, that other creditors also hold privileges, that no misuse of irrevocable powers of attorney is found, and that the insolvency law reform programme will revisit the position of pledge and mortgage holders with the advisory group.
This subject was already discussed in June 2017 with the group of representatives from the insolvency practice.
Dit onderwerp is in juni 2017 al eens besproken met de groep vertegenwoordigers uit de faillissementspraktijk
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sneller over het bericht dat miljoenen te besparen valt op dure medicijnen

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care whether doctors prescribe cheaper, equally effective biosimilars less often, whether this could save hundreds of millions a year, and what is being done to improve their reputation. The minister acknowledged rising biosimilar use, said the savings potential is uncertain, and pointed to a subsidised implementation programme and ongoing stakeholder engagement, without any structural change to oversight.
Prescribing biosimilars, however, is not a goal in itself.
Het voorschrijven van biosimilars is echter geen doel op zich.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Huizenkoper bij bank duizenden euro’s duurder uit dan bij onafhankelijk adviseur’

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether a report showing bank-channel mortgage buyers pay more than those using independent advisers reflects reality, and what the government will do about competition and transparency. The minister said he cannot confirm the survey's findings, sees no signals of insufficient competition or transparency, and will examine how the advisory-cost disclosure document (dienstverleningsdocument) can be improved, with a follow-up letter to Parliament.
I cannot confirm the results of this study.
Ik kan de resultaten van dit onderzoek niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de informatievoorziening van de Tweede Kamer aangaande de agenda van de informele Ecofinraad van 27 en 28 april 2018 te Sofia

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the agenda documents for the informal Ecofin in Sofia reached the Chamber only after the meeting had started, and about the information provision to parliament on EU finance council matters. The Minister answered that publication timing lies with the Bulgarian presidency, that Dutch pressure for early publication was made, that informal Ecofins are not decision-making bodies, and that the government commits to transparency through annotated agendas and reports.
For the informal Ecofin, it is ultimately up to the presidency to decide when the documents it prepares are made public.
In het geval van de informele Ecofin is het uiteindelijk aan het voorzitterschap om te bepalen wanneer de stukken die het hiervoor opstelt openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de deelname van de ECB aan de groep van 30

MP Leijten asked the Finance Minister about ECB president Draghi's membership of the opaque G30 group, its membership, funding, and whether it undermines ECB independence and transparency. The minister answered that G30 engagement is acceptable at arm's length, that no direct influence on ECB supervision was found, and that the ECB is raising transparency in response to the Ombudsman's recommendations.
The European Ombudsman's investigation also did not reveal any direct influence by the G30 on the ECB's supervision.
Uit het onderzoek van de Europese Ombudsman is ook niet gebleken dat er sprake is van directe beïnvloeding door de G30 op het toezicht van de ECB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over hogere beloningen aan de top van Van Lanschot

An MP asks the Finance Minister about proposed large pay rises for the top of Van Lanschot Kempen, including a rise in share-based fixed pay and pension contributions, whether this circumvents the bonus rules, and whether shareholders should vote against. The minister calls the proposed increase remarkable and very large, says the supervisory board and shareholders are responsible for pay decisions, and announces he will work with the sector on tightening the Banking Code and is considering legal measures on financial-sector pay.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het feit dat een markt voor topbestuurders fictie is

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether he was surprised by a PhD study showing performance pay does not deliver its promise, whether benchmarking top executive pay against peers is flawed, and whether he would act on the Ronnes motion. The minister said the bonus cap evaluation is ongoing with results due before summer, agreed that benchmarking and performance pay are not ideal, and committed to talks with the sector on pay policy and to informing the House on the motion.
I will inform the House in writing about the implementation of the motion.
Ik zal de Kamer schriftelijk informeren over de uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het afschaffen van de dividendbelasting

MP Snels (GroenLinks) asked the Finance Ministry about the employment and investment effects of abolishing the dividend tax, the Unilever headquarters move, and internal civil-service and CPB analyses questioning the policy. State Secretary Snel answered that the government cannot quantify employment effects, sees the dividend tax abolition as part of a broader fiscal package for the investment climate, and disputed several analyses, while not providing quantified beneficiary breakdowns.
The cabinet has no direct insight into Unilever's personnel policy.
Het kabinet heeft geen direct zicht op het personeelsbeleid van Unilever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over foute overboekingen bij ING

Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about duplicate debits at ING, whether such errors are becoming more frequent, their cause, customer compensation, comparisons across banks, outage statistics, and ING's executive pay proposal. The minister answered that the duplicate debits were a human error during a system change, corrected within hours with manual adjustments, that no statistics on such errors are kept, and that the remuneration decision rests with ING's supervisory board and shareholders.
The supervisory board and, by extension, the shareholders are responsible for the remuneration policy and remuneration of executives of financial companies.
De raad van commissarissen en in het verlengde daarvan de aandeelhouders zijn verantwoordelijk voor het beloningsbeleid en beloningen van bestuurders van financiële ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het onderzoek van het CPB “Eenverdieners onder druk”

An MP asks the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the CPB finding that the tax burden gap between single-earner and dual-earner households is widening, and about its fairness, efficiency and international position. The government answers that the individual tax system and progressivity cause the gap, that it is taking measures to lower single-earner burdens, and that it will report annually on the gap in the 2019 budget.
The cabinet will continue to pay attention to the position of single-earner households and will monitor the development of their tax burden and purchasing power.
Het kabinet blijft aandacht houden voor de positie van de eenverdiener en zal daarbij de ontwikkeling van de belastingdruk en de koopkracht van eenverdieners in het oog houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het ANBO-onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat honderdduizenden ouderen met een aflossingsvrije hypotheek in de problemen komen

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about an ANBO study suggesting hundreds of thousands of older people with interest-only mortgages face difficulties at loan maturity, including whether banks refuse renewals, whether the rules are too restrictive, and whether equity release options should be expanded. The minister replied that DNB and the AFM are monitoring the risk, banks are identifying vulnerable clients, a government reaction will follow before summer, and no clear evidence of refusals or overly restrictive AFM rules has been found.
I have no signals that lenders are unwilling to offer their existing customers a new mortgage at the end of the term.
Ik heb geen signalen dat kredietverstrekkers niet bereid zijn om hun bestaande klanten aan het einde van de looptijd een nieuwe hypotheek aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de woekerrente op rood staan bij banken

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister whether high overdraft interest rates charged by banks amount to usury, whether a maximum rate should be lowered, and how overdrafts relate to debt problems and state collection measures. The minister replies that the interest cap is tied to the statutory rate, defends the cost structure and the ACM's view that lowering the cap would backfire, and promises a forthcoming AFM-based review but does not commit to lowering the cap.
How much banks earn from the interest charged on overdrafts is not known to me, as this concerns commercially confidential information.
Hoeveel banken verdienen met de rente die wordt gerekend op roodstanden is mij niet bekend, aangezien het hier gaat om bedrijfsvertrouwelijke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de overval op Rabobank en of banken niet behoren te weten of er crimineel geld in kluisjes wordt opgeborgen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a large robbery of safe-deposit boxes at a Rabobank branch and whether banks should know what is stored in their boxes given possible money laundering. The minister declined to discuss the ongoing criminal case, explained the Wwft anti-money-laundering duties and DNB supervision, and said he will review with DNB whether the rules need tightening.
In consultation with DNB I will examine to what extent it is necessary to pay further attention to the application of the existing rules in the Netherlands
In overleg met DNB zal ik bezien in hoeverre het noodzakelijk is nadere aandacht te besteden aan de toepassing van de bestaande regels in Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Zelfs solide DNB belegt nu riskanter’

MPs Nijboer asked whether DNB's shift into corporate bonds, including high-yield funds, raises risk, whether ESG standards are weaker, and whether the State pressured DNB to protect the dividend. The minister answered that the bond stake is about 1 billion of 18.5 billion euros, diversification keeps portfolio risk stable, ESG requirements are comparable to equities, and the State had no role in investment decisions beyond the agreed internal guidelines.
Because of the independence of the central bank, the State is not involved in the implementation of DNB's investment policy.
Vanwege de onafhankelijkheid van de centrale bank is de Staat niet betrokken bij de uitvoering van het beleggingsbeleid van DNB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over de bizar hoge voorbeeldrendementen bij beleggingsverzekeringen en het risico op een nieuwe (pensioen)woekerpolisaffaire

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about unrealistically high example returns (up to 16%) in investment insurance products under the EU PRIIPs regulation and the risk of a new pension-insurance scandal. The minister answered that the returns follow a mandated EU calculation method based on the past five years, that the issue is being raised at EU level with the AFM, and that Dutch parliament had no role in the delegated regulation.
Parliament was not informed about the adoption of the delegated regulation.
Over de vaststelling van de gedelegeerde verordening is Uw Kamer niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de bankenbuffers

An MP asks the Finance Minister about bank capital buffers, the risk of a new crisis, and whether systemic banks receive implicit subsidies. The minister says the leverage ratio will be introduced at 3%, Dutch systemic banks already hold higher buffers, and that the systemic bank category does not create an implicit subsidy.
The cabinet supports introducing this 3% requirement as a minimum requirement for all banks.
Het kabinet is voorstander van de introductie van deze eis van 3% als minimumeis voor alle banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de ING als huisbankier van de staat

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether ING's proposed pay rise for its CEO fits government views on restrained pay, whether ING still meets standards of social propriety, whether corporate social responsibility and pay played a role in awarding ING the state's banking contract, under what conditions that contract can be terminated, and whether the government would reconsider the contract if the raise went ahead. The minister called the proposal excessive, said pay is the responsibility of ING's supervisory board and shareholders, explained the tender criteria and termination conditions, and noted that ING's board withdrew the proposal; he could not rule out a contract change under the procurement rules.
In my view, the supervisory board's proposal was excessive and thereby undermined the process of restoring trust in the financial sector.
Het voorstel van de raad van commissarissen van ING was – in mijn ogen – buitensporig en deed daardoor afbreuk aan het proces van herwinnen van het vertrouwen in de financiële sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de forse aanblijfbonussen van bankiers bij beursgang NIBC

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister whether NIBC's large retention bonuses for bankers at its stock-market listing are acceptable, given its past state guarantee, whether DNB approved them, and whether NIBC falsely claims it survived the crisis without state aid. The minister answers that the bonuses are legally permitted under the Wbfo with DNB consent, that the board must justify them, that the law is under evaluation, and that the state guarantee was in fact used until December 2014.
Because of supervisory confidentiality, DNB cannot share further information about this specific case.
Omwille van de toezichtsvertrouwelijkheid kan DNB geen nadere informatie over deze specifieke casus delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het afscheidsinterview van de president-directeur van Schiphol

An MP asked the ministers about the outgoing Schiphol CEO's farewell interview on airport capacity, connectivity, selectivity policy, Ryanair, Lelystad Airport and a flight tax. The minister answered that data on the economic value of connectivity are limited to existing studies, pointed to planned selectivity measures and a future Luchtvaartnota, and said a flight tax is being prepared for 2021.
I have no information on what specifically the increase in direct connectivity since 2009 has yielded.
Ik heb geen informatie over wat specifiek de sinds 2009 toegenomen directe connectiviteit heeft opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de juridische eigendomsrechten van slots

An MP asked the ministers about passenger growth at Schiphol in early 2018 and the legal status of airport slots, including whether slots can be withdrawn and how their number can be reduced. The minister replied that slots are permissions under EU Regulation 95/93, not property or landing rights, that they can be withdrawn only on specific legal grounds, and that the slot cap is set through capacity declarations and environmental rules.
Slots are not the same as landing rights.
Slots zijn niet hetzelfde als landingsrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over erfpacht

An MP from the CDA asked ministers about leasehold (erfpacht) disputes in Amsterdam, including court costs, the legal status of the Amsterdam switch scheme to perpetual leasehold, whether it amounts to an insurance product requiring AFM oversight, and the financial burden on homeowners. The minister answered that courts remain open at manageable cost, that the scheme is a contractual arrangement not an insurance product so the AFM has no role, and that the municipality offered a calculator tool and a financial safety net.
It is up to the leaseholder, possibly after obtaining legal advice on his case, to decide whether he wants to bring proceedings against the municipality.
Het is aan de erfpachter om – eventueel na het inwinnen van juridisch advies over zijn zaak – te beslissen of hij een procedure tegen de gemeente wil voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over incassofraude bij banken

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about a reported gap in bank direct-debit systems that allows incasso fraud, including whether banks pre-fund transfers from intermediate accounts and whether they warn creditors of possible reversal. The minister replied that the system complies with EU rules, that incasso fraud is very small in value, that police do not register it separately, and that banks will be asked via the MOB to renew attention to the rules.
Via the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer (MOB) I will ask the banks to give renewed attention to this in the coming period.
Via het Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer (MOB) zal ik de banken verzoeken hier de komende tijd hernieuwde aandacht aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het ontbreken van incidenten in het jaarverslag van ABN AMRO

An MP from D66 asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO's 2016 annual report omitted an incident in which traders failed to report a loss in time, and about the availability and enforcement of the Trading Mandate. The minister confirmed one such incident involving two traders, said the bank dismissed them and a disciplinary body reprimanded them, and stated that reporting of the incident is the bank's responsibility under applicable rules.
It is up to ABN AMRO to prepare its annual report in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations.
Het is aan ABN AMRO om haar jaarverslag op te stellen in overeenstemming met de relevante wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het tobben van de Europese bankensector

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the struggles of the European banking sector, including profitability, low interest rates, non-performing loans, too-big-to-fail risk and a possible next banking downturn. The minister answered that European banks are overall profitable, that ECB policy effects are monitored, that NPL write-downs are mainly the banks' responsibility with supervisory pressure, and that the Netherlands opposes a eurozone stabilisation mechanism.
The cabinet shares the IMF's view that member states should prepare for a next economic downturn.
Het kabinet deelt de mening van het IMF dat lidstaten zich moeten voorbereiden op een volgende economische neergang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de zwarte en grijze lijst van belastingparadijzen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance why Bahrain, the Marshall Islands and Saint Lucia were not explicitly flagged for removal from the EU blacklist of tax havens, and about transparency of the Code of Conduct Group's procedures, commitment letters, sanctions and the Dutch response. The State Secretary answered that the EU list procedures are confidential but Dutch pressure led to publication of list changes after Coreper, that 35 jurisdictions have consented to publishing their commitment letters, and that Dutch measures (withholding taxes, CFC rules) will target listed or low-tax jurisdictions.
The formal procedures of the Code of Conduct Group state that the work of the Code of Conduct Group is confidential.
De formele procedures van de Gedragscodegroep stellen dat het werk van de Gedragscodegroep vertrouwelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘ING Bank wil niet verder met alFitrah vanwege transacties uit Koeweit’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about ING Bank ending its relationship with the alFitrah foundation over suspicious transactions linked to Kuwait, and about money-laundering controls generally. The minister answered that banks must monitor transactions and may terminate client relationships under the Wwft and duty of care, that DNB and AFM supervise compliance, that the fourth anti-money-laundering directive strengthens the framework, and that an evaluation by WODC is underway, but declined to judge the specific case.
It is not for me to give a judgement on a specific case, in this case the breach of trust between ING Bank and the Stichting alFitrah.
Het is niet aan mij een oordeel te geven over een concreet geval, in casu de vertrouwensbreuk tussen ING Bank en de Stichting alFitrah.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Hypotheekkeurslijf nekt starters en senioren’

MPs Kops and Tony van Dijck asked whether mortgage lenders deliberately refuse maatwerk (tailored) mortgages to starters and seniors, whether strict rules deter lenders, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that lenders choose whether to offer maatwerk for commercial reasons, that the platform maatwerk has improved clarity, that about 43% of lenders now offer it, and promised to inform parliament before the summer after evaluating the outcomes with the sector.
I will inform you about this before the summer.
Ik zal u voor de zomer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert over de benoeming van een nieuw hoofd van de Griekse “Parliamentary Budget Office”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the appointment of Mr Koutentakis, a former government finance official, as head of the Greek Parliamentary Budget Office and whether this threatens its independence. The minister answered that the procedure appears to have been followed, that former civil servants can work independently, and that independence is for Greece to guard, with the ESM programme supporting it.
As far as is known, the applicable procedure was followed in this appointment.
Voor zover bekend is bij deze benoeming de hiervoor geldende procedure gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht ‘Bestuur ASR krijgt fikse verhoging van salaris’

MP Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about ASR's board pay rise of over 35% shortly after the state sold its stake, and whether Rhineland governance should apply instead of Anglo-Saxon models. The minister called the rise striking but said pay is for the supervisory board and new shareholders to decide, while confirming Dutch governance rules embody the Rhineland model and that the Volksbank's pay policy will be addressed when the bank is ready.
Because I am no longer a shareholder, I do not decide on the level of pay of ASR's board of management.
Omdat ik geen aandeelhouder meer ben, ga ik niet over de hoogte van de beloning van de raad van bestuur van a.s.r.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Ex-staatsbedrijf ASR gooit salarissen aan de top met tonnen omhoog'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about ASR's sharp executive pay rise shortly after the state sold its last shares, including whether the government will act against it and whether bonuses return. The minister says the state is no longer a shareholder, the supervisory board and new shareholders must judge pay, he will send a letter on ING pay and sector accountability measures, and no pay commitments were made after full privatisation.
Because I am no longer a shareholder, I do not decide on the level of pay of the ASR management board.
Omdat ik geen aandeelhouder meer ben, ga ik niet over de hoogte van de beloning van de raad van bestuur van a.s.r.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de herziening van het beloningsstelsel bij de verzekeraar ASR

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about a large pay rise for the ASR executive board, arguing it clashes with a 2% staff increase and that the state had bailed out ASR. The minister answered that since the state sold its last ASR shares, pay is a matter for the supervisory board and new shareholders, though he finds the rise remarkable and expects the board to weigh ASR's social role, and he described the Dutch corporate governance framework on shareholder interests.
Because the state is no longer a shareholder, I do not decide on the level of the pay of the executive board of a.s.r.
Omdat de staat geen aandeelhouder meer is, ga ik niet over de hoogte van de beloning van de raad van bestuur van a.s.r.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de omvang en de beloning van de directie van NWB Bank

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the expansion of the NWB Bank executive board to three people, its pay levels, the pay norms and whether it is proportionate to the bank's size and risk profile. The minister answered that the board has been three-member since 1993 apart from 2008-2011, listed 2016 pay figures, and said the pay policy follows the state-participation framework and was revised in 2015 with shareholder approval.
NWB Bank will publish its 2017 annual report on 19 April 2018, in which the board's 2017 remuneration can be consulted.
De NWB Bank zal op 19 april 2018 haar jaarverslag 2017 publiceren waarin de beloning van de directie in 2017 te raadplegen zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Rabobank, National Association bereikt schikking over tekortkomingen compliance programma'

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the 298 million euro US settlement by Rabobank National Association over failed anti-money-laundering compliance, including directors' knowledge, the dismissal of a whistleblowing employee, and whether Dutch prosecutors settle such cases. The minister answered that the facts are serious and that Dutch AML rules are being tightened, but declined to comment on the details of the case or on Dutch prosecutorial settlement policy, which was referred to the Justice Minister.
In principle I cannot go into the details of individual cases.
In beginsel kan ik niet ingaan op details van individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Ronnes en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Peking pleegt coup bij verzekeringsreus Anbang’

MPs Ronnes (CDA) and Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about reports of a Chinese state takeover of Anbang, the owner of Dutch insurer Vivat, and what this means for Dutch supervision, capitalisation, possible capital outflows, state aid and policyholder protection. The minister answered that DNB supervises Vivat under Dutch law, that Vivat has repaid loans to Anbang and may not lend to or guarantee its shareholder without DNB consent, and that policyholders face no consequence, though he had no information beyond the media on the Chinese intervention.
I have no further information on the intervention by the Chinese insurance supervisor CIRC at Anbang beyond what is known from the media.
Ik heb geen nadere informatie over de interventie van de Chinese toezichthouder op de verzekeringssector CIRC bij Anbang dan in de media bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht 'Aandelenbeurzen niet gelukkig met nieuwe handelsregels'

Van der Linde (VVD) asked the Finance Minister about reports that stock exchanges were unhappy with new MiFID II trading rules, including a shift of trades from transparent venues to less transparent systematic internalisers, and about monitoring and evaluation. Minister Hoekstra answered that available evidence shows a shift toward transparent venues rather than away from them, that ESMA is working to harmonise tick sizes, and that evaluation clauses require reports from the European Commission.
I will inform your House of the results of the market consultation on the tick size rules carried out by ESMA.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de resultaten van de door ESMA uitgevoerde marktconsultatie van de tick size regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over een brede open studie naar het zorgstelsel en de zorgkosten

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether the government and the WRR would carry out a broad open study of the healthcare system and rising healthcare costs, as promised in the budget debate. The minister replied that the government supports the request, is consulting the WRR, and that the WRR will decide on its work programme this spring.
Yes, we have discussed your request and wholeheartedly support it.
Ja, wij hebben uw verzoek besproken en steunen het verzoek van harte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het versoepelen van de bonuswetgeving voor flitshandelaren

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the AFM may decline to enforce the bonus cap for flash traders and whether this undermines parliament's legislation. The minister explained the AFM's non-enforcement until end-2019 as a justified exception to the duty to enforce, while stating the proposal only continues an existing exemption and that he will not take irreversible steps pending a parliamentary motion.
The AFM has therefore decided not to enforce compliance with the bonus cap until and including 31 December 2019.
De AFM heeft daarom besloten naleving van het bonusplafond niet te handhaven tot en met 31 december 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht ‘Geldspoor miljardenfraude met cryptomunten leidt naar ING’

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that tether tokens and bitcoin price manipulation linked to Bitfinex led to an ING bank account, and whether ING should disclose if the backing exists and what rules govern banks' gatekeeping. The minister said the reports fit known crypto risks, that ING cannot disclose client details due to confidentiality, that banks must apply enhanced due diligence under the Wwft with DNB supervising, that the case assessment is not for the minister, and that he intends to bring crypto exchanges under a regulatory framework.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Geldspoor miljardenfraude met cryptomunten leidt naar ING’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports linking ING to Tether, the crypto-related firm allegedly involved in large-scale fraud, including why banks ended relations, bank due diligence duties, consumer protection and international enforcement. The minister answered that DNB and the AFM supervise banks' compliance and that DNB cannot comment on ING's case due to confidentiality, while committing to consult credit card companies and to bring crypto exchanges within a regulatory framework.
DNB cannot make statements about that, given its statutory duty of confidentiality.
DNB kan daar, met het oog op haar wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht, geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat hoogleraren en fiscalisten pleiten voor openheid belastingafspraken met multinationals

Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether publishing tax rulings with multinationals is needed to remove secrecy, whether rulings can comply with law only if published or stopped, whether they comply with EU Code of Conduct guidelines, and related questions on the 2016 pre-consultation decision, NFIA, the cv/bv structure, transfer pricing and the EU MFF. Snel answered that rulings are exchanged internationally and general frameworks and exemplary APAs/ATRs are published, that individual rulings cannot be published under the AWR, that EU guidelines are soft law with procedural alignment planned by 1 January 2019, and that individual publication adds limited value.
In connection with Article 67 of the General Tax Act, individual rulings cannot be made public.
In verband met artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen kunnen individuele rulings niet publiek gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het bericht ‘Franse regering wil strengere regels voor Bitcoin'

Van Rooijen (50PLUS) asked the Finance Minister whether he shares French concerns that crypto-assets enable tax evasion and terrorism financing, whether crypto investment should be regulated like other high-risk products, and whether the Netherlands will join France's international initiative. Minister Hoekstra agreed the risks are real, said a ban is unenforceable so crypto should be brought under a regulatory framework, and committed to pursue coordinated EU and G20 action and consumer-protection steps.
The Netherlands supports this initiative and wants to play a leading role in the European and international approach to crypto-assets.
Nederland steunt dit initiatief en wil een voortrekkersrol spelen binnen de Europese en internationale aanpak van cryptovaluta.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sienot over het bericht ‘Rotterdam wil af van steenkool in de haven’

MPs Jetten and Sienot asked whether the government will support Rotterdam's motion to phase out coal handling at the port, use its shareholder powers and tariffs to curb coal transshipment, and support similar phase-outs in Amsterdam. The minister answered that the coal contract is a matter between the port company and private operators, that restricting coal handling would only shift flows to German and Belgian ports, and that the state will oversee sound financial decisions by the port company as shareholder.
Restricting coal handling in Rotterdam does not lead to a reduction in CO2 emissions, unlike a ban on coal use for electricity production, which does.
Het beperken van de op- en overslag van kolen in Rotterdam leidt niet tot vermindering van de CO 2 -uitstoot, zoals een verbod op het gebruik van kolen voor elektriciteitsproductie dat wel doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aanhoudende DDoS-aanvallen op Nederlandse banken en de Belastingdienst

MPs asked the Finance ministers about recent DDoS attacks on Dutch banks and the Tax Authority, including whether data was leaked, how perpetrators are investigated, what measures banks take, whether DNB supervises payment availability, and what the government will do to keep access to money and tax filing secure. The government answered that the attacks caused temporary outages but no data breach or direct financial loss, described a suspect arrested, listed existing protective measures and DNB supervision, and said vigilance will be maintained.
There is no danger to the personal data of customers and/or taxpayers or to the security of their data and money, and there has been no data breach.
Er is geen gevaar voor de persoonsgegevens van klanten en/of belastingplichtigen of voor de veiligheid van hun gegevens en geld, en er is geen sprake geweest van een datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over DDoS-aanvallen op banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister about economic damage, whether banks comply with legal resilience requirements, and whether a backup for digital payments is needed after DDoS attacks on Dutch banks. The government answered that damage is limited, that DNB supervises compliance with resilience norms, and that it sees no need for a decentralised backup for digital payments, while pointing to ongoing public-private cooperation.
DNB has set standards for the security and availability of payment traffic in the Netherlands, laid down in the Regulation on Oversight of the Proper Functioning of Payment Traffic.
DNB heeft normen gesteld voor de veiligheid en beschikbaarheid van het betalingsverkeer in Nederland, die in de Regeling Oversight goede werking betalingsverkeer zijn vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het verslag van de Ecofinraad van 23 januari 2018

MP Snels asked why Parliament was not informed in advance about the Ecofin agenda item on delisting eight jurisdictions from the EU tax blacklist, why commitments by Panama and others were accepted despite being vague, and whether the minister would press for more transparency. The State Secretary admitted the item was added as an A-item late and that Parliament should have been informed via an agenda supplement, promised to flag expected listing changes in future agendas, defended the adequacy of the commitments, and said that secret assessment details cannot be shared but some correspondence was published and further transparency pleas were made.
It would have been better if Parliament had been informed through a supplement to the annotated agenda of this change to the agenda.
Het was beter geweest als uw Kamer door middel van een aanvulling op de geannoteerde agenda op de hoogte was gebracht van deze wijziging van de agenda
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de financiering van een kolencentrale in de Dominicaanse Republiek

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asks the government about ING's financing of the Punta Catalina coal plant in the Dominican Republic, including corruption concerns linked to Odebrecht and whether ING's coal policy and IMVO convenant apply. The government answers that ING bears its own responsibility, that existing financing commitments predate its 2015 policy, that due diligence is for ING to conduct, and that it sees no need to talk to ING's CEO.
It is the bank's own responsibility to set an appropriate sustainability policy and to account for it.
Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een bank om een passend duurzaamheidsbeleid vast te stellen en daarover verantwoording af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de politie-inval bij de Eurogroep-voorzitter

An MP asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about a police raid on Eurogroup president Centeno, how integrity was assessed in his selection, and whether he should remain in office during an investigation. The government replied that integrity is essential, that the Portuguese investigation has concluded with no finding of integrity violations, and that Centeno was never formally a suspect.
A statement from the Portuguese public prosecutors says the investigation found that Centeno did not commit any integrity violations.
In een verklaring van de Portugese openbaar aanklagers wordt gesteld dat uit het onderzoek is gebleken dat Centeno zich niet schuldig heeft gemaakt aan integriteitsschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het aanstellen van “ambassadeurs” en toezichthouders

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked about how special envoys (StartupDelta and FinTech) and an AFM supervisory board member were appointed, their time commitment, pay, the plagiarism admitted by the FinTech envoy, and whether appointment procedures produce suitable people. The Minister answered that the envoys' roles and pay were set by agreements (partly via a foundation), the FinTech envoy's post had expired and was unpaid, and the AFM appointment followed a profile-based search and vetting, with pay caps under the WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ‘’Waakhond accountants VS in diskrediet’’

MP Leijten asks the Finance Minister whether Dutch regulators are at risk from revolving-door fraud like the US PCAOB/KPMG case, whether the AFM cooperates with US regulators, whether it will examine KPMG's international activities, and what KPMG settlements with prosecutors have been since 2000. The minister answers that the US cases are for US authorities, the AFM has no known Dutch cases and has confidentiality and cooling-off rules, cooperation with the PCAOB exists but no request arose, oversight of the AFM is its own responsibility, and two large KPMG settlements (7 and 8 million euro) are listed.
As Minister of Finance in the Netherlands, I am not involved in this case.
Als Minister van Financiën in Nederland ben ik niet bij deze zaak betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert en Bruins over de balansen in Target2 en de daarmee verbonden risico’s

Three MPs (Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bruins) asked the Finance Minister about TARGET2 balances, financial fragmentation, possible capital flight, deposit discouragement, and whether TARGET2 should be an EU policy indicator. The minister replied that fragmentation persists but is declining, that the current balances stem from ECB asset purchases rather than capital flight, that discouraging deposits is undesirable, and that the government works on EU reforms to reduce the underlying imbalances.
As I also indicated in my answer to question 2, the current rise in TARGET2 balances differs fundamentally in origin from the rise during the crisis.
Zoals ik ook in de beantwoording van vraag 2 heb aangegeven, verschilt de huidige oploop van TARGET2-saldi wezenlijk in oorsprong van de oploop ten tijden van de crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht 'Maatregelen tegen witwassen weinig effectief'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a report calling anti-money-laundering measures ineffective, including the WODC risk assessment's methodology and the lack of rules on virtual currencies. The minister defended the WODC National Risk Assessments as a sound basis for risk-based policy, noted EU agreement to bring crypto platforms under anti-money-laundering rules, and promised further WODC policy monitors and an integrated policy response.
When these policy monitors on money laundering and terrorist financing are available, they will be sent to your House and an integrated policy response will be prepared.
Wanneer deze beleidsmonitors witwassen en terrorismefinanciering beschikbaar zijn, zullen deze aan uw Kamer worden gezonden en zal een integrale beleidsreactie worden voorbereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Lijst taksparadijzen halveert’

An MP from the PvdA asked the Finance Ministry why several jurisdictions were removed from the EU blacklist of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions, why the grey list is not public, and what sanctions are planned for listed countries. The State Secretary referred to the Ecofin report for the delisting reasons, said the grey list is publicly available only in the Council conclusions and that Nederland wants more transparency, and described the agreed mix of fiscal and non-fiscal countermeasures while promising a separate letter on the wider approach.
I refer you for an answer to these questions to the report of the Ecofin Council of 23 January.
Ik verwijs voor een antwoord op deze vragen naar het verslag van de Ecofinraad van 23 januari jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de uitspraak dat Nederland een ‘fiscaal zwart gat’ is

The SP MP Leijten asks the government whether it is proud of being called a 'fiscal black hole' by Commissioner Moscovici, how often the Netherlands has been challenged in EU forums on narrowing its tax base, and why Panama and others were removed from the EU tax haven list. State Secretary Snel rejects the characterisation as inappropriate, points to Dutch anti-avoidance measures and EU Code of Conduct reviews, and refers to the Ecofin report on the list, while acknowledging concerns about transparency of the list and promising a separate letter.
I have therefore repeatedly pressed for more transparency from the Code of Conduct Group and specifically regarding the process of the EU list.
Ik heb daarom ook herhaaldelijk aangedrongen op meer transparantie van de Gedragscodegroep en meer specifiek rondom het proces van de EU-lijst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Paternotte over de continuïteit van DBFM(O)-projecten na faillissement van de private aanbieder

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance Minister how DBFM(O) public-private projects stay continuous if a private contractor goes bankrupt, following the collapse of a large British construction firm. The minister answered that no Dutch DBFM(O) contractor has ever gone bankrupt, that continuity is secured through project company structures, contracts and direct agreements with financiers, and that the state is not responsible for projects of subnational governments.
The central government is not responsible for DBFM(O) at subnational governments because they are autonomous and responsible for their own projects, budgets and the choice of contract form.
Het Rijk is niet verantwoordelijk voor DBFM(O) bij medeoverheden omdat deze autonoom zijn en verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen projecten, budgetten en de afweging over de beste contractvorm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over het stellen van hogere kapitaaleisen aan leningen voor fossiele investeringen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether higher capital requirements should apply to loans for fossil investments and whether a green supporting factor should be resisted. The minister answered that capital rules serve prudential purposes and should not be used to steer investment, that other policy options are more effective, and that the government will not push for higher capital requirements on fossil lending.
No, capital requirements serve a prudential purpose and should not be used for other policy objectives.
Nee, kapitaaleisen dienen een prudentieel doel en moeten niet ingezet worden voor andere beleidsdoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bruins en Sneller over de rechtsgrondslag van het voorgestelde Europees Monetair Fonds (EMF)

MPs asked whether the Commission's proposal for a European Monetary Fund, based on the flexibility clause Article 352 TFEU, is legally sound, given a German Bundestag opinion that found the basis inadequate, and whether the government has legal advice. The minister acknowledged the Commission's choice and said the government finds it insufficiently clear why an EMF is needed, will request a Council legal service opinion, and favours keeping the ESM's intergovernmental character.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Molen en Slootweg over overfinanciering bij agentschappen en ZBO’s

MPs Van der Molen and Slootweg (CDA) asked whether agencies and zbo's are over-financed, citing a November 2017 article, and whether the government will reclaim the surplus funds. Minister Hoekstra denies the over-financing picture, citing audited 2016 annual reports showing fixed assets exceed long-term debt and reserves, and points to existing supervisory instruments, while rejecting any need to recover funds.
I do not recognise the picture that unnecessary funds go to agencies and zbo's and therefore see no need for this.
Ik herken me niet in het beeld dat er onnodige middelen naar agentschappen en zbo's gaan en zie hiervoor daarom geen noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert en Bruins over de balansen in TARGET2 en de daarmee verbonden risico’s

MPs Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert and Bruins asked the Finance Minister about TARGET2 imbalances across euro countries, whether they are better balanced than in 2012, whether mitigation is desirable, and how the risks (including exit scenarios and accounting) are assessed. The minister answered with the country balances, explained the post-2015 rise as driven by QE, stated that the euro-exit scenario is speculative and that TARGET2 balances are not a government-debt indicator, and noted no EU plans to rebalance TARGET2.
There are no plans on the European agenda to rebalance the TARGET2 system.
Er zijn geen plannen op de Europese agenda om het TARGET2-systeem meer in balans te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de grote achterstanden bij het Kifid

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about long processing delays at Kifid, the financial complaints body, including assignment times, staff turnover and the 180-day internal target. The Minister acknowledged that delays rose in 2017, attributed them to complexity, capacity and staff turnover, said Kifid is independent but the Minister approved its budget, and promised a progress report around summer.
I will therefore report to the House around the summer on developments at Kifid.
Ik zal de Kamer dan ook rond de zomer rapporteren over de ontwikkelingen bij Kifid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de financiële sector vervuilers kan aanpakken

An MP asked whether a new CO2 footprint model for financial portfolios improves public transparency on sustainability and whether the sector should be bound by enforceable climate targets. The minister welcomed the model as increasing transparency, said a Climate Act is being explored and that the EU expert group will report in spring 2018, but noted the model covers only CO2, not broader environmental or social aspects.
I welcome the methodology developed by twelve Dutch financial institutions to map the CO2 footprint of the portfolio(s) of individual institutions.
Ik verwelkom de methodiek die door twaalf Nederlandse financiële instellingen is ontwikkeld om de CO 2 -voetafdruk van de portefeuille(s) van individuele instellingen in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de Douane

Van Raak (SP) asked why customs (Douane) is not designated to use blue lights and sirens, despite earlier commitments and promises to align with the shop floor. The ministers answered that the application was rejected under the criteria because use would be too infrequent to guarantee safe driving, and that a speed-limit exemption and police cooperation are sufficient.
Based on assessment against the criteria used for this, however, this application was rejected.
Op basis van toetsing aan de criteria die hiervoor worden gehanteerd is deze aanvraag echter afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Nijboer over de waarschuwing van AFM voor digitale beursgangen (ICO’s)

MPs Paternotte and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about the AFM warning on ICOs, including whether the regulator can do more than warn, how ICOs work, which rules apply, and how investors are warned. The minister answered that the warnings are appropriate, that many ICOs fall outside financial supervision law, that consultation with AFM and DNB took place, and that he sees no need for further measures beyond existing warnings.
The supervisory authorities informed me in advance about the publication of these warnings.
De toezichthouders hebben mij van tevoren geïnformeerd over de publicatie van deze waarschuwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het artikel dat Nederland nog altijd dwarsligt bij de EU-aanpak van belastingontwijking

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that the Netherlands obstructs EU efforts against tax avoidance and why it is absent from the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions, including whether Dutch tax practices should be tested against the same criteria. The Secretary of State replied that the Netherlands meets all EU standards, that external testing is unnecessary, and that the government will set out its broader anti-avoidance approach and countermeasures in a letter in February 2018.
The Netherlands does not belong on the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions, because the Netherlands meets all EU standards within the framework of the EU list.
Nederland hoort niet thuis op de EU-lijst van non-coöperatieve jurisdicties, omdat Nederland voldoet aan alle EU-standaarden in het kader van de EU-lijst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat banken brandonveilige stallen financieren

An SP MP asked the Agriculture and Finance ministers whether banks financing livestock barns should check fire safety, and whether the state should press state-owned banks on animal welfare and fire prevention. Minister Schouten replied that fire safety rules fall on municipalities and regional environmental services, banks have no formal role but are welcome to add fire-prevention conditions, state-owned banks are bound only by normal law, and she is willing to talk with the Dutch Banking Association.
Banks have no formal responsibility in this context.
Banken hebben geen formele verantwoordelijkheid in dit kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de snelgroeiende handel in Exchange Traded Funds (ETF’s) door de herziene richtlijn markten in financiële instrumenten (MIFID II)

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about rapid growth in ETF investment, systemic risk, whether MiFID II will spur unbalanced growth, governance of ETF issuers, regulation of high-frequency trading, and conflicts of interest for banks. The minister answered that ETFs are not currently large enough to disrupt the economy, that MiFID II adds cost transparency, that supervisors monitor the market, and that the government will not commit to new measures.
Supervisors monitor the development of the growth of ETFs.
Toezichthouders monitoren de ontwikkeling van de groei van ETF's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Slootweg over het verdwijnen van pinautomaten

MPs Ronnes and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance about reports that a quarter of cash machines may disappear, the joint management of ATMs by Rabobank, ABN AMRO and ING via Geldservice Nederland, competition concerns, municipal input, outage data, cash volumes and security. The minister confirmed the plan, said the 5 km access norm would be maintained with coverage of 99.73%, that the ACM saw no competition problem, and pointed to existing consultation channels, while admitting no data exists on outage durations.
No figures are known on the number of hours that outdoor cash machines are out of use due to a fault or being empty.
Over het aantal uren dat geldautomaten in buitenmuren buiten gebruik zijn vanwege een storing of leegstand zijn geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het verdwijnen van pinautomaten en de verminderende toegankelijkheid tot contant geld

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether access to cash is a public utility, whether the decline of ATMs and bank branches harms local economies, and how cash access is safeguarded. The Minister answered that cash access must stay in balance with demand, that banks and GSN voluntarily keep the five-kilometre norm, and that he sees no reason to impose a formal access norm.
I therefore see no reason to move towards setting a norm for access to cash.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om over te gaan tot het normeren van de toegang tot contant geld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Keuzevrijheid is in het geding’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Arno Rutte asked whether limited competition and entry barriers in the health insurance market threaten consumer choice, and whether the government will commission further study or reconsider regulation and a proposed profit ban. The minister agrees competition matters, cites the ACM report on entry barriers, finds current regulation proportionate, and declines additional research as the ACM study already covers the issue.
Additional research therefore currently has no added value.
Aanvullend onderzoek heeft daarom op dit moment geen meerwaarde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht dat de AFM stopt met het onderzoek naar bijzonder beheer bij banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the AFM stopped its investigation into special management of bank SME loans, whether this falls outside its mandate, and whether the investigation will be resumed. The minister answered that the AFM has limited powers over business lending, that the sector is self-regulating via a handreiking and a forthcoming gedragscode, and that he will not ask the AFM to resume but will consider legislation if the code proves insufficient.
I share the AFM's observation that a new situation has arisen since the AFM's exploratory investigation in 2015.
Ik deel de observatie van de AFM dat er na het verkennend onderzoek van de AFM in 2015 een nieuwe situatie is ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over hoe de voorgenomen maatregelen in het regeerakkoord van Rutte III de ‘brievenbus-bv’s’ het leven zuur gaan maken

MPs Leijten asked the Finance Minister how the Rutte III coalition plans to make 'brievenbus-bv's' (letterbox companies) difficult, including which firms would be taxed, how many exist, their employment, and rulings granted. The state secretary replied that the plans include a withholding tax on interest and royalties to low-tax jurisdictions and abolishing the dividend tax, that the number of affected firms cannot yet be known, and gave ruling and employment figures.
It is currently not possible to indicate how many companies established in the Netherlands would have to apply the proposed withholding taxes if they continue their activities unchanged.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk aan te geven hoeveel vennootschappen die nu in Nederland zijn gevestigd de voorgestelde bronheffingen zouden moeten inhouden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een bankenlobby een EU-voorstel om de schade van een bank-run te beperken bestrijdt

MP Leijten asks the Finance Minister about a report that US bank lobbies oppose an EU proposal allowing temporary freezing of deposits in vulnerable banks, and about the lobby's influence on regulation. The minister says the Netherlands supports a moratorium instrument with restraint, that member states disagree on its scope and duration, that bail-in rules and MREL buffers matter more, and that EU consultation and a lobby-contact code apply.
The Ministry of Finance aims for openness and transparency about its contacts with external parties.
Het Ministerie van Financiën streeft naar openheid en transparantie over haar contacten met externe partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de mislukte Griekse steunprogramma’s

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors report on the failed Greek bailout programmes, including the role of the Commission, the ECB, bank recapitalisation losses, evaluations and parliamentary oversight. The minister largely welcomed the report, defended the programmes' necessity, stated that HFSF losses do not burden the Dutch state, and explained the ECB's limited audit scope under the SSM regulation.
I am willing to ask the Commission to also address the follow-up to the ECA's recommendations in the planned ex-post evaluation of the Greek programme.
Ik ben bereid om de Commissie te vragen om in de voorziene ex-post evaluatie van het Griekse programma ook in te gaan op de opvolging van de aanbevelingen door de ERK.
